source_text: in the beginning god made of nought heaven and earth.
target_text: uru-uru tèka, ama lamatua paj'aj'i dedha-liru dènge rai-haha.

source_text: forsooth the earth was idle and void, and darknesses were on the face of depth; and the spirit of the lord was borne on the waters or the spirit of god was borne upon the waters.
target_text: lod'o rai-haha j'aj'i mèka, aa'i-aa'i dhae mèci mèka. dhu abhu, èi. aa maroga aatu-aatu saguru nare ne. ka roh lamatua lela ètu dedha èi èèna.

source_text: and god said, light be made, and the light was made.
target_text: hèia ama lamatua peka, hud'i ku dènge saraa. ropa peka nare sèmi ne'e, ka saraa j'aj'i dènge ka.

source_text: and god saw the light, that it was good, and he parted the light from darknesses;
target_text: ropa nèdhi saraa ne, d'ara na karej'e, lula ngaa dhu na ad'u, mema be'a. hèia na hag'e eele saraa nèti maroga, sèna ka èci-èci ka dènge taa na.

source_text: and he called the light, day, and the darknesses, night. and the eventide and the morrowtide was made, one day.
target_text: ka pangare saraa ne ‘mèu', aa maroga na ‘mèda'. ne'e ne, lod'o ka èci kèna.

source_text: and god said, the firmament be made in the midst of waters, and part waters from waters. and god made the firmament, and parted the waters that were under the firmament, from the waters that were on the firmament or that were above the firmament; and it was done so.
target_text: hèia ama lamatua lii hari, na peka, hud'i dènge ku era talele, sèna ka hag'e eele èi. nèti èèna ka, èi re dedha, aa abhu kahèi èi re haha. ropa peka nare sèmi èèna, hèia èi b'agi dènge mi dua.

source_text: and god called the firmament, heaven. and the eventide and the morrowtide was made, the second day.
target_text: ka na pangare èi re dedha na, ‘liru'. ne'e ne, lod'o ka dua kèna.

source_text: forsooth god said, the waters, that be under heaven, be gathered into one place, and a dry place appear; and it was done so.
target_text: hèia ama lamatua peka hari, aku nèngu na, èi re haha hud'i pakaboko ku mi ca era, sèna ka abhu rai kamango. ropa padhai lii nare sèmi ne'e, j'aj'i dènge ka rai mango.

source_text: and god called the dry place, earth; and he called the gatherings together of waters, the seas. and god saw that it was good;
target_text: ka era rai mango, na pangare na ‘rai-dedha'; aa era èi dhu kaboko èèna, na pangare na ‘dhasi'. ropa nèdhi aa'i-aa'i ne, d'ara na karej'e, lula ngaa dhu na ad'u, mema be'a.

source_text: and said, the earth bring forth green herb, and making seed, and an apple tree making fruit by his kind, whose seed be in itself, on the earth; and it was done so.
target_text: ka ama lamatua lii hari, peka na, rai hud'i pamamuri ku rupa-rupa ana aaj'u. sèna ka abhu aj'u dhu hua, dhu dènge lamusi, aa dhu dènge rèu mangèru. sèna ka aj'u-aj'u se, hua-hela madhutu rupa rèngu. ropa padhai lii nare sèmi ne'e, j'aj'i dènge ka ana aaj'u aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: and the earth brought forth green herb and making seed by his kind, and a tree making fruit, and each having seed by his kind. and god saw that it was good.
target_text: ètu dedha-rai, ana aaj'u se hua-hela ka madhutu rupa rèngu. ropa nèdhi aa'i-aa'i se, d'ara na karej'e, lula ngaa dhu na ad'u, mema be'a.

source_text: and the eventide and the morrowtide was made, the third day.
target_text: ne'e ne, lod'o ka tèlu kèna.

source_text: forsooth god said, lights be made in the firmament of heaven, and part they the day and night; and be they into signs, and times, and days, and years; and shine those in the firmament of heaven, and lighten they the earth; and it was done so.
target_text: hèia ama lamatua lii hari, aku nèngu na, re bèka dedha, hud'i abhu ku mèdha dhu saraa, ho pasaraa rai-haha ne. hud'i abhu mèdha dhu pasaraa re mèu, aa abhu kahèi dhu pasaraa re mèda. rèngu aa'i-aa'i se, j'aj'i tadha, ho sèna ka bisa ige lod'o, hèru, dènge tèu. ropa padhai lii nare sèmi ne'e, mèdha dhu heo aa'i-aa'i ra j'aj'i dènge ka.

source_text: and god made two great lights, the greater light that it should be before to the day, and the lesser light that it should be before to the night; and god made stars;
target_text: ka na tao ka mèdha kapai dua dhu pasaraa rai-haha. dhu kapai risi, pasaraa re mèu; aa dhu ako ana iiki, pasaraa re mèda. aa na tao hua-hètu kahèi.

source_text: and setted them in the firmament of heaven, that they should shine on the earth,
target_text: na tèke mèdha dhu saraa sèra ètu dedha-liru, sèna ka loti mai asa rai-haha.

source_text: and that they should be before to the day and to the night, and should part light and darkness. and god saw that it was good.
target_text: ka mèdha se, pasaraa ka re mèu, aa pasaraa re mèda. dènge j'ara ne'e, na hag'e eele saraa nèti maroga. ropa nèdhi aa'i-aa'i se, d'ara na karej'e, lula ngaa dhu na ad'u, mema be'a.

source_text: and the eventide and the morrow-tide was made, the fourth day.
target_text: ne'e ne, lod'o ka èpa kèna.

source_text: also god said, the waters bring forth a reptile, either a creeping beast, of living soul, and a volatile, either a bird flying above the earth, under the firmament of heaven.
target_text: hèia ama lamatua padhai lii hari, peka na, hud'i abhu ku ae-ae dhu mamuri ètu d'ara èi. dènge hud'i abhu ku rupa-rupa manu-bhui dhu lela ètu dedha rai-haha ne.

source_text: and god made of nought great whales, and each living soul and movable, which the waters have brought forth in their kinds; and god made of nought each volatile by his kind. and god saw that it was good;
target_text: ka na tao ka i'a aa'i-aa'i dènge badha kapai dhu mamuri ètu d'ara èi. na paj'aj'i kahèi manu-bhui aa'i-aa'i. ropa nèdhi aa'i-aa'i se, d'ara na karej'e, lula ngaa dhu na ad'u, mema be'a.

source_text: and blessed them, and said, wax ye, and be ye multiplied, and fill ye the waters of the sea, and the birds be multiplied on the earth.
target_text: ka na padhai lii ho sèna ka hia berkat mi aa'i-aa'i dhu mamuri, peka na, i'a se, hud'i laa bèba-kacanga sèna ka papènu èi ètu mia-mia. aa manu-bhui, asa tabha kahèi.

source_text: and the eventide and the morrowtide was made, the fifth day.
target_text: ne'e ne, lod'o ka lèmi kèna.

source_text: and god said, the earth bring forth a living soul in his kind, work beasts, and reptiles, either creeping beasts, and unreasonable beasts of the earth, by their kinds; and it was done so. and god made unreasonable beasts of the earth by their kinds, and work beasts, and each creeping beast of the earth in his kind. and god saw that it was good;
target_text: ka ama lamatua peka hari, na, hud'i abhu ku rupa-rupa badha dhu mamuri ètu rai-dedha. sèmi: badha-manu dhu ani, badha hui, dènge badha dhu rod'o, èci-èci ka dènge rupa na. ropa padhai lii nare sèmi ne'e, badha aa'i-aa'i ra j'aj'i dènge ka. ropa nèdhi aa'i-aa'i se, d'ara na karej'e, lula ngaa dhu na ad'u, mema be'a.

source_text: and said, make we man to our image and likeness, and be he sovereign to the fishes of the sea, and to the volatiles of heaven, and to the unreasonable beasts of the earth, and to each creature, and to each creeping beast or each reptile, which is moved in the earth.
target_text: ka ama lamatua peka hari, aku nèngu na, hua iia, mai ta paj'aj'i dhèu, madhutu rupa èdhi. hud'i laa ra leru dènge ator i'a aa'i-aa'i ètu d'ara dhasi, manu-bhui aa'i-aa'i ètu dedha-liru, badha-manu dhu ani, dènge badha leo aa'i-aa'i ra dhu mamuri ètu rai-haha ne.

source_text: and god made of nought a man to his image and likeness; god made of nought a man, to the image of god; god made of nought them, male and female.
target_text: hèia na paj'aj'i dhèu rai-haha ne madhutu rupa na. na paj'aj'i si, dhèu mone dènge dhèu bhèni.

source_text: and god blessed them, and said, increase ye, and be ye multiplied, and fill ye the earth, and make ye it subject; and be ye lords to the fishes of the sea, and to the volatiles of heaven, and to all living beasts that be moved on the earth.
target_text: ka na padhai lii ho sèna ka hia berkat mi rèngu, aku nèngu na, miu hud'i bèba-kacanga ku, sèna ka pea papènu rai-haha ne, ho mi ator ne. ja'a hia miu koasa, sèna ka mi ator i'a, manu-bhui, dènge badha-manu aa'i-aa'i ra ètu rai-haha ne.

source_text: and god said, lo! i have given to you each herb bearing seed on the earth, and all trees that have in themselves the seed of their kind, that they be into meat to you;
target_text: mi nanene paie-iie! ja'a hia miu rupa-rupa nganga'a ètu rai-haha ne'e. sèmi: ana aaj'u dhu dènge hua, dhu dènge lamusi, aa dhu dènge rèu mangèru.

source_text: and to all living beasts of the earth, and to each bird of heaven, and to all things that be moved in the earth, and in which is a living soul, that they have to eat; and it was done so.
target_text: ja'a hia rupa-rupa ana aaj'u kahèi sèna ka j'aj'i nganga'a badha. nganga'a hia badha-manu dhu ani, badha hui, badha dhu rod'o, dènge manu-bhui. ropa padhai lii nare sèmi ne'e, nganga'a badha sèra aa'i-aa'i ra j'aj'i dènge ka.

source_text: and god saw all things which he made, and they were full good. and the eventide and the morrowtide was made, the sixth day.
target_text: ropa nèdhi aa'i-aa'i se, d'ara na karej'e, lula ngaa dhu na ad'u, mema be'a. ne'e ne, lod'o ka èna kèna.

source_text: therefore heavens and earth be made perfect, and all the ornament of those or them.
target_text: dènge j'ara sèmi èèna ka, ama lamatua paj'aj'i dedha-liru, rai-haha, dènge isi ra aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: and god ful filled in the seventh day his work which he made; and he rested in the seventh day from all his work which he had made;
target_text: ropa na sab'a èle, asa bèli èèna, lèke dènge lod'o ka pidhu. hèia na ae nèti sasab'a-la'a na.

source_text: and he blessed the seventh day, and hallowed it; for in that day god ceased of all his work which he made of nought, that he should make.
target_text: dènge j'ara ne'e, na tao lod'o ka pidhu ne, lod'o dhu kapai risi nèti lod'o dhu leo sèra. na tao sèmi èèna, lula na pa'èle aa'i le sasab'a na, ka ètu d'ara lod'o ka pidhu na, na ae.

source_text: these be the generations of heaven and of earth, in the day wherein the lord god made heaven and earth,
target_text: d'ai sange ne'e ka, lii lolo ama lamatua paj'aj'i dedha-liru dènge rai-haha ne. lod'o ama lamatua heka paj'aj'i dedha-liru dènge rai-haha èèna,

source_text: and each little tree of the earth before that it sprang out in the earth; and he made each herb of the field before that it burgeoned. for the lord god had not rained on the earth, and no man there was that wrought or might work the earth; but a well went out of the earth, and moisted all the higher part of the earth.
target_text: dhae abhu mèka ana aaj'u, lula na papuru mèka èj'i. taa èèna, dhoka sèb'u èi di, mai nèti d'ara rai ho pabasa rai re dedha. aa abhu mèka dhèu rai-haha dhu tao oka-tedhe.

source_text: therefore the lord god formed man of the slime of the earth, and breathed into his face the breathing of life; and man was made into a living soul.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ama lamatua nare rai ciki, ka na paj'aj'i dhèu rai-haha. hèia na tiu a'ae na asa d'ara sahènga dhèu na, ka na mamuri dènge ka.

source_text: forsooth the lord god planted at the beginning paradise of liking or the garden of eden, wherein he set man whom he had formed.
target_text: hèia ama lamatua bhoke oka cue ètu rai eden, re bèka dhimu. hèia na hia dhèu ne pea ètu d'ara oka na.

source_text: and the lord god brought forth of the earth each tree fair in sight, and sweet to eat; also he brought forth the tree of life in the midst of paradise, and the tree of knowing of good and of evil.
target_text: ètu d'ara oka èèna, na pamamuri rupa-rupa aj'u dhu be'a, dhu dhèu bisa ra'a. aa na pamamuri kahèi aj'u dua kapua ètu talora aae oka èèna. ladhe dhèu ra'e hua nèti aj'u èci, na mamuri taa-taa. aa ladhe dhèu ra'e hua nèti aj'u èci hari, ne'a hag'e mia dhu be'a, aa mia dhu karehe.

source_text: and a river went out from the place of liking or eden to moist paradise or the garden, which river is parted from thence into four heads.
target_text: ètu era èèna, abhu loko èci dhu hae nèti d'ara oka èèna. loko èèna, èpa kacanga.

source_text: the name of the one river is pishon, that it is that encompasseth all the land of havilah, where gold cometh forth,
target_text: kacanga ka èci na, ngara na pison. nèngu ka dhu hae pale-lème rai hawila dhu abhu hualaa ae-ae.

source_text: and the gold of that land is the best, and there is found bdellium, that is, a tree of spicery, and the stone onyx;
target_text: ètu era èèna ka, abhu poe-pai, aj'u dhu raa na hèu mèngi, dènge hadhu kale'e.

source_text: and the name of the second river is gihon, that it is that encompasseth all the land of ethiopia;
target_text: kacanga ka dua, ngara na gihon. kacanga ne, hae pale-lème rai kus.

source_text: forsooth the name of the third river is tigris, that goeth against assyrians; soothly the fourth river is that euphrates.
target_text: kacanga ka tèlu, ngara na tigris. kacanga ne'e ka, j'aj'i mi too rai asyur re ca bèka dhimu. kacanga ka èpa, ngara na efrat.

source_text: therefore the lord god took man, and set him in paradise of liking, that he should work and keep it.
target_text: ka ama lamatua hia dhèu pea ètu d'ara eden, ho na ladhe-leru oka èèna.

source_text: and god commanded to him and said, eat thou of each tree of paradise;
target_text: hèia na hia paredha mi dhèu ne, aku nèngu na, hua aaj'u aa'i-aa'i ètu d'ara oka ne, èu bisa mu'a.

source_text: forsooth eat thou not of the tree of knowing of good and of evil; for in whatever day thou shalt eat thereof, thou shalt die by death.
target_text: te ngaa èci dhu èu bisa boe mu'a. nuka hua nèti aj'u dhu ne'a hag'e mia dhu be'a, aa mia dhu karehe. ladhe mu'a, èu madhe dènge.

source_text: and the lord god said, it is not good that a man be alone; make we to him an helper like to himself.
target_text: ka ama lamatua tuhu haru lii na, aku nèngu na, babe'a na aad'o, ladhe dhèu ne mamuri mesa na. de ja'a neo paj'aj'i hia ne, anga ca dhèu dhu pamèci dènge ne.

source_text: and therefore when all living beasts of the earth, and all the volatiles of heaven, were formed of the earth, the lord god brought those or them to adam, that he should see what he should call those or them; for all thing that adam called of living soul, that is the name thereof. and adam called by their names all living things, and all volatiles of heavens, and all unreasonable beasts of the earth. forsooth to adam was not found an helper like him.
target_text: lod'o èèna, ama lamatua nare rai ciki, ka na tao rupa-rupa badha dènge manu-bhui. hèia na pangèd'u si asa dhèu ne, sèna ka na pangare si. ka dhèu ne pangare badha se dènge manu-bhui aa'i-aa'i ra, èci-èci ka dènge ngara ra. te ngaa dhèu ne abhu mèka anga dhu pamèci dènge nèngu.

source_text: therefore the lord god sent sleep into adam, and when he slept, god took one of his ribs, and filled flesh for it.
target_text: hèia ama lamatua pabhèj'i luu dhèu ne'e. ropa na bhèj'i, ama lamatua nare rui karasa na calaa, ka na pakateme hari nu'a deo na.

source_text: and the lord god builded the rib which he had taken from adam into a woman, and brought her to adam.
target_text: nèti rui ne, na paj'aj'i bhèni ca dhèu. hèia na pangèd'u bhèni ne mi dhèu èèna.

source_text: and adam said, this is now a bone of my bones, and flesh of my flesh; this shall be called virago, for she is taken of man.
target_text: ropa ladhe nèdhi bhèni ne, ka dhèu na peka, aku nèngu na, waaa! ne'e ne ku! sèmi ne'e ku, heka pamèci dènge ja'a kèna! rui na, sama èci èèna ka dènge rui ja'a. aa isi na, sama kahèi dènge isi ja'a. lula nèngu ne, j'aj'i nèti dhèu mone, nèti èèna ka ja'a pangare ne, ‘dhèu bhèni'.

source_text: wherefore a man shall forsake his father and mother, and shall cleave to his wife, and they shall be twain or two in one flesh.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, dhèu mone hud'i tèke eele ku ina-ama na, ho la'e mamuri d'ara èci dènge dhèu èmu-kamali na, lula dua ra, j'aj'i le èci.

source_text: forsooth ever either was naked, that is, adam and his wife, and they were not ashamed.
target_text: lod'o èèna, dua ra dhu dènge boe mèdha-papake, te ngaa ra makae boe.

source_text: but the serpent was feller or more sly than all living beasts of the earth, which the lord god had made. the which serpent said to the woman, why commanded god to you, that ye should not eat of each tree of paradise?
target_text: nèti badha aa'i-aa'i dhu ama lamatua paj'aj'i ètu rai-haha ne, mege ka dhu mèu risi kapod'e-kabèli. ca lod'o, mege karèi bhèni na, aku nèngu na, tare'a, do? ama lamatua kai miu baku mi'a hua aaj'u aa'i-aa'i ètu d'ara oka ne'e.

source_text: to whom the woman answered, we eat of the fruit of trees that be in paradise; soothly god commanded to us, that we should not eat of the fruit of the tree, which is in the midst of paradise, and that we should not touch it, lest peradventure we die.
target_text: ka bhèni na b'ala, aad'o! ji'i bisa nga'a! dhodhoka aj'u ca kapua ètu talora oka ne, ama lamatua kai, baku nga'a hua na. na peka na, ji'i baku nga'a, aa baku g'ag'e hua èèna kahèi, te aad'o na, ji'i madhe!

source_text: forsooth the serpent said to the woman, ye shall not die by death;
target_text: te ngaa mege na dhaa, aku nèngu na, waa! sèmi boe èèna! miu se madhe boe!

source_text: for why god knoweth that in what-ever day ye shall eat thereof, your eyes shall be opened, and ye shall be as gods, knowing good and evil.
target_text: ama lamatua mema kai tare'a sèmi èèna, lula dhu ne'a le, ladhe mi'e hua aaj'u èèna, miu j'aj'i d'èlu-mèu sèmi nèngu. ho èèna na me'a mia dhu be'a, aa mia dhu karehe.

source_text: therefore the woman saw that the tree was good, and sweet to eat, and fair to the eyes, and delightable in beholding; and she took of the fruit thereof, and ate, and gave to her husband, and he ate.
target_text: aa bhèni ne ladhe na aj'u ne be'a titu kèna, dènge hua na ele boe kee. na ngee, ladhe ja'a ku'a hua aj'u ne'e, ja'a d'èlu-mèu. hèia puu nare ka hua aj'u èèna, ka na'e. na'e nare, nèti hia dhèu èmu na, ka na'a kahèi.

source_text: and the eyes of both were opened; and when they knew that they were naked, they sewed together the leaves of a fig tree, and made breeches to themselves.
target_text: ra'a rare ka, heka re'a na rèngu dhu pake boe mèdha dhu hutu ua rèngu. nèti èèna ka, ra lui rèu aj'u ho pa'abhe era makae rèngu.

source_text: and when they heard the voice of the lord god going in paradise at the wind after midday, adam and his wife hid them from the face of the lord god in the midst of the trees of paradise.
target_text: d'ai lod'o nihia, dua ra tadèngi lii core haga ama lamatua ètu d'ara oka èèna. ka dua ra rai lasi lu'u asa ca bèka aj'u, sèna ka lamatua baku nèdhi si.

source_text: and the lord god called adam, and said to him, where art thou?
target_text: te ngaa ama lamatua paroa mi dhèu mone èèna, aku nèngu na, adam! èu ètu mia?

source_text: and adam said, i heard thy voice in paradise, and i dreaded, for i was naked, and i hid me.
target_text: hèia mone na dhaa, ja'a tadèngi lii lamatua ètu ne'e. te ngaa ja'a makae, lula ja'a pake boe mèdha ètu ua. nèti èèna ka, ja'a rai pahuni iisi.

source_text: to whom the lord said, who showed to thee that thou were naked, no but for thou hast eaten of the tree of which i commanded to thee that thou shouldest not eat?
target_text: ka lamatua peka na, cee ka dhu peka, na èu dhu pake boe mèdha-papake? de tasamia? tatu èu mu'a le hua aj'u dhu ja'a kai na, sina ma?

source_text: and adam said, the woman which thou gavest for fellowship to me, gave me of the tree, and i ate.
target_text: ka na b'ala, peka na, bhèni dhu èu hia ho pa'anga dènge ja'a èèna, ka dhu hia ja'a ku'a!

source_text: and the lord said to the woman, why didest thou this thing? the which answered, the serpent deceived me, and i ate.
target_text: hèia ama lamatua peka dènge bhèni na, aku nèngu na, nga tao ka, èu ad'u madha j'ara èèna? ka bhèni ne dhaa, peka na, te mege ne ka dhu ag'o ja'a! nèti èèna ka, ja'a ku'a.

source_text: and the lord god said to the serpent, for thou didest this, thou shalt be cursed among all the living things, and unreasonable beasts of the earth; thou shalt go on thy breast, and thou shalt eat earth in all the days of thy life.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ama lamatua dhoo mege èèna, aku nèngu na, ja'a huku èu, lula tatao èu. nèti badha aa'i-aa'i, dhoka èu di dhu abhu huku sèmi ne'e. mulai nèti deo ne'e toke èu madhe, èu dhoka rod'o dènge kakara, aa mu'a ètu rai di.

source_text: i shall set or put enmities betwixt thee and the woman, and betwixt thy seed and her seed; she shall break thine head, and thou shalt set ambushes to her heel.
target_text: ja'a tao sèna ka, èu loe boe pamusu dènge bhèni ne. aa ana-èpu miu dua mi sèmi èèna kahèi. ana-èpu èu, èèna na kadhi hui tèdhu dhèu. te ngaa ca dhèu nèti ana-èpu bhèni ne, èèna na dhedhe palaho kètu èu.

source_text: also god said to the woman, i shall multiply thy wretchednesses and thy conceivings; in sorrow thou shalt bear thy children; and thou shalt be under power of thine husband, and he shall be lord of thee.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ama lamatua peka dènge bhèni ne, èèna na, ja'a pasusa tabha èu, ropa èu dènge babia; lod'o mora iisi, èu asa tabha j'èra. masi ka sèmi èèna, d'ara èu d'èi taruu dhèu èmu èu, aa nèngu ka dhu ator èu.

source_text: soothly god said to adam, for thou heardest the voice of thy wife, and hast eaten of the tree, of which i commanded to thee that thou shouldest not eat, the earth shall be cursed in thy work, that is, for thy sin; in travails thou shalt eat thereof in all the days of thy life;
target_text: ka ama lamatua peka dènge mone ne, èu madhutu boe lii paredha ja'a, te ngaa èu nanene dhoka lii dhèu èmu èu di, ka èu mu'a hua aj'u dhu ja'a kai èèna. nèti èèna ka, èu abhu huku kahèi. aa rai lèke huku kahèi. nèti deo ne'e, toke d'ai èu madhe, hud'i èu kabèli rai, heka èu abhu nganga'a kèna. dènge sab'a bia sèmi ne'e ka, èu heka mamuri kèna.

source_text: it shall bring forth thorns and briars to thee, and thou shalt eat herbs of the earth;
target_text: masi ka èu sèle rupa-rupa hini èèna ka, te ngaa dhu muri mai dhodhoka dhudhu-sete di.

source_text: in the sweat of thy cheer, or face, thou shalt eat thy bread, till thou turn again into the earth of which thou art taken; for thou art dust, and thou shalt turn again into dust.
target_text: hud'i èu èi kabhèsu haa ku, heka rai hia èu nganga'a kèna. èu hud'i sab'a bia sèmi èèna ku, toke d'ai lod'o èu madhe. èu ne, ja'a paj'aj'i nèti rai. de ladhe èu madhe, èu j'aj'i hari rai.

source_text: and adam called the name of his wife eve, for she was the mother of all men living.
target_text: èle èèna ka, adam pangare dhèu èmu na ‘hawa' dhu sasoa na ‘dhu mamuri', te nèngu ka j'aj'i ina nèti dhèu dhu mamuri aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: and the lord god made coats of skins to adam and eve his wife, and clothed them;
target_text: hèia ama lamatua tao mèdha-papake nèti ka'uri badha, ka papake dua ra.

source_text: and said, lo! adam is made as one of us, and knoweth good and evil; now therefore see ye, lest peradventure he put out his hand, and take also of the tree of life, and eat, and live without end.
target_text: ka ama lamatua peka, limuri ne, dhèu re'a le, mia dhu be'a dènge mia dhu karehe, sèmi èdhi kahèi. de mage dhoka, rèngu ra'a hua aj'u dhu èci hari na, dhu hia mamuri taa-taa.

source_text: and the lord god sent him out of paradise of liking or the garden of eden, that he should work the earth, of which he was taken.
target_text: èle èèna ka, na babèga eele si nèti d'ara oka eden èèna, ho lasi asa era leo, sèna ka ra mamuri dènge sab'e oka-tedhe. lula dhèu j'aj'i nèti rai, de mamuri kahèi nèti rai.

source_text: and god casted out adam, and setted before paradise of liking cherubim, that is, gave it unto the keeping of angels, and a sword of flame turning about to keep charge of the way of the tree of life.
target_text: babège nare si, ka lamatua paredha ana pajuu na nèti sorga, dhu dènge èla, ho lasi j'aga oka èèna re ca bèka dhimu. rèngu dènge samala dhu heo ha'a-ha'a, dhu seru la'e-mai. lamatua pua si bèdho eele j'ara la'e sa d'ara, te nèngu d'èi boe dhèu puu rare hua aj'u dhu hia ra mamuri taa-taa èèna.

source_text: forsooth adam knew eve his wife, which conceived, and childed cain, and said, i have gotten a man by god.
target_text: hèia adam j'unu dènge dhèu èmu na, hawa. ka bhèni ne dènge babia. hèia nara iisi ana mone ca dhèu. ka na peka, aku nèngu na, ja'a abhu le ana mone ca dhèu, lula ama lamatua soru nare le ja'a. ka na pangare ana ne, kaen dhu sasoa na ‘abhu'.

source_text: and again she childed his brother abel. forsooth abel was a keeper of sheep, and cain was an earth-tiller.
target_text: hèia hawa nara iisi hari ana mone èci. ka na pangare ne habel. dua ra kapai ka, habel j'aj'i dhèu madhenge badha. aa a'a na kaen, sab'a oka-tedhe.

source_text: soothly it was done after many days, that cain offered gifts to the lord of the fruits of the earth;
target_text: ca lod'o, kaen nèti isi rai na cahag'e, ka hia lamatua.

source_text: and abel offered of the first engendered of his flock, and of the fatness of those or them. and the lord beheld to abel and to the gifts of him;
target_text: habel nèti ana-ana uuru kahib'i-kalèbho na. na roro kahib'i-kalèbho se, ka nèti sisi dhu be'a hia lamatua. d'ara ama lamatua karej'e ropa ladhe nèdhi korban nèti habel ne.

source_text: soothly he beheld not to cain and to his gifts. and cain was wroth greatly, and his cheer felled down.
target_text: te ngaa na d'èi boe korban unu kaen. hèia kaen nasa bia, ka rèhu na mare boe.

source_text: and the lord said to him, why art thou wroth, and why felled down thy face?
target_text: ka lamatua lii dènge kaen, aku nèngu na, kaen! nga tao ka èu nasa sèmi èèna, ka rèhu èu mare boe?

source_text: whether not if thou shalt do well, thou shalt receive well; but if thou doest evil, thy sin shall be present anon in the gates? but the desire thereof, that is, of sin, shall be under thee, and thou shalt be lord thereof.
target_text: ladhe tatao èu be'a, na ja'a sèmi èu dènge hua iia. de mu pangee uuru ku! ladhe èu tao bhelu, na bhabhelu èèna na'e hari èu, sama sèmi meo neo pacèli maraho. de sèmi èu neo tao bhabhelu, be'a risi core eele ka!

source_text: and cain said to abel, his brother, go we out. and when they were in the field, cain rose against his brother abel, and killed him.
target_text: ca tèka, kaen gale habel, na peka na, mai lati ngad'o oka, we. ropa dua ra d'ai d'ara oka, kaen kalabhe pamadhe ari na.

source_text: and the lord said to cain, where is abel thy brother? which answered, i know not; whether i am the keeper of my brother?
target_text: ka lamatua karèi kaen, aku nèngu na, kaen! ari mu ka mia? hèia kaen dhaa, aku nèngu na, ja'a ke'a boe na ètu mia! èu ngee na, ja'a dhèu kèpe haga na, do?

source_text: and god said to cain, what hast thou done? the voice of the blood of thy brother crieth to me from the earth.
target_text: ka lamatua b'ala, nga tao ka èu bhelu sèmi èèna? baku pangee na, èu pahuni more le raa ari èu ètu d'ara rai, te ja'a dhu kèdhi aa'i-aa'i le!

source_text: now therefore thou shalt be cursed on the earth, that opened his mouth, and received of thine hand the blood of thy brother.
target_text: de lii dhoo lèke le mi dedha èu. lod'o èu pamadhe ari èu, rai sakid'o nare raa na. de limuri ne, rai bisa heka nèti mamuri mi èu.

source_text: when thou shalt work the earth, it shall not give his fruits to thee; thou shalt be unstable of dwelling, and fleeing about on the earth, in all the days of thy life.
target_text: de ladhe èu sab'a oka-tedhe, rai ne hia heka èu ngaa-ngaa. nèti deo ne'e, èu lu'u sa haa-sa dhimu, sèmi dhèu dhu dènge boe era paleo-palu'u.

source_text: and cain said to the lord, my wickedness is more than that i deserve forgiveness;
target_text: te ngaa kaen b'ala lamatua, aku nèngu na, haii! ama lamatua, ee! lamatua dhoo ja'a bia titu kèna, de ja'a pasae mèke boe nga.

source_text: lo! today thou castest me out from the face of the earth; and i shall be hid from thy face, and i shall be unstable of dwelling, and fleeing about in earth; therefore each man that shall find me shall slay me.
target_text: lula lamatua bège eele ja'a nèti era ne'e, ja'a kaj'èu nèti ama lamatua. ja'a kako lole-laa asa mia-mia. de ladhe paraga dènge dhèu, èèna na ra pamadhe ja'a.

source_text: and the lord said to him, it shall not be done so, but each man that shall slay cain shall be punished sevenfold. and the lord set a sign in cain, that each man that should find him should not slay him.
target_text: te ngaa lamatua dhaa na, aad'o sèmi èèna! dhèu cee dhu pamadhe èu, èèna na ja'a huku ne, babia na pidhu hari risi nèti èu. hèia lamatua tao tadha mi kaen, sèna ka dhèu re'a ho baku pamadhe ne.

source_text: and cain went out from the face of the lord, and dwelled fleeing about in the earth, at the east coast of eden, that is, of earthly paradise.
target_text: hèia kaen tèke eele dènge era èèna. la'e pakaj'èu nèti lamatua, asa era èci, ètu bèka dhimu oka eden. era ne'e, ngara na nod dhu sasoa na, ‘lole-laa'. ka na pea ètu era èèna.

source_text: forsooth cain knew his wife, which conceived, and childed enoch; and cain builded a city, and called the name thereof of the name of his son, enoch.
target_text: hèia kaen leo-èmu, ka dhèu èmu na dènge babia. ka nara iisi ana mone ca dhèu, dhu pangare na henok. hèia kaen patitu rae cue, ngara na henok, madhutu ngara ana na.

source_text: forsooth enoch begat irad; and irad begat mehujael; and mehujael begat methusael; and methusael begat lamech;
target_text: ka henok matana irad. hèia irad matana mehuyael. mehuyael matana metusael. aa ana metusael, lamek.

source_text: that took two wives, the name to the one wife was adah, and the name to the other was zillah.
target_text: dhèu èmu lamek, dhèu dua. èci ngara na ada, aa ca dhèu hari, ngara na sila.

source_text: and adah begat jabal, that was the father of dwellers in tents, and of shepherds;
target_text: ana ada, ngara na yabal. ana-èpu na, j'aj'i dhèu piara badha. mamuri ra ètu boe ca era, aa ra pea dhoka ètu d'ara paleo di.

source_text: and the name of his brother was jubal; he was the father of the singers in harp and organ.
target_text: ari yabal, ngara na yubal. ana-èpu yubal, j'aj'i dhèu gai sasadhu, dènge tiu sakino.

source_text: and zillah begat tubalcain, that was an hammer-beater, and a smith on all works of brass and of iron; forsooth the sister of tubalcain was naamah.
target_text: dhèu èmu lamek èci hari, sila, nara iisi tubal kaen. ana-èpu na j'aj'i tuka bèsi, ka ra tuku mèdha ae-ae tao nèti bèsi, dènge tabaga. ana hèni tubal kaen, ngara na na'ama.

source_text: and lamech said to his wives, adah and zillah, ye wives of lamech, hear my voice, and hearken to my words; for i have slain a man by my wounding, and a young waxing man by my violent beating;
target_text: ca tèka, lamek padedha iisi na ètu madha dhèu èmu dua ra, peka na, mi nanene, ee! deo na, ana mone ngèru èci neo game ja'a. te ngaa ja'a dhadhedhe ne, toke madhe.

source_text: vengeance shall be given seven-fold of cain, forsooth of lamech seventy times seven times.
target_text: dhèu dhu pamadhe kaen, abhu huku pidhu hari. te ngaa cee ka dhu neo b'ala ho pamadhe ja'a, abhu huku pidhu nguru pidhu hari.

source_text: also yet adam knew his wife, and she childed a son, and called his name seth, and said, god hath put or set to me another seed for abel, whom cain killed.
target_text: ka hawa nara iisi hari ana mone ca dhèu. hèia ra pangare ne, set dhu sasoa na, ‘hia', lula aku hawa na, ama lamatua hia ja'a ana ne, sèna ka gati madha habel, dhu kaen pamadhe ne.

source_text: but also a son was born to seth, which son he called enos; this began to call inwardly the name of the lord.
target_text: pe d'ai nèbhu ku, set abhu ana mone ca dhèu, dhu pangare na enos. tèu èèna, dhèu mulai manèngi-mangaj'i mi ama lamatua.

source_text: this is the book of the generations of adam, in the day wherein god made man of nought. god made man to the image and likeness of god; god formed them male and female, and blessed them, and called the name of them adam, in the day in which they were formed.
target_text: lod'o ama lamatua paj'aj'i dhèu rai-haha, na tao si sama sèmi rupa nèngu. na paj'aj'i si, dhèu mone dènge dhèu bhèni. ka na pangare si ‘dhèu rai-haha', aa na hia si berkat. dhèu dhu uru, ngara na adam. ana-èpu adam, nuka sèmi ne'e ka:

source_text: forsooth adam lived an hundred years and thirty, and begat a son to his image and likeness, and called his name seth.
target_text: lod'o adam d'ai ca ngasu tèlu nguru tèu, na matana ana mone ca dhèu, dhu rèhu na nare adam. ka pangare na, set.

source_text: and the days of adam after that he begat seth were made eight hundred years, and he begat sons and daughters.
target_text: ka adam mamuri hari d'ai aru ngasu tèu, hèia na abhu hari ana mone dènge ana bhèni.

source_text: and all the time in which adam lived was made nine hundred years and thirty, and he was dead.
target_text: umur adam ceo ngasu tèlu nguru tèu, heka madhe kèna.

source_text: and seth lived an hundred and five years, and begat enos.
target_text: lod'o set d'ai ca ngasu lèmi tèu, na abhu ana mone ca dhèu, ngara na enos.

source_text: and seth lived after that he begat enos eight hundred and seven years, and begat sons and daughters.
target_text: ka set mamuri hari d'ai aru ngasu pidhu tèu, na abhu hari ana mone dènge ana bhèni.

source_text: and all the days of seth were made nine hundred and twelve years, and he was dead.
target_text: umur set ceo ngasu canguru dua tèu, heka madhe kèna.

source_text: forsooth enos lived ninety years, and begat cainan;
target_text: lod'o enos mamuri d'ai ceo nguru tèu, na matana ana mone ca dhèu, ngara na kenan.

source_text: after whose birth enos lived eight hundred and fifteen years, and begat sons and daughters.
target_text: ka enos mamuri hari d'ai aru ngasu canguru lèmi tèu, na abhu hari ana mone dènge ana bhèni.

source_text: and all the days of enos were made nine hundred and five years, and he was dead.
target_text: umur enos ceo ngasu lèmi tèu, heka madhe kèna.

source_text: also cainan lived seventy years, and begat mahalaleel.
target_text: lod'o kenan d'ai pidhu nguru tèu, na matana ana mone ca dhèu, ngara na mahalalel.

source_text: and cainan lived after that he begat mahalaleel eight hundred and forty years, and begat sons and daughters.
target_text: ka kenan mamuri hari d'ai aru ngasu èpa nguru tèu, ka na abhu hari ana mone dènge ana bhèni.

source_text: and all the days of cainan were made nine hundred and ten years, and he was dead.
target_text: umur kenan ceo ngasu canguru tèu, heka madhe kèna.

source_text: forsooth mahalaleel lived sixty years and five, and begat jared.
target_text: lod'o mahalalel d'ai èna nguru lèmi tèu, na abhu ana mone ca dhèu, ngara na yared.

source_text: and mahalaleel lived after that he begat jared eight hundred and thirty years, and begat sons and daughters.
target_text: ka mahalalel mamuri hari d'ai aru ngasu tèlu nguru tèu, na abhu hari ana mone dènge ana bhèni.

source_text: and all the days of mahalaleel were made eight hundred and ninety and five years, and he was dead.
target_text: umur mahalalel aru ngasu ceo nguru lèmi tèu, heka na madhe kèna.

source_text: and jared lived an hundred and two and sixty years, and begat enoch.
target_text: lod'o yared d'ai cangasu èna nguru dua tèu, na abhu ana mone ca dhèu, ngara na henok.

source_text: and jared lived after that he begat enoch eight hundred years, and begat sons and daughters.
target_text: ka yared mamuri d'ai aru ngasu tèu, na abhu hari ana mone dènge ana bhèni.

source_text: and all the days of jared were made nine hundred and two and sixty years, and he was dead.
target_text: umur yared ceo ngasu èna nguru dua tèu, heka madhe kèna.

source_text: forsooth enoch lived five and sixty years, and begat methuselah.
target_text: ropa henok mamuri d'ai èna nguru lèmi tèu, na matana ana mone ca dhèu, ngara na metusalak.

source_text: and enoch went with god; and enoch lived after that he begat methuselah three hundred years, and begat sons and daughters.
target_text: ele èèna, henok mamuri d'ara èci dènge ama lamatua d'ai tèlu ngasu tèu. ka na abhu hari ana mone dènge ana bhèni.

source_text: and all the days of enoch were three hundred and five and sixty years. and enoch went with god, and appeared not afterward, for god took him away.
target_text: na mamuri d'ara èci dènge ama lamatua. hèia lod'o na d'ai tèlu ngasu èna nguru lèmi tèu, ka na ele, lula ama lamatua paca'e ne sa dedha.

source_text: also methuselah lived an hundred and seven and eighty years, and begat lamech.
target_text: lod'o metusalak d'ai cangasu aru nguru pidhu tèu, na matana ana mone èci, ngara na lamek.

source_text: and methuselah lived after that he begat lamech seven hundred and two and eighty years, and begat sons and daughters.
target_text: èle èèna ka, metusalak mamuri hari d'ai pidhu ngasu aru nguru dua tèu, ka na abhu hari ana mone dènge ana bhèni.

source_text: and all the days of methuselah were made nine hundred and nine and sixty years, and he was dead.
target_text: umur metusalak ceo ngasu èna nguru ceo tèu, heka madhe kèna.

source_text: forsooth lamech lived an hundred and two and eighty years, and begat a son;
target_text: lod'o lamek mamuri d'ai ca ngasu aru nguru dua tèu, na matana ana mone ca dhèu.

source_text: and he called his name noah, and said, this man shall comfort us of the works and travails of our hands, in the land which the lord cursed.
target_text: lamek pangare ne noh dhu sasoa na ‘pakarej'e d'ara', lula na peka na, ana ne, èèna na pakarej'e d'ara èdhi nèti sasab'a dhu bia, ètu rai dhu ama lamatua dhoo le.

source_text: and lamech lived after that he begat noah five hundred and ninety and five years, and begat sons and daughters.
target_text: ka lamek mamuri taruu d'ai lèmi ngasu ceo nguru lèmi tèu, aa na abhu hari ana mone dènge ana bhèni.

source_text: and all the days of lamech were made seven hundred and seventy and seven years, and he was dead.
target_text: umur lamek pidhu ngasu pidhu nguru pidhu tèu, heka na madhe kèna.

source_text: forsooth noah, when he was of five hundred years, begat shem, ham, and japheth.
target_text: lod'o noh mamuri d'ai lèmi ngasu tèu, na matana ana mone dhèu tèlu, sem, yafet dènge ham.

source_text: and when men began to be multiplied on the earth, and had begat daughters,
target_text: taa èèna, dhèu rai-haha, asa bèba-kacanga. ka ra papala-palème rai-haha. dhèu se matana kahèi ana-ana bhèni.

source_text: the sons of god saw the daughters of men that they were fair, and took wives to them of all which they had chosen.
target_text: ana-ana mone nèti lamatua ladhe rèdhi ana bhèni nèti dhèu rai-haha se, bhèni iia hua. ka lasi todhe rare ana bhèni mia dhu ra d'èi.

source_text: and god said, my spirit shall not dwell in man without end, for he is flesh; and the days of him shall be an hundred and twenty years.
target_text: ka lamatua peka na, ja'a roca le dènge tatao dhèu dhu lèke-lèke boe se. roh ja'a dhu pamamuri rèngu sa, d'èi heka hia ra mamuri manèro. hud'i rèngu madhe ku. de èèna na, mamuri rèngu se dhoka d'ai ca ngasu dua nguru tèu di.

source_text: soothly giants were on the earth in those days, forsooth after that the sons of god entered in to the daughters of men, and those daughters begat; these were mighty of the world and famous men.
target_text: taa èèna, dènge taa-tebho dhu limuri nèti èèna hari, abhu le dhèu raksasa ètu rai-haha ne. ropa ana mone nèti lamatua leo rare ana bhèni dhèu rai-haha se, ka rara iisi dhèu kapai, nuka: kapala musu, dhèu re'a madhutu lii lolo uru-uru sèra.

source_text: soothly god saw that much malice of men was in the earth, and that all the thought of their heart was attentive, either given, to evil in all time,
target_text: taa èèna, lamatua ladhe nèdhi bhabhelu-katub'a dhèu rai-haha dhu seli-kolane. d'ara rèngu pangee dhoka bhabhelu di.

source_text: and it repented him that he had made man in earth; and god was wary before against time to coming or to come, and was touched with sorrow of heart within;
target_text: ka lamatua manyasa, lula na paj'aj'i le rèngu se ho pea ètu rai-haha ne. tatao rèngu ne'e ka dhu papèd'a d'ara lamatua.

source_text: and said, i shall do away man, whom i made of nought, from the face of the earth; from man till to living things, from creeping beast till to the birds of heaven; for it repenteth me that i made them.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, na peka na, dènge tatao rèngu sèmi èèna na, ja'a huku pamadhe dhèu rai-haha aa'i-aa'i dhu paj'aj'i kore si le. manu-bhui dènge badha leo sèra, ja'a palaho aa'i si kahèi. te ja'a manyasa, nèti ja'a ka paj'aj'i si.

source_text: forsooth noah found grace before the lord.
target_text: te ngaa noh di dhu pakarej'e d'ara lamatua.

source_text: these be the generations of noah. noah was a just man and perfect in his generations; noah went with god, and begat three sons, shem, ham, and japheth.
target_text: lii lolo noh sèmi ne'e ka: ana mone na, dhèu tèlu, nuka sem, yafet dènge ham. noh mamuri dènge mola, koe-kapengo boe. taa èèna, nèngu di dhu mamuri mola. d'ara na dhodhoka ètu ama lamatua.

source_text: forsooth the earth was corrupt before god, and was filled with wickedness. and when god saw, that the earth was corrupt, for each flesh, or man, had corrupted his way on the earth,
target_text: te ngaa dhèu leo se, ama lamatua ladhe ra bhelu aa'i mèu-mèu. ètu mia-mia èèna ka, j'ara mamuri dhèu se ele iie aa'i. ama lamatua nèdhi dhodhoka bhabhelu di, ètu rai-haha ne.

source_text: he said to noah, the end of all flesh is come before me; the earth is filled with wickedness of the face of them, and i shall destroy them with the earth.
target_text: hèia ama lamatua peka dènge noh, aku nèngu na, ja'a kèdhi dhoka bhabhelu dhèu di, dhu pale-lème rai-haha ne. ka ja'a pama'ète kore le, sèna ka ja'a palaho aa'i rai-haha ne dènge isi na aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: make thou to thee a ship of wood hewn and planed; thou shalt make dwelling places in the ship, and thou shalt anoint it with pitch within and withoutforth.
target_text: de sèmi ne'e, noh! èu tao kapa aae cue, dhu tao nèti aj'u adhu. re d'ara roa na, èu bagi mi kama-kama. aa re d'ara dènge li'u kapa, èu lame dènge èi dama.

source_text: and so thou shalt make it. the length of the ship shall be of three hundred cubits, the breadth shall be of fifty cubits, and the highness thereof shall be of thirty cubits.
target_text: mu sab'e kapa na, madhera na ca ngasu tèlu nguru tèlu meter; bhabhèla na dua nguru dua meter; dènge katitu na canguru tèlu meter.

source_text: thou shalt make a window in the ship, and thou shalt end the highness thereof in a cubit; soothly thou shalt set the door of the ship in the side beneath; thou shalt make solars or upper rooms, and places of three chambers in the ship.
target_text: èu tao èmu ètu dedha kapa na. te ngaa paconga ca laa ai nèti kadidhi re dedha. èu bagi kapa ne mi tèlu tad'a. aa re karasa na, tao babèdho èci.

source_text: lo! i shall bring waters of deluge, or great flood, on the earth, and i shall slay each flesh in which is the spirit of life under heaven, and all things that be in the earth, shall be wasted.
target_text: sanèd'e paie-iie! bèli-camèd'a, ja'a papuru èi aae lala, ho pacène eele rai-haha ne, sèna ka pamadhe aa'i dhu mamuri.

source_text: and i shall set my covenant of peace with thee; and thou shalt enter into the ship, thou, and thy sons, and thy wife, and the wives of thy sons shall enter with thee.
target_text: te ngaa ja'a pa'èki lii pajaji dènge èu. èèna na, èu maso d'ara kapa èèna, mèti dènge dhèu èmu èu, ana-ana èu, dènge dhèu èmu ana-ana èu.

source_text: and of all living beasts of all flesh, thou shalt bring into the ship twain or two and twain, of male kind and female, that they live with thee; of birds by their kind, and of work beasts in their kind, and of each creeping beast of the earth, by their kind; twain or two and twain of all shall enter with thee, that they may live.
target_text: badha aa'i-aa'i ra, èu hag'e more ca pasa-ca pasa, eo mèti asa d'ara kapa, ho ra abhu mamuri dènge èu kahèi. sèmi: badha ani, manu-bhui, dènge badha dhu rod'o, sèna ka ra abhu mamuri.

source_text: therefore thou shalt take with thee of all meats that may be eaten, and thou shalt bear together at thee, and those shall be as well to thee as to the beasts into meat.
target_text: èu hud'i mèti dènge nganga'a-nganginu, pala miu dènge pala badha sèra hèi.

source_text: therefore noah did all things which god commanded to him.
target_text: ka noh sab'e madhutu sèmi lii paredha ama lamatua aa'i-aa'i sèra.

source_text: also the lord said to noah, enter thou and all thine house into the ship, for i saw thee alone were just before me in this generation.
target_text: èle èèna ka, lamatua peka dènge noh, ja'a ladhe le palème, te ngaa abhu dhoka èu di dhu d'ara mola. nèti èèna ka, èu dènge bhèni-ana niki èu, lami ka asa d'ara kapa.

source_text: of all clean living beasts, thou shalt take by seven and by seven, male and female; forsooth of unclean living beasts, thou shalt take by twain and by twain or two and two, male and female; and also of the volatiles or fowls of heaven, thou shalt take, by seven and by seven, male and female, that their seed be saved on the face of all earth.
target_text: mèti dènge badha-badha dhu bisa mi'a, aa bisa hia ja'a kahèi, de mèti pidhu-pidhu pasa asa d'ara kapa. mèti kahèi rupa-rupa manu-bhui pidhu-pidhu pasa. te ngaa badha dhu leo, mèti dhoka ca pasa-ca pasa di. sèna ka badha dènge manu-bhui se, j'aj'i hini, ho baku ma'ète.

source_text: for yet and after seven days, i shall rain on the earth forty days and forty nights, and i shall do away all substance which i made, from the face of the earth.
target_text: sanèd'e paie-iie, oo! di pidhu lod'o ka, ja'a papuru èj'i aae mai dhu bhoka boe ca lod'o sa, toke d'ai èpa nguru lod'o mèu-mèda. dènge sèmi ne'e, ja'a pamadhe aa'i ngaa-ngaa dhu mamuri ètu dedha-rai, dhu ja'a paj'aj'i kore le.

source_text: therefore noah did all things which the lord commanded to him.
target_text: ka noh tao aa'i sèmi lii paredha lamatua.

source_text: and he was of six hundred years, when the waters of the great flood flowed on the earth.
target_text: lod'o èi aae lala, umur noh èna ngasu tèu.

source_text: and noah entered into the ship, and his sons, and his wife, and the wives of his sons, entered with him, for the waters of the great flood.
target_text: noh dènge dhèu èmu na, dènge ana niki na, aa dènge dhèu èmu ana ra di, lasi asa d'ara kapa, ho ra abhu mamuri.

source_text: and of living beasts clean and unclean, and of the birds of heaven, and of each beast which is moved on the earth, by twain and by twain or two and two, male and female entered to noah into the ship, as the lord commanded to noah.
target_text: madhutu lii paredha lamatua, ka noh pamaso manu-bhui dènge badha leo sèra, èci-èci ka dènge pasa na, nèti dhu bisa ra'a, dènge dhu bisa boe ra'a.

source_text: and when seven days had passed, the waters of the great flood flowed on the earth.
target_text: ropa èle pidhu lod'o, cag'ag'a laa èi aae lala, ka rai-haha ne, mulai cène.

source_text: in the six hundredth year of the life of noah, in the second month, in the seventeenth day of the month, all the wells of the great sea were broken, and the windows of heaven were opened,
target_text: lèke dènge umur noh èna ngasu tèu, risi dua hèru, canguru pidhu lod'o, ka mulai èi aae lala. lod'o èèna, sèmi babèdho liru dhu bhoke eele sa, ka èi na tao sabhori mai. aa èi madha-èi madha ètu rai-haha sabhoka, ka sèmi tao sabhuu sa dedha.

source_text: and rain was made on the earth forty days and forty nights.
target_text: ka èj'i bhori mai loe boe èpa nguru lod'o mèu-mèda.

source_text: in the end of that day noah entered, and shem, and ham, and japheth, his sons, and his wife, and the three wives of his sons, entered with them into the ship.
target_text: te ngaa lod'o èèna, noh dènge dhèu èmu na, dènge ana mone na dhèu tèlu: sem, yafet dènge ham, dènge dhèu èmu ra, maso lasi asa d'ara kapa.

source_text: they entered, and each beast by his kind, and all work beasts in their kind, and each beast which is moved on the earth in his kind, and each volatile by his kind; all birds and all volatiles or fowls,
target_text: lasi palere dènge badha aa'i-aa'i ra, sèmi: badha ani, badha hui, badha dhu rod'o, manu-bhui, dènge badha-badha leo dhu dènge èla sèra.

source_text: entered to noah into the ship, by twain and by twain or two and two of each flesh in which the spirit of life was. and those that entered, entered male and female of each flesh, as god commanded to him. and the lord enclosed him from withoutforth.
target_text: ca pasa-ca pasa nèti aa'i-aa'i dhu mamuri, lasi asa d'ara kapa palere dènge noh, madhutu sèmi lii paredha ama lamatua. ropa aa'i-aa'i ra d'ai d'ara kapa, lamatua bèdho babèdho kapa èèna.

source_text: and the great flood was made forty days and forty nights on the earth, and the waters were multiplied, and raised the ship on high from the earth. the waters flowed greatly, and filled all things in the face of the earth. forsooth the ship was borne on the waters. and the waters had mastery greatly on the earth, and all the high hills under all of heaven were covered;
target_text: èj'i aae puru ma'ète boe d'ai èpa nguru lod'o. hèia kapa èèna taleb'o. èi ca'e loe boe toke hutu nare kolo ledhe dhu dedha aae.

source_text: the water was higher, by fifteen cubits, over the hills which it covered.
target_text: èi ca'e taruu, ka marèma na seli èpa rèpa risi nèti kolo ledhe sèra.

source_text: and each flesh was wasted that moved on the earth, of birds, of living beasts, of unreasonable beasts, and of all reptiles or all creeping beasts that creep on the earth. all men, and all things in which the breathing of life was in the earth, were dead. and god did away all the substance that was on the earth, from man till to beast, as well a creeping beast, as the birds of heaven; and those or they were done away from the earth. forsooth noah dwelled alone, and they that were with him in the ship.
target_text: dènge j'ara èèna, ngaa-ngaa dhu mamuri ètu dedha-rai sèra, madhe aa'i mèu-mèu. nuka: dhèu, badha ani, badha hui, badha dhu rod'o, dènge manu-bhui aa'i-aa'i ra. ate dhoka noh dènge aa'i-aa'i dhu ètu dedha kapa.

source_text: and the waters of the great flood over-went the earth an hundred and fifty days.
target_text: èi na, kura boe toke ca ngasu lèmi nguru lod'o.

source_text: forsooth the lord had mind of noah, and of all living beasts, and of all work beasts, that were with him in the ship; and he brought a wind on the earth. and the waters were decreased, or assuaged,
target_text: masi ka sèmi èèna, ama lamatua bhèlu boe noh si dènge badha-manu aa'i-aa'i dhu ètu dedha kapa. hèia na hia ngèlu g'oro, ka èi na kura ka noo-noo.

source_text: and the wells of the sea were closed, and the windows of heaven were closed, and rains of heaven were ceased.
target_text: na katange èi madha aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne, aa na taha èj'i kahèi.

source_text: and the waters turned again from off the earth, and went again, and began to be decreased, or assuaged, after an hundred and fifty days.
target_text: ka èi kura noo-noo ka. d'ai cangasu lèmi nguru lod'o, èi marèma heka.

source_text: and the ship rested in the seventh month, in the seven and twentieth day of the month, on the hills or mounts of armenia.
target_text: lèke dènge hèru ka pidhu, risi canguru pidhu lod'o, kapa eta ètu kolo ledhe aae èci, ngara na ararat.

source_text: and soothly the waters went and decreased till to the tenth month, for in the tenth month, in the first day of the month, the tops of the hills appeared.
target_text: èi kura taruu toke lod'o ka èci, hèru ka canguru, ka kolo-kolo ledhe cèu noo-noo.

source_text: and when forty days had passed, noah opened the window of the ship which he had made,
target_text: risi nèti èpa nguru lod'o, hèia noh bhoke jendela èci.

source_text: and sent out a crow, which went out, and turned not again till the waters were dried on the earth.
target_text: ka na patalale lakaa ci'u. manu-bhui ne lela la'e-mai, toke èi puru. ka na lèpa heka asa kapa.

source_text: also noah sent out a culver after him, to see if the waters had ceased then on the face of the earth;
target_text: hèia noh patabuli hari, koro j'aha ci'u, sèna ka neo ne'a èi na puru le, do dhae.

source_text: and when the culver found not where her foot should rest, she turned again to him into the ship, for the waters were on all the earth; and noah held forth his hand, and brought the culver taken into the ship.
target_text: te ngaa, lula èi hutu nare dedha-rai era, ka koro ne abhu boe era tèka. ka lèpa hari asa kapa. hèia noh j'ole ai na, kèpe nare, ka na pamaso hari asa d'ara kapa.

source_text: soothly when other seven days were abided afterward, again he sent out a culver from the ship;
target_text: ka noh tatae hari d'ai pidhu lod'o, hèia na patabuli hari koro j'aha deo na.

source_text: and she came to him at eventide, and bare in her mouth a branch of an olive tree with green leaves. there-fore noah understood that the waters had ceased or abated on earth;
target_text: d'ara lod'o nihia sa, koro ne lèpa hari la'e asa noh, tutu nèti dènge rèu saitun ca rèu dhu heka tutu nare kèna. nèti èèna ka, noh heka ne'a kèna, èi na dhu puru le tare'a di.

source_text: and nevertheless he abode seven other days, and sent out a culver, which turned not again to him.
target_text: ka na mate hari d'ai pidhu lod'o, hèia na patalale hari koro j'aha ca hari ni. te ngaa ca tèka ne, koro ne lèpa heka.

source_text: therefore in the six hundred and one year of the life of noah, in the first month, in the first day of the month, the waters were decreased on earth; and noah opened the roof of the ship, and beheld, and saw that the face of the earth was dried.
target_text: lod'o noh mamuri d'ai èna ngasu ca tèu, lèke lod'o ka èci hèru èci, èi mèti aa'i le. hèia noh bhoke jendela, ka na ladhe palème, nèdhi rai dhu mango le.

source_text: in the second month, in the seven and twentieth day of the month, the earth was made dry.
target_text: d'ai hèru ka dua, lod'o ka dua nguru pidhu, dedha-rai ne dhu mango meto le.

source_text: soothly the lord spake to noah; and said,
target_text: ka ama lamatua peka dènge noh,

source_text: go out of the ship, thou, and thy wife, and thy sons, and the wives of thy sons with thee;
target_text: noh! aa'i-aa'i mi puru ka nèti dedha kapa èèna.

source_text: and lead out with thee all living beasts that be with thee of each flesh, as well in volatiles, as in unreason-able beasts, and all reptiles or all creeping beasts that creep on the earth; and enter ye on the earth, increase ye, and be ye multiplied on earth.
target_text: papuru aa'i badha-manu sèra! nuka: badha ani, badha hui, badha dhu rod'o, dènge manu-bhui aa'i-aa'i ra. hud'i si, sèna ka ra bèba, papènu rai-haha ne.

source_text: therefore noah went out, and his sons, and his wife, and the wives of his sons with him; but also all living beasts, and work beasts, and birds, and reptiles that creep on the earth, by their kind, went out of the ship.
target_text: èle èèna ka, noh dènge dhèu èmu na, dènge ana-ana na, aa dènge dhèu èmu ana na sèra, aa'i-aa'i ra puru nèti dedha kapa èèna. badha se, aa'i-aa'i ra, kalua ka madhutu anga ra èci-èci.

source_text: forsooth noah builded an altar to the lord, and he took of all clean beasts and birds, and offered burnt sacrifices on the altar.
target_text: hèia noh pudhi hadhu, tao mei korban hia lamatua. nèti badha-badha dhu bisa ra'a sèra, noh nare ci'u-ci'u, ka na roro, tunu ètu dedha mei deo na, ho j'aj'i mi tadha makasi mi lamatua.

source_text: and the lord savoured the odour of sweetness, and said to him, i shall no more curse the earth for men, for the wit and thought of man's heart be ready, either prone, into evil from young waxing age; therefore i shall no more smite each living soul, as i did;
target_text: ropa lamatua sangèd'u nare hèu gèmu korban deo na, d'ara na karej'e. ka na ngee na, nèti deo ne'e ne, ja'a huku heka rai-haha ne, lula bhabhelu-katub'a dhèu. masi ka rèngu dhoka ngee bhabhelu di, ja'a pa'ele iie heka ngaa-ngaa dhu mamuri, sèmi dhu ja'a heka tao kore èèna.

source_text: in all the days of the earth, seed and ripe corn, cold and heat, summer and winter, night and day, shall not rest.
target_text: lod'o rai-haha ne era, hèru dènge tèu, kako madhutu atora. sèmi: hèru sèla dènge hèru puu-g'ètu, hèru pacuhi dènge hèru sagoro, hèru hadhu dènge hèru èj'i lai, mèu dènge mèda.

source_text: and god blessed noah and his sons, and said to them, increase ye, and be ye multiplied, and fill ye the earth;
target_text: hèia ama lamatua pala-bagi berkat mi noh dènge ana-ana na, peka na, miu matana pa'ae-ae, sèna ka papènu rai-haha ne.

source_text: and your dread and trembling be on all the unreasonable beasts of the earth, and on all the birds of heaven, with all things that be moved in earth; all fishes of the sea be given to your hand.
target_text: ladhe èèna na, badha hui, manu-bhui dènge i'a aa'i-aa'i ra madha'u dènge miu. miu ka dhu ator si.

source_text: and all thing which is moved and liveth shall be to you into meat; i have given to you all things, as i gave the green worts before,
target_text: sisi badha aa'i-aa'i, miu bisa mi'a, sèmi dhu mi'a hua-hela, dènge rèu ana aaj'u se. aa'i-aa'i se, ja'a hia miu.

source_text: except that ye shall not eat flesh with the blood,
target_text: dhoka sisi dhu dènge raa era, miu madha mèu mi'a, lula samanga badha ètu raa na.

source_text: for i shall seek the blood of your lives, of the hand of all unreasonable beasts and of the hand of man, of the hand of man and of his brother, i shall seek the life of man. whoever sheddeth out man's blood, his blood shall be shed; for man is made to the image of god.
target_text: ja'a paj'aj'i dhèu madhutu raropa ja'a. nèti èèna ka, baku pamadhe dhèu. ladhe abhu dhèu, do badha, dhu pamadhe dhèu, na, pamadhe ne kahèi. ne'e, lii paredha nèti ja'a.

source_text: forsooth increase ye, and be ye multiplied, and enter ye on the earth, and fill ye it.
target_text: miu se hud'i matana pa'ae-ae ku, sèna ka papènu hari rai-haha ne.

source_text: also the lord said these things to noah, and to his sons with him,
target_text: ka ama lamatua tuhu hari lii padhai lii na,

source_text: lo! i shall make my covenant with you, and with your seed after you,
target_text: de ne'e ne, ja'a pajaji dènge miu, toke d'ai lai ana lai èpu.

source_text: and to each living soul which is with you, as well in birds as in work beasts and small beasts of the earth, and to all things that went out of the ship, and to all unreasonable beasts of the earth.
target_text: lii pajaji ne, lèke kahèi mi aa'i-aa'i dhu mamuri, sèmi: badha ani, badha hui, dènge manu-bhui. peka ka laa, lèke aa'i-aa'i dhu kalua palere-lere dènge miu nèti dedha kapa.

source_text: i shall make my covenant with you, and each flesh shall no more be slain of the waters of the great flood, neither the great flood destroying all the earth shall be any more.
target_text: lii pajaji ja'a sèmi ne'e: ja'a hia heka èi aae lala, ho pamadhe aa'i ngaa-ngaa dhu mamuri, aa dènge pa'ele iie rai-haha ne.

source_text: and god said, this is the sign of bond of peace, which i give between me and you, and to each living soul which is with you, into everlasting generations. i shall set my bow in the clouds, and it shall be a sign of bond of peace between me and the earth;
target_text: ja'a pasa saroo ètu dedha-liru, sèna ka j'aj'i tadha pasanèd'e lii pajaji ja'a dhu ma'ète boe dènge miu, dènge aa'i-aa'i dhu mamuri, aa dènge rai-haha ne.

source_text: and when i shall cover the heaven with clouds, my bow shall appear in the clouds, and i shall have mind of my bond of peace which i made with you, and with each soul living that nourisheth flesh; and the waters of the great flood shall no more be to do away all flesh. and my bow shall be in the clouds, and i shall see it, and i shall have mind of the everlasting bond of peace, which is made between god and man, and each soul living of all flesh which is on the earth. and god said to noah, this shall be a sign of the bond of peace, which i made between me and each flesh on earth.
target_text: ladhe abhu ra'i-liru, ho saroo cèu, èèna na pasanèd'e ja'a nèti lii pajaji èèna. na peka na, èi aae pa'ele iie heka aa'i-aa'i dhu mamuri. dènge j'ara ne'e ne ka, lii pajaji ja'a dhu ma'ète boe, pa'èki tèke le dènge miu, aa dènge aa'i-aa'i dhu mamuri.

source_text: therefore they that went out of the ship were noah, shem, ham, and japheth; forsooth ham, that is the father of canaan.
target_text: ana-ana noh dhu puru nèti dedha kapa, sem, yafet dènge ham ham èèna, ama kana'an.

source_text: these three were the sons of noah, and all the kind of men was sown of them on all the earth.
target_text: dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra ètu rai-haha ne, j'aj'i nèti ana noh dhèu tèlu sèra.

source_text: and noah, an earth-tiller, began to till the earth, and he planted a vinery or a vineyard,
target_text: noh èèna, dhèu sab'a oka-tedhe. nèngu ka dhu uru j'ara tao oka anggor.

source_text: and one day he drank wine, and was drunken; and he was naked, and lay in his tabernacle.
target_text: ca tèka, na ninu èi anggor, ka na mahu titu kèna. hèia na puru eele mèdha-papake nèti ua na. ka na j'unu lega-loli dènge boe mèdha-papake ètu d'ara paleo na.

source_text: and when ham, the father of canaan, had seen this thing, that is, that the shameful members of his father were made naked, he told his two brethren withoutforth.
target_text: ropa ham ladhe nèdhi era makae ama na, ka rai li'u la'e, lolo dènge a'a na, sem dènge yafet.

source_text: and shem and japheth putted a mantle on their shoulders, and they went backward, and covered the shameful members of their father, and their faces were turned away, and they saw not the privy members of their father.
target_text: hèia dua ra rare sig'i-kalolo ca bèla, ka ra bhoke mema ètu kabela-kao ra. ka dua ra kako kabodho lasi asa d'ara paleo ama ra, sèna ka ra pahutu mi ngi'u na. dènge sèmi èèna, rèdhi boe era makae ama ra. èle èèna ka, ra kalua sa li'u.

source_text: and noah waked of the wine, and when he had learned what things his lesser, or younger, son had done to him,
target_text: ropa noh mase'a, na ne'a tatao nèti ana limuri na, ham.

source_text: he said, cursed be the child canaan, he shall be a servant of servants to his brethren.
target_text: ka na peka, aku nèngu na, he! ama kana'an! ja'a dhoo èu! èu ne, èèna na j'aj'i ènu nèti a'a mu si!

source_text: and noah said, blessed be the lord god of shem, and canaan be the servant of shem;
target_text: koa-kio lamatua, lula sem! te ngaa kana'an j'aj'i ènu sem.

source_text: god alarge japheth, and dwell he in the tabernacles of shem, and canaan be the servant of him.
target_text: hud'i laa, ama lamatua pataleo rai unu yafet. aa ana-èpu na mamuri mera-milu dènge ana-èpu sem. te ngaa hud'i kana'an j'aj'i ènu yafet.

source_text: forsooth noah lived after the great flood three hundred and fifty years;
target_text: nèti èle èi aae lala, noh mamuri era d'ai tèlu ngasu lèmi nguru tèu.

source_text: and all the days of him were filled nine hundred and fifty years, and he was dead.
target_text: umur noh d'ai ceo ngasu lèmi nguru tèu, heka madhe kèna.

source_text: these be the generations of the sons of noah; shem, ham, and japheth. and sons were born to them after the great flood.
target_text: èle èi aae, ka ana-ana noh abhu ana-èpu. nuka ana-èpu nèti sem, yafet, dènge ham.

source_text: the sons of japheth were gomer, and magog, and madai, and javan, and tubal, and meshech, and tiras. forsooth the sons of gomer were ashkenaz, and riphath, and togarmah. forsooth the sons of javan were elishah, and tarshish, kittim, and dodanim; of these sons the isles of the heathen men were parted in their countries, each by his language, and meines, in his nations.
target_text: ana-èpu yafet, nuka: gomer, magog, madai, yawan, tubal, mesek dènge tiras. èci-èci ka dènge lii, suku, aa dènge rai ra. ana-èpu gomer, ka: askenas, rifat dènge togarma. ana-èpu yawan, ka: elisa, tarsis, dhèu kitim, dènge dhèu dodanim dhu pea ètu sebhe dhasi.

source_text: soothly the sons of ham were cush, and mizraim, and phut, and canaan.
target_text: ana-èpu ham, ka: kus, misraim, put, dènge kana'an.

source_text: forsooth the sons of cush were seba, and havilah, and sabtah, and raamah, and sabtechah. the sons of raamah were sheba, and dedan.
target_text: ana-èpu kus, ka: seba, hawila, sabta, raema dènge sabteka. ana-èpu raema, ka: syeba dènge dedan.

source_text: forsooth cush begat nimrod; he began to be mighty in the earth,
target_text: ana mone kus, ka, nimrod. nèngu ne, kapala musu dhu uru tèka, aa èra.

source_text: and he was a strong hunter, or oppressor, of men before the lord; of him a proverb went out, as nimrod, a strong hunter before the lord.
target_text: a'èra na mai nèti lamatua, aa nèngu kahèi j'aj'i dhèu dhu èra bia magèla badha. nèti èèna ka, dhèu biasa peka na, sèna ka èu more dhèu dhu èra bia magèla badha, sèmi nimrod, dhu abhu a'èra nèti lamatua.

source_text: soothly the beginning of his realm was babylon, and erech, and accad, and calneh, in the land of shinar.
target_text: era na, mulai uru nèti rae babel, erek akad, toke kalne. rae se aa'i-aa'i ra, ètu rai sinear.

source_text: asshur went out of that land, and builded nineveh, and the streets of the city, and calah,
target_text: nèti era sèra, na nare hari asyur. ka na patitu kota niniwe, rehobot-ir, kala,

source_text: and resen betwixt nineveh and calah; this is a great city.
target_text: dènge resen, ètu talora aae niniwe dènge kala. aa'i-aa'i sèra, kota-kota kapai hua.

source_text: and soothly mizraim begat ludim, and anamim, and lehabim, and naphtuhim,
target_text: ana-èpu misraim, ka: dhèu ludim, dhèu ananim, dhèu lehabim, dhèu naftuhim,

source_text: and pathrusim, and casluhim; of which the philistines and caphtorim came forth.
target_text: dhèu patrusim, dhèu kasluhim, dènge dhèu kaftorim. dhèu kasluhim nuka bèi-baki nèti dhèu pilistin.

source_text: forsooth canaan engendered sidon, his first engendered son, heth,
target_text: ana uuru kana'an, nuka, sidon. kana'an j'aj'i bèi-baki nèti dhèu het,

source_text: and jebusites, and amorites, girgashites,
target_text: dhèu yebusi, dhèu amori, dhèu girgasi,

source_text: hivites, and arkites, sinites,
target_text: dhèu hiwi, dhèu arki, dhèu sini,

source_text: and arvadites, zemarites, and hamathites; and the peoples of canaanites were sown abroad by these men.
target_text: dhèu arwadi, dhèu semari, dènge dhèu hamati. ana-èpu kana'an se, pea palème d'ai era dhu kaj'èu,

source_text: and the terms of canaan were made to men coming from sidon to gerar, till to gaza, till thou enter into sodom, and gomorrah, and admah, and zeboiim, till to lasha.
target_text: toke too rai rèngu mulai nèti sidon taruu asa gerar, d'ai gasa. nèti èèna, la'e d'ai sodom, gomora, adma dènge seboim, d'ai kota lasa.

source_text: these were the sons of ham, in their kindreds, and languages, and generations, and lands, and folks.
target_text: rèngu aa'i-aa'i sèra, ana-èpu ham. èci-èci dènge lii, suku, aa dènge rai ra.

source_text: also of shem were born the fathers of all the sons of eber, and japheth was the more, or elder, brother of shemor shem was the more or elder brother of japheth.
target_text: sem, a'a yafet, nèngu ka j'aj'i bèi-baki dhèu eber.

source_text: the sons of shem were elam, and asshur, and arphaxad, and lud, and aram.
target_text: ana-èpu sem, ka: elam, asyur, arpaksad, lud dènge aram.

source_text: the sons of aram were uz, and hul, and gether, and mash.
target_text: ana-èpu aram ka: dhèu us, dhèu hul, dhèu geter, dènge dhèu mas.

source_text: and soothly arphaxad begat salah, of whom eber was born.
target_text: ana arpaksad ka, sela. ana sela ka, eber.

source_text: and two sons were born to eber, the name to the one son was peleg, for the land was parted in his days; and the name of his brother was joktan.
target_text: ana eber, mone dhèu dua. ana uuru, ngara na pelek dhu sasoa na ‘palème era', lula taa èèna dhèu pea palème ètu rai-haha ne. ngara ari na, yoktan.

source_text: and that joktan begat almodad, and sheleph, and hazarmaveth, jerah,
target_text: ana-èpu yoktan, ka: almodad, selef, hasar-mawet, yera,

source_text: and hadoram, and uzal, and diklah,
target_text: hadoram, usal, dikla,

source_text: and obal, and abimael, sheba,
target_text: obal, abimael, syeba,

source_text: and ophir, and havilah, and jobab; all these were the sons of joktan.
target_text: ofir, hawila, dènge yobab. rèngu aa'i-aa'i se, ana-èpu yoktan.

source_text: and the habitation of them was made from mesha, as men goeth till to sephar, an hill of the east.
target_text: era pea rèngu, mulai nèti mesa, taruu d'ai sefar, nuka era dhu kabhuku re sebhe dhimu.

source_text: these be the sons of shem, by kindreds, and languages, and countries, in their folks.
target_text: rèngu aa'i-aa'i se, ana-èpu sem. èci-èci ka dènge lii, suku, aa dènge rai ra.

source_text: these be the meines of noah, by their peoples, and nations; the folks or gentiles in the earth were parted of these after the great flood.
target_text: aa'i-aa'i se, ana-èpu noh, èci-èci ka dènge suku ra. ropa èi aae lala èle, rèngu se'e ka pea papènu lème rai-haha ne.

source_text: forsooth the land was of one language, and of the same speech or the same words.
target_text: uru-uru tèka na, dhèu ètu rai-haha ne, dhoka lii èci di.

source_text: and when they went forth from the east, they found a field in the land of shinar, and they dwelled therein.
target_text: lod'o rèngu cahag'e lasi asa ca bèka dhimu, ra d'ai era mera ètu sinear, ka ra pea ètu èèna.

source_text: and one said to his neighbour, come ye, and make we tilestones, and bake we those or them with fire; and they had tile for stones, and pitch, either strong glue, for mortar; and they said, come ye, and make we to us a city and a tower, whose highness stretch till to heaven; and make we solemn our name, before that we be parted into all lands.
target_text: rèngu aa'i-aa'i rare lii èci, aku rèngu na, a'ari, ee! mai ta patitu kota kapai aae cue. ti tao hadhu bata; ti tunu pa'adhu. èèna na, èdhi pudhi sa dedha, ho ti tape dènge èi dama. ho èèna na, ti patitu manara dedha aae èci, dhu kolo nèngu na d'ai dedha-liru, sèna ka èdhi abhu kolongara kapai. ho sèna ka èdhi j'aj'i ca kabarai aae, dhu pahag'a ia ka.

source_text: forsooth the lord came down to see the city, and the tower, which the sons of adam builded.
target_text: hèia lamatua puru mai laladhe kota dènge manara dhu ra patitu èèna.

source_text: and he said, lo! the people is one, and one language is to all, and they have begun to make this; neither they shall cease of their thoughts, till they ful fill those or them in work;
target_text: ka na peka na, dhèu rai-haha se, aa'i-aa'i ra ca kabarai, dènge lii èci di. ngaa dhu rèngu tao ne, heka mulai kèna. bèli-camèd'a ladhe rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra j'aj'i mi èci sèmi ne'e, èèna na, ngaa dhu rèngu neo tao, j'aj'i aa'i mèu-mèu.

source_text: therefore come ye, go we down, and shame or confound we there the tongue of them, that each man hear not the voice of his neighbour.
target_text: de be'a risi, èdhi puru lati ho tao lii si baka-leo, ho sèna ka èci ne'a boe lii èci.

source_text: and so the lord separated them from that place into all lands; and they ceased to build the city.
target_text: hèia lamatua puru, ka kakeho lii ra. dènge j'ara sèmi èèna, na pacèri si palème rai-haha ne. ka ra pakèd'i taruu heka kota deo na.

source_text: and therefore the name thereof was called babel, for the language of all the earth was confounded there; and from thence the lord scattered them on the face of all countries.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ra pangare kota na, babel dhu sasoa na ‘pab'ingu', lula lamatua kakeho lii ra, aa pacèri eele si palème rai-haha ne.

source_text: these be the generations of shem. shem was an hundred years when he begat arphaxad, two years after the great flood.
target_text: se'e se, ana-èpu sem. ropa èle èi aae lala dua tèu sa, sem mamuri cangasu tèu kèna, ka na abhu ana mone ca dhèu, ngara na arpaksad.

source_text: and shem lived after that he begat arphaxad five hundred years, and begat sons and daughters.
target_text: ka sem mamuri hari d'ai lèmi ngasu tèu, na abhu hari ana mone dènge ana bhèni.

source_text: forsooth arphaxad lived five and thirty years, and begat salah;
target_text: lod'o umur arpaksad d'ai tèlu nguru lèmi tèu, na abhu ana mone ca dhèu, ngara na sela.

source_text: and arphaxad lived after that he begat salah three hundred and three years, and begat sons and daughters.
target_text: ka arpaksad mamuri hari d'ai èpa ngasu tèlu tèu, na abhu hari ana mone dènge ana bhèni.

source_text: and salah lived thirty years, and begat eber;
target_text: lod'o umur sela d'ai tèlu nguru tèu, na abhu ana mone ca dhèu, ngara na eber.

source_text: and salah lived after that he begat eber four hundred and three years, and begat sons and daughters.
target_text: ka sela mamuri hari d'ai èpa ngasu tèlu tèu, na abhu hari ana mone dènge ana bhèni.

source_text: soothly eber lived four and thirty years, and begat peleg;
target_text: lod'o umur eber d'ai tèlu nguru èpa tèu, na abhu ana mone ca dhèu, ngara na pelek.

source_text: and eber lived after that he begat peleg four hundred and thirty years, and begat sons and daughters.
target_text: ka eber mamuri era d'ai èpa ngasu tèlu nguru tèu, na abhu hari ana mone dènge ana bhèni.

source_text: also peleg lived thirty years, and begat reu;
target_text: lod'o umur pelek d'ai tèlu nguru tèu, na matana ana mone ca dhèu, ngara na rehu.

source_text: and peleg lived after that he begat reu two hundred and nine years, and begat sons and daughters.
target_text: ka pelek mamuri era d'ai dua ngasu ceo tèu, na abhu hari ana mone dènge ana bhèni.

source_text: and reu lived two and thirty years, and begat serug;
target_text: lod'o umur rehu d'ai tèlu nguru dua tèu, na abhu ana mone èci, ngara na seruk.

source_text: and reu lived after that he begat serug two hundred and seven years, and begat sons and daughters.
target_text: ka rehu mamuri era d'ai dua ngasu pidhu tèu, na abhu hari ana mone dènge ana bhèni.

source_text: soothly serug lived thirty years, and begat nahor;
target_text: lod'o umur seruk d'ai tèlu nguru tèu, na matana ana mone ca dhèu, ngara na nahor.

source_text: and serug lived after that he begat nahor two hundred years, and begat sons and daughters.
target_text: ka seruk mamuri era d'ai dua ngasu tèu, ka na abhu hari ana mone dènge ana bhèni.

source_text: forsooth nahor lived nine and twenty years, and begat terah;
target_text: lod'o umur nahor d'ai dua nguru ceo tèu, na abhu ana mone èci, ngara na tera.

source_text: and nahor lived after that he begat terah an hundred and nineteen years, and begat sons and daughters.
target_text: ka nahor mamuri era d'ai cangasu canguru ceo tèu, ka na abhu hari ana mone dènge ana bhèni.

source_text: and terah lived seventy years, and begat abram, nahor, and haran.
target_text: lod'o umur tera d'ai pidhu nguru tèu risi, na abhu ana mone, dhèu tèlu: abram, nahor, dènge haran.

source_text: soothly these be the generations of terah. terah begat abram, nahor, and haran. forsooth haran begat lot;
target_text: ana-èpu tera, sèmi ne'e: ana mone na, ka: abram, nahor, dènge haran. haran abhu ana mone ca dhèu, ngara na lot.

source_text: and haran died before terah, his father, in the land of his nativity, in ur of chaldees.
target_text: haran madhe ètu rae èta-èsu na, ngara na ur, rai dhèu kasdim. lod'o èèna, ama na tera mamuri era.

source_text: forsooth abram and nahor wedded wives; the name of the wife of abram was sarai, and the name of the wife of nahor was milcah, the daughter of haran, father of milcah, and father of iscah.
target_text: abram madhèdi dènge sarai. nahor leo dènge ana bhèni haran, ngara na milka. haran abhu ana mone èci kahèi, ngara na yiska.

source_text: soothly sarai was barren, and had no children.
target_text: te ngaa sarai dènge boe ana.

source_text: and so terah took abram, his son, and lot, the son of haran, his son, and sarai, his daughter-in-law, the wife of abram, his son, and led them out of ur of chaldees, that they should go into the land of canaan; and they came unto haran, and dwelled there.
target_text: ca tèka, tera nèti ana na abram, dènge sarai dhèu èmu abram, dènge èpu na lot, lasi tèke eele rae ur, neo lasi asa rai kana'an. te ngaa lasi d'ai rae haran, rèngu pea ka ètu èèna.

source_text: and the days of terah were made two hundred years and five, and he was dead in haran.
target_text: tera madhe ètu èèna, dènge umur na dua ngasu lèmi tèu.

source_text: forsooth the lord said to abram, go thou out of thy land, and of thy kindred, and of the house of thy father, and come thou into the land which i shall show to thee;
target_text: lod'o èèna, lamatua peka le dènge abram, peka na, abram! èu pakèd'i nèti era èu ne, tèke eele ina-ama èu, èmu ina-ama mu, dènge rae-lesa èu. lamu asa era èci, dhu pe ja'a peka dènge èu.

source_text: and i shall make thee into a great folk, and i shall bless thee, and i shall magnify thy name, and thou shalt be blessed;
target_text: èèna na, ja'a hia mèngi-nale mi èu. aa ana-èpu èu, èèna na, bèba-kacanga, j'aj'i suku dhu kapai, toke dhèu tadhe kolongara èu. ho bèli-camèd'a, èu j'aj'i berkat hia dhèu leo kahèi.

source_text: i shall bless them that bless thee, and i shall curse them that curse thee; and all kindreds of the earth shall be blessed in thee.
target_text: èèna na, ja'a hia berkat mi dhèu dhu hia berkat mi èu. te ngaa ja'a huku dhèu cee dhu dhoo èu. nanene paie! pe èèna na, dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne abhu berkat lula èu.

source_text: and so abram went out, as the lord commanded him, and lot went with him. abram was five and seventy years when he went out of haran. and he took sarai, his wife, and lot, the son of his brother, and all the substance which they had in possession, and the men which they had begotten in haran; and they went out that they should go into the land of canaan. and when they came into it,
target_text: lod'o èèna, umur abram pidhu nguru lèmi tèu. na nèti dhèu èmu na sarai, aa dènge ana ari na, lot, dènge mèdha-panyau ra aa'i-aa'i, aa dènge dhèu sab'a na aa'i-aa'i dhu na abhu ètu kota haran. hèia abram si lasi ka, tèke eele kota haran, asa era dhu lamatua peka le dènge ne. ka ra kako taruu, d'ai rai èci, ngara na kana'an.

source_text: abram passed through the land till to the place of shechem, and till to the noble valley. forsooth canaanite was then in the land.
target_text: d'ai era èèna, abram kako palème rai ne, toke d'ai padètu dènge rae èci, ngara na sikem. ka ra pea taha ètu èèna, padètu dènge aj'u aae ca kapua ètu more. lod'o èèna, dhèu kana'an dhu pea ètu èèna era.

source_text: soothly the lord appeared to abram, and said to him, i shall give this land to thy seed. and abram built there an altar to the lord, that appeared to him.
target_text: ètu era èèna ka, lamatua pad'elo iisi na mi abram, peka na, èèna na, ja'a hia ana-èpu èu rai ne'e ne. ka abram pudhi hadhu tao mei korban hia lamatua dhu pad'elo iisi na dènge nèngu ètu era èèna.

source_text: and from thence he passed forth to the hill or the mount of bethel, that was against the east, and setted there his tabernacle, having bethel from the west, and hai from the east. and he builded also there an altar to the lord, and inwardly called his name.
target_text: èle èèna ka, abram si pidha hari asa ledhe re balèu. ka ra pea taha ètu talora rae betel dènge rae ai. ètu èèna, na patitu mei korban èci ho na mangaj'i mi lamatua.
