source_text: which answered, we each saw a dream, and there is no man that expoundeth it to us. and joseph said to them, whether the expounding is not of god? tell ye to me what ye have seen.
target_text: hèia ra dhaa, peka na, mèda deo na, ji'i nii. te ngaa ji'i nge'a boe sasoa na samia! hèia yusuf peka dènge dua ra, aku nèngu na, dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne'e, èci sa re'a boe sasoa nii, dhodhoka ama lamatua di. de miu lolo ku laa. pe èèna ho ja'a karèi sasoa nèti lamatua.

source_text: the master butler told first his dream; i saw before me that a vine,
target_text: hèia dhèu dhu lalau dhua èi hia dhèu aae èèna, lolo uuru peka na, ètu d'ara nii, ja'a ladhe kèdhi aj'u anggor ca kapua.

source_text: in which were three scions, waxed little and little into burgeonings, and that after the flowers, the grapes waxed ripe,
target_text: aj'u anggor ne dadana nèngu tèlu di. aj'u na muri mai ka dènge rèu, hela, dènge hua giru-gari dhu madhasa.

source_text: and the cup of pharaoh was in mine hand; therefore i took the grapes, and pressed them out into the cup that i held, and i gave drink to pharaoh.
target_text: aa ja'a kèd'u galaa dhu dhèu aae biasa pake ninu. ja'a puu hua anggor, ka pacèli èi sa d'ara galaa deo na. hèia kèti asa dhèu aae, hia na ninu.

source_text: joseph answered, this is the expounding of the dream; three scions be yet three days,
target_text: tadèngi nare hèia, yusuf peka dènge ne sèmi ne'e ka, ama, ee. sasoa nii na sèmi ne'e ka: dadana tèlu, sasoa na di tèlu lod'o ka.

source_text: after which pharaoh shall have mind of thy service, and he shall restore thee into the first degree, and thou shalt give to him the cup, by thine office, as thou were wont to do before.
target_text: ètu d'ara tèlu lod'o ne, dhèu aae kalua eele ama nèti d'ara bèdho ne'e. ho na hia hari, ama lalau dhua èi hia dhèu aae sèmi uru na.

source_text: only have thou mind of me, when it is well to thee, and thou shalt do mercy with me, that thou make suggestion to pharaoh, that he lead me out of this prison;
target_text: ladhe ama abhu babe'a sèmi èèna, baku bhèlu ja'a, ee? ladhe ama sue ja'a, peka dènge dhèu aae kalua eele ja'a nèti era ne'e.

source_text: for thiefly, that is, by thievery, i am taken away from the land of hebrews, and here i am sent innocent into prison.
target_text: te ja'a ne, madhutu madha j'ara na dhu mola, rèngu se rare ja'a dènge laka-seti, nèti rae dhèu ibrani. d'ai era ne'e, ja'a tao boe sasala ngaa èci sa. te ngaa rèngu pamaso ja'a asa d'ara bèdho ne'e. rèngu tao ja'a sèmi dhèu bhelu-katub'a sa.

source_text: the master baker saw that joseph had declared prudently the dream, and he said, and i saw a dream, that i had three baskets of meal on mine head,
target_text: ropa tadèngi nare sasoa nii ne'e be'a mi dedha angalai na, hèia dhèu èci dhu lalau roti na, lolo hari nii nèngu, peka na, ari yusuf. nii ja'a sèmi ne'e ka: ja'a tèd'u soe pagod'o-god'o tèlu.

source_text: and i guessed that i bare in one basket, that was highest, all meats or baked foods that be made for pharaoh by the craft of bakers, and that birds ate thereof.
target_text: ètu d'ara soe re dedha tèka na, pènu dènge koki dhèu aae, dhu rupa ae titu kèna. te ngaa manu-bhui lela mai ka ra'e aa'i koki d'ara soe dhu ètu kètu ja'a na.

source_text: joseph answered, this is the expounding of the dream; three baskets be yet three days,
target_text: ropa yusuf tadèngi nare, ka na dhaa, peka na, sasoa lii nii ama, sèmi ne'e ka: soe tèlu sèra, sama kahèi dènge tèlu lod'o.

source_text: after which pharaoh shall take away thine head, and he shall hang thee in a cross, and birds shall draw thy flesh.
target_text: d'ara tèlu lod'o ne, mu ladhe, te dhèu aae pua dhèu mai poro rare kètu èu. ho èèna na, ra kadhoe ngi'u aae èu ètu agarii. hèia manu-bhui tutu ra'e aa'i sisi èu.

source_text: from thence the third day was the day of the birth of pharaoh, which made a great feast to his servants, and he had mind among the meats or during the meal, of the master butler, and of the prince of bakers;
target_text: ropa d'ai tèlu lod'o, dhu lèke dènge lod'o hari jadi dhèu aae, na tao tatao dhu kapai hia dhèu kapai na aa'i-aa'i sèra. na paredha ho dhèu lasi kalua eele dhèu dua sèra nèti d'ara bèdho.

source_text: and he restored the one into his place, that he should dress the cup, either drink, to the king,
target_text: ka na hia hari mone dhu lalau dhua èi na, sab'e sasab'a nèngu uru na.

source_text: and he hanged the tother in a gibbet, that the truth of joseph declaring the dreams should be proved.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu dhu lalau roti dhèu aae èèna, ra poro eele kètu na, ka ra kadhoe ngi'u na, sama sèmi ngaa dhu yusuf peka dènge rèngu dua ra.

source_text: and nevertheless when prosperities befelled to the master butler, he forgat joseph that declared his dream.
target_text: te ngaa mone dhu lalau dhua èi dhèu aae ne, sanèd'e heka yusuf. na bhèlu eele lii moa yusuf.

source_text: after two years pharaoh saw a dream; he guessed that he stood on a river,
target_text: pe d'ai dua tèu risi sa, hèia dhèu aae masir nii. na nii na, nèngu dhu titu ètu sebhe loko nil.

source_text: from which seven fair kine and full fat went up, and they were fed in the places of marshes;
target_text: kabèdhi laa, nèngu nèdhi sapi pidhu ngi'u dhu kabèb'u bia. ka'uri ra kale'e. ra kalua nèti d'ara loko, ka ra'a j'u'u ètu sebhe loko èèna.

source_text: and another seven, foul and lean, came out of the river, and were fed in that brink of the water, in green places;
target_text: nèbhu boe, sapi pidhu ngi'u dhu leo hari, kalua nèti d'ara loko deo na. ngi'u sapi sèra malaka-god'a. ra titu padètu dènge sapi kabèb'u sèra.

source_text: and those foul and lean kine devoured those kine of which the fairness and comeliness of their bodies were wonderful. pharaoh waked,
target_text: hèia sapi malaka pidhu ngi'u sèra, dhèle aa'i pidhu sapi dhu kabèb'u sèra. hèia dhèu aae kabèdhi, ka na marèi dènge.

source_text: and slept again, and he saw another dream; seven ears of corn, full and fair, came forth in one stalk,
target_text: nèbhu boe ka, dhèu aae bhèj'i luu hari. ka na nii hari ca tèka. lii nii na sèmi ne'e ka: nèngu ladhe nèdhi are pidhu huri dhu isi pènu, bhodho nèti laa are dhu sub'u.

source_text: and others, as many ears of corn, thin and smitten with corruption of burning wind, came forth,
target_text: èle èèna ka, nèdhi hari are pidhu huri dhu isi aad'o, aa dhu kamale dhae-dhae sène, lèke lai ngèlu dhu pana.

source_text: devouring all the fairness of the first. pharaoh waked after this rest,
target_text: ka pidhu huri are dhu isi aad'o sèra, dhèle aa'i pidhu huri are dhu isi pènu deo sa. hèia dhèu aae kabèdhi ka nèti bhèj'i. heka nèngu ne'a kèna, nèngu dhu nii hari di.

source_text: and when the morrowtide was made, he was afeared by inward dread, and he sent to all the expounders of egypt, and to all the wise men; and when they were called, he told the dream, and none was that expounded it.
target_text: mad'ae aae èèna, d'ara isi na be'a boe. hèia, na paredha dhèu lasi paroa aa'i dhèu ai tadha dènge dhèu d'èlu-mèu, ètu rai masir mai paraga dènge ne. ka na lolo lii nii na sèra dènge si. te ngaa dhèu èci sa bisa boe peka sasoa lii nii deo sa mi dhèu aae.

source_text: then at the last, the master butler bethought to him, and said to pharaoh, i acknowledge my sin;
target_text: ka mone dhu lalau dhua èi dhèu aae èèna, heka sanèd'e nèdhi yusuf kèna. hèia la'e peka dènge dhèu aae, aku nèngu na, ama! ja'a mangaku sala.

source_text: the king was wroth to his servants, and commanded me and the master baker to be cast down into the prison of the prince of knights,
target_text: uru èèna, dhu ama ku nasa dènge ja'a, dènge angalai ku èci na, ka pamaso ji'i asa d'ara bèdho,

source_text: where we both saw a dream in one night, before-showing of things to come.
target_text: mèda ca lod'o ka, ji'i dua mi nii. èci-èci ka dènge nii na. aa sasoa nii se'e, sama boe kahèi.

source_text: an hebrew child, servant of the same duke of knights, was there, to whom we told the dreams, and heard whatever thing the befalling of the thing proved afterward;
target_text: ètu d'ara bèdho na, abhu ana mone ibrani èci. kapala èmu bèdho nedhe ana mone ne, j'aj'i kapala urusan ho lalau ji'i. ji'i lolo lii nii ji'i dènge ne, ka na peka sasoa lii nii sèra dènge ji'i.

source_text: for i am restored to mine office, and he was hanged in a cross.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ama dhèu aae ded'e hari ja'a. aa angalai ja'a na, abhu huku madhe. se'e se j'aj'i sama sèmi ngaa dhu ana mone ibrani na peka.

source_text: anon at the behest of the king, they polled joseph, led him out of the prison, and when his clothing was changed, they brought him to the king.
target_text: nanene nare lii ne'e hèia, dhèu aae pua dhèu lasi lai-lai rare yusuf nèti d'ara bèdho mai. ka yusuf pamèu iisi na, aa na gati mèdha-papake na, ka na la'e paraga dènge dhèu aae.

source_text: to whom the king said, i saw dreams, and none there is that expoundeth those things that i saw; i have heard that thou expoundest such things most prudently.
target_text: ropa na d'ai madha hèia, dhèu aae peka, ja'a nii, te ngaa dhèu èci sa re'a boe sasoa lii nii sèra. te ngaa dhèu peka na èu me'a.

source_text: joseph answered, without me, god shall answer prosperities to pharaoh.
target_text: hèia yusuf dhaa, aku nèngu na, ama dhèu aae. ja'a èèna ka oo, ke'a boe ngaa-ngaa kahèi. dhoka ama lamatua di dhu ne'a, ho na peka sasoa lii nii sa, dènge lèke. na neo peka lii dhu be'a mi ama dhèu aae.

source_text: therefore pharaoh told that that he saw; i guessed that i stood on the brink of the flood,
target_text: hèia dhèu aae lolo ka, lii nii sèra dènge ne, aku nèngu na, ètu d'ara nii èèna, ja'a titu ètu sebhe loko nil.

source_text: and seven kine, full fair, with flesh able to eating, went up from the water, which kine gathered green sedges in the pasture of the marshes;
target_text: ja'a ladhe la'a na sapi pidhu ngi'u dhu kabèb'u bia, dènge ka'uri dhu kale'e. ra kalua nèti d'ara loko mai, ka ra'a j'u'u ètu sebhe loko èèna.

source_text: and lo! seven other kine, so foul and lean, followed these, that i saw never such in the land of egypt;
target_text: hèia sapi pidhu ngi'u dhu leo mai hari. rèngu se'e dhu malaka-god'a. ètu rai masir ne'e, ja'a kèdhi mèka sapi dhu malaka-god'a sèmi èèna!

source_text: and when the former kine were devoured and wasted of the lean kine,
target_text: dhu pamalaa ja'a, pidhu sapi dhu malaka-god'a sèra, kabèdhi laa dhèle aa'i pidhu sapi dhu kabèb'u se.

source_text: the lean kine gave no step, or token, of fullness, but were slow, or feeble, by like leanness and paleness. i waked,
target_text: sapi dhu malaka sèra dhèle aa'i, te ngaa ngi'u ra malaka taruu sèmi èèna ka. hèia ja'a kabèdhi dènge ka.

source_text: and again i was oppressed by sleep, and i saw a dream; seven ears of corn, full and most fair, came forth on one stalk,
target_text: èle èèna ka, ja'a bhèj'i luu hari, ka nii hari ca tèka. ja'a kèdhi pidhu huri are dhu isi pènu, kalua nèti laa are ca kapua dhu sub'u.

source_text: and another seven, thin and smitten with a burning wind, came forth of the stubble,
target_text: èle èèna ka, ja'a kèdhi hari, pidhu huri are dhu isi aad'o, aa dhu kamale dhae-dhae, lèke lai ngèlu pana.

source_text: which devoured the fairness of the former; i told this dream to the expounders, and no man there is that expoundeth it.
target_text: ka pidhu huri are dhu bèdhu sèra dhèle aa'i pidhu huri are dhu isi pènu sèra. èle èèna ka, ja'a kèd'i nèti bhèj'i. ka ja'a lolo lii nii se'e mi dhèu d'èlu-mèu se'e, te ngaa èci sa bisa boe peka sasoa lii nii sèra.

source_text: joseph answered, the dream of the king is one; god hath showed to pharaoh what things he shall do.
target_text: hèia yusuf padhai lii, peka na, ama dhèu aae! lii nii dua sèra, sasoa na dhoka èci di. ama lamatua peka le, mi ama dhèu aae, ngaa dhu na neo tao.

source_text: seven fair kine, and seven full ears of corn, be seven years of plenty, and the same things comprehend the strength of the dream;
target_text: sasoa na sèmi ne'e ka: pidhu sapi dhu kabèb'u, dènge pidhu huri are dhu isi pènu sèra, sasoa na, tèu dhu bècu-manèsa pidhu tèu. sasoa ra dhoka èci di.

source_text: and the seven kine, thin and lean, that went up after the fair kine, and the seven thin ears of corn, and smitten with a burning wind, be seven years of hunger to coming or to come,
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi, pidhu sapi dhu malaka-god'a, dènge pidhu huri are dhu isi aad'o, sasoa na, tèu manganga pidhu tèu.

source_text: which shall be fulfilled by this order.
target_text: de lamatua dhu peka mema le, ngaa dhu nèngu neo tao. èèna sama kahèi, dènge ngaa dhu ja'a peka deo na.

source_text: lo! seven years of great plenty in all the land of egypt shall come,
target_text: ladhe bèli-camèd'a, ètu rai masir ne'e, d'ara pidhu tèu, èdhi abhu bècu-manèsa palème rae.

source_text: and seven other years of so great barrenness shall pursue or follow those, that all the abundance before shall be given to forgetting; for hunger shall waste all the land, and the greatness of neediness shall waste the greatness of plenty.
target_text: èle èèna na, heka èdhi abhu manganga d'ara pidhu tèu. d'ara pidhu tèu na, manganga madèu aae. toke èdhi abhu boe nganga'a calamusi sa, ètu dedha rai masir ne'e. dhèu aa'i-aa'i manganga ae titu kèna, ka ra bhèlu eele uru na dhu rèngu abhu le babècu pidhu tèu.

source_text: forsooth this that thou sawest the second time in a dream pertaining to the same thing, is a showing of firm-ness, that is, a confirming of the first, for the word of god shall be done, and it shall be ful filled full swiftly.
target_text: de ladhe ama dhèu aae abhu nii dua hari, sasoa na, ama lamatua ka dhu ator tèke. nèbhu heka, ngaa dhu na ator ne, j'aj'i kèna.

source_text: now therefore purvey the king a wise man and a ready, and make the king him sovereign to the land of egypt,
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ja'a manèngi sèmi ne'e: be'a risi ama dhèu aae tenge dhèu d'èlu-mèu èci, dhu bisa tao ai-hèb'a la'a dènge be'a. aa ded'e ne, ho ladhe-leru kabarai ne'e dènge be'a.

source_text: which man ordain governors by all countries, and gather he into barns the fifth part of fruits by the seven years of plenty, that shall come now;
target_text: d'ara pidhu tèu dhu bècu èèna, be'a risi ama dhèu aae ded'e hari dhèu, ho ra oru-pakaboko nganga'a dhu risi eele. nganga'a dhu risi sèra, bagi mi lèmi ho tèke ca pala.

source_text: and all the wheat be kept under the power of pharaoh, and be it kept in the cities,
target_text: ana kabarai ne'e, hud'i madhutu dènge be'a paredha ama dhèu aae, ho pakaboko are-are dhu risi eele, nèti rae-rae ètu rai masir ne'e. aa ra soli sa d'ara soka ho j'aga paie.

source_text: and be it made ready to the hunger to coming or to come of the seven years that shall oppress egypt, and the land be not wasted by poverty.
target_text: sèna ka pidhu tèu dhu manganga nèi mai te, èdhi dhu sadia le nganga'a. dènge j'ara sèmi ne'e, èci sa madhe boe manganga.

source_text: the counsel of joseph pleased pharaoh, and all his servants,
target_text: ropa tadèngi lii padhai lii yusuf ne, dhèu aae dènge dhèu kapai sèra, sèmi ngaa dhu na peka dènge dhèu aae èèna.

source_text: and he spake to them, whether we be able to find such a man which is full of god's spirit?
target_text: ka dhèu aae padhai lii, peka na, roh ama lamatua hia le koasa mi yusuf ne'e. nèti èèna ka, èdhi abhu heka dhèu dhu risi nèti nèngu.

source_text: therefore pharaoh said to joseph, for god hath showed to thee all things which thou hast spoken, whether i may find a wiser man than thou, and like to thee?
target_text: èle èèna ka, dhèu aae padhai lii dènge yusuf, peka na, ama lamatua peka dènge èu, ngaa-ngaa se'e aa'i-aa'i. nèti sèmi ne'e ka, heka ji'i nge'a kèna èu ne'e tare'a-re'a dhèu mèu. aa mamèu èu ne, risi eele dhèu ètu mia-mia.

source_text: therefore thou shalt be over mine house, and all the people shall obey to the behest of thy mouth; i shall pass thee only by one throne of the realm.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, deo ne'e kahèi ja'a ded'e èu j'aj'i ai g'ana ja'a. sèna ka èu j'aj'i dhèu kapai ètu d'ara èmu ja'a. aa ana kabarai ja'a nanene lii paredha èu. dhoka ja'a di dhu risi nèti èu.

source_text: and again pharaoh said to joseph, lo! i have ordained thee on all the land of egypt. and pharaoh took off the ring from his hand, and gave it in the hand of joseph, and he clothed joseph with a stole of bis, or of white silk, and he put a golden wreath about his neck;
target_text: èle èèna ka, dhèu aae puru eele kadheli dhu dènge cap nèti ai na, ka na pasaluu mi ai yusuf. ka na padhai lii, aku nèngu na, dènge ne'e ne, ja'a ded'e èu, j'aj'i ai g'ana ja'a ètu rai masir. hèia na papake kodho madhera dhu milu èci mi yusuf, aa na pa'inu rate hualaa cakoko mi ladha-goro na.

source_text: and pharaoh made joseph to go upon his second chariot, while a beadle cried, that all men should kneel before him, and should know that he was sovereign of all the land of egypt.
target_text: èle èèna ka, dhèu aae hia hari yusuf kareta ka dua nèngu. ka na hia dhèu lasi uuru, ho pa'oo peka na, we! patalele j'ara oo! pahaha iisi mliu! dhèu kapai neo re ne'e! dènge j'ara ne'e, dhèu aae ded'e le yusuf, j'aj'i ai g'ana na ètu rai masir.

source_text: and the king said to joseph, i am pharaoh, without thy behest no man shall stir hand either foot in all the land of egypt.
target_text: hèia dhèu aae padhai lii dènge yusuf, peka na, sèmi ne'e. èu dhu me'a le ja'a ne dhèu aae. te ngaa ja'a peka le dènge ana kabarai masir aa'i-aa'i, peka na, ladhe èu hia boe ijin, rèngu bisa boe tao ngaa èci sa.

source_text: and pharaoh turned the name of joseph, and called him by the egyptian language, the saviour of the world, or zaphnathpaaneah; and he gave to joseph a wife, asenath, the daughter of potipherah, a priest of heliopolis, that is, the city of the sun. and so joseph went out to the land of egypt.
target_text: èle ka, dhèu aae pangare yusuf madhutu ngara masir, na safnat panea. aa, na hia yusuf madhèdi dènge ana bhèni èci, ngara na asnat. ama dhèu èmu na, ngara na potifera. nèngu ne'e ka dhu j'aj'i ama agama ètu d'ara kota on. dènge j'ara ne'e, yusuf j'aj'i dhèu kapai ètu rai masir.

source_text: forsooth joseph was of thirty years, when he stood in the sight of king pharaoh, and compassed all the countries or regions of egypt.
target_text: lod'o na j'aj'i dhèu kapai ètu rai masir, umur nèngu tèlu nguru tèu le. hèia na kako palème rai masir.

source_text: and the plenty of the seven years came, and the ripe corns were bound into handfuls or sheaves,
target_text: ètu d'ara pidhu tèu dhu bècu-manèsa ne'e, oka-tedhe pènu dènge nganga'a.

source_text: and they were gathered into the barns of egypt, also all the abundance of ripe corns was kept in all cities,
target_text: hèia yusuf kaboko nganga'a dhu risi, ka na tèka paia si. ètu era mia dhu na pakaboko nganga'a, ètu èèna kahèi na soli asa d'ara soka.

source_text: and so great abundance was of wheat, that it was made even to the gravel, or the sand, of the sea, and the plenty passed measure.
target_text: are dhu pakaboko nare, ae titu kèna. èci èèna ka, dènge salae ètu nebhe dhasi, ka dhèu uku rare heka.

source_text: soothly two sons were born to joseph before that the hunger came, which asenath, the daughter of potipherah, a priest of heliopolis, childed to him.
target_text: d'ai mèka tèu manganga, dhèu èmu yusuf, asnat nara iisi le ana mone dhèu dua.

source_text: and joseph called the name of the first begotten son, manasseh, and said, god hath made me to forget all my travails, and the house of my father;
target_text: ka yusuf padhai lii, peka na, ama lamatua tao j'ara ne'e, sèna ka pabhèlu ja'a nèti j'aj'èra dhu lod'o ja'a kalua nèti d'ara èmu ama ku. nèti èèna ka, ana uuru, na pangare ne manase dhu sasoa na ele boe ‘bhèlu'.

source_text: and he called the name of the second son ephraim, and said, god hath made me to increase in the land of my poverty.
target_text: lod'o na abhu ana ka dua, na padhai lii hari, peka na, ja'a abhu j'aj'èra ae d'ai seli ètu era ne'e. te ngaa sasue dènge ladhe-leru ama lamatua ka, ja'a abhu ana ètu ne'e. ka na pangare ana ne'e efraim.

source_text: therefore when seven years of plenty that were in egypt were passed,
target_text: nèbhu boe ka, èle pidhu tèu dhu bècu-manèsa na.

source_text: the seven years of poverty began to come, which joseph before-said, and hunger had the mastery in all the world; also hunger was in all the land of egypt;
target_text: aa pidhu tèu manganga madèu d'ai kèna, sama sèmi dhu uru èèna yusuf peka le. ètu era leo, dhèu manganga le. te ngaa rae-rae ètu masir nganga'a ae era.

source_text: and when that land hungered, the people cried to pharaoh, and asked for meats; to whom he answered, go ye to joseph, and do ye whatever thing he saith to you.
target_text: te ngaa nèbhu-nèbhu, kabarai masir manganga kahèi. ka lasi asa dhèu aae ho ra manèngi nganga'a. aa dhèu aae pua si lasi asa yusuf, sèna ka ra madhutu paredha yusuf.

source_text: forsooth hunger increased each day in all the land, and joseph opened all the barns, and sold corn to the egyptians, for also hunger oppressed them;
target_text: te ngaa rai manganga ètu mia-mia asa tabha, toke d'ai rae-rae ètu rai masir. nèti èèna ka, yusuf bhoke aa'i soka nganga'a sèna ka pahie dènge dhèu masir.

source_text: and all the provinces came into egypt to buy corns, and to abate the evil of neediness.
target_text: lula manganga ae titu kèna, ka dhèu nèti mia-mia mai hèli nganga'a ètu yusuf ètu rai masir.

source_text: forsooth jacob heard that foods were sold in egypt, and he said to his sons, why be ye negligent?
target_text: tèu èèna, yakob tadèngi dhèu palolo na abhu are ètu masir. ka na peka dènge ana na si, aku nèngu na, ana ee! miu nga tao madhèdi mau-mau ka laa?

source_text: i have heard that wheat is sold in egypt; go ye down, and buy ye necessaries to us, that we may live, and be not wasted by neediness.
target_text: ja'a tadèngi na ètu masir pahia nganga'a. hua iia lami hèli, sèna ka èdhi baku madhe manganga.

source_text: therefore ten brethren of joseph went down to buy wheat in egypt,
target_text: ka a'a yusuf canguru dhèu se'e pa'èra ka, lasi hèli nganga'a asa masir.

source_text: and benjamin was withholden of jacob at home, that said to his brethren, lest peradventure in the way he suffer any evil.
target_text: te ngaa yakob hia boe ari yusuf dhu ngara na benyamin, la'e dènge a'a na si. te, na pangee, mage dhoka, ana ne'e abhu hari j'aj'èra ètu talora j'ara.

source_text: soothly they entered into the land of egypt, with other men that went thither to buy corn; forsooth hunger was in the land of canaan.
target_text: lula dhèu ae nèti mia-mia tadèngi le abhu nganga'a ètu masir, ka ra lasi hèli asa nèi. manganga ne d'ai le rai kana'an kahèi. ka ana-ana yakob se, lasi hèli kahèi asa masir.

source_text: and joseph was the prince of egypt, and at his will wheats were sold to the peoples. and when his brethren had worshipped or honoured him,
target_text: tèu èèna, yusuf j'aj'i ai g'ana dhèu aae masir. ladhe dhèu nèti mia-mia mai hèli are, yusuf ka dhu pahia. nèti èèna ka, lod'o a'a na si d'ai nèi, rèngu patitu kètu urutuu, ho tab'e yusuf toke rèhu rèngu oe d'ai rai.

source_text: and he had known them, he spake harder to them, as to aliens, and asked them, from whence came ye? which answered, from the land of canaan, that we buy necessaries to our lifelode. and nevertheless he knew his brethren, and he was not known of them,
target_text: ropa yusuf ladhe nèdhi a'a na si, na tadhe le èèna. te ngaa yusuf tao iisi sèmi dhèu masir. nèti èèna ka, rèngu tadhe boe ne hèi. hèia na jèka si, aku nèngu na, ee! miu se nèti mia? hèia ra dhaa, aku rèngu na, ji'i se nèti kana'an. ji'i mai hèli nganga'a sa ama wakil.

source_text: and he bethought on the dreams which he saw sometime. and he said to them, ye be spyers or spies, ye came to see the feebler things of the land.
target_text: hèia yusuf sanèd'e lii nii na uru na. ka na pamadha'u si, aku nèngu na, ja'a lèka boe! miu se'e dhèu mata-mata. miu mai tenge rahasia rai masir, ho èèna na mai musu rai ji'i!

source_text: which said, lord, it is not so, but thy servants came to buy meats;
target_text: te ngaa ra dhaa peka na, aad'o, ama! ji'i se'e dhoka ana pua-paleha nèti ama di. tare'a-re'a ji'i mai sa ne'e ne, neo hèli nganga'a di. leo nèti èèna, aad'o.

source_text: all we be the sons of one man, we came hither peaceably, and thy servants imagine not any evil.
target_text: ji'i aa'i-aa'i se'e, ana nèti ca ama di. ji'i mai mata-mata boe rai ama ku si ne'e. ji'i se'e dhèu be'a.

source_text: to which he answered, it is in other manner, ye came to see the feeble things of the land.
target_text: te ngaa yusuf jèka si dènge lii mèdhu hari, peka na, he! omo koso! baku kapod'e-kabèli ja'a. miu se'e tare'a-re'a dhèu bhelu. miu mai tenge rahasia rai ne'e!

source_text: and they said, we thy servants be twelve brethren, the sons of one man in the land of canaan; the youngest is with our father, another is not alive.
target_text: ka ra peka, aad'o ama! ji'i se'e ana pua-paleha ama ku di. ji'i mai nèti rai kana'an. ji'i aa'i-aa'i mi nèti ca ama, canguru dua dhèu. ari ji'i dhu limuri tèka, pea dènge ama ji'i. aa ari ji'i èci aad'o heka!

source_text: this it is, he said, that i spake to you, ye be spyers or spies,
target_text: hèia yusuf dhaa, aku nèngu na, aad'o! lèke sèmi lii ja'a deo na! miu se'e dhèu mata-mata.

source_text: right now i shall take experience or very knowing of you; by the health of pharaoh ye shall not go from hence, till your least brother come hither;
target_text: na! karèi sèmi èèna, na miu hia ku tadha èci, sèna ka ja'a ke'a lii padhai lii miu deo sa, tare'a, do aad'o. ja'a subha ee! ladhe ari miu dhu limuri na, d'ai boe ne'e, miu èci sa bisa boe kalua nèti rai ne'e!

source_text: send ye one of you, that he bring him, forsooth ye shall be in bonds till those things that ye said be proved, whether those or they be false or true; else, by the health of pharaoh, ye be spies.
target_text: de hua iia miu pua dhèu èci la'e, ho nèti ari miu dhu limuri èèna asa ne'e mai. aa miu dhu leo se, ja'a taha. ja'a neo ke'a miu se'e peka tare'a, do aad'o. ladhe aad'o, miu se'e tare'a-re'a mata-mata.

source_text: therefore he betook them into keeping three days;
target_text: ka yusuf pua taha si d'ara bèdho tèlu lod'o.

source_text: soothly in the third day, when they were led out of prison, joseph said, do ye that that i said, and ye shall live, for i dread god;
target_text: d'ai lod'o ka tèlu, yusuf la'e padhai lii dènge ra ètu d'ara bèdho, peka na, ja'a ne'e, ca dhèu dhu madha'u dènge lamatua. aa ja'a madhutu dad'èi na taruu. sèna ka miu mamuri, ja'a neo patabuli miu. te ngaa hud'i dènge ku lii pajaji.

source_text: if ye be peaceable, one brother of you be bound in prison; forsooth the rest go ye, and bear the wheat, which ye have bought, into your houses,
target_text: ladhe miu se'e tare'a padhai lii dhu mola, miu pad'elo ku ngaa èci j'aj'i mi tadha. j'ara na sèmi ne'e: ja'a taha ca dhèu ètu d'ara bèdho ne'e. dhèu leo lèpa ho mèti nganga'a hia a'ari miu, te ra tatae miu lami mèti nganga'a.

source_text: and bring ye your youngest brother to me, that i may prove your words, and ye die not. they did as he said,
target_text: d'ai nèi, miu mèti ari miu dhu limuri èèna mai asa ne'e, ho j'aj'i bukti, tare'a miu se'e dhèu be'a. sèna ka ja'a baku huku pamadhe miu. ropa ra tadèngi rare ne'e, ra d'èi kahèi sèmi èèna.

source_text: and they spake together, worthily we suffer these things, for we sinned against our brother, and we saw the anguish of his soul, while he prayed us, and we heard him not; therefore this tribulation cometh on us.
target_text: ka ra padhue-padhai ka èci dènge èci, peka na, waa! ne'e ne, èdhi heka abhu b'ala kèna, lula sala dhu èdhi ad'u-ue mi dedha ari èdhi uru na. èdhi ladhe tèdhi nèngu j'èra titu kèna, d'ai na manèngi sasue èdhi, te ngaa èdhi pusi boe ne. nèti èèna ka, èdhi abhu j'aj'èra sèmi ne'e ne.

source_text: of which one, reuben, said, whether i said not to you, do not ye sin against the child, and ye heard not me? lo! his blood is sought.
target_text: hèia ruben pasanèd'e si, peka na, we! ari-ari ja'a, ee! uru na ja'a kai le miu, ho baku paj'èra ana èèna, si? te ngaa miu-miu se'e ka dhu mo'o boe nanene lii ja'a. nèti èèna ka, lod'o ne'e èdhi dui tare raa ari èdhi yusuf èèna.

source_text: soothly they knew not that joseph understood them, for he spake to them by an interpreter or an expounder.
target_text: rèngu padhai lii ae-ae sèmi èèna, re'a boe na yusuf ne'a lii rèngu kahèi. lod'o yusuf padhai lii dènge rèngu, na pake lii masir, ho èèna na dhèu leo lole hari pake lii ibrani.

source_text: and he turned away himself a little, and wept; and he turned again, and spake to them. and he took simeon, and bound him, while they were present;
target_text: tadèngi ra padhai lii sèmi èèna hèia, yusuf kèd'i eele si, la'e tangi asa era leo. tangi nare, la'e hari pa'èci dènge si. ka na pua dhèu èki simeon ètu madha a'ari na sèra.

source_text: and he commanded the servants, that they should fill their sacks with wheat, and that they should put all their money in their bags, and over this give to them meats in the way; which did so.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yusuf paredha dhèu sab'a sèra, ho soli are asa d'ara karo a'a na si. aa tao hari doi kab'ua are sèra, asa d'ara karo ra èci-èci. ra tèke ètu hèb'a karo sèra. na pua dhèu sab'a se'e, ho hia si dènge gee. ka dhèu sab'a se'e lalau ka, madhutu ngaa dhu yusuf paredha.

source_text: and they bare the wheats on their asses, and went forth,
target_text: èle ka, a'a na si hua karo nganga'a sèra asa dedha badha keled'ei. ka ra pakèd'i dènge ka.

source_text: and when the sack of one of them was opened that he should give meat to the work beast in the inn, he beheld the money in the mouth of the bag,
target_text: ropa d'ai talora j'ara, ra ae. dhèu èci bhoke karo na, ho neo ani keled'ei na. na ladhe la'a na, doi na ètu dedha are, ètu d'ara karo èèna.

target_text: yusuf jèka si, aku nèngu na, he! nga tao ka miu tao ne'e mi ja'a! miu me'a boe, ja'a ne dhèu kapai ètu ne'e. ja'a pake na'i dhu bisa ke'a tatao dhèu, dhu dhèu leo re'a boe!

source_text: to whom judah said, what shall we answer to my lord, or what shall we speak, either what may we justly against-say? god hath found the wickedness of thy servants; lo! all we be the servants of my lord, both we and he at whom the cup is found.
target_text: hèia yahuda dhaa, aku nèngu na, irii! te ama lamatua pasabhoka kèna sasala èdhi. pe ji'i peka lii mia hari, ama? ji'i sili iisi sa mia hari? ladhe ama neo taha ari ji'i ne'e, na be'a risi, taha ji'i aa'i-aa'i mi. more ji'i aa'i-aa'i, j'aj'i mi ènu ama ka laa.

source_text: joseph answered, far be it from me, that i do so; he be my servant that stole the cup; forsooth go ye free to your father.
target_text: te ngaa yusuf dhaa, aku nèngu na, aad'o! abhu moo èèna ètu cee, na nèngu di dhu j'aj'i ènu ja'a. miu dhu leo, lèpa hari dènge mera-milu sa ama miu!

source_text: soothly judah nighed near, and said trustily, my lord, i pray thee, thy servant speak a word in thine ears, and be thou not wroth to thy servant; for after pharaoh thou art my lord.
target_text: hèia yahuda la'e padètu asa madha yusuf, ka na padhai lii, aku nèngu na, ama wakil! ja'a ke'a koasa ama sama sèmi koasa dhèu aae! uru nèti èèna, ja'a manèngi ama baku nasa dènge ja'a. ja'a neo padhai lii ciki dènge ama.

source_text: thou askedest first thy servants, have ye a father, or a brother?
target_text: med'a na, ama karèi le ji'i, peka na, ‘ama miu, dènge ari miu dhu èci na, era do? '

source_text: and we answered to my lord, an eld or old father is to us, and a little child that was born in his eld age, whose brother of the same womb is dead, and his mother hath him alone; forsooth his father loveth him tenderly.
target_text: ka ji'i dhaa peka na, ‘ama ji'i heka d'ai seli le. aa ari ji'i dhu limuri èci. lod'o nara iisi ari ji'i ne'e, ama ji'i na heka le. ari ji'i dhu limuri ne'e dènge a'a d'èlu na èci, te ngaa na aad'o heka. ina ra madhe le. ka di nèngu ka mesa na. nèti èèna ka, ama ji'i ne sue ne titu kèna! '

source_text: and thou saidest to thy servants, bring ye him to me, and i shall set mine eyes on him.
target_text: ka ama pua ho ji'i ngèti ari ji'i na mai, sèna ka ama nèdhi ne.

source_text: we made suggestion to thee, my lord, the child may not forsake his father; for if he shall leave his father, his father shall die.
target_text: ka ji'i dhaa na, ‘ana èèna, bisa boe tèke eele ama na mesa na. ladhe na tèke eele, na ama ji'i na tatu madhe dènge kèna. '

source_text: and thou saidest to thy servants, if your youngest brother shall not come down with you, ye shall no more see my face.
target_text: hèia ama dhaa na, ‘ladhe miu mèti boe ari miu na, baku mi pad'elo hari rèhu mi sa ne'e. '

source_text: therefore when we had gone up to thy servant, our father, we told to him all things which my lord spake to us;
target_text: èle èèna ka, ji'i lèpa. d'ai nèi ka, ji'i lolo lii dhu mu moa sèra dènge ama ji'i.

source_text: and our father said, turn ye again, and buy ye to you a little of wheat;
target_text: nèbhu-nèbhu, nganga'a ji'i èla. hèia ama ji'i pua hari ji'i mai hèli nganga'a sa masir ne'e.

source_text: to whom we said, we may not go; only if our least brother shall go down with us, we shall go forth together; else, if he is absent, we dare not see the lord's face.
target_text: te ngaa ji'i dhaa na, ‘ama, ee! ji'i la'a heka sa nèi. te ai g'ana dhèu aae na dhu moa le, aku nèngu na, ladhe ji'i ngèti boe ari ji'i dhu limuri na, bisa heka ji'i pad'elo rèhu sa nèi. de ladhe ari ji'i la'e hèi, na heka ji'i la'a kèna. '

source_text: to which things our father answered, ye know that my wife childed two sons to me;
target_text: ama ji'i peka hari, aku nèngu na, ‘miu me'a kahèi, si ma? dhèu èmu ja'a rahel èèna, ana na dhoka dua di.

source_text: one went out, and ye said, a beast hath devoured him, and hither-to he appeareth not;
target_text: ana uuru èèna, aad'o heka. ele boe badha hui na'e aa'i le. nèti èèna ka, ja'a kèdhi heka rèhu na toke d'ai sange ne'e.

source_text: if ye take also this son, and anything befall to him in the way, ye shall lead forth mine hoar hairs with mourning to hells or to hell.
target_text: ladhe miu mèti hari ana limuri ne, ho sèmi na abhu j'aj'èra, èèna miu paj'èra ja'a dhèu heka ne'e. ladhe sèmi èèna na, ja'a madhe dènge kèna. '

source_text: therefore if i enter again to thy servant, our father, and the child fail to be with us, since his life hangeth of the life of the child, and he see that the child is not with us, he shall die, and thy servants shall lead forth his hoar hairs with sorrow to hells or to hell.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ama, ladhe ja'a lèpa kèti boe dènge ari ji'i ne, ama ji'i madhe dènge kèna. te samanga na dhu pa'èki dènge ana ne'e di. dènge ètu d'ara haheka na ne'e, ladhe ji'i tao ne tabha j'èra, tatu na madhe dènge kèna.

source_text: be i properly thy servant, which received this child on my faith, and i promised, and said, if i shall not bring again him to thee, i shall be guilty of sin against my father in all time;
target_text: ngaa hari, ja'a moa le mi ama ku, peka na, ‘ja'a ka dhu tago ana ne'e. ladhe ja'a kèti heka ana ne'e mai sa madha ama, ja'a ka tago sasala na, toke d'ai ja'a madhe. '

source_text: and so i shall dwell thy servant for the child into the service of my lord, and the child go up with his brethren;
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ja'a manèngi sèmi ne'e, ama wakil: hud'i laa ja'a ka pea mi ne'e gati nèngu, sèna ka ja'a j'aj'i ènu ama wakil. hia ne lèpa dènge a'a na si.

source_text: for i may not go again to my father, if the child be absent, lest i stand a witness of the wretchedness that shall oppress my father.
target_text: ladhe ana ne'e la'e boe, ja'a bisa boe lèpa kahèi. d'ara ja'a la'e boe ladhe j'aj'èra ama ji'i toke madhe.

source_text: joseph might no longer abstain himself, while many men stood there before him; wherefore he commanded that all men should go out, and that none alien were present in the knowing of joseph and his brethren.
target_text: ropa tadèngi nare lii yahuda na, d'ara yusuf roe bhilu, toke taha nare boe ètu madha dhèu sab'a na sèra. nèti èèna ka, na hia ra lasi asa li'u, sèna ka mesa na di, dènge a'ari na ètu d'ara èmu. dènge j'ara ne'e, nèngu bisa patadhe iisi na, mi a'ari na sèra.

source_text: and joseph raised up his voice with weeping, which the egyptians heard, and all the household of pharaoh.
target_text: hèia dhèu sab'a se'e kalua asa li'u, ka yusuf tangi dènge d'ara pèd'a. lii tangi na mèdhu, ka dhèu-dhèu masir ètu li'u sèra tadèngi kahèi. mesa boe dhèu ètu li'u sèra, te dhèu ètu èmu dhèu aae tadèngi kahèi.

source_text: and he said to his brethren, i am joseph; liveth my father yet? his brethren might not answer, and were aghast with full much dread.
target_text: ka yusuf peka mola-mola dènge a'ari na si, aku nèngu na, a'ari, ee! ja'a ne'e ka yusuf èèna! ama ku mamuri era, do? ropa tadèngi rare, a'a na sèra madha'u titu kèna. ra bisa heka bhoke hèb'a padhai lii ngaa èci sa.

source_text: to whom joseph said meekly, cometh nigh to me. and when they had nighed nigh, he said, i am joseph your brother, whom ye sold into egypt;
target_text: hèia yusuf paroa si, peka na, mai ku padètu-dètu dènge ja'a. ka ara lasi padètu sa madha yusuf. ka na peka hari, ja'a ne, yusuf, dhu uru èèna, miu pahia eele asa masir ne'e.

source_text: do not ye dread, neither seem it to be hard to you, that ye sold me into these countries; for god hath sent me before you into egypt for your health.
target_text: miu se tare'a pahie eele ja'a. te ngaa mage miu madha'u, aa baku peka cee ka dhu sala. lula ama lamatua ka dhu hia uuru ja'a mai sa ne'e. ho dènge j'ara ne'e, na pake ja'a ho hia mamuri mi dhèu ae. sèna ka baku madhe manganga.

source_text: for it is two years that hunger began to be in the land, yet five more years shall pursue, in which men shall not be able to ear, neither reap;
target_text: rai manganga ne heka dua tèu kèna. lèmi tèu era. bèli-camèd'a dhèu tao heka oka-tedhe, sèla heka, aa abhu heka nganga'a hèru èj'i lai.

source_text: and god before-sent me, that ye be kept alive on earth, and may have meats to live.
target_text: dènge j'ara dhu èdhi te'a boe ne, ama lamatua hia ja'a mai asa ne'e uru nèti miu. sèna ka, miu dènge ana-èpu miu abhu mamuri.

source_text: i was sent hither not by your counsel, but by god's will, which hath made me as the father of pharaoh, and lord of all his house, and prince in all the land of egypt.
target_text: de dhu lèke, nèti boe tatao miu ka ja'a d'ai era ne'e, te ngaa tatao ama lamatua di. nèngu ka dhu hia ja'a j'aj'i ai g'ana dhèu aae masir. ka ja'a j'aj'i mi kapala urusan ètu d'ara èmu dhèu aae. abhu boe dhèu leo èci sa dhu kapai risi nèti ja'a.

source_text: haste ye, and goeth up to my father, and ye shall say to him, thy son joseph sendeth these things to thee; god hath made me lord of all the land of egypt; come down here to me, and tarry not,
target_text: de miu lami ka lai-lai ne, ho peka lii padhai lii ja'a ne dènge ama ku, sèmi ne'e: ‘yusuf, ana ama ku, mamuri era! nèngu j'aj'i le dhèu kapai ètu rai masir. na manèngi ama ku la'e lai-lai asa nèi.

source_text: and dwell in the land of goshen; and thou shalt be beside me, thou, and thy sons, and the sons of thy sons, thy sheep, and thy great beasts, and all things which thou wieldest,
target_text: ho èèna na, ama pea ètu rai gosen padètu dènge nèngu. era na be'a aa taleo. sèna ka ama bisa piara kahib'i-kalèbho, kahib'i-ka'ia dènge sapi aa'i-aa'i ra. aa na manèngi kahèi ho ama la'e dènge ana-èpu, dènge isi èmu, dènge mèdha-panyau, ho pea taruu mi nèi.

source_text: and there i shall feed thee; for yet five years of hunger be left, lest both thou perish, and thine house, and all things which thou wieldest.
target_text: ladhe ama pea ètu gosen, nèngu ladhe-leru ama ètu nèi. te rai manganga lèmi tèu era. sèna ka na tenge j'ara ho ama dènge ana-èpu, aa dènge badha-manu bisa mamuri dènge be'a. '

source_text: lo! your eyes, and the eyes of my brother benjamin see, that my mouth speaketh to you;
target_text: yusuf peka nare hèia, na padhai lii hari, peka na, miu unu mi mèdhi le, si? aa èu kahèi, benyamin. ja'a ne'e, tare'a-re'a yusuf.

source_text: tell ye to my father all my glory, and all things which ye saw in egypt; haste ye, and bring ye him to me.
target_text: de miu peka dènge ama èdhi, na, ja'a ne'e dènge koasa kapai titu kèna, ètu kabarai masir ne'e. aa lolo dènge ama, ngaa aa'i-aa'i dhu miu mèdhi le ètu ne'e. ho èèna na, karohe mèti ama sa ne'e mai!

source_text: and when he had embraced, and felled into the neck of benjamin, his brother, he wept, the while also benjamin wept in like manner on the neck of joseph.
target_text: èle èèna ka, liku nare ari na benyamin, hèia dua ra tangi.

source_text: and joseph kissed all his brethren, and wept on them all; after which things they were hardy to speak to him.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi, na liku nare a'a na si èci-èci, ka na uu si. ka heka ra bani padhai lii dènge ne kèna.

source_text: and it was heard, and published by famous word in the king's hall, the brethren of joseph be come. and pharaoh joyed, and all his household;
target_text: ropa dhèu aae dènge dhèu-dhèu kapai na sèra, tadèngi rare a'ari yusuf mai asa masir, ra karej'e kahèi.

source_text: and pharaoh said to joseph, that he should command his brethren, and say to them, charge ye your beasts, and go ye into the land of canaan,
target_text: ka dhèu aae peka dènge yusuf, aku nèngu na, ari! peka dènge a'ari èu sèra, ho hua ka nganga'a asa dedha keled'ei rèngu, sèna ka rèti sa kana'an.

source_text: and take ye from thence your father, and your kindred, and come ye back to me; and i shall give you all the goods of egypt, that ye eat the marrow of the land.
target_text: aa peka dènge si, rèti ama mu dènge ana-èpu aa'i-aa'i, mai pea sa ne'e. d'ai ne'e, pe ja'a hia rèngu rai, era dhu hèu mèngi risi, sèna ka rèngu bisa mamuri nèti isi rai èèna.

source_text: command thou also, that they take wains of the land of egypt to the carriage of their little children, and wives, and say thou, take ye your father, and haste ye in coming soon,
target_text: aa hia rèti mema dènge kareta pèri-pèri nèti ne'e, ho sèna ka hua ana iiki-ana iiki dènge ama mu.

source_text: neither leave ye anything of the appurtenance of your house, for all the riches of egypt shall be yours.
target_text: baku ra pangee mèdha-panyau dhu rèngu bisa boe nedhe rèti, te, ngaa-ngaa dhu be'a ètu rai masir ne, èèna na j'aj'i unu rèngu.

source_text: the sons of israel did as it was commanded to them; to which joseph gave wains, by the behest of pharaoh, and meats in the way;
target_text: tadèngi sèmi èèna, ka yusuf hia si kareta pèri-pèri bua, dènge parèko ra'a j'ara, sama sèmi lii paredha dhèu aae. aa a'ari na pa'èra ka, ho lèpa madhutu lii paredha dhèu aae.

source_text: and he commanded two stoles to be brought forth to each; forsooth he gave to benjamin three hundred pieces of silver, with five of the best stoles;
target_text: ka yusuf hia si mèdha-papake dhu hiu, ca dhèu ca pasa. te ngaa benyamin, na hia doi iia tèlu ngasu, dènge mèdha-papake dhu hiu, lèmi pasa.

source_text: and he sent to his father so much of silver, and of clothes, and he added to them ten male asses, that should bear of the riches of egypt, and so many female asses, bearing wheat and loaves in the way.
target_text: yusuf pa'adhu mèdha-panyau dhu be'a risi nèti masir hia ama na. rèngu hua mi dedha keled'ei canguru ngi'u. sèmi èèna kahèi, na hia are, roti, dènge nganga'a ae-ae, dhu j'aj'i parèko j'ara, lod'o dhu rèngu mulai pakèd'i nèti kana'an asa masir. nganga'a se, ra hua ètu dedha keled'ei dhu leo hari canguru ngi'u.

source_text: therefore he let go his brethren, and said to them going forth, be ye not wroth in the way.
target_text: èle èèna ka, na hia si lèpa, aa na moa si, aku nèngu na, miu baku patao-palaha ètu talora j'ara, ee!

source_text: which went up from egypt, and came into the land of canaan, to their father jacob;
target_text: hèia ra pakèd'i ka lasi sa ama ra ètu kana'an.

source_text: and they told to him, and said, joseph, thy son, liveth, and he is lord in all the land of egypt. and when this was heard, jacob waked as of a grievous sleep; nevertheless he believed not to them.
target_text: d'ai nèi ka, ra lolo dènge ama ra, peka na, ama! ana mu yusuf na, dhu mamuri era di. na j'aj'i le dhèu kapai, ka na paredha ètu rai masir! yakob tadèngi hiu-hiu na, loo-loo sène, te na lèka boe.

source_text: they told on the contrary to him all the order of the thing; and when jacob had seen the wains, and all things which joseph had sent, his spirit lived again,
target_text: te ngaa ropa na tadèngi nare lii lolo rèngu sèra, aa na ladhe nèdhi kareta dhu yusuf pa'adhu mai ho hua ne asa masir, heka na lèka kèna.

source_text: and he said, it sufficeth to me, if joseph my son liveth yet; i shall go and see him before that i die.
target_text: hèia na padhai lii, aku nèngu na, hea! de ana ja'a dhu mamuri era di! ja'a heka karej'e kèna. ja'a hud'i laku kèdhi ku ne, heka ja'a madhe dènge karej'e kèna.

source_text: and israel went forth with all things that he had, and he came to the well of oath or beersheba; and when sacrifices were slain there to the god of his father isaac,
target_text: èle èèna ka, yakob si pa'èra ka mèdha ra, ka ra pakèd'i nèti kana'an. ropa ra d'ai rae barseba, ka na roro badha tao korban hia lamatua, dhu uru na ama na isak mangaj'i.

source_text: he heard god by a vision in that night calling to him, and saying to him, jacob! jacob! to whom he answered, lo! i am present.
target_text: mèda ca lod'o ka na nii. ètu d'ara nii ne'e, na tadèngi na ama lamatua paroa ne, peka na, yakob! yakob! èu kèd'i ho nanene ku la! hèia na dhaa, peka na, nga tao, ama?

source_text: god said to him, i am the full strong god of thy father; do not thou dread, go down into egypt, for i shall make thee there into a great folk;
target_text: ka lamatua peka na, ja'a ne, ama lamatua dhu ama mu mangaj'i nèti uru ka. mage èu madha'u kahèi lamu masir. te èèna na, ja'a tao ana-èpu èu j'aj'i suku kapai ètu rai nèi.

source_text: i shall go down thither with thee, and i shall bring thee turning again from thence, and joseph shall set his hand on thine eyes.
target_text: ja'a laku hèi masir sama-sama dènge èu. ho ladhe èèna na, ja'a kahèi dhu kèti hari ana-èpu èu lèpa asa rai kana'an ne'e. ropa èu madhe, na, ana mu yusuf madhèdi ètu baboa èu.

source_text: jacob rose from the well of oath, and his sons took him, with their little children, and wives, in the wains which pharaoh had sent to bear the eld or old man,
target_text: èle èèna ka, yakob dènge ana-ana na sèra, lasi taruu tèke eele rae barseba. ra paca'e ne dènge bhèni-ana iiki na asa kareta sèra dhu dhèu aae masir pa'adhu hia si.

source_text: and all things which he wielded in the land of canaan; and he came into egypt with all his seed, his sons, and their sons, and daughters, and all the generations together.
target_text: rèti aa'i mèu-mèu mèdha-panyau dènge badha-manu dhu j'aj'i kakaja rèngu ètu rai kana'an. hèia yakob dènge ana-èpu na, bhèni-mone aa'i-aa'i ra pakèd'i ka lasi rai masir.

source_text: forsooth these be the names of the sons of israel, that entered into egypt; jacob with his free children. the first begotten is reuben;
target_text: ana-èpu yakob dhu madhutu lasi asa masir, nuka se'e: ruben, ana uuru na.

source_text: the sons of reuben; hanoch, and phallu, and hezron, and carmi.
target_text: ana-ana na ka: henok, palu, hesron dènge karmi.

source_text: the sons of simeon; jemuel, and jamin, and ohad, and jachin, and zohar, and shaul, the son of a woman of canaan.
target_text: simeon, dènge ana-ana na: yemuel, yamin, ohat, yakin, dènge sohar. dènge saul kahèi, ana na nèti dhèu èmu na bhèni kana'an.

source_text: the sons of levi; gershon, kohath, and merari.
target_text: lewi, dènge ana-ana na: gerson, kehat, dènge merari.

source_text: the sons of judah; er, and onan, and shelah, and perez, and zarah. forsooth er and onan died in the land of canaan; and the sons of perez were born, hezron, and hamul.
target_text: yahuda, dènge ana-ana na: sela, peres, dènge sera. ana yahuda dhu leo, er dènge onan, madhe le ètu kana'an. na nèti dènge ana-ana peres, hesron dènge hamul.

source_text: the sons of issachar; tola, and phuvah, and job, and shimron.
target_text: isaskar, dènge ana-ana na: tola, pua, ayub, dènge simron.

source_text: the sons of zebulun; sered, and elon, and jahleel.
target_text: sebulon, dènge ana-ana na: seret, elon, dènge jahleel.

source_text: these be the sons of leah, which she childed to jacob in mesopotamia of syria, with dinah, her daughter; all the souls of his sons and daughters by leah, three and thirty.
target_text: rèngu se'e, ana-ana nèti yakob dènge dhèu èmu na lea, lod'o rèngu pea ètu mesopotamia. ana bhèni rèngu èci, ngara na dina. ana-èpu nèti yakob dènge lea, aa'i-aa'i ra tèlu nguru tèlu dhèu.

source_text: the sons of gad; ziphion, and haggi, shuni, and ezbon, eri, and arodi, and areli.
target_text: aa yakob abhu ana-ana dènge dhèu èmu dhu leo hari. nuka: gad, dènge ana-ana na: sifion, hagi, suni, esbon, eri, arodi dènge areli.

source_text: the sons of asher; jimnah, and ishuah, and isui, and beriah; and serah, the sister of them. the sons of beriah; heber, and malchiel.
target_text: aser, dènge ana-ana na: yimna, yiswa, yiswi, beria, dènge ana hèni ra èci, ngara na sera. beria, dènge ana le kahèi: heber dènge malkiel.

source_text: these were the sons of zilpah, whom laban gave to leah, his daughter, and through whom jacob begat these sixteen persons.
target_text: rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra, canguru èna dhèu. ana-èpu nèti yakob dènge dhèu èmu na silpa. silpa ne'e ka dhu laban hia j'aj'i ènu nèti lea, dhèu èmu uru yakob na.

source_text: the sons of rachel, jacob's wife, were joseph and benjamin.
target_text: aa ana-ana nèti yakob dènge dhèu èmu na bhèni leo hari, ngara na rahel, nuka: yusuf dènge benyamin.

source_text: and two sons were born to joseph in the land of egypt, manasseh and ephraim, which asenath, the daughter of potipherah, priest of heliopolis, childed to him.
target_text: lod'o èèna, yusuf leo le dènge asnat ètu masir. ama asnat èèna, ama agama ètu kota on. ngara na, potifera. ana-ana yusuf dènge asnat: efraim dènge manase.

source_text: the sons of benjamin were belah, and becher, and ashbel, gera, and naaman, and ehi, and rosh, and muppim, and huppim, and ard.
target_text: benyamin madhutu hèi lasi masir dènge ana-ana na: bela, beker, asibel, gera, naaman, ehi, ros, mupim, hupim dènge aret.

source_text: these were the sons of rachel, the which jacob begat through her; all the persons were fourteen.
target_text: ana-èpu yakob dènge dhèu èmu na rahel, canguru èpa dhèu.

source_text: the son of dan; hushim.
target_text: dhèu èmu yakob èci hari, ngara na bilha. ana-ana ra, dan, dènge naftali. ana dan, ngara na husim.

source_text: the sons of naphtali; jahzeel, and guni, and jezer, and shillem.
target_text: ana nèti naftali: yasel, guni, yeser dènge silem.

source_text: these were the sons of bilhah, whom laban gave to rachel his daughter. and jacob begat these through bilhah; all the souls were seven.
target_text: yakob dènge dhèu èmu na bilha, ana-èpu rèngu dhèu pidhu. bilha ne, ènu nèti rahel, dhu na abhu nèti ama na laban.

source_text: and all the men that entered with jacob into egypt, and went out of his thigh, without his sons' wives, were sixty and six.
target_text: de ana-èpu yakob dhu lasi masir, aa'i-aa'i ra dhèu èna nguru èna dhèu. se'e se, ige mèka dènge dhèu èmu nèti ana-ana nèngu sèra.

source_text: forsooth the sons of joseph, that were born to him in the land of egypt, were two men. all the souls of the house of jacob, that entered into egypt, were seventy.
target_text: ladhe tabha dènge ana-ana yusuf dhu ina na nara iisi ètu masir dhèu dua, na yakob dènge ana-èpu aa'i-aa'i ra si, pidhu nguru dhèu.

source_text: forsooth jacob sent judah before him to joseph, that he should tell to him, and he meet with them in goshen. and when jacob had come thither,
target_text: ropa ra dètu dènge masir, yakob pua yahuda la'e uuru, paroa yusuf ho mai paraga dènge ne ètu gosen. ropa ra d'ai gosen,

source_text: joseph went up in his chariot to meet his father at the same place. and he saw jacob, and felled on his neck, and wept betwixt embraces.
target_text: yusuf ca'e nare kareta na, mai paraga dènge ama na. ropa ra paraga, liku nare ama na, ka na tangi nèbhu bia.

source_text: and the father said to joseph, now i shall die joyful, for i have seen thy face, and i leave thee living.
target_text: hèia yakob padhai lii dènge yusuf, aku nèngu na, ana, ee! ja'a unu ku kèdhi le èu. aa ja'a ke'a le èu mamuri era. de ladhe ja'a madhe èèna ka oo, ngaa-ngaa tao heka.

source_text: and joseph spake to his brethren, and to all his father's household, i shall go up, and tell to pharaoh, and i shall say to him, my brethren, and the household of my father, that were in the land of canaan, be come to me,
target_text: ka yusuf peka dènge a'ari na aa'i-aa'i, peka na, ja'a laku peka ku dènge dhèu aae, sèna ka ne'a na a'ari ja'a mai le nèti kana'an.

source_text: and they be men keepers of sheep, and have busyness of flocks to be fed; they brought with them their sheep, and great beasts, and all things which they might have.
target_text: aa, pe ja'a peka kahèi dènge ne, miu biasa ani kahib'i-kalèbho dènge sapi. nèti èèna ka, miu mèti dènge badha-manu dènge mèdha-panyau miu nèti kana'an.

source_text: and when pharaoh shall call you, and shall say, what is your work?
target_text: de ladhe dhèu aae paroa miu, ho na karèi miu biasa sab'a ngaa,

source_text: ye shall answer, we be thy servants, men shepherds, from our childhood till into this present time, both we and our fathers. soothly ye shall say these things, that ye may dwell in the land of goshen, for egyptians loathe all keepers of sheep.
target_text: na, miu dhaa ne peka na, miu se aa'i-aa'i mi nèti ana iiki ka mai piara badha, sama sèmi bèi-baki ji'i. sèna ka na pua miu pea ètu rai gosen. yusuf peka sèmi èèna, lula dhèu masir madenge pea pa'èci dènge ana madhutu badha.

source_text: therefore joseph entered, and told to pharaoh, and said, my father and brethren, the sheep and the great beasts of them, and all things that they wield, have come from the land of canaan; and lo! they stand in the land of goshen. and joseph ordained five, the least, or meekest, men of his brethren, to come before the king,
target_text: èle èèna ka, yusuf dènge a'ari na dhèu lèmi, lasi paraga dènge dhèu aae. d'ai madha dhèu aae, ka yusuf patadha si dènge dhèu aae, ka na peka na, ama dhèu aae! ama ku dènge a'ari ku mai le nèti kana'an. rèngu mai dènge kahib'i-kalèbho, sapi, dènge mèdha-panyau aa'i-aa'i ra. nuka ra ètu rai gosen nèi.

source_text: whom he asked, what work have ye? they answered, we thy servants be keepers of sheep, both we and our fathers;
target_text: dhèu aae karèi si, aku nèngu na, sasab'a miu ngaa? ra dhaa, peka na, ji'i se, ana madhutu badha, sama sèmi bèi-baki ji'i sèra.

source_text: we came into thy land to be pilgrims, that is, to dwell for a time, for no grass is to the flocks of thy servants; for hunger waxeth grievous in the land of canaan, and we ask that thou command us thy servants to be in the land of goshen.
target_text: limuri ne'e, ètu rai ji'i kana'an, hèru hadhu madhera, ka nganga'a dènge j'u'u tèdhi heka. nèti èèna ka, ji'i mai taha asa kabarai ne'e. ngèti dènge badha-manu ji'i. de ji'i manèngi ama dhèu aae, ho hia ji'i pea ètu rai gosen, sèna ka ji'i piara badha ji'i ètu nèi.

source_text: and so the king said to joseph, thy father and thy brethren have come to thee;
target_text: hèia dhèu aae padhai lii dènge yusuf sèmi ne'e: ama mu dènge a'ari mu ètu ne'e le.

source_text: the land of egypt is in thy sight; make thou them to dwell in the best place, and give thou to them the land of goshen; that if thou knowest that witting men be in them, ordain them masters of my beasts.
target_text: de hud'i laa rèngu tao kabarai ne'e, sama sèmi kabarai rèngu. madhutu kake'a ja'a, gosen èèna era dhu be'a risi nèti era leo ètu rai masir ne'e. de be'a risi rèngu pea ètu èèna ka la. aa ladhe rèngu cee dhu ladhe-leru badha dènge hua iia, na ja'a hia badha ja'a ho na piara si ètu èèna.

source_text: after these things joseph brought in his father to the king, and set him before the king, and he blessed the king;
target_text: èle èèna hèia, yusuf patadhe ama na dènge dhèu aae. ka yakob manèngi mi ama lamatua, sèna ka hia mèngi-nale mi dhèu aae.

source_text: and he was asked of the king, how many be the days of the years of thy life?
target_text: dhèu aae karèi yakob, aku nèngu na, ama umur pèri tèu kèna?

source_text: and he answered, the days of the pilgrimage of my life be few and evil, of an hundred and thirty years, and those or they have not come to the days of my fathers, in which they were pilgrims.
target_text: yakob dhaa, umur ja'a cangasu tèlu nguru tèu kèna, te ngaa ja'a pea boe mi ca era sa. bèi-baki ja'a sèmi èèna kahèi. ladhe pakasame dènge rèngu, na umur ja'a kura nèti rèngu. te ngaa mamuri ja'a pènu dènge j'aj'èra.

source_text: and when jacob had blessed the king again, he went out.
target_text: hèia yakob manèngi parmisi neo lèpa. te ngaa kalua mèka nèti d'ara èmu, na manèngi hari ca tèka mi lamatua ho sèna ka hia berkat mi dhèu aae.

source_text: forsooth joseph gave to his father and his brethren a possession in egypt, in rameses, the best soil of the earth, as pharaoh commanded;
target_text: èle èèna ka, yusuf pad'elo era pea hia a'ari na si ètu gosen, madhutu lii pua dhèu aae deo na. era èèna be'a titu kèna. ra pangare era èèna ‘rameses'. ka ama na dènge a'ari na sèra pea taruu ètu èèna.

source_text: and he fed them, and all the household of his father, and gave meats to them all.
target_text: hèia yusuf sadia nganga'a hia ama na, a'ari na, dènge ana dhèu èmu ra, aa'i-aa'i ra, nèti dhèu kapai toke d'ai ana susu.

source_text: for bread failed in all the world, and hunger oppressed the land, mostly of egypt and of canaan;
target_text: taa èèna, rai manganga titu kèna, tèdhi boe nganga'a ca lamusi sa ètu mia-mia. nèti masir toke kana'an, dhèu-dhèu manganga roe ca palèpa, taga nèti ra'a-rinu heka. dhèu bisa heka sab'a ngaa-ngaa, lula manganga titu kèna.

source_text: of which lands joseph gathered all the money for the selling of wheat, and brought it into the king's treasury.
target_text: dhèu-dhèu nèti d'ara rae-rae ètu masir, sèmi èèna kahèi dhèu-dhèu nèti d'ara rae-rae ètu kana'an, mai hèli nganga'a ètu yusuf. doi-doi dhu na sèmi sèra, na pakaboko aa'i ka, la'e tèke asa èmu dhèu aae.

source_text: and when price failed to the buyers, all egypt came to joseph, and said, give thou loaves to us; why shall we die before thee, while money faileth?
target_text: tèu èèna, èla aa'i doi dhèu masir dènge dhèu kana'an ka ra bisa heka hèli nganga'a. hèia ra mai roma iisi mi yusuf, aku rèngu na, ama wakil! hia ku ji'i nganga'a ciki la, sèna ka ji'i baku madhe manganga. te doi ji'i, èla aa'i mèu-mèu le.

source_text: to whom he answered, bring ye your beasts, and i shall give you meats for those or them, if ye have not price.
target_text: hèia yusuf dhaa, peka na, ladhe tare'a doi miu aad'o heka, na sèmi ne'e ka la! mèti badha miu, ho pasilu dènge nganga'a.

source_text: and when they had brought those, he gave them meats for horses, and sheep, and oxen, and asses; and he sustained them in that year for the exchange of beasts.
target_text: ka dhèu se'e mai pasilu badha ra dènge nganga'a. badha-badha sèmi jara, kahib'i-ka'ia, kahib'i-kalèbho, sapi, dènge keled'ei. lula tèu èèna, yusuf dhu moa tèke le.

source_text: and they came in the second year, and said to him, we cover not from our lord, that the while money faileth, also our beasts failed altogether, neither it is hid from thee, that without bodies and land, we have nothing;
target_text: tèu mai na, rèngu mai hari sa madha yusuf, ka ra peka, ama wakil, ee! ji'i peka tare'a-re'a kèna. doi ji'i dènge badha ji'i ama pasilu aa'i-aa'i le. limuri ne'e, ji'i dènge heka ngaa-ngaa. dhu ètu ji'i dhodhoka ngi'u dènge rai ji'i di.

source_text: why therefore shall we die, while thou seest this? both we and our land shall be thine; buy thou us into the king's servage, and give thou us seeds to sow, lest while the tiller perisheth, the land be turned into wilderness.
target_text: baku tèke eele ji'i madhe manganga. te ladhe ji'i madhe na, cee ka dhu sab'a oka-tedhe se'e? de hua iia, ama wakil more ji'i, ho j'aj'i ènu mu. aa more aa'i rai ji'i kahèi. pe, èèna na, ama hia hini ho ji'i sèla hia ama. gaji dènge kab'ua rai ji'i, ama pasilu dènge nganga'a. sad'i ji'i baku madhe manganga.

source_text: therefore joseph bought all the land of egypt, while all men sold him their possessions, for the greatness of hunger; and he made it and all the peoples thereof subject to pharaoh,
target_text: lula rai manganga ae, ka dhèu masir pahie aa'i rai rèngu. nèti èèna ka, yusuf hèli nara aa'i rai ètu masir j'aj'i mi pusaka dhèu aae.

source_text: from the last terms of egypt till to the last ends thereof,
target_text: dènge j'ara sèmi èèna ka, dhèu masir aa'i-aa'i ra j'aj'i ènu nèti dhèu aae.

source_text: except the land of priests, that was given of the king to them, to which priests also meats were given of the common barns, and therefore they were not compelled to sell their possessions.
target_text: dhoka rai unu ama agama sèra di, yusuf hèli nare boe, te dhèu aae hia taruu dhèu se nganga'a na. nèti èèna ka, dhèu se pahie boe rai rèngu.

source_text: therefore joseph said to the peoples, lo! as ye see, pharaoh wieldeth both you and your land; now take ye seeds, and sow ye fields,
target_text: lod'o èèna, yusuf peka dènge ana kabarai sèra, aku nèngu na, naa! miu j'aj'i le ènu nèti dhèu aae. ja'a hèli kore aa'i le, rai miu hia dhèu aae. de mere hini se'e ho lami sèla ka mi dedha rai sèra.

source_text: that ye may have fruits; ye shall give the fifth part to the king; i suffer to you the four residue parts into seed, and into meats, to you, and to your free children.
target_text: ladhe miu puu-g'ètu na, bagi mi lèmi. ho ca pala hia dhèu aae. aa èpa pala sèra, miu tao hini dènge mi pake mi'a-minu dènge a'ari miu.

source_text: which answered, our health is in thine hands; only our god behold us, and we shall joyfully serve the king.
target_text: hèia ra dhaa, aku rèngu na, ama pamamuri ji'i le, de ji'i manèngi tarima kasi. ji'i neo j'aj'i ènu nèti dhèu aae.

source_text: from that time till to this present day, in all the land of egypt, the fifth part is paid to the kings, and it is made as into a law, without the land of priests, that was free from this condition.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, yusuf tao madha j'ara ne'e, j'aj'i ad'a kabarai ètu masir. ladhe ra puru rare are na, ra bagi mi lèmi pala. ho ca pala rèngu hia mi dhèu aae. aa èpa pala rèngu abhu. te ngaa rai ama agama sèra, dhèu aae hèli boe. ad'a èèna, ra pake taruu.

source_text: therefore israel dwelled in egypt, that is, in the land of goshen, and wielded it; and he was increased, and multiplied full much.
target_text: karèi nèti lod'o èèna, dhèu isra'el pea taruu ka ètu masir, ètu rai gosen. ra j'aj'i dhèu kaja, aa ana-èpu rèngu asa tabha ae.

source_text: and he lived therein sixteen or seventeen years; and all the days of his life were made an hundred and seven and forty years.
target_text: ètu masir, yakob mamuri hari canguru pidhu tèu era. j'aj'i umur yakob aa'i-aa'i ra, cangasu èpa nguru pidhu tèu.

source_text: and when he saw the day of his death to nigh, he called his son joseph to his bed, and said to him, if i have found grace in thy sight, put thine hand under mine hip, and swear that thou shalt do mercy and truth to me, that thou bury not me in egypt;
target_text: lod'o dètu na madhe èèna, na paroa yusuf, ka na padhai lii dènge ne, aku nèngu na, ana yusuf! ja'a rasa na, mamuri ja'a madhera heka. nèbhu heka, lamatua paroa ja'a lèpa kèna. èèna ka ja'a manèngi sèna ka ladhe èu sue ja'a, èu subha sèna ka baku padhane ja'a ètu rai masir ne'e.

source_text: but i shall sleep with my fathers, and take thou away me from this land, and bury me in the sepulchre of my greaters. to whom joseph answered, i shall do that that thou commandest.
target_text: èu hud'i mèti ngi'u aae ja'a, ho padhane asa era ro'a bèi-baki èdhi. ho èu padhane ja'a ètu èèna. ne'e ne, dad'èi d'ara ama. ka yusuf dhaa ne, aku nèngu na, be'a ama! ladhe dad'èi ama ku kèna, na ja'a madhutu.

source_text: and israel said, therefore swear thou to me; and when joseph swore, israel turned to the head of the bed, and worshipped god.
target_text: ka yakob padhai lii hari, peka na, de ladhe sèmi èèna, èu hud'i subha uuru ku, ho ke'a na èu madhutu dad'èi ama. hèia yusuf subha madhutu dad'èi yakob. ka yakob patitu kètu urutuu ètu dedha era j'unu na, ka na manèngi makasi mi ama lamatua.

source_text: and so when these things were done, it was told to joseph, that his father was sick. and he took his two sons, manasseh and ephraim, and he disposed him to go.
target_text: nèbhu boe ka, dhèu lasi peka dènge yusuf na, ama na pèd'a aae. hèia la'e nèti dènge ana na, efraim dènge manase, sèna ka lasi ladhe baki ra yakob.

source_text: and it was said to the eld or old man, lo! thy son joseph cometh to thee; which was comforted, and sat up in the bed.
target_text: ropa yakob tadèngi yusuf si mai le, ka na pakaseti madhèdi.

source_text: and when joseph entered to him, he said, almighty god appeared to me in luz, which is in the land of canaan, and blessed me,
target_text: hèia na padhai lii dènge yusuf, aku nèngu na, ana yusuf, ee! ama lamatua dhu dènge koasa kapai risi na, uru èèna, na pad'elo le iisi na dènge ja'a ètu rae lus, ètu rai kana'an. ètu nèi, na moa tèke mi ja'a.

source_text: and said, i shall increase thee, and multiply thee, and i shall make thee into companies of peoples, and i shall give to thee this land, and to thy seed after thee, into everlasting possession.
target_text: na padhai lii, peka na, ‘bèli-camèd'a ja'a hia ana-èpu èu j'aj'i ae, ho rèngu j'aj'i suku dhu kapai. rai ne'e ne, ja'a hia j'aj'i unu rèngu, ho j'aj'i pusaka ra toke d'ai rai-haha èle. '

source_text: therefore thy two sons, that be born to thee in the land of egypt, before that i came hither to thee, shall be mine; ephraim and manasseh, as reuben and simeon, shall be areckoned to me;
target_text: aa ana èu efraim dènge manase èèna, hak rèngu sèmi ne'e ka: lod'o dhu ja'a d'ai masir na, mere iisi le rèngu dua ra. masi ka sèmi èèna, ja'a tao rèngu sèmi ana d'èlu ja'a, sama sèmi ruben dènge simeon.

source_text: forsooth the others which thou shalt beget after them shall be thine; and they shall be called by the name of their brethren in their possessions.
target_text: aa ladhe bèli-camèd'a èu abhu hari ana, na èèna di unu èu kèna. ja'a tao boe rèngu sèmi ana d'èlu ja'a. pe pusaka ra, rèngu abhu nèti a'a ra, efraim dènge manase.

source_text: forsooth when i came from mesopotamia, rachel was dead to me in the land of canaan, in that way; and it was the beginning of summer; and before that i entered into ephratah, and i buried her beside the way of ephratah, which by another name is called bethlehem.
target_text: ja'a tao sèmi èèna, sèna ka èdhi sanèd'e ina mu rahel. lod'o ji'i mai nèti mesopotamia asa kana'an, d'ai talora j'ara, ina mu madhe ropa nara iisi aa'i. èèna na, ji'i dètu rae efrata ètu rai kana'an. lod'o èèna, ja'a susa d'ai seli. ka ja'a padhane ne ètu sebhe j'ara la'e asa rae efrata. limuri ne, rae èèna ra gati ngara na betlehem.

source_text: forsooth jacob saw the sons of joseph, and said to him, who be these?
target_text: ropa yakob padhai lii nare sèmi èèna hèia, na boti kètu na, ladhe nèdhi ana-ana yusuf ètu èèna. hèia na karèi yusuf, aku nèngu na, se'e se, ana cee?

source_text: he answered, they be my sons, which god gave me in this place. jacob said, bring them to me, that i bless them.
target_text: ka yusuf dhaa, se'e, ana dhu ama lamatua hia ja'a ètu masir. yakob peka hari, ladhe sèmi èèna, na hia ra mai padètu dènge ja'a, ho ja'a manèngi ama lamatua hia si mèngi-nale.

source_text: for the eyes of israel dimmed for great eld age, and he might not see clearly; and he kissed and embraced those children joined to him,
target_text: yakob heka le, aa musi madha na ahu le. na ladhe nèdhi be'a heka. hèia yusuf nèti ana na sèra padètu asa madha yakob, ka na liku nare si, aa na uu si dua ra.

source_text: and he said to his son, i am not defrauded of thy sight; furthermore god hath showed to me thy seed.
target_text: ka na peka dènge yusuf, aku nèngu na, nèbhu nare sange ne'e, ja'a pangee na, ja'a bisa heka kèdhi rèhu èu. te ngaa ama lamatua, tao risi eele nèti ngaa dhu ja'a ngee, toke ja'a bisa kèdhi ana-ana èu kahèi.

source_text: and when joseph had taken them from his father's lap, he worshipped or honoured low to the earth.
target_text: hèia yusuf hari eele ana na dhèu dua sèra nèti madha yakob, ka na patitu kètu urutuu na, aa na pacud'u rèhu na d'ai rai, ètu madha ama na.

source_text: and he set ephraim on his right side, that is, on the left side of israel; forsooth he set manasseh on his left side, that is, on the right side of his father; and he joined both to him.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yusuf kèd'i. na nare ana na dhèu dua sèra, ka na hia ra titu padètu-dètu dènge ama na. na patitu ana uuru na manase, re bèka g'ana yakob. aa ana ka dua, efraim, re bèka kariu yakob.

source_text: which held forth the right hand, and laid it on ephraim's head, the younger brother; soothly he laid his left hand on manasseh's head, that was the more through birth. jacob changed his hands,
target_text: te ngaa ropa yakob soro ai na neo manèngi mèngi-nale hia ana dua sèra, na soro ai g'ana na mi kètu efraim, aa ai kariu mi kètu manase.

source_text: and blessed his son joseph, and said, god, in whose sight my fathers abraham and isaac went; god that feedeth me from my young waxing age till into this present day;
target_text: ka na manèngi ama lamatua hia berkat mi yusuf, peka na, baki mu isak, dènge ama na abraham, dua ra madhutu taruu dad'èi ama lamatua. ama lamatua ladhe-leru ja'a kahèi, nèti ana ngèru toke d'ai deo ne'e ne.

source_text: the angel that delivered me from all evils, bless these children, and my name be called on them, and the names of my fathers, abraham and isaac; and wax they in multitude on earth.

source_text: and joseph, her husband, for he was rightful or a just man, and would not publish her, he would privily have left her.

source_text: but while he thought these things, lo! the angel of the lord appeared to him in sleep, and said, joseph, the son of david, do not thou dread to take mary, thy wife; for that thing that is born in her is of the holy ghost.

source_text: and she shall bear a son, and thou shalt call his name jesus; for he shall make his people safe from their sins.

source_text: for all this thing was done, that it should be fulfilled, that was said of the lord by a prophet, saying,

source_text: lo! a virgin shall have in the womb, and she shall bear a son, and they shall call his name emmanuel, that is to say, god with us.

source_text: and joseph rose up from sleep, and did as the angel of the lord commanded him, and took mary, his wife;

source_text: and he knew her not, till she had born her first begotten son, and he called his name jesus.

source_text: therefore when jesus was born in bethlehem of judea, in the days of king herod, lo! astronomers, or kings, or wise men, came from the east to jerusalem,

source_text: and said, where is he, that is born the king of jews? for we have seen his star in the east, and we have come to worship him.
target_text: ropa ra d'ai yerusalem dhèu se pakarèi, aku rèngu na, dhèu aae nèti dhèu yahudi, dhu heka rara iisi hiu èèna, era na buli mia, ee? ji'i ngèdhi hua-hètu cue ètu bèka dhimu, dhu j'aj'i mi tadha dhu peka na, rara iisi le nèngu. nèti èèna ka, ji'i mai neo pahaha iisi mi nèngu.

source_text: but king herod heard, and was troubled, and all jerusalem with him.
target_text: ropa dhèu aae herodes tadèngi lii ne'e, hèia d'ara na susa. nèti èèna ka, dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu yerusalem sèra, d'ara ra susa kahèi.

source_text: and he gathered together all the princes of priests, and scribes of the people, and inquired of them, where christ should be born.

source_text: and they said to him, in bethle-hem of judea; for so it is written by a prophet,

source_text: and thou, bethlehem, the land of judah, art not the least among the princes of judah; for of thee a duke shall go out, that shall govern my people israel.

source_text: then herod called privily the astronomers, or the kings, and learned busily of them the time of the star that appeared to them.

source_text: and he sent them into bethlehem, and said, go ye, and ask ye busily of the child, and when ye have found, tell ye it to me, that i also come, and worship him.

source_text: and they saw the star, and joyed with a full great joy.

source_text: and when they were gone, lo! the angel of the lord appeared to joseph in sleep, and said, rise up, and take the child and his mother, and flee into egypt, and be thou there, till that i say to thee; for it is to come, that herod seek the child, to destroy him.

source_text: and joseph rose up, and took the child and his mother by night, and went into egypt,
target_text: hèia yusuf kèd'i nèti bhèj'i. ka mèda èèna kahèi, nèti dhèu èmu na dènge ana ne, rai lasi asa masir.

source_text: and he was there till the death of herod; that it should be fulfilled, that was said of the lord by the prophet, saying, from egypt i have called my son.

source_text: and said, rise up, and take the child and his mother, and go into the land of israel; for they that sought the life of the child be dead.

source_text: joseph rose up, and took the child and his mother, and came into the land of israel.

source_text: in those days john baptist came, and preached in the desert of judea,

source_text: and said, do ye penance, for the kingdom of heaven shall come nigh.

source_text: for this is he, of whom it is said by isaiah, the prophet, saying, a voice of a crier in desert, or a voice of a man crying in desert, make ye ready the ways of the lord; make ye right the paths of him.

source_text: and they were washed or christened of him in jordan, acknowledging their sins.

source_text: therefore do ye worthy fruits of penance,

source_text: and do not ye say within you, we have abraham to our father or we have the father abraham; for i say to you, that god is mighty to raise up of these stones the sons of abraham.
