target_text: aa ladhe èu tao sala dènge kacui-aai g'ana èu, poro eele kacui-aai ne. te be'a risi èu maso sorga dènge kacui-aai cabèka di, aa baku ra pèci mu asa d'ara ai naraka dènge kacui-aai dhu kateme iisi.

source_text: and it hath been said, whoever leaveth his wife, give he to her a libel or a little book of forsaking.
target_text: miu dhu me'a le atora musa, na, ‘dhèu dhu pa'ia dènge dhèu èmu-kamali na, nèngu hud'i hia ku sasuri pa'ia mi bhèni èèna. '

source_text: but i say to you, that every man that leaveth his wife, except the cause of fornication, maketh her to do lechery, and he that weddeth the forsaken wife, doeth adultery.
target_text: te ngaa ja'a peka sèmi ne'e: ladhe abhu dhèu dhu ia eele dhèu èmu na, te ngaa bhèni ne tao nèdhi boe j'ara makae, hèia bhèni ne leo hari èmu, na, dhèu èmu uuru èèna ka dhu tao nèngu j'aj'i bersina. aa ladhe abhu dhèu mone dhu leo nare bhèni dhu dhèu èmu na ia eele, na, rèngu dua ra bersina kahèi.

source_text: again ye have heard, that it was said to old men, thou shalt not forswear, but thou shalt yield thine oaths to the lord.
target_text: miu dhu me'a le atora musa dhu na hia mi bèi-baki èdhi, peka na, ‘ladhe èu pajaji pake lii soo-subha, dhu ale kolongara ama lamatua, na, èu dhu pa'èki le dènge soo-subha èèna. '

source_text: but i say to you, that ye swear not for anything; neither by heaven, for it is the throne of god;
target_text: te ngaa ja'a peka sèmi ne'e: ladhe èu neo pajaji, na, mage mu j'oka subha. baku subha dènge ngara sorga, lula sorga èèna era pea ama lamatua.

source_text: neither by the earth, for it is the stool of his feet; neither by jerusalem, for it is the city of a great or the great king;
target_text: mage subha pake ngara rai-haha, lula rai-haha ne, era bane haga ama lamatua. aa mage subha pake ngara yerusalem, lula yerusalem èèna, kota nèti dhèu aae kapai.

source_text: neither thou shalt swear by thine head, for thou mayest not make one hair white, or black;
target_text: baku subha pake ngara kab'a kètu miu. te miu dènge boe koasa ho paredha rèu kètu miu, sèna ka ca loa sa j'aj'i mèdhi do j'aj'i pudhi.

source_text: but be your word, yea, yea; nay, nay; and that that is more than these, is of evil.
target_text: de ladhe miu neo pajaji, dhu peka oo, na, peka la ‘oo' di. te ngaa ladhe aad'o, na, peka la, ‘aad'o' di. ladhe miu peka risi nèti èèna, sèra sa j'aj'aj'i nèti nidhu.

source_text: ye have heard that it hath been said, eye for eye, and tooth for tooth.
target_text: miu dhu me'a le atora musa, dhu peka na, ‘ladhe dhèu cee dhu pa'ele iie musi madha miu, na, pa'ele iie kahèi musi madha na. aa ladhe abhu dhèu dhu pakabhui eele ngutu èu, na, pakabhui eele ngutu na kahèi. '

source_text: but i say to you, that ye against-stand not an evil man, or to not against-stand evil; but if any smite thee in the right cheek, show or give to him also the other;
target_text: te ngaa ja'a peka dènge miu sèmi ne'e: baku b'ala bhabhelu dènge bhabhelu. ladhe dhèu tèb'e ripi èu cabèka, na hud'i laa, na tèb'e hari ripi dhu leo.

source_text: and to him that will strive with thee in doom, and take away thy coat, leave thou to him also thy mantle or thine over-cloth;
target_text: ladhe dhèu neo tenge lii langu dènge èu, ho neo nare kodho èu, na, hia ne kodho pana èu kahèi.

source_text: and whoever constraineth thee a thousand paces, go thou with him other twain.
target_text: ladhe sordad'u ca dhèu laka-seti èu ho pasae mèdha na kako d'ai ca kilometer, na, èu pasae mèti kaj'èu na toke dua kilometer.

source_text: give thou to him that asketh of thee, and turn thou not away from him that will borrow of thee.
target_text: ladhe dhèu neo manèngi nare mèdha èu èci, na, hia la. aa ladhe dhèu neo pija mèdha èu, na, hia la.

source_text: ye have heard that it was said, thou shalt love thy neighbour, and hate thine enemy.
target_text: miu tadèngi le, dhu peka na, ‘sue la a'ari èu, aa nasa la dènge dhèu dhu nasa dènge èu. '

source_text: but i say to you, love ye your enemies, do ye well to them that hate you, and pray ye for them that pursue, and slander you;
target_text: te ngaa ja'a peka sèmi ne'e: èu hud'i sue ku dhèu dhu nasa dènge èu, aa manèngi ho lamatua hia mèngi-nale mi dhèu dhu paj'èra èu.

source_text: that ye be the sons of your father that is in heavens, that maketh his sun to rise upon good and evil men, and raineth on just men and unjust.
target_text: ladhe èu tao sèmi èèna, èu pad'elo, na, èu ana ama ètu sorga. lula nèngu ka tao madha lod'o hia dhèu dhu be'a, dènge dhèu dhu bhelu. na papuru èj'i hia dhèu dhu tao madhutu paredha na, aa mi dhèu dhu lab'a paredha na kahèi.

source_text: for if ye love them that love you, what meed shall ye have? whether the publicans do not this thing?
target_text: de ladhe èu sue dhoka dhèu dhu sue èu, èu ngee na ama lamatua hud'i b'ala hia èu mèngi-nale, do? aad'o! te dhèu bhelu kahèi ne'a sue angalai na, dhu sue nèngu.

source_text: and if ye greet your brethren only, what shall ye do moreover? do not heathen men or pagans this?
target_text: de ladhe èu me'a dhoka hia lii maho'o mi angalai èu, na, kolo-karisi na ngaa? te dhèu dhu parcaya boe ama lamatua, re'a ad'u-ue j'ara sèmi èèna kahèi.

source_text: therefore be ye perfect, as your heavenly father is perfect.
target_text: de sanèd'e, ee! ama mu ètu sorga sue dhèu aa'i-aa'i. de èu hud'i tao madhutu ku sèmi èèna kahèi!

source_text: take heed, that ye do not your rightwiseness before men, to be seen of them, else ye shall have no meed at your father that is in heavens.
target_text: yesus aj'a taruu, peka na, sanèd'e! mage mi madhutu atora agama di, sèna ka dhèu pad'iri miu. te ladhe miu tao sèmi èèna, ama miu ètu sorga b'ala boe rui-j'aj'èra miu.

source_text: therefore when thou doest alms, do not thou trumpet before thee, as hypocrites do in synagogues and streets, that they be worshipped of men; soothly i say to you, they have received their meed.
target_text: ladhe miu neo soru-bara dhèu kasia, mage lami palolo asa mia-mia. te ladhe miu se tao sèmi èèna, miu ca ropa dènge dhèu dhu padhai lii leo, tao leo. dhèu sèmi sèra, d'èi lasi karihu asa d'ara èmu sabaj'a ho dhèu koa si, peka na, ‘ira ii! dhèu ne maj'èni madhutu atora agama, nga! ' ja'a peka mola-mola kèna! dhèu dhu tema sèmi rare lii koa-kad'iri nèti dhèu, rèngu se abhu le pala ra.

source_text: but when thou doest alms, know not thy left hand what thy right hand doeth,
target_text: de ladhe miu neo soru-bara dhèu dhu dènge boe ngaa-ngaa, mage mi palolo kahèi!

source_text: that thine alms be in huddles, and thy father that seeth in huddles, shall requite or yield to thee.
target_text: dènge sèmi èèna, dhèu ètu rai-haha ne re'a boe. te ngaa ama miu ètu sorga dhu ne'a ngaa dhu miu tao pahuni. pe nèngu ka dhu b'ala hia miu berkat ae-ae.

source_text: and when ye pray, ye shall not be as hypocrites, that love to pray standing in synagogues and in corners of streets, to be seen of men or that they be seen of men; truly i say to you, they have received their meed.
target_text: lod'o miu sabaj'a, miu baku tao nuka sèmi dhèu dhu padhai lii leo, tao leo. dhèu se d'èi lasi asa j'ara dhu dhèu ae-ae, aa titu ètu d'ara èmu manèngi-mangaj'i ho dhèu koa-kad'iri si, peka na, ‘dhèu se, dhèu mola-mèci! ' te ngaa nanene pabe'a-be'a! dènge rèngu abhu koa sèmi èèna, rèngu sèmi rare le pala ra.

source_text: but when thou shalt pray, enter into thy couch, and when the door is shut, pray thy father in huddles, and thy father that seeth in huddles, shall yield to thee.
target_text: te ngaa miu baku sèmi èèna. ladhe miu manèngi-mangaj'i, lami asa d'ara kama ho bèdho babèdho na. èle èèna, heka mi sabaj'a mau-mau hia ama mi ètu sorga. masi ka dhèu leo rèdhi boe, te ngaa ama miu ladhe nèdhi. bèli-camèd'a na b'ala hia miu berkat ae-ae.

source_text: but in praying do not ye speak much, as heathen men do, for they guess that they be heard in their much speech.
target_text: ladhe miu sabaj'a, baku padhai lii dhu dènge boe kolo-kapua. te dhèu dhu tadhe boe ama lamatua sabaj'a sèmi èèna ka. rèngu pangee, na, ama lamatua d'èi nanene lii manèngi ra dhu madhera lola-lola èèna.

source_text: therefore do not ye be made like to them, for your father knoweth what is needful to you, before that ye ask him.
target_text: mage mi madhutu j'ara rèngu sèra! te masi ka miu dhae manèngi mèka ngaa-ngaa nèti ama mi ètu sorga, te ngaa nèngu dhu ne'a mema le, ngaa dhu miu parluu.

source_text: and thus ye shall pray, our father that art in heavens, hallowed be thy name;
target_text: de ladhe sabaj'a, na, madhutu la conto sèmi ne'e: ‘ama ètu sorga! kolongara ama dhu mola-mèci. hud'i laa dhèu aa'i-aa'i, ded'e padedha-dedha kolongara ama dhu kapai èèna.

source_text: thy kingdom come to; be thy will done in earth as it is in heaven or thy will be done as in heaven and in earth;
target_text: hud'i laa ama j'aj'i dhèu aae mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i! hud'i laa dhèu aa'i-aa'i, tao madhutu paredha ama ètu rai-haha ne, nuka sèmi ana pajuu ama, tao madhutu paredha ama ètu sorga.

source_text: give to us this day our each day's bread;
target_text: ama, hia la ji'i nganga'a-nganginu dhu d'ai bèli-bèli.

source_text: and forgive to us our debts, as we forgive to our debtors;
target_text: ji'i manèngi, ho ama saku eele aa'i sasala-sasigo ji'i, nuka sèmi ji'i kahèi pabhèlu eele sasala dhèu dhu ra tao mi ji'i.

source_text: and lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from evil. amen.
target_text: ama, j'aga la ji'i, sèna ka ji'i baku tao bhabhelu. aa pakaj'èu la ji'i nèti koasa nidhu, te ama ka dhèu aae dhu koasa kapai risi eele. aa ama ka dhu mèd'u paredha, toke d'ai mia-mia la'e. sabaj'a ji'i d'ai sange ne'e ka, ama. amin. '

source_text: for if ye forgive to men their sins, your heavenly father shall forgive to you your trespasses or your sins.
target_text: te ngaa sanèd'e, ee! ladhe miu pabhèlu eele sasala dhu dhèu tao mi miu, èèna na ama mi ètu sorga saku eele sasala-sasigo miu kahèi.

source_text: soothly if ye forgive not to men the sins of them, neither your father shall forgive to you your sins.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe miu mo'o boe pabhèlu eele sasala dhu dhèu tao mi miu, bèli-camèd'a ama mi bhèlu boe sasala miu kahèi.

source_text: but when ye fast, do not ye be made as hypocrites sorrowful, for they deface themselves, or they put their faces out of kindly terms, to seem fasting to men; truly i say to you, they have received their meed.
target_text: ladhe miu manèngi-mangaj'i aa puasa, mage mi tao rèhu susa, nuka sèmi dhèu dhu padhai lii leo, tao leo. te ra ad'u-ue j'ara èèna, ho dhèu pad'iri si, peka na, ‘dhèu se'e se, dhèu mola-mèci! ' te ngaa sanèd'e, ee! dènge sèmi rare koa-kad'iri sèmi èèna, na, rèngu abhu le pala ra.

source_text: but when thou fastest, anoint thine head, and wash thy face,
target_text: te ngaa ladhe miu puasa, lèu pamèu-mèu rèhu mi, aa sageri paie kètu miu!

source_text: that thou be not seen fasting to men, but to thy father that is in huddles, and thy father that seeth in privy or in huddles, shall yield to thee.
target_text: de ladhe dhèu rèdhi miu, re'a boe na, miu dhu puasa. te ngaa ama miu ne'a. pe na pala hia miu mèngi-nale ae-ae.

source_text: do not ye treasure to you treasures here in earth, where rust and moth destroyeth, and where thieves delve out, and steal;
target_text: miu baku sab'a taruu, ho dhodhoka pakaboko mèdha-panyau ae-ae ètu rai-haha ne di. te hub'u dènge rutu pa'ele iie aa'i si. aa dhèu mana'u mai pa'ele iie era tatèka mèdha-panyau, aa mana'u rèti si.

source_text: but gather ye to you treasures in heaven, where neither rust nor moth destroyeth, and where thieves delve not out, nor steal.
target_text: te ngaa be'a risi miu maj'èni sab'a, sèna ka pakaboko mèdha-panyau ae-ae ètu sorga. te ètu era nèi, abhu boe hub'u dènge rutu dhu pa'ele iie si, aa abhu boe dhèu mana'u, ho mai mana'u rèti.

source_text: for where thy treasure is, there also thine heart is.
target_text: te ladhe miu tèka mèdha-panyau miu ètu era mia, na, tatu d'ara miu ètu èèna kahèi.

source_text: the lantern of thy body is thine eye; if thine eye be simple, all thy body shall be light-full;
target_text: musi madha dhèu, nuka sèmi labhu dhu pasaraa d'ara ra. ladhe musi madha na mèu, nèngu madhutu j'ara mamuri dhu hua iia, èci èèna ka dènge dhèu dhu kako ètu d'ara saraa.

source_text: but if thine eye be wayward, all thy body shall be dark-full. if then the light that is in thee be darknesses, how great shall those darknesses be?
target_text: te ngaa ladhe musi madha na ahu, nèngu bisa boe kako madhutu madha j'ara mola, nuka sèmi dhèu dhu gogo ai lae-lae ètu d'ara maroga. de ladhe saraa ètu d'ara miu j'aj'i maroga, na miu mamuri d'ara maroga kahèi.

source_text: no man may serve two lords, for either he shall hate the one, and love the tother; either he shall sustain the one, and despise the other. ye may not serve god and riches.
target_text: dhèu bisa boe sab'a hia dua lamatua, lula èèna na nèngu d'èi risi ca dhèu di. bisa kahèi nèngu madhutu lamatua èci, aa pusi-pahae boe dhu leo. nèti èèna ka, èu bisa boe peka na, ‘ama lamatua èèna, lamatua ja'a, ' ladhe èu tao doi-dhari j'aj'i mi lamatua èu.

source_text: therefore i say to you, that ye be not busy to your life, what ye shall eat; nor to your body, with what ye shall be clothed. whether life is not more than meat, and the body more than the cloth?
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ja'a peka dènge miu sèmi ne'e: baku bhute pangee, na, ja'a mamuri tasa mera mia, ku'a-kinu ngaa, pake ngaa? miu pangee na, mamuri ne dhoka ta'a-tinu, di? aa ngi'u ne, dhoka pake mèdha-papake, di? aad'o sèmi èèna.

source_text: behold ye the fowls of the air, for they sow not, neither reap, neither gather into barns; and your father of heaven feedeth them. whether ye be not more worthy than they?
target_text: ladhe ku manu-bhui dhu lela ètu talora liru. rèngu bhute rèdhi boe sèla hini, dènge puu-g'ètu, ho tèka nganga'a ètu d'ara soka. te ngaa ama miu ètu sorga piara manu-bhui sèra taruu. tatu nèngu kab'oi miu risi eele nèti rèngu. de ngee pabe'a-be'a. te ama lamatua pakab'ua miu risi nèti manu-bhui sèra.

source_text: but who of you thinking may put or may add to his stature one cubit?
target_text: ladhe dhèu titu ètu madha tèru, ho na bhute dènge lalau ngi'u na, nèngu bisa pamadhera hari ngi'u na, do? bisa boe!

source_text: and of clothing what be ye busy? behold ye the lilies of the field, how they wax. they travail not, neither they spin;
target_text: ladhe bisa boe, na, nga tao ka miu bhute dènge pangee hari mèdha-papake? lami ladhe ku hela bunga dhu muri tab'a ètu d'ara pad'a sod'a. rèngu manyèru boe hèngu, aa manènu boe sig'i sa hèi.

source_text: and i say to you, that solomon in all his glory was not covered as one of these.
target_text: te ngaa sanèd'e ku la! mèdha-papake dhèu aae soleman dhu kab'ua risi, saraga na bisa boe segi saraga hela bunga ne.

source_text: and if god clotheth thus the hay of the field, that today is, and tomorrow is cast into an oven or is sent into the furnace, how much more you of little faith?
target_text: te ama lamatua taru kira mi bunga dhu muri dhoka doe ne'e, aa bèli madhe, ho dhèu core asa d'ara ai. ladhe na tao sèmi èèna, tatu nèngu papake miu risi eele nèti hela bunga sèra. de tasamia ka miu parcaya pa'èra boe mi nèngu?

source_text: therefore do not ye be busy, saying, what shall we eat? or, what shall we drink? or, with what thing shall we be covered?
target_text: de baku mi pangee na, ‘ji'i neo nga'a ngaa? ' do, ‘neo nginu ngaa? ' do, ‘neo pake ngaa? '

source_text: for heathen men seek all these things; and your father knoweth, that ye have need to all these things.
target_text: dhèu dhu parcaya boe ama lamatua, rèngu sab'a loe boe ho neo abhu aa'i-aa'i se. te ngaa miu baku tao sèmi èèna, te ama miu ètu sorga dhu ne'a aa'i le, ngaa-ngaa dhu miu parluu.

source_text: therefore seek ye first the kingdom of god, and his rightwiseness, and all these things shall be cast to you.
target_text: te ngaa miu hud'i pakako uuru ku sasab'a na, aa hud'i madhutu ku paredha na, heka na hia miu aa'i-aa'i dhu miu parluu.

source_text: therefore do not ye be busy into the morrow, for the morrow shall be busy to itself; for it sufficeth to the day his own malice.
target_text: de baku bhute pangee, na, bèli miu parluu ngaa. te bèli èèna dènge bhabhute unu na. sasusa lod'o doe ne'e, èle ètu doe ne'e kahèi.

source_text: do not ye deem, that ye be not deemed;
target_text: miu baku galaa dhèu, sèna ka ama lamatua baku pasala miu kahèi.

source_text: for in what doom ye deem, ye shall be deemed, and in what measure ye mete, it shall be meted again to you.
target_text: ladhe miu nile dhèu sèmi mia, pe ama lamatua nile miu sèmi èèna kahèi. ladhe miu ige sasala dhèu sèmi mia, bèli-camèd'a ama lamatua ige sasala miu sèmi èèna kahèi.

source_text: but what seest thou a little mote in the eye of thy brother, and seest not a beam in thine own eye?
target_text: masi ka sasala dhèu ciki oo'e èèna ka, èu bhèlu boe. te ngaa sasala èu dhu kapai, èu pame'a boe ciki sa. èci èèna ka dènge èu ladhe mèdhi ahu ca katèd'a ètu d'ara madha angalai èu, te ngaa abhu agarii aae ca laa dhu pa'abhe nare musi madha èu, dhu èu me'a more boe.

source_text: or how sayest thou to thy brother, brother, suffer that i shall do out a mote from thine eye, and lo! a beam is in thine own eye?
target_text: nga tao ka èu bani peka na, ‘angalai! mai ho ja'a tiu eele ahu nèti d'ara madha èu'. aa te ngaa èu mesa mu bisa boe mèdhi ngaa-ngaa, lula agarii aae dhu hutu nare musi madha mu.

source_text: hypocrite, first do out the beam of thine eye or do thou out first the beam of thine own eye, and then thou shalt see to do out the mote of the eye of thy brother.
target_text: heeh! èu ne, mema dhèu dhu padhai lii leo, tao leo! tao eele uuru ku agarii nèti musi madha èu, heka ladhe mèdhi ahu ca katèd'a ètu d'ara madha angalai mu, sèna ka èu bisa tiu eele ahu ne kèna.

source_text: do not ye give holy thing to hounds, neither cast ye your margarites before swine, lest peradventure they defoul them with their feet, and the hounds be turned, and tear you all to pieces.
target_text: baku aj'a j'ara lamatua dhu mola-mèci mi dhèu dhu d'èi pahahe dhèu. lula dhèu sèra nuka sèmi busa pakadhi, dhu ra kabèli mai kadhi hari miu. rèngu sèra goa sama sèmi hahi kahèi. ladhe dhèu hia ne mutiara dhu kab'ua, na pusi boe! te ne'a dhoka j'èli palaho di.

source_text: ask ye, and it shall be given to you; seek ye, and ye shall find; knock ye, and it shall be opened to you.
target_text: ladhe miu sabaj'a, baku loe manèngi mi lamatua; te èèna na, na hia. ladhe patangi-tenge; pe na pad'elo j'ara. ladhe kad'eu taruu babèdho; pe na bhoke.

source_text: for each that asketh, taketh; and he that seeketh, findeth; and it shall be opened to him, that knocketh.
target_text: te dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu loe boe manèngi mi lamatua, èèna na ra sèmi rare. dhu patangi-tenge, pe ra abhu. dhu kad'eu taruu, pe na bhoke èmu.

source_text: what man of you is, that if his son ask him bread, whether he will take to him a stone?
target_text: miu pangee sèku! ladhe ana manèngi roti, tatu ama na hia boe ne hadhu, si?

source_text: or if he ask a fish, whether he will give to him an adder?
target_text: do, ladhe ana manèngi i'a, ama na hia boe mege, sina ma?

source_text: therefore if ye, when ye be evil men, know how to give good gifts to your sons, how much more your father that is in heavens shall give good things to men that ask him?
target_text: ama mi ètu sorga, mema d'ara na hua iia titu kèna! de ladhe dhèu rai-haha dhu bhelu-katub'a sèmi miu, me'a hia mèdha dhu be'a mi ana miu, ngaa hari ama mi! tatu na bagi hia miu ngaa dhu miu manèngi.

source_text: therefore all things, whatever things ye will that men do to you, do ye to them, for this is the law and the prophets.
target_text: de, ngaa dhu èu neo dhèu leo tao mi èu, na, èu hud'i tao sèmi èèna kahèi hia nèngu. lula ne'e ne ka, j'aj'i mi kapua nèti aa'i-aa'i dhu musa dènge dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua dhu peka-padhai karèi nèti uru ka.

source_text: enter ye by the strait gate; for the gate that leadeth to perdition, or to damnation, is large, and the way is broad, and there be many that enter by it.

source_text: how strait is the gate, and narrow the way, that leadeth to life, and there be few that find it.

target_text: baku pamud'e dènge dhèu dhu tema kapod'e-kabèli, dhu d'èi padedha iisi, peka na, rèngu se dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua. te rèngu tao ngi'u ra be'a nuka sèmi kahib'i-kalèbho. te ngaa rèngu se dhèu bhelu-katub'a, èci èèna ka dènge busa hui dhu mai kadhi kahib'i-kalèbho.

source_text: of their fruits ye shall know them. whether men gather grapes of thorns, or figs of briars?

source_text: so every good tree maketh good fruits; but an evil tree maketh evil fruits.
target_text: te aj'u dhu be'a ladhe d'ai hua, hua na be'a kahèi. te ngaa aj'u dhu karehe ladhe na hua, hua na karehe kahèi.

source_text: a good tree may not make evil fruits, neither an evil tree may make good fruits.
target_text: abhu ètu mia, aj'u dhu be'a, hua na karehe, aa aj'u dhu karehe, hua na be'a?

source_text: every tree that maketh not good fruit, shall be cut down, and shall be cast into the fire.
target_text: aj'u dhu hua na karehe, tatu ra patue eele, ho core asa d'ara ai.

source_text: therefore of their fruits ye shall know them.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi dènge rèngu dhu rèti lii padhai kapod'e-kabèli sèra. miu tadhe si nèti tatao ra.

source_text: not every man that saith to me, lord, lord, shall enter into the kingdom of heavens; but he that doeth the will of my father that is in heavens, he shall enter into the kingdom of heavens.
target_text: èèna na abhu dhèu dhu paroa ja'a, na, ‘lamatua! ' te ngaa rèngu dhoka ale ètu hèb'a di. bèli-camèd'a ama lamatua ètu sorga tule eele si. te dhodhoka dhèu dhu d'èi tao madhutu dad'èi nèngu di, dhu na sèmi nare rèngu j'aj'i dhèu unu na.

source_text: many shall say to me in that day, lord, lord, whether we have not prophesied in thy name, and have cast out fiends or devils in thy name, and have done many virtues in thy name?
target_text: pe ropa d'ai èle rai-haha ne, dhèu ae mangaku, peka na, ja'a ne lamatua rèngu. aa dènge lii solo-mako, ra peka na, ‘lamatua! ji'i se la'a pakako a'aj'a lamatua ètu mia-mia, babège nidhu dènge kolongara lamatua, aa tao tadha-tadha malaa pake koasa nèti lamatua. '

source_text: and then i shall acknowledge to them, that i knew you never; depart away from me, ye that work wicked-ness.
target_text: masi ka rèngu solo-mako ja'a sèmi èèna, te ngaa èèna na ja'a peka dènge rèngu, na, ‘miu se, cee? ja'a tadhe boe miu, te miu mamuri boe madhutu dad'èi ama lamatua. de mi pakaj'èu ka nèti ne'e! '

source_text: therefore every man that heareth these my words, and doeth them, shall be made like to a wise man, that hath builded his house on a stone.
target_text: dhèu dhu mai nanene ja'a, hèia ra tao madhutu lii padhai ja'a, rèngu se nuka sèmi dhèu dhu d'èlu-mèu, dhu patitu èmu ra ètu dedha hadhu kapua.

source_text: and rain came down, and floods came, and winds blew, and rushed into that house; and it felled not down, for it was founded on a stone.
target_text: nèbhu boe, ka èj'i aae mai toke èi lala, aa ngèlu aae lèke èmu ne. te ngaa èmu ne guri boe, lula patitu ètu dedha hadhu kapua.

source_text: and every man that heareth these my words, and doeth them not, is like a fool, that hath builded his house on gravel or on sand.
target_text: dhèu dhu mai nanene ja'a, te ngaa tao boe madhutu lii padhai ja'a, nèngu ne èci èèna ka dènge dhèu goa dhu patitu èmu na ètu dedha salae.

source_text: and rain came down, and floods came, and winds blew, and hurled against that house; and it felled down, and the falling down thereof was great.
target_text: nèbhu boe, ka èj'i aae mai toke èi lala. ngèlu aae lèke èmu ne kahèi. hèia èmu ne guri eele, toke laho teb'o-teb'o.

source_text: and it was done, when jesus had ended these words, the people wondered on his teaching;

source_text: for he taught them, as he that had power, and not as the scribes and the pharisees.
target_text: te nèngu ne'a mèu isi nèti a'aj'a ne. na aj'a-nori sèmi boe mese agama sèra.

source_text: but when jesus was come down from the hill, much people pursued him or many companies followed him.
target_text: lod'o yesus puru nèti ledhe, hèia dhèu ae-ae lasi madhutu ne.

source_text: and lo! a leprous man came, and worshipped him, and said, lord, if thou wilt, thou mayest make me clean.
target_text: kabèdhi laa, ca dhèu dhu pèd'a kusta mai paraga dènge ne. hèia na patitu kètu urutuu ètu madha yesus, ho manèngi, aku nèngu na, lamatua! sue ku ja'a la! ladhe mo'o, na, puri ku papèd'a ja'a ne, sèna ka dhèu madenge ia ka dènge ja'a, aa ja'a bisa hari sabaj'a ètu d'ara èmu manèngi-mangaj'i.

source_text: and jesus held forth the hand, and touched him, and said, i will, be thou made clean. and anon the leprosy of him was cleansed.
target_text: ropa tadèngi nare, hèia yesus j'ole kacui-aai na ka na g'ag'e dhèu ne, hèia na lii, aku nèngu na, ja'a ko'o! èu èle kèna! kabèdhi la, èi papèd'a dhèu ne èle dènge ka.

source_text: and jesus said to him, see, say thou to no man; but go, show thee to the priests, and offer the gift that moses commanded, in witnessing to them.
target_text: hèia yesus peka dènge ne, sanèd'e paie! èu èle le nèti papèd'a-tarègu, te ngaa baku èu lolo dènge dhèu èci sa. aa èu hud'i madhutu ku atora musa. de lamu asa ama agama ho na parisa ngi'u èu, sèna ka ne'a na èi papèd'a mu ele le, tare'a, do dhae. èle na, èu hia persembahan tadha makasi, sèna ka dhèu re'a, na, èu ne èle tare'a-re'a le nèti papèd'a.

source_text: and when he had entered into capernaum, the centurion nighed to him, and prayed him,

source_text: and said, lord, my child lieth in the house sick on or in the palsy, and is evil tormented.
target_text: ama! ana sab'a ja'a ca dhèu, pèd'a aae, ka na j'èra titu kèna ètu èmu. na bisa boe puru nèti era j'unu na.

source_text: and jesus said to him, i shall come, and shall heal him.
target_text: ka yesus dhaa, peka na, oo! pe ja'a dhiu puri-pa'èle ne.

source_text: and the centurion answered, and said to him, lord, i am not worthy, that thou enter under my roof; but only say thou by word, and my child shall be healed.
target_text: te ngaa komedhaa ne b'ala, aku nèngu na, ama! ama roca ia ka mai asa èmu ja'a, lula ja'a nia boe sèmi ama asa d'ara èmu ja'a. sad'i ama ku peka dhoka lii ca hèb'a di nèti ne'e, tatu ana sab'a ja'a ne èle dènge nèti papèd'a.

source_text: for why i am a man ordained under power, and have knights under me; and i say to this, go, and he goeth; and to another, come, and he cometh; and to my servant, do this, and he doeth it.
target_text: ja'a ke'a j'ara ne, lula ja'a dènge dhèu paredha dedha kahèi, dhu dènge koasa ho paredha ja'a. aa ja'a dènge koasa kahèi, sèna ka paredha sordad'u ja'a sèra. ladhe ja'a pua, peka na, ‘lamu sa nèi! ' tatu na la'e dènge. aa ladhe ja'a peka, ‘mai asa ne'e! ' tatu na mai. aa ladhe ja'a paleha dhèu sab'a ja'a, peka na, ‘sab'a ne'e! ' tatu na tao madhutu. de sad'i ama ku lii di, tatu ana sab'a ja'a èèna, èle dènge nèti papèd'a na.

source_text: and jesus heard these things, and wondered, and said to men that pursued him, truly i say to you, i found not so great faith in israel.
target_text: ropa yesus tadèngi nare, hèia na malaa. ka na padhai lii dènge dhèu ae sèra, aku nèngu na, nèbhu nare sange ne'e, ja'a dhae paraga kèdhi mèka dènge ca dhèu sa nèti dhèu yahudi dhu lèka èra sama sèmi dhèu roma ne!

source_text: and i say to you, that many shall come from the east and the west, and shall rest with abraham and isaac and jacob in the kingdom of heavens;

source_text: but the sons of the realm shall be cast out into outer-more or uttermost darknesses; there shall be weeping, and grinding of teeth.
target_text: masi ka lamatua dhu hag'e nare le dhèu yahudi, sena ka j'aj'i dhèu unu na, te ngaa ae ka dhu pusi-pahae boe ne. èèna na, lamatua tule eele si asa era dhu maroga kiu-kiu. ètu era ne'e, ra tangi roma iisi d'ara pèd'a, aa ra j'èra titu kèna.

source_text: and jesus said to the centurion, go, and as thou hast believed, be it done to thee. and the child was healed from that hour.
target_text: padhai lii nare, hèia yesus peka dènge komedhaa ne, lèpa ka. te ana sab'a èu èèna èle le, madhutu sèmi parcaya èu ne. ka lod'o dhu na padhai èèna, ana ne èle dènge ka.

source_text: and when jesus was come into the house of simon peter, he saw his wife's mother lying, and shaken or shaking with fevers.
target_text: ca tèka, yesus la'e asa èmu petrus. na ladhe nèdhi ina dhèu èmu petrus dhu j'unu ètu dedha koi, dhu pèd'a maringi-sagoro.

source_text: and he touched her hand, and the fever left her; and she rose, and served them.
target_text: ka yesus kèpe kacui-aai na, hèia ina ne èle nèti papèd'a na. hèia na kèd'i, ka la'e lalau nganga'a hia yesus si.

source_text: and when it was even, they brought to him many that had devils, and he casted out spirits by word, and healed all that were evil-at-ease or having sickness;

source_text: that it were fulfilled, that was said by isaiah, the prophet, saying, he took our infirmities, and bare our sicknesses.

source_text: and jesus saw much people about him, and bade or commandedhis disciplesto go over the water.

source_text: another of his disciples said to him, lord, suffer me to go first, and bury my father.
target_text: èle ka, dhèu èci hari mai peka dènge yesus, na, ama! ja'a neo madhutu ama, te ngaa hud'i ja'a ladhe-leru ku ina-ama ja'a. ladhe ama ku madhe, ho padhane kore, heka ja'a madhutu kèna.

source_text: but jesus said to him, pursue thou me, and let the dead men bury their dead men.
target_text: te ngaa yesus padhai lii, peka na, sèmi ne'e! hud'i laa dhèu leo dhu parcaya boe lamatua padhane dhèu madhe. te ladhe èu neo madhutu ja'a, na, madhutu la dènge d'ara kateme!

source_text: and when he was gone up into a little ship, his disciples pursued him.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus ca'e asa dedha koha, palere dènge ana-ana madhutu na.

source_text: and lo! a great stirring was made in the sea, so that the ship was covered with waves; but he slept.

source_text: and jesus said to them, what be ye of little faith aghast or afeared? then he rose up, and commanded to the winds and the sea, and a great peaceableness was made.
target_text: hèia yesus dhaa, peka na, wee! nga tao ka miu se madha'u sèmi ne'e ne? miu parcaya boe ja'a, do? ka na kèd'i. èle ka na kai ngèlu dènge naha ètu d'ara dano ne, peka na, mau ka! hèia naha dènge ngèlu mau dènge ka.

source_text: and men wondered, and said, what manner man is this, for the winds and the sea obey to him?

source_text: and when he was come over the water into the country of men of gergesenes, two men met him, that had devils, and came out of graves, full mad, or going out from burials, full fierce, or wicked, so that no man might go by that way.

target_text: ra pa'oo, peka na, we, ana ama lamatua! nga tao ka èu mai gagu ji'i se? masi ka d'ai mèka lod'o ho hia hahuku mi ji'i, te ngaa èu mai le ho neo paj'èra ji'i!

source_text: and not far from them was a flock of many swine or a drove of many hogs pasturing.
target_text: kaj'èu boe ètu era èèna, abhu hahi canau dhu nyuu rai, tenge nganga'a.

source_text: and the devils prayed him, and said, if thou castest out us from hence, send us into the drove of swine or hogs.

source_text: and he said to them, go ye. and they went out, and went into the swine or the hogs; and lo! in a great rush all the drove went headlong into the sea, and they were dead in the waters.
target_text: hèia yesus paredha nidhu se, peka na, lami ka! hèia nidhu kalua tèke eele dhèu dua se, lasi maso asa d'ara hahi deo sa. ka hahi se rai paceb'a re sebhe ledhe ka manahu asa d'ara dano, hèia ra cèna, ka madhe aa'i si.

source_text: and the herders fled away, and came into the city, and told all these things, and of them that had the fiends or the devils.
target_text: ropa ladhe rèdhi sèmi èèna, dhèu madhenga hahi, rai lasi asa d'ara rae, hèia ra lolo ngaa dhu j'aj'i ne.

source_text: and lo! all the city went out to meet jesus; and when they had seen him, they prayed him, that he would pass from their coasts.

source_text: and jesus went up into a boat, and passed over the water, and came into his city.
target_text: èle èèna, yesus si ca'e hari koha, lèpa asa ca bèka dano. ka rèngu puru ètu kota na.

source_text: and lo! they brought to him a man sick in palsy, lying in a bed. and jesus saw the faith of them, and said to the man sick in palsy, son, have thou trust; thy sins be forgiven to thee.
target_text: ètu era ne'e dhèu j'èru rèti angalai ra dhu karuku asa yesus. ropa ladhe nèdhi, yesus ne'a le, na, rèngu parcaya ne, peka na, nèngu bisa puri-pa'èle angalai ra. hèia na peka dènge dhèu karuku ne, aku nèngu na, ana! pa'èra d'ara èu! te ja'a saku eele le sasala èu.

source_text: and lo! some of the scribes said within themselves, this blasphemeth.

source_text: and when jesus had seen their thoughts, he said, whereto think ye evil things in your hearts?
target_text: te ngaa yesus ne'a d'ara rèngu. nèti èèna ka na lii, aku nèngu na, nga tao ka miu se pangee, na, ja'a ne pahaha ama lamatua?

source_text: what is lighter to say, thy sins be forgiven to thee, either to say, rise thou, and walk?

source_text: but that ye know that man's son hath power to forgive sins in earth, then he said to the sick man in palsy or the man sick in palsy, rise up; take thy bed, and go into thine house.
target_text: ladhe na kèd'i dènge ka, miu heka mèdhi, na, ja'a ne dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a. te ja'a dènge hak ho abho sasala dhèu. hèia yesus paredha dhèu karuku ne, peka na, kèd'i ka! ded'e mèti ka karad'a èu, ho lèpa ka!

source_text: and he rose, and went into his house.
target_text: ka dhèu karuku ne kèd'i, hèia na lèpa dènge ka.

source_text: and the people seeing dreaded, and glorified god, that gave such power to men.
target_text: ropa ladhe rèdhi, hèia rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra malaa-maloha. hèia ra ded'e padedha-dedha kolongara ama lamatua, peka na, ama lamatua, kapai risi eele! na hia koasa kapai sèmi ne'e, hia mi dhèu rai-haha.

source_text: and when jesus passed from thence, he saw a man, matthew by name, sitting in a tollbooth. and he said to him, pursue thou me. and he rose, and followed him.
target_text: èle ka yesus la'e nèti era èèna, hèia ladhe nèdhi ca dhèu roro doi bea dhu sab'a ètu kantor bea. ngara dhèu ne, mateos. hèia yesus gale ne, peka na, mai madhutu ja'a! ropa tadèngi nare, hèia mateos kèd'i dènge ka, la'e madhutu yesus.

source_text: and it was done, while he sat at the meat in the house, lo! many publicans and sinful men came, and sat at the meat with jesus and his disciples.
target_text: ka mateos nèru yesus si lasi ra'a-rinu asa èmu na. na nèru kahèi mone aanga-angalai na dhèu roro bea sèra, aa tamu dhu leo kahèi, ho ra'a-rinu dènge rèngu.

source_text: and the pharisees saw, and said to his disciples, why eateth your master with publicans and sinful men?
target_text: te ngaa abhu pèri-pèri dhèu nèti partei parisi, mai ka'ugu ètu madha ana-ana madhutu yesus, peka na, nga tao ka mese miu madhèdi na'a-ninu dènge dhèu-dhèu dhu guna boe se, nuka sèmi dhèu roro bea dènge angalai ra dhu bhelu-katub'a sèra?

source_text: and jesus heard, and said, a leech is not needful to men that fare well, but to men that be evil-at-ease or having evil.
target_text: te ngaa yesus peka dènge rèngu, aku nèngu na, dhèu pèd'a parluu dote-matarii, te ngaa dhèu dhu pèd'a boe parluu boe.

source_text: but go ye, and learn what it is, i will mercy, and not sacrifice; for i came, not to call rightful or rightwise men, but sinful men to penance.
target_text: be'a risi lami parisa paie-iie lii holo-nori ama lamatua. te uru èèna, na pua hosea, ca dhèu nèti lii padhai na, dhu suri peka na, ‘dad'èi ja'a nuka, dhèu-dhèu ja'a hud'i pasue ku èci dènge èci, aa pad'elo rasa kasia. ladhe ra tao boe madhutu sèmi èèna, na, badha korban rèngu dhu rèti hia ja'a, dènge boe kab'ua. ' ne'e ne ka dhu ama lamatua peka tèke le. nèti èèna ka, ja'a mai boe ho uri dhèu dhu pangee na, rèngu dhèu mola, te ngaa ja'a mai sèna ka ladhe-leru dhèu dhu laku-laku boe.

source_text: then the disciples of john came to him, and said, why we and the pharisees fast oft, but thy disciples fast not?
target_text: èle èèna ka, ana madhutu yohanis tuka sarani sèra, mai sa yesus. dhèu se karèi, aku rèngu na, ji'i dhu madhutu yohanis tema puasa. aa dhèu parisi puasa kahèi. te ngaa tasamia ka ana madhutu ama sèra loe boe ra'a-rinu? rèngu re'a boe puasa, do?

source_text: and jesus said to them, whether the sons of the spouse may mourn or wail as long as the spouse is with them? but days shall come, when the spouse shall be taken away from them, and then they shall fast.
target_text: te ngaa yesus dhaa dènge lii pakasame, na, sèmi ne'e: ladhe pesta kab'i, tamu sèra puasa boe, te ngaa ra'a toke bècu. ladhe pengantin mone dènge rèngu era, aa'i-aa'i ra ra'a-rinu palere-lere. te ngaa ladhe dhèu leo rai rèti ka pengantin mone ne, hèia mone aanga-angalai na, d'ara ra susa, de heka ra puasa kèna.

source_text: and no man putteth a patch of rough cloth, or of rude, or new, cloth, into an old clothing; for it doeth away or taketh away the fullness of the cloth, and a worse breaking is made.
target_text: dhèu bisa boe rare bèla hiu ca èta, ho kalape mi kodho dhui dhu mae. te ropa base kodho ne, bèla hiu dhu kalape la'a deo na karuku, na kodho deo na asa mae aae.

source_text: neither men put new wine into old bottles or old wine vessels, else the bottles or wine vessels be broken, and destroyed, and the wine shed out. but men put new wine into new bottles or into new wine vessels, and both be kept.
target_text: j'ara sèmi èèna kahèi, dènge dhua dhu heka rèti mai nèti kapua, bisa boe bhori asa d'ara sabha dhui. te aad'o na sabha ne madhore, hèia dhua bhori eele asa rai la'e. de dhua dhu hiu hud'i bhori ku asa d'ara sabha hiu, sèna ka dua ra be'a taruu! dènge sèmi ne'e, yesus nori si, peka na, a'aj'a na dhu hiu, baku pakihu dènge a'aj'a dhu dhui.

source_text: whiles that jesus spake these things to them, lo! a prince came, and worshipped him, and said, lord, my daughter is now dead; but come thou, and put thine hand on her, and she shall live.
target_text: ètu d'ara yesus padhai lii era dènge ana madhutu yohanis sèra, hèia kapala nèti èmu manèngi-mangaj'i mai paraga dènge ne. ka na patitu kètu urutuu ètu madha yesus. hèia na manèngi, aku nèngu na, ama, ee! sue ku ja'a la! te ana bhèni ja'a heka madhe kèna. de lati ho ama bane ai mi ana ne, sèna ka na mamuri hari.

source_text: and jesus rose, and his disciples, and pursued him.
target_text: ropa na tadèngi, hèia yesus dènge ana madhutu na, madhutu dènge ka dhèu deo na.

source_text: and lo! a woman, that had a bloody flux, or that suffered the running of blood, twelve years, nighed behind, and touched the hem of his cloth. for she said within herself, if i touch only the cloth of him, i shall be safe.
target_text: ètu talora j'ara, ca dhèu ina kako la'e madhutu si. bhèni ne lèke papèd'a bhèni, dhu loe boe ciki sa d'ai canguru dua tèu kèna. na pangee, na, sad'i ja'a gai lèke kodho yesus di, tatu èi papèd'a ja'a ne èle. nèti èèna ka, na ara padètu la'e, hèia na gai lèke suu kodho yesus.

source_text: and jesus turned, and saw her, and said, daughter, have thou trust; thy faith hath made thee safe. and the woman was made whole from that hour.
target_text: yesus dhu ne'a, hèia na kabib'a, ladhe sa ina ne. ka na lii, peka na, ina, ee! pa'èra la d'ara èu. te, lula èu parcaya ja'a tare'a-re'a, nèti èèna ka èu èle nèti papèd'a. hèia bhèni ne èle dènge ka.

source_text: and when jesus came into the house of the prince, and saw minstrels, and the people making noise,
target_text: èle ka, yesus si lasi taruu asa èmu nèti kapala èmu manèngi-mangaj'i èèna. d'ai era nèi, maso la'e asa d'ara, hèia na ladhe nèdhi dhèu dhu tema karihu musiik mamadhe, dènge dhèu ae dhu tangi d'ara pèd'a.

source_text: he said, go ye away, for the damsel is not dead, but sleepeth. and they scorned him.
target_text: te ngaa yesus peka dènge ra, aku nèngu na, ae eele ka tangi, aa lami ka èmu miu! te ana ne madhe boe, dhoka na bhèj'i di. te ngaa dhèu se mari dènge pakapengo hèb'a mi yesus.

source_text: and when the folk was put out, he went in, and held her hand; and the damsel rose up.
target_text: èle ka, dhèu se aa'i-aa'i lasi asa li'u. ka yesus maso asa d'ara kama ana bhèni ne. na kèpe ai ana ne, hèia ana ne mamuri dènge ka.

source_text: and this fame went out into all that land.
target_text: ropa ladhe rèdhi j'ara ne, ka dhèu mulai palolo lème ètu kabarai ra, lula-nèti ngaa dhu yesus tao ne.

source_text: and when jesus passed from thence, two blind men crying pursued him or two blind men pursued him, crying, and said, thou son of david, have mercy on us.
target_text: èle, hèia yesus kako taruu. ètu talora j'ara, abhu dhèu bèdhu dhèu dua dhu madhutu ne. dua ra rodhe, peka na, ana-èpu dhèu aae daud! sue ku ji'i la!

source_text: and when he came into the house, the blind men came to him; and jesus said to them, what will ye, that i do to you? and they said, lord, that our eyes be opened. and jesus said, believe ye, that i may do this thing to you? they said to him, yea, lord.
target_text: ropa yesus maso asa d'ara èmu cue, dhèu bèdhu se lasi paraga dènge ne. ka yesus karèi dua ra, peka na, miu se lèka tare'a-re'a, na, ja'a ne dènge koasa ho puri-pa'èle miu, sèna ka bisa ladhe mèdhi, do? hèia dua ra dhaa, aku rèngu na, ama karèi ia ka, te ji'i dhu lèka mema-mema le.

source_text: then he touched their eyes, and said, after your faith be it done to you.
target_text: ropa tadèngi lii dhaa dua ra, hèia yesus g'ag'e musi madha ra, ka na peka na, ladhe sèmi èèna, na, j'aj'i ka madhutu parcaya miu.

source_text: and the eyes of them were opened. and jesus threatened them, and said, see ye, that no man know.
target_text: yesus padhai lii èle, hèia dua ra ladhe rèdhi dènge ka. te ngaa yesus pasanèd'e si, peka na, baku miu peka dènge ca dhèu sa, ngaa dhu j'aj'i le!

source_text: but they went out, and famed him through all that land.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu se taha rare boe d'ara ra. ka ra kako palème kabarai èèna, lole dènge dhèu aa'i-aa'i, tatao yesus mi rèngu dua ra.

source_text: and when they were gone out, lo! they brought to him a dumb man, having a devil.
target_text: ropa dhèu bèdhu se lasi, dhèu rèti dhèu leo hari èci asa yesus. dhèu ne bisa boe padhai lii, lula nidhu tao ne.

source_text: and when the devil was cast out, the dumb man spake. and the people wondered, and said, it hath not been seen thus in israel or it appeared never so in israel.
target_text: ropa ladhe nèdhi, hèia yesus paredha nidhu kalua nèti dhèu lii aad'o ne. nidhu èèna kalua, ka dhèu ne padhai lii dènge ka. hèia dhèu ae ètu era èèna malaa, ka ra peka na, ira ii! èdhi dhèu yahudi paraga tèdhi mèka madha j'ara sèmi ne'e ne!

source_text: but the pharisees said, in the prince of devils he casteth out devils.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu parisi ka'uu, peka na, dhèu aae nidhu ka dhu hia ne koasa, sèna ka na bisa babège eela nidhu.

source_text: and jesus went about all the cities and castles, teaching in the synagogues of them, and preaching the gospel of the kingdom, and healing every languor or all ache, and every sickness.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus kako palème kota-kota dènge rae-rae, sèna ka aj'a-nori dhèu ètu d'ara èmu sabaj'a sèra. na aj'a dhèu nèti lii holo-nori ama lamatua, aa j'ara tasamia rèngu bisa j'aj'i dhèu unu ama lamatua. na puri-pa'èle kahèi dhèu nèti papèd'a-tarègu ra.

source_text: and he saw the people, and had ruth on them; for they were travailed, and lying as sheep not having a shepherd.
target_text: ropa yesus ladhe nèdhi dhèu ae se, hèia na taha nare boe d'ara, lula dhèu se re'a heka tao sèmi ngaa sa. te rèngu nuka sèmi kahib'i-kalèbho dhu dènge boe dhèu madhenga.

source_text: then he said to his disciples, soothly there is much ripe corn, but few workmen.
target_text: èle ka, yesus padhai lii dènge ana madhutu na, aku nèngu na, dhèu ae se, nuka sèmi nganga'a ae-ae ètu d'ara oka-tedhe. masi ka nganga'a ae titu kèna, te ngaa dhèu sab'a d'ai boe ho puu-g'ètu, sèna ka tèke asa d'ara gud'a.

source_text: therefore pray ye the lord of the ripe corn, that he send workmen into his ripe corn.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, miu hud'i manèngi ku mi lamatua oka, sèna ka na tabha hari dhèu sab'a, ho lasi puu-g'ètu isi oka se.

source_text: and when his twelve disciples were called together, he gave to them power of unclean spirits, to cast them out of men, and to heal every languor or all ache, and all sickness.
target_text: èle ka, yesus paroa ana madhutu na, sèna ka mai pakaboko. hèia na hia si koasa ho babège eele nidhu aa puri-pa'èle dhèu nèti papèd'a-tarègu ra.

source_text: and these be the names of the twelve apostles; the first, simon, that is called peter, and andrew, his brother; james of zebedee, and john, his brother;
target_text: ana madhutu na dhu na pua sèra, dhèu canguru dua, nuka: partama, ngara na simon dhu dhèu tema paroa ne, ‘petrus', dènge ari na, anderias, yakobis, dènge ari na, yohanis dua ra ana sabadeus,

source_text: philip, and bartholomew; thomas, and matthew, publican; and james of alphaeus, and thaddaeus;
target_text: pelipus, bertolomeos, tomas, mateos dhèu roro doi bea, yakobis dhu leo nuka ana alpius, tadius,

source_text: simon canaanite, and judas iscariot, that betrayed christ or which betrayed him.
target_text: simon nèti partei politik selot, dènge yudas iskariot dhu èèna na pahie yesus.

source_text: jesus sent these twelve, and commanded to them, and said, go ye not into the way of heathen men, and enter ye not into the cities of samaritans; but rather go ye to the sheep of the house of israel, that have perished.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus pua ana madhutu na canguru dua dhèu sèra, aa paredha si, peka na, ja'a pua miu lami asa dhèu èdhi dhèu yahudi sèra, lula ae nèti rèngu dhu madhutu boe j'ara mamuri ama lamatua dènge mola. rèngu cakaraa kahib'i-kalèbho dhu sala j'ara. nèti èèna ka, baku lami asa dhèu yahudi boe, nuka sèmi dhèu samaria.

source_text: and go ye, and preach ye, and say, that the kingdom of heavens shall nigh;
target_text: lami peka dènge dhèu isra'el èdhi sèra, na, ‘ne'e ne, d'ai lod'o kèna, sèna ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra bisa j'aj'i dhèu unu ama lamatua. '

source_text: heal ye sick men, raise ye dead men, cleanse ye mesels or leprous men, cast ye out devils; freely ye have taken, freely give ye.
target_text: aa lami puri-pa'èle dhèu pèd'a, pamamuri hari dhèu madhe, pa'èle dhèu kusta, aa babège eele nidhu. ama lamatua hia le miu ae-ae, te ngaa na manèngi hari boe ca ana maa sa. de lami ka ho pala pa'ae-ae mi dhèu leo, te ngaa mage mi manèngi hari ngaa-ngaa kahèi.

source_text: do not ye wield gold, nor silver, nor money in your girdles,
target_text: pakèd'i dènge ai hua. baku mèti doi,

source_text: not a scrip in the way, neither two coats, neither shoes, nor a staff or a rod; for a workman is worthy his meat.
target_text: gee j'ara, mèdha silu, salapa, do tatea. te dhèu hud'i hia ku dhèu sab'a, ngaa dhu pantas ho ra bisa mamuri.

source_text: into whatever city, or castle, ye shall enter, ask ye who therein is worthy, and there dwell ye, till ye go out.
target_text: ladhe miu maso asa d'ara kota do rae èci, na, miu hud'i tenge ku dhèu dhu neo sèmi rare miu. hèia miu pea ètu èmu èèna, toke miu pakèd'i tèke eele era èèna.

source_text: and when ye go into an house, greet ye it, and say, peace to this house.
target_text: ladhe miu maso asa d'ara èmu dhèu, peka la dènge rèngu, ‘saloom! lamatua hia miu mèngi-nale. '

source_text: and if that house be worthy, your peace shall come on it; but if that house be not worthy, your peace shall turn again to you.
target_text: ladhe dhèu ètu d'ara èmu ne, sèmi rare miu dènge be'a, na, miu manèngi sèna ka lamatua hia si berkat. te ngaa ladhe ra ro'o boe sèmi rare miu, na, lamatua hia boe rèngu berkat.

source_text: and whoever receiveth not you, nor heareth your words, go ye forth from that house or city, and sprinkle off the dust of your feet or smite away the dust from your feet.
target_text: ladhe dhèu ro'o boe nanene lii padhai miu, mi kalua nèti èmu èèna, do kota èèna, hèia miu caro eele ahu nèti haga miu, sèna ka j'aj'i mi tadha, peka na, ladhe ro'o boe nanene, pe rèngu d'ui rare pala ra.

source_text: truly i say to you, it shall be more sufferable to the land of men of sodom and of gomorrah in the day of judgement, than to that city.
target_text: bèli-camèd'a, lod'o ama lamatua huku dhèu ètu rai-haha ne'e, tatu na pabia mi dhèu sodom dènge gomora dhu uru èèna bhelu titu kèna. te ngaa sanèd'e! èèna na, nèngu huku bia risi hari mi dhèu dhu ro'o boe sèmi rare miu!

source_text: lo! i send you as sheep in the middle or into the midst of wolves; therefore be ye sly, or prudent, or wary, or wise, as serpents, and simple as doves.
target_text: sanèd'e paie! te ja'a pua miu ne, èci èèna ka ja'a patabuli kahib'i-kalèbho asa talora aae busa hui. nèti èèna ka, ngangee miu hud'i sèmi mege dhu d'èlu-mèu. aa d'ara mi hud'i mola ku nuka sèmi koro j'aha dhu ne'a boe tenge lii langu.

source_text: but be ye ware of men, for they shall take you in councils, and they shall beat you in their synagogues;
target_text: te ngaa baku pamud'e! te bèli-camèd'a dhèu paj'èra miu, sama sèmi busa hui kadhi pamadhe kahib'i-kalèbho. èèna na, rèngu nuni rèti miu asa era parisa lii langu agama. aa dhèu hake paparu miu ètu d'ara èmu sabaj'a.

source_text: and to mayors, or to presidents, and to kings, ye shall be led for me, in witnessing to them, and to heathen men.
target_text: pe rèngu ère rèti miu asa madha gubernur dènge dhèu aae, lula miu madhutu ja'a. te ngaa miu hud'i pake lod'o sèra, ho peka-padhai dènge ra lii lolo be'a nèti ja'a. dènge j'ara ne'e, dhèu dhu tadhe boe ama lamatua tadèngi kahèi kolongara ja'a ne.

source_text: but when they take you, do not ye think, how or what thing ye shall speak, for it shall be given to you in that hour, what ye shall speak;
target_text: te ngaa ladhe rèngu nuni rèti miu sèmi èèna, mage miu madha'u, peka na, ‘èèna na, ja'a peka tasamia? ' do, ‘ja'a neo dhaa peka sèmi ngaa? ' baku j'aj'i mi ngangee, te ladhe d'ai lod'o na, ama mi ètu sorga ka dhu peka dènge miu, nèti j'ara mia ka dhu miu hud'i peka-padhai.

source_text: for it be not ye that speak, but the spirit of your father, that speaketh in you.
target_text: lod'o èèna, ngaa dhu miu padhai, mai boe nèti d'ara miu unu mi, te roh lamatua dhu mola-mèci èèna ka dhu aj'a-nori ètu d'ara miu, sèna ka miu padhai sèmi ngaa sa.

source_text: and the brother shall betake the brother into death, and the father the son, and sons shall rise against their father and mother, and shall torment them by death or to the death.
target_text: sanèd'e, te bèli-camèd'a ètu d'ara èmu cue, ladhe abhu ca dhèu parcaya ja'a, èèna na a'ari nèngu mesa na, ka dhu tenge j'ara ho pamadhe ne. aa ladhe ana ka dhu parcaya, èèna na ama na ka dhu pamadhe ne. ladhe ina-ama ka dhu parcaya, bèli-camèd'a ana-ana ra ka dhu pamadhe si.

source_text: and ye shall be in hate or in hatred to all men for my name; but he that shall dwell still or shall continue into the end, shall be made safe.
target_text: sanèd'e! te bèli-camèd'a dhèu aa'i-aa'i tèka d'ara dènge miu, lula miu parcaya ja'a ne. te ngaa dhèu dhu taha taruu, èèna na ama lamatua hia ne mamuri.

source_text: and when they pursue you in this city, flee ye into another. truly i say to you, ye shall not end the cities of israel, before that man's son come.
target_text: ladhe dhèu paj'èra miu ètu d'ara kota cue, rai lami asa kota leo! lèke kèna! ja'a ne dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a. bèli-camèd'a ropa miu palème aa'i mèka kota-kota ètu isra'el, te ngaa ja'a dhu lèpa hari mai le èèna.

source_text: the disciple is not above the master or above his master, nor the servant above his lord;
target_text: biasa dhèu pakab'ua ca dhèu mese risi nèti ana sakola na sèra. aa dhèu pakab'ua ca dhèu lamatua risi nèti ènu na sèra.

source_text: it is enough to the disciple, that he be as his master, and to the servant as his lord. if they have called the husbandman, or the father of the meine, beelzebub, how much more his household meine?
target_text: ladhe ana sakola mèu sama sèmi mese na, nèngu pangee na d'ai le. aa ladhe ènu d'èlu-mèu sama sèmi lamatua na, nèngu ngee na d'ai le. de sanèd'e paie! ladhe dhèu paroa lamatua èmu, peka na, ‘èu ne, baalsebul, dhèu aae nidhu! ' tatu isi èmu na abhu kolongara dhu karehe risi hari.

source_text: therefore dread ye not them; for nothing is hid or is covered, that shall not be showed; and nothing is privy, that shall not be known.
target_text: de miu baku madha'u dènge dhèu dhu lab'a miu. te, ngaa dhu dhèu tao pahuni, bèli-camèd'a dhèu aa'i-aa'i ladhe rèdhi.

source_text: that thing that i say to you in darknesses, say ye in the light; and preach ye on houses or upon roofs, that thing that ye hear in the ear.
target_text: ngaa dhu ja'a aj'a-nori le miu mesa mi, miu hud'i lami lole ku mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i. aa ngaa dhu ja'a paholo le dènge miu, miu se hud'i lami peka ku palème era.

source_text: and do not ye dread them that slay the body; for they may not slay the soul; but rather dread ye him, that may lose both soul and body into hell.
target_text: baku madha'u dènge dhèu rai-haha, te rèngu bisa dhoka pamadhe ngi'u aae dhèu di, te ngaa bisa boe pa'ele iie samanga. nèti èèna ka, miu hud'i madha'u ku dènge ama lamatua, te dhoka nèngu di dhu dènge koasa ho pamaso ngi'u aae dhèu dènge samanga kateme, asa d'ara dhasi ai dhu heo na loe boe ciki sa.

source_text: whether two sparrows be not sold for an halfpenny? and one of them shall not fall on the earth without your father.
target_text: de pa'èra d'ara miu. dhèu pahie ana mangungu ètu d'ara pasa dènge kab'ua ciki oo'e di. te ngaa ci'u sa bisa boe madhe, ladhe ama mi ètu sorga no'o mèka.

source_text: and all the hairs of your head be numbered.
target_text: ama miu ètu sorga dhu loe boe ladhe-leru miu, toke j'ara-j'ara dhu ana iiki-iiki. d'ai rèu kètu ètu kab'a kètu miu, na ige nare aa'i hèi.

source_text: therefore do not ye dread; ye be better than many sparrows.
target_text: de baku madha'u! lula ama lamatua pakab'ua miu risi nèti ana mangungu aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: therefore every man that shall acknowledge me before men, i shall acknowledge him before my father that is in heavens.
target_text: hèia yesus tuhu hari lii padhai na, peka na, dhèu dhu bani mangaku ja'a ètu madha dhèu ae ètu rai-haha ne, pe ja'a kahèi mangaku nèngu ètu katanga madha ama ku ètu sorga, peka na, ‘nèngu ne dhèu ja'a. '

source_text: but he that shall deny me before men, i shall deny him before my father that is in heavens.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu dhu pasili ja'a ètu madha dhèu ae, peka na nèngu tadhe boe ja'a, bèli-camèd'a ja'a peka dènge ama ku ètu sorga kahèi, na, ‘ja'a tadhe boe dhèu ne'e. '

source_text: do not ye deem that i came to send peace into the earth; i came not to send peace, but sword.
target_text: mage mi pangee na, ja'a ne mai kèti dame asa rai-haha ne. te mamai ja'a ne, sèna ka dhèu rai-haha ne èci lab'a èci.

source_text: for i came to part a man against his father, and the daughter against her mother, and the son's wife against the husband's mother;
target_text: ja'a mai asa rai-haha ne, madhutu ngaa dhu dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua peka tèke èèna, ‘èèna na, ana mone lab'a ama na, ana bhèni lab'a ina na, aa bhèni dhèu èmu ana na, lab'a ina nèti dhèu èmu na,

source_text: and the enemies of a man be they, that be at home with him.
target_text: te isi èmu mae-manyèla, lula èci lab'a èci. '

source_text: he that loveth father or mother more than me, is not worthy to me/is not worthy of me. and he that loveth son or daughter more than me, is not worthy to me or of me.
target_text: de dhèu dhu neo madhutu ja'a tare'a-re'a, nèngu hud'i sue ku ja'a, risi nèti aa'i-aa'i, risi nèti ina-ama na, aa risi nèti ana niki na. ladhe aad'o, na, nèngu nia boe j'aj'i dhèu unu ja'a.

source_text: and he that taketh not his cross, and pursueth me, is not worthy to me or of me.
target_text: te dhèu dhu neo madhutu ja'a, te ngaa d'èi boe pasae j'aj'èra, nèngu nia boe j'aj'i dhèu unu ja'a.

source_text: he that findeth his life, shall lose it; and he that loseth his life for me, shall find it.
target_text: dhèu dhu sadia madhe lula na madhutu ja'a, bèli-camèd'a nèngu abhu mamuri taruu dènge ama lamatua. te ngaa dhèu dhu dhoka neo mamuri hia ngi'u nèngu unu na, èèna na, mamuri na ele iia d'ara!

source_text: he that receiveth you, receiveth me; and he that receiveth me, receiveth him that sent me.
target_text: dhèu dhu sèmi nare miu dènge be'a, nèngu sèmi nare ja'a kahèi. aa dhèu dhu sèmi nare ja'a, nèngu kahèi sèmi nare ama lamatua dhu pua ja'a mai.

source_text: he that receiveth a prophet in the name of a prophet, shall take or shall receive the meed of a prophet. and he that receiveth a just man in the name of a just man, shall take or shall receive the meed of a just man.
target_text: dhèu dhu sèmi nare dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua, lula na padhue-padhai lii holo-nori ama lamatua, pe lamatua b'ala nèngu sama sèmi na b'ala mi ca dhèu nèti lii padhai nèngu. aa dhèu dhu sèmi nare ca dhèu d'ara mola, lula dhèu èèna madhutu tare'a-re'a dad'èi ama lamatua, pe lamatua b'ala nèngu sama sèmi na b'ala mi ca dhèu d'ara mola.

source_text: and whoever giveth drink to one of these least, a cup of cold water only, in the name of a disciple, truly i say to you, he shall not lose his meed.
target_text: dhèu dhu sèmi nare ca dhèu dhu haha d'ai seli, lula nèngu madhutu ja'a, tatu ama lamatua b'ala ne. masi ka dhèu hia èi hua ca galaa di, tatu ama lamatua bhèlu boe ne.

source_text: and it was done, when jesus had ended, he commanded to his twelve disciples, and passed from thence to teach and preach in the cities of them.
target_text: ropa yesus hia nare lii moa mi canguru dua ana madhutu na, hèia na la'e kako palème rae-rae ètu rai èèna, sèna ka aj'a dhèu ètu sèra. aa na peka-padhai lii lolo be'a ama lamatua.

source_text: but when john in bonds had heard the works of christ, he sent two of his disciples,
target_text: lod'o èèna, yohanis ètu d'ara bèdho. ropa na tadèngi j'ara aa'i-aa'i dhu yesus tao, hèia na pua ana madhutu na ho lasi karèi yesus, peka na,

source_text: and said to him, art thou he that shall come, or we abide another?
target_text: ama lamatua dhu pajaji tèke le karèi nèti uru ka, na, nèngu neo pua kristus mai, sèna ka pala mamuri mi èdhi dhèu yahudi. ama ne, kristus, do? do, èdhi hud'i mate hari ku dhèu leo? ka lasi karèi yesus.

source_text: and jesus answered, and said to them, go ye, and tell again to john those things that ye have heard and seen.
target_text: ropa tadèngi nare, hèia yesus dhaa, aku nèngu na, miu se tadèngi le, aa mèdhi unu mi dènge madha. de lèpa ho lami peka dènge yohanis, aa'i-aa'i dhu j'aj'i, nuka sèmi ngaa dhu dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua, yesaya, suri tèke le, peka na:

source_text: blind men see, crooked men go, mesels be made clean, deaf men hear, dead men rise again, poor men be taken to preaching of the gospel.
target_text: dhèu bèdhu, ladhe rèdhi. dhèu karuku, kèd'i kako. dhèu pèd'a kusta, ka'uri ra milu hari. dhèu katele-katipa, bisa tadèngi. dhèu madhe, mamuri hari. dhèu unu aad'o, nanene lii lolo be'a.

source_text: and he is blessed, that shall not be caused to stumble in me.
target_text: de sèmi ne'e: lami peka dènge yohanis, bèli-camèd'a nèngu abhu a'oto, ladhe na parcaya ja'a taruu. nèti èèna ka, ama lamatua hia mèngi-nale mi dhèu dhu parcaya ja'a pa'èra-èra!

source_text: and when they were gone away, jesus began to say of john to the people, what thing went ye out into desert to see? a reed waved with the wind?
target_text: ropa ana madhutu yohanis se lèpa, hèia yesus peka dènge dhèu ae se, lula-nèti yohanis ne, aku nèngu na, lod'o miu neo paraga dènge yohanis ètu d'ara pad'a sod'a, miu pangee, na, neo paraga dènge dhèu dhu sèmi ngaa sa? tatu boe, miu paraga dènge dhèu dhu roe aala-aala, nuka sèmi kalai èèu dhu bhabheu madhutu ngèlu di!

source_text: or what thing went ye out to see? a man clothed with soft clothes? lo! they that be clothed with soft clothes be in the houses of kings.
target_text: aa tatu boe miu mèdhi dhèu dhu pake mèdha-papake dhu kab'ua aae, te dhèu sèmi èèna era pea na dhodhoka ètu d'ara èmu dhèu aae di!

source_text: but what thing went ye out to see? a prophet? yea, i say to you, and more than a prophet.
target_text: de lami ladhe dhèu sèmi ngaa sa ètu nèi? mi pangee na, miu lami tenge dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua! tare'a! te nèngu ne, ca dhèu nèti lii padhai lamatua dhu kapai risi.

source_text: for this is he, of whom it is written, lo! i send mine angel before thy face, that shall make ready thy way before thee.
target_text: te ètu d'ara sasuri ama lamatua dhu mola-mèci èèna, dhu suri tèke le lula-nèti yohanis ne, peka na, ‘nanene! ja'a pua dhèu ja'a, sèna ka bhoke j'ara hia èu. '

source_text: truly i say to you, there rose none more or none greater than john baptist among the children of women; but he that is less or that is the least in the kingdom of heavens, is more than he.
target_text: nanene paie! ètu rai-haha ne, abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu kapai risi nèti yohanis ne. te ngaa nèti dhèu rai-haha aa'i-aa'i dhu mangaku ama lamatua sama sèmi dhèu aae, dhèu dhu haha d'ai seli èèna ka, nèngu dhu kapai risi nèti yohanis.

source_text: and from the days of john baptist till now the kingdom of heavens suffereth violence, and violent men ravish it.
target_text: karèi nèti yohanis pakako sasab'a na, d'ai sange ne'e ne, abhu dhèu ae-ae dhu j'aj'i le dhèu unu ama lamatua. te ngaa abhu dhèu leo dhu pangee sala, peka na rèngu hud'i pamusu ku, sèna ka laka-seti dhèu ho j'aj'i dhèu unu ama lamatua.

source_text: for all the prophets and the law till john prophesied;
target_text: toke d'ai lod'o mamai yohanis tuka sarani, èdhi dhèu yahudi dhu tema madhutu atora musa, dènge atora dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua leo sèra.

source_text: and if ye will receive, he is elijah, that is to come.
target_text: de parcaya la ja'a! yohanis ne, nuka elia, dhu dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua, peka mema le lula-nèti mamai na.

source_text: he that hath ears of hearing, hear he.
target_text: de dhu neo me'a mèu, hud'i nanene ku paie-iie!

source_text: but to whom shall i guess this generation like? it is like to children sitting in the chapping, that cry to their peers,
target_text: ja'a neo hia lii pakasame, sèna ka miu me'a, rupa sèmi mia ka dhèu taa limuri ne. te rèngu se cakaraa dènge ana-ana dhu madhèdi ètu d'ara pasa. rèngu dhu pa'oo-parodha dènge angalai ra, peka na,

source_text: and say, we have sung to you, and ye have not danced; we have mourned to you, and ye have not wailed.
target_text: ‘ji'i aa'i-aa'i mi tiu sakino dènge karej'e-karae, te ngaa miu roge-ledho boe. hèia ji'i sod'a lii beke dhèu madhe, te ngaa miu tangi boe. '

source_text: for john came neither eating nor drinking, and they say, he hath a devil.
target_text: miu se sama sèmi ana iiki dhu re'a boe roca. lod'o yohanis mai, nèngu d'èi puasa, aa ninu boe èi anggor. te ngaa dhèu peka na, ‘nèngu, nidhu tao! '

source_text: the son of man came eating and drinking, and they say, lo! a man a glutton, and a drinker of wine, and a friend of publicans and of sinful men. and wisdom is justified of her sons.
target_text: te ngaa ja'a, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne, mai le. ja'a puasa boe, aa kinu èi anggor. te ngaa dhèu peka na, ‘nèngu èèna, dhèu gagoo-gagehu! dhèu tema mahu bia! la'e pa'angalai dènge dhèu roro bea! pa'èci dènge dhèu dhu laku-laku boe. nèngu dhu ne'a boe makae! ' te ngaa mi patadhe lii padhai ja'a ne! mamèu ama lamatua èèna, cèu ètu d'ara mamuri dhèu unu na.

source_text: then jesus began to say reproof to cities, in which full many virtues of him were done, for they did not penance.
target_text: èle èèna ka, lamatua yesus pasanèd'e dhèu-dhèu dhu pea ètu pèri-pèri rae. na tao le tadha-tadha malaa ae risi ètu nèi, te ngaa ro'o boe ae eele nèti sasala ra, ho madhutu j'ara mamuri ama lamatua dhu mola.

source_text: woe to thee! chorazin, woe to thee! bethsaida; for if the virtues that be done in you had been done in tyre and sidon, sometime they had done penance in hair-shirt and ashes.
target_text: yesus jèke si, peka na, heh! miu dhèu korasin, aa miu dhèu betsaida! mate unu miu! bèli-camèd'a pasae mere mamadhe-mamopo! ja'a tao le rupa-rupa tadha malaa ètu katanga madha miu, te ngaa miu mo'o boe parcaya ama lamatua. masi ka miu dhèu yahudi dhu peka na, miu tadhe lamatua, te ngaa ladhe sèmi tadha malaa dhu ja'a tao se'e ètu kota tirus dènge kota sidon, tatu nèbhu nare sange ne'e, dhèu-dhèu ètu sèra èle le ho'a, aa tèke eele le sasala-sasigo ra ho madhutu ama lamatua. aa tatu ra pake le bèla mèdhi, dènge tao ahu mi kètu ho j'aj'i mi tadha, na, rèngu manyasa nèti sasala ra. masi ka dhèu tirus dènge dhèu sidon sèra dhèu yahudi boe, dhu mangaku na, tadhe lamatua.

source_text: nevertheless i say to you, it shall be less pain to tyre and sidon in the day of doom, than to you.
target_text: ja'a monya boe! bèli-camèd'a mèdhi unu mi! d'ai lod'o dhu ama lamatua pama'ète lii langu dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra, hahuku dhèu tirus dènge dhèu sidon samaa risi nèti hahuku miu.

source_text: and thou, capernaum, whether thou shalt be araised up into heaven? thou shalt go down into hell. for if the virtues that be done in thee had been done in sodom, peradventure they should have dwelled till into this day.
target_text: miu dhèu kapernaum! mage-mage, ee! mage mi pangee, na, ama lamatua paca'e miu lami asa sorga. aad'o! èèna na lamatua pèci mi asa d'ara naraka! ladhe sèmi tadha-tadha malaa dhu ja'a tao ètu rae miu dhu j'aj'i uuru le ètu kota sodom, tatu ama lamatua parluu boe labhu pakèpu kota èèna. te ladhe dhèu sodom rèdhi tadha malaa se, tatu ra rai eele le nèti bhabhelu-katub'a ra.

source_text: nevertheless i say to you, that to the land of sodom it shall be less pain in the day of doom, than to thee.
target_text: tare'a! pe mèdhi unu mi! ladhe d'ai ka lod'o ama lamatua pama'ète lii langu dhèu aa'i-aa'i, hahuku dhèu sodom samaa risi nèti hahuku miu se!

source_text: in that time jesus answered, and said, i acknowledge to thee, father, lord of heaven and of earth, for thou hast hid these things from wise men, and ready, or wary, or prudent, or sly, and hast showed them to little children;
target_text: ropa padhai lii nare, hèia yesus sabaj'a, peka na, ama! ama dhu j'aj'i lamatua ètu dedha-liru dènge rai-haha. ja'a manèngi makasi ae-ae, lula ama pahuni pamèno-mèno j'ara-j'ara dhu ama hia huku mi dhèu-dhèu dhu pangee na, rèngu d'èlu-mèu, aa dhu padedha iisi ra. te ngaa ama bhoke patalele j'ara se'e aa'i-aa'i mi dhèu haha dènge dhu pahaha iisi ra.

source_text: so, father, for so it was pleasing before thee.
target_text: tare'a, ama! te sèmi èèna ka, dhu pakarej'e d'ara ama!

source_text: all things be given to me of my father; and no man knew or knoweth the son, but the father, neither any man knew or knoweth the father, but the son, and to whom the son would show.
target_text: ropa sabaj'a nare, hèia yesus peka dènge dhèu-dhèu ètu sèra, na, nanene paie-iie! ama ku ètu sorga pangèd'u le koasa aa'i-aa'i mi ja'a ne. dhu tadhe mèu ja'a, dhoka ama ku di. aa dhu tadhe mèu ama, dhoka ana na, nuka ja'a ne. aa ja'a hag'e kore dhèu leo, sèna ka peka dènge ra, ho rèngu tadhe mèu ne kahèi.

source_text: all ye that travail, and be charged, come to me, and i shall fulfill or shall refresh you.
target_text: miu aa'i-aa'i mi dhu roe lula sab'a bia, mai madhutu ja'a! aa miu aa'i-aa'i mi dhu pasae bia, mai la asa ja'a!

source_text: take ye my yoke on you, and learn ye of me, for i am mild and meek in heart; and ye shall find rest to your souls.
target_text: ladhe miu sèmi mere a'aj'a ja'a, ho kako palere-lere dènge ja'a, na, èdhi ca ropa dènge sapi dua ngi'u dhu nuni kataka pare rai èci. te ja'a ne, d'ara hua iia, aa lii mako. ladhe miu madhutu ja'a, miu j'aj'i èra hari.

source_text: for my yoke is soft or sweet, and my charge is light or easy.
target_text: lula a'aj'a ja'a, carui boe. aa paredha ja'a, bia boe kahèi.

source_text: in that time jesus went by corns in or on the sabbath day; and his disciples hungered, and began to pluck the ears of corn, and to eat.
target_text: ca lod'o, lèke dènge ae sasab'a dhèu yahudi, yesus dènge ana-ana madhutu na dhu kako re karasa oka dhèu. ana madhutu na manganga, hèia ra g'ètu are-gandum ka ra'a noo-noo.

source_text: and the pharisees, seeing, said to him, lo! thy disciples do that thing that is not leaveful to them to do in the sabbaths.
target_text: ètu èèna, abhu pèri-pèri dhèu nèti partei agama parisi dhu madhutu pa'èra ad'a dhèu yahudi ra. ropa ladhe rèdhi ana madhutu yesus se tao sèmi èèna, hèia ra kai ne, peka na, ana madhutu mu, g'ètu gandum lèke dènge lod'o ae sasab'a-la'a! rèngu baku tao sèmi ne'e! te tatao ne sisu atora èdhi.

source_text: and he said to them, whether ye have not read, what david did, when he hungered, and they that were with him? how he entered into the house of god, and ate loaves of proposition, either of setting forth, which loaves it was not leaveful to him to eat, neither to them that were with him, but to priests alone?
target_text: te ngaa yesus b'ala, aku nèngu na, tasamia, ee? miu teko bhèlu lii lolo daud, si? daud dènge ana-ana madhutu na dhu manganga titu kèna. hèia na maso asa d'ara paleo manèngi-mangaj'i ama lamatua, ka nare roti dhu ama agama hia le mi lamatua, ka rèngu ra'a. te ngaa dhu bisa ra'e roti se dhodhoka ama agama sèra. dhèu leo bisa boe. èle ka daud si ra'a, te ngaa ca dhèu sa pasala boe si. miu nuka sèmi dhèu dhu baca mèdhi boe sasuri lii holo-nori ama lamatua!

source_text: or whether ye have not read in the law, that in the sabbaths priests in the temple defoul the sabbaths, and they be without blame?
target_text: te ètu d'ara sasuri èèna, suri kahèi nèti sasab'a ama agama yahudi sèra, ètu d'ara èmu sabaj'a, lèke dènge lod'o ae sasab'a. te ngaa rèngu sala boe ngaa-ngaa.

source_text: and i say to you, that here is a greater than the temple.
target_text: nanene! uru èèna, èmu sabaj'a ka dhu kab'ua, te ngaa limuri ne abhu dhu kab'ua risi, nuka ja'a ne, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a.

source_text: and if ye knew, what it is, i will mercy, and not sacrifice, ye should never have condemned innocents.
target_text: ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua, na peka na, ‘dad'èi ja'a sèmi ne'e: dhèu ja'a sèra hud'i pad'elo ku rasa kasia èci dènge èci. ladhe ra tao boe madhutu j'ara ne, na, badha korban dhu rèngu rèti hia ja'a, dènge boe kab'ua. ' de ladhe miu me'a mèu sasoa nèti lii padhai lamatua ne, tatu miu pasala boe ana madhutu ja'a se. te ra tao boe sala ngaa-ngaa!

source_text: for man's son is lord, yea, of the sabbath.
target_text: te ja'a ne, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a. ja'a ka dhu dènge hak ho pama'ète, peka na, dhèu bisa sab'a ngaa, lèke dènge lod'o ae sasab'a.

source_text: and when he passed from thence, he came into the synagogue of them.
target_text: èle ka yesus tèke eele era èèna, la'e asa d'ara èmu sabaj'a ra.

source_text: and lo! a man that had a dry hand. and they asked him, and said, whether it be leaveful to heal in the sabbath? that they should accuse him.
target_text: ètu ne'e, abhu mone ca dhèu dhu kacui-aai madhe cabèka. dhèu parisi sèra dhu tenge-tenge j'ara ho pasala yesus, ladhe sèmi na puri-pa'èle dhèu dhu kacui-aai madhe cabèka ne, lèke dènge lod'o ae sasab'a. hèia ra karèi ne, peka na, madhutu atora agama èdhi, dhèu bisa puri-pa'èle dhèu, lèke dènge lod'o ae sasab'a-la'a, do aad'o?

source_text: and he said to them, what man of you shall there be, that hath one sheep, and if it fall into a ditch in the sabbaths, whether he shall not hold, and lift it up?
target_text: hèia yesus dhaa, aku nèngu na, ladhe kahib'i-kalèbho ci'u manahu asa d'ara ro'a, lèke dènge lod'o ae sasab'a, dhèu unu na mai name nare, sina ma?

source_text: how much more is a man better than a sheep? therefore it is leaveful to do good in the sabbaths.
target_text: de ama lamatua sue dhèu rai-haha, risi nèti dhèu unu kahib'i-kalèbho deo na. nèti èèna ka, dhèu bisa tao j'ara dhu be'a lèke dènge lod'o ae sasab'a.

source_text: then he said to the man, stretch forth thine hand. and he stretched forth; and it was restored to health as the other.
target_text: ka na lii dènge dhèu dhu ai madhe cabèka na, j'ole kacui-aai èu mai! hèia, na j'ole kacui-aai dhu madhe èèna, kaca'a la èle dènge ka, sama dènge kacui-aai dhu iia èèna.

source_text: and the pharisees went out, and made a counsel against him, how they should destroy him.
target_text: ropa dhèu parisi se rèdhi sèmi èèna, hèia ra nasa titu kèna. èle ka ra kalua tèke eele èmu sabaj'a ne, hèia lasi pare'a, aku rèngu na, èdhi hud'i tenge ku j'ara, sèna ka pamadhe ne!

source_text: and jesus knew it, and went away from thence; and many pursued him, and he healed them all.
target_text: te ngaa yesus dhu ne'a ngangee rèngu dhu karehe ne, nèti èèna ka la'e asa era leo. dhèu ae madhutu ne, hèia na puri-pa'èle dhèu dhu pèd'a aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: and he commanded to them, that they should not make him known;
target_text: te ngaa na kai si, peka na, mage lami palolo kahèi dènge dhèu leo lula-nèti ja'a.

source_text: that that thing were fulfilled, that was said by isaiah, the prophet, saying,
target_text: nèngu tao sèmi èèna, madhutu sèmi lii padhai ama lamatua dhu peka le mi dhèu nèti lii padhai na, ngara na yesaya, dhu suri tèke, na,

source_text: lo! my child, whom i have chosen, my darling, in whom it hath well pleased to my soul; i shall put my spirit on him, and he shall tell doom to heathen men.
target_text: ladhe ku laa! nèngu ne, dhèu pajuu-paleha ja'a, dhu ja'a hag'e kore le. ja'a sue ne, aa d'ara ja'a karej'e taruu dènge ne. èèna na, ja'a pangèd'u ne roh ja'a, ho la'e aj'a-nori dhèu nèti suku aa'i-aa'i lula-nèti j'ara mamuri ja'a dhu mola.

source_text: he shall not strive, nor cry, neither any man shall hear his voice in streets.
target_text: nèngu ne, ne'a boe tèb'a kakara. nèngu ne, ne'a boe padedha iisi.

source_text: a bruised reed he shall not break or he shall not break altogether a shaken reed, and he shall not quench smoking flax, till he cast out doom to victory;
target_text: d'ara na hua iia. dhu ne'a boe paj'èra dhèu. aj'u dhu oe padhe, na lèku eele boe. labhu dhu saruru, na tiu pamadhe boe. na loe boe aj'a-nori dhèu, toke dhèu aa'i-aa'i tao madhutu j'ara mamuri dhu mola nèti ama lamatua.

source_text: and heathen men shall hope in his name.
target_text: dhèu nèti suku aa'i-aa'i èèna na parcaya ne, lula re'a na, nèngu ne, cee.

source_text: then a man blind and dumb, that had a fiend or a devil, was brought to him; and he healed him, so that he spake, and saw.
target_text: ca tèka, rèti asa yesus ca dhèu dhu nidhu tao toke bèdhu aa ele lii. hèia yesus pa'èle ne dènge babège eele nidhu nèti dhèu ne'e. ka dhèu ne bisa nèdhi, aa bisa padhai lii.

source_text: and all the people wondered, and said, whether this be the son of david?
target_text: dhèu ae se, ropa rèdhi sèmi èèna, hèia ra malaa-maloha. ra papeka na, nèngu ne'e, ele boe ana-èpu daud, dhu dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua suri tèke karèi nèti uru ka! nèngu ne'e, tatu dhèu dhu èdhi mate tae-tae èèna!

source_text: but the pharisees heard, and said, he this casteth not out fiends, but in beelzebub, prince of fiends or prince of devils.
target_text: te ngaa ropa dhèu parisi tadèngi rare, hèia ra ro'o boe parcaya. ka ra papeka, na, wee! dhèu ne bisa babège nidhu, lula dhèu aae nidhu baalsebul ka dhu pangèd'u na koasa.

source_text: and jesus, witting their thoughts, said to them, each kingdom parted against itself, shall be desolated or be desolate, and each city, or house, parted against itself, shall not stand.
target_text: te ngaa yesus ne'a lii padhai dhèu parisi se. hèia na peka dènge dhèu se'e, aku nèngu na, lii padhai miu ne, lèke boe! ladhe ètu d'ara rai cue, ana kabarai na patao-palaha, tasa mera mia ho rai ne bisa taha! sèmi èèna kahèi, ladhe dhèu ètu d'ara kota èci, do d'ara èmu cue, èci patao dènge èci, tatu ra mae-manyèla, toke laho mae-mae, si!

source_text: and if satan casteth out satan, he is parted against himself; therefore how shall his kingdom stand?
target_text: de ladhe nidhu pamusu dènge nidhu, aa palab'a èci dènge èci, tatu dhèu aae ra nèd'u paredha nèbhu boe!

source_text: and if i in beelzebub cast out devils, in whom, or by whose might, your sons cast out? therefore they shall be your doomsmen.
target_text: sanèd'e paie! dhèu miu re'a kahèi babège eele nidhu. ra pake koasa nèti nidhu, do? aad'o! de miu baku padhai lii ore dhu peka na, ja'a pake koasa nidhu, ho babège eele nidhu. pe dhèu miu unu mi ka dhu pama'ète, peka na, ngaa dhu miu galaa ne, lèke boe j'ara.

source_text: but if i in the spirit of god cast out fiends, then the kingdom of god is come into you or is come among you.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe ja'a tare'a-re'a babège eele nidhu pake koasa nèti roh ama lamatua, èèna pad'elo na, lamatua èèna tare'a-re'a dhèu aae dhu ètu le katanga madha miu.

source_text: either how may any man enter into the house of a strong man, and take away his vessels, but he first bind the strong man, and then he shall spoil his house?
target_text: ladhe dhèu neo lasi mana'u èmu dhèu èci dhu èra, nèngu hud'i èki-karadhe uuru ku dhèu lamatua èmu ne. heka na mana'u nèti mèdha-panyau na sèra.

source_text: he that is not with me, is against me; and he that gathereth not together with me, scattereth abroad.
target_text: sanèd'e, ee! te dhèu dhu pa'èci boe dènge ja'a, nèngu pamusu dènge ja'a. aa dhèu dhu soru-bara boe ja'a ètu d'ara sab'a-la'a, nèngu ne'a dhoka pa'iu dhèu di.

source_text: therefore i say to you, all sin and blasphemy shall be forgiven to men, but the blasphemy of the spirit shall not be forgiven.
target_text: de nanene paie-iie lii padhai ja'a ne! ama lamatua dhu sadia saku eele sasala-sasigo dhèu. ladhe dhèu padhai lii pakarehe kolongara dhèu leo, ama lamatua sadia abho ne era. te ngaa ladhe abhu dhèu dhu bani padhai pakarehe roh ama lamatua dhu mola-mèci, ama lamatua saku eele boe sasala na èèna.

source_text: and whoever saith a word against man's son, it shall be forgiven to him; but who that saith a word against the holy ghost, it shall not be forgiven to him, neither in this world, nor in the tother.
target_text: ladhe dhèu pakarehe ja'a, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne, ama lamatua sadia saku eele sasala na. te ngaa cee ka dhu bani padhai lii pahahe roh ama lamatua, te ngaa ama lamatua saku eele boe sasala na, masi ka toke dai mia-mia la'e!

source_text: either make ye the tree good, and his fruit good; either make ye the tree evil and his fruit evil; for a tree is known of his fruit.
target_text: hèia yesus padhai lii taruu dènge dhèu parisi se, peka na, ngee paie-iie! aj'u dhu be'a, hia hua dhu be'a. te ngaa aj'u dhu karehe, hia hua dhu karehe. nèti hua na, dhèu bisa tadhe aj'u ne, be'a do karehe.

source_text: ye generation of adders, how may ye speak good things, when ye be evil? for the mouth speaketh of the plenty or of the great abundance of the heart.
target_text: te ngaa miu se ca ropa dènge mege, dhu ne'a dhoka kapod'e-kabèli di! miu me'a boe padhai lii dhu be'a. lula ngaa dhu tèke ètu d'ara, èèna ka dhu kalua mai nèti d'ara hèb'a na.

source_text: a good man bringeth forth good things of good treasure, and an evil man bringeth forth evil things of evil treasure.
target_text: dhèu be'a, tatu lii padhai na be'a, lula ètu d'ara na abhu j'ara dhu be'a. te ngaa dhèu bhelu, tatu lii padhai na karehe, lula ètu d'ara na dhu pènu dènge bhabhelu-katub'a.

source_text: and i say to you, that of every idle word, that men speak, they shall yield reason thereof in the day of doom;
