target_text: lèka la lii ja'a ne! te bèli-camèd'a lod'o èle rai-haha, ama lamatua parisa lii langu dhèu aa'i-aa'i. lod'o èèna, dhèu èci-èci ka hud'i dhaa lii-lii nèngu dhu dènge boe kolo-kapua.

source_text: for of thy words thou shalt be justified, and of thy words thou shalt be condemned.
target_text: de mage-mage! te bèli-camèd'a èèna, ama lamatua dadoo lii-lii miu sèra, aa pama'ète peka na, miu lèke huku do, aad'o.

source_text: then some of the scribes and the pharisees answered to him, and said, master, we will see a token of thee.
target_text: ropa tadèngi lii padhai yesus sèmi èèna, hèia pèri-pèri mese agama dènge dhèu parisi, peka dènge yesus, aku rèngu na, ama mese! ji'i neo ngèdhi tadha malaa èci, sèna ka j'aj'i mi tadha, peka na, koasa ama, tare'a nèti ama lamatua.

source_text: which answered, and said to them, an evil kindred and a spouse-breaker or adulterous seeketh a token, and a token shall not be given to it, but the token of jonah, the prophet.
target_text: te ngaa yesus jèke si, peka na, weh! miu dhèu taa limuri ne, mo'o boe madhutu ama lamatua! miu se me'a dhodhoka ad'u-ue bhelu-katub'a di! masi ka miu manèngi tadha malaa, te ngaa ja'a tao boe. lula uru èèna, lamatua hia le tadha malaa re yunus, dhèu nèti lii padhai na. èèna d'ai le!

source_text: for as jonah was in the womb of a whale three days and three nights, so man's son shall be in the heart of the earth three days and three nights.
target_text: yunus pea tèlu mèu-tèlu mèda ètu d'ara kabake i'a aae ci'u. sèmi èèna kahèi dènge ja'a, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne. bèli-camèd'a ja'a kahèi ètu d'ara ro'a dhèu madhe, tèlu mèu-tèlu mèda.

source_text: men of nineveh shall rise in doom with this generation, and shall condemn it; for they did penance in the preaching of jonah, and lo! here is a greater than jonah.
target_text: ladhe d'ai lod'o èle rai-haha ne, lamatua j'aj'i hakim. aa dhèu niniwe se titu j'aj'i sakasii ho galaa miu, peka na, ‘miu aa'i-aa'i se, goa! ' uru èèna, ropa dhèu niniwe sèra tadèngi lii padhai yunus, dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua, hèia ra tèke eele sasala ra. te ngaa miu sèmi boe èèna. masi ka limuri ne, abhu le dhèu ètu talora aae miu, dhu kapai risi nèti yunus, nuka ja'a ne. te ngaa miu se pusi-pahae boe ja'a ciki sa hèi.

source_text: the queen of the south shall rise in doom with this generation, and shall condemn it; for she came from the ends of the earth to hear the wisdom of solomon, and lo! here is a greater than solomon.
target_text: pe, ètu d'ara lod'o èle rai-haha ne, ladhe lamatua j'aj'i hakim, bhèni aae syeba nèti balèu, j'aj'i sakasii kahèi. na paj'uj'u ai na mi miu, ho na galaa miu aa'i-aa'i dhu ana loo-limuri ne, peka na, ‘miu aa'i-aa'i mi, goa! ' uru èèna, bhèni aae ne mai nèti rai kaj'èu ho neo nèdhi unu na mamèu dhèu aae soleman. te ngaa limuri ne, abhu ca dhèu ètu talora aae miu dhu kapai risi nèti dhèu aae soleman, nuka ja'a ne. te ngaa miu pusi-pahae boe ja'a ciki sa hèi.

source_text: when an unclean spirit goeth out from a man, he goeth by dry places, seeking rest, and findeth not or none.
target_text: ladhe babège eele nidhu nèti ca dhèu, nidhu ne la'e pea asa era dhu kaliu, ho j'aj'i mi era ae iisi na. te ngaa abhu boe era dhu mèci ho na pea kalili.

source_text: then he saith, i shall turn again into mine house, from whence i went out. and he cometh, and findeth it void, and cleansed with besoms, and made fair.
target_text: hèia na pangee, peka na, ‘abhu boe era dhu be'a sèmi nèi, hua iia ja'a lèpa hari asa dhèu dhu uru èèna ja'a pea. ' ka la'e hari asa era nèngu uru èèna. na ladhe na, era ne mèu bia, aa dhu lalau rare pabe'a-be'a.

source_text: then he goeth, and taketh with him seven other spirits worse than himself; and they enter in, and dwell there. and the last things of that man be made worse than the former. so it shall be to this worst generation.
target_text: hèia nidhu ne la'e paroa nare angalai na dhèu pidhu dhu bhabhelu ra risi nèti nèngu. ka lasi pea ètu d'ara dhèu ne, hèia aa'i-aa'i ra kakeho ne. de limuri ne, mamuri dhèu ne asa ele iie-iie. sèmi èèna kahèi lèke mi dhèu bhelu-katub'a taa limuri ne.

source_text: yet while he spake to the people, lo! his mother and his brethren stood withoutforth, seeking to speak with him.
target_text: lod'o èèna, yesus padhai lii era dènge dhèu ae. hèia ina dènge ari na sèra, mai neo paraga dènge ne. rèngu titu ètu li'u, ka ra pua dhèu lasi paroa ne.

source_text: and a man said to him, lo! thy mother and thy brethren stand with-outforth, seeking thee.
target_text: hèia dhèu mai peka dènge ne, aku rèngu na, ama! ina dènge ari ama ètu li'u nèi. rèngu neo paraga dènge ama.

source_text: and he answered to the man, that spake to him, and said, who is my mother? and who be my brethren?
target_text: ka yesus peka dènge ra, cee ka ina ku, aa cee ka a'ari ja'a dhu tare'a-re'a?

source_text: and he held forth his hand into his disciples, and said, lo! my mother and my brethren;
target_text: hèia na paj'uj'u asa dhèu-dhèu dhu madhutu ne, ka na lii, aku nèngu na, rèngu se'e se ka, ina dènge a'ari ja'a.

source_text: for whoever doeth the will of my father that is in heavens, he is my brother, and sister, and mother.
target_text: te dhèu dhu tao madhutu dad'èi ama ku ètu sorga, rèngu ka ina ku aa a'ari ja'a dhu tare'a-re'a.

source_text: in that day jesus went out of the house, and sat beside the sea.
target_text: lod'o èèna kahèi, yesus kalua nèti èmu èèna, la'e madhèdi asa sebhe dano galilea.

source_text: and much people was gathered to him, so that he went up into a boat, and sat; and all the people stood on the brink.
target_text: hèia dhèu ae-ae mai lingu rare ne. ka la'e madhèdi asa dedha koha cue, dhu panahu ètu era èèna, ho aj'a dhèu sèra. dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu dae sèra nanene ne.

source_text: and he spake to them many things in parables, and said, lo! he that soweth, went out to sow his seed.
target_text: hèia na aj'a madha j'ara ae-ae mi rèngu pake lii pakasame. na lole, peka na, abhu ca dhèu sab'a oka-tedhe, dhu ceb'e hini ètu d'ara oka na.

source_text: and while he soweth, some seeds felled beside the way, and birds of the air came, and ate them.
target_text: ropa na ceb'e hini se, abhu dhu lèke ètu j'ara. hèia manu-bhui mai, ka tutu ra'e aa'i hini se.

source_text: but other seeds felled into stony places, where they had not much earth; and anon they sprung up, for they had not deepness of earth.
target_text: te ngaa hini cahag'e lèke ètu rai dhu dènge hadhu. hini se muri malai, lula abhu rai ciki di.

source_text: but when the sun was risen, they sweltered or they burned for the heat, and for they had not root, they dried up.
target_text: te ngaa ropa lod'o rea, hèia ana aaj'u se kamale, ka mango eele si. te amo ra marèma boe ètu d'ara rai.

source_text: and other seeds felled among thorns; and the thorns waxed up, and strangled them.
target_text: abhu hini cahag'e dhu lèke ètu era j'u'u padhudhu. hèia j'u'u padhudhu se hèlu pamadhe aa'i si.

source_text: but other seeds felled into good land, and gave fruit; some an hundred-fold, another sixtyfold, another thirty-fold.
target_text: te ngaa abhu hini cahag'e lèke ètu rai isi. hini se muri, ka ra kapai toke hua-hela. abhu dhu tèlu nguru hari, abhu dhu èna nguru hari, aa abhu dhu d'ai cangasu hari.

source_text: he that hath ears of hearing, hear he.
target_text: cee dhu dènge ro'a dhilu, na nanene paie-iie!

source_text: and the disciples came nigh, and said to him, why speakest thou in parables to them?
target_text: èle èèna ka, ana madhutu yesus mai karèi ne, aku rèngu na, nga tao ka ama aj'a dhèu ae pake lii pakasame?

source_text: and he answered, and said to them, for to you it is given to know the privates or mysteries of the kingdom of heavens; but it is not given to them.
target_text: hèia yesus dhaa, aku nèngu na, lula miu se neo me'a tare'a-re'a paredha ama lamatua, nèti èèna ka ja'a peka mema sasoa nèti lii pakasame ne. te ngaa mi dhèu leo, ja'a aj'a pake lii pakasame.

source_text: for it shall be given to him that hath, and he shall have plenty; but if a man hath not, also that thing that he hath shall be taken away from him.
target_text: te dhèu dhu tare'a-re'a neo re'a dad'èi ama lamatua, pe lamatua hia ne asa ne'a ae. te ngaa dhèu dhu pusi-pahae boe dad'èi lamatua, pe lamatua tao ne asa tabha goa.

source_text: therefore i speak to them in parables, for they seeing see not, and they hearing hear not, neither under-stand;
target_text: ja'a aj'a-nori si pake dhoka lii pakasame di, lula: ‘rèngu rèdhi le, te ngaa ro'o boe re'a. rèngu tadèngi le, te ngaa ra pusi-pahae boe. '

source_text: that the prophecy of isaiah saying be fulfilled in them, with hearing ye shall hear, and ye shall not under-stand; and ye seeing shall see, and ye shall not see;
target_text: rèngu se cakaraa dènge dhèu dhu yesaya suri mema le. yesaya èèna, nuka dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua, dhu suri, na, ‘miu èèna na tadèngi, te ngaa miu pakatele dhilu. miu èèna na ladhe mèdhi, te ngaa mo'o boe pame'a ngaa dhu j'aj'i le.

source_text: for the heart of this people is greatly fatted, and they heard heavily with ears, and they have closed their eyes, lest sometime they see with eyes, and with ears hear, and under-stand in heart, and they be converted, and i heal them.
target_text: lula d'ara dhèu se'e adhu sèmi hadhu, ra pakatele dhilu ra, aa ra pabèdhu musi madha ra. de hud'i rèngu sène, sèna ka ro'a dhilu ra katele-katipa, aa soro tèke si, sèna ka musi madha ra bèdhu sèmi èèna. hud'i laa, ho ja'a puri-pa'èle ia ka si, lula rèngu pusi-pahae boe ja'a. '

source_text: but your eyes that see be blessed, and your ears that hear.
target_text: te ngaa miu se, oto! lula miu ladhe mèdhi dènge musi madha, aa tadèngi dènge ro'a dhilu miu unu mi.

source_text: forsooth i say to you, that many prophets and just men coveted to see those things that ye see, and they saw not, and to hear those things that ye hear, and they heard not.
target_text: parcaya la ja'a! uru èèna, dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua, dènge dhèu dhu d'ara mola, d'ara ra neo rèdhi ngaa dhu limuri ne miu ladhe mèdhi, te ngaa bisa boe. d'ara ra neo kahèi tadèngi ngaa dhu limuri ne miu tadèngi le, te ngaa bisa boe.

source_text: therefore hear ye the parable of the sower.
target_text: ropa padhai lii nare, hèia yesus peka dènge ra, de mi nanene ka sasoa nèti lii pakasame deo na.

source_text: each that heareth the word of the realm, and understandeth not, the evil spirit cometh, and ravisheth that that is sown in his heart; this it is or this is he, that is sown beside the way.
target_text: hini dhu lèke ètu j'ara, nuka dhèu dhu nanene lii holo-nori nèti ama lamatua nèd'u paredha, te ngaa nèngu ne'a iia boe. hèia dhèu aae nidhu mai parame nare lii holo-nori nèti d'ara dhèu ne.

source_text: but this or he that is sown on the stony land, this it is or is this, that heareth the word of god, and anon with joy taketh it.
target_text: hini dhu ceb'e lèke ètu rai dhu pènu dènge hadhu, nuka dhèu dhu nanene lii holo-nori ama lamatua, hèia na sèmi nare dènge d'ara karej'e.

source_text: and he hath not root in himself, but is temporal. for when tribulation and persecution is made for the word, anon he is caused to stumble.
target_text: te ngaa lii holo-nori ne, amo na marèma boe. nèti èèna ka, nare boe nèbhu ètu d'ara dhèu ne. ropa dhèu leo paj'èra ne lula na sèmi nare lii holo-nori ne, ka dhèu ne kèpe pa'èra heka a'aj'a sèra.

source_text: but he that is sown in thorns, is this that heareth the word, and the busyness of this world, and the fallacy or the falseness of riches strangleth the word, and it is made without fruit.
target_text: aa hini dhu lèke ètu talora aae j'u'u padhudhu, nuka dhèu dhu nanene lii holo-nori. te ngaa nèngu bhute dènge rupa-rupa j'ara, ho pakarej'e mamuri na. hèia bhabhute se'e ka seti eele lii holo-nori ne nèti d'ara nèngu, toke dènge heka kab'ua.

source_text: but he that is sown into good land, is this that heareth the word, and understandeth, and bringeth forth fruit. and some maketh an hundred-fold, truly another sixtyfold and another thirtyfold.
target_text: te ngaa hini dhu lèke ètu rai isi, nuka dhèu dhu pasa paie dhilu na, sèna ka sèmi nare lii holo-nori, aa tao madhutu dad'èi lamatua. hèia na tao j'ara-j'ara dhu be'a, sama sèmi hini dhu muri toke kapai, ka na hua ae-ae. abhu dhu tèlu nguru hari, abhu kahèi èna nguru hari, aa abhu dhu d'ai cangasu hari.

source_text: another parable jesus put forth to them, and said, the kingdom of heavens is made like to a man, that sowed good seed in his field.
target_text: yesus lolo hari lii pakasame èci, aku nèngu na, paredha ama lamatua ne, nuka sèmi abhu ca dhèu la'e ceb'e hini dhu be'a ètu d'ara oka na.

source_text: and when men slept, his enemy came, and sowed above tares, or darnels, or cockles, in the middle of wheat, and went away.
target_text: d'ara mèda èèna, ropa dhèu aa'i-aa'i bhèj'i luu, hèia dhèu bhelu mai, ka na ceb'e lamusi j'u'u ètu d'ara oka ne.

source_text: but when the herb was grown, and made fruit, then the tares, or the darnels, or cockles, appeared.
target_text: ropa hini ètu d'ara oka ne d'ai hua-hela, hèia dhèu sab'a se, ladhe rèdhi j'u'u dhu muri palere-lere dènge hini se.

source_text: and the servants of the husband-man came, and said to him, lord, whether hast thou not sown good seed in thy field? whereof then hath it tares, or darnels, or cockles?
target_text: ka lasi peka dènge lamatua oka ne, aku rèngu na, ‘ama! ca hari ni ji'i sèle hini dhu be'a ètu d'ara oka ama, si? nga tao ka muri mai pab'ali dènge j'u'u ae-ae? '

source_text: and he said to them, an enemy hath done this thing. and the servants said to him, wilt thou that we go, and gather them?
target_text: lamatua oka ne dhaa, peka na, ‘èèna tatao nèti dhèu bhelu. ' hèia dhèu sab'a se peka, aku rèngu na, ‘ama, ji'i la'a ko'o eele j'u'u sèi, do? '

source_text: and he said, nay, lest peradven-ture ye in gathering tares, or the darnels, or cockles, draw up with them also the wheat by the root.
target_text: te ngaa na b'ala, peka na, ‘hud'i laa, te ladhe miu ko'o eele j'u'u se, ana nganga'a èdhi se lèke bete kahèi.

source_text: suffer ye them both to wax into reaping time; and in the time of ripe corn, i shall say to the reapers, first gather ye together the tares, or the darnels, or cockles, and bind them together in knitches, or small bundles, to be burnt, but gather ye the wheat into my barn.
target_text: hud'i rèngu sène ra muri palere-lere toke hèru puu-g'ètu. pe d'ai lod'o na, ja'a peka dènge dhèu sab'a se, na, miu pakaboko uru ku j'u'u sèra. hèia èki si ca èki-ca èki ho tunu eele si. èle ku, heka ta pakaboko isi oka kèna, sèna ka pamaso asa d'ara babesi. '

source_text: another parable jesus put forth to them, and said, the kingdom of heavens is like to a corn of sinapi, which a man took, and sowed in his field.
target_text: èle, ka yesus peka hari, na, ja'a pake hari lii pakasame èci, sèna ka miu me'a tasamia ama lamatua j'aj'i dhèu aae mi dhèu ae-ae. dhèu unu na sèra, mulai nuka sèmi lamusi dhu ana iiki titu kèna, dhu dhèu sèle ètu d'ara oka na.

source_text: which truly is the least of all seeds, but when it hath waxen, it is the most of all worts, and is made a tree; so that the birds of the air come, and dwell in the boughs or the branches thereof.
target_text: masi ka lamusi ne ana iiki d'ai seli, te ngaa ladhe na muri mai, j'aj'i aj'u dhu kapai aae ètu d'ara oka ne. toke manu-bhui tao rèd'a ètu dadana-dadana na.

source_text: another parable jesus spake to them or he spake another parable to them, the kingdom of heavens is like to sourdough, which a woman took, and hid in three measures of meal, till it were all soured.
target_text: yesus peka hari lii pakasame èci, aku nèngu na, dhèu-dhèu unu ama lamatua, èci èèna ka dènge ragi dhu bhèni èci nare, pab'ali dènge tarigu ca sak. hèia roti ne ca'e toke kapai, lula ragi dhu ciki oo'e deo na.

source_text: jesus spake all these things in parables to the people, and he spake not to them without parables,
target_text: yesus aj'a dhèu ae dènge lii lolo rupa-rupa. lii padhai na, aa'i-aa'i se, dhodhoka pake lii pakasame di.

source_text: that it should be fulfilled, that is said by the prophet, saying, i shall open my mouth in parables; i shall tell out hid things or things hid from the making of the world.
target_text: na aj'a sèmi èèna, sèna ka madhutu sèmi lii nèti dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua dhu suri tèke, peka na, pe ja'a aj'a-nori pake lii pakasame. pe ja'a lole j'ara-j'ara dhu dhèu tadèngi rèdhi mèka, karèi nèti lamatua paj'aj'i rai-haha toke d'ai sange ne'e.

source_text: then he left the people, and came into an house; and his disciples came to him, and said, expound to us the parable of the tares, or the darnels, or cockles, of the field.
target_text: èle ka, yesus lèpa èmu tèke eele dhèu ae sèra. hèia ana madhutu na sèra mai manèngi, na, ama! peka ku dènge ji'i sasoa nèti lii pakasame j'u'u deo sa!

source_text: which answered, and said, he that soweth good seed is man's son;
target_text: ka yesus dhaa, na, dhèu dhu ceb'e hini dhu be'a èèna, nuka ja'a, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne.

source_text: the field is the world; but the good seed, these be the sons of the kingdom, but tares, these be evil children, or forsooth darnels, or cockles, these be evil sons or sons of the wicked;
target_text: aa oka èèna, nuka rai-haha ne. hini dhu be'a èèna, nuka dhèu-dhèu dhu j'aj'i le ana-èpu ama lamatua. aa j'u'u sèra, nuka ana pajuu nèti dhèu aae nidhu.

source_text: the enemy that soweth them is the fiend or the devil; and the ripe corn is the ending of the world, the reapers be angels.
target_text: aa dhèu bhelu dhu mai ceb'e lamusi j'u'u, nuka dhèu aae nidhu. aa lod'o puu-g'ètu èèna, nuka d'ai èle rai-haha ne. dhèu sab'a dhu pakaboko isi oka se, nuka ana pajuu ama lamatua nèti sorga.

source_text: therefore as tares, or darnels, or cockles, be gathered together, and be burnt in the fire, so it shall be in the ending of the world.
target_text: ropa d'ai èle rai-haha ne, ra oru rare j'u'u se ho tunu pakèpu si.

source_text: man's son shall send his angels, and they shall gather from his realm all causes of stumbling, and them that do wickedness;
target_text: te ja'a, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne, bèli-camèd'a pua ana pajuu nèti sorga mai. rèngu èèna na pakaboko dhèu-dhèu dhu pusi-pahae boe madhutu paredha ama lamatua. aa rèngu oru rare kahèi dhèu-dhèu dhu dadugu-rariu dhèu leo, sèna ka baku madhutu paredha lamatua.

source_text: and they shall send them into the chimney of fire; there shall be weeping, and beating together of teeth.
target_text: èèna na ra core dhèu bhelu-katub'a aa'i-aa'i se asa d'ara ai naraka, nuka sèmi j'u'u dhu ai na'e pakèpu si. ètu nèi, dhèu se rasa j'èra titu kèna, aa tangi d'ara ma'ète mae-mae loe boe ciki sa.

source_text: then just men shall shine as the sun, in the realm of their father. he that hath ears of hearing, hear he.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu dhu mamuri mola madhutu dad'èi ama lamatua, rèngu pea taruu dènge ama dhèu aae ra ètu sorga. ètu nèi, dhèu se ha'a-ha'a, hèti-hèti, nuka sèmi madha lod'o. de dhèu dhu neo tadhe mèu ja'a, pasa dhilu paie-iie!

source_text: the kingdom of heavens is like to treasure hid in a field, which a man that findeth, hideth; and for joy of it he goeth, and selleth all things that he hath, and buyeth that field.
target_text: yesus tabha hari lii pakasame èci, aku nèngu na, dhèu dhu neo tadhe mèu ama lamatua nèd'u paredha, rèngu nuka sèmi dhèu dhu neo abhu mèdha kab'ua aae, dhu dhèu huni tèke ètu d'ara rai cakasib'i. ka dhèu ne la'e kèi, hèia na abhu mèdha ne, nèti èèna ka na karej'e-karae. èle èèna ka, na dhènu hari mèdha deo na. hèia na lèpa hari lai-lai, la'e pahia aa'i mèdha-panyau na. ka la'e hèli nare rai ne, sèna ka na unu mèdha dhu kab'ua aae deo na.

source_text: again the kingdom of heavens is like to a merchant, that seeketh good margarites or good pearls;
target_text: yesus tuhu hari lii pakasame, peka na, dhèu dhu neo tadhe mèu ama lamatua nèd'u paredha, èci èèna kahèi dènge dhèu d'aga ca dhèu dhu d'ara na neo abhu mutiara dhu kab'ua aae titu kèna. èle ka, na patangi-tenge mutiara ho neo hèli.

source_text: but when he hath found one precious margarite, he went, and sold all things that he had, and bought it.
target_text: ropa na rage mutiara cue dhu be'a titu kèna, hèia na lèpa lai-lai, sèna ka pahia aa'i mèdha-panyau na. hèia la'e tihe mutiara ne, sèna ka j'aj'i mi unu na.

source_text: again the kingdom of heavens is like to a net cast into the sea, and that gathereth together of all kinds of fishes;
target_text: yesus peka hari, na, paredha ama lamatua, nuka sèmi pèku èci dhu dhèu sab'a dhasi lasi lolo ètu d'ara dano. ka pèku ne lèke rupa-rupa i'a.

source_text: which when it was full, they drew it up, and sat by the brink, and chose the good into their vessels, but the evil they cast out.
target_text: ropa pèku ne pènu dènge i'a, dhèu pèku se ded'e rèti asa dedha nebhe. hèia ra madhèdi kabhili i'a nèti pèku ne. i'a dhu be'a, ra tao asa d'ara kalera. te ngaa i'a dhu karehe, ra core eele.

source_text: so it shall be in the end of the world. angels shall go out, and shall separate evil men from the middle or the midst of just men.
target_text: èci èèna ka, ladhe d'ai lod'o èle rai-haha ne. èèna na ana pajuu lamatua mai nèti sorga, sèna ka hag'e eele dhèu dhu d'ara mola nèti dhèu bhelu-katub'a.

source_text: and they shall send them into the chimney of fire; there shall be weeping, and grinding of teeth.
target_text: dhèu dhu bhelu-katub'a aa'i-aa'i ra, core si asa d'ara ai naraka. ètu nèi, rèngu heka re'a j'aj'èra, aa loe boe tangi roma iisi.

source_text: have ye understood all these things? they say to him, yea.
target_text: ropa padhai lii nare, hèia yesus karèi ra, aku nèngu na, miu me'a aa'i ngaa dhu ja'a peka-padhai se, do? ra dhaa peka na, nge'a, ama!

source_text: he saith to them, therefore every wise man of the law taught in the kingdom of heavens, is like to an husbandman, that bringeth forth of his treasure new things and old.
target_text: hèia yesus b'ala, peka na, be'a! te mese agama aa'i-aa'i dhu re'a tare'a-re'a lii holo-nori lamatua dhu suri tèke karèi nèti uru èèna, ka ra kèpe pa'èra a'aj'a ja'a, na, rèngu ca ropa dènge lamatua èmu dhu d'èi bhoke gud'a na, ho pad'elo mèdha-panyau na dhu dhui, dènge mèdha-panyau na dhu hiu.

source_text: and it was done, when jesus had ended these parables, he passed from thence.
target_text: ropa yesus aj'a nare dhèu ae sèra, pake lii pakasame, hèia la'e, tèke eele era èèna,

source_text: and he came into his country, and taught them in their synagogues, so that they wondered, and said, from whence this wisdom and virtues came to this? or to him?
target_text: ho lèpa asa rae na. d'ai nèi, maso la'e asa d'ara èmu sabaj'a, ho aj'a-nori dhèu. dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu tadèngi lii padhai na malaa-maloha. ka ra papeka, aku rèngu na, ira ii! dhèu ne d'èlu-mèu titu kèna, nga! na sakola ètu mia ne? tasamia ka na bisa tao tadha malaa se'e?

source_text: whether this is not the son of a carpenter? whether his mother be not said mary? and his brethren, james, and joseph, and simon, and judas?
target_text: nèngu ne dhoka ana nèti ca dhèu tuka aj'u di. èdhi patadha be'a dènge ina na maria; aa dènge ari na aa'i-aa'i, nuka yakobis, yusuf, yudas dènge simon.

source_text: and his sisters, whether they all be not among us? from whence then all these things come or came to this? or to him?
target_text: èdhi tadhe ana hèni na kahèi, te èdhi pea ètu d'ara rae cue! de na abhu mamèu na nèti mia? aa na abhu koasa kapai ne nèti cee hari?

source_text: and so they were offended in him. but jesus said to them, a prophet is not without honour, but in his own country, and in his own house.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, dhèu se kacèki, toke ra ro'o heka nanene lii padhai na. te ngaa yesus peka dènge ra, aku nèngu na, mema tare'a! dhèu d'èi risi pakab'ua dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua dhu mai nèti era leo, te ngaa ra pakab'ua boe dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua dhu mai nèti rae rèngu unu ra.

source_text: and he did not there many virtues, for the unbelief of them.
target_text: lula d'ara ra adhu, toke ra parcaya boe yesus, nèti èèna ka na tao tadha malaa ae boe ètu d'ara rae na.

source_text: in that time herod tetrarch, that is, prince of the fourth part, heard the fame of jesus;
target_text: tèu èèna, dhèu aae herodes nèd'u paredha ètu propensi galilea. nèngu ne dhu tadèngi le kahèi rupa-rupa j'ara lula-nèti yesus.

source_text: and said to his children, this is john baptist, he is risen from death, and therefore virtues work in him.
target_text: na peka dènge dhèu sab'a na sèra, aku nèngu na, ele boe yesus ne, nuka yohanis tuka sarani, dhu ca hari ni ja'a pua dhèu poro rare kètu na. limuri ne, na mamuri hari le! nèti èèna ka, na abhu koasa, tao tadha-tadha malaa sèra.

source_text: for herod had holden or held john, and bound him, and putted him in prison for herodias, the wife of his brother.
target_text: dhèu aae herodes peka sèmi èèna, lula uru èèna nèngu dhu tao lii langu dènge yohanis, toke na kèpe yohanis aa pamaso asa d'ara bèdho. j'aj'aj'i lii langu ne, sèmi ne'e ka: dhèu aae herodes leo nare dhèu èmu ari na pelipus, ngara na herodias. aa te ngaa pelipus dènge herodias dhae pa'ia-pa'ela mèka.

source_text: for john said to him, it is not leaveful to thee to have her.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, yohanis kai ne pahari-pahari, peka na, ama dhèu aae, baku paleo èmu dènge dhèu èmu ari mu. te j'ara ne, pamèci boe dènge ad'a èdhi dhèu yahudi!

source_text: and he willing to slay him, dreaded the people; for they had him as a prophet.
target_text: te ngaa herodes dale boe lii kai na, hèia leo nare herodias. madhutu iia-iia na, herodes neo pamadhe yohanis tuka sarani. te ngaa na madha'u dènge dhèu ae sèra, lula ra parcaya na, yohanis ne, ca dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua. nèti èèna ka, na pua dhèu sab'a na pamaso yohanis asa d'ara bèdho.

source_text: but in the day of herod's birth, the daughter of herodias danced in the middle, and pleased herod.
target_text: te ngaa nèbhu-nèbhu, hèia herodes tao pesta hari jadi na. lod'o èèna, ana bhèni nèti bhèni aae herodias la'e roge ètu madha tamu se. na roge be'a titu kèna, toke d'ara herodes karej'e bia.

source_text: wherefore with an oath he promised to give to her, whatever thing she asked of him.
target_text: na roge nare, hèia herodes paroa ne, ka na peka, èu neo manèngi hadia ngaa nèti ja'a, na peka la! te èèna na ja'a hia èu. ja'a leko boe-monya boe. aa ja'a subha dènge kolongara ama lamatua.

source_text: and she before-warned or before admonished of her mother, said, give thou to me here the head of john baptist in a dish.
target_text: ropa na tadèngi dhèu aae peka sèmi èèna, hèia ina na kakèj'i ne. nèti èèna ka, ana ne la'e peka na, ama! ja'a manèngi kètu nèti yohanis tuka sarani. tèke ne mi d'ara dula, ho rèti mai asa ne'e hia ja'a.

source_text: and the king was sorrowful, but for the oath, and for them that sat together at the meat, he commanded to be given.
target_text: ropa tadèngi lii manèngi ana bhèni ne, hèia d'ara herodes roe dènge. te ngaa nèngu bisa boe ère nare hari lii subha na, te tamu aa'i-aa'i dhu tadèngi le. nèti èèna ka, na madhutu dhoka dad'èi ana bhèni ne di.

source_text: and he sent, and beheaded john in the prison.
target_text: ka na paredha dhèu lasi poro rare kètu yohanis ètu d'ara bèdho.

source_text: and his head was brought in a dish, and it was given to the damsel, and she bare it to her mother.
target_text: ropa ra poro rare, hèia ra tèke mi d'ara dula ho rèti lasi hia mi ana bhèni ne. ropa ana bhèni ne sèmi nare dula, hèia nèti asa ina na.

source_text: and his disciples came, and took his body, and buried it; and they came, and told to jesus.
target_text: lod'o ana madhutu yohanis se tadèngi, ka mai rare ngi'u aae na, ho lasi padhane. èle ka, lasi peka dènge yesus j'ara dhu j'aj'i ne.

source_text: and when jesus had heard this thing, he went from thence in a boat, into a desert place beside. and when the people had heard, they followed him on their feet from cities.
target_text: lod'o yesus tadèngi ngaa dhu j'aj'i mi yohanis, hèia nèngu dènge ana-ana madhutu na tèke eele era èèna. hèia ra ca'e koha, ho lasi asa era dhu dhèu pea boe, sèna ka ra ae rare ciki. te ngaa dhèu ae ladhe rèdhi koha yesus si dhu oro-oro re sebhe dano. ka dhèu se mai nèti rae-rae, kako karohe-karohe re dedha rai. nèti èèna ka, dhèu se d'ai uuru nèti yesus si.

source_text: and jesus went out, and saw a great people or a great multitude, and had ruth on them, and he healed the sick men of them.
target_text: ropa na puru nèti dedha koha, hèia nèdhi dhèu ae-ae dhu mate le nèngu. ka na rasa kasia mi rèngu. hèia na puri-pa'èle papèd'a-tarègu ra.

source_text: but when eventide was come, his disciples came to him, and said, the place is desert, and the time is now passed; let the people go into towns, to buy them meat.
target_text: d'ai lod'o nihia, hèia ana madhutu na, peka dènge ne, ama! hua iia ama pua dhèu se, sèna ka lasi hèli nganga'a ètu rae-rae dhu padètu ètu se'e. te lod'o nihia le! ètu ne'e nganga'a aad'o.

source_text: jesus said to them, they have not need or no need to go; give ye them somewhat to eat.
target_text: te ngaa yesus b'ala si, peka na, baku! miu ka dhu panga'a si.

source_text: they answered, we have not here, but five loaves and two fishes.
target_text: te ngaa ra dhaa, aku rèngu na, ira ee, ama! ji'i se dènge boe ngaa-ngaa, ho panga'a dhèu ae-ae sèmi ne'e ne. ji'i tao tasamia? te abhu dhoka roti lèmi bua di, aa i'a dua ngi'u di!

source_text: and he said to them, bring ye them hither to me.
target_text: te ngaa yesus lii, peka na, oo! be'a kèna. mèti ku mai!

source_text: and when he had commanded the people to sit to the meat on the hay, he took five loaves and two fishes, and he beheld into heaven, and blessed, and brake, and gave loaves to his disciples; and the disciples gave to the people.
target_text: ka na pua dhèu se aa'i-aa'i ra madhèdi kaboko ètu dedha j'u'u. èle èèna ka, yesus nare roti lèmi bua dènge i'a dua ngi'u sèra. hèia na ladhe asa dedha, ho manèngi makasi mi ama lamatua. èle ka, na pamae roti se, hèia j'ole asa ana madhutu na, sèna ka ra papala mi dhèu se aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: and all ate, and were fulfilled or filled. and they took the remnants of broken gobbets, twelve coffins full.
target_text: ka dhèu se ra'a toke bècu. ra'a rara, hèia ana madhutu se pakaboko rare dhu ata, pènu canguru dua soe.

source_text: and the number of men that ate was five thousand of men, without women and little children.
target_text: dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu ra'a se, dhèu mone pe d'ai lèmi riho sa, iga mèka dhèu bhèni dènge ana iiki.

source_text: and anon jesus compelled the disciples to go up into a boat, and to go before him over the sea, while he let go the people.
target_text: ropa dhèu aa'i-aa'i se ra'a rare, hèia yesus pua ana madhutu na ca'e koha, sèna ka lasi uru asa cabèka dano. te ngaa nèngu ètu èèna era, sena ka pua dhèu se lèpa.

source_text: and when the people was let go, he went up alone into an hill to pray. but when the evening was come, he was there alone.
target_text: ropa rèngu lèpa aa'i mèu-mèu, hèia yesus ca'e la'e asa ledhe èci, ho sabaj'a. toke mèda, nèngu mesa na ètu èèna era.

source_text: and the boat in the middle of the sea was shogged or thrown with waves, for the wind was contrary to them.
target_text: lod'o èèna, koha ana madhutu na d'ai le talora aae dano. te ngaa rèngu tuku d'ai madhe, lula ngèlu nèti madha, aa naha kapai tatèb'e koha ra.

source_text: but in the fourth waking of the night, he came to them walking on the sea.
target_text: oe d'ai mèu, hèia yesus la'e madhutu si. te ngaa nèngu dhu kako re dedha èi.

source_text: and they, seeing him walking on the sea, were disturbed or distroubled, and said, that it is a phantom; and for dread they cried.
target_text: ropa ladhe rèdhi, ana madhutu se cag'ag'a, hèia ra padhai dènge lii madha'u, aku rèngu na, heeh! nidhu kèna!

source_text: and anon jesus spake to them, and said, have ye trust, i am; do not ye dread.
target_text: te ngaa yesus lii dènge ra, peka na, miu baku madha'u! te ja'a ne, yesus! mau-mau la!

source_text: and peter answered, and said, lord, if thou art, command me to come to thee on the waters.
target_text: ropa ra tadèngi lii ne'e, hèia petrus peka na, ladhe ama kèna, pua la ja'a kako re dedha èi ne, dhiu asa ama.

source_text: and he said, come thou. and peter went down from the boat, and walked on the waters to come to jesus.
target_text: ka yesus dhaa peka na, mai ka! hèia petrus puru nèti dedha koha, la'e re dedha èi, asa yesus.

source_text: but he saw the wind strong, and was afeared; and when he began to drench or drown, he cried, and said, lord, make me safe.
target_text: te ngaa ropa petrus rasa na ngèlu aae, hèia na madha'u bia. ka na mulai cène, hèia na pa'oo, aku nèngu na, ira oo, ama, ee! soru ku ja'a la!

source_text: and anon jesus held forth his hand, and took peter, or caught him, and said to him, thou of little faith, why hast thou doubted?
target_text: yesus j'ole dènge ka kacui-aai na, ka kèpe nare petrus. hèia yesus padhai lii, aku nèngu na, petrus, ee! nga tao ka d'ara èu kajari? èu parcaya èra boe mi ja'a, do?

source_text: and when he had gone up into the boat, the wind ceased.
target_text: ka dua ra ca'e lasi asa dedha koha, hèia ngèlu mau dènge.

source_text: and they, that were in the boat, came, and worshipped him, and said, verily, thou art god's son.
target_text: ropa rèdhi sèmi èèna, ana madhutu na koa-kio padedha-dedha ne, peka na, ira ii! ama ne, mema tare'a-re'a ana ama lamatua!

source_text: and when they had passed over the sea, they came into the land of gennesaret.
target_text: ropa rèngu d'ai cabèka dano, hèia ra puru lasi asa dedha nebhe nèti rae genesaret.

source_text: and when men of that place had known him, they sent into all that country; and they brought to him all that had sicknesses or all having evil.
target_text: lod'o ra puru èèna, dhèu ae dhu tadhe le. hèia dhèu pa'oo, peka na, wee! yesus mai le! ra rai lasi peka palème, hèia dhèu rèti dhèu pèd'a aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: and they prayed him, that they should touch the hem of his clothing; and whoever touched were made safe.

target_text: te ngaa lii padhai petrus ne, madhutu boe dad'èi lamatua. nèti èèna ka, yesus kabib'a, ka jèke ne, peka na, heh! pakaj'èu nèti ne'e! lii padhai èèna nèti dhèu aae nidhu! èu baku bhabhae ja'a! èu ne dhodhoka pangee madhutu dad'èi dhèu rai-haha di, te ngaa madhutu boe dad'èi ama lamatua!

source_text: then jesus said to his disciples, if any man will come after me, deny he himself, and take his cross, and pursue me;
target_text: èle èèna ka, hèia yesus aj'a ana madhutu na sèra, aku nèngu na, dhèu dhu neo madhutu ja'a, nèngu hud'i taha taruu ku bèli-bèli! nèngu hud'i pa'uru ku dad'èi ama lamatua, aa pabhèlu eele dad'èi nèngu unu na. masi ka dhèu neo pamadhe ne, nèngu hud'i madhutu ja'a taruu, sama sèmi dhèu pasae aj'u palolo-palèbha na, la'e asa era mamadhe na.

source_text: for he that will make his life safe, shall lose it; and he that shall lose his life for me, shall find it.
target_text: te dhèu dhu sadia madhe lula na madhutu ja'a, bèli-camèd'a nèngu abhu mamuri taruu dènge ama lamatua. te ngaa dhèu dhu d'èi dhoka mamuri hia ngi'u aae na di, èèna na mamuri nèngu ele iie d'ara!

source_text: for what profiteth it to a man or what profiteth to a man, if he win all the world, and suffer impairing of his soul? or what exchanging shall a man give for his soul?
target_text: nanene paie-iie! ladhe èu abhu aa'i isi rai-haha ne, te ngaa ladhe lamatua core eele èu, a'oto na ètu mia? masi ka èu pasae mèti aa'i isi rai-haha ne, èu bisa boe pasilu dènge samanga èu!

source_text: for man's son shall come in the glory of his father, with his angels, and then he shall yield to every man after his works.
target_text: ja'a peka mema dènge miu j'ara aa'i-aa'i ra, lula ja'a ne, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a. bèli-camèd'a ja'a mai hari dènge dadedha nèti ama ku, palere-lere dènge ana pajuu na nèti sorga. lod'o èèna, pe ja'a b'ala mi ca dhèu-ca dhèu madhutu tatao ra.

source_text: truly i say to you, there be some of them that stand here, which shall not taste death, till they see man's son coming in his kingdom.
target_text: sanèd'e paie! nèti miu aa'i-aa'i se, bèli-camèd'a abhu cahag'e dhu madhe boe, toke ra rèdhi ja'a, nuka dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne, j'aj'i dhèu aae dhu kèd'u paredha.

source_text: and after six days jesus took peter, and james, and john, his brother, and led them aside into an high hill,
target_text: èle èna lod'o, ka yesus paroa petrus, yakobis dènge ari na yohanis, sèna ka lasi asa ledhe dhu dedha èci, ho pea mesa ra ètu nèi.

source_text: and was transfigured, or turned, into another likeness before them. and his face shone as the sun; and his clothes were made white as snow.
target_text: d'ai nèi, ra ladhe na, rupa yesus leko-leo. rèhu na kaha'a nuka sèmi madha lod'o, aa mèdha-papake na j'aj'i pudhi kale'e.

source_text: and lo! moses and elijah appeared to them, and spake with him.
target_text: kaca'a la, rèngu ladhe rèdhi yesus dhu padhai lii dènge musa dènge elia.

source_text: and peter answered, and said to jesus, lord, it is good us to be here. if thou wilt, make we here three tabernacles; to thee one, to moses one, and one to elijah.
target_text: hèia petrus bingu, ka na padhai lii leli, aku nèngu na, ama! ji'i karej'e titu kèna ètu era ne'e ne! de be'a risi ji'i patitu paleo tèlu bua. cue hia ama, cue hia musa, aa cue hari hia elia.

source_text: yet while he spake, lo! a bright cloud overshadowed them; and lo! a voice out of the cloud, that said, this is my dearworthy son, in whom i have well pleased to me; hear ye him.
target_text: lod'o petrus padhai lii sèmi èèna era, cag'ag'a laa, ra'i-liru puru mai sarimu nare rèngu. hèia rèngu malaa-maloha tadèngi lii èci dhu kalua nèti d'ara ra'i-liru ne, peka na, nanene! yesus ne, ana pasue ja'a. nèngu ne'e ka dhu pakarej'e taruu d'ara ja'a. nanene ne paie-iie!

source_text: and the disciples heard, and felled down on their faces, and dreaded greatly.
target_text: ropa tadèngi lii ne, hèia ana madhutu na madha'u titu kèna, ka ra bèbha sagèb'a ètu rai.

source_text: and jesus came, and touched them, and said to them, rise up, and do not ye dread.
target_text: te ngaa yesus mai gai si, ka na peka na, mi kèd'i ka, baku madha'u!

source_text: and they lifted up their eyes, and saw no man, but jesus alone.
target_text: ka ana madhutu se boti kètu ra, te ngaa ra ladhe rèdhi heka dhèu èci sa ètu era èèna, dhoka yesus di.

source_text: and as they came down of the hill or down from the mountain, jesus commanded to them, and said, say ye to no man the vision, till man's son rise again from death.
target_text: èle ka, ra puru nèti ledhe ne. hèia yesus kai si, aku nèngu na, ngaa dhu heka ladhe mèdhi deo na, mage peka dènge dhèu èci sa kahèi! te ja'a dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne, hud'i madhe uuru ku. èle èèna, ladhe ja'a mamuri hari, heka miu lole dènge dhèu kèna.

source_text: and his disciples asked him, and said, what then say the scribes, that it behooveth that elijah come first?
target_text: hèia ra karèi ne, aku rèngu na, ama ne mema kristus, te ngaa elia ètu mia? te mese agama se aj'a, peka na, elia hud'i mai uuru ku, èle èèna, heka kristus mai kèna. te ngaa madhutu ama, tasamia?

source_text: he answered, and said to them, elijah shall come, and he shall restore all things.
target_text: ka yesus dhaa, aku nèngu na, mema lèke. elia hud'i mai uuru ku, ho bhoke j'ara hia kristus.

source_text: and i say to you, that elijah is now come, and they knew him not, but they did in him whatever things they would; and so man's son shall suffer of them.
target_text: nanene paie! elia mai le, te ngaa dhèu tadhe boe ne. rèngu paj'èra ne, madhutu dad'èi ra. sèmi èèna kahèi, bèli-camèd'a rèngu paj'èra ja'a, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne.

source_text: then the disciples understood, that he said to them of john the baptist.
target_text: ropa ra tadèngi rare, ana madhutu na heka re'a, na, elia dhu yesus peka ne, nuka yohanis tuka sarani.

source_text: and when he came to the people, a man came to him, and felled down on his knees before him, and said,
target_text: èle ka, ropa rèngu lèpa, paraga dènge dhèu ae dhu mate le. hèia ama ca dhèu mai patitu kètu urutuu, ka na manèngi yesus,

source_text: lord, have mercy on my son; for he is lunatic, and suffereth evil, for oft times he falleth into the fire, and oft times into the water.
target_text: na peka, ama! sue ku ana ja'a la! te nèngu dhu huj'u kahib'i, aa na j'èra titu kèna. ladhe èi papèd'a ne cèu, na bèbhe sa d'ara èi, do d'ara ai. ama sue ku la!

source_text: and i brought him to thy disciples, and they might not heal him.
target_text: ana ne, ja'a kèti le asa ana-ana madhutu ama ku, te ngaa ra tao rare boe ne.

source_text: jesus answered, and said, a! thou generation unbelieveful, or out of the faith, and wayward; how long shall i be with you? how long shall i suffer you? bring ye him hither to me.
target_text: ropa na tadèngi sèmi èèna, hèia yesus jèke ana madhutu na sèra, aku nèngu na, heh! miu se seli-kolane! ja'a aj'a le miu pahari-pahari, te ngaa miu me'a mèu boe. aa miu parcaya boe ja'a dènge d'ara kateme. ja'a hud'i mate hari ku miu, d'ai pèri lod'o? mèti ana èèna mai!

source_text: and jesus blamed him, and the devil went out from him; and the child was healed from that hour.
target_text: hèia, rèti ana ne, ka yesus babège eele nidhu nèti ana ne'e. ka nidhu rai tèke eele ne, hèia ana ne èle dènge ka.

source_text: then the disciples came to jesus privily, and said to him, why might not we cast him out?
target_text: èle èèna ka, ropa yesus mesa na dènge ana madhutu sèra, ka ra karèi ne, peka na, ama! nga tao ka ji'i bisa boe babège ngare nidhu deo na?

source_text: jesus saith to them, for your unbelief. truly i say to you, if ye have faith, as a corn of sinapi, ye shall say to this hill, pass thou from hence, and it shall pass; and nothing shall be impossible to you;
target_text: ka yesus dhaa, na, miu babège mere boe, lula miu parcaya boe dènge d'ara kateme. sanèd'e! ladhe miu parcaya ja'a tare'a-re'a, masi ka ciki oo'e èèna ka sama sèmi lamusi ana iiki-iiki èci, miu bisa paredha ledhe èci, peka na, ‘hee ledhe, hari sa nèi, lamu! ' tatu na hari kahèi. de miu bisa tao ngaa èèna ka, sad'i parcaya dènge d'ara kateme.

source_text: but this kind is not cast out, but by prayer and fasting.
target_text: te ngaa sanèd'e! nidhu sèmi se'e se, mema bhelu titu kèna. ladhe miu sabaj'a boe aa puasa boe, ho manèngi mi ama lamatua, na, miu babège mere boe nidhu sèmi sèra.

source_text: and whiles they were abiding together in galilee, jesus said to them, man's son shall be betrayed into the hands of men;
target_text: ca lod'o, yesus dènge ana madhutu na dhu pakaboko ètu propensi galilea. na peka dènge rèngu, na, nèbhu heka, te ra neo pahie ja'a asa dhèu leo rai kara.

source_text: and they shall slay him, and the third day he shall rise again to life. and they were made full sorry or were sorrowful greatly.
target_text: hèia ra pamadhe ja'a, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne. mema tare'a ja'a madhe, te ngaa asa camèd'a ja'a mamuri hari. ropa ana madhutu na sèra tadèngi lii deo na, hèia d'ara ra susa titu kèna.

source_text: and when they came to capernaum, they that took tribute, came to peter, and said to him, your master payeth not tribute?
target_text: lod'o yesus dènge ana madhutu na lasi asa rae kapernaum, hèia dhèu roro bea mai paraga dènge petrus, ka ra karèi ne, na, mese miu b'ae bea èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i do, aad'o?

source_text: and he said, yes. and when he was come into the house, jesus came before him, and said, simon, what seemeth to thee? kings of the earth, of whom take they tribute? of their sons, either of aliens?
target_text: hèia petrus dhaa, na b'ae! ropa petrus lepa, ka yesus karèi dènge ka, aku nèngu na, simon, èu pangee ku la! dhèu aae-dhèu aae ètu rai-haha ne abhu bea nèti cee? nèti ana matana ra, do, nèti dhèu leo?

source_text: and he said, of aliens. jesus said to him, then sons be free.
target_text: petrus dhaa, na, nèti dhèu leo! ka yesus tuhu lii padhai na, peka na, ladhe sèmi èèna, ana dhèu aae di dhu b'ae boe, si?

source_text: but that we offend them not, go thou to the sea, and cast an hook, and take that fish that first cometh up; and, when his mouth is opened, thou shalt find a stater, that is, a certain of money; take it, and give to them for thee and for me.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi dènge bea èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. te ngaa hud'i laa, sèna ka dhèu roro bea se baku nasa dènge èdhi. de be'a risi lamu madulu i'a asa d'ara dano. i'a dhu èu abhu uuru èèna, èu bhoke hèb'a na. pe èu abhu doi iia cue. more, ho b'ae bea èdhi dua ti. te doi ne, d'ai le bea èdhi dua ti.

source_text: in that hour the disciples came to jesus, and said, who, guessest thou, is the greater in the kingdom of heavens?
target_text: lod'o èèna, ana madhutu yesus lasi karèi ne, peka na, ama! nèti dhèu-dhèu unu ama lamatua, cee ka dhu kapai risi?

source_text: and jesus called a little child, and put him in the middle or in the midst of them;
target_text: hèia yesus paroa nare ana iiki èci, mai patitu asa talora aae rèngu.

source_text: and said, i say truth to you or truly i say to you, but ye be turned, and be made as little children, ye shall not enter into the kingdom of heavens.
target_text: ka na peka dènge ra, nanene paie-iie! dhèu dhu neo j'aj'i dhèu unu lamatua, rèngu hud'i ub'a ngangee ra, ho j'aj'i sama sèmi ana iiki dhu ne'a boe padedha iisi.

source_text: therefore whoever meeketh him-self as this little child, he is greater in the kingdom of heavens.
target_text: lula dhèu dhu ne'a pahaha iisi sama sèmi ana iiki ne, nèngu èèna ka dhu kapai risi ètu madha ama lamatua.

source_text: and he that receiveth one such little child in my name, receiveth me.
target_text: aa dhèu dhu sèmi nare dhèu haha nuka sèmi ana iiki ne, lula na parcaya ja'a, na, nèngu sèmi nare le ja'a ne.

source_text: but whoso causeth to stumble one of these small or these little, that believe in me, it speedeth to him, that a millstone of asses be hanged in his neck, and he be drenched or drowned in the deepness of the sea.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus padhai lii hari, peka na, ladhe abhu dhèu dhu tao ana iiki sèna ka madhutu j'ara dhu sale, toke ana ne parcaya heka ja'a, na, mata unu na! be'a risi dhèu èki hadhu aae cue, mi ladha goro na, ho pacène ne asa d'ara dhasi marèma.

source_text: woe to the world, for causes of stumbling; for it is needed, that causes of stumbling come; nevertheless woe to that man by whom a cause of stumbling cometh.
target_text: rai-haha ne mema era dhu pènu dènge dhudhu-sete, lula abhu j'ara ae dhu pamanahu dhèu asa d'ara sasala-sasigo. te ngaa dhèu dhu dui babia risi, nuka dhèu dhu tenge-tenge j'ara ho soro dhèu asa d'ara sasala.

source_text: and if thine hand or thy foot cause thee to stumble, cut it off, and cast it away from thee. it is better to thee to enter in to life feeble, either crooked, than having twain hands or two feet to be sent into everlasting fire.
target_text: ladhe èu tao sala, pake kacui-aai èu, do, haga èu, na, poro eele ne! te be'a risi èu maso asa d'ara sorga dènge ai cabèka, do, haga calaa. mage dhoka ra core èu asa d'ara ai naraka, dènge ai do haga dhu tesa.

source_text: and if thine eye cause thee to stumble, pull it out, and cast it away from thee. it is better to thee, with one eye to enter into life, than having twain eyes to be sent into the fire of hell or into hellfire.
target_text: ladhe èu tao sala, pake musi madha èu, na, cèru eele ne! te be'a risi èu maso asa d'ara sorga dènge musi madha cabèka. mage dhoka ra core èu asa d'ara ai naraka, dènge musi madha dhu tesa.

source_text: see ye, that ye despise not one of these little. for i say to you or truly i say to you, that the angels of them in heavens see evermore the face of my father that is in heavens.
target_text: ka yesus tuhu hari lii na, aku nèngu na, sanèd'e, ee! baku mi pahaha ana iiki sèmi se'e se. te abhu ana pajuu ama lamatua nèti sorga dhu madhenga si. aa ana pajuu se dhu lasi taruu, peka dènge ama lamatua ngaa-ngaa dhu j'aj'i mi ana se.

source_text: for man's son came to save that thing that perished. what seemeth to you? if there were to a man an hundred sheep, and one of them hath erred, whether he shall not leave ninety and nine in desert or in the hills, and shall go to seek that that erred? and if it fall that he find it, truly i say to you, that he shall have joy thereof or for he shall joy thereon, more than on ninety and nine that erred not.
target_text: mi pangee paie-iie, te ja'a hia lii pakasame èci sèmi ne'e ka: abhu dhèu èci dhu kahib'i-kalèbho na, cangasu ngi'u. ca lod'o, ci'u nèti kahib'i-kalèbho se, kako sala j'ara. madhutu ngangee miu, dhèu madhenga ne tao tasamia? tatu na tèke eele ceo nguru ceo ngi'u sèra ètu ledhe, ho la'e tenge ci'u dhu ele ne. ladhe na abhu hari, tatu na karej'e, ropa na ladhe nèdhi ci'u ne, risi nèti kahib'i-kalèbho na ceo nguru ceo ngi'u dhu ele boe sèra. ja'a, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne, mai ho hia mamuri mi dhèu dhu kako sale nèti j'ara dhu mola.

source_text: so it is not the will of your father that is in heavens or in heaven, that one of these little perish.
target_text: te, masi ka ana iiki ca dhèu di dhu kako sala j'ara, te ngaa ama ku ètu sorga d'èi boe kahèi.

source_text: but if thy brother sinneth against thee, go thou, and reprove him, betwixt thee and him alone; if he heareth thee, thou hast won thy brother.
target_text: yesus lii hari, aku nèngu na, ladhe a'ari èu dhèu parcaya tao sale mi èu, na, èu mesa mu lamu paraga dènge ne. ladhe miu dua mi mesa mi, heka èu peka sasala nèngu kèna. ladhe na sèmi nare lii padhai èu, na, miu dua mi pabe'a hari le kèna.

source_text: and if he heareth thee not, take with thee one or twain that every word stand in the mouth of twain or three witnesses.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe no'o boe sèmi nare lii padhai èu, lamu paroa more angalai mu ca dhèu do dua dhèu, ho lami paraga dènge ne, sèna ka padhai lii hari. te ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua dhu suri tèke, peka na, ‘ètu d'ara lii langu èci, hud'i abhu ku dua-tèlu sakasii dhu lii èci, heka sèmi rare lii galaa ra. '

source_text: and if he heareth not them, say thou to the church. but if he heareth not the church, be he as a heathen and a publican to thee.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe no'o boe nanene lii miu, lami lole dènge juma'at. aa ladhe na d'èi boe nanene lii juma'at kahèi, tao ne nuka sèmi ca dhèu dhu tadhe boe lamatua. ladhe aad'o na, cap ne nuka sèmi dhèu bhelu, conto sèmi dhèu roro bea sèra.

source_text: i say to you truly, whatever things ye bind on earth, those shall be bound also in heaven; and whatever things ye unbind on earth, those shall be unbound also in heaven.
target_text: sanèd'e paie-iie lii padhai ja'a ne! ngaa dhu miu oro ètu rai-haha ne, èèna ka dhu lamatua oro le ètu sorga. aa ngaa dhu miu hia isin ètu rai-haha ne, èèna ka lamatua hia le isin ètu sorga kahèi.

source_text: again i say to you, that if twain of you consent on earth, of everything whatever they ask, it shall be done to them of my father that is in heavens.
target_text: aa ja'a peka hari, na, ladhe abhu dhèu dua dhu sabaj'a dènge d'ara èci, pe ama ku ètu sorga hia ngaa dhu ra manèngi.

source_text: for where twain or three be gathered in my name, there i am in the middle of them. for where two or three be gathered in my name, there i am in the midst of them.
target_text: te, ladhe abhu dua, do tèlu dhèu, pakaboko sabaj'a sama-sama, lula rèngu dhèu ja'a, na, ja'a ètu talora aae rèngu kahèi.

source_text: then peter came to him, and said, lord, how oft shall my brother sin against me, and i shall forgive him? whether till seven times?
target_text: èle èèna, ka petrus karèi yesus, aku nèngu na, ama, ja'a neo karèi ciki. ladhe a'ari ja'a tao sale pahari-pahari mi ja'a, èèna na d'ai pèri hari ja'a hud'i hia ne abho? d'ai pidhu hari, do?

source_text: jesus saith to him, i say not to thee, till seven times; but till or to seventy times seven times.
target_text: hèia yesus dhaa, peka na, aad'o! èu hud'i abho ne pidhu kali pidhu nguru hari, toke èu ige more heka.

source_text: therefore the kingdom of heavens is likened to a king that would reckon with his servants.
target_text: miu hud'i tao ku sèmi èèna, lula ama lamatua nuka sèmi dhèu aae dhu ige kèlu na ètu pegawi na.

source_text: and when he began to reckon, one that owed to him ten thousand talents or bezants, was brought to him.
target_text: ropa na ige nare, hèia na pua dhèu lasi paroa pegawi dhu pakèlu toke riho kehi.

source_text: and when he had not whereof to yield, his lord commanded him to be sold, and his wife, and children, and all things that he had, and to be paid.
target_text: te ngaa pegawi ne b'ae nare boe kèlu na. ka dhèu aae paredha, peka na, ‘lami pahie eele dhèu ne dènge bhèni-ana niki na aa'i-aa'i, sèna ka ra j'aj'i ènu. aa mèdha-panyau na, pahie aa'i kahèi, ho b'ae kèlu-g'ètu na. '

source_text: but that servant felled down, and prayed him, and said, have patience in me, and i shall yield to thee all things.
target_text: ropa pegawi ne tadèngi nare, hèia na pabèbha iisi, ho patitu kètu urutuu ètu madha dhèu aae, ka pamako, aku nèngu na, ‘ira ee! ama dhèu aae hia ja'a tebho d'ai ciki sa! sèna ka ja'a b'ae kèlu ja'a aa'i-aa'i ra. '

source_text: and the lord had mercy on that servant, and suffered him to go or delivered him, and forgave him the debt.
target_text: ropa tadèngi, hèia dhèu aae rasa kasia dènge ne. ka dhèu aae pabhèlu eele aa'i mèu-mèu kèlu na, ka pua na lèpa.

source_text: but that servant went out, and found one of his even-servants, that owed him an hundred pence; and he held him, and strangled him, and said, yield that that thou owest.
target_text: te ngaa ropa na d'ai li'u, hèia pegawi ne paraga dènge angalai na dhu pakèlu nèngu doi ciki di. ka na kèpe angalai ne, hèia pacèli ladha goro na, aa na jèke ne, aku nèngu na, ‘weh! b'ae ka d'ara lai-lai ne kèlu èu sèra! '

source_text: and his even-servant fell down, and prayed him, and said, have patience in me, and i shall requite all things to thee.
target_text: ropa angalai na tadèngi, hèia na patitu kètu urutuu, ka pamako ne, peka na, ‘ira ee! angalai, ee! hia ku ja'a tebho d'ai ciki sa! pe ja'a b'ae kèlu ja'a sèra! '

source_text: but he would not; but went out, and put or sent him into prison, till he paid all the debt.
target_text: te ngaa pegawi ne peka na, ‘bisa boe! ja'a mate heka panèbhu. èu b'ae dènge ka lod'o doe ne'e kahèi! ' èle ka, la'e pamaso angalai na asa d'ara bèdho, toke na b'ae aa'i kèlu na.
