source_text: and his disciples said to him, thou seest the people thrusting or pressing thee, and sayest, who touched me?
target_text: ka ana madhutu na dhaa, aku rèngu na, ama, ladhe ku laa. dhèu ae paseti sèmi ne'e. nga tao ka ama karèi, peka na, ‘cee ka dhu gai kodho ja'a? '

source_text: and jesus looked about to see her that had done this thing.
target_text: te ngaa yesus ladhe pala-lème, neo ne'a cee ka dhu gai lèke sebhe kodho na.

source_text: and the woman dreaded, and quaked, witting that it was done in her, and came, and felled down before him, and said to him all the truth. forsooth the woman dreading, and trembling, knowing that it was done in her, came, and fell down before him, and said to him all the truth.
target_text: ropa yesus karèi sèmi èèna, hèia bhèni èèna madha'u bia. èle èèna ka, na mai patitu kètu urutuu ètu madha yesus, ka na mangaku, ama! ja'a ka dhu gai lèke sebhe kodho ama ku deo na.

source_text: and jesus said to her, daughter, thy faith hath made thee safe; go in peace, and be thou whole of thy sickness.
target_text: hèia yesus peka mi bhèni ne, aku nèngu na, lula èu parcaya ja'a dènge d'ara kateme, nèti èèna ka, èu èle le. lamu ka èmu, dènge d'ara karej'e-karae.

source_text: yet while he spake, messengers came to the prince of the synagogue, and said, thy daughter is dead; what travailest thou the master further?
target_text: ropa yesus padhai lii era, hèia dhèu èci mai nèti èmu yairus, aku nèngu na, ira ii! ana mu madhe le. de baku paj'èra ia ka ama mese. nèngu la'e ia ka sa nèi.

source_text: but when the word was heard that was said, jesus said to the prince of the synagogue, do not thou dread, only believe thou.
target_text: te ngaa yesus pusi boe dènge lii padhai lii dhèu ne'e. ka na peka dènge yairus, èu baku madha'u, ee! parcaya mi ama lamatua di.

source_text: and he took no man to pursue him, but peter, and james, and john, the brother of james.
target_text: hèia yesus la'e dènge ka, tèke eele ana madhutu na cahag'e. nèti dhoka petrus, yakobis dènge yohanis.

source_text: and they came into the house of the prince of the synagogue. and he saw noise, and men weeping and wailing much.
target_text: ropa d'ai èmu yairus, rèngu rèdhi dhèu jau oob'a-jau oob'a, aa tadèngi cahag'e tangi d'ara pèd'a.

source_text: and he went in, and said to them, what be ye troubled, and weep? the damsel is not dead, but sleepeth.
target_text: yesus maso asa d'ara, ka na karèi si, aku nèngu na, nga tao ka miu maruru dènge tangi sèmi ne'e? ana ne'e madhe boe! nèngu dhoka bhèj'i di.

source_text: and they scorned him. but when all were put out, he taketh the father and the mother of the damsel, and them that were with him, and they entered, where the damsel lay.
target_text: dhèu ètu sèra tadèngi yesus peka sèmi èèna, ka ra mari pakapengo hèb'a dènge ne. hèia na pua dhèu sèra kalua aa'i nèti d'ara kama ana dhu madhe èèna. ka na paroa ina-ama ana bhèni ne, dènge ana madhutu na dhèu tèlu sèra, maso asa d'ara.

source_text: and he held the hand of the damsel, and said to her, talitha, cumi, that is to say, damsel, i say to thee, arise.
target_text: hèia yesus kèpe kacui-aai ana dhu madhe ne, ka na padhai lii pake lii rèngu, lii aram, aku nèngu na, talita kum! sasoa na, ana bhèni! kèd'i ka!

source_text: and anon the damsel rose, and walked; and she was of twelve years. and they were abashed with a great astonishing. and he commanded to them greatly, that no man should know it. and he commanded to give her meat or to give to her to eat.
target_text: kabèdhi laa, ana dhu madhe èèna mamuri hari. hèia na kèd'i titu, ka na kako. hèia yesus peka dènge ina na, aku nèngu na, hia ana ne'e na'a-ninu! dhèu ae ètu sèra dhu rèdhi j'ara dhu j'aj'i ne, ra malaa titu kèna. hèia yesus kai si, peka na, mage mi peka dènge dhèu èci sa, ja'a ka dhu pamamuri hari ana ne.

source_text: and he went out from thence, and went into his own country; and his disciples followed him.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus dènge ana madhutu na sèra aa'i-aa'i ra, lèpa hari asa rae na, nasaret.

source_text: and when the sabbath was come, jesus began to teach in a synagogue. and many heard him, and wondered in his teaching, and said, of whence cometh to this man all these things? and what is the wisdom that is given to him, and such virtues, which be made by his hands?
target_text: lod'o èèna lèke dènge lod'o sabaj'a dhèu yahudi. hèia yesus la'e asa d'ara èmu manèngi-mangaj'i ho na aj'a lii holo-nori ama lamatua ètu èèna. lod'o èèna, dhèu ae lasi manèngi-mangaj'i. ropa ra tadèngi yesus aj'a lii holo-nori ama lamatua, hèia dhèu aa'i-aa'i sèra malaa, aku rèngu na, dhèu ne mèu samia ne! na dènge koasa kahèi! tasamia ka na sèmi èèna, ee?

source_text: whether this is not a carpenter, the son of mary, the brother of james and of joseph and of judas and of simon? whether his sisters be not here with us? and they were offended in him.
target_text: nèngu ne'e dhoka tuka aj'u di. èdhi tadhe ina na, maria. sèmi èèna kahèi ari na, yakobis, yoses, yudas dènge simon, dènge ari na dhèu bhèni sèra. rèngu dènge èdhi pea ca rae. dhèu se'e ngee ètu d'ara rèngu na, rèngu mèu risi nèti yesus. nèti èèna ka, ra d'èi heka nanene ne.

source_text: and jesus said to them, that a prophet is not without honour, but in his own country, and among his kin, and in his house.
target_text: ka yesus peka, mema tare'a! dhèu pakab'ua risi dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua nèti rae leo. te ngaa ra pakab'ua boe dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua dhu nèti rae nèngu.

source_text: and he might not do there any virtue, save that he healed a few sick men, laying on them his hands.
target_text: d'ara dhèu sèra adhu sèmi hadhu, ka ra parcaya boe lii padhai lii yesus. nèti èèna ka, na malaa, hèia na pake boe koasa na. ka na puri-pa'èle dhoka dhèu pèri di, ètu èèna.

source_text: and he wondered for the unbelief of them. and he went about castles on each side, and taught.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus kako palème asa rae-rae dhu padètu ètu sèra, ho aj'a dhèu j'ara mamuri ama lamatua.

source_text: and he called together twelve, and began to send them by two together; and gave to them power of unclean spirits,
target_text: na paroa nare ana madhutu na dhèu canguru dua sèra, ka na pua rèngu lasi dua-dua ho lole lii lolo be'a nèti ama lamatua. na hia si koasa kahèi, ho babège eele nidhu nèti d'ara dhèu.

source_text: and commanded them, that they should not take anything in the way, but a staff or a rod only, not a scrip, nor bread, neither money in the girdle, but shod with sandals, and that they should not be clothed with two coats.
target_text: na peka dènge si, aku nèngu na, miu baku mèti mèdha ae ètu d'ara kakako miu. baku mèti nganga'a, doi, dènge tas. mèti dhoka tatea, salapa ètu haga, dènge kodho ètu ua di.

source_text: and he said to them, whither ever ye enter into an house, dwell ye there, till ye go out from thence.
target_text: ladhe cee dhu sèmi rare miu ètu èmu ra, miu pea dhoka ètu èèna di, toke d'ai pakèd'i hari.

source_text: and whoever receive you not, nor hear you, go ye out from thence, and shake away the powder from your feet, into witnessing to them.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe miu lami asa era èci, hèia dhèu ètu sèra sèmi rare boe miu, aa ra d'èi boe nanene lii padhai lii miu, tèke eele era èèna. aa peka mi dhèu sèra, na, ‘miu mo'o boe nanene, si! de bèli-camèd'a sèmi mere pala mi! '

source_text: and they went forth, and preached, that men should do penance.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ra lasi lole lii lolo be'a. ra peka, dhèu aa'i-aa'i hud'i ele ho'a nèti sasala-sasigo ra, ka lèpa ho mamuri madhutu dad'èi lamatua.

source_text: and they casted out many fiends, and anointed with oil many sick men, and they were healed.
target_text: ka ra babège eele nidhu nèti d'ara dhèu. ra pasuti èi lèngi mi kètu dhèu pèd'a, aa sabaj'a ho pa'èle si nèti papèd'a. ka ra èle dènge.

source_text: and king herod heard, for his name was made open, and he said, that john baptist hath risen again from death, and therefore virtues work in him.
target_text: lod'o èèna, dhèu ètu mia-mia tadhe aa'i le yesus. dhèu aae herodes tadèngi le lii lolo lula-nèti koasa yesus kahèi. dhèu palolo ètu mia-mia, aku rèngu na, yohanis tuka sarani èèna, mamuri hari le ètu d'ara ngi'u yesus! nèti èèna ka, na bisa tao tadha malaa sèra.

source_text: others said, that it is elijah; but others said, that it is a prophet, as one of the prophets.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu cahag'e hari peka, aku rèngu na, aad'o! ne'e ne, elia dhu mamuri hari d'ara ngi'u yesus. aa dhèu cahag'e hari, peka na, dhèu ne'e ne, dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua dhu leo hari nèti uru sèra.

source_text: and when this thing was heard, herod said, this is john, whom i have beheaded, he is risen again from death.
target_text: ropa dhèu aae herodes tadèngi nare lii lolo dhèu se'e lula-nèti yesus, ka na dhaa, peka na, èèna yohanis tuka sarani, dhu ca hari ni ja'a hia dhèu pare pamadhe le, te ngaa na mamuri hari!

source_text: for that herod sent, and held john, and bound him into prison, for herodias, the wife of philip, his brother; for he had wedded her. for john said to herod, it is not leaveful to thee, to have the wife of thy brother.
target_text: dhèu aae herodes pua sèmi èèna, lula nèngu lii langu dènge yohanis. lii lolo na sèmi ne'e ka: dhèu aae herodes leo nare dhèu èmu ari na, pelipus, ngara na herodias. aa te ngaa pelipus dènge herodias dhae pa'ia mèka. nèti èèna ka, yohanis kai pahari-pahari, peka na, ama dhèu aae baku leo dènge dhèu èmu ari mu. te èèna sisu ad'a èdhi dhèu yahudi. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa herodes leo nare bhèni ne'e kahèi. hèia na pua dhèu lasi kèpe rare yohanis, ho pamaso ne asa d'ara bèdho.

source_text: and herodias laid ambush to him, and would slay him, and might not.
target_text: lula yohanis kai pèri hari le, hèia bhèni ne tèka d'ara dènge ne, ka na neo pamadhe ne. te ngaa lake nare mèka, te herodes dhu pamaso le yohanis asa d'ara bèdho la'e.

source_text: and herod dreaded john, and knew him a just man and holy, and kept him. and herod heard him, and he did many things, and gladly heard him.
target_text: ka na pua sordad'u sèra madhenge paie ne ètu d'ara bèdho. herodes madha'u dènge yohanis. na ne'a tare'a, yohanis ne dhèu dhu ama lamatua pua mai. aa yohanis ne dhèu d'ara mola. herodes d'èi nanene lii padhai lii yohanis kahèi. te ngaa stèka-stèka, d'ara na pèd'a nanene lii padhai lii yohanis.

source_text: and when a covenable day was fallen, herod in his birthday made a supper to the princes, and tribunes, and to the greatest of galilee.
target_text: ka ca tèka, herodias abhu lod'o dhu be'a, sèna ka na b'ala d'ara pèd'a na. lod'o èèna, lèke dènge hari jadi herodes. ka ra nèru dhèu aae-dhèu kapai mai ra'a-sisi hari jad'i. dhèu dhu mai sèra, ama-ama dhu paredha, ama-ama sordad'u, dènge dhèu heka-dhèu heka ad'a ètu galilea.

source_text: and when the daughter of that herodias was come in, and danced, and pleased to herod or and pleased herod, and also to men that sat at the meat, the king said to the damsel, ask thou of me what thou wilt, and i shall give to thee.
target_text: ètu d'ara talora tatao èèna, ana bhèni herodias la'e roge. na roge be'a risi eele, ka d'ara herodes dènge dhèu dhu nèru sèra karej'e bia. nèti èèna ka, herodes paroa ne mai asa madha, ka na karèi, aku nèngu na, èu neo manèngi ngaa? èu peka ho ja'a hia.

source_text: and he swore to her, that what-ever thou ask, i shall give to thee, though it be half of my kingdom.
target_text: èu manèngi era paredha ja'a ne bagi dua, hia èu cabèka èèna ka, ja'a ko'o kahèi. ja'a subha dènge ngara ama lamatua!

source_text: and when she had gone out, she said to her mother, what shall i ask? and she said, the head of john the baptist.
target_text: ka ana bhèni èèna la'e karèi ina na, aku nèngu na, ina, ee! madhutu ngangee ina ku, na, ja'a manèngi ngaa dhu be'a risi nèti ama ku? ka ina na dhaa, aku nèngu na, lamu asa madha ama mu ho peka dènge ne, ja'a manèngi dhoka kètu yohanis di.

source_text: and when she was come in anon with haste to the king, she asked, and said, i will that anon, thou give to me in a dish the head of john baptist.
target_text: ka ana bhèni ne la'e asa madha herodes, ka na peka, aku nèngu na, ama! ja'a manèngi kètu yohanis, tao ètu d'ara dula èci hia ja'a. deo ne'e ne, kahèi!

source_text: and the king was sorry or sorrowful for the oath, and for men that sat together at the meat, he would not make her sorry or heavy;
target_text: ropa herodes tadèngi nare lii manèngi ana bhèni na, ka d'ara na cag'ag'a. te ngaa nèngu bisa heka ère hari lii subha nèngu deo na, lula dhèu ètu sèra tadèngi aa'i le.

source_text: but he sent a man-queller and commanded, that john's head were brought in a dish. and he beheaded him in the prison,
target_text: èle èèna ka, herodes paredha komedhaa sordad'u lasi poro rare kètu yohanis nèti d'ara bèdho.

source_text: and brought his head in a dish, and gave it to the damsel, and the damsel gave it to her mother.
target_text: ropa ra poro rare, ra tao asa d'ara dula èci, ka rèti la'a asa ana bhèni èèna. na sèmi nare, hèia nèti asa ina na la'e.

source_text: and when this thing was heard, his disciples came, and took his body, and laid it in a burial.
target_text: ropa ana madhutu yohanis sèra tadèngi ra poro rèti le kètu yohanis, rèngu mai nedhe rèti ngi'u nèngu lasi padhane. d'ai sange ne'e ka, lii lolo mamadhe yohanis.

source_text: and the apostles came together to jesus, and told to him all things, that they had done, and taught.
target_text: ca lod'o hari, ana madhutu yesus dhu na pua lasi asa rae-rae ho aj'a dhèu j'ara mamuri ama lamatua sèra, lèpa hari mai, ka ra pakaboko hari dènge ne. ra lolo dènge yesus ngaa dhu rèngu tao dènge aj'a mi dhèu.

source_text: and he said to them, come ye by yourselves into a desert place; and rest ye a little. for there were many that came, and went again, and they had not space for to eat.
target_text: lod'o èèna, dhèu ae mai patangi-tenge yesus. lula dhèu ae seli eele, ka yesus dènge ana madhutu na abhu boe tebho ra'a-rinu hèi. nèti èèna ka, yesus ale dènge ana madhutu sèra, peka na, be'a risi èdhi pakèd'i nèti era ne'e lati tenge era èci dhu mau, sèna ka èdhi ae tara ciki.

source_text: and they went into a boat, and went into a desert place by them-selves.
target_text: ka ra ca'e koha cue lasi asa era dhu mau, kaj'èu nèti d'ara rae.

source_text: and they saw them go away, and many knew, and they went afoot from all cities, and ran together thither, and came before them.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu ae ètu sèra sa, ladhe rèdhi koha rèngu kako re sebhe dano. hèia ra kalua nèti rae ka kako pamèri madhutu re dedha rai. nèti èèna ka, rèngu d'ai uuru yesus si.

source_text: and jesus went out, and saw much people, and had ruth or mercy on them, for they were as sheep not having a shepherd. and he began to teach them many things.
target_text: ropa yesus puru nèti dedha koha, ladhe laa, na, dhèu ae dhu mate ne. dhèu se'e re'a heka tao iisi ra tasamia. nèti èèna ka, d'ara yesus sue si, te rèngu sama sèmi kahib'i-kalèbho dhu dènge boe ana madhenga. èle èèna ka, na aj'a si j'ara mamuri ama lamatua.

source_text: and when it was late in the day, his disciples came to him, and said, this is a desert place, and the time is now passed; let them go into the next towns and villages, to buy them meat to eat.
target_text: na aj'a nèti loo nètu, toke d'ai nihia la'e. hèia ana madhutu na sèra mai padhue dènge ne, aku rèngu na, ama! hua iia ama ku pua si lasi hèli nganga'a ètu rae dhu dètu ètu era se'e. te oe mèda kèna, aa ètu era ne'e nganga'a aad'o.

source_text: and he answered, and said to them, give ye to them for to eat. and they said to him, go we, and buy we loaves with two hundred pence, and we shall give to them for to eat.
target_text: te ngaa yesus b'ala lii rèngu, aku nèngu na, baku tao sèmi èèna! hud'i laa, pe miu panga'a si. hèia ra karèi hari ne, ira, ee! ladhe èdhi panga'a dhèu ae sèmi ne'e, èdhi kalua doi ae bia, nga. sama sèmi gaji tuka ca tèu kateme, nga! aa èdhi tare doi sèra, nèti mia hua kèna!

source_text: and he saith to them, how many loaves have ye? go ye, and see. and when they had known, they say, five, and two fishes.
target_text: yesus dhaa, peka na, miu lami karèi sèku dhèu sèra, teko cee dhu nèti nganga'a mèra. hèia ra lasi karèi, ka mai peka dènge ne, abhu dhoka roti lèmi bua, dènge i'a dua ngi'u di.

source_text: and he commanded to them, that they should make all men sit to meat by companies, on the green hay.
target_text: hèia yesus pua dhèu aa'i-aa'i sèra ho madhèdi cakaboko-cakaboko ètu dedha j'u'u.

source_text: and they sat down by parts or by parties, by hundreds, and by fifties.
target_text: dhèu se'e madhèdi sèmi dhu yesus pua. abhu kaboko dhu dhèu cangasu-cangasu, aa abhu kaboko dhu dhèu lèmi nguru-lèmi nguru.

source_text: and when he had taken the five loaves, and two fishes, he beheld into heaven, and blessed, and brake the loaves, and gave to his disciples, that they should set before them. and he parted two fishes to all;
target_text: hèia yesus nare roti lèmi bua dènge i'a dua ngi'u sèra, ka na ladhe asa dedha. na manèngi makasi mi ama lamatua. èle èèna ka, nare roti lèmi bua, ka na ku'u pamae ca'èta-'èta. hèia na hia mi ana madhutu na, ho lasi papala hia dhèu dhu madhèdi sèra. na pala-bagi i'a dua ngi'u sèra kahèi.

source_text: and all ate, and were full-filled or fulfilled.
target_text: ka dhèu sèra ra'a toke bècu.

source_text: and they took the remnants of broken meats, twelve coffins full, and of the fishes.
target_text: ra'a èle, hèia ana madhutu na sèra lasi pakaboko nganga'a dhu risi eele sèra, pènu canguru dua soe.

source_text: and they that ate, were five thousand of men.
target_text: dhèu dhu ra'a sèra, dhèu mone di, lèmi riho dhèu, ige mèka bhèni dènge ana iiki.

source_text: and anon he made his disciples to go up into a boat, to pass before him over the sea to bethsaida, while he let the people go.
target_text: èle ka, yesus pua ana madhutu sèra pakèd'i uuru dènge koha asa rae betsaida ètu cabèka dano. te nèngu dhae la'e mèka, ho na pua dhèu ae sèra lèpa.

source_text: and when he had left them, he went into an high hill, to pray.
target_text: ropa dhèu sèra lèpa, na la'e asa ledhe èci ètu èèna, ho na manèngi-mangaj'i.

source_text: and when it was even, the boat was in the middle or in the midst of the sea, and he alone in the land; and he saw them travailing in rowing; for the wind was contrary to them. and about the fourth waking of the night, he wandering on the sea, came to them, and would pass them. and as they saw him wandering on the sea, they guessed that it were a phantom, and cried out; for all saw him, and they were afraid, or they were troubled, or disturbed. and anon he spake with them, and said to them, trust ye, i am; do not ye dread.
target_text: lod'o mèda le, ka yesus puru mai. na ladhe nèdhi ana madhutu na sèra dènge koha lasi d'ai talora dano le. lula ngèlu madha mèdhu ae, ka ra tuku koha d'ai madhe. d'ara oe mèu sa, yesus heka la'e madhutu si kèna. te ngaa na kako re dedha èi. ropa na kako oe seli koha ra, ana madhutu sèra ladhe rèdhi ne, ka ra madha'u titu kèna. hèia èci karèi èci, aku rèngu na, irii! ngaa nèi? nidhu, do? hèia yesus lii dènge si, aku nèngu na, we! miu baku madha'u! te ja'a ne!

source_text: and he came up to them into the boat, and the wind ceased. and they wondered more within themselves;
target_text: ropa yesus ca'e la'e asa dedha koha, kabèdhi laa, ngèlu mau dènge. ana madhutu na sèra malaa bia.

source_text: for they understood not of the loaves; for their heart was blinded.
target_text: rèngu heka rèdhi kèna, yesus pake koasa na, lod'o panga'a lèmi riho dhèu èèna. te ngaa rèngu re'a iia boe koasa yesus, lula d'ara rèngu adhu sèmi hadhu.

source_text: and when they were passed over the sea, they came into the land of gennesaret, and setted to land.
target_text: ropa rèngu d'ai cabèka dano, ra panahu koha ètu dae genesaret.

source_text: and when they were gone out of the boat, anon they knew him.
target_text: ropa ra puru nèti dedha koha, dhèu ae ladhe rèdhi si. ka ra rodhe lème, aku rèngu na, ee! yesus mai le!

source_text: and they ran through all that country, and began to bring sick men in beds on each side, where they heard that he was. and whither ever he entered into villages, or into towns, or into cities, they set sick men in streets, and prayed him, that they should touch namely the hem of his cloth; and how many that touched him, were made safe.
target_text: dhèu sèra aa'i-aa'i ra lasi peka palème rae, nèti èèna ka, dhèu mai nèti mia-mia, jèru rèti a'ari rèngu dhu pèd'a asa yesus. sad'i ra tadèngi yesus ètu era èci, na, rame-rame nedhe rèti dhèu pèd'a mai. ra paj'unu si ètu d'ara tana lapa ètu èèna. te ra pangee, na, sad'i dhèu pèd'a sèra goi lèke sebhe kodho yesus di, èle dènge nèti papèd'a ra. ka dhèu goi lèke kodho na, hèia èle nèti papèd'a ra.

source_text: and the pharisees and some of the scribes came from jerusalem together to him.
target_text: ca lod'o, dhèu partei agama parisi canau dènge mese-mese agama mai nèti kota yerusalem neo paraga dènge yesus.

source_text: and when they had seen some of his disciples eat bread with unwashen hands, they blamed them. for the pharisees and all the jews eat not, but they wash often their hands, holding the traditions of elder men. and when they turn again from the market, they eat not, but they be washed; and many other things there be, that be taken to them to keep, as washing of cups, and of water vessels or cruets, and of vessels of brass, and of beds. and pharisees and scribes asked him, and said, why go not thy disciples after the tradition of elder men, but with unwashen hands they eat bread?
target_text: dhèu parisi kèpe pa'èra ad'a yahudi. nuka sèmi, dhèu neo ra'a-rinu hud'i j'amo uuru ku kacui-aai madhutu atora ad'a. sèmi èèna kahèi, ladhe lèpa nèti d'ara pasa, hud'i diu uuru ku èi. toke mèdha dapu rèngu sèmi èru-pangala, pega, curu, galaa, cere, hud'i rase uuru ku madhutu atora ad'a, heka bisa pake ra'a-rinu kèna. ladhe dhèu yahudi cahag'e madhutu boe ad'a rèngu sèmi èèna, dhèu parisi nasa. nèti èèna ka, ra nasa ropa rèdhi ana madhutu yesus sèra ra'a-rinu j'amo boe kacui-aai madhutu atora ad'a rèngu. ka rèngu mai pasala yesus, peka na, nga tao ka ana madhutu èu se ra'a-rinu j'amo uuru boe kacui-aai? sèra sa, pasala dènge ad'a nèti bèi-baki èdhi!

source_text: and he answered, and said to them, isaiah prophesied well of you, hypocrites, as it is written, this people worshippeth or honoureth me with lips, but their heart is far from me; and in vain they worship me, teaching the doctrines and the behests or the commandments of men.
target_text: te ngaa yesus dhaa, aku nèngu na, miu se mema padhai lii leo, tao leo! nèti uru nèka mai yesaya suri tèke le, lii padhai lii ama lamatua sèmi ne'e, ‘abhu dhèu dhu koa-kio kolongara ja'a, dhoka dènge hèb'a di, te ngaa nèti boe d'ara. tatao rèngu sèmi èèna na, lèke boe. rèngu pusi-pahae boe dad'èi ja'a, te ngaa rèngu madhutu dhoka atora dhèu rai-haha di. ' miu èci èèna kahèi.

source_text: for ye leave the commandment of god, and hold the traditions of men, as the washing of water vessels or cruets, and of cups; and many other things like these ye do. and he said to them, well ye have made the commandment of god void, to keep your tradition.
target_text: miu tèke eele le paredha ama lamatua, ho madhutu atora dhèu rai-haha. tatao miu ne, d'èlu-mèu bia!

source_text: for moses said, worship or honour thy father and thy mother; and he that curseth father or mother, die he by death.
target_text: karèi nèti uuru èèna, musa peka le lii paredha ama lamatua sèmi ne'e ka, ‘pakab'ua ina-ama miu. ' aa tabha hari, peka na, ‘ladhe ana èci padhèda ama na, do ina na, hud'i ra huku pamadhe ne. '

source_text: but ye say, if a man say to father or mother, corban, that is, whatever gift is of me, it shall profit to thee; and over or further ye suffer not him to do anything to father or mother,
target_text: ama lamatua aj'a sèmi èèna, te ngaa miu aj'a leo. miu peka na, ‘ladhe dhèu èci pamoa le neo hia ngaa èci mi ama lamatua, masi ka ina dènge ama na j'èra oe madhe èèna ka, te ngaa pake boe mèdha èèna ho soru-bara si, lula nèngu moa le neo hia mi lamatua. '

source_text: and ye break the word of god by your tradition, that ye have given; and ye do many other such things.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, deo na ja'a peka le, miu pake heka dad'èi ama lamatua, te ngaa miu gati eele dènge atora miu dhu hiu. atora ae le dhu miu gati eele sèmi èèna.

source_text: and he again called the people, and said to them, ye all hear me, and understand.
target_text: hèia yesus paroa hari dhèu leo ètu sèra, ka na peka na, pasa dhilu ho nanene paie, sèna ka miu me'a.

source_text: nothing that is without a man, that entereth into him, may defoul him; but those things that come forth of a man, those it be that defoul a man.
target_text: ngaa dhu maso asa d'ara d'èlu, pakaj'alu boe. te ngaa dhu kalua mai nèti d'ara, èèna ka dhu pakaj'alu dhèu.

source_text: if any man have ears of hearing or ears to hear, hear he.
target_text: cee dènge ro'a dhilu, na, nanene.

source_text: and when he was entered into an house, from the people, his disciples asked him the parable.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus dènge ana madhutu na tèke eele dhèu sèra, ka lasi asa d'ara èmu èci. ka ana madhutu sèra karèi sasoa nèti lii pakasame deo na.

source_text: and he said to them, ye be unwise also. understand ye not, that all thing withoutforth that entereth into a man, may not defoul him? for it hath not entered into his heart, but into the womb, and beneath it goeth out, purging all meats.
target_text: hèia yesus dhaa, peka na, miu me'a boe kahèi? sasoa na sèmi ne'e ka: ngaa dhu dhèu ra'a, èèna be'a. te ngaa dhu kalua mai, karehe. èèna be'a boe. ngaa dhu èdhi ta'a, maso asa d'ara d'èlu, ho èèna na kalua hari asa li'u la'e. lii yesus èèna neo peka mi èdhi, nganga'a aa'i-aa'i, èci sa dhu luri boe.

source_text: but he said, the things that go out of a man, those defoul a man.
target_text: ngaa dhu mai nèti d'ara, èèna ka dhu pa'ele iie dhèu, nèti èèna ka, ama lamatua d'èi boe pa'èci dènge ne.

source_text: for from within, of the heart of men come forth evil thoughts, adulteries, fornications, manslayings,
target_text: te j'ara bhelu-katub'a ae ka dhu kalua nèti d'ara dhèu! nuka sèmi: ngangee karehe, tao j'ara makae dènge dhèu dhu dhèu èmu boe nèngu, mana'u, pamadhe dhèu,

source_text: thefts, avarices, or covetousness, or over-hard keeping of goods, wickednesses, guile, unchastity, evil eye, blasphemies, pride, folly.
target_text: gagoo-gagehu, bersina, bhelu-katub'a, leko-monya, dhèu dhu taha nare boe d'ara, d'èi boe dhèu risi nèngu, padhai lii pamanahu dhèu, padedha iisi, tatao dhu lèke boe, dènge kètu hadhu.

source_text: all these evils come forth from within, and defoul a man.
target_text: j'ara karehe aa'i-aa'i sèra mai nèti d'ara dhèu. sèra ka dhu pa'ele iie dhèu. ama lamatua d'èi boe dènge dhèu sèmi èèna.

source_text: and jesus rose up from thence, and went into the coasts of tyre and sidon. and he went into an house, and would that no man knew; and he might not be hid.
target_text: èle ka, yesus tèke eele era èèna, ka la'e asa kota èci, ngara na tirus. d'ai nèi, lasi asa d'ara èmu èci, lula yesus d'èi boe dhèu re'a nèngu ètu èèna. te ngaa nèngu bisa boe pahuni ngi'u.

source_text: for a woman, anon as she heard of him, whose daughter had an unclean spirit, entered, and fell down at his feet. and the woman was heathen, of the generation of syrophenician. and she prayed him, that he would cast out a devil from her daughter.
target_text: ètu èèna, abhu dhèu bhèni dintiu èci dhu nèti rai finisia ètu propensi siria. ropa na tadèngi yesus ètu èèna, na mai manèngi yesus babège eele nidhu nèti ana bhèni na.

source_text: and he said to her, suffer thou that the children be fulfilled or filled first; for it is not good to take the bread of children, and give it to hounds.
target_text: te ngaa yesus core lii èci, peka na, ana-ana hud'i ra'a uuru ku, ho sisa na, ra core hia busa kèna. dènge lii pacele èèna, yesus hud'i soru-bara uuru ku dhèu yahudi nèngu, heka dhèu leo kèna.

source_text: and she answered, and said to him, yes, lord; for little whelps eat under the board of the crumbs of children.
target_text: te ngaa bhèni èèna b'ala, aku nèngu na, mema tare'a ama. te ngaa busa mate le ètu ro'a mei. nèngu abhu kahèi nganga'a dhu bèbhe nèti d'ara pega ana iiki sèra. madhutu bhèni èèna, lod'o ana ra'a, na, busa na'a kahèi. masi ka yesus soru-bara dhèu unu na, te ngaa nèngu hud'i soru-bara dhèu leo kahèi.

source_text: and jesus said to her, go thou, for this word the fiend went out of thy daughter.
target_text: ropa yesus tadèngi lii dhaa bhèni ne, hèia na peka, aku nèngu na, tare'a! lii padhai lii èu èèna, mola-mola na kèna! lèpa ka! te nidhu rai le nèti ana èu.

source_text: and when she was gone into her house home, or when she had gone home, or she had gone into her house, she found the damsel lying on the bed, and the devil gone out from her.
target_text: hèia bhèni ne la'e ka. na d'ai èmu, ana na dhu bhèj'i luu. nidhu kalua le.

source_text: and again jesus went out from the coasts of tyre, and came through sidon to the sea of galilee, between the middle of the coasts of decapolis.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus si pakèd'i nèti kota tirus, kako lasi madhutu nebhe dhasi re kota sidon. nèti era èèna, rèngu lasi taruu d'ai dano galilea. hèia ra lasi asa rai èci dhu dènge canguru kota, dhu ra biasa pangare na, ‘dekapolis'.

source_text: and they bring to him a man deaf and dumb, and prayed him to lay his hand/s on him.
target_text: ètu èèna, abhu dhèu èci dhu lii aad'o aa katele-katipa. angalai na lere rèti ne asa yesus. ra manèngi sèna ka yesus tao ai mi kètu na, sèna ka na èle.

source_text: and he took him aside from the people, and put his fingers into his ears; and he spat, and touched his tongue.
target_text: hèia yesus tèke eele dhèu ae sèra, ka la'e mesa na dènge dhèu èèna. yesus pamaso kacui-aai na asa ro'a dhilu dhèu eèna dua-dua. èle èèna ka, na tao ilu ètu kacui-aai na, ka na g'ag'e he'o dhèu ne'e.

source_text: and he beheld into heaven, and sorrowed within, and said to him, ephphatha, that is, be thou opened.
target_text: hèia yesus ladhe asa dedha, na ère a'ae madhera, ka na paredha, aku nèngu na, efata. sasoa na, bhoke ka!

source_text: and anon his ears were opened, and the band of his tongue was unbound, and he spake rightly.
target_text: na peka dhoka sèmi èèna di, kabèdhi laa, dhilu dhèu èèna tadèngi dènge. sèmi èèna kahèi, he'o dhu sakaa èèna, mako ka na padhai lii dènge.

source_text: and he commanded to them, that they should say to no man; but how much he commanded to them, so much the more they preached,
target_text: èle èèna ka, dua ra lasi asa era dhèu ae sèra. ka yesus kai si, aku nèngu na, nanene, ee! baku lolo dènge dhèu, peka na, ja'a ka dhu pa'èle dhèu ne'e ne. masi ka na kai si, te ngaa dhèu se'e lasi lolo palème d'ai mia-mia.

source_text: and by so much the more they wondered, and said, he did well all things, both he hath made deaf men to hear, and dumb men to speak.
target_text: dhèu-dhèu dhu tadèngi lii lolo èèna, malaa bia. ra papeka isi-aanga ra, aku rèngu na, dhèu ne'e, dhèu di, nga! nèngu tao pabe'a aa'i mèu-mèu. dhèu katele bisa tadèngi, aa dhèu lii aad'o bisa padhai lii.

source_text: in those days, when much people was with jesus, and had not what they should eat, when his disciples were called together, he said to them, i have ruth on the people, for lo! now the third day they abide me, and they have not what to eat; and if i leave them fasting into their houses, they shall fail in the way; for some of them came from far.
target_text: ca lod'o hari, dhèu ae mai kamue rare yesus neo nanene lii holo-nori na. dhèu sèra tèlu lod'o kèna ètu era èèna dènge yesus. nèti èèna ka, gee ra èle aa'i le. hèia yesus paroa ana madhutu na, ka na peka, ja'a rasa kasia dènge dhèu ae se'e. cahag'e mai nèti rae kaj'èu, ètu era ne'e d'ai tèlu lod'o kèna, ka nganga'a rèngu aad'o heka ciki sa. baku hia ra lèpa dènge kabake manganga. mage dhoka ra mad'ea ho bèbha ètu j'ara.

source_text: and his disciples answered to him, whereof shall a man be able to fill them with loaves here in wilder-ness?
target_text: ka ana madhutu yesus sèra dhaa, peka na, ama. era ne kaj'èu nèti rae. èdhi panga'a tare boe dhèu ae sèmi ne'e!

source_text: and he asked them, how many loaves have ye? which said, seven.
target_text: hèia yesus karèi si, peka na, roti miu pèri bua era? ka ra dhaa peka na, ama. roti ji'i ate dhoka pidhu bua di.

source_text: and he commanded the people to sit down on the earth. and he took the seven loaves, and did thankings, and brake, and gave to his disciples, that they should set forth. and they setted forth to the people.
target_text: ropa nanene nare, hèia na pua dhèu ae sèra madhèdi ètu rai. ka nare roti pidhu bua sèra, hèia na sabaj'a manèngi makasi mi ama lamatua. sabaj'a nare, hèia na pamae roti pidhu bua sèra. ka na hia ana madhutu na papala mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i sèra.

source_text: and they had a few small fishes; and he blessed them, and commanded, that they were set forth.
target_text: rèngu dènge i'a pèri ngi'u kahèi. ka yesus sabaj'a hari manèngi makasi. èle èèna ka, na hia ana madhutu na papala hari mi dhèu ae sèra.

source_text: and they ate, and were fulfilled or were filled; and they took up that that was left of the remnants, seven baskets. and they that ate, were as four thousand of men; and he left them.
target_text: dhèu aa'i-aa'i sèra ele boe d'ai èpa riho sa. ra ra'a toke bècu. ra'a rare, hèia ana madhutu yesus pakaboko nganga'a sisa, ka ra ige pidhu soe hahake. èle èèna ka, yesus pua dhèu se lèpa.

source_text: and anon he went up into a boat, with his disciples, and came into the coasts of dalmanutha.
target_text: ropa dhèu se lèpa, yesus dènge ana madhutu na ca'e koha pakèd'i asa rae èci, ngara na dalmanuta.

source_text: and the pharisees went out, and began to dispute with him, and asked a token of him from heaven, and tempted him.
target_text: lod'o yesus si d'ai dalmanuta, dhèu partei parisi pèri-pèri mai paraga dènge yesus. ra tenge j'ara neo pamanahu ne. ra manèngi, peka na, ama. pad'elo tadha malaa, sèna ka j'aj'i tadha, peka na, èu tare'a-re'a abhu koasa nèti ama lamatua.

source_text: and he sorrowing within in spirit, said, what seeketh this generation a token, or a sign, either miracle? truly i say to you, a token or a sign shall not be given to this generation.
target_text: hèia yesus ère a'ae madhera, ka na dhaa si, peka na, ladhe ja'a madhutu lii padhai lii miu ne, ja'a manyasa! nga tao ka miu manèngi tadha malaa? baku sèmi èèna. ja'a bisa tao tadha malaa. te ngaa ja'a parluu boe pad'elo mi miu.

source_text: and he left them, and went up again into a boat, and went over the sea.
target_text: hèia yesus tèke eele dhèu parisi sèra, la'e hari asa dedha koha. ka na pakèd'i dènge ana madhutu na sèra asa cabèka dano.

source_text: and they forgot to take bread, and they had not with them but one loaf in the boat.
target_text: ropa yesus si d'ai talora dano, hèia ana madhutu na sèra heka sanèd'e kèna, na, rèngu rèti boe nganga'a leo, dhoka roti cue di.

source_text: and he commanded to them, and said, see ye, and beware of the sourdough of the pharisees, and of the sourdough of herod.
target_text: tadèngi ra ale roti, hèia yesus peka dènge si, aku nèngu na, miu mage-mage ku! baku lèke pangaru karehe nèti dhèu aae herodes dènge dhèu parisi. pangaru rèngu, sama sèmi ragi dhu dhèu pakihu tao roti.

source_text: and they thought, and said one to another, for we have not loaves or bread.
target_text: ra tadèngi na padhai lii sèmi èèna, ka ana madhutu sèra malaa. ka ra papeka isi-aanga si, peka na, mone heka nèi, peka ngaa ne? tao-tao èdhi tèti boe roti, ka na lii sèmi èèna.

source_text: and when this thing was known, jesus said to them, what think ye, for ye have not loaves? or bread? yet ye know not, neither understand; yet ye have your heart blinded.
target_text: te ngaa yesus ne'a lii padhai rèngu. ka na peka, aku nèngu na, nga tao ka miu padhue dhoka roti di! miu me'a mere boe ngaa dhu ja'a peka na, do? mema kahadhu miu kateme.

source_text: ye having eyes, see not, and ye having ears, hear not; neither ye have mind,
target_text: miu mèdhi dènge madha le, te ngaa mo'o boe me'a! èci èèna ka dènge miu mèdhi mèka. miu tadèngi dènge ro'a dhilu le, te ngaa mo'o boe nanene. èci èèna ka dènge miu tadèngi mèka. miu bhèlu le, do?

source_text: when i brake five loaves among five thousand, and how many coffins full of broken meat took ye up? they said to him, twelve.
target_text: roti lèmi bua dhu ja'a pamae kore ka hia dhèu lèmi riho sèra ra'a, si? ca hari ni, miu pakaboko mere roti dhu risi sèra pèri soe? ka ra dhaa, aku rèngu na, canguru dua soe, ama.

source_text: when also seven loaves among four thousand of men, how many baskets full of broken meat took ye up? and they say to him, seven.
target_text: ka na karèi hari, aku nèngu na, miu sanèd'e era lod'o ja'a pamae kore roti pèri bua sèra, ka hia dhèu èpa riho ra'a sa, do aad'o? miu pakaboko mere sisa pèri soe hahake? ka ra dhaa, na, pidhu, ama.

source_text: and he said to them, how understand ye not yet?
target_text: hèia na peka, na, mema tare'a! miu mèdhi dènge madha le. te ngaa, nga tao ka miu me'a mèka koasa ja'a kapua nèti mia?

source_text: and they came to bethsaida, and they brought to him a blind man, and they prayed him, that he would touch him.
target_text: ropa yesus si d'ai rae betsaida, dhèu rèti dhèu bèdhu èci mai asa yesus. ra manèngi sèna ka yesus pa'èle musi madha dhèu bèdhu ne.

source_text: and when he had taken the blind man's hand, he led him out of the street, and he spat into his eyes, and set his hands on him; and he asked him, if he saw anything.

target_text: ropa oe maso d'ara kota, ka dhèu ae rare sig'i-kalolo, ka ra hèle mi dedha j'ara oka-hoo. dhèu cahag'e lasi para rèu palam ètu sebhe j'ara, ho ra tao mi talora j'ara oka-hoo. tatao sèmi èèna na, sama sèmi tadha èci dhu peka na, rèngu pakab'ua yesus.

source_text: and they that went before, and that pursued, cried, and said, hosanna, blessed is he that cometh in the name of the lord;
target_text: dhèu cahag'e kako uru ètu madha yesus; aa cahag'e kako limuri. ka ra pa'oo, peka na, hosana! mai ti koa-kio kolongara ama lamatua! lamatua hia berkat mi dhèu dhu mai pake kolongara na, lula ama lamatua hia ne mai!

source_text: blessed be the kingdom of our father david that is to come; hosanna in highest things or hosanna in highest.
target_text: hosana! mai ti koa-kio kolongara ama lamatua! lula lamatua neo pakèd'i hari paredha dhèu aae daud! hosana! mai ti koa-kio kolongara ama lamatua! lula lamatua madhèdi nèd'u paredha ètu era dedha risi eele!

source_text: and he entered into jerusalem, into the temple; and when he had seen all things about, when it was evening, he went out into bethany, with the twelve.
target_text: ropa ra d'ai d'ara kota, ka yesus si maso asa madha èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. ka yesus ladhe palème era èmu èèna. te ngaa, lula lod'o nihia ae le, ka ra lèpa hari asa rae betania.

source_text: and another day, when he went out of or out from bethany, he hungered.
target_text: asa bèli mad'ae aae èèna, ka rèngu kalua nèti betania lasi asa yerusalem. d'ai talora j'ara ka yesus manganga.

source_text: and when he had seen a fig tree afar having leaves, he came, if happily he should find anything thereon; and when he came to it, he found nothing, except leaves; for it was not time of figs.
target_text: ka na ladhe nèdhi ana aaj'u èci ètu sebhe j'ara. hua aj'u na, dhu dhèu ra'a. yesus la'e padètu ho neo ne'a aj'u na, hua do aad'o. na ladhe aj'u èèna hua boe cue sa. te mema d'ai mèka hèru hua. rèu heka mare kèna.

source_text: and jesus answered and said to it, now never eat any man fruit of thee more or now no more without end any man eat fruit of thee. and his disciples heard;
target_text: ka yesus peka mi aj'u èèna, lula èu hia boe ja'a hua, mulai ti deo ne'e, èu bisa heka hia hua èu asa dhèu leo! ana madhutu yesus sèra tadèngi na padhai lii dènge nasa sèmi èèna.

source_text: and they came to jerusalem. and when he was entered into the temple, he began to cast out sellers and buyers in the temple; and he turned upside-down the boards of changers, and the chairs of men that sold culvers;
target_text: yesus si kako taruu asa yerusalem, d'ai nèi ka yesus maso asa èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. ètu madha èmu èèna, dhèu tao pasa ho ra pahia koro j'aha dhu biasa dhèu pake tao korban ho ra sabaj'a. ropa yesus nèdhi sèmi èèna, ka na lalèta si asa li'u. na tule eele mei dhu ra pake ho pasilu doi sèra, aa na tule paguri eele bagu dhu ra pake pahia manu-bhui sa.

source_text: and he suffered not, that any man should bear a vessel through the temple.
target_text: ka yesus kai si aa'i-aa'i ra, sèna ka ra rèti ia ka mèdha rèngu re d'ara madha èmu èèna.

source_text: and he taught them, and said, whether it is not written, that mine house shall be called the house of praying to all folks? but ye have made it a den of thieves.
target_text: ka na aj'a si, peka na, miu me'a le lii dhu dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua suri tèke le, peka na: ‘ja'a tao èmu ne'e, sèna ka suku aa'i-aa'i mai sabaj'a ètu ne'e. ' te ngaa miu tao èmu ne j'aj'i era pakaboko dhèu parapo.

source_text: and when this thing was heard, the princes of priests, and the scribes sought how they should lose him; for they dreaded him, for all the people wondered on his teaching.
target_text: ropa kètu agama yahudi dènge mese agama sèra re'a rare tatao yesus sèmi èèna, ka ra nasa dènge ne. ka ra tenge j'ara ho neo pamadhe ne. te ngaa ra madha'u, lula dhèu ae dhu d'èi lii holo-nori yesus.

source_text: and when evening was come, he went out of the city.
target_text: d'ara lod'o cèna sa, yesus si kalua hari nèti kota yerusalem lèpa lasi j'unu asa rae betania.

source_text: and as they passed forth early, they saw the fig tree made dry from the roots. and peter bethought him, and said to him, or peter having mind, said to him, master, lo! the fig tree, whom thou cursedest, is dried up.
target_text: bèli mad'ae èèna, yesus si lasi hari asa yerusalem. d'ai talora j'ara, ka ra rèdhi aj'u dhu yesus padhai lii med'a na. ka ana madhutu yesus sèra malaa, lula rèngu rèdhi aj'u èèna mango le d'ai amo. hèia petrus sanèd'e lii padhai lii yesus med'a na. ka na peka na, ama! ladhe ku! aj'u dhu ama dhoo med'a na, madhe le!

source_text: and jesus answered and said to them, have ye the faith of god;
target_text: yesus dhaa, peka na, tare'a, we! sad'i miu parcaya ama lamatua sèmi èèna, na, j'aj'i kahèi.

source_text: truly i say to you, that whoever saith to this hill, be thou taken, and cast into the sea; and doubt not in his heart, but believeth, that whatever he say, shall be done, it shall be done to him.
target_text: ladhe miu parcaya dènge d'ara kateme, miu bisa pua ledhe hia na pidha asa d'ara dhasi. pe lamatua pidha eele ledhe èèna, sad'i miu baku parcaya dènge d'ara cabèka. miu parcaya mi ama lamatua, hud'i dènge d'ara kateme ku.

source_text: therefore i say to you, all things whatever things ye praying shall ask, believe ye that ye shall take, and they shall come to you.
target_text: baku bhèlu! sad'i miu parcaya dènge d'ara kateme, ngaa dhu miu manèngi, tatu ama lamatua bisa hia miu.

source_text: and when ye shall stand to pray, forgive ye, if ye have anything against any man, that also your father that is in heavens, forgive to you your sins.
target_text: ladhe dhèu èci sabaj'a, aa te ngaa na tèka d'ara era dènge dhèu leo, nèngu hud'i la'e pabe'a uuru ku dènge dhèu èèna. ladhe miu tao sèmi èèna, ama miu ètu sorga heka saku eele sasala miu kèna.

source_text: and if ye forgive not, neither your father that is in heavens, shall forgive to you your sins.
target_text: ladhe abhu nèti miu dhu tèka d'ara dènge dhèu, ho mo'o boe hia abho, na, tatu ama miu ètu sorga no'o boe pabhèlu eele sasala miu kahèi.

source_text: and again they came to jerusalem. and when he walked in the temple, the highest priests, and scribes, and the elder men came to him,
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus si lasi taruu. ropa d'ai yerusalem, ka ra maso hari asa èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. ropa maso asa madha èmu èèna, kètu agama yahudi, mese agama, dènge dhèu heka-dhèu heka yahudi sèra mai,

source_text: and said to him, in what power doest thou these things? or who gave to thee this power, that thou do these things?
target_text: ka ra karèi yesus, peka na, cee ka dhu pua èu mai tao maruru ètu ne'e med'a na? cee ka hia èu hak!

source_text: jesus answered and said to them, and i shall ask you one word, and answer ye to me, and i shall say to you in what power i do these things.
target_text: te ngaa yesus ne'a, na, rèngu neo tenge j'ara ho pamanahu ne. ka na b'ala si, peka na, ja'a neo karèi miu kahèi. miu dhaa uuru ku ja'a, heka ja'a dhaa miu kèna.

source_text: whether was the baptism of john of heaven, or of men? answer ye to me.
target_text: ja'a neo karèi miu sèmi ne'e: miu aa'i-aa'i mi tadhe yohanis, tuka sarani èèna, sina ma? cee ka dhu pua nèngu la'e sarani dhèu? lamatua do, dhèu rai-haha?

source_text: and they thought within them-selves, saying, if we say of heaven, he shall say to us, why then believe ye not to him;
target_text: ra pajiko la'e-mai, ka ra padhue, peka na, eea! nara èdhi le! ladhe èdhi dhaa, peka na, ‘ama lamatua ka dhu pua yohanis, ' na b'ala hari, peka na, ‘nga tao ka miu parcaya boe yohanis! '

source_text: if we say of men, we dread the people; for all men had john, that he was verily a prophet.
target_text: te ngaa èdhi bisa boe peka kahèi, na, ‘dhèu rai-haha dhu pua ne. ' te aad'o na, dhèu ae tao dènge èdhi. lula dhèu ae parcaya, yohanis èèna, dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua.

source_text: and they answered, and said to jesus, we know not. and jesus answered, and said to them, neither i say to you, in what power i do these things.
target_text: ka ra dhaa, peka na, ji'i nge'a boe! ka yesus dhaa hari si, peka na, ladhe sèmi èèna, ja'a ko'o boe peka kahèi, cee ka dhu pua ja'a.

source_text: and jesus began to speak to them in parables. a man planted a vineyard, and set an hedge about it, and delved a pit, and builded a tower, and hired it to earth-tillers, and went forth in pilgrimage.
target_text: èle ka, yesus padhai lii hari dènge kètu agama yahudi, mese agama, dènge dhèu heka-dhèu heka ad'a yahudi sèra. ka na lole pake lii upama èci, peka na, dhèu èci la'e tao oka ho neo sèla anggor ètu dedha rai na. ka na tao tedhe reo nare oka èèna, aa tao bak cue ho kanate èi anggor asa d'ara la'e kahèi. hèia na patitu èmu madhenga oka cue dhu dedha. èle èèna ka, na hia dhèu leo seb'a oka èèna, ho ra pabagi èi anggor. hèia na pakèd'i asa rai leo la'e.

source_text: and he sent to the earth-tillers in time a servant, to receive of the earth-tillers of the fruit of the vineyard.
target_text: lod'o d'ai hèru puu-g'ètu hua anggor, ka lamatua oka pua ana paleha na èci la'e asa dhèu sab'a oka sèra, ho na manèngi pala na.

source_text: and they took him, and beat him, and left him void.
target_text: ropa d'ai nèi, ka dhèu seb'a sèra kèpe rare, ka game ne. hèia ra pua ne lèpa dènge ai hua da'u-da'u.

source_text: and again he sent to them another servant, and they wounded him in the head, and tormented him or punished him with chidings, or reprovings.
target_text: ka lamatua oka pua hari ana paleha leo èci. te ngaa dhèu seb'a sèra dhedhe panu'a kètu na. ka ra pamakae ne, dènge magèle eele ne.

source_text: and again he sent another, and they slew him, and others more, beating some, and slaying others or soothly they killed others.
target_text: hèia lamatua oka èèna pua hari ana paleha leo èci la'e. te ngaa dhèu seb'a sèra hake pamadhe ne. ra tao samia èèna ka, lamatua oka pua taruu ana paleha na la'e. te ngaa dhèu seb'a sèra game cahag'e, aa pamadhe cahag'e.

source_text: but yet he had a most dearworthy son, and he sent him last to them, and said, peradventure they shall dread with reverence my son.
target_text: ate eele dhodhoka ana mone mesa dhu pasue nèti lamatua oka. lula na abhu heka j'ara dhu leo, ka lamatua oka na pua ana d'èlu na la'e. na pajiko, peka na, ‘sèmi ja'a pua ana d'èlu ja'a la'e, na, rèngu sèmi rare dènge be'a, aa ra nanene ne. '

source_text: but the earth-tillers said together or forsooth the tenants said to them-selves, this is the heir; come ye, slay we him, and the heritage shall be ours.
target_text: hèia na pua ana na la'e. ropa dhèu seb'a sèra rèdhi ana na mai, ka ra papeka isi-aanga ra, peka na, ‘we! mi ladhe ku laa! mone heka nèi pua ana d'èlu na mai! ladhe ama na madhe, nèngu ne'e ka dhu sèmi nare aa'i-aa'i mèdha pusaka ama na. de mai ti pamadhe ne, sèna ka èdhi tare pusaka na! '

source_text: and they took him, and killed him, and casted him out without the vineyard.
target_text: ka aa'i-aa'i ra kèpe, ka ra pamadhe ne, hèia ra core eele ngi'u aae na asa li'u tedhe la'e. lii pakasame ne, d'ai sange ne'e ka.

source_text: then what shall the lord of the vineyard do? he shall come, and lose the earth-tillers or the tenants, and give the vineyard to others.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus karèi dhèu kapai sèra, peka na, madhutu ngangee miu, na, lamatua oka èèna tao dhèu seb'a sèra tasa mera mia? madhutu ngangee ja'a, tatu nèngu mai ho pamadhe aa'i dhèu seb'a sèra, sèna ka na hia dhèu leo hari seb'a oka anggor na.

source_text: whether ye have not read this scripture, the stone which the builders have despised, this is made into the head of the corner?
target_text: èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti baca le ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua, peka na, ‘abhu hadhu cue dhu tuka hadhu sèra core eele le, te ngaa limuri ne, j'aj'i le hadhu padhèdi.

source_text: this thing is done of the lord, and it is wonderful in our eyes.
target_text: ama lamatua mesa na dhu pili nare, ka na pamadhèdi hadhu ne. nèti èèna ka, èdhi ladhe, na, be'a titu kèna! '

source_text: and they sought to hold him, and they dreaded the people; for they knew that to them he said this parable; and they left him, and they went away.
target_text: dhèu kapai sèra re'a dènge, na, yesus padhai lii paraga, pake lii pakasame èèna. rèngu sèra sama sèmi dhèu seb'a oka anggor èèna. hèia ra tenge j'ara ho neo kèpe yesus. te ngaa ra madha'u dènge dhèu ae dhu d'èi lii holo-nori yesus. ka ra kako eele ne.

source_text: and they sent to him some of the pharisees and of the herodians, to take him in word.
target_text: èle èèna ka, dhèu kapai yahudi se pua pèri-pèri dhèu parisi dènge dhèu nèti partei herodes, lasi pakarèi dènge yesus, ho ra neo sahèdhe ne.

source_text: which came, and said to him, master, we know that thou art sooth-fast, and reckest not of any man; for neither thou beholdest into the face of any man, but thou teachest the way of god in truth. is it leaveful that tribute be given to the emperor, or we shall not give?
target_text: ka ra karèi ne, peka na, ama mese! ji'i nge'a, na, d'ara ama ku mola, aa d'èi boe kapod'e-kabèli. ama me'a d'ara dhèu. ama peka dad'èi lamatua dènge mola-mola, lula ama pili boe rèhu dhèu. de, ji'i neo karèi ama ku ca j'ara. madhutu atora agama yahudi, èdhi bisa b'ae bea asa dhèu aae kapai dhu paredha roma, do aad'o?

source_text: which witting their privy false-ness, said to them, what tempt ye me, hypocrites? bring ye to me a penny, that i see.
target_text: te ngaa yesus ne'a le, na, rèngu neo sahèdhe ne, sèna ka na padhai lii lab'a paredha roma. ka yesus b'ala si, peka na, nga tao ka miu neo sahèdhe ja'a dènge lii karèi sèmi èèna! cob'a pad'elo ku mi ja'a doi pudhi cue!

source_text: and they brought to him. and he said to them, whose is this image, and the writing above? and they say to him, the emperor's or caesar's.
target_text: ka ra j'ole doi pudhi cue hia ne. hèia yesus nare, ka laladhe. ka na karèi si, peka na, rèhu dènge ngara cee ètu doi pudhi ne? ka ra dhaa, peka na, èèna dhèu aae kapai paredha roma!

source_text: and jesus answered and said to them, then yield ye to the emperor or caesar those things that be the emperor's or of caesar; and to god those things that be of god. and they wondered of him.
target_text: ka yesus peka, naa, ladhe sèmi èèna, ngaa dhu unu dhèu paredha, hia asa dhèu paredha la'e. te ngaa dhu unu ama lamatua, hia asa ama lamatua la'e. ropa tadèngi rare, lii b'ala na, ka ra malaa, lula yesus peka dhu lèke. nèti èèna ka, dhèu sèra bisa heka sahèdhe ne.

source_text: and sadducees, that say that there is no resurrection, came to him, and asked him, and said,
target_text: abhu partei agama dhu leo èci, ngara na partei saduki. rèngu aj'a, peka na, dhèu madhe bisa heka mamuri. ca tèka, abhu dhèu saduki pèri-pèri mai neo sahèdhe yesus.

source_text: master, moses wrote to us, that if the brother of a man were dead, and left his wife, and have no sons, his brother take his wife, and raise up seed to his brother.
target_text: ka ra padhai lii dènge yesus, peka na, ama mese! musa suri tèke le hia èdhi atora, peka na: ladhe dhèu mone èci madhe tèke eele dhèu èmu na, te ngaa rèngu dènge boe kolo, na, ari dhèu mone na bisa leo nare hari bhèni balu èèna, sèna ka abhu kolo ho baku pa'ele kolongara a'a na dhu madhe èèna.

source_text: then seven brethren there were; and the first took a wife, and died, and left no seed.
target_text: mema musa aj'a sèmi èèna. te ngaa ji'i neo karèi ama sèmi ne'e: abhu dhèu pidhu dhu pa'a'ari. mone uru leo uuru èmu, te ngaa madhe, abhu mèka kolo.

source_text: and the second took her, and died, and neither he left seed. and the third also.
target_text: ka ari na leo nare bhèni balu èèna. nèbhu boe ka ari na madhe, te ngaa abhu boe kolo kahèi. ari na ka tèlu, sèmi èèna kahèi; na leo nare bhèni balu èèna, te ngaa abhu mèka kolo, nèngu madhe.

source_text: and in like manner the seven took her, and left no seed. and the woman the last of all died.
target_text: taruu-taruu sèmi èèna ka, d'ai ana limuri tèka madhe kahèi. nèbhu boe, hèia bhèni balu èèna madhe.

source_text: then in the resurrection, when they shall rise again, whose wife of these shall she be? for seven had her to wife.
target_text: naa! ji'i neo karèi ama sèmi ne'e: dhèu bhèni èèna, leo le dènge mone dhèu pidhu! d'ai lod'o èle rai-haha ne, ho lamatua pamamuri hari dhèu madhe, bhèni ne j'aj'i dhèu èmu cee, nèti dhèu pidhu sèra?

source_text: and jesus answered, and said to them, whether ye err not therefore, that ye know not the scriptures, neither the virtue of god?
target_text: yesus dhaa, peka na, lii karèi miu sèra, tadha, na, miu me'a iia mèka isi sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua! miu me'a boe koasa lamatua kahèi. de miu sala titu kèna!

source_text: for when they shall rise again from death, neither they shall wed, nor shall be wedded, but they shall be as angels of god in heavens or in heaven.
target_text: mi nanene! sèmi ne'e: ètu sorga dhèu paleo boe èmu. dhèu madhe aa'i-aa'i dhu lamatua pamamuri hari, ra paleo heka èmu. sèmi èèna kahèi, ana pajuu ama lamatua ètu sorga.

source_text: and of dead men, that they rise again, have ye not read in the book of moses, on the bush, how god spake to him, and said, i am god of abraham, and god of isaac, and god of jacob?
target_text: aa ja'a peka mi miu lula-nèti dhèu madhe mamuri hari, do aad'o. musa suri tèke lula-nèti ana aaj'u dhu ai na'e, te ngaa kèpu boe. miu sanèd'e lii lolo èèna, do aad'o? ropa ai na'e ana aaj'u èèna, ama lamatua peka dènge musa, na, ‘ja'a ne, ama lamatua nèti bèi-baki èu, nuka abraham, isak, dènge yakob. toke d'ai sange ne'e, rèngu aa'i-aa'i manèngi-mangaj'i mi ja'a era. '

source_text: he is not god of dead men, but of living men; therefore ye err much.
target_text: èdhi te'a, na, bèi-baki èdhi sèra madhe nèbhu le. te ngaa, lula ama lamatua peka nare le, na, nèngu j'aj'i lamatua rèngu era. nèti èèna ka, èdhi te'a, na, rèngu mamuri hari le. de masi ka dhèu madhe le, te ngaa ra mamuri hari. de dhèu mamuri dhu manèngi-mangaj'i mi ama lamatua, te ngaa dhèu madhe aad'o, sina ma? nèti èèna ka, ladhe miu kèpe taruu a'aj'a dhu peka na, dhèu madhe mamuri heka, èèna miu sala ae!

source_text: and one of the scribes, that had heard them disputing together, came nigh, and saw that jesus had well-answered them or had answered them well, and asked him, which was the first commandment of all.
target_text: ètu lod'o èèna, abhu mese agama èci dhu nanene yesus padhai lii dènge dhèu nèti partei saduki sèra. madhutu a'abhu mese agama èèna, na, yesus dhaa lèke le lii karèi rèngu. hèia na karèi yesus, peka na, ama! ja'a neo karèi sèmi ne'e: atora ad'a dènge lii paredha agama èdhi ae titu kèna. madhutu a'abhu ama, nèti lii paredha dhu mai nèti musa, mia ka dhu hua iia risi?

source_text: and jesus answered to him, that the first commandment of all is, hear thou, israel, thy lord god is one god or the lord thy god is one god;
target_text: ka yesus dhaa, peka na, lii paredha dhu hua iia risi, peka sèmi ne'e ka: ‘miu dhèu isra'el aa'i-aa'i mi! mi nanene paie! ama lamatua èèna, mema lamatua èdhi, aa kètu èdhi kahèi. nèngu dhoka mesa na di, lamatua leo aad'o.

source_text: and thou shalt love thy lord god or the lord thy god of all thine heart, and of all thy soul, and of all thy mind, and of all thy might, or strength. this is the first command-ment.
target_text: de miu hud'i sue risi eele ne nèti aa'i-aa'i. nèti èèna ka, miu hud'i d'èi pa'èci dènge ne dènge d'ara kateme, aa tadhe mèu ne, dènge sab'a èra ho madhutu dad'èi na. '

source_text: and the second is like to this, thou shalt love thy neighbour as thy-self. there is none other command-ment greater than these.
target_text: aa lii paredha ka dua peka na: ‘èu hud'i sue ku dhèu leo, sama sèmi èu sue ngi'u èu unu mu. ' dua paredha se'e ka dhu hua iia risi. abhu heka lii paredha leo dhu risi eele nèti dua paredha se'e.

source_text: and the scribe said to him, master, in truth thou hast well said; for one god is, and there is none other, except him;
target_text: ka mese agama èèna b'ala hari, peka na, tare'a! ama ku peka lèke kèna. te ama lamatua j'aj'i kètu èdhi. lamatua leo aad'o.

source_text: and that he be loved of all the heart, and of all the mind, and of all the understanding, and of all the soul, and of all the strength, and to love the neighbour as himself, is greater or is more, than all burnt offerings and sacrifices.
