source_text: for he that will make his life safe shall lose it; and he that loseth his life for me, shall make it safe.
target_text: te dhèu dhu sadia madhe lula madhutu ja'a, bèli-camèd'a nèngu unu mamuri taa-taa dènge ama lamatua. te ngaa dhèu dhu neo dhoka mamuri hia ngi'u aae na, bèli-camèd'a nèngu pakaj'èu-j'èu nèti lamatua.

source_text: and what profiteth it to a man, if he win all the world, and lose himself, and do impairing of himself or to himself.
target_text: ladhe dhèu unu aa'i ngaa-ngaa ètu rai-haha ne, te ngaa ama lamatua tule eele ne, a'oto na ngaa?

source_text: for whoso shameth me and my words, man's son shall shame him, when he cometh in his majesty, and of the father's, and of the holy angels.
target_text: ja'a ne, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a. de dhèu dhu makae madhutu ja'a, aa makae sèmi lii aj'a ja'a, ja'a kahèi makae mangaku nèngu ètu madha ama lamatua, lod'o ja'a lèpa mai nèti sorga. te bèli-camèd'a ja'a puru mai dènge dadedha ama ku, palere-lere dènge ana-ana pajuu na nèti sorga.

source_text: and i say to you, verily there be some standing here, which shall not taste death, till they see the realm of god.
target_text: ja'a peka patare'a dènge miu. abhu pèri-pèri nèti miu ètu se'e se, bèli-camèd'a ladhe rèdhi unu ra lamatua nèd'u paredha, heka ra madhe kèna.

source_text: and it was done after these words almost eight days, and he took peter and james and john, and he ascended into an hill, to pray.
target_text: èle aru lod'o, ka yesus nèti petrus, yohanis dènge yakobis, lasi ca'e asa ledhe èci, ho neo sabaj'a.

source_text: and while he prayed, the like-ness of his face was changed, and his clothing was white shining.
target_text: dhu na sabaj'a era, rèhu na j'aj'i leko-leo, aa mèdha-papake na pudhi lao-lao.

source_text: and lo! two men spake with him, and moses and elijah
target_text: cag'ag'a laa, dhèu dua cèu mai. dhèu se, nuka baki musa dènge baki elia. ka ra padhai lii dènge yesus.

source_text: were seen in majesty; and they said his going out, which he should fulfill in jerusalem.
target_text: dua ra ladhe na le'e-le'e hèti-hèti. tèlu ra padhue-padhai lula-nèti mamadhe yesus bèli-camèd'a ètu yerusalem.

source_text: and peter, and they that were with him, were heavy of sleep, or were grieved, or heavied, with sleep, and they waking saw his majesty, and the two men that stood with him.
target_text: lod'o èèna, petrus dènge angalai na dhèu dua sèra musi madha sakaa titu kèna, ka ra bhèj'i luu. ropa ra kabèdhi, hèia rèdhi yesus titu dènge dhèu dua. aa rèdhi yesus dhu kaha'a kahèi.

source_text: and it was done, when they departed from him, peter said to jesus, commander, it is good that we be here, and make we here three tabernacles, one to thee, and one to moses, and one to elijah. and he knew not what he should say.
target_text: ropa musa dènge elia neo lèpa, petrus bingu, ne'a heka tao tasamia. ka na padhai lii leli, na peka na, ama! ji'i ètu ne'e, be'a d'ai seli! de hua iia ji'i tao paleo tèlu bua. cue hia ama, cue hia baki musa, aa cue hari hia baki elia.

source_text: but while he spake these things, a cloud was made, and overshadowed them; and they dreaded, when they entered into the cloud.
target_text: te ngaa ropa petrus padhai lii era, ra'i-liru puru mai, ka saguru rare rèngu. hèia petrus si madha'u bia.

source_text: and a voice was made out of the cloud, and said, this is my dear-worthy son, hear ye him.
target_text: ka ra tadèngi lii nèti d'ara ra'i-liru èèna, peka na, ne'e ne, ana ja'a dhu ja'a hag'e kore le! ladhe na padhai lii, nanene ne paie-iie!

source_text: and while the voice was made, jesus was found alone. and they were still, and to no man said in those days any of those things, that they had seen, or they held peace, and said to no man in those days aught of those things that they had seen.
target_text: ropa lii na èle, petrus si ladhe rèdhi dhoka yesus mesa-mesa na. rèngu tèlu ra, peka boe dènge dhèu èci sa, ngaa dhu rèngu rèdhi le. d'ai nèbhu ku, heka ra palolo dènge dhèu leo kèna.

source_text: but it was done in the day pursuing, when they came down of the hill, much people met them.
target_text: asa bèli èèna, lod'o yesus dènge petrus si puru mai nèti ledhe, dhèu ae mai paraga dènge yesus.

source_text: and lo! a man of the company cried, and said, master, i beseech thee, behold my son, for i have no more;
target_text: ka dhèu èci rodhe ne, peka na, ama mese! ladhe ku ana mone ja'a ca dhèu ne laa!

source_text: and lo! a spirit taketh him, and suddenly he crieth, and hurtleth him down, and draweth him with foam or with froth, and scarcely he goeth away drawing him all to pieces.
target_text: te abhu nidhu dhu loe boe kèpe ne, ka na pakèce sahèka, aa nyanyoko ne, toke hèb'a na horo karaka. nidhu ne loe boe dhadhedhe ana ne, aa d'èi boe hia ana ne ae nare ciki sa.

source_text: and i prayed thy disciples, that they should cast him out, and they might not.
target_text: ja'a manèngi le kahèi ana madhutu ama se ho ra babège eele nidhu ne, te ngaa tao rare boe!

source_text: and jesus answered and said to them, a! unfaithful generation and wayward, how long shall i be with you, and suffer you? bring hither thy son.
target_text: ka yesus jèke si, peka na, eeh! miu se parcaya boe, na, lamatua bisa pa'èle dhèu nèti papèd'a ra. miu mema dhèu dhu me'a boe mamuri madhutu j'ara mola! de ja'a hud'i tatae hari miu toke pèri lod'o? hèia na peka dènge ama ana ne, mèti ana mu sa ne'e mai!

source_text: and when he came nigh, the devil hurtled him down, and wrenched him. and jesus blamed the unclean spirit, and healed the child, and yielded him to his father.
target_text: ropa pakako rèti ana ne asa yesus, hèia nidhu hake pabèbhe, aa rarumu ne. te ngaa yesus paredha nidhu ho kalua tèke eele ana ne, hèia na èle dènge. ka yesus hia ana ne asa ama na la'e.

source_text: and all men wondered greatly in the greatness of god. and when all men wondered in all things that he did, he said to his disciples,
target_text: dhèu-dhèu ètu sèra dhu ladhe rèdhi koasa yesus, aa'i-aa'i ra malaa-maloha. ropa dhèu se padhue era tadha malaa dhu yesus tao, nèngu lii dènge ana madhutu na, aku nèngu na,

source_text: put ye these words in your hearts, for it is to come, that man's son be betrayed into the hands of men.
target_text: miu patadhe paie lii padhai ja'a ne! nèbhu boe dhèu neo pahie ja'a, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne. ka ra soro ja'a asa d'ara adhe-aai dhèu leo.

source_text: and they knew not this word, and it was hid before them, that they feeled it not; and they dreaded to ask him of this word.
target_text: te ngaa ana madhutu na se bingu. masi ka rèngu dhane rare boe sasoa na, te ngaa ra madha'u karèi ne, sasoa na ngaa.

source_text: but a thought entered into them, who of them should be greatest.
target_text: ca lod'o, ana madhutu yesus pasisu lula-nèti rèngu se, cee ka dhu bèli-camèd'a j'aj'i dhèu re madha.

source_text: and jesus, seeing the thoughts of the heart of them, took a child, and setted him beside him;
target_text: te ngaa yesus ne'a ngaa dhu rèngu pasisu. ka na paroa nare ana iiki ca dhèu, hèia na patitu ètu karasa na.

source_text: and said to them, whoever receiveth this child in my name, receiveth me; and whoever receiveth me, receiveth him that sent me; for he that is least among you all, is the greatest.
target_text: ka yesus peka dènge ra, nanene paie! dhèu dhu madhutu ja'a, ho na ladhe-leru dhèu haha, dhu sama sèmi ana iiki ne, sasoa na nèngu ladhe-leru ja'a kahèi. aa na ladhe-leru kahèi ama ku ètu sorga dhu pua ja'a mai asa rai-haha ne. abhu dhèu ae dhu pusi-pahae boe dhèu sèmi se'e se. dhèu se'e, nuka: dhu unu aad'o, dhu susa, dhu laku-laku boe, dhu kalua aapa, aa dènge dhèu haha. de dhèu dhu d'èi lalau-lalo'o dhèu sèmi se'e se, madhutu ama lamatua, nèngu ka dhu dhèu re madha.

source_text: and john answered and said, commander, we saw a man casting out fiends in thy name, and we have forbidden him, for he pursueth not thee with us.
target_text: hèia yohanis peka dènge yesus, aku nèngu na, ama! ca lod'o ji'i ngèdhi ca dhèu babège eele nidhu, dènge ale kolongara ama. ka ji'i kai ne, sèna ka na ale ia ka ngara ama, lula nèngu ne dhèu èdhi boe.

source_text: and jesus said to him, do not ye forbid, for he that is not against us, is for us.
target_text: te ngaa yesus dhaa, peka na, baku! te dhèu dhu lab'a boe èdhi, nèngu èèna angalai èdhi.

source_text: and it was done, when the days of his taking up were fulfilled, he set fast his face, to go to jerusalem,
target_text: yesus ne'a le lod'o na ca'e asa sorga dètu le. ka na pama'ète nare, ho la'e asa kota yerusalem.

source_text: and sent messengers before his sight. and they went, and entered into a city of samaritans, to make ready to him.
target_text: na pua dhèu lasi uuru, sèna ka ra lalau nganga'a-nganginu. ka dhèu lasi uuru se, maso lasi asa d'ara rae cue ètu propensi samaria, ho lalau mema era rèngu manubha.

source_text: and they received not him, for the face of him was going into jerusalem.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu ètu samaria se, ro'o boe sèmi rare yesus si, lula nèngu neo la'e sogo-tagu ama lamatua ètu kota yerusalem.

source_text: and when james and john, his disciples, saw, they said, lord, wilt thou that we say, that fire come down from heaven, and waste them, as elijah did?
target_text: ropa yakobis dènge yohanis tadèngi lii ne'e, ka ra pamako yesus, aku rèngu na, ama! tasamia na ti manèngi ama lamatua papuru ai mai nèti dedha-liru, ho tunu pakèpu si?

source_text: and he turned, and blamed them, and said, ye know not, whose spirits ye be;
target_text: te ngaa yesus ladhe asa dua ra, hèia na kai si, peka na, baku pangee sèmi èèna.

source_text: for man's son came not to lose men's souls, but to save them. and they went into another castle.
target_text: èle èèna ka, lasi hari asa rae leo.

source_text: and it was done, when they walked in the way, a man said to him, i shall pursue thee, whither ever thou shalt go.
target_text: ropa rèngu kako era, dhèu èci lii dènge yesus, peka na, ama! ama neo asa mia èèna ka, ja'a neo madhutu ama taruu!

source_text: and jesus said to him, foxes have dens or ditches, and birds of the air have nests, but man's son hath not where he shall rest his head.
target_text: hèia yesus b'ala, peka na, be'a kahèi! te ngaa pangee ku laa. dhèu aa'i-aa'i dènge era pea-palu'u. sèmi èèna kahèi dènge badha-manu. busa hui lèpa la'e asa d'ara ro'a na. manu-bhui lasi asa d'ara rèd'a ra. te ngaa ja'a ne, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a, dènge boe era pea-palu'u ho pasoru iisi ja'a ne. era lalaka kètu, aad'o kahèi.

source_text: and he said to another, pursue thou me. and he said, lord, suffer me first to go, and bury my father.
target_text: ca tèka, yesus paroa dhèu leo ca dhèu, ka na peka, mai madhutu ja'a, ho j'aj'i dhèu ja'a. ka dhèu ne dhaa, aku nèngu na, be'a kahèi, do! te ngaa sèmi ne'e, ama. hud'i ja'a lèpa ku ladhe-leru ina-ama ja'a. ladhe padhane kore ama ku, heka ja'a madhutu kèna.

source_text: and jesus said to him, suffer that dead men bury their dead men; but go thou, and tell the kingdom of god.
target_text: te ngaa yesus peka dènge ne, sèmi ne'e! hud'i laa dhèu dhu parcaya boe lamatua, uri dhèu rèngu dhu madhe. te ngaa miu dhu lèka lamatua, sasab'a miu lami peka-padhai j'ara-j'ara paredha ama lamatua.

source_text: and another said, lord, i shall pursue thee, but first suffer me to leave all things or to tell to them that be at home.
target_text: abhu dhèu leo dhu peka na, be'a kahèi. ja'a neo madhutu ama taruu. te ngaa hud'i ja'a laku palangu ku lii dènge a'ari ja'a, heka ja'a mai madhutu ama.

source_text: and jesus said to him, no man that putteth his hand to the plough, and beholding backward, is able to the kingdom of god.
target_text: te ngaa yesus lii dènge ne, sèmi ne'e. ladhe dhèu neo pare rai, te ngaa tao hari ngaa-ngaa dhu leo, toke bhèlu sèle, tatu oka na j'aj'i boe. sèmi èèna kahèi dènge dhèu dhu pama'ète nare le neo madhutu ja'a, te ngaa pangee taruu mamuri na lod'o dhu uru sèra. dhèu sèmi èèna gaguna na aad'o j'aj'i dhèu sab'a ètu d'ara paredha ama lamatua.

source_text: and after these things the lord jesus ordained also other seventy and twain, and sent them by twain and twain before his face into every city and place, whither he was to come.
target_text: èle èèna, yesus hag'e nare ana madhutu na dhu leo, pidhu nguru dua dhèu. ka na hag'e si, dua-dua dhèu, sèna ka lasi uuru asa era-era dhu nèngu neo la'e.

source_text: and he said to them, there is much ripe corn, and few workmen; therefore pray ye the lord of the ripe corn, that he send workmen into his ripe corn.
target_text: hèia na pua si, aku nèngu na, abhu dhèu ae dhu nuka sèmi are dhu karara le. ka lamatua oka pua dhèu sab'a na lasi g'ètu are se. de miu hud'i sabaj'a, sèna ka ama lamatua hia tabha dhèu-dhèu sab'a na, ho oru rare dhèu-dhèu dhu neo madhutu ja'a. lula dhèu dhu neo madhutu ja'a, ae. te ngaa dhèu sab'a dhoka ciki oo'e di.

source_text: go ye, lo! i send you as lambs among wolves.
target_text: de lami ka! ja'a pua miu lami asa dhèu ae. te ngaa sanèd'e sèmi ne'e. miu èci èèna ka dènge ana kahib'i-kalèbho dhu lami asa talora aae busa hui dhu bhelu.

source_text: therefore do not ye bear a satchel, neither scrip, neither shoes, and greet ye no man by the way.

source_text: into whatever house that ye enter, first say ye, peace to this house. and if a son of peace be there, your peace shall rest on him; but if none, it shall turn again to you. and dwell ye in the same house, eating and drinking those things that be at them; for a workman is worthy his hire. do not ye pass from house into house. and into whatever city ye enter, and they receive you, eat ye those things that be set or be put to you;
target_text: ladhe miu maso asa d'ara rae èci, miu baku pidha-pidha era pea. ladhe dhèu sèmi rare miu dènge be'a ètu d'ara èmu cue, pea dhoka ètu èèna toke miu pakèd'i tèke eele rae èèna. ladhe miu maso asa èmu cue, miu hud'i manèngi sèna ka ama lamatua hia berkat mi dhèu isi èmu èèna. ladhe lamatua èmu ètu sèra sèmi nare miu dènge be'a, tatu lamatua pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi isi èmu èèna. te ngaa ladhe ro'o boe sèmi miu, na, hud'i laa lamatua pad'elo d'ara hua iia na hia miu mesa mi. ladhe miu maso asa èmu cue, do, asa rae èci, ra hia miu nganga'a, mi'a-minu laa dènge karej'e. te ra hia èèna pamèci dènge èi kabhèsu miu dhu hae.

source_text: and heal ye the sick men that be in that city. and say ye to them, the kingdom of god shall come nigh to you.

source_text: and into whatever city ye enter, and they receive you not, go ye out into the streets of it, and say ye,
target_text: te ngaa abhu kahèi rae dhu dhèu ra ro'o boe sèmi rare miu. ladhe ra tao miu sèmi èèna, na, lami titu asa j'ara-j'ara ètu d'ara rae èèna, mi lii dènge ra, peka na,

source_text: we wipe off against you the powder that cleaved to us of your city; nevertheless know ye this thing, that the realm of god shall come nigh.
target_text: ‘nanene paie! miu dhèu dhu ètu d'ara rae ne. ji'i mai le ngèti lii lolo be'a lamatua hia miu, te ngaa miu pusi-pahae boe. de ji'i caro eele ahu rae ne'e nèti haga ji'i, ho j'aj'i mi tadha dhu peka na, pe bèli-camèd'a sèmi mere pala mi! te ngaa sanèd'e paie-iie! paredha ama lamatua ètu katanga madha miu le. '

source_text: i say to you, that to sodom it shall be easier or less pain than to that city in that day.
target_text: miu me'a, sina ma, bhabhelu dhèu kota sodom? ja'a pasanèd'e miu! bèli-camèd'a, d'ai lod'o èle rai-haha ne, ama lamatua huku dhèu-dhèu dhu ro'o boe sèmi rare miu, bia risi nèti dhèu sodom!

source_text: woe to thee, chorazin; woe to thee, bethsaida; for if in tyre and sidon the virtues had been done, which have been done in you, some-time they would have sat in haircloth and ashes, and have done penance.
target_text: ka yesus tuhu hari lii padhai na, aku nèngu na, mate unu miu dhu pea ètu rae korasin dènge miu ètu rae betsaida! miu dui mere j'aj'èra! ja'a tao tadha-tadha malaa ètu katanga madha miu, te ngaa miu mo'o boe parcaya lamatua. ngaa hari miu dhèu yahudi dhu peka na, miu tadhe ne. ladhe sèmi tadha-tadha malaa se, dhu ja'a tao ètu rae miu, lèke ètu kota tirus dènge kota sidon, tatu nèbhu nare sange ne'e dhèu sèra ele-ho'a le, aa ra tèke eele sasala-sasigo ra, ho mai madhutu lamatua. aa rèngu tatu pake le mèdha sasusa, dènge tao ahu ètu kètu ra j'aj'i mi tadha dhu peka na, rèngu manyasa nèti sasala-sasigo ra. te ngaa dhèu tirus dènge dhèu sidon sèra, dhèu yahudi boe. de ra peka boe, na, rèngu dhèu dhu tadhe lamatua.

source_text: nevertheless to tyre and sidon it shall be easier in the doom, than to you.
target_text: tare'a! miu ladhe ku laa! bèli-camèd'a d'ai lod'o lamatua pama'ète lii langu dhèu aa'i-aa'i, hahuku nèti lamatua mi dhèu tirus dènge dhèu sidon samaa risi nèti hahuku miu.

source_text: and thou, capernaum, art enhanced till to heaven; thou shalt be drenched or drowneddown till into hell.
target_text: mata unu miu, kabarai kapernaum! miu baku pangee, na, bèli-camèd'a lamatua nedhe miu pamaso asa d'ara sorga. aad'o! mola-mèu èi! èèna na lamatua pèci miu asa d'ara naraka lami!

source_text: he that heareth you, heareth me; and he that despiseth you, despiseth me; and he that despiseth me, despis-eth him that sent me.

source_text: and the two and seventy disciples turned again with joy, and said, lord, also devils be subject to us in thy name.

source_text: and he said to them, i saw satan falling down from heaven, as lightning.
target_text: te ngaa yesus b'ala si, peka na, mema tare'a! lod'o miu tao sèra sa, ja'a ladhe kèdhi ama lamatua pèci eele nidhu dènge dhèu aae ra nèti dedha-liru nèi, nuka sèmi bela dhu kaha'a nèti haa, nèti dhimu!

source_text: and lo! i have given to you power to tread on serpents, and scorpions, and on all the virtue of the enemy, and nothing shall annoy you.
target_text: sanèd'e! dhèu aae nidhu èèna, musu èdhi. aa nèngu dènge koasa kahèi. te ngaa ja'a pangèd'u le miu koasa, ho palaho koasa na. ladhe miu j'èli lèke kaisao, do karaka rai, miu ngaa-ngaa tao boe. ngaa èci sa bisa boe paj'èra miu.

source_text: nevertheless do not ye have joy in this thing, that spirits be subject to you; but joy ye, that your names be written in heavens.
target_text: miu karej'e lula nidhu nanene miu. be'a kahèi, te ngaa sèra sa ana iiki era! dhu be'a risi, d'ara miu karej'e, lula lamatua suri nare le ngara miu, j'aj'i ana kabarai na ètu sorga.

source_text: in that hour he gladded in the holy ghost, and said, i acknowledge to thee, father, lord of heaven and of earth, for thou hast hid these things from wise men and prudent, and hast showed them to small or little children. yea, father, for so it pleased before thee or so it pleased to thee.
target_text: lod'o èèna, roh lamatua dhu mola-mèci tao d'ara yesus karej'e-karae. hèia na koa-kio ama lamatua, peka na, ama dhu j'aj'i lamatua ètu dedha-liru dènge rai-haha. ja'a manèngi makasi ae-ae, lula ama pa'abhe j'ara-j'ara se'e nèti dhèu dhu tao iisi d'èlu-mèu dènge dhèu lela dedha. te ngaa ama bhoke patalele aa'i-aa'i se hia mi ana iiki-ana iiki dènge dhèu-dhèu dhu pahaha iisi. tare'a ama! lula èèna ka dhu pakarej'e d'ara ama!

source_text: all things be given to me of my father, and no man knoweth who is the son, but the father; and who is the father, but the son, and to whom the son will show.
target_text: hèia yesus peka dènge dhèu ae sèra, aku nèngu na, nanene paie! ama ku ètu sorga pangèd'u aa'i le koasa mi ja'a. dhu tadhe mèu, ja'a ne cee, dhoka ama di. aa dhu tadhe mèu, ama èèna cee, dhoka ana nèti ama di, nuka ja'a ne. aa ja'a hag'e kore dhèu leo, sèna ka nori si, ho ra tadhe mèu nèngu kahèi.

source_text: and he turned to his disciples, and said, blessed be the eyes, that see those things that ye see.
target_text: ka yesus kabib'a asa ana madhutu na, hèia na peka dènge rèngu mesa ra, aku nèngu na, miu se oto titu kèna, lula mèdhi le koasa lamatua.

source_text: for i say to you, that many prophets and kings would have seen those things, that ye see, and they saw not; and hear those things, that ye hear, and they heard not.
target_text: dhèu aae-dhèu aae dènge dhèu rèti lii padhai lamatua uru-uru sèra, d'èi titu kèna neo rèdhi ngaa dhu miu limuri ne mèdhi, te ngaa rèdhi boe. rèngu d'èi kahèi neo tadèngi ngaa dhu miu nanene ne, te ngaa ra tadèngi rèdhi boe.

source_text: and lo! a wise man of the law rose up, tempting him, and saying, master, what thing shall i do to have everlasting life?
target_text: ca tèka, ca dhèu d'èlu-mèu atora agama yahudi, titu ho neo sèku pamanahu yesus. na karèi peka na, ama mese! mu peka ku laa! ja'a ad'u j'ara sèmi ngaa, sèna ka ja'a mamuri taa-taa dènge ama lamatua ètu sorga?

source_text: and he said to him, what is written in the law? how readest thou?
target_text: ka yesus b'ala ne, aku nèngu na, musa suri tasamia lula-nèti j'ara ne'e ne? aa madhutu mame'a èu, tasamia?

source_text: he answered, and said, thou shalt love thy lord god or the lord thy god of all thine heart, and of all thy soul, and of all thy strengths, and of all thy mind; and thy neighbour as thyself.
target_text: hèia dhèu ne dhaa peka na, na suri sèmi ne'e ka: ‘èu hud'i sue ku ama lamatua, risi nèti ngaa-ngaa aa'i-aa'i ra. nèti èèna ka, d'ara èu hud'i d'èi nèngu titu kèna, sab'a pa'èra ho madhutu dad'èi na, aa tadhe mèu ne. ' dhu suri kahèi, peka na, ‘èu hud'i sue ku dhèu èu, sama sèmi èu sue ngi'u èu mesa mu. '

source_text: and jesus said to him, thou hast answered rightly; do this thing, and thou shalt live.
target_text: hèia yesus b'ala ne, dhu lèke kèna! ladhe èu tao madhutu sèmi sèra, na, èu mamuri taa-taa dènge ama lamatua.

source_text: but he willing to justify himself, said to jesus, and who is my neigh-bour?
target_text: te ngaa dhèu ne, tao iisi na sèmi dhèu mola sa. ka na karèi hari yesus, aku nèngu na, te ngaa, ‘dhèu ja'a' èèna, ka cee?

source_text: and jesus beheld, and said, a man or some man came down from jerusalem into jericho, and fell among thieves, and they robbed him, and wounded him, and went away, and left the man half alive.
target_text: hèia yesus b'ala ne, peka na, sèmi ne'e. ja'a neo lolo dènge èu lii pakasame èci. pe èu mesa mu ka dhu peka, na, mia ka dhu tare'a-re'a ‘dhèu èu'. lii pakasame ne, sèmi ne'e ka: ca lod'o, abhu dhèu yahudi ca dhèu pakèd'i nèti kota yerusalem, puru la'e asa kota jeriko. te ngaa ropa d'ai talora j'ara, cag'ag'a laa parapo mai game paroe ne. ra game, aa parame rare aa'i doi-dhari dènge mèdha-papake dhèu ne. ka parapo se core ne asa sebhe j'ara la'e, aa ra rai tèke eele ne. dhèu ne, oe madhe.

source_text: and it befell, that a priest came down the same way, and passed forth, when he had seen him.
target_text: te ngaa nèbhu boe, ka ama agama yahudi ca dhèu puru mai re j'ara èèna. te ngaa ropa na ladhe nèdhi dhèu ne dhu diu raa, aa dhu tarenga ètu sebhe j'ara, ama agama ne titu boe sa hèi, ho uri dhèu ne. na kako paseli eele dhèu ne'e, la'e asa cabèka j'ara, ka na taruu.

source_text: also a deacon, when he was beside the place, and saw him, passed forth.
target_text: nèbhu boe ka dhèu leo hari èci kako re èèna. nèngu ne nèti suku lewi dhu tema sab'a ètu d'ara èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i ama lamatua. ropa nèdhi dhèu ne dhu baa-baa ètu sebhe j'ara, hèia la'e padètu-dètu ho ladhe, te ngaa na bara boe ne kahèi. na sigo eele j'ara, ka la'e taruu.

source_text: but a samaritan, going the way, came beside him; and he saw him, and had ruth on him; forsooth some samaritan, making journey, came beside the way; and he seeing him, was stirred by mercy; and came to him, and bound together his wounds, and poured in oil and wine; and laid him on his beast, and led him in to an hostelry, and did the care of him.
target_text: nèbhu boe ka, dhèu èci nèti rai samaria mai re j'ara èèna dènge badha keled'ei na. dhèu yahudi pahae boe dhèu samaria. te ngaa ropa dhèu samaria ne nèdhi dhèu dhu lèke rapo èèna, ka d'ara na mèke boe. na mai padètu-dètu ho neo sarad'e ne. ka pamèu nu'a dhèu ne dènge èi anggor, hèia na pana'i dènge èi mènyi. aa na parbaan nu'a na, èle ka na paca'e asa keled'ei na. hèia nèti ne la'e asa d'ara kota. na pamaso ne asa d'ara losmen, aa lalau pabe'a-be'a ne.

source_text: and another day, he brought forth two pence, and gave to the hosteller, and said, have the care of him; and whatever thou shalt give over, i shall yield to thee, when i come again.
target_text: asa bèli mad'ae èèna, dhèu ne la'e b'ae uuru kètu, doi iia dua bua mi lamatua losmen ne, ka na peka, ‘pake uuru doi ne ho lalau dhèu ne toke èle. ladhe d'ai boe, pake uuru doi èu. pe ja'a lèpa, pula hari doi sèra. '

source_text: who of these three, seemeth to thee, was neighbour to him, that fell among the thieves?
target_text: lii pakasame yesus ne d'ai sange ne'e ka. hèia yesus karèi mi dhèu d'èlu-mèu atora agama yahudi ne, aku nèngu na, madhutu èu, mia ka dhu tare'a-re'a ‘dhèu nèngu, ' mi dhèu dhu lèke rapo ne?

source_text: and he said, he that did mercy into him. and jesus said to him, go thou, and do thou in like manner.
target_text: ka dhèu ne dhaa, peka na, tatu dhèu dhu lalau ne toke èle. hèia yesus lii, peka na, tare'a! de lamu ka, tao madhutu sèmi èèna.

source_text: and it was done, while they went, he entered into a castle; and a woman, martha by name, received him into her house. and to this was a sister, mary by name, which also sat beside the feet of the lord, and heard his word. but martha busied about the oft or much service. and she stood, and said, lord, takest thou no keep, that my sister hath left me alone to serve? therefore say thou to her, that she help me.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus dènge ana madhutu na, lasi taruu asa yerusalem. hèia ra dhuli ètu rae èci. ètu era ne'e, dhèu dua dhu pa'a'ari, ngara ra, marta dènge maria. marta manèngi ho yesus si manubha ètu èmu rèngu. ka ra pea taha ètu èèna. ropa yesus madhèdi ho aj'a si, marta bhute dènge pananasu. te ngaa ari na maria, madhèdi padètu-dètu haga yesus, ho nanene lii padhai na. nèbhu boe ka marta mai ka'ugu ètu madha yesus, aku nèngu na, ama! tasamia, ee? ja'a d'ai madhe lalau nganga'a-nganginu mesa-mesa ku, te ngaa ari ja'a madhèdi mau-mau. peka ku dènge ne laa, sèna ka mai bara ja'a ètu dapu ne.

source_text: and the lord answered, and said to her, martha, martha, thou art busy, and art troubled about full many things;
target_text: te ngaa lamatua yesus dhaa, na, marta. èu ne bhute dènge ngangee rupa-rupa.

source_text: but one thing is necessary. mary hath chosen the best part, which shall not be taken away from her.
target_text: be'a kahèi do, te ngaa j'ara èci dhu be'a risi. maria pili nare dhu be'a risi le, nuka madhèdi ho nanene lii lolo be'a nèti ja'a. dhèu bisa boe parame rare nèti nèngu lii lolo be'a ne.

source_text: and it was done, when he was praying in a place, as he ceased, one of his disciples said to him, lord, teach us to pray, as john taught his disciples.
target_text: ca tèka, yesus la'e manèngi-mangaj'i. manèngi-mangaj'i nare, hèia ana madhutu na ca dhèu mai, ka na manèngi, aku nèngu na, ama! yohanis tuka sarani, aj'a ana madhutu na ka re'a sabaj'a. ji'i manèngi sèna ka ama aj'a ji'i sabaj'a kahèi.

source_text: and he said to them, when ye pray, say ye, father or father ours, hallowed be thy name. thy kingdom come to; thy will be done on earth, as it is in heaven.
target_text: ka yesus peka, na, be'a! sabaj'a pake conto sèmi ne'e: ama! kolongara ama dhu mola-mèci. hud'i laa dhèu aa'i-aa'i j'oka padedha-dedha kolongara ama dhu kapai na. hud'i laa ama j'aj'i dhèu aae mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: give to us today our each day's bread.
target_text: ama hia laa ji'i bèli-bèli, nganga'a dhu d'ai.

source_text: and forgive to us our sins, as we forgive to each man that oweth to us. and lead us not into temptation.
target_text: ji'i manèngi ama pabhèlu eele sasala-sasigo ji'i, nuka sèmi ji'i kahèi pabhèlu eele sasala-sasala dhèu dhu tao mi dedha ji'i. ama magee ji'i, sèna ka ji'i baku ad'u-ue bhelu-katub'a.

source_text: and he said to them, who of you shall have a friend, and shall go to him at midnight, and shall say to him, friend, lend to me three loaves; for my friend cometh to me from the way, and i have not what i shall set or shall put before him.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus nori hari si, j'ara-j'ara sabaj'a. na pake upama, peka na, sèmi d'ai talora mèda, angalai èu mai nèti kaj'èu, ho manubha ètu èmu èu. te ngaa èu dhu dènge boe ngaa-ngaa, sèna ka hia ne na'a. ka èu lamu asa èmu angalai dhu leo, ho pamako nèti li'u, peka na, ‘lai aae na, ee! hia taha ku ja'a roti d'ai tèlu bua sa! te ji'i abhu tamu ètu èmu, te ngaa ji'i dhu mola-mèu èi! de lai aae na, ee! dhoka tèlu bua di. pe ja'a g'ati hari! '

source_text: and he withinforth answer and say, do not thou be heavy to me; the door is now shut, and my children be with me in bed; i may not rise, and give to thee.
target_text: ladhe sèmi angalai èu dhaa, peka na, ‘te a'a, ee! dhèu bhèj'i luu, na, èu mai parèi! babèdho dhu patèke le! ana iiki se dhu bhèj'i aa'i le. de mage mu nasa kahèi! pe lod'o leo hari ku laa! '

source_text: and if he shall dwell still knocking or if he shall continue knocking, i say to you, though he shall not rise, and give to him, for that that he is his friend, nevertheless for his continual asking, he shall rise, and give to him, as many as he hath need to.
target_text: te ngaa masi ka sèmi èèna, ngee paie-iie. masi ka dhèu ne kèd'i boe lula èu angalai nèngu, te ngaa ladhe èu loe boe pamako, tatu na kèd'i, ho hia èu roti sèra.

source_text: and i say to you, ask ye, and it shall be given to you; seek ye, and ye shall find; knock ye, and it shall be opened to you.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi, dènge manèngi-mangaj'i. manèngi taruu mi lamatua; pe na hia. tenge taruu; pe na paj'uj'u j'ara. paroa taruu; pe na bhoke hèb'a èmu.

source_text: for each that asketh, taketh, and he that seeketh, findeth; and to a man that knocketh, it shall be opened.
target_text: te dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu manèngi taruu mi ama lamatua, èèna na rèngu sèmi. dhu loe boe tenge, èèna na abhu. dhu ma'ète boe paroa, pe na bhoke babèdho.

source_text: therefore who of you asketh his father bread, whether he shall give to him a stone? or if he asketh fish, whether he shall give to him a serpent for the fish?
target_text: miu pangee ku laa. abhu ètu mia ladhe ama, dhu ana na manèngi i'a, na hia mege?

source_text: or if he asketh an egg, whether he shall areach to him a scorpion?
target_text: do, ladhe ana manèngi kanadhu manu, na hia karaka rai? tatu aad'o, si?

source_text: therefore if ye, when ye be evil, know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more your father of heaven shall give a good spirit to men that ask him.
target_text: dhèu rai-haha ne, mema bhelu. te ngaa ama miu ètu sorga, nèngu ne mema be'a. de ladhe miu dhèu dhu bhelu, d'èi hia mèdha dhu be'a mi ana-ana miu, ngaa hari ama! nèngu ne hia, mesa boe ngaa dhu miu parluu, te ngaa risi nèti èèna. na pala-bagi roh na dhu mola-mèci mi dhèu dhu manèngi mi nèngu.

source_text: and jesus was casting out a fiend, and it was dumb. and when he had cast out the fiend, the dumb man spake; and the people wondered.
target_text: ca lod'o, yesus magèle eele nidhu nèti ca dhèu dhu lii aad'o. ka dhèu ne bisa padhai lii hari. dhèu-dhèu ètu sèra malaa.

source_text: and some of them said, in beelzebub, prince of devils, he casteth out devils.
target_text: te ngaa abhu kahèi dhu peka na, mema, nèngu bisa magèle eele nidhu, lula nèngu abhu koasa nèti dhèu aae nidhu, nuka baalsebul.

source_text: and others tempting asked of him a token from heaven.
target_text: abhu dhèu leo neo sèku yesus. ka ra manèngi ho yesus tao tadha malaa èci hari, sèna ka dhèu re'a, na, koasa na nèti ama lamatua.

source_text: and as he saw the thoughts of them, he said to them, every realm parted against itself shall be desolate, and an house shall fall on an house.
target_text: te ngaa yesus ne'a nare le kahadhu kaj'alu rèngu sèra. ka na lii, peka na, ladhe ètu rai cue, kabarai na pamusu, tatu rai ne laho mae-mae. sèmi èèna kahèi, ladhe ètu d'ara èmu cue, isi èmu loe boe patao-palaha, tatu èmu ne j'aj'i boe mi ngaa sa èci!

source_text: and if satan be parted against himself, how shall his realm stand? for ye say, that i cast out fiends in beelzebub.
target_text: de ladhe nidhu se pamusu aa pabata èci dènge èci, tatu dhèu aae ra bisa boe rèd'u paredha dènge nèbhu. de maso boe asa d'ara kahadhu, ladhe miu peka, na, ja'a pake koasa nidhu ho bata eele hari nidhu.

source_text: and if i in beelzebub cast out fiends, in whom cast out your sons? or in whom your sons cast out? therefore they shall be your doomsmen.
target_text: sanèd'e paie! dhèu miu kahèi dhu re'a magèle eele nidhu. rèngu pake koasa nèti nidhu, do? aad'o, si! de miu baku sad'i padhai lii di, dhu peka na, ja'a ne pake koasa nidhu sèna ka bata eele si. pe dhèu miu ka dhu pama'ète, peka na, ngaa dhu miu galaa ne, lèke boe.

source_text: but if i cast out fiends in the finger of god, then the realm of god is come among you.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe ja'a tare'a-re'a bata nidhu pake koasa ama lamatua, èèna dhu peka na, paredha lamatua ètu katanga madha miu le. paredha ne abhu le, te ngaa miu oe sèmi pame'a boe sa.

source_text: when a strong, armed man keepeth his house, all things that he wieldeth be in peace.
target_text: ladhe dhèu èra èci dènge rèka, dhu bori tèke ètu keja g'ana-kariu madhenge èmu na, tatu mèdha-panyau na, dhèu bani boe lasi mana'u.

source_text: but if a stronger than he come upon him, and overcome him, he shall take away all his arms in which he trusted, and shall deal abroad his robberies or his spoils.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe abhu dhèu dhu èra risi nèti nèngu mai segi ne, aa parame nèti rèka na. hèia na parame nèti mèdha-panyau na kahèi, ho papala mi dhèu-dhèu na. nèbhu nare sange ne'e lamatua èmu èèna maena dhoka mi rèka na. te ngaa limuri ne, na maena heka rèka na sèra.

source_text: he that is not with me, is against me; and he that gathereth not together with me, scattereth abroad.
target_text: sanèd'e paie-iie! dhèu dhu pa'èci boe dènge ja'a, nèngu musu ja'a. aa dhèu dhu soru-bara boe ètu d'ara sasab'a ja'a, nèngu ne'a dhoka ad'u-ue j'ara maruru di.

source_text: when an unclean spirit goeth out of a man, he wandereth by dry places, and seeketh rest; and he finding none, saith, i shall turn again into mine house, from whence i came out.
target_text: yesus tuhu hari lii na, aku nèngu na, ladhe èdhi bata eele nidhu nèti ca dhèu, nidhu ne rai la'e asa era kaliu, ho tenge era ae iisi. lula na abhu boe era dhu pamèci dènge dad'èi na, hèia na pangee na, ‘aah! abhu boe era ae iisi, be'a risi ja'a lèpa hari asa dhèu dhu uru èèna ja'a pea. '

source_text: and when he cometh, he findeth it cleansed with besoms, and fair arrayed or adorned.
target_text: ropa na lèpa, rage hari era uru èèna, dhu mèu le, aa dhu lalau pabe'a-be'a.

source_text: then he goeth, and taketh with him, seven other spirits worse than himself, and they enter, and dwell there. and the last things of that man be made worse than the former.
target_text: hèia nidhu ne la'e paroa angalai na pidhu dhu bhelu risi nèti nèngu. ka aa'i-aa'i ra lasi pea ètu dhèu èèna, ka ra madahu ne. de lèpa limuri, mamuri dhèu ne asa aae ka ele iie.

source_text: and it was done, when he had said these things, a woman of the company raised up her voice, and said to him, blessed be the womb that bare thee, and blessed be the teats that thou hast sucked.
target_text: lod'o yesus padhai lii era dènge dhèu ae sèra, dhèu bhèni èci ètu èèna pa'oo, peka na, ina mu oto kapai, lula nara iisi èu, aa pasusu èu!

source_text: and he said, but yea or rather, blessed be they, that hear the word of god, and keep it.
target_text: ka yesus b'ala ne, peka na, tare'a ina! te ngaa dhu oto risi, nuka dhèu dhu pasa dhilu ho nanene lii holo-nori ama lamatua aa tao madhutu!

source_text: and when the people ran together, he began to say, this generation is a wayward generation; it seeketh a token, and a token shall not be given to it, but the token of jonah the prophet.
target_text: lod'o yesus padhai lii era, dhèu oke rare ne, hèia na peka, dhèu limuri ne re'a dhoka ad'u-ue bhabhelu di. rèngu loe boe manèngi ho ja'a tao tadha malaa hia rèngu, sèna ka re'a, na, ja'a ne tare'a-re'a dhèu unu lamatua. te ngaa lamatua dhu tao le tadha malaa uru èèna, re dhèu nèti lii padhai na, nuka yunus. èèna na d'ai le!

source_text: for as jonah was a token to men of nineveh, so man's son shall be to this generation.
target_text: ngaa dhu lèke mi dedha yunus èèna, j'aj'i tadha hia dhèu ètu kota niniwe, peka na, ama lamatua ka dhu paleha ne mai. èci èèna ka dènge dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne. ngaa dhu lèke mi ja'a, èèna na j'aj'i mi tadha hia dhèu limuri ne, dhu peka na, mema ama lamatua ka dhu pua ja'a mai.

source_text: the queen of the south shall rise in doom with men of this generation, and shall condemn them; for she came from the ends of the earth, to hear the wisdom of solomon, and lo! here is a greater than solomon.
target_text: ladhe lod'o d'ai èle rai-haha ne, ho lamatua j'aj'i ka hakim, pe bhèni aae nèti balèu mamuri hari ho na j'aj'i sakasii. na paj'uj'u ho galaa miu aa'i-aa'i mi dhu mamuri taa limuri ne, peka na, ‘miu aa'i-aa'i mi se, goa! ' te uru èèna, bhèni aae mai nèti j'ara kaj'èu, ho nèdhi dènge madha na, mamèu dhèu aae soleman. te ngaa limuri ne abhu dhèu ètu talora aae miu, dhu kapai risi nèti dhèu aae soleman. te ngaa miu pusi boe ne!

source_text: men of nineveh shall rise in the doom with this generation, and shall condemn it; for they did penance in or at the preaching of jonah, and lo! here is a greater than jonah.
target_text: mesa boe nèngu di! èèna na dhèu-dhèu nèti niniwe kèd'i titu ho paj'uj'u ai asa miu dhu mamuri limuri ne, peka na, ‘miu aa'i-aa'i mi se, goa! ' ra peka sèmi èèna, lula uru èèna, ropa yunus la'e peka dad'èi lamatua dènge rèngu, hèia ra ele-ho'a dènge. masi ka dhèu dhu kapai risi nèti yunus ètu talora aae miu, te ngaa mo'o boe ele-ho'a sa hèi.

source_text: no man tendeth or lighteneth a lantern, and putteth it in huddles, neither under a bushel, but on a candlestick, that they that go in, see light.
target_text: yesus tuhu hari lii padhai na, aku nèngu na, dhèu suru labhu, na padhèdi ètu era dhu dedha, sèna ka pasaraa d'ara kama hia dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu maso asa era èèna. abhu ètu mia dhèu suru labhu, ho saguru ne dènge soe, sèna ka pahuni ne! èèna guna boe ngaa-ngaa!

source_text: the lantern of thy body is thine eye; if thine eye be simple, all thy body shall be light-full; but if it be wayward, all thy body shall be dark-full.
target_text: musi madha miu èci èèna ka dènge labhu. nèngu ka dhu pasaraa d'ara miu. ladhe musi madha maroga, dhèu ladhe ngaa aa'i-aa'i dènge d'ara dhu maroga. te ngaa ladhe musi madha mèu, dhèu rèdhi dènge d'ara dhu be'a.

source_text: therefore see thou, lest the light that is in thee, be darknesses.
target_text: tenge j'ara sèna ka saraa ètu d'ara miu, j'aj'i mèu aae sèmi saraa madha lod'o. saraa ètu d'ara miu, mage sèmi heo hèru, dhu pad'elo dhoka mamaho di.

source_text: therefore if all thy body be bright or light-full, and have no part of darknesses, it shall be all bright or light-full, and as a lantern of bright-ness, or shining, it shall give light to thee.
target_text: ladhe d'ara miu saraa, abhu boe sasanga èci sa dhu maroga, tatu mamuri miu j'aj'i mèu, nuka sèmi labhu aae dhu d'elo mamuri miu.

source_text: and when he spake, a pharisee prayed him, that he should eat with him. and he entered, and sat to or at the meat.
target_text: yesus padhai lii nare, ka dhèu èci nèti partei agama parisi nèru ne, lasi ra'a asa èmu na. d'ai d'ara èmu èèna, ka yesus madhèdi ètu mei ra'a.

source_text: and the pharisee began to say, guessing within himself, why he was not washed before the meat.
target_text: te ngaa lamatua èmu ne malaa ladhe yesus madhèdi na'a, dhu j'amo uru boe ai, madhutu atora dhèu parisi.

source_text: and the lord said to him, now ye pharisees cleanse that that is with-outforth of the cup and the platter; but that thing that is within of you or that thing of you that is within, is full of raven and wickedness.
target_text: ka yesus lii dènge ne, peka na, eeh! miu dhèu parisi se seli-kolane! miu kèpe pa'èra atora agama miu! miu bhèlu boe rase pega dènge galaa re li'u toke kale'e, te ngaa sanèd'e boe ho pamèu d'ara miu dhu kaj'alu, dhu bhelu-katub'a dènge manga'a dèu ngara!

source_text: fools, whether he that made that that is withoutforth, made not also that that is within?
target_text: goa, ee! baku bhèlu. ama lamatua ka dhu paj'aj'i re li'u, aa tao re d'ara kahèi.

source_text: nevertheless that that is over-plus, or superfluous, give ye alms, and lo! all things be clean to you.
target_text: te ngaa dhu be'a risi eele, miu pala-bagi dhèu dènge boe unu sèra, nèti ngaa dhu miu unu, sèna ka miu mola ètu katanga madha lamatua.

source_text: but woe to you, pharisees, that tithe mint, and rue, and each herb, and leave doom and the charity of god. for it behooved to do these things, and not to leave those.
target_text: miu dhèu parisi! bèli-camèd'a miu dui mere mamadhe-mamopo! ca pala nèti canguru pala dhu miu hia mi lamatua, miu pa'iga taruu nèti dhu ana iiki toke kapai. toke bubhu-lara dhu ana iiki-iiki d'ara oka, miu pa'iga hèi! te ngaa miu pusi boe dènge j'ara dhu kapai risi. j'ara-j'ara sasue mi ama lamatua, aa dènge boe bia cabèka, miu pabhèlu eele! mema tare'a, èdhi hud'i hia ku pala lamatua, te ngaa baku bhèlu kahèi dènge j'ara-j'ara dhu kapai risi sèra.

source_text: woe to you, pharisees, that love the first chairs in synagogues, and salutations in chapping.
target_text: bèli-camèd'a miu dui mere mamadhe-mamopo! te miu d'èi dhoka tenge era re madha ètu d'ara èmu sabaj'a, aa d'èi dhèu pakab'ua miu ètu madha dhèu ae.

source_text: woe to you, that be as sepulchres, that be not seen or which appear not, and men walking above know not.
target_text: bèli-camèd'a miu dui mere mamadhe-mamopo! te miu nuka sèmi ro'a dhèu madhe dhu pamera le dènge rai. dhèu kako re dedha, te ngaa re'a boe, na, ètu èèna na abhu ro'a dhèu madhe, lula ro'a èèna ètu dedha na tèdhi na mèu, te ngaa d'ara na laho kao-kao. masi ka madhutu ad'a èdhi, ladhe dhèu j'èli lèke ro'a dhèu madhe, pakaj'alu ngi'u na, de nèngu nia boe maso asa d'ara èmu sabaj'a. miu dhèu parisi se, ca ropa dènge ro'a dhèu madhe èèna! re li'u, miu mèu titu kèna. te ngaa ètu d'ara miu pènu dènge kaj'alu. dhèu dhu padètu dènge miu, j'aj'i mi kaj'alu kahèi.

source_text: but one of the wise men of the law answered, and said to him, master, thou saying these things, also to us doest despite or doest despite also to us.
target_text: ètu èèna, abhu ca dhèu d'èlu-mèu atora agama yahudi. ropa na tadèngi lii yesus, ka b'ala dènge, aku nèngu na, lii padhai ama deo na, lèke mi dedha ji'i!

source_text: and he said, also woe to you, wise men of the law, for ye charge men with burdens which they may not bear, and ye yourselves with your one finger touch not the heavinesses.
target_text: hèia yesus b'ala lii na, peka na, tare'a! miu dhèu d'èlu-mèu agama yahudi, hud'i dui mamadhe-mamopo kahèi! miu soru boe dhèu ho pasamaa si, te ngaa miu asa pasusa si dènge j'ara pabia atora agama miu. ka miu pua dhèu sèra pasae rupa-rupa babia nèti atora miu sèra. te ngaa miu mesa mi, mo'o boe pasae babia ne dènge kacui-aai miu ca laa sa hèi!

source_text: woe to you, that build tombs or the burials of prophets; and your fathers slew them.
target_text: bèli-camèd'a miu dui mere mamadhe-mamopo! te miu bhute dhoka pudhi hadhu tao tugu hia dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua dhu uru sèra, sèna ka pakab'ua si. te ngaa bèi-baki miu se'e ka dhu pamadhe si!

source_text: truly ye witness, that ye consent to the works of your fathers; for they slew them, but ye build their sepulchres.
target_text: miu èci èèna kahèi dènge bèi-baki miu sèra. rèngu tule eele dhèu rèti lii padhai lamatua, ka ra pamadhe si. hèia miu dame hadhu ro'a ho j'aj'i tadha, peka na, miu se mo'o kahèi dènge tatao bèi-baki miu.

source_text: therefore the wisdom of god said, i shall send to them prophets and apostles, and of them they shall slay and persecute or pursue,
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ama lamatua dhu ne'a aa'i, peka nèdhi le, na, ‘pe ja'a pua dhèu rèti lii padhai ja'a, dènge dhèu pajuu-paleha dhu leo, sèna ka lasi asa dhèu sèra. hèia dhèu sèra kalabhe paj'èra cahag'e, aa cahag'e hari ra pamadhe si. '

source_text: that the blood of all the prophets, that was shed from the making or the beginning of the world, be sought of this generation; from the blood of just abel to the blood of zechariah, that was slain betwixt or which perished between the altar and the house. so i say to you, it shall be sought of this generation.
target_text: dhèu taa limuri ne, hud'i tago rare tatao nèti dhèu-dhèu dhu pamadhe dhèu rèti lii padhai lamatua. sèra sa, mulai ige nèti lamatua paj'aj'i rai-haha ne, karèi nèti mamadhe habel, toke d'ai dhèu dhu limuri tèka, nuka sakaria. nèngu ne'e ka dhu ra pamadhe ne ètu talora aae mei korban dènge kama mola-mèci ètu d'ara èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. miu se kahèi pasae mere hahuku ra!

source_text: woe to you, wise men of the law, for ye have taken away the key of knowing; and ye yourselves entered not in, and ye have forbidden them that entered.
target_text: miu dhèu d'èlu-mèu atora agama yahudi! bèli-camèd'a miu dui mere mamadhe-mamopo! te miu dhu mèd'u gagoe ho bisa bhoke babèdho, sèna ka dhèu re'a mèu dad'èi ama lamatua. te ngaa miu mesa mi maso boe asa d'ara. dhu karehe risi hari, miu pahèb'e dhèu, ho baku ra lasi asa èèna!

source_text: and when he said these things to them, the pharisees and the wise men of the law began grievously to against-stand him, and stop his mouth of many things, ambushing him, and seeking to take something of his mouth, to accuse him.
target_text: ropa yesus padhai lii nare, ka mese agama dènge dhèu parisi sèra jèke ne. karèi nèti lod'o èèna ka, rèngu karèi rupa-rupa j'ara, sèna ka neo pamanahu ne. ra loe boe tenge j'ara ho pabèbhe ne.

source_text: and when much people stood about, so that they trod each on other or so that they trod each other, he began to say to his disciples, be ye ware of the sourdough of the pharisees, that is hypocrisy.
target_text: lod'o èèna, abhu dhèu pèri-pèri riho dhu mai ho nanene lii padhai yesus. dhèu se mai pasuki, lingu rare ne. ka na peka uru dènge ana madhutu na, aku nèngu na, j'aga ngi'u ho baku madhutu j'ara mamuri dhèu parisi. te rèngu padhai lii leo, tao leo.

source_text: for nothing is covered, that shall not be showed; neither hid, that shall not be known.
target_text: rèngu sangaja be'a, te ngaa bèli-camèd'a abhu hui. te aa'i-aa'i dhu pahuni ne, bèli-camèd'a sabhoka.

source_text: for why those things that ye have said in darknesses, shall be said in light; and that that ye have spoken in the ear in bedchambers, shall be preached in roofs.
target_text: ngaa dhu deo ne'e miu padhai pahuni, bèli-camèd'a dhèu tadèngi dènge mèu. ngaa dhu miu paholo ètu d'ara kama, èèna na dhèu peka paled'a ètu madha dhèu ae.

source_text: and i say to you, my friends, be ye not afeared of them that slay the body, and after these things have no more what they shall do.
target_text: ka yesus tuhu hari lii na, aku nèngu na, ana-ana, ee! mage miu madha'u, ladhe dhèu neo pamadhe miu. te rèngu pamadhe dhoka ngi'u aae di, te ngaa ra bisa boe tao ngaa mi samanga miu.

source_text: but i shall show to you, whom ye shall dread; dread ye him, that after he hath slain, hath power to send into hell. and so i say to you, dread ye him.
target_text: de ja'a neo peka, na, miu hud'i madha'u mi cee ku. miu hud'i madha'u ku dènge ama lamatua. te nèngu ka dhu bisa pamadhe miu, aa pèci asa d'ara ai naraka. de miu hud'i madha'u tare'a-re'a mi nèngu.

source_text: whether five sparrows be not sold for two halfpence or two farthings; and one of them is not in forgetting before god?
target_text: miu pangee sèku, ana mangungu kab'ua ca ngaa? mura titu kèna! lèmi ngi'u, dua doi, si? masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa ama lamatua bhèlu boe ci'u sa hèi.

source_text: but also all the hairs of your head be numbered. therefore do not ye dread; ye be of more price, than many sparrows.
target_text: aa sèmi èèna kahèi, lamatua tao ai-hèb'a mi miu. lamatua ne'a mèu, abhu rèu kètu pèri loa ètu kaba kètu miu. de miu baku madha'u, te lamatua pakab'ua miu risi nèti ana mangungu ae-ae sèra.

source_text: truly i say to you, each man that acknowledgeth me before men, man's son shall acknowledge him before the angels of god.
target_text: èle ka, yesus padhai lii dènge ana madhutu na, aku nèngu na, pasa dhilu miu paie-iie! ladhe dhèu bani mangaku ja'a ètu madha dhèu ae ètu rai-haha ne, pe ja'a mangaku nèngu kahèi ètu madha ana pajuu ama lamatua ètu sorga, peka na, nèngu ne dhèu ja'a.

source_text: but he that denieth me before men, shall be denied before the angels of god.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu dhu padhai lii ètu madha dhèu rai-haha, peka na, nèngu tadhe boe ja'a, bèli-camèd'a ètu madha ana pajuu ama lamatua ètu sorga, ja'a tadhe boe nèngu kahèi.

source_text: and each that saith a word against man's son or against the son of man, it shall be forgiven to him; but it shall not be forgiven to him, that blasphemeth against the holy ghost.
target_text: ja'a ne, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a. ladhe abhu dhèu dhu padhai pakarehe kolongara ja'a, ama lamatua sadia ho pabhèlu eele sasala na era. te ngaa ladhe na padhai pakarehe kolongara roh lamatua dhu mola-mèci èèna, ama lamatua bhèlu boe sasala na.

source_text: and when they lead you into synagogues, and to magistrates, and potentates, do not ye be busy, how or what ye shall answer, or what ye shall say.
target_text: ladhe dhèu ère rèti miu asa era uri lii langu agama, do, rèti miu asa dhèu paredha, lula miu parcaya ja'a, mage miu pangee, na, tasamia miu bisa siri iisi.

source_text: for the holy ghost shall teach you in that hour, what it behooveth you to say.
target_text: te ètu d'ara lai-lai èèna kahèi, roh ama lamatua dhu mola-mèci èèna, peka dènge miu lii dhu pamèci ho b'ala dhèu sèra.

source_text: and one of the people said to him, master, say to my brother, that he part with me the heritage.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ca dhèu nèti dhèu ae sèra, karèi yesus, aku nèngu na, ama mese! peka ku dènge a'a ku, ho pabagi dènge ja'a pusaka ama ji'i.

source_text: and he said to him, man, who ordained me a doomsman, or a parter, on you? or over you?
target_text: te ngaa yesus b'ala ne, waa! dhèu cee ka dhu ded'e ja'a j'aj'i hakim, sèna ka pama'ète lii langu miu sèmi èèna?

source_text: and he said to them, see ye, and beware of all covetousness; for the life of a man is not in the abundance of the things, which he wieldeth.
target_text: hèia yesus peka mi dhèu ae sèra, aku nèngu na, sanèd'e, ee! miu baku j'aj'i dhèu manga'a. te kakaja-sasu'i bisa boe nèti mamuri dhu mera-milu.

source_text: and he told to them a likeness, and said, the field of a rich man brought forth plenteous fruits.
target_text: èle ka, na padhai lii pake lii pakasame, aku nèngu na, dhèu kaja ca dhèu, isi oka na ae titu kèna.

source_text: and he thought within himself, and said, what shall i do, for i have not whither i shall gather my fruits?
target_text: ka èmu-èmu dhu tèka nganga'a na pènu tao cacèci, aa risi eele hèi, ka ne'a heka tao tasamia.

source_text: and he saith, this thing i shall do; i shall throw down my barns, and i shall make greater, and thither i shall gather all things that grow to me, and my goods.
target_text: ka na pama'ète, peka na, ‘ja'a neo tao sèmi ne'e ka! èmu era tèka nganga'a dhu dhui se, ja'a sag'e eele ho patitu hari dhu kapai risi, sèna ka tèke nganga'a nèti d'ara oka dènge mèdha-panyau ja'a aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: and i shall say to my soul, soul, thou hast many goods kept into full many years; rest thou, eat, drink, and make feast.
target_text: ladhe j'aj'i ka sèmi èèna, ja'a pama'ète kore, na, gud'a pènu le! nganga'a tesa le, ku'a d'ai tèu-tèu. de ku'a-kinu pakarej'e iisi dènge pacapa haga! '

source_text: and god said to him, fool, in this night they shall take thy life from thee or they shall ask of thee thy soul. and whose shall those things be, that thou hast arrayed?
target_text: te ngaa ama lamatua peka dènge ne, na, ‘heeh! dhèu goa! mèda ne'e kahèi, èu madhe. aa cee ka dhu abhu aa'i isi gud'a èu sèra? '

source_text: so is he that treasureth to himself, and is not rich in god.
target_text: de sèmi ne'e! bisa kahèi, dhèu pakaboko mèdha-panyau ae-ae ètu rai-haha ne hia ngi'u na, te ngaa ètu d'ara ngangee ama lamatua, nèngu ne, dhèu unu aad'o, lula pabe'a boe dènge lamatua.

source_text: and he said to his disciples, therefore i say to you, do not ye be busy to your life, what ye shall eat, neither to your body, with what ye shall be clothed.
target_text: ka yesus aj'a tabha hari ana madhutu na, aku nèngu na, miu mage dhoka pangee mamuri miu bèli-bèli, nèti nganga'a-nganginu, do mèdha-papake.

source_text: the life is more than meat, and the body more than clothing.
target_text: te mamuri èdhi ne risi nèti ngaa dhu èdhi ta'a, aa ngaa dhu èdhi pake.

source_text: behold the crows, for they sow not, neither reap, to which is neither cellar, nor barn, and god feedeth them. how much more ye be or be ye of more price than they.
target_text: ladhe sèku lakaa! rèngu sèra sèla boe, puu-g'ètu boe, dènge boe gud'a ho tèke nganga'a, te ngaa ama lamatua kab'oi si. ladhe sèmi èèna, tatu nèngu piara miu kahèi. lula na pakab'ua miu risi nèti manu-bhui sèra.

source_text: and who of you by thinking may put or add one cubit to his stature?
target_text: sèmi dhèu titu ètu madha tèru, ho lalau iisi na, nèngu bisa pamadhera mamuri na, do? aad'o, sina ma!

source_text: therefore if ye may not do that that is least, what be ye busy of other things?
target_text: de ladhe bhute dènge ngaa-ngaa dhu ana iiki sèra, dhu dènge boe kolo-kapua, tasamia hari ka miu bhute dènge madha j'ara dhu kapai? a'oto na ngaa?

source_text: behold ye the lilies of the field, how they wax; they travail not, neither spin. and i say to you, that neither solomon in all his glory was clothed as one of these.
target_text: ladhe sèku bunga dhu muri tab'a ètu d'ara j'ami. rèngu sab'a boe oka-tedhe, aa ra manènu boe sig'i-rabhi. te ngaa mèdha-papake dhèu aae soleman dhu kab'ua aae, saraga risi boe hela bunga dhu muri tab'a ètu d'ara j'ami sèra.

source_text: and if god clotheth thus the hay, that today is in the field, and tomorrow is cast into an oven; how much more you of little faith.
target_text: te ama lamatua piara j'u'u dhu ana iiki-iiki dhu kab'ua aad'o, dhu dhoka mamuri deo ne'e, aa bèli madhe, ho dhèu core asa d'ara ai. ladhe sèmi èèna, na, nèngu bisa kab'oi miu dhu kab'ua risi eele nèti j'u'u sèra. de tasamia ka parcaya miu èra boe mi lamatua?

source_text: and do not ye seek, what ye shall eat, or what ye shall drink; and do not ye be raised on high.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi, miu baku bhute dènge nganga'a-nganginu. te èèna na, lamatua uri hia miu.

source_text: for folks of the world seek all these things; and your father knoweth, that ye have need to all these things.
target_text: dhèu dhu tadhe boe lamatua, rèngu sèra sab'a toke madhe, sèna ka tao j'ara sèra. te ngaa miu baku sèmi rèngu, te ama miu ètu sorga dhu ne'a aa'i le ngaa dhu miu parluu.

source_text: nevertheless seek ye first the kingdom of god, and all these things shall be cast to you.
target_text: te ngaa pakako uuru ku sasab'a ama lamatua, pe na uri j'ara se'e hia miu kahèi.

source_text: do not ye, little flock, dread, for it pleased to your father to give you a kingdom.
target_text: hèia yesus tuhu hari lii padhai na, peka na, miu nuka sèmi cakaboko iiki kahib'i-kalèbho dhu èra boe. te ngaa baku madha'u! te ama miu ètu sorga, dhèu aae kapai. ngaa dhu unu nèngu, na hia mi ana-ana na dènge d'ara karej'e.

source_text: sell ye those things that ye have in possession or that ye wield, and give ye alms. and make to you satchels that wax not old, treasure that faileth not in heavens, whither a thief nigh-eth not, neither moth destroyeth.
target_text: de lami pahie mèdha-panyau miu, ho kab'ua na pabagi dènge dhèu dhu dènge boe unu. dènge sèmi èèna, miu tèke le mèdha-panyau miu ètu sorga ètu era dhu ele iie boe taa-taa. dhèu mana'u bisa boe lasi mana'u rare. ana cangèpi bisa boe pa'ele iie.

source_text: for where is thy treasure, there thine heart shall be. forsooth where thy treasure is, there also thine heart shall be.
target_text: sanèd'e paie-iie! mèdha-panyau miu ètu mia, na, d'ara miu ètu èèna kahèi.

source_text: be your loins girded above, and lanterns burning in your hands; and be ye like to men that abide their lord, when he shall turn again from the weddings, that when he shall come, and knock, anon they open to him.
target_text: yesus padhai lii hari, peka na, mèda-mèu miu musti bori mema dhari ho lalau lamatua. nuka sèmi ènu dhu beke, mate lamatua èmu na lèpa nèti pesta kab'i. ropa lamatua na kad'eu babèdho èmu, nèngu bhoke dènge.

source_text: blessed be those servants, that when the lord shall come, he shall find waking. truly i say to you, that he shall gird himself, and make them sit to or at the meat, and he shall go, and serve them.
target_text: ladhe lamatua mai nèdhi dhèu sab'a se dhu mate tae-tae, tatu rèngu oto. pe lamatua ra pad'elo d'ara be'a na mi rèngu. na pake mèdha-papake dhèu sab'a, ho la'e lalau nganga'a be'a, sèna ka hia dhèu sab'a se'e ra'a-rinu.

source_text: and if he come in the second waking, and if he come in the third waking, and find so, those servants be blessed.
target_text: dhèu sab'a se mema oto, lula rèngu ladhe-leru lamatua ra dènge be'a. masi ka lamatua ra lèpa èmu hake pèri èèna ka, d'ara talora mèda, do oe mèu, rèngu dhu bori mema dhari.

source_text: and know ye this thing, for if an husbandman knew, in what hour the thief would come, soothly he should wake, and not suffer his house to be under-mined.
target_text: sanèd'e paie-iie! ladhe abhu lamatua èmu dhu ne'a mema hake pèri dhèu mana'u mai mana'u, tatu na soro tèke boe ho dhèu mana'u huki èmu na.

source_text: and be ye ready, for in what hour ye guess not, man's son shall come.
target_text: de miu hud'i bori mema dhari, te ca dhèu sa dhu re'a boe pèri lod'o dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a èèna mai hari.

source_text: and peter said to him, lord, sayest thou this parable to us, or to all?
target_text: hèia petrus karèi yesus, peka na, ama mese! lii pakasame ama deo na, lèke dhoka mi ji'i do, lèke mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i?

source_text: and the lord said, who, guessest thou, is a true or a faithful dispenser, and prudent, whom the lord hath ordained on his meine, to give them in time a measure of wheat? blessed is that servant, that the lord when he cometh, shall find so doing. verily i say to you, that on all things that he wieldeth, he shall ordain him.
target_text: ka yesus dhaa, na, lii pakasame deo na lèke mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu tao sèmi kapala urusan dhu satia. nèngu d'èlu-mèu uri j'ara-j'ara dhu be'a hia mi lamatua na. te èèna na, lamatua na ded'e ne, sèna ka papala nganga'a hia mi dhèu sab'a dhu leo sèra. ladhe nèngu maj'èni sab'e madhutu sasab'a na sèmi èèna, masi ka lamatua na mai sange mera mia èèna ka, te ngaa nèngu ne dhu loe boe tao j'ara dhu lèke. hèia na oto, lula lamatua na ded'e ne ho ladhe-leru mèdha-panyau na aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: that if that servant say in his heart, my lord tarrieth to come; and begin to smite children, and hand-maidens, and eat, and drink, and be filled or full-filled over-measure,
target_text: te ngaa carui bagi kapala urusan dhu pangee, na, ‘ele boe nèbhu ku, heka lamatua ne lèpa kèna. ' hèia na kalabhe dhèu sab'a dhu leo sèra, mone dènge bhèni. ka na madhèdi na'a-ninu dènge kea rae-rae toke mahu.

source_text: the lord of that servant shall come, in the day that he hopeth not, and in the hour that he knoweth not, and shall part him, and put his part with unfaithful men.
target_text: te ngaa ca tèka kapala urusan ne ne'a nare boe, cag'ag'a laa, lamatua na lèpa. ka lamatua na kalabhe ne, hèia babège eele ne, sèna ka sèmi nare pala na ètu li'u, palere-lere dènge dhèu dhu satia boe, tao madhutu dad'èi lamatua ra.

source_text: but that servant that knew the will of his lord, and made not him ready, and did not after his will, shall be beaten with many beatings.
target_text: te dhèu sab'a dhu re'a dad'èi lamatua ra, te ngaa pa'èra boe tao madhutu, do, d'èi boe sab'e madhutu, bèli-camèd'a ra dui rare hahuku dhu bia.

source_text: but he that knew not, and did worthy things of strokes, shall be beaten with few. for to each man to whom much is given, much shall be asked of him; and they shall ask more of him, to whom they betook much.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu sab'a dhu sab'e sale, lula re'a boe dad'èi lamatua ra, rèngu abhu boe hahuku dhu bia. te dhèu dhu abhu ae, ra manèngi ae nèti nèngu kahèi. dhèu dhu abhu sasab'a kapai, dhadhaa na kapai kahèi.

source_text: i came to send fire into the earth, and what will i, but that it be kindled?
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus tuhu hari lii padhai na, aku nèngu na, mamai ja'a ne ho cèri eele dhèu ja'a nèti dhèu leo ètu rai-haha ne. ne'e nuka sèmi dhèu pake ai, ho tunu eele maruru. dad'èi ja'a ka ladhe ai ne mulai heo ètu mia-mia.

source_text: and i have to be baptized with a baptism, and how am i constrained, till that it be perfectly done?
target_text: te ngaa uru nèti èèna, ja'a hud'i pasae ku j'aj'èra dhu bia. ja'a bèli-camèd'a j'èra ae, toke d'ai èle sasab'a-la'a ja'a.

source_text: ween ye, or guess ye, that i came to give peace into the earth? nay, i say to you, but parting.
target_text: miu pangee, na, ja'a mai kèti dame ètu rai-haha, do? aad'o! ja'a mai sèna ka tao dhèu rai-haha ne patao-palaha dènge mae-manyèla, lula lii holo-nori ja'a.

source_text: for from this time there shall be five parted in one house; three shall be parted against twain, and twain shall be parted against three;
target_text: nèti deo ne'e, dhèu dhu pa'a'ari mae-manyèla. ètu d'ara èmu cue, dhèu tèlu lab'a dhèu dua, dua lab'a tèlu.

source_text: the father against the son, and the son against the father; the mother against the daughter, and the daughter against the mother; the husband's mother against the son's wife, and the son's wife against her husband's mother.
target_text: ama lab'a ana, ana lab'a ama. ina lab'a ana; ana lab'a ina. teto lab'a ana mantu; ana mantu lab'a teto na.

source_text: and he said also to the people, when ye see a cloud rising from the sun going down, anon ye say, rain cometh; and so it is done.
target_text: hèia yesus lii dènge dhèu ae sèra, aku nèngu na, ladhe miu mèdhi ra'i-liru mèdhi aae cèu nèti haa, miu peka na, ‘ne'e, tadha èj'i oe mai kèna. ' mema lèke sèmi èèna.

source_text: and when ye see the south blowing, ye say, that heat shall be; and it is done.
target_text: ladhe ngèlu balèu mai, miu peka na, ‘ne'e, tadha lod'o pana titu kèna. ' mema tare'a sèmi èèna kahèi.

source_text: hypocrites, ye know how to prove the face of heaven and of earth, but how prove ye not this time? .
target_text: weeh! miu dhèu leko-monya dhu padhai lii leo, tao leo! miu d'èlu-mèu titu kèna me'a peka mia lod'o èj'i, aa mia lod'o pana aae. te ngaa tasamia ka mo'o boe me'a dènge dad'èi lamatua ètu taa limuri ne?

source_text: but what and of yourselves ye deem not that that is just? forsooth why and of yourselves deem ye not this thing that is just? but when thou goest with thine adversary in the way to the prince or to the prince in the way, do busyness to be delivered from him; lest peradventure he take thee to the doomsman, and the doomsman betake thee to the masterful asker, and the masterful asker send thee into prison.
target_text: ka yesus tuhu hari lii na, aku nèngu na, ladhe miu tao lii langu, nga tao ka miu bisa boe pama'ète unu mi, mia dhu lèke! be'a risi uri uuru ku dame! mage dhoka miu d'ai katanga madha hakim, ho na pama'ète, na, miu maso asa d'ara bèdho.

source_text: i say to thee, thou shalt not go out from thence, till thou yield the last farthing.
target_text: te ladhe sèmi èèna, miu bisa boe kalua, ladhe miu b'ae mere mèka dedha dhu hakim pama'ète nare èèna.

source_text: and some men were present in that time, that told to him of the galileans, whose blood pilate mingled with the sacrifices of them.
target_text: lod'o èèna, dhèu mai peka dènge yesus, na, gubernur pilatus pamadhe le dhèu yahudi pèri-pèri nèti galilea, lod'o dhu mai asa yerusalem, rèti korban asa èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i.

source_text: and he answered, and said to them, ween ye that these men of galilee were sinners more than all galileans, for they suffered such things?
target_text: ropa tadèngi nare, ka yesus karèi si, madhutu miu, na, tasamia? dhèu dhu ra pamadhe sèra, sasala ra kapai risi nèti dhèu galilea dhu leo aa'i-aa'i ra, do? nèti èèna ka, ra huku pamadhe si, do?

source_text: i say to you, nay; all ye shall perish in like manner, but ye have penance.
target_text: aad'o! te ngaa ladhe miu tèke eele boe mamuri miu dhu bhelu, ho lèpa madhutu dad'èi lamatua, lod'o limuri miu laho nuka sèmi rèngu kahèi.

source_text: and as those eighteen, on which the tower in siloam fell down, and slew them, guess ye, that they were debtors more than all men that dwell in jerusalem?
target_text: aa tasa mera mia hari dènge canguru aru dhèu dhu madhe ca hari ni, ropa ètu siloam manara guri, hèia kabhie nare si, èèna? sasala si ae risi nèti dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu yerusalem, do?

source_text: i say to you, nay; but also all ye shall perish, if ye do not penance.
target_text: aad'o! te ngaa ladhe miu tèke eele boe mamuri miu dhu bhelu, ho lèpa asa j'ara lamatua dhu mola, miu èèna na laho sèmi rèngu kahèi.

source_text: and he said this likeness, a man had a fig tree planted in his vineyard, and he came seeking fruit in it, and found none.
target_text: hèia yesus peka lii pakasame èci, na, abhu ca dhèu dhu dènge ana aaj'u ètu d'ara oka na. bèli-bèli, na la'e patigi, teko-teko ana aaj'u ne hua le, do dhae. te ngaa ana aaj'u ne dhae hua mèka.

source_text: and he said to the tiller of the vineyard, lo! three years be, since i come seeking fruit in this fig tree, and i find none; therefore cut it down, whereto occupieth it the earth?
target_text: ka na pua dhèu sab'a ètu d'ara oka, aku nèngu na, ‘tèlu tèu kèna, ja'a laku-mai ho ladhe ana aaj'u ne hua le, do dhae, te ngaa ja'a abhu boe ngaa-ngaa. de patue eele ne, te nèngu ne dhoka na'e era di. '

source_text: and he answering said to him, lord, suffer it also this year, the while i delve about it, and i shall dung it or and dung it;
target_text: te ngaa dhèu sab'a ne dhaa, peka na, ‘ama baku pasori ku. hud'i nèbhu hari ku ciki laa d'ai ca tèu sa. pe ja'a kakèi rai reo kapua na, sèna ka tao pupuk, ho na sega.

source_text: if it shall make fruit, else if not, in time coming thou shalt cut it down.
target_text: ladhe d'ai tèu mai nèi, aj'u ne hua, na be'a. ladhe aad'o, la'a sina ma, patue eele ka laa. '

source_text: and he was teaching in their synagogue in the sabbaths.
target_text: ca tèka, lèke dènge lod'o sabaj'a dhèu yahudi, yesus la'e aj'a dhèu ètu d'ara èmu sabaj'a.

source_text: and lo! a woman, that had a spirit of sickness eighteen years, and was crooked or bowed down, and neither in any manner might look upward.
target_text: ètu ne'e abhu bhèni ca dhèu dhu kabodho kapo'o canguru aru tèu kèna, lula nidhu tao ne. bhèni ne bisa boe pamola kabodho na.

source_text: whom when jesus had seen, he called her to him, and said to her, woman, thou art delivered of thy sickness.
target_text: ropa yesus ladhe nèdhi, hèia na paroa ne, aku nèngu na, ina! lamatua patalale le j'aj'èra nèti èu.

source_text: and he set or put on her his hands, and anon she stood upright, and glorified god.
target_text: ka yesus tao ai mi bhèni ne. kaca'a laa, kabodho bhèni ne mola dènge kahèi. hèia bhèni ne manèngi makasi, aa koa-kio kolongara ama lamatua.

source_text: and the prince of the synagogue answered, having disdain for jesus had healed in the sabbath; and he said to the people, there be six days, in which it behooveth to work; therefore come ye in these, and be ye healed, and not in the day of sabbath.
target_text: te ngaa kapala èmu sabaj'a ne nasa, lula yesus puri-pa'èle dhèu lèke dènge lod'o sabaj'a. ka na peka dènge dhèu ae sèra, aku nèngu na, d'ara ca migu, dhèu sab'a èna lod'o. de be'a risi dhèu pèd'a mai lèke dènge lod'o-lod'o sab'a sèra, sèna ka tenge dhèu puri-pa'èle si. baku mai lèke dènge lod'o sabaj'a!

source_text: but the lord answered to him, and said, hypocrite, whether each of you untieth not in the sabbath his ox, or ass, from the cratch, or the stall, and leadeth to water?
target_text: te ngaa yesus b'ala ne, heeh! dhèu kapod'e-kabèli! ètu d'ara lod'o sabaj'a, miu sab'a kahèi, si? te miu lami patabuli sapi dènge keled'ei miu, sèna ka hia ra'a-rinu, si?

source_text: behooved it not this daughter of abraham, whom satan hath bound, lo! eighteen years, to be unbound of this bond in the day of sabbath?
target_text: bhèni ne, ana-èpu abraham sama sèmi èdhi. dhèu aae nidhu paj'èra ne canguru aru tèu kèna. ladhe ja'a patabuli ne nèti nidhu, lèke dènge lod'o manèngi-mangaj'i, na èèna sala, do?

source_text: and when he said these things, all his adversaries were ashamed, and all the people joyed in all things, that were gloriously done of him.
target_text: ropa tadèngi rare sèmi èèna, ka musu yesus sèra makae. te ngaa dhèu ae dhu leo sèra karej'e, lula sasab'a na sèra be'a titu kèna.

source_text: therefore he said, to what thing is the kingdom of god like? and to what thing shall i guess it to be like?
target_text: ka yesus peka hari, na, ja'a pasoro dhèu-dhèu lamatua sèmi ngaa hari?

source_text: it is like to a corn of sinapi, which a man took, and cast into his garden or into his yard; and it waxed, and was made into a great tree, and fowls of the air rested in the branches thereof.
target_text: hiu-hiu èèna rèngu ciki di, te ngaa nèbhu-nèbhu ka rèngu asa tabha ae. rèngu sèmi aj'u dhu lamusi na ana iiki-iiki. dhèu sèle ne ètu d'ara oka. ka muri mai, hèia j'aj'i ana aaj'u dhu kapai aae. èèna ka manu-bhui mai tao rèd'a ètu dadana na sèra.

source_text: and again he said, to what thing shall i guess the kingdom of god like?
target_text: hèia yesus padhai lii hari, peka na, ja'a pasoro dhèu unu lamatua sèmi ngaa hari?

source_text: it is like to sourdough that a woman took, and hid it in three measures of meal, till all were soured.
target_text: nèngu ne nuka sèmi ragi dhu dhèu bhèni nare, ho na pab'ali dènge tarigu dua saku, sèna ka tao roti pa'ae. lula ragi dhu ciki oo'e èèna, pab'ali dènge tarigu ae-ae, hèia ca'e aa'i. dhèu unu lamatua pangaru ra asa tabha kapai sèmi èèna kahèi.

source_text: and he went by cities and castles, teaching and making journey into jerusalem.
target_text: èle ka, yesus si mulai kako lasi asa kota yerusalem. rèngu kako, lasi dhuli kota-kota dènge rae-rae, ho na aj'a dhèu.

source_text: and a man said to him, lord, if there be few, that be saved? and he said to them,
target_text: d'ai era èci, ka ca dhèu karèi ne, ama mese! ele boe dhèu ciki di, dhu abhu sod'a, do?

source_text: strive ye to enter by the strait gate; for i say to you, many seek to enter in, and they shall not be able.
target_text: ka yesus b'ala, aku nèngu na, hèb'a maso asa sorga èèna, kob'o. de tenge j'ara paie-iie, sèna ka miu bisa maso re èèna. te abhu dhèu ae dhu sèku neo maso, te ngaa bisa boe.

source_text: for when the husbandman is entered, and the door is closed, ye shall begin to stand withoutforth, and knock at the door, and say, lord, open to us. and he shall answer, and say to you, i know you not, of whence ye be.
target_text: ladhe lamatua èmu patèke le babèdho, èèna na miu titu ètu li'u, ho kad'eu babèdho, dènge pa'oo manèngi, peka na, ‘ama! bhoke ku laa! ' te ngaa na b'ala, aku nèngu na, ‘miu sèra, cee? ja'a tadhe boe miu! '

source_text: then ye shall begin to say, we have eaten before thee and drunk, and in our streets thou hast taught.
target_text: hèia miu peka hari, na, ‘nga tao ka ama tadhe boe ji'i? ji'i se ka dhu tema madhèdi nga'a-nginu dènge ama. aa ama kahèi dhu tema aj'a-nori ji'i ètu j'ara oka-hoo ji'i. '

source_text: and he shall say to you, i know you not, of whence ye be; go away from me, all ye workers of wickedness.
target_text: hèia na peka, aku nèngu na, ‘deo na ja'a dhu peka le, na, ja'a tadhe boe miu! miu se, dhèu dhu tema ad'u-ue bhabhelu di. de pakaj'èu nèti ne'e ne! '

source_text: there shall be weeping and grinding of teeth, when ye shall see abraham, and isaac, and jacob, and all the prophets in the kingdom of god; and you to be put out.
target_text: ladhe d'ai lod'o ama lamatua pama'ète lii langu dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne, miu tangi roma iisi dènge kadhi ngutu lii kico-kico. te miu ladhe mèdhi baki abraham, isak dènge yakob, dènge dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua, madhèdi le ètu sorga. te ngaa miu lèke babège asa li'u.

source_text: and they shall come from the east and the west, and from the north and the south, and shall sit at the meat in the realm of god.
target_text: pe dhèu mai nèti suu-suu rai-haha ne, nèti dhimu, nèti haa; nèti badae, nèti balèu, ho aa'i-aa'i ra madhèdi pa'èci, ra'a-rinu rame-rame ètu d'ara èmu ama lamatua.

source_text: and lo! they that were the first, be the last; and they that were the last, be the first.
target_text: patadhe pabe'a-be'a j'ara ne'e: ladhe d'ai ka lod'o lamatua pama'ète lii langu dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne, abhu dhèu dhu uru èèna, pangee, na, nèngu ana iiki d'ai seli, aa te ngaa nèngu kab'ua titu kèna. aa abhu dhu uru èèna peka, na, nèngu dhèu kapai, te ngaa ètu madha lamatua, nèngu dhoka ana iiki di.

source_text: in that day some of the pharisees came nigh, and said to him, go out, and go from hence, for herod will slay thee.
target_text: lod'o èèna, abhu dhèu parisi pèri-pèri, mai paraga dènge yesus, ka ra peka, na, hua iia ama mese pakaj'èu nèti era ne'e, te dhèu aae herodes neo pamadhe ama.

source_text: and he said to them, go ye, and say to that fox, lo! i cast out fiends, and i make perfectly healings, today and tomorrow, and the third day i am ended. nevertheless it behooveth me today, and tomorrow, and the day that pursueth, to walk; for it falleth not for a prophet to perish out of jerusalem.
target_text: ka yesus dhaa, aku nèngu na, herodes ne, cakaraa badha dhu d'èlu-mèu kapod'e-kabèli. lami peka dènge nèngu, na, ja'a bata eele nidhu dènge pa'èle dhèu nèti papèd'a-tarègu ra, deo ne'e ne dènge bèli. camèd'a ku, sasab'a ja'a ne heka èle kèna. masi ka tasa mera mia èèna ka, nèti kakako ja'a asa yerusalem ne, ja'a neo sab'a hari ku ciki. te dhèu yerusalem sèra, dhu d'èi pamadhe dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua.

source_text: jerusalem, jerusalem, that slayest prophets, and stonest them that be sent to thee, how oft would i gather together thy sons, as a bird gathereth his nest under feathers or under wings, and thou wouldest not.
target_text: waa, dhèu kabarai yerusalem, ee! miu dhu loe boe pamadhe dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua, aa pèci pamadhe dhèu pajuu-paleha sèra dhu mai pad'elo j'ara hia miu. pèri-pèri hari le, ja'a neo kaboko miu ho bhiri mi nèti bhelu-katub'a, nuka sèmi manu rena dhu sarimu nare ana na ètu d'ara èla na. te ngaa miu mo'o boe.

source_text: lo! your house shall be left to you desert. and i say to you, that ye shall not see me, till it come, when ye shall say, blessed is he, that cometh in the name of the lord.
target_text: limuri ne, lamatua pusi-pahae heka èmu manèngi-mangaj'i miu. bèli-camèd'a nèngu j'aj'i èmu pa'ela. èèna na, miu mèdhi heka ja'a, toke miu dhaa, na, ‘ama lamatua hia mèngi-nale mi dhèu dhu mai nèti kolongara ama lamatua, lula ama lamatua ka dhu hia na mai! '

source_text: and it was done, when he had entered into the house of a prince of pharisees, in the sabbath, to eat bread, they espied him.
target_text: ca lod'o, lèke dènge lod'o manèngi-mangaj'i, ca dhèu ama nèti partei agama parisi nèru yesus ho ra'a-sisi ètu èmu na. ropa yesus madhèdi na'a, abhu dhèu dhu ma'u, neo rèdhi ne tao ngaa lèke dènge lod'o manèngi-mangaj'i.

source_text: and lo! a man sick in the dropsy was before him.
target_text: lod'o èèna, ca dhèu dhu pèd'a boho madhèdi ètu èèna kahèi.

source_text: and jesus answering spake to the wise men of the law, and to the pharisees, and said, whether it is leaveful to heal in the sabbath?
target_text: hèia yesus karèi dhèu d'èlu-mèu atora yahudi dènge dhèu parisi dhu madhèdi ra'a ètu sèra kahèi, aku nèngu na, madhutu atora nèti baki musa, bisa pa'èle dhèu pèd'a lèke dènge lod'o sabaj'a, do aad'o?

source_text: and they held peace. and jesus took, and healed him, and let him go.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu èci sa bhoka boe hèb'a. hèia yesus gai dhèu pèd'a ne, ka na èle dènge nèti papèd'a na. ka yesus pua dhèu ne, sèna ka lèpa ka.

source_text: and he answered to them, and said, whose ass or ox of you shall fall into a pit, and he shall not anon draw him out in the day of sabbath?
target_text: èle ka yesus karèi hari si, peka na, ladhe ana èci manahu asa d'ara èi lèke dènge lod'o sabaj'a, miu lami ère eele ana ne'e, do aad'o? ladhe sapi manahu asa d'ara èi la'e, miu soro tèke, do, lami kaso ne asa li'u? tatu miu kaso ne asa li'u. de èèna, sasoa na, miu sab'a le, sina ma?

source_text: and they might not answer to him to these things.
target_text: ropa tadèngi lii padhai yesus ne, èci sa bisa boe dhaa.

source_text: he said also a parable of men bidden to a feast, and he beheld how they chose the first sitting places, and said to them,
target_text: lod'o èèna, yesus taru kira mi dhèu mai ra'a-sisi ètu d'ara èmu ne. dhèu ae ka dhu d'èi era re madha, ho lasi madhèdi. ropa nèdhi sèmi èèna, yesus peka,

source_text: when thou art bidden to bridals or when thou shalt be bidden to weddings, sit not at the meat in the first place; lest peradventure a worthier than thou be bidden of him,
target_text: sanèd'e, ee! ladhe dhèu nèru miu asa pesta kab'i, mage lami madhèdi ka asa era dhèu aae-dhèu kapai. mage dhoka lamatua pesta ne nèru tamu dhu kapai risi.

source_text: and lest he come that called thee and him, and say to thee, give place to this, and then thou shalt begin with shame to hold the lowest place.
target_text: ladhe sèmi èèna, lamatua pesta mai gai èu, peka na, ‘mage mu nasa kahèi, ama! ama pidha sa kabodho, ee. te ja'a tèke kadera ne hia dhèu kapai nèi. ' hèia èu kèd'i dènge makae, tèke eele kadera ne, ka lamu madhèdi asa kabodho.

source_text: but when thou art bidden to a feast, go, and sit down in the last place, that when he cometh, that bade thee to the feast, he say to thee, friend, come up higher. then worship shall be to thee, before men that sit together at the meat.
target_text: de ladhe èu abhu nèru, lamu madhèdi ètu kadera re kabodho tèka. ropa lamatua pesta ladhe nèdhi èu, na mai peka, ‘ama! mai madhèdi asa madha ne. ' dènge j'ara ne, miu abhu pakab'ua ètu madha tamu aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: for each that enhanceth himself, shall be lowed or be made low; and he that meeketh himself, shall be highed.
target_text: te dhèu dhu padedha iisi ra, èèna na lamatua pahaha si. te ngaa dhèu dhu tao iisi ra sèmi dhèu haha, èèna na lamatua ded'e padedha si.

source_text: and he said to him, that had bidden him to the feast, when thou makest a meat, or a supper, do not thou call thy friends, nor thy brethren, neither thy cousins, neither neighbours, nor rich men; lest peradventure they bid thee again to the feast, and it be yielded again to thee.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus peka dènge lamatua èmu ne, lod'o leo, ladhe ama neo tao tatao, mage nèru dhoka a'ari ama dènge dhèu kaja sèra mesa ra! te tatu rèngu bisa nèru hari ama.

source_text: but when thou makest a feast, call poor men, feeble men, crooked, and blind,
target_text: te ngaa ladhe ama tao tatao, nèru dhèu dhu dènge boe ngaa-ngaa, dhèu haga roe cabèka, dhèu karuku, dènge dhèu bèdhu sèra.

source_text: and thou shalt be blessed; for they have not whereof to yield again to thee, for it shall be yielded to thee in the rising again of just men.
