target_text: tatu rèngu b'ala rare boe ama. te ngaa ladhe ama nèru si, ama lamatua ka dhu b'ala ama. ladhe d'ai lod'o ama lamatua pamamuri hari dhèu-dhèu parcaya dhu madhe le, na bhèlu boe babe'a ama.

source_text: and when one of them that sat together at the meat, had heard these things, he said to him, blessed is he, that shall eat bread in the realm of god.
target_text: ropa tadèngi lii padhai lii yesus ne, ca dhèu dhu madhèdi ca mei dènge yesus, padhai lii, peka na, dhu karej'e risi ka, rèngu dhu madhutu ra'a pa'èci ètu d'ara èmu ama lamatua!

source_text: and he said to him, a man made a great supper, and called many.
target_text: ka yesus b'ala, peka na, ja'a lolo sèmi ne'e: abhu ca dhèu dhu tao tatao kapai. hèia na nèru dhèu ae titu kèna.

source_text: and he sent his servant in the hour of supper, to say to men that were bidden to the feast, that they should come, for now all things be ready.
target_text: ropa d'ai tadha dhèu ra'a-rinu, ka na pua ènu na, la'e paroa dhèu dhu ra nèru sèra, peka na, ‘mai lati ka, te neo mulai pesta kèna. '

source_text: and all began together to excuse them. the first said to him, i have bought a town, and i have need to go out, and see it; i pray thee, have me excused.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu se'e padhai lii rupa-rupa, sèna ka lasi boe asa d'ara pesta. ca dhèu peka sèmi ne'e, ‘ja'a heka hèli kore oka cue, de neo laku ladhe sèku. de mage nasa, te ja'a lake kore boe. '

source_text: and the tother said, i have bought five yokes of oxen, and i go to prove them; i pray thee, have me excused.
target_text: dhèu leo hari peka na, ‘ja'a heka hèli kore sapi maroo rai lèmi pasa. de ja'a neo laku cob'a si. baku nasa, te ja'a lake kore boe! '

source_text: and another said, i have wedded a wife; and therefore i may not come.
target_text: dhèu leo hari peka na, ‘ja'a heka kab'i kèna, de bisa boe dhiu. '

source_text: and the servant turned again, and told these things to his lord. then the husbandman was wroth, and said to his servant, go out swiftly into the great streets and the small streets of the city, and bring in hither poor men, and feeble, and blind men, and crooked.
target_text: ka ènu ne, lèpa peka dènge lamatua na. ropa tadèngi nare, ka nasa titu kèna. hèia na paredha ènu na, aku nèngu na, ‘ladhe sèmi èèna, èu lamu lai-lai! lamu asa j'ara-j'ara, dènge asa sasanga j'ara ètu kota ne'e, sèna ka nèru dhèu dhu dènge boe ngaa-ngaa, dhèu kasia, dhu haga roe cabèka, dhu bèdhu, dènge dhèu-dhèu karuku sèra. '

source_text: and the servant said, lord, it is done, as thou hast commanded, and yet there is a void place.
target_text: ropa tadèngi nare, la'e dènge ka nèru dhèu-dhèu sèra. ka na lèpa hari, hèia na peka dènge lamatua na, aku nèngu na, ‘ama! dhèu se, ka se'e le. te ngaa era madhèdi ae era. '

source_text: and the lord said to the servant, go out into ways and hedges, and constrain men to enter, that mine house be full-filled.
target_text: hèia lamatua na peka, ‘ladhe sèmi èèna, lamu hari asa rae-rae ètu li'u kota, toke d'ai d'ara oka sèi. lamu pamako sad'i cee èèna ka, mèti si mai ho ra madhèdi papènu d'ara pesta ne.

source_text: for i say to you, that none of those men that be called, shall taste my supper.
target_text: nanene, ee! dhèu dhu pahae boe dènge lii nèru ja'a ne, rèngu se re'a boe babe'a tatao ne ciki sa hèi! '

source_text: and much people went with him; and he turned, and said to them,
target_text: ka yesus si lasi taruu asa yerusalem. dhèu ae madhutu ne. hèia na kabib'a ladhe sa rèngu, ka na peka, na,

source_text: if any man cometh to me, and hateth not his father, and mother, and wife, and sons, and brethren, and sisters or sistren, and yet his own life, he may not be my disciple.
target_text: dhèu dhu tare'a-re'a neo madhutu ja'a, nèngu hud'i sue ku ja'a risi nèti ngaa-ngaa aa'i-aa'i ra; risi nèti ina-ama na, risi nèti dhèu èmu-kamali na, risi nèti ana niki na, risi nèti a'ari na, aa risi-risi hari nèti ngi'u nèngu unu na. ladhe aad'o, dhèu ne nia boe j'aj'i ana madhutu ja'a.

source_text: and he that beareth not his cross, and cometh after me, may not be my disciple.
target_text: te dhèu dhu d'èi boe pasae j'aj'èra lula nèngu madhutu ja'a, nèngu nia boe j'aj'i dhèu ja'a. dhèu dhu neo j'aj'i dhèu ja'a, masi ka dhèu neo pamadhe ne, te ngaa nèngu pasae j'aj'èra na taruu.

source_text: for who of you willing to build a tower, whether he sit not first or he first sitteth not, and counteth the expenses that be needful, if he have to perform?
target_text: de ladhe neo madhutu ja'a, ngee pabe'a-be'a ku. nuka sèmi dhèu neo tao èmu dhu dènge tad'a-tad'a. nèngu hud'i ige uuru ku, ogo d'ai lutu sela. mage dhoka doi d'ai boe.

source_text: lest after that he hath set the foundament, and may not perform, all that see, begin to scorn him,
target_text: ladhe ige boe paie-iie, ele boe d'ai fanderen di, doi dhu aad'o heka le. ladhe sèmi èèna, dhèu mari madhe aa pamakae ne hèi,

source_text: and say, for this man began to build, and might not make an end.
target_text: peka na, ‘miu ladhe ku dhèu ne'e laa! heka na sab'e fanderen kèna, te ngaa doi na saku aa'i le! '

source_text: or what king that will go to do a battle against another king, whether he sitteth not first, and bethinketh, if he may with ten thousand go to meet him that cometh against him with twenty thousand?
target_text: conto dhu leo, nuka sèmi dhèu lasi pamusu. dhèu aae dhu neo la'e pamusu hud'i madhèdi ku, sèna ka pare'a uuru ku dènge angalai na. ladhe sordad'u rèngu dhoka canguru riho dhèu di, bisa segi musu dua nguru riho dhèu, do aad'o?

source_text: else yet while he is afar, he send-eth a messenger, and prayeth those things that be of peace.
target_text: ladhe ige rare, te ngaa rèngu bisa boe segi, be'a risi lod'o musu dhu kaj'èu era, ra pua dhèu lasi peka sèna ka uri padame.

source_text: so therefore each of you, that forsaketh not or renounceth not all things that he hath, may not be my disciple.
target_text: sama sèmi èèna kahèi, dènge dhèu dhu neo madhutu ja'a. nèngu hud'i kali bagi ku la'e-mai, dhu peka na, nèngu dhu pa'èra le tèke eele aa'i ngaa-ngaa, do aad'o? te ladhe aad'o, na, dhèu ne'e nia boe j'aj'i ana madhutu ja'a.

source_text: salt is good; but if salt vanish, in what thing shall it be savoured? neither in earth, nor in the dunghill it is profitable, but it shall be cast out. he that hath ears of hearing, hear he.
target_text: yesus tuhu lii padhai pake lii pakasame dhu leo hari, na, masi ne, be'a. èdhi pake ne ho pabe'a nganga'a. te ngaa ladhe na sèro heka, j'aj'i ngaa hari? bisa heka pake ne, ho pabe'a nganga'a. neo tao mi pupuk, bisa boe kahèi. dhodhoka core eele iia d'ara di. dhèu cee dhu dènge ro'a dhilu, nanene paie-iie!

source_text: and publicans and sinful men were nighing to him, to hear him.
target_text: lod'o èèna, dhèu roro bea dènge dhèu dhu laku-laku boe mai ae-ae asa yesus, sèna ka nanene lii padhai na. te ngaa dhèu yahudi peka, na, rèngu sèra dhèu karehe.

source_text: and the pharisees and scribes grutched, saying, for this man receiv-eth sinful men, and eateth with them.
target_text: ropa rèdhi sèmi èèna, hèia dhèu parisi dènge mese agama yahudi sèra ka'uu-kamuki, peka na, huuh! dhèu ne pa'angalai dènge dhèu-dhèu dhu laku boe se. ngaa hari na madhèdi na'a-ninu dènge si!

source_text: and he spake to them this parable, and said,
target_text: ropa tadèngi sèmi èèna, ka yesus lolo dènge ra lii pakasame èci, aku nèngu na,

source_text: what man of you that hath an hundred sheep, and if he hath lost one of them, whether he leaveth not ninety and nine in desert, and goeth to it that perished, till he find it?
target_text: ladhe nèti miu abhu ca dhèu dhu unu kahib'i-kalèbho cangasu ngi'u. ka ci'u ele. na tao tasamia? tatu na tèke eele dhu ceo nguru ceo se ètu era dhu be'a, aa la'e tenge dhu ele deo na, toke rage ne.

source_text: and when he hath found it, he joyeth, and layeth or putteth it on his shoulders;
target_text: ropa nèdhi hari kahib'i-kalèbho ne, ka na pasae nèti, dènge karej'e-karae.

source_text: and he cometh home, and calleth together his friends and neighbours, and saith to them, be ye glad with me, for i have found my sheep, that had perished or i had lost.
target_text: d'ai èmu, ka na paroa angalai na aa'i-aa'i, hèia na peka dènge si, ‘mai, sèna ka karej'e dènge ja'a! te kahib'i-kalèbho ja'a dhu ele èèna, kèdhi hari le. '

source_text: and i say to you, so joy shall be in heaven on one sinful man doing penance, more than on ninety and nine just, that have no need to or of penance.
target_text: ètu sorga, sèmi èèna kahèi. ladhe ca dhèu dhu tao sala, hèia ele-ho'a, ka na lèpa hari asa lamatua, ana kabarai sorga aa'i-aa'i ra karej'e-karae. rèngu karej'e risi lula ca dhèu dhu lèpa hari asa lamatua, nèti ceo nguru ceo dhèu dhu mamuri mola, dhu sala boe j'ara.

source_text: or what woman having ten bezants or ten drachmas, and if she hath lost one bezant or one drachma, whether she tendeth not or lighteth not a lantern, and turneth upside-down the house, and seeketh diligently, till she find it?
target_text: ka yesus lolo hari lii pakasame dhu leo èci, peka na, abhu ca dhèu ina, dhu doi iia na canguru bua. ne'a na, dhu ele ca doi. ka na tao tasamia? tatu la'e suru labhu ho d'elo palème era, aa saku èmu ne d'ai ro'a kakilu, sèna ka tenge doi cue dhu ele ne.

source_text: and when she hath found, she calleth together friends and neighbours, and saith, be ye glad with me, for i have found the bezant or the drachma that i had lost.
target_text: ropa nèdhi hari doi ne, na paroa dènge dhèu dhu ètu baboa èmu na sèra, hèia na peka, aku nèngu na, ‘miu mai, ho karej'e sama-sama dènge ja'a. te doi ja'a cue dhu ele deo na, kèdhi hari le! '

source_text: so i say to you, joy shall be before the angels of god on one sinful man doing penance.
target_text: ètu sorga sèmi èèna kahèi. ladhe abhu ca dhèu dhu tao sala, ka na ele-ho'a, ho lèpa hari asa ama lamatua, tatu ana pajuu ètu sorga aa'i-aa'i ra karej'e-karae.

source_text: and he said, a man had two sons;
target_text: hèia yesus tuhu hari lii padhai na dènge lii pakasame kahèi, peka na, ama ca dhèu dènge ana mone na dhèu dua.

source_text: and the younger of them said to the father or to his father, father, give me the portion of chattel or substance that falleth to me. and he parted to them the chattel or the substance.
target_text: ca lod'o, ana limuri peka dènge ama na, aku nèngu na, ‘ama! hia ka pala ja'a nèti pusaka sèra, deo ne'e ne kahèi! ' hèia ama na bagi hia dua ra pusaka na, sèna ka èci-èci dènge pala ra.

source_text: and not after many days, when all things were gathered together, the younger son went forth in pilgrimage into a far country; and there he wasted his goods or his substance in living lecherously.
target_text: nèbhu boe ka ana limuri ne pahie unu na. hèia na lalau mèdha na, ka la'e asa rae kaj'èu. ètu era nèi, ana limuri ne pasaku aa'i-aa'i doi-dhari na, ho pakarej'e iisi.

source_text: and after that he had ended all things, a strong hunger was made in that country, and he began to have need.
target_text: ropa doi na èle aa'i mèu-mèu, rai ne dhu lèke manganga bia, ka mamuri ana ne j'èra d'ai seli.

source_text: and he went, and drew him to one of the citizens of that country. and he sent him into his town, to feed swine or hogs.
target_text: ka la'e tenge sasab'a. hèia ca dhèu nèti kabarai èèna hia na panga'a hahi.

source_text: and he coveted to fill his womb of the pods that the hogs ate, and no man gave to him.
target_text: lula ana ne manganga d'ai seli, ka neo na'a nganga'a hahi se. te abhu boe ca dhèu sa hia ne na'a.

source_text: and he turned again to himself, and said, how many hired men in my father's house have plenty of loaves; and i perish here through hunger.
target_text: nèbhu-nèbhu, ka na pangee la'e-mai, aku nèngu na, ‘anga ee! ja'a ètu ne'e, oe madhe manganga kèna. te ngaa ètu d'ara èmu ama ku, dhèu sab'a ra'a toke bècu.

source_text: i shall rise up, and go to my father, and i shall say to him, father, i have sinned into or against heaven, and before thee;
target_text: de be'a risi ja'a lèpa hari asa ama ku, ho peka dènge ne, ama! ja'a tao le sala dhu kapai titu kèna, mi lamatua dènge ama.

source_text: and now i am not worthy to be called thy son, make me as one of thine hired men.
target_text: ja'a nia boe j'aj'i ana ama ku. hud'i laa ama sèmi more ja'a ne j'aj'i mi kuli ètu d'ara èmu ama, ngaa-ngaa tao boe! '

source_text: and he rose up, and came to his father. and when he was yet afar, his father saw him, and was stirred by mercy. and he ran, and fell on his neck, and kissed him.
target_text: ropa pangee nare sèmi èèna, hèia na kèd'i dènge ka, lèpa la'e asa èmu ama na. nèti kaj'èu era, ama na ladhe nèdhi le nèngu, ka ama na rasa kasia. ka na puru nèti èmu, rai la'e soru nare ana dhu lèpa hari ne. hèia na liku nare, ka uu ne.

source_text: and the son said to him, father, i have sinned into or against heaven, and before thee; and now i am not worthy to be called thy son.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ana ne peka dènge ama na, aku nèngu na, ‘ama! ja'a ne tao le sala dhu kapai mi dedha lamatua dènge ama ku. ja'a nia heka j'aj'i hari ana ama. '

source_text: and the father said to his servants, swiftly bring ye forth the first stole, and clothe ye him, and give ye a ring in his hand, and shoes on his feet;
target_text: te ngaa ama na paredha dènge ka dhèu-dhèu sab'a na, peka na, ‘karohe! lami mere kodho madhera dhu be'a risi, ho papake ne. mere kadheli, ho pasaluu mi kacui-aai na. aa papake salapa mi haga na.

source_text: and bring ye a fat calf or a calf made fat, and slay ye, and eat we, and make we feast.
target_text: lami ère mere sapi kab'oi èèna ho pare, te èdhi neo ta'a-tinu rame-rame.

source_text: for this my son was dead, and hath lived again; he perished, and is found. and all men began to eat gladly.
target_text: lula ana ja'a ne, nuka sèmi dhu madhe le, te ngaa na mamuri hari. nèngu dhu ele le, te ngaa ja'a abhu hari ne. ' na padhai lii èle sèmi èèna, ka mulai ra'a-rinu aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: but his elder son was in the field; and when he came, and nighed to the house, he heard a symphony and a crowd.
target_text: lod'o èèna, ana uuru dhu aad'o ètu èmu, te na sab'a ètu d'ara oka. ropa na lèpa, nèti kaj'èu era, na tadèngi le dhèu karihu musiik dènge roge-ledho.

source_text: and he called one of the servants, and asked, what these things were.
target_text: ka na paroa nare dhèu sab'a ca dhèu, hèia na karèi, aku nèngu na, ee! tao rarame ngaa ètu ne'e?

source_text: and he said to him, thy brother is come, and thy father slew a fat or a fatted calf, for he received him safe.
target_text: hèia dhèu sab'a ne dhaa, peka na, ‘ari mu lèpa hari le. de ama mu pua pare sapi, sèna ka tao pesta kapai, te ana na lèpa hari dènge sod'a. '

source_text: and he was wroth, and would not come in. therefore his father went out, and began to pray him.
target_text: ropa tadèngi nare, hèia ana uuru ne pasaree. na no'o boe maso asa d'ara èmu. ka ama na la'e rarange ne.

source_text: and he answered to his father, and said, lo! so many years i serve thee, and i never brake thy commandment; and thou never gave to me a kid, that i with my friends should have eaten.
target_text: te ngaa na ka'ugu, peka na, ‘ama! pangee ku laa! nèbhu nare sange ne'e, ja'a sab'a toke èi kabhèsu hae, nuka sèmi kuli sa, hia mi ama. ja'a ne ke'a boe sisu dad'èi ama. masi ka sèmi èèna, abhu mèka ama hia ana kahib'i ci'u, sèna ka ja'a pakarej'e dènge mone aanga-angalai ja'a.

source_text: but after that this thy son, that hath devoured his substance with whores, came, thou hast slain to him a fat or a fatted calf.
target_text: te ngaa ropa ana ama dhu bhera-lelu doi-dhari ama, ho la'e karihu dènge bhèni karehe, lèpa hari mai, ka ama pare sapi kab'oi na, tao pesta aae hia ne. '

source_text: and he said to him, son, thou art evermore with me, and all my things be thine.
target_text: te ngaa ama na b'ala, aku nèngu na, ‘ana pasue, ee! nanene paie-iie. nèbhu nare sange ne'e, èu ne bera-bera dènge ja'a. aa'i-aa'i dhu unu ja'a, sèra sa unu èu kahèi.

source_text: but it behooved to make feast, and to have joy; for this thy brother was dead, and lived again or liveth again; he perished, and is found.
target_text: te ngaa limuri ne, èdhi hud'i karej'e dènge karae ku, lula ari mu ca dhèu ne. uru èèna, nuka sèmi dhu madhe le, te ngaa limuri ne mamuri hari. nèngu dhu ele le, te ngaa abhu hari. '

source_text: he said also to his disciples, there was a rich man, that had a bailiff or a farmer; and this was denounced to him, as he had wasted his goods.
target_text: ka yesus hia lii upama èci mi ana madhutu na, peka na, dhèu kaja ca dhèu dhu ded'e dhèu sab'a na èci j'aj'i kapala urusan. te ngaa nèbhu-nèbhu, na tadèngi dhèu palolo, peka na, kapala urusan ne mulai kapod'e-kabèli ka parugi nèngu.

source_text: and he called him, and said to him, what hear i this thing of thee? yield reckoning of thy bailiffship, for thou might not now be bailiff, yield reason of thy farm, or for now thou shalt no more hold the farm.
target_text: hèia dhèu kaja ne paroa kapala urusan na, ka peka dènge ne, ‘èu ne, tasamia? ja'a tadèngi, na, èu kapod'e mèdha-panyau ja'a. de lamu suri ku ngaa dhu èu ad'u-ue ètu d'ara sasab'a èu, ho ja'a parisa ku. ladhe parisa kore, ja'a kalua eele èu. '

source_text: and the bailiff said within himself, what shall i do, for my lord taketh away from me the bailiffship? delve may i not, i shame to beg. forsooth the farmer said within himself, what shall i do, for my lord taketh away from me the farm? i may not delve, i am ashamed to beg?
target_text: ropa na tadèngi nare, hèia kapala urusan ne mulai pajiko, na, ‘ja'a ne j'èra kèna! ja'a neo sab'a ngaa hari? pare rai, ja'a èra boe. j'aj'i dhèu hèb'a mènyi, ja'a makae.

source_text: i know what i shall do, that when i am removed from the bailiffship or from the farm, they receive me into their houses.
target_text: ladhe ja'a sab'a heka ètu ne'e, ja'a hud'i tenge j'ara ku, sèna ka dhèu leo bisa hari sèmi rare ja'a ho sab'a. '

source_text: therefore when all the debtors of his lord were called together, he said to the first, how much owest thou to my lord?
target_text: nèti èèna ka, na paroa nare aa'i dhèu dhu pakèlu lamatua na. na karèi dhèu uru, aku nèngu na, ‘ee! kèlu èu ca ngaa ètu lamatua ja'a? '

source_text: and he said, an hundred barrows of oil. and he said to him, take thy caution or thine obligation, and sit soon, and write fifty.
target_text: dhèu ne dhaa, peka na, ‘ja'a dhu pakèlu èi lèngi saitun èpa riho liter. ' hèia kapala urusan ne peka, na, ‘tare'a. sasuri pakèlu èu ka ne'e. ciu eele ka, madhèdi ho suri gati sasuri kèlu dhu hiu, peka na, kèlu èu dua riho liter di. '

source_text: afterward he said to another, and how much owest thou? which answered, an hundred cors or measures of wheat. and he said to him, take thy letters, and write fourscore.
target_text: ka karèi dhèu pakèlu ka dua, peka na, ‘aa èu hari, kèlu ca ngaa? ' ka dhèu ne dhaa, na, ‘ja'a pakèlu are, cariho karo. ' hèia kapala urusan ne peka, na, ‘ciu eele sasuri dhui èèna, ho suri dhu hiu hari, peka na, kèlu èu, aru ngasu karo di. '

source_text: and the lord praised the bailiff or the farmer of wickedness, for he had done prudently; for the sons of this world be more prudent in their generation, than the sons of light.
target_text: na tao sèmi ne'e ka, toke lamatua na ne'a tatao nèngu. te ngaa lamatua ne hud'i mangaku, na, dhèu kapala urusan dhu bhelu ne mema mèu kapod'e-kabèli. de ja'a lolo lii upama ne, sèna ka miu me'a, na, ladhe pasoro dènge dhèu parcaya, dhèu dhu parcaya boe d'èlu-mèu risi tenge j'ara ho pa'oto ngi'u ra ètu talora aae kabarai limuri ne.

source_text: and i say to you, make ye to you friends of the riches of wickedness, that when ye shall fail, they receive you into everlasting tabernacles.
target_text: miu ngee sèku. masi ka dhèu rai-haha ne karihu kaj'alu re mèdha-panyau ra, te ngaa be'a risi miu pake mèdha-panyau miu sèra, ho soru-bara dhèu. dènge j'ara sèmi èèna, miu abhu angalai ae. masi ka mèdha se èle, te ngaa bèli-camèd'a lamatua tao tèke era hia miu ètu sorga.

source_text: he that is true or faithful in the least thing, is true or faithful also in the more; and he that is wicked in a little thing, is wicked also in the more.
target_text: ladhe dhèu mola ètu j'ara dhu ana iiki, tatu na mola kahèi ètu j'ara-j'ara dhu kapai. te ngaa ladhe dhèu mèu kapod'e ètu j'ara dhu ana iiki, tatu na kapod'e kahèi ètu j'ara dhu kapai.

source_text: therefore if ye were not true in the wicked thing of riches or in the wicked riches, who shall betake to you that that is very? or that is sooth?
target_text: ladhe dhèu parcaya heka miu, ho uri mèdha-panyau ètu j'ara-j'ara dhu ana iiki ètu rai-haha ne, tasamia ka lamatua parcaya miu ètu j'ara-j'ara dhu kapai?

source_text: and if ye were not true in other men's thing, who shall give to you that that is yours?
target_text: ladhe miu bisa boe uri mèdha-panyau dhèu leo, na, dhèu cee ka dhu bani ho hia miu mèdha-panyau ra?

source_text: no servant may serve to two lords; for either he shall hate the one, and love the other; either he shall draw or cleave to the one, and despise the other. ye may not serve to god and to riches.
target_text: dhèu sab'a èci bisa boe nanene dua lamatua. te aad'o na, nèngu d'èi boe èci, aa sue èci. nèngu d'ara kateme dènge ca dhèu, te ngaa pusi boe dènge èci. sèmi èèna kahèi dènge miu. te dhèu bisa boe sue ama lamatua palere dènge sue doi-dhari.

source_text: but the pharisees, that were covetous, heard all these things, and they scorned him.
target_text: lod'o èèna, abhu dhèu parisi pèri-pèri dhu nanene lii padhai yesus deo na. ka ra sasei ne, lula rèngu se dhèu manga'a doi-dhari.

source_text: and he said to them, ye it be, that justify you before men; but god hath known your hearts or god knoweth your hearts, for that that is high to men, is abomination before god.
target_text: te ngaa yesus peka dènge si, masi ka miu pamèu iisi ètu madha dhèu, te ngaa ama lamatua ne'a d'ara bhelu miu. abhu j'ara ae dhu dhèu rai-haha ded'e padedha-dedha, te ngaa ama lamatua peka na, j'ara sèra karehe, aa dhu madenge dènge rèngu.

source_text: the law and the prophets till to john; from that time the realm of god is evangelized or is preached, and each man doeth violence into it.
target_text: toke mamai yohanis tuka sarani, èdhi dhèu yahudi muri madhutu atora nèti baki musa aa nèti dhèu rèti lii padhai lamatua. te ngaa limuri ne, lii lolo be'a nèti lamatua pale-lème le ètu mia-mia. dhèu ae dhu tenge le j'ara, sèna ka ra mamuri madhutu dad'èi lamatua.

source_text: forsooth it is lighter heaven and earth to pass, than that one tittle fall from the law.
target_text: masi ka dedha-liru dènge rai-haha ne ele, te ngaa atora nèti ama lamatua ciki sa, ele boe. ca katèd'a sa ele boe hèi!

source_text: every man that forsaketh his wife, and weddeth another, doeth lechery or adultery; and he that weddeth the wife forsaken of the husband, doeth adultery.
target_text: dhèu dhu pa'ia-pa'ela dènge dhèu èmu na, aa na madhèdi hari dènge bhèni leo, nèngu bersina. aa dhèu dhu leo dènge bhèni dhu pa'ia-pa'ela, nèngu bersina kahèi.

source_text: there was a rich man, and was clothed in purple, and white silk, and ate every day shiningly.
target_text: ka yesus lole tabha hari, peka na, abhu dhèu kaja ca dhèu. nèngu d'èi pake mèdha-papake dhu be'a-be'a, tao nèti bèla alus. mèu-mèda na'a-ninu nganga'a dhu be'a hua, aa karae taruu.

source_text: and there was a beggar, lazarus by name, that lay at his gate full of boils,
target_text: ètu kota ne'e, abhu kahèi ca dhèu dhu dènge boe ngaa-ngaa. ngara na, lasarus. ngi'u na dhu pènu dènge kamèu. bèli-bèli angalai na rèti pamadhèdi ne ètu hèb'a tedhe dhèu kaja èèna.

source_text: and coveted to be fulfilled of or with the crumbs, that fell down from the rich man's board, and no man gave to him; but hounds came, and licked his boils.
target_text: na sanao teko-teko abhu kaha'i nganga'a nèti dhèu kaja ne, sèna ka bisa na'a, te ngaa na abhu boe ngaa-ngaa. dhoka busa di mai, ho j'ore nana kamèu na.

source_text: and it was done, that the beggar died, and was borne of angels into abraham's bosom. and the rich man was dead also, and was buried in hell.
target_text: nèbhu boe ka, lasarus madhe. hèia ana pajuu ama lamatua mai nèti sorga, ka rèti lasi pamadhèdi ne ètu baboa abraham. aa nèbhu boe ka, dhèu kaja ne madhe kahèi, ka dhèu ded'e lasi padhane.

source_text: and he raised up his eyes, when he was in torments, and saw abraham afar, and lazarus in his bosom.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu kaja ne maso boe sorga. nèngu maso asa d'ara naraka, sama-sama dènge dhèu-dhèu leo dhu madhe le. ètu era nèi, dhèu kaja ne abhu j'aj'èra taa-taa. ca tèka na boti kètu, ka ladhe nèdhi lasarus madhèdi ètu baboa baki abraham.

source_text: and he cried, and said, father abraham, have mercy on me, and send lazarus, that he dip the end of his finger in water, and cool my tongue; for i am tormented in this flame.
target_text: hèia na pa'oo, peka na, ‘baki abraham, ee! sue ku ja'a laa! pua ku lasarus cèb'u kolo ai na asa d'ara èi, sèna ka mai pabasa ku kolo he'o ja'a ne. te ja'a j'èra titu kèna ètu d'ara ai naraka ne! '

source_text: and abraham said to him, son, have mind, for thou hast received good things in thy life, and lazarus also evil things; but he is now comforted, and thou art tormented.
target_text: te ngaa abraham dhaa, peka na, ‘ana, ee! sanèd'e ku! uru èèna lod'o èu mamuri era ètu rai-haha nèi, èu abhu le aa'i-aa'i dhu be'a. te ngaa lasarus ne, unu dhodhoka sasusa di. ka limuri ne, lamatua pakarej'e ne ètu ne'e, te ngaa èu pasae more j'aj'èra.

source_text: and in all these things a great dark place or great dark depth is stablished betwixt us and you; that they that will from hence pass to you, may not, neither from thence pass over hither.
target_text: risi-risi hari, ètu talora aae èu dènge ji'i, lamatua tao tèke loe aae èci dhu taleo dènge marèma. de dhèu nèti ne'e bisa boe dhiu asa era èèna, aa dhèu nèti èèna bisa boe pège sa ne'e mai. '

source_text: and he said, then i pray thee, father, that thou send him into the house of my father.
target_text: hèia dhèu kaja ne pamako hari, aku nèngu na, ‘ladhe sèmi èèna, baki abraham pua lasarus la'e asa èmu ama ku.

source_text: for i have five brethren, that he witness to them, lest also they come into this place of torments.
target_text: te ja'a ne dènge ari dhèu mone, dhèu lèmi era. sèna ka lasarus la'e pasanèd'e si, ho ra lèpa ka asa lamatua. masi ka lod'o d'ai ra madhe, rèngu maso ia ka asa era j'aj'èra ne. '

source_text: and abraham said to him, they have moses and the prophets; hear they them.
target_text: te ngaa abraham b'ala ne, ‘ama lamatua hia le rèngu sasuri nèti baki musa dènge dhèu rèti lii padhai na. ari mu si, bisa baca pahari-pahari ho re'a dad'èi lamatua. '

source_text: and he said, nay, father abraham, but if any of dead men go to them, they shall do penance.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu kaja ne pasisu, peka na, ‘baki abraham, ee! èèna dhae d'ai mèka. rèngu sèi pahae boe lii holo-nori ama lamatua! hud'i abhu ku ca dhèu nèti talora dhèu madhe la'e asa rèngu, heka rèngu ele-ho'a, aa neo nanene kèna. '

source_text: and he said to him, if they hear not moses and the prophets, neither if any of dead men rise again, they shall believe to him.
target_text: te ngaa abraham dhaa, peka na, ‘ladhe rèngu sèi ro'o boe nanene lii holo-nori nèti musa dènge nèti dhèu rèti lii padhai lamatua, na, masi ka dhèu madhe bhodho nèti d'ara ro'a ra, ho padhai lii dènge rèngu èèna ka, rèngu ro'o boe nanene. '

source_text: and jesus said to his disciples, it is impossible that causes of stumbling come not; but woe to that man, by whom they come.
target_text: yesus peka dènge ana madhutu na, ae ka dhèu manahu asa d'ara sasala, lula tatao dhèu leo. te ngaa dhèu dhu pamanahu dhèu asa d'ara sasala èèna, pasae nare mamadhe-mamopo.

source_text: it is more profitable to him, if a millstone be put about his neck, and he be cast into the sea, than that he cause to stumble one of these little.
target_text: ladhe dhèu ad'u-ue j'ara karehe, toke ana iiki parcaya boe ja'a, èèna na ama lamatua huku ne bia. dhu samaa risi, ladhe èki ladha goro dhèu ne'e dènge hadhu aae cue, ho parèu eele asa d'ara dhasi ètu talora lèu.

source_text: take ye heed to yourselves; if thy brother hath sinned against thee, blame him; and if he do penance, forgive him.
target_text: de j'aga ngi'u pabe'a-be'a, sèna ka miu baku pamanahu dhèu asa d'ara sasala! te ngaa ladhe a'ari mu tao sala, pasanèd'e ne. ladhe na ele-ho'a, hèia na mai manèngi abho, na pabhèlu eele sasala na.

source_text: and if seven times in the day he do sin against thee, and seven times in the day he be converted to thee, and say, it repenteth me, forgive thou him.
target_text: ladhe a'ari èu tao sala pidhu hari d'ara ca lod'o, ka na ele-ho'a, hèia na mai pidhu hari ho manèngi abho, èu hud'i pabhèlu eele sasala na pidhu hari kahèi.

source_text: and the apostles said to the lord, increase to us faith or increase faith to us.
target_text: ca lod'o, ana madhutu se mai asa yesus, ka ra manèngi, aku rèngu na, ama mese! parcaya ji'i se èra boe. de ama pa'èra ku parcaya ji'i.

source_text: and the lord said, if ye have faith as the corn or a corn of sinapi, ye shall say to this sycamore tree, be thou drawn up by the root, and be over-planted or planted over into the sea, and it shall obey to you.
target_text: hèia yesus dhaa, peka na, ladhe miu parcaya koasa nèti ama lamatua, masi ka ciki oo'e èèna ka, te ngaa miu bisa paredha aj'u aae ne, ‘tahoi eele, ho pidha asa d'ara dhasi! ' ka aj'u ne madhutu lii paredha miu.

source_text: but who of you hath a servant earing, or pasturing oxen, which saith to him, when he turneth again from the field, anon go, and sit to or at the meat;
target_text: èle ka yesus lii, aku nèngu na, tare conto èci. nuka sèmi ènu dhu pare rai ètu d'ara oka, do, ladhe kahib'i-kalèbho ètu d'ara pad'a sod'a. sab'a nare, ka lèpa sa èmu. tatu lamatua na peka boe dènge ne, ‘mai ho dua ti ta'a sama-sama! '

source_text: and saith not to him, make ready, that i sup, and gird thee, and serve me, while i eat and drink, and after this thou shalt eat and drink;
target_text: aad'o, sina ma? dhu lèke ka, lamatua paredha ne, peka na, ‘lamu lalau mei hia ja'a. ku'a-kinu kore ku, pe èu mu'a-minu ètu kabodho nèi! '

source_text: whether he hath grace to that servant, for he did that that he commanded him? nay, i guess.
target_text: ladhe ènu ne lalau nare madhutu dad'èi lamatua na, miu ngee, na, lamatua ne manèngi makasi mi ènu ne, do? aad'o!

source_text: so also ye, when ye have done all things that be commanded to you, say ye, we be unprofitable servants, we have done that that we ought to do.
target_text: miu èci èèna kahèi. ladhe sab'a mere aa'i dhu lamatua paredha le, miu peka na, ‘ji'i dhoka ana pua-paleha di. ji'i tenge boe lii koa-kad'iri. ji'i dhoka pakako sasab'a-la'a ji'i di. '

source_text: and it was done, the while jesus went to jerusalem, he passed through the midst of samaria, and galilee.
target_text: lod'o yesus si lasi asa yerusalem, rèngu d'ai too propensi galilea dènge propensi samaria.

source_text: and when he entered into a castle, ten leprous men came to meet him, which stood afar,
target_text: ropa rèngu neo maso asa d'ara rae cue ètu èèna, dhèu canguru dhu pèd'a kusta mai, neo paraga dènge yesus. rèngu se titu nèti kaj'èu.

source_text: and raised up their voice, and said, jesus, commander, have mercy on us.
target_text: ka ra pa'oo palere-lere, peka na, yesus! mone kapai, ee! sue ku ji'i laa!

source_text: and as he saw them, he said, go, show ye you to the priests. and it was done, while they went, they were cleansed.
target_text: ropa yesus tadèngi lii pa'oo ra, ka na ladhe si, hèia na pua, aku nèngu na, lami pad'elo uuru ku isi miu asa ama agama, sèna ka ra parisa papèd'a kusta miu sèra, èle le, do dhae! ra tadèngi sèmi èèna, ka lasi dènge. te ngaa ropa d'ai talora j'ara, cag'ag'a laa, rèngu dhu èle le nèti kusta.

source_text: and one of them, as he saw that he was cleansed, went again, magni-fying god with a great voice.
target_text: rèngu lasi taruu dènge karej'e-karae. te ngaa abhu ca dhèu di, dhu lèpa hari mai asa yesus. na pa'oo, peka na, koa-kio lamatua! te ja'a èle le nèti papèd'a!

source_text: and he fell down on the face before his feet, and did thankings or doing graces; and this was a samaritan.
target_text: hèia na patitu kètu urutuu na, ho manèngi makasi ae-ae mi yesus. te'a boe, te nèngu ne dhèu yahudi boe. nèngu ne ca dhèu samaria dhu loe boe tao lii langu dènge dhèu yahudi.

source_text: and jesus answered, and said, whether ten be not cleansed, and where be the nine?
target_text: ka yesus karèi dhèu sèra dhu madhutu dènge ne, aku nèngu na, tasamia, ee? deo na ja'a pa'èle dhèu canguru si? dhu ceo, mia lasi?

source_text: there is none found, that turned again, and gave glory to god, but this alien or this stranger.
target_text: tasamia ka dhoka dhèu leo kara ne'e di, dhu lèpa mai ho manèngi makasi mi ama lamatua, dènge koa-kio kolongara na?

source_text: and he said to him, rise up, go thou; for thy faith hath made thee safe.
target_text: hèia na peka mi dhèu ne, na, èu èle le, lula èu parcaya ja'a tare'a-re'a. de kèd'i, lèpa ka dènge sod'a-mole!

source_text: and he was asked of the pharisees, when the realm of god cometh. and he answered to them, and said, the realm of god cometh not with espying, neither they shall say, lo! here, or lo! there; for lo! the realm of god is within you.
target_text: ca lod'o, dhèu parisi pèri-pèri mai karèi yesus, peka na, ama mese! peka ku dènge ji'i, lod'o mia ama lamatua neo pakako paredha na? ka yesus dhaa, sèmi ne'e. mage mi pangee, na, lamatua pakako paredha na dènge rupa-rupa tadha ètu rai-haha ne, dhu dhèu bisa rèdhi dènge musi madha ra. dhèu abhu boe tadha dhu peka na, ‘ladhe ku asa ne'e mai! te ama lamatua pakako paredha na ètu ne'e! ' do, ‘na pakako paredha na ètu nèi! ' aad'o! te na pakako paredha na ètu talora aae miu, ètu d'ara dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: and he said to his disciples, days shall come, when ye shall desire to see one day of man's son, and ye shall not see.
target_text: hèia yesus peka dènge ana-ana madhutu na, nèbhu boe, na, ja'a, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne, pa'èci heka dènge miu. d'ai ka lod'o j'aj'èra sèra, miu d'èi titu kèna neo mèdhi mamai hari ja'a. te ngaa d'ai mèka lod'o mamai ja'a.

source_text: and they shall say to you, lo! here, and lo! there. do not ye go, neither pursue;
target_text: ladhe èèna na dhèu mai peka, na, ‘kristus ètu ne'e! ' do, ‘kristus ètu nèi! ' na, miu baku bhute ho patangi-tenge, te lii padhai rèngu sèra, kapod'e-kabèli.

source_text: for as lightning shining from under heaven shineth into or on those things that be under heaven, so shall man's son be in his day.
target_text: te ladhe dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne, lèpa hari mai, tadha na dhu mèu aadha-aadha, nuka sèmi bela dhu heo kacèb'a ètu dedha-liru nèti suu asa suu.

source_text: but first it behooveth him to suffer many things, and to be reproved of this generation.
target_text: te ngaa nèngu hud'i abhu uuru ku j'aj'èra rupa-rupa. ka dhèu rai-haha taa limuri ne, ro'o boe nanene, aa neo tule eele ne.

source_text: and as it was done in the days of noah, so it shall be in the days of man's son.
target_text: te ngaa bèli-camèd'a, ladhe na neo mai hari, dhèu mamuri karehe sama biasa, èci èèna ka dènge lod'o noh mamuri era.

source_text: they ate and drank, wedded wives, and were given to weddings, till into the day in which noah entered into the ship; and the great flood came, and lost all.
target_text: taa èèna, rèngu ra'a-rinu, tao pesta kab'i toke lod'o noh maso asa d'ara kapa na. te ngaa rèngu ro'o boe nanene kahèi. kaca'a laa, èi aae lala, ka pamadhe aa'i si.

source_text: also as it was done in the days of lot, they ate and drank, bought and sold, planted and builded;
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi, lod'o lot mamuri era, dhèu mamuri karehe titu kèna. taa èèna, rèngu ra'a-rinu, bad'aga, sab'a oka-tedhe, patitu èmu, aa mamuri karehe sèmi biasa.

source_text: but in the day that lot went out of sodom, the lord rained fire and brimstone from heaven, and lost all.
target_text: te ngaa ro'o boe nanene kahèi. hèia mad'ae aae era, ropa lot rai eele nèti kota sodom, cag'ag'a laa, èj'i ai dènge èi nasu bhori mai nèti dedha-liru, aa labhu pakèpu rèngu aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: like this thing it shall be, in what day man's son shall be showed.
target_text: de miu baku pamud'e ku! mage dhoka bèli-camèd'a dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne, lèpa hari mai, dhèu mamuri dhoka sèmi biasa di. te ngaa kaca'a laa, na cèu mai.

source_text: in that hour or that day, he that is in the roof, and his vessels in the house, come he not down to take them away; and he that shall be in the field, also turn not again behind.
target_text: lod'o èèna, dhèu ètu madha èmu, maso ia ka asa d'ara ho lalau mèdha. dhèu dhu sab'a ètu d'ara oka, lèpa ia ka asa èmu ho rare mèdha ra.

source_text: be ye mindful of the wife of lot.
target_text: sanèd'e ku ngaa dhu uru èèna j'aj'i mi dhèu èmu lot. na madhe, lula nèngu ngee mèdha-panyau ètu èmu na.

source_text: whoever seeketh to make his life safe, shall lose it; and whoever loseth it, shall quicken it.
target_text: dhèu dhu d'èi boe madhutu ja'a lula sue ngi'u na, èèna na mamuri na ele iia d'ara. te ngaa dhèu dhu madhutu ja'a toke soro mamuri na, lula sue ja'a, bèli-camèd'a abhu sod'a-mole, aa mamuri taa-taa dènge ama lamatua.

source_text: but i say to you, in that night two shall be in one bed, one shall be taken, and the other forsaken;

source_text: for i dreaded thee, for thou art an austere man; thou takest away that that thou settedest not, and thou reapest that that thou hast not sown.
target_text: ja'a tao sèmi èèna, lula madha'u. ja'a ke'a ama, dhèu nasa. te ama d'èi more ngaa dhu unu boe ama, aa d'èi puu hua dhu ama sèle boe! '

source_text: he saith to him, wicked servant, of thy mouth i deem thee. knewest thou, that i am an austere man, taking away that thing that i setted not, and reaping that thing that i sowed not? or i have not sown?
target_text: ropa dhèu aae tadèngi sèmi èèna, ka na jèke ne, ‘èu ne, dhèu goa d'ara! lii padhai èu ne pabia ngi'u èu mesa mu. èu me'a, na, ja'a dhèu nasa, ho kore ngaa dhu unu boe ja'a, aa puu ngaa dhu ja'a sèle boe.

source_text: and why hast thou not given my money to the board, and i coming should have asked it or should have received it with usuries?
target_text: de ladhe sèmi èèna, nga tao ka lamu boe tèke ne asa bank? ho sèna ka lod'o ja'a lèpa, ja'a bisa abhu leto. masi ka ciki di. '

source_text: and he said to men standing nigh, take away from him the bezant, and give ye it to him that hath ten bezants.
target_text: hèia dhèu aae ne pua dhèu leo ètu sèra, peka na, ‘mere doi nèngu ne, sèna ka hia mi dhèu sab'a dhu abhu leto canguru deo na. '

source_text: and they said to him, lord, he hath ten bezants.
target_text: te ngaa ra pasisu, peka na, ‘ama! dhèu ne abhu ae le. nga tao ka neo more nèti dhèu dhu unu ciki, ho patabha sa nèngu hari? '

source_text: and i say to you, to each man that hath, it shall be given, and he shall increase; but from him that hath not, also that thing that he hath, shall be taken of or from him.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu aae b'ala, peka na, ‘pangee paie-iie ku! ladhe dhèu dhu mèu uri ngaa dhu dhèu hia ne, èèna na nèngu abhu tabha hari. te ngaa dhèu dhu bai-eed'a, èèna na rare aa'i ngaa dhu na unu.

source_text: nevertheless bring ye hither those mine enemies, that would not that i reigned on them, and slay ye before me.
target_text: de lami kèpe mere musu ja'a, dhu ro'o boe ja'a j'aj'i dhèu aae. mèti si mai sa ne'e, sèna ka pamadhe si ètu madha ja'a. lami ka! '

source_text: and when these things were said, he went before, and went up to jerusalem.
target_text: ropa yesus lolo èle, hèia lasi taruu ka asa yerusalem. yesus dhu kako uru.

source_text: and it was done, when jesus came nigh to bethphage and bethany, at the mount, that is called of olivet, he sent his two disciples,
target_text: ropa oe dètu dènge dua rae, nuka betfage dènge betania, dhu ètu karasa ledhe saitun, ka na pua ana madhutu na dhèu dua lasi uru.

source_text: and said, go ye into the castle that is against you; into which as ye enter, ye shall find a colt of an ass tied, on which never man sat; untie ye him, and bring ye to me.
target_text: na pua si peka na, miu dua mi lami asa rae dhu ètu madha nèi. pe miu mèdhi keled'ei ngèru ci'u dhu èki tèke ètu èèna. keled'ei ne, dhèu manya'e rèdhi mèka. mi lècu dhari na, pakako mèti mai.

source_text: and if any man ask you, why ye untie, thus ye shall say to him, for the lord desireth his work.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe abhu dhèu dhu karèi, ‘tasamia ka mi lècu eele dhari keled'ei èèna? ' mi peka dènge si, na, ‘lamatua ji'i neo pake ne. '

source_text: and they that were sent, went forth, and found as he said to them, a colt standing.
target_text: dua ra lasi ka, hèia ra rage keled'ei ngèru nuka sèmi dhu yesus peka.

source_text: and when they untied the colt, the lords of it said to them, what or why untie ye the colt?
target_text: ropa ra lècu dhari keled'ei ne, ka lamatua badha ne karèi si, na, nga tao ka miu patabuli badha ne?

source_text: and they said, for the lord hath need to him.
target_text: ka ra dhaa, aku rèngu na, lamatua ji'i neo pake ne.

source_text: and they led him to jesus; and they casted their clothes on the colt, and set or put jesus on him.
target_text: lamatua badha ne d'èi kahèi, ka dua ra nuni rèti keled'ei asa yesus. ra hèle sig'i-kalolo ra mi dedha kabodho keled'ei ne. èle èèna ka, ra paca'e yesus asa dedha na.

source_text: and when he went, they spreaded their clothes in the way.
target_text: dhèu ae kahèi hèle sig'i-kalolo dènge salalu ra mi j'ara, ho soru yesus nuka sèmi soru dhèu kapai.

source_text: and when he came nigh to the coming down of the mount of olivet, all the people that came down began to joy, and to praise god with great voice on all the virtues, that they had seen,
target_text: ropa na puru nèti ledhe saitun, ka dhèu se dènge ana-ana madhutu na, mulai pa'oo koa-kio kolongara ama lamatua, lula rèngu rèdhi le tadha-tadha koasa.

source_text: and said, blessed be the king, that cometh in the name of the lord; peace in heaven, and glory in high things.
target_text: ra pa'oo peka na, nèngu ne, dhèu aae dhu ama lamatua pua mai! ama lamatua hia ne berkat! dhèu rai-haha limuri ne, bisa padame le dènge lamatua ètu sorga. koa-kio kolongara lamatua dhu madhèdi nèd'u paredha ètu dedha-liru dhu dedha risi.

source_text: and some of the pharisees of the people said to him, master, blame thy disciples.
target_text: te ngaa abhu kahèi dhèu-dhèu parisi ètu talora aae dhèu ae sèra. ka ra peka dènge yesus, ama mese! kai ku dhèu se, ho baku ra pakii-pakèce sèmi ne'e, te seli-kolane!

source_text: and he said to them, i say to you, for if these be still, stones shall cry.
target_text: te ngaa yesus dhaa, peka na, ja'a pasanèd'e mema! ladhe dhèu se'e kutu hèb'a ra, èèna na, hadhu se ka dhu koa-kio kolongara lamatua!

source_text: and when he nighed, he saw the city, and wept on it,
target_text: ropa rèngu oe dètu yerusalem, yesus ladhe nèdhi kota ne, hèia na tangi,

source_text: and said, for if thou haddest known, thou shouldest weep also; for in this day, the things be in peace to thee, but now they be hid from thine eyes.
target_text: peka na, ira ii! dhèu yerusalem, ee! dad'èi ja'a deo ne'e, miu abhu dame dhu ja'a kèti mai. te ngaa lula miu pahae boe lamatua, ka miu unu heka. dame ne pakaj'èu le nèti miu.

source_text: but days shall come in thee or shall come to thee, and thine enemies shall environ thee with a pale, and they shall go about thee, and make thee strait on all sides,
target_text: bèli-camèd'a musu miu mai udhu padedha rai palème li'u tedhe miu ne, hèia ra maso sa d'ara, musu dènge miu.

source_text: and cast thee down to the earth, and thy sons or thy children that be in thee; and they shall not leave in thee a stone upon a stone, for thou hast not known the time of thy visitation.
target_text: ra dhedhe palaho kota miu, toke pamera dènge rai, hèia ra pamadhe aa'i miu dènge ana-ana mi. ra tèke eele boe hadhu cue sa dhu titu, lula miu mo'o boe tadhe lamatua lod'o na mai hia miu mamuri!

source_text: and he entered into the temple, and began to cast out men selling therein and buying,
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus maso asa d'ara èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. ètu madha èmu ne, dhèu tao sèmi pasa sa, ho ra pahia badha korban. ropa nèdhi, hèia yesus babège si nèti era èèna.

source_text: and said to them, it is written, that mine house is an house of prayer, but ye have made it a den of thieves.
target_text: ka na jèke si, peka na, dhèu nèti lii padhai lamatua dhu suri tèke le, peka na, ‘ja'a patitu èmu ne, ho dhèu aa'i-aa'i bisa mai manèngi-mangaj'i ètu era ne'e. ' te ngaa mi tao ne nuka sèmi era pakaboko dhèu parapo.

source_text: and he was teaching every day in the temple. and the princes of priests, and the scribes, and the princes of the people sought to lose him;
target_text: èle èèna ka, bèli-bèli yesus la'e aj'a-nori dhèu ètu èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. te ngaa kètu agama yahudi, mese agama, dènge dhèu heka ad'a yahudi sèra, patangi-tenge j'ara ho neo pamadhe ne.

source_text: and they found not, what they should do to him, for all the people was fervently occupied, and heard him or for to hear him.
target_text: te ngaa ra abhu boe j'ara, lula dhèu ae dhu d'èi titu kèna, nanene lii padhai yesus.

source_text: and it was done in one of the days, when he taught the people in the temple, and preached the gospel or evangelizing, the princes of priests, and the scribes came together with the elder men;
target_text: ca lod'o, yesus la'e asa èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i, ka na aj'a-nori lii lolo be'a lamatua ètu èèna. hèia kètu agama yahudi, mese agama, dènge dhèu heka-dhèu heka ad'a yahudi sèra, mai karèi ne.

source_text: and they said to him, say to us, in what power thou doest these things, or who is he that gave to thee this power?
target_text: ra peka na, mu peka ku laa! cee ka dhu hia èu hak sèna ka ad'u-ue maruru ètu ne'e med'a na?

source_text: and jesus answered, and said to them, and i shall ask you one word; answer ye to me.
target_text: ka yesus b'ala si, ja'a neo karèi miu ca madha j'ara kahèi, heka ja'a dhaa lii karèi miu kèna.

source_text: was the baptism of john of heaven, or of men?
target_text: sèmi ne'e: miu se tadhe yohanis tuka sarani dhèu, do? cee ka dhu hia ne koasa ho sarani dhèu? ama lamatua do, dhèu rai-haha?

source_text: and they thought within them-selves, saying, for if we say, of heaven, he shall say, why then believe ye not to him?
target_text: hèia ra papeka èci dènge èci, ira ee! èdhi sèmi tare le pala ti ngaa. ladhe èdhi peka na, ‘ama lamatua ka pua', èèna na b'ala, aku nèngu na, ‘ladhe sèmi èèna, nga tao ka miu lèka boe yohanis? '

source_text: and if we say, of men, all the people shall stone us; for they be certain, that john is a prophet.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe èdhi dhaa, peka na, ‘dhèu rai-haha ka pua', na dhèu ae sèra pèci pamadhe èdhi. te dhèu sèra parcaya, na, yohanis ne dhèu nèti lii padhai lamatua.

source_text: and they answered, that they knew not, of whence it was.
target_text: ka ra dhaa, peka na, ji'i nge'a boe.

source_text: and jesus said to them, neither i say to you, in what power i do these things.
target_text: hèia yesus peka dènge ra, ladhe sèmi èèna, ja'a ko'o boe peka kahèi, cee ka dhu pua ja'a.

source_text: and he began to say to the people this parable. a man planted a vineyard, and hired it to tillers; and he was gone in pilgrimage long time.
target_text: hèia yesus lolo dènge dhèu ae sèra, pake lii pakasame, peka na, abhu dhèu èci dhu sèle anggor ètu d'ara oka na. na hia dhèu seb'a oka anggor ne, sèna ka rèngu pabagi isi rai nèti oka-tedhe ne. ka na pidha la'e pea panèbhu asa rai kaj'èu.

source_text: and in the time of gathering of grapes, he sent a servant to the tillers, that they should give to him of the fruit of the vineyard; which beat him, and let him go void.
target_text: d'ai hèru puu-g'ètu, hèia lamatua oka anggor ne pua ana paleha na ca dhèu, la'e nare pala nèngu. te ngaa dhèu sab'a oka anggor se, game ana paleha ne, ka ra hia ne lèpa dènge ai hua.

source_text: and he thought yet to send another servant; and also they beat this, and tormented him sore, and let him go void.
target_text: èle èèna ka, lamatua oka ne pua ana paleha na ca dhèu hari. te ngaa dhèu sab'a oka se game, ka ra pamakae ne. hèia ra babège ne lèpa dènge ai hua da'u-da'u.

source_text: and he thought yet to send the third, and him also they wounded, and casted him out.
target_text: èle èèna ka, lamatua oka ne pua hari ana paleha na ka tèlu, te ngaa ra game ne, toke diu raa, ka ra core ne asa li'u oka.

source_text: and the lord of the vineyard said, what shall i do? i shall send my dearworthy son; peradventure, when they see him, they shall dread or they shall be ashamed.
target_text: hèia lamatua oka ne pangee ka, ‘ja'a tao hari ku tasamia? be'a risi ja'a pua ana pasue ja'a ka la'e. ele boe ra pakab'ua ne, de ra sèmi ne dènge be'a. ' de na pua ana d'èlu na la'e.

source_text: and when the tillers saw him, they thought within themselves, and said, this is the heir, slay we him, that the heritage be ours.
target_text: te ngaa ropa dhèu sab'a oka anggor se ladhe rèdhi ne, hèia ra papeka èci dènge èci, aku rèngu na, ‘mi ladhe ku laa! te lamatua oka ne hia ana d'èlu na nuka mai nèi. nèngu ne ka dhu bèli-camèd'a unu pusaka ama na aa'i-aa'i ra. de ta pamadhe ne! sèna ka èdhi ka dhu unu oka anggor ne. '

source_text: and they casted him out of the vineyard, and killed him. what shall then the lord of the vineyard do to them?
target_text: ropa ana ne d'ai, hèia dhèu se nuni pa'oro ne rèti asa li'u oka, ka ra pamadhe ne. de ja'a neo karèi miu sèmi ne'e: miu pangee, na, lamatua oka ne tao dhèu sab'a oka sèra tasamia?

source_text: he shall come, and destroy these tillers, and give the vineyard to others. and when this thing was heard, they said to him, god forbid.
target_text: madhutu a'abhu ja'a, tatu na mai pamadhe aa'i si, ka na hia hari dhèu leo seb'a oka ne. ropa dhèu se tadèngi lii padhai yesus, rèngu peka na, ladhe bisa, na, ji'i baku abhu huku nèti ama lamatua sèmi èèna!

source_text: but he beheld them, and said, what then is this that is written, the stone which men building reproved, this is made into the head of the corner?
target_text: hèia yesus laladhe patae si, ka na karèi, ladhe huku boe si sèmi èèna, nga tao ka dhèu nèti lii padhai lamatua suri, na: ‘hadhu cue dhu tuka hadhu core eele le, te ngaa limuri ne dhu j'aj'i le era padhèdi agarii talora? '

source_text: each that shall fall on that stone, shall be bruised or be broken, but on whom it shall fall, it shall all-break him or it shall break him into small parts.
target_text: dhèu dhu kadhunu lèke hadhu ne, nèngu tatu laho teb'o-teb'o, lula abhu huku. aa ladhe hadhu ne bèbhe lèke dhèu cee, nèngu laho kao-kao, lula lèke huku.

source_text: and the princes of priests, and the scribes, sought to lay on him hands or to lay hands on him in that hour, and they dreaded the people; for they knew that to them he said this likeness.
target_text: ropa mese agama dènge kètu agama yahudi se tadèngi lii lolo ne, rèngu re'a, na, yesus padhai lii padhèto dènge rèngu pake lii pakasame. rèngu se cakaraa dènge dhèu seb'a oka anggor deo sa. de ra nasa titu kèna. ka ra tenge j'ara ho neo kèpe ne. te ngaa rèngu madha'u dènge dhèu ae sèra, dhu d'èi nanene lii aj'a yesus. ka lasi tèke eele ne.

source_text: and they espied, and sent spies, that feigned themselves just, that they should take him in word, and betake him to the power of the prince, and to the power of the justice.
target_text: èle ka, musu-musu yesus ma'u ne. rèngu tenge dhèu j'aj'i mata-mata dhu bisa tao iisi ra sèmi dhèu mola, sèna ka ra kèpe ne. rèngu sanao sèna ka yesus padhai lii dhu palab'a dènge dhèu paredha roma, ho èèna na lasi peka dènge gubernur, sèna ka ra pua dhèu lasi kèpe yesus.

source_text: and they asked him, and said, master, we know, that rightly thou sayest and teachest or that thou sayest and teachest rightly; and thou takest not the person of man, but thou teachest in truth the way of god.
target_text: ka ra pua mata-mata, sèna ka pakarèi dènge yesus, aku rèngu na, ama mese! ji'i nge'a ama ca dhèu dhu d'ara mola. ama me'a boe kapod'e-kabèli, aa hag'e boe dhèu. ama aj'a-nori dhèu madhutu lii lolo be'a ama lamatua dènge mola.

source_text: is it leaveful to us to give tribute to the emperor or to caesar, or nay?
target_text: de ji'i neo karèi ca j'ara: madhutu atora agama èdhi dhèu yahudi, hud'i ji'i b'ae ku doi bea mi dhèu aae kapai paredha roma, do aad'o?

source_text: and he beheld the deceit of them, and said to them, what tempt ye me?
target_text: te ngaa yesus ne'a le ngangee kaj'alu rèngu ho neo pamanahu ne. ka na dhaa, aku nèngu na,

source_text: show ye to me a penny; whose image and superscription hath it? they answered, and said to him, the emperor's or caesar's.
target_text: pad'elo sèku ja'a doi iia cue. hèia ra pad'elo dènge ne doi èci. ka yesus karèi si, ne'e ne, rupa cee ka ne? aa ngara cee, ne? ra dhaa, peka na, èèna, dhèu aae kapai, keser.

source_text: and he said to them, yield ye therefore to the emperor those things that be the emperor's or to caesar those things that be caesar's, and those things that be of god, to god.
target_text: hèia yesus peka na, ladhe sèmi èèna, hia asa dhèu paredha, ngaa dhu unu rèngu. aa hia mi ama lamatua ngaa dhu j'aj'i hak ama lamatua.

source_text: and they might not reprove his word before the people; and they wondered in his answer, and held peace.
target_text: tadèngi sèmi èèna, dhèu se malaa, lula rèngu bisa boe sii pamanahu rare ne ètu madha dhèu ae. ka hèb'a ra kutu mèno.

source_text: some of the sadducees, that denied the again-rising from death to life or the resurrection, came, and asked him.
target_text: èle èèna ka, pèri-pèri dhèu nèti partei agama saduki mai ho neo kèpe yesus. dhèu saduki aj'a, na, dhèu madhe mamuri heka ètu lod'o èle rai-haha ne. rèngu mai pakarèi dènge yesus, na,

source_text: and said, master, moses wrote to us, if the brother of any man have a wife, and he be dead or died, and he was without heirs or free children, that his brother take his wife, and raise seed to his brother.
target_text: ama mese! atora musa dhu suri tèke hia èdhi, peka na: ladhe dhèu mone madhe, aa dhu dènge mèka kolo, na, ari nèti dhèu madhe ne madhèdi nare hari bhèni balu ne, sèna ka abhu kolo hia a'a dhu madhe ne.

source_text: and so there were seven brethren. the first took a wife, and is dead without heirs, or without sons, or free children;
target_text: mema uru èèna baki musa aj'a sèmi èèna ka. te ngaa ji'i neo karèi sèmi ne'e: ana mone dhèu pidhu dhu pa'a'ari. dhu uru leo-èmu, te ngaa madhe dènge boe ana.

source_text: and the brother pursuing took her or the second took her, and he is dead without son;
target_text: hèia ari na todhe nare hari bhèni balu ne. nèbhu boe ka, na madhe, dhu dènge mèka kolo kahèi.

source_text: and the third took her; also and all seven, and they left not seed or no seed, but be dead;
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi dènge ana ka tèlu. na leo dènge bhèni balu ne, te ngaa madhe kahèi dènge boe ana. toke ari ra limuri tèka, madhe kahèi dènge boe kolo.

source_text: and the last of all the woman is dead.
target_text: hèia bhèni balu ne madhe.

source_text: therefore in the rising again, whose wife of them shall she be? for seven had her to wife.
target_text: de ji'i neo karèi ama sèmi ne'e: bhèni ne leo nèdhi le dènge ana mone dhèu pidhu sèra. ladhe d'ai èle rai-haha ne, ho lamatua pamamuri hari dhèu madhe sèra, bhèni ne j'aj'i mi dhèu èmu cee?

source_text: and jesus said to them, sons of this world wed, and be given to weddings;
target_text: ka yesus b'ala si, peka na, dhèu dhodhoka paleo èmu ètu rai-haha ne di.

source_text: but they that shall be had worthy of that world, and of the rising again from death, neither be wedded, nor wed wives, neither they shall be able to die more; for they be even with angels, and be the sons of god, since they be the sons of the rising again from death.
target_text: te ngaa ètu sorga dhèu paleo boe èmu. aa ètu era nèi, dhèu madhe heka. rèngu èci èèna ka dènge ana pajuu nèti ama lamatua ètu sorga. te, lod'o ama lamatua pamamuri hari dhèu madhe, na hag'e nare si, sèna ka j'aj'i mi ana na.

source_text: and that dead men rise again, also moses showed beside the bush, as he saith, the lord god of abraham, and god of isaac, and god of jacob.
target_text: ètu d'ara sasuri baki musa, dhu lole aj'u iiki ca kapua dhu ai na'e, te ngaa kèpu boe. nèti lii lolo ne, èdhi te'a, na, dhèu madhe bisa mamuri hari. ètu èèna, ama lamatua peka dènge musa, na, ‘ja'a ne, ama lamatua nèti baki èu dhu uru-uru sèra. nuka baki abraham, isak dènge yakob. rèngu se mangaj'i taa-taa mi ja'a toke d'ai sange ne'e ne. '

source_text: and god is not of dead men, but of living men; for all men live to him.
target_text: masi ka baki mu se madhe karèi jahi ali. te ngaa, lula ama lamatua ka dhu peka na, nèngu j'aj'i mi lamatua rèngu era, de èdhi te'a le, na, rèngu se mamuri era. de masi ka dhèu madhe le, te ngaa ra mamuri hari. te dhoka dhèu dhu mamuri di, dhu pahaha iisi mi ama lamatua; dhèu madhe, aad'o si!

source_text: and some of the scribes answering, said, master, thou hast well said.
target_text: tadèngi yesus dhaa sèmi èèna, ka mese agama padhai lii, peka na, lii dhaa ama mese èèna, lèke kèna.

source_text: and they durst no more ask him anything.
target_text: nèti lod'o èèna, abhu heka ca dhèu sa dhu bani karèi yesus, lula abhu boe j'ara dhu bisa pamanahu rare ne.

source_text: but he said to them, how say men, christ to be the son of david or that christ is the son of david,
target_text: yesus aj'a-nori dhèu ètu èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i era. ka na karèi dhèu sèra, peka na, madhutu a'abhu miu, tasamia? mese agama sèra, aj'a peka na, kristus èèna, nuka dhèu dhu ama lamatua paj'uj'u karèi nèti uru-uru ka. madhutu a'aj'a rèngu, nèngu ne dhodhoka ana-èpu dhèu aae daud di. te ngaa èèna dhae d'ai mèka.

source_text: and david himself saith in the book of psalms, the lord said to my lord, sit thou on my right half,
target_text: lula uru èèna, dhèu aae daud mesa na dhu suri le, ètu d'ara lii sod'a koa-kio, na, ‘ama lamatua peka le dènge lamatua ja'a, na, mai madhèdi mi era dhu kab'ua ètu babo g'ana ja'a ne.

source_text: till i put thine enemies a stool of thy feet?
target_text: te bèli-camèd'a ja'a tao musu-musu èu, toke ra pahaha iisi mi èu. '

source_text: therefore david calleth him lord, and how is he his son?
target_text: de nèti sasuri ne, èdhi te'a, na, dhèu aae daud mesa na paroa kristus ne, ‘lamatua'. sasoa na, ladhe dhèu peka na kristus ne dhoka ana-èpu nèti dhèu aae daud di, èèna dhae d'ai mèka! lula nèngu ne j'aj'i lamatua nèti dhèu aae daud kahèi!

source_text: and in hearing of all the people, he said to his disciples,
target_text: ropa dhèu aa'i-aa'i taru kira mi lii padhai yesus, hèia na peka dènge ana-ana madhutu na, aku nèngu na,

source_text: be ye ware of the scribes, that will wander in stoles, and love salutations in the chapping, and the first chairs in the synagogues, and the first sitting places in the feasts;
target_text: baku pamud'e dènge mese agama sèra. te rèngu d'èi kako pake kodho robho rai, lasi paraga dènge dhèu ae, ho dhèu koa si, peka na, ‘rèngu se dhèu kapai! ' rèngu d'èi tenge era re madha ètu d'ara èmu sabaj'a, ètu d'ara pesta, aa ètu era-era dhèu ae pakaboko.

source_text: that devour the houses of widows, and feign long praying; these shall take the more damnation.
target_text: de miu baku pamud'e, lula rèngu d'èi kapod'e-kabèli bhèni balu ho parame rare èmu ra. te ngaa ètu madha dhèu ae, rèngu pahuni bhabhelu ra dènge titu ho sabaj'a panèbhu-nèbhu. rèngu d'èi dhèu koa ra, peka na, rèngu dhèu mola. te ngaa lamatua ne'a sasala ra, de èèna na nèngu huku si bia risi.

source_text: and he beheld, and saw the rich men, that cast their gifts into the treasury;
target_text: lod'o yesus aj'a ètu èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i, ladhe nèdhi dhèu kaja mai pamaso doi asa d'ara boaraka derma.

source_text: but he saw also a little poor widow casting two farthings or two little moneys.
target_text: ladhe nèdhi kahèi bhèni balu ca dhèu dhu unu boe ngaa-ngaa mai madhutu sabaj'a. na pamaso kahèi doi dua sen asa d'ara boaraka ne. doi na se'e, kab'ua ciki oo'e di.

source_text: and he said, truly i say to you, that this poor widow cast more than all men.
target_text: ka yesus lii dènge ana madhutu na, peka na, nanene pabe'a-be'a! bhèni balu ne, dhoka pamaso doi dua sen di, te ngaa na hia risi nèti dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: for why all these of the thing that was plenteous or abundant to them cast in to the gifts of god; but this widow of that thing that failed to her, cast all her livelode or all her lifelode, that she had.
target_text: dhèu leo se pamaso doi kolete nèti doi karisi rèngu. te ngaa bhèni balu ne hia aa'i mèu-mèu doi na tao mi doi kolete. masi ka nèti doi ne'e, nèngu ako taha mamuri.

source_text: and when some men said of the temple, that it was appareled or adorned with good stones and gifts, he said,
target_text: lod'o èèna, ana madhutu yesus dhu koa-kad'iri èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i, peka na, ama! ladhe ku laa, èmu ne be'a titu kèna! ra pake hadhu cetak dhu kapai hua, ka ra paca'e mera titu kèna. aa dhèu hia kahèi mèdha ra dhu kab'ua, sèna ka pasaraga èmu lamatua ne! te ngaa yesus b'ala, na,

source_text: these things that ye see, days shall come, in which a stone shall not be left on a stone, which shall not be destroyed.
target_text: èmu ne mema saraga. te ngaa nèbhu heka, dhèu paguri eela hadhu se, toke mera dènge rai.

source_text: and they asked him, and said, commander, when shall these things be? and what token shall be, when they shall begin to be done?
target_text: hèia ana madhutu yesus se karèi, peka na, ama mese! ngaa dhu ama peka-padhai deo na, j'aj'aj'i na pèri lod'o? ladhe lod'o na dètu le, tadha-tadha na sèmi ngaa sa?

source_text: and he said, see ye, that ye be not deceived; for many shall come in my name, saying, for i am, and the time shall nigh; therefore do not ye go after them.
target_text: ka yesus dhaa, aku nèngu na, sad'i miu j'aga paie-iie, ho baku lèke tipu. te èèna na rupa-rupa dhèu mai tèb'a kakara ra, peka na, ‘ja'a ne, kristus. ' abhu kahèi dhu peka na, ‘lod'o a'èle rai-haha dètu kèna! ' te ngaa baku mi parcaya kahèi!

source_text: and when ye shall hear battles and strives or dissensions within, do not ye be afeared; it behooveth first these things to be done, but not yet anon is an end or the end.
target_text: ladhe miu tadèngi ka dhèu palolo, peka na: dhèu patao-palaha, dènge papara-pakèj'i ètu mia-mia, baku mi cag'ag'a. sèra sa hud'i j'aj'i uru ku. te ngaa d'ai mèka lod'o èle rai-haha ne.

source_text: then he said to them, folk shall rise against folk, and realm against realm;
target_text: bèli-camèd'a suku èci pamusu dènge suku leo. negara èci papara-pakèj'i dènge negara leo.

source_text: and great movings of the earth shall be by places, and pestilences, and hungers, and dreads from heaven, and great tokens shall be.
target_text: èèna na, j'aj'i rai opo dhu kapai aae. ètu mia-mia, manganga-mad'èu dhu seli eele, aa èi papèd'a pad'ai cèu palème era. bèli-camèd'a dhèu ladhe rèdhi kahèi tadha dhu pamadha'u dhèu, aa tadha-tadha dhu kapai aae ètu dedha-liru.

source_text: but before all these things they shall set their hands on you, and shall pursue you, betaking into synagogues and keepings, either prisons, and drawing you to kings and to justices, for my name;
target_text: j'ara se'e se j'aj'i aa'i mèka, te ngaa èèna na dhèu mai kèpe rare miu, aa paj'èra miu, lula miu parcaya ja'a. hèia ra soro miu asa dhèu dhu uri lii langu ètu d'ara èmu-èmu sabaj'a, aa ra taha miu ètu d'ara bèdho. ra rèti miu asa madha dhèu aae-dhèu aae, dènge dhèu paredha leo. aa'i-aa'i se j'aj'i, lula miu madhutu ja'a.

source_text: but it shall fall to you into witnessing.
target_text: te ngaa miu hud'i pake lod'o ne'e, sèna ka peka dènge rèngu lii lolo be'a ja'a.

source_text: therefore put ye in your hearts, not to think before, how ye shall answer;
target_text: de mage pangee tasamia miu siri iisi.

source_text: for i shall give to you mouth and wisdom, to which all your adversaries shall not be able to against-stand, and gainsay.
target_text: te lod'o èèna, ja'a hia miu lii-lii dhu pamèci dènge lii dhaa. dènge sèmi èèna, musu miu sèra, re'a heka peka-padhai sèmi ngaa hari.

source_text: and ye shall be taken or betrayed of father, and mother, and brethren, and cousins, and friends, and by death they shall torment some of you; and ye shall be in hate to or be hated of all men for my name.
target_text: bèli-camèd'a dhèu tèka d'ara dènge miu, lula miu madhutu ja'a. abhu nèti a'ari miu unu mi, sèmi ina-ama, a'ari, kera ba'i, rae lesa dènge mone anga-aangalai. èèna na nèti rèngu se'e ka, tenge j'ara ho pahie eele miu, toke ra pamadhe miu cahag'e.

source_text: and an hair of your head shall not perish;
target_text: te ngaa miu baku madha'u, te lamatua bhèlu boe miu. rèu kètu miu ca loa sa kabhui eele boe, ladhe dènge boe dad'èi na.

source_text: in your patience ye shall wield your souls.
target_text: ladhe miu taha mere taruu, tatu ama lamatua pala-bagi mamuri hia miu.

source_text: but when ye shall see jerusalem be environed with an host of battle, then know ye, that the desolation of it shall nigh.
target_text: yesus padhai lii tabha hari, aku nèngu na, ladhe miu mèdhi ka sordad'u mai pamusu reo rare yerusalem, miu me'a le, na, d'ai lod'o ele iie yerusalem kèna.

source_text: then they that be in judea, flee to the mountains; and they that be in the middle of it, go away; and they that be in the countries, enter not into it.
target_text: ropa ladhe mèdhi sèmi èèna, dhèu ètu propensi yudea rai dènge ka asa ledhe-ledhe. dhèu ètu d'ara kota kèd'i kahèi, sèna ka rai. aa dhèu ètu rae, mai ia ka asa d'ara kota.

source_text: for these be the days of vengeance, that all things that be written, be fulfilled.
target_text: te lamatua hia lod'o-lod'o sasusa sèra, ho huku dhèu-dhèu dhu ro'o boe nanene nèngu. se'e se lèke nuka sèmi lii padhai nèti dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua dhu suri tèke karèi nèti uru ka.

source_text: and woe to them, that be with child, and nourishing or nursing in those days; for a great dis-ease or pressure shall be on the earth, and wrath to this people.
target_text: lod'o èèna, dhèu dhu j'èra risi, nuka, dhèu bhèni dhu dènge babia, aa ina-ina dhu dènge ana susu. lod'o èèna, abhu susa palème rai-haha, aa dhèu yahudi j'èra bia, lula ama lamatua nasa dènge rèngu sèra.

source_text: and they shall fall by the sharpness of sword, and they shall be led prisoners or led captive into all folks; and jerusalem shall be defouled of heathen men, till the times of nations be fulfilled.
target_text: èèna na musu mai pamadhe si cahag'e, aa taha cahag'e ho j'aj'i ènu ètu mia-mia ètu rai-haha ne. ka dhèu leo rai kara dhu tadhe boe ama lamatua, mai j'aj'èli pakaj'alu kota yerusalem, aa koasa rare kabarai na, toke èle lod'o ra.

source_text: and tokens shall be in the sun, and the moon, and in the stars; and in the earth overlaying of folks, for confusion of the sound of the sea and of floods or of waves;
target_text: èle ka yesus lole mamai hari na, aku nèngu na, bèli-camèd'a ladhe dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a neo mai hari, abhu tadha ètu madha lod'o, hèru, dènge hua hètu-hua hètu. ètu rai-haha ne abhu tadha kahèi, sèmi uli sea, dhasi ko'a dhu loe boe, aa naha aae lalulu mai. se'e se tao dhèu rai-haha ne, madha'u dènge ele ngangee, toke re'a heka tao ngaa-ngaa.

source_text: for men shall wax dry for dread and abiding, that shall come into or on all the world; for virtues of heaven shall be moved.
target_text: koasa-koasa ètu dedha-liru loe boe karèbha. ropa ladhe rèdhi aa'i-aa'i, hèia ra madha'u titu kèna, lula rai-haha ne oe ele iie kèna!

source_text: and then they shall see man's son coming in a cloud, with great power and majesty.
target_text: èle ku heka dhèu ladhe rèdhi ja'a kèna, ‘dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne puru mai ètu d'ara ra'i-liru'. ja'a mai dènge koasa, aa dènge dadedha dhu kapai risi eele.

source_text: and when these things begin to be made or beginning to be done, behold ye, and raise ye your heads, for your redemption nigheth.
target_text: ladhe mulai j'aj'i ka tadha sèra, na, miu boti ka kètu miu, te lod'o d'ai kèna, lamatua hia mamuri mi miu.

source_text: and he said to them a likeness, see ye the fig tree, and all trees,
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus lolo pake lii pakasame, aku nèngu na, miu taru kira pabe'a-be'a ku mi aj'u sèra.

source_text: when they bring forth now of themselves fruit, ye know that summer is nigh;
target_text: ladhe d'ai ka hèru rèu ra karara, èèna tadha na hèru hadhu dètu le.

source_text: so also ye, when ye see these things to be done, know ye, that the kingdom of god is nigh.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi dènge lod'o-lod'o sasusa. ladhe cèu, èèna tadha na paredha ama lamatua dhu dètu iiki le.

source_text: truly i say to you, that this generation shall not pass, till all things be done.
target_text: ja'a pasanèd'e mema miu! nèti dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu mamuri limuri ne, bèli-camèd'a cahag'e dhae madhe mèka, te lod'o-lod'o j'aj'èra se mai le.

source_text: heaven and earth shall pass, but my words shall not pass.
target_text: masi ka liru dènge rai-haha ele, te ngaa lii holo-nori ja'a taha taa-taa.

source_text: but take ye heed to yourselves, lest peradventure your hearts be grieved with gluttony, and drunken-ness, and busynesses of this life, and that day come suddenly on you;
target_text: hèia yesus tuhu lii padhai na, aku nèngu na, mi j'aga-j'aga, te cag'ag'a laa ja'a mai hari sahèka! mage dhoka miu taru kira heka, hèia miu mamuri dènge minu mahu, aa bhute dhoka tenge mamuri karej'e di. mage dhoka miu me'a boe tadha ne, lula miu bhute dènge j'ara dhu leo.

source_text: for as a snare it shall come on all men, that sit on the face of all the earth.
target_text: ladhe ja'a lèpa hari mai, abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu bisa pahuni iisi ra nèti madha ja'a.

source_text: therefore wake ye, praying in each time, that ye be had worthy to flee all these things that be to come or that shall come, and to stand before man's son.
target_text: de miu hud'i mate tatae ku. baku ma'ète manèngi-mangaj'i, sèna ka miu bisa taha ètu talora aae sasusa sèra. dènge sèmi èèna, ropa ja'a lèpa hari mai, miu makae boe titu ètu madha dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne.

source_text: and in days he was teaching in the temple, but in nights he went out, and dwelled in the mount, that is called of olivet.
target_text: bèli-bèli, ladhe re mèu, yesus la'e aj'a lii holo-nori lamatua ètu èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. te ngaa ladhe re mèda, kalua nèti yerusalem ho la'e bhèj'i asa rae ètu ledhe saitun.

source_text: and all the people rose or came early, to come to him in the temple, for to hear him.
target_text: mad'ae aae era, dhèu ae-ae dhu mai le pakaboko ètu èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i, ho nanene lii aj'a-nori na.

source_text: and the holiday or the holy day of therf loaves, that is said pask, nighed.
target_text: lod'o èèna, oe d'ai lod'o hua iia dhèu yahudi, nuka pesta roti dhu dènge boe ragi. ètu d'ara lod'o hua iia se, ra roro kahib'i-kalèbho tao kalela paska kahèi. rèngu tao sèmi ne'e, sèna ka pasanèd'e uru èèna, lod'o bèi-baki rèngu kalua nèti masir.

source_text: and the princes of priests, and the scribes sought, how they should slay jesus, but they dreaded the people.
target_text: lod'o èèna, kètu agama yahudi dènge mese agama sèra tenge j'ara ho pamadhe yesus. te ngaa ra mage dhèu ae sèra maruru, lula dhèu se d'èi nanene ne.

source_text: and satan entered into judas, that was called iscariot, one of the twelve.
target_text: nèti dhèu pajuu-paleha yesus, dhèu canguru dua sèra, èci ngara na yudas iskariot. lod'o kètu agama yahudi sèra tenge j'ara ho pamadhe yesus, dhèu aae nidhu maso asa d'ara yudas iskariot.

source_text: and he went, and spake with the princes of priests, and with the magistrates, how he should betray him to them.
target_text: hèia la'e tenge kètu agama yahudi se dènge kètu nèti dhèu madhenga èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. la'e neo pane'a dènge ra, sèna ka pahie yesus dènge rèngu.

source_text: and they joyed, and made covenant to give him money.
target_text: ropa tadèngi lii padhai yudas, hèia ra karej'e titu kèna. ra pamoa, peka na, la'a, ma! ladhe èu neo pahie yesus dènge ji'i, na ji'i b'ae.

source_text: and he promised, and he sought opportunity, to betray him, without the people.
target_text: ka yudas d'èi, hèia na mulai tenge lod'o dhu lake nare, sèna ka dhèu ae baku re'a nèngu pahie eele yesus.

source_text: but the days of therf loaves came, in which it was need, that the sacrifice of pask were slain.
target_text: hèia d'ai ka lod'o hua iia dhèu yahudi, dhu rèngu biasa roro ana kahib'i-kalèbho sèna ka tao kalela paska.

source_text: and he sent peter and john, and said, go ye, and make ye ready to us the pask, that we eat.
target_text: ka yesus pua petrus dènge yohanis, aku nèngu na, dua mi lami uuru, sèna ka sadia tèke nganga'a kalela paska ho ta'a sama-sama.

source_text: and they said, where wilt thou, that we make ready?
target_text: ka dua ra karèi, ama! ji'i la'a sadia nganga'a asa mia?

source_text: and he said to them, lo! when ye shall enter into the city, a man bearing a vessel of water shall meet you; pursue ye him into the house, into which he entereth.
target_text: hèia na b'ala, ladhe miu maso asa d'ara kota yerusalem, pe miu paraga dènge dhèu mone ca dhèu dhu pasae g'ala èi cue. madhutu ne toke d'ai èmu na.

source_text: and ye shall say to the husband-man of the house, the master saith to thee, where is a chamber, where i shall eat the pask with my disciples?
target_text: peka dènge lamatua èmu ne, ‘ama mese ji'i manèngi ca kama, ho neo pake tao kalela paska dènge ana-ana madhutu na. abhu, do? '

source_text: and he shall show to you a great supping place strewed, and there make ye ready.
target_text: èèna na lamatua èmu ne pad'elo dènge miu kama èci dhu taleo ètu èmu dedha. nèngu lalau pamèci nare aa'i le kama èèna. ate dhoka miu dua mi lami sadia nganga'a ètu èèna.

source_text: and they went, and found as he said to them, and they made ready the pask.
target_text: ka dua ra lasi. hèia ra paraga ka nuka sèmi ngaa dhu yesus peka le. ka dua ra sadia nganga'a-nganginu kalela paska ètu nèi.

source_text: and when the hour was come, he sat at the meat, and the twelve apostles with him.
target_text: ropa lalau rare aa'i, yesus si mai. yesus madhèdi ètu mei, aa ana-ana pajuu-paleha na madhèdi kahèi ra'a pesta.

source_text: and he said to them, with desire i have desired to eat with you this pask, before that i suffer;
target_text: hèia yesus peka dènge si, ja'a d'èi titu kèna madhèdi ku'a kalela paska dènge miu aa'i-aa'i mi, uru nèti ja'a abhu j'aj'èra.

source_text: for i say to you, that from this time i shall not eat it, till it be fulfilled in the realm of god.
target_text: patadhe pabe'a-be'a. te èle ne'e ne, ja'a madhèdi heka ku'a kalela paska dènge miu. ladhe dhèu aa'i-aa'i re'a mèu ku, peka na, ama ku nèd'u paredha, ja'a heka ku'a hari kèna.

source_text: and when he had taken the cup, he did graces or thankings, and said, take ye, and part ye among you;
target_text: hèia na kèpe nare galaa cue dhu isi èi anggor. ka na manèngi makasi mi ama lamatua, èle ka na soro galaa ne asa rèngu. hèia na padhai lii, aku nèngu na, sèmi mere galaa ne, ho èci-èci minu.

source_text: for i say to you, that i shall not drink of the kind or of the generation of this vine, till the realm of god come.
target_text: sanèd'e paie-iie! karèi nèti mèda ne'e ne, ja'a kinu heka èi anggor. ladhe dhèu aa'i-aa'i re'a mèu ka, peka na, ama ku nèd'u paredha, ja'a heka kinu hari kèna.

source_text: and when he had taken bread, he did thankings or graces, and brake, and gave to them, and said, this is my body, that shall be given for you; do ye this thing in mind of me or into my commemoration.
target_text: hèia na kèpe nare roti cue, ka manèngi makasi mi ama lamatua. ka na pamae roti ne, hèia na soro sa rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra. ka na peka, roti ne'e ne, ngi'u aae ja'a dhu ja'a hia sa miu aa'i-aa'i mi. lod'o-lod'o dhu miu mi'e ne, pasanèd'e taruu miu, lula tatao ja'a.

source_text: he took also the cup or the chalice, after that he had supped, and said, this cup is the new testament in my blood, that shall be shed for you.
target_text: ropa ra'a rare, ka na ded'e nare galaa dhu isi èi anggor. hèia na lii, peka na, èi anggor ne'e ne, raa ja'a ka ne, dhu bhori mai sèna ka hia sod'a-mole mi miu. nèti raa ne'e ka, ama lamatua pa'èki lii pajaji dhu hiu dènge miu.

source_text: nevertheless lo! the hand of him that betrayeth me, is with me at the table.
target_text: mage pamud'e, te abhu dhèu dhu madhèdi sama-sama dènge èdhi ètu mei ne, èèna na, nèngu pahie eele ja'a.

source_text: and man's son goeth, as it is determined; nevertheless woe to that man, by whom he shall be betrayed.
target_text: mema ja'a, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne, hud'i madhe ku madhutu dad'èi ama lamatua. te ngaa dhèu dhu pahie eele ja'a, sanèd'e, ee! te bèli-camèd'a, nèngu pasae nare mamadhe-mamopo!

source_text: and they began to seek among themselves, who it was of them, that was to do this thing.
target_text: ropa ra tadèngi lii ne, ana-ana pajuu-paleha se pakarèi, peka na, cee ka dhu ad'u-ue madha j'ara bhelu ne mi dedha na?

source_text: and strife was made among them, which of them should be seen to be greatest.

source_text: and jesus saith to them, fill ye the pots with water. and they filled them, up to the mouth or unto the highest part.
target_text: hèia yesus lii dènge dhèu sab'a se, peka na, lami mere èi, ho isi papènu g'ala se. ka ra isi toke pènu oe bua eele.

source_text: and jesus said to them, draw ye now, and bear ye to the master of the feast. and they bare.
target_text: ka na peka dènge ra, dhui mere ciki, ho mèti asa lamatua tatao. hèia dhèu sab'a se madhutu kahèi.

source_text: and when the master of the feast had tasted the water made wine, and knew not whereof it was, but the ministers knew that drew the water, the master of the feast calleth the spouse,
target_text: ropa lamatua pesta sèmi nare, ka na ngao. te ngaa re'a rare boe, èi ne dhu j'aj'i le anggor! dhèu ne malaa, te ne'a boe, na, dhèu se abhu anggor ne nèti mia. te ngaa dhèu sab'a se re'a. ka na paroa nare pengantin dhèu mone.

source_text: and saith to him, each man setteth first good wine, and when men be full-filled, then that that is worse; but thou hast kept the good wine into this time.
target_text: hèia na peka, aku nèngu na, sèmi ne'e. dhu tema le, lamatua èmu hia uuru ku anggor dhu be'a risi. ladhe dhèu rinu ae ku, heka hia anggor dhu ako karehe kèna. te ngaa èu tao leo. èu hia uuru anggor dhu ako karehe, heka limuri dhu be'a risi!

source_text: jesus did this the beginning of signs, in the cana of galilee, and showed his glory; and his disciples believed in him.
target_text: j'ara ne j'aj'i ètu rae kana, propensi galilea. ne'e ne heka hiu-hiu kèna yesus tao tadha malaa dhu dhèu bisa rèdhi dènge musi madha ra. na pad'elo dadedha na sèmi èèna, ka ana madhutu na parcaya ne.

source_text: after these things he came down to capernaum, and his mother, and his brethren, and his disciples; and they dwelled there not many days.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus, ina na, ari dènge ana madhutu na sèra, puru lasi asa kota kapernaum. te ngaa rèngu pea dhoka pèri lod'o di ètu èèna.

source_text: and the pask of jews was nigh, and jesus went up to jerusalem.
target_text: ropa oe dètu dènge lod'o kalela paska dhèu yahudi, yesus ca'e la'e asa kota yerusalem.
