source_text: and he found in the temple men selling oxen, and sheep, and culvers, and money-changers sitting.
target_text: ètu madha èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i, yesus ladhe nèdhi dhèu pahia sapi, kahib'i-kalèbho, dènge koro j'aha dhu dhèu hèli ho j'aj'i korban. ètu era ne'e, abhu kahèi dhèu dhu madhèdi ètu mei ho pasilu doi dhu ra pake hia mi ama lamatua ètu èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i èèna.

source_text: and when he had made as it were a scourge of small cords, he drove out all or cast all out of the temple, and oxen, and sheep; and he shedded out the money of changers, and turned upside-down the boards.
target_text: hèia yesus nare dhari pèri-pèri loa ho na èpi j'aj'i sèmi gui sa. ka na babège-lalèta dhèu se'e aa'i-aa'i ra nèti madha èmu èèna. nèngu bhabhoo eele sapi, dènge kahib'i-kalèbho sèra kahèi. na lege eele mei, aa na ceb'e eele doi sèra kahèi.

source_text: and he said to them that sold culvers, take away from hence these things, and do not ye make the house of my father an house of merchandise.
target_text: hèia na pua dhèu pahia koro j'aha sèra, aku nèngu na, mèti sa li'u manu-bhui dènge karogo ra sèra nèti ne'e! ne'e, era pahia-pahèli boe! baku tao èmu ama ku, j'aj'i mi era d'aga!

source_text: and his disciples had mind, for it was written, the fervent love or zeal of thine house hath eaten me.
target_text: ka ana madhutu na ngee rèdhi sasuri mola-mèci lamatua dhu suri, peka na, ja'a sue èmu ama ku titu kèna. nèti èèna ka, d'ara ja'a èra ho j'aga ngara be'a èmu èèna.

source_text: therefore the jews answered, and said to him, what token or sign showest thou to us, that thou doest these things?
target_text: hèia ama-ama dhèu yahudi peka dènge yesus, aku rèngu na, ladhe èu dènge hak ho babège-lalèta dhèu sèmi ne'e, na, mu pad'elo tadha malaa èci hia ji'i, sèna ka j'aj'i mi bukti!

source_text: jesus answered, and said to them, undo ye this temple, and in three days i shall raise it.
target_text: ka yesus b'ala si, peka na, ladhe miu paguri era mola-mèci ne, pe camèd'a èèna, ja'a patitu kore hari le èèna.

source_text: therefore the jews said to him, in forty and six years this temple was builded, and shalt thou in three days raise it?
target_text: te ngaa ra pab'ala, peka na, abhu ètu mia? te dhèu patitu èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i ne èpa nguru èna tèu. tasamia ka, èu peka na, èu parluu dhoka tèlu lod'o di, sèna ka patitu more hari? !

source_text: but he said of the temple of his body.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu se'e re'a rare boe, yesus peka lula-nèti ngi'u nèngu unu na, dhu nuka sèmi era mola-mèci.

source_text: therefore when he was risen from death, his disciples had mind, that he said these things of his body; and they believed to the scripture, and to the word that jesus said.
target_text: de d'ai lèpa lod'o limuri, ropa yesus madhe, hèia mamuri hari, heka ana-ana madhutu na sanèd'e kèna, ngaa dhu na peka tèke dènge rèngu. ka ra parcaya ngaa dhu suri tèke ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci lamatua karèi nèti uru-uru ka, dènge ngaa dhu yesus peka mema dènge rèngu.

source_text: and when jesus was at jerusalem in pask, in the feast day, many believed in his name, seeing his signs that he did.
target_text: ka yesus pea taha ètu kota yerusalem, ho madhutu kalela paska ètu èèna. hèia dhèu ae rèdhi tadha-tadha malaa dhu na tao, ka ra parcaya ne.

source_text: but jesus trusted not himself to them, for he knew all men; and for it was not need to him, that any man should bear witnessing of man, for he knew, what was in man.
target_text: te ngaa yesus lèka boe rèngu, lula ne'a mèu d'ara dhèu aa'i-aa'i. nèngu parluu boe dhèu ho peka dènge ne, lula na ne'a mema le mamuri dènge tatao dhèu rai-haha.

source_text: and there was a man of the pharisees, nicodemus by name, a prince of the jews.
target_text: abhu ca dhèu nèti partei agama parisi, ngara na nikodemus. nèngu ne, mese aae nèti dhèu yahudi.

source_text: and he came to jesus by night, and said to him, rabbi, we know, that thou art come from god a master or for of god thou hast come a master; for no man may do these signs, that thou doest, but god be with him.
target_text: ca tèka, na mai paraga dènge yesus re mèda. hèia na padhai lii dènge yesus, aku nèngu na, ama mese! ji'i nge'a, na, lamatua ka dhu pua ama ho aj'a-nori ji'i. te tadha-tadha malaa dhu ama tao sèra, pad'elo, na, lamatua ka dhu pangèd'u koasa mi ama. ladhe sèmi boe èèna, tatu tadha malaa se'e bisa boe j'aj'i.

source_text: jesus answered, and said to him, truly, truly, i say to thee, but a man be born again, he may not see the kingdom of god.
target_text: ka yesus dhaa, peka na, tare'a! aa ja'a neo peka sèmi ne'e ku: ladhe dhèu rara iisi hari boe ne, nèngu bisa boe j'aj'i dhèu unu lamatua.

source_text: nicodemus said to him, how may a man be born, when he is old? whether he may enter again into his mother's womb, and be born again?
target_text: hèia nikodemus karèi, aku nèngu na, tasamia dhèu dhu kapai le bisa rara iisi hari ne! ? nèngu tatu bisa boe maso hari asa d'ara kabake ina na, sèna ka ina na nara iisi hari ne. bisa boe, sina ma! ?

source_text: jesus answered, truly, truly, i say to thee, but a man be born again of water, and of the holy ghost, he may not enter into the kingdom of god.
target_text: ka yesus dhaa, peka na, tare'a! te ngaa ja'a peka dènge èu sèmi ne'e: dhèu hud'i rara iisi ku re èi sèna ka j'aj'i mèu, aa re roh ho j'aj'i dhèu hiu. dènge j'ara ne'e, nèngu heka bisa j'aj'i dhèu unu lamatua kèna.

source_text: that that is born of the flesh, is flesh; and that that is born of the spirit, is spirit.
target_text: te dhèu rai-haha ne rara iisi nèti dhèu rai-haha, te ngaa roh dhèu rara iisi hiu nèti roh ama lamatua.

source_text: wonder thou not, for i said to thee, it behooveth you to be born again.
target_text: baku malaa ladhe ja'a peka, na, ‘miu hud'i rara iisi hiu ku, ho abhu mamuri hiu. '

source_text: the spirit breatheth where he will, and thou hearest his voice, but thou knowest not, from whence he cometh, nor whither he goeth; so is each man that is born of the spirit.
target_text: èdhi pasoro ku dènge lai ngèlu. te lai ngèlu g'oro madhutu dad'èi na. èdhi bisa tadèngi lii na, te ngaa te'a boe mai nèti mia, aa la'e asa mia. dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu rara iisi hiu nèti roh lamatua sama sèmi èèna kahèi. te èdhi bisa ladhe tèdhi roh lamatua tao dhèu j'aj'i hiu, masi ka te'a boe tasa mera mia j'ara èèna bisa j'aj'i.

source_text: nicodemus answered, and said to him, how may these things be done?
target_text: ka nikodemus karèi, na, tasamia ka j'aj'i sèmi èèna?

source_text: jesus answered, and said to him, thou art a master in israel, and knowest not these things?
target_text: yesus b'ala, aku nèngu na, èu ne mese aae dhèu isra'el. tasamia ka èu me'a boe j'ara se'e?

source_text: truly, truly, i say to thee, for we speak that that we know, and we witness that that we have seen, and ye take not our witnessing.
target_text: ja'a peka j'ara dhu lèke mola-mola. ja'a dènge dhèu-dhèu ja'a, nge'a j'ara se'e. te ji'i j'aj'i sakasii lula-nèti j'ara-j'ara dhu ngèdhi unu mi. te ngaa miu sèmi boe lii padhai ji'i.

source_text: if i have said to you earthly things, and ye believe not, how if i say to you heavenly things, shall ye believe?
target_text: miu mo'o boe lèka, ropa ja'a lole lula-nèti j'ara-j'ara dhu j'aj'i ètu rai-haha ne. ngaa hari ladhe ja'a lole j'ara-j'ara dhu j'aj'i ètu dedha-liru nèi. tatu miu asa lèka boe!

source_text: and no man ascendeth or goeth up into heaven, but he that came down from heaven, man's son that is in heaven or the son of man which is in heaven.
target_text: abhu boe dhèu èci sa dhu ca'e la'e paraga dènge ama lamatua ètu dedha-liru nèi. dhodhoka ja'a di, nuka dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne, dhu puru mai nèti nèngu.

source_text: and as moses areared or reared up a serpent in desert, so it behooveth man's son to be raised up,
target_text: uru-uru sèra ètu d'ara mamoo, musa kadhoe mege tabaga ci'u ètu kolo aj'u, sèna ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu laladhe ne, rèngu abhu mamuri. j'ara sèmi èèna hud'i j'aj'i ku mi dedha ja'a, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne. bèli-camèd'a ra kadhoe ja'a ètu aj'u,

source_text: that each man that believeth in him, perish not, but have everlasting life.
target_text: sèna ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu parcaya ja'a abhu mamuri dhu lèke dhu ma'ète boe.

source_text: for god loved so the world or forsooth god so loved the world, that he gave his one begotten son, that each man that believeth in him perish not, but have everlasting life.
target_text: te ama lamatua sue seli dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne. nèti èèna ka, na pua ja'a, ana mesa na mai, sèna ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu parcaya ja'a, cèri eele boe nèti lamatua. dènge j'ara ne, rèngu abhu mamuri dhu lèke dhu ma'ète boe.

source_text: for god sent not his son into the world, that he judge the world, but that the world be saved by him.
target_text: lamatua pua boe ja'a, ana na, mai asa rai-haha ne ho pama'ète hahuku dhèu. te ngaa na hia ja'a mai, sèna ka patabuli dhèu nèti koasa sasala-sasigo ra.

source_text: he that believeth in him, is not deemed, or condemned; but he that believeth not, is now deemed or condemned, for he believeth not in the name of the one or the only begotten son of god.
target_text: ama lamatua huku boe dhèu dhu parcaya ja'a. te ngaa nèngu dhu pama'ète nare le hahuku mi dedha dhèu dhu parcaya boe, lula rèngu parcaya boe ja'a, nuka ana mesa nèti ama lamatua.

source_text: and this is the doom, for light came into the world, and men loved more darknesses than light; for their works were evil.
target_text: nuka sèmi ne'e: lamatua hia le saraa ho pasaraa rai-haha ne. te ngaa dhèu d'èi risi mamuri ètu d'ara maroga. rèngu ro'o boe mamuri ètu d'ara saraa lula tatao rèngu dhu lèke boe. nèti èèna ka, ama lamatua neo huku si.

source_text: for each man that doeth evil, hateth the light; and he cometh not to the light, that his works be not reproved.
target_text: te dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu tatao ra lèke boe, d'èi boe saraa èèna. rèngu d'èi boe saraa ne d'elo rèngu, sèna ka saraa ne baku pasabhoka bhabhelu-katub'a ra.

source_text: but he that doeth truth, cometh to the light, that his works be showed, that they be done in god.
target_text: te ngaa dhu tao lèke, rèngu ara mai sèna ka saraa ne d'elo si. te saraa ne'e ka dhu pad'elo, na, rèngu dhu tao madhutu dad'èi lamatua.

source_text: after these things jesus came, and his disciples, into the land of judea, and there he dwelled with them, and baptized.
target_text: ka yesus dènge ana madhutu na sèra kalua nèti kota yerusalem, te ngaa rèngu pea taha ètu rai yudea. ètu era ne'e rèngu sarani dhèu.

source_text: and john was baptizing in aenon, beside salim, for many waters were there; and they came, and were baptized or christened. and john was not yet sent into prison.
target_text: lod'o èèna, herodes si dhae pamaso mèka yohanis tuka sarani asa d'ara bèdho. aa yohanis sarani dhèu ètu rae ainon, padètu dènge rae salim, lula abhu èi ae ètu era èèna. nèti èèna ka, dhèu ae mai asa yohanis ho na sarani si.

source_text: therefore a question was made of john's disciples with the jews, of the purification, or cleansing.
target_text: madhutu ad'a agama yahudi, ladhe neo sabaj'a, hud'i pamèu uuru ku iisi. ètu era ne'e abhu dhèu yahudi ca dhèu dhu patao-palaha dènge ana-ana madhutu yohanis, lula j'ara èèna.

source_text: and they came to john, and said to him, master or rabbi, he that was with thee beyond or over jordan, to whom thou hast borne witnessing, lo! he baptizeth, and all men come to him.
target_text: ka dhèu se mai asa yohanis, hèia ra peka na, ama mese! sanèd'e era, do aad'o? dhèu dhu uru èèna tenge ama ètu sebhe loko yarden, dhu ama peka na, nèngu èèna, kristus. nèngu sarani dhèu kahèi! nèti èèna ka, abhu heka dhèu dhu mai asa ji'i! te lasi aa'i asa nèngu!

source_text: john answered, and said, a man may not take anything, but it be given to him from heaven.
target_text: hèia yohanis dhaa, peka na, sèmi ne'e! dhèu bisa boe tao ngaa èci sa, ladhe ama lamatua bhoke boe j'ara hia ne.

source_text: ye yourselves bear witnessing to me, that i said, i am not christ, but that i am sent before him.
target_text: miu tadèngi dhu ja'a peka le mola-mola dènge miu, na, ‘ja'a ne, kristus boe, dhu èdhi tatae. te ngaa lamatua pua uuru ja'a mai, ho oti j'ara hia kristus. j'ara na sèmi èèna ka! '

source_text: he that hath a wife, is the husband or the spouse; but the friend of the spouse that standeth, and heareth him, joyeth with joy, for the voice of the spouse. therefore in this thing my joy is fulfilled.
target_text: ladhe abhu pengantin dhèu mone, tatu abhu pengantin dhèu bhèni kahèi. te ngaa sakasii na, dhu titu dènge ne, d'ara na karej'e, ladhe tadèngi lii padhai lii pengantin dhèu mone. yesus ne, sama sèmi pengantin dhèu mone. aa ja'a ne, sama sèmi sakasii na. nèti èèna ka, limuri ne d'ara ja'a karej'e-karae.

source_text: it behooveth him to wax, but me to be made less or to be diminished.
target_text: dhu lèke ka, nèngu hud'i asa tabha kapai, aa hud'i laa ja'a asa kura j'aj'i dhèu haha.

source_text: he that came from above, is above all; he that is of the earth, speaketh of the earth; he that cometh from heaven, is above all.
target_text: yohanis tuhu hari lii padhai na, aku nèngu na, nèngu ne mai nèti ama lamatua ètu sorga, nèti èèna ka nèngu kapai risi aa'i. te ngaa ja'a ne dhoka mai nèti rai-haha, nèti èèna ka ja'a èci èèna ka dènge dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne. ja'a padhai lii lula-nèti j'ara dhu biasa j'aj'i ètu rai-haha ne. te ngaa dhu mai nèti ama lamatua ètu sorga, tatu nèngu kapai risi nèti ngaa aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: and he witnesseth that thing that he hath seen, and heard, and no man taketh his witnessing.
target_text: nèngu peka lula-nèti ngaa dhu nèdhi, dènge ngaa dhu na tadèngi le. te ngaa dhèu sèmi boe lii padhai na.

source_text: but he that taketh his witnessing, hath confirmed that god is soothfast.
target_text: ladhe dhèu sèmi rare ngaa dhu dhèu nèti dedha-liru ne peka, èèna pad'elo bukti kahèi, na, nèngu parcaya lii padhai ama lamatua èèna, lèke tare'a.

source_text: but he whom god hath sent, speaketh the words of god; for not to measure god giveth the spirit.
target_text: dhèu dhu lamatua pua mai èèna, lole lii moa ama lamatua. te ama lamatua hia le nèngu roh na dhu dènge boe too-lane.

source_text: the father loveth the son, and he hath given all things into his hand.
target_text: te ama ètu sorga sue ana na titu kèna. aa na pangèd'u aa'i mèu-mèu mi d'ara adhe-aai ana na.

source_text: he that believeth in the son, hath everlasting life; but he that is unbelieveful to the son, shall not see everlasting life, but the wrath of god dwelleth on him.
target_text: ka dhèu dhu parcaya ana ne, rèngu abhu mamuri dhu lèke dhu ma'ète boe. te ngaa dhèu dhu parcaya boe ne, aa tao boe madhutu lii moa na, rèngu abhu boe mamuri èèna. tatu ama lamatua nasa ka huku si.

source_text: therefore as jesus knew, that the pharisees heard, that jesus maketh and baptizeth more disciples than john, though jesus baptized not, but his disciples,
target_text: ladhe pasoro yohanis dènge yesus, ana-ana madhutu yesus mulai sarani dhèu dhu madhutu ne ae risi nèti yohanis. yesus sarani boe dhèu, dhodhoka ana madhutu na ka dhu sarani si. ka ropa yesus ne'a, na, dhèu nèti partei agama parisi re'a, na, yesus si sarani dhèu ae risi,

source_text: he left judea, and went again into galilee.
target_text: hèia nèngu dènge ana madhutu na tèke eele rai yudea, lèpa hari asa propensi galilea.

source_text: and it behooved him to pass by samaria.
target_text: te ngaa kakako rèngu èèna re propensi samaria asa propensi galilea.

source_text: therefore jesus came into a city of samaria, that is called sychar, beside the place or the field that jacob gave to joseph, his son.
target_text: ètu d'ara kakako ra, rèngu d'ai kota èci ètu samaria, ngara na sikar, padètu dènge rai dhu yakob hia ana na yusuf.

source_text: and the well of jacob was there; and jesus was weary of the journey, and sat thus upon the well. and the hour was, as it were the sixth. and a woman came from samaria, to draw water. and jesus saith to her, give me drink. and his disciples were gone into the city, to buy meat.
target_text: ètu era ne'e, abhu madha èi èci, ngara na ‘madha èi yakob'. d'ai loo nètu ku, yesus si d'ai era ne'e. lula j'èra nèti kakako deo na, ka yesus madhèdi taha ètu madha èi ne'e. ka ana madhutu na sèra tèke eele mesa na, lasi hèli nganga'a ètu d'ara kota. hèia bhèni ca dhèu nèti kota èèna, mai usu èi. ka yesus manèngi ne èi, aku nèngu na, ja'a bisa kinu èi ciki, do?

source_text: therefore that woman of samaria saith to him, how thou, that art a jew, askest of me a drink, that am a woman of samaria? for the jews used not to deal with the samaritans.
target_text: te ngaa bhèni ne cag'ag'a, lula dhèu yahudi tema boe padhai lii dènge dhèu samaria. ka bhèni ne karèi yesus, aku nèngu na, èu dhèu yahudi. ja'a ne dhèu samaria. sala boe ne, ladhe èu manèngi ja'a èi ho minu?

source_text: jesus answered, and said to her, if thou knewest the gift of god, and who it is, that saith to thee, give me drink, thou peradventure wouldest have asked of him, and he should have given to thee quick water.
target_text: hèia yesus dhaa, aku nèngu na, sèmi ne'e. ladhe èu me'a ngaa dhu ama lamatua neo hia dhèu aa'i-aa'i, aa ladhe èu tadhe ja'a ne cee, dhu manèngi èu èi ne, na, tatu èu manèngi hari èi nèti ja'a. pe ja'a hia èu èi dhu nèti mamuri.

source_text: the woman saith to him, sire, thou hast not wherein to draw, and the pit is deep; whereof then hast thou quick water?
target_text: ka bhèni ne b'ala, peka na, èu dènge boe sabha uusu. aa madha èi ne marèma. nèti mia èu abhu èi dhu nèti mamuri èèna? èi èèna abhu ètu mia hari?

source_text: whether thou art greater than our father jacob, that gave to us the pit? and he drank thereof, and his sons, and his beasts.
target_text: abhu ètu mia èu kapai risi nèti baki èdhi yakob! nèngu ka dhu tèke eele madha èi ne hia ji'i. aa nèngu, ana-ana na, dènge badha-manu na rinu nèti èi ne'e kahèi.

source_text: jesus answered, and said to her, each man that drinketh of this water, shall thirst again;
target_text: hèia yesus peka na, sanèd'e, ee! dhèu dhu tema rinu nèti madha èi ne, èèna na koko-kamango hari.

source_text: but he that drinketh of the water that i shall give him, shall not thirst without end; but the water that i shall give him, shall be made in him a well of water, springing up into everlasting life.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu dhu rinu èi dhu ja'a hia, èèna na koko-kamango heka. te èi dhu ja'a hia èèna, nuka sèmi èi madha dhu sabhoka asa li'u. èi ne, nèti mamuri dhu lèke, dhu ma'ète boe.

source_text: the woman saith to him, sire, give me this water, that i thirst not, neither come hither to draw.
target_text: ka aku dhèu bhèni ne, na, ladhe sèmi èèna, na, èu hia ku ja'a èi èèna, sèna ka ja'a koko-kamango ia ka! dènge sèmi èèna, ja'a mai heka pahari-pahari asa ne'e ho usu èi.

source_text: jesus saith to her, go, call thine husband, and come hither.
target_text: hèia yesus peka dènge ne, sèmi ne'e. èu lèpa, lamu paroa ku dhèu èmu mu, mai asa ne'e.

source_text: the woman answered, and said, i have none husband or i have not an husband. jesus saith to her, thou saidest well, that i have none husband or i have not an husband; for thou hast had five husbands, and he that thou hast now, is not thine husband. this thing thou saidest soothly.
target_text: ka bhèni ne dhaa, peka na, te ngaa ja'a dènge boe dhèu èmu. hèia yesus peka na, tare'a. èu peka mola-mola èèna. te èu leo mèdhi le èmu lèmi hari. aa mone dhu limuri ne, dhèu èmu èu boe.

source_text: the woman saith to him, lord, i see, that thou art a prophet.
target_text: ka bhèni ne lii, peka na, ira ii! ja'a heka ke'a kèna, ama ne ca dhèu nèti dhèu rèti lii padhai lamatua.

source_text: our fathers worshipped in this hill, and ye say, that at jerusalem is a place, where it behooveth to worship.
target_text: de ja'a neo karèi. bèi-baki ji'i dhèu samaria pahaha iisi mi ama lamatua ètu ledhe gerisim. te ngaa miu dhèu yahudi peka na, ladhe neo sabaj'a mi ama lamatua, dhèu aa'i-aa'i hud'i lasi ku asa kota yerusalem. madhutu ama, mia ka dhu lèke?

source_text: jesus saith to her, woman, believe thou to me, for the hour shall come, when neither in this hill, neither in jerusalem, ye shall worship the father.
target_text: yesus dhaa, na, èu parcaya ku lii ja'a ne, te dhu lèke sèmi ne'e ku. dhèu neo pahaha iisi mi ama lamatua ètu ledhe ne'e, do, ètu yerusalem, pe d'ai lod'o na, dua era se guna heka.

source_text: ye worship that that ye know not; we worship that that we know; for health is of the jews.
target_text: miu dhèu samaria me'a mèu boe, mi cee ka miu pahaha iisi. te ngaa ji'i dhèu yahudi nge'a mèu, lula-nèti ama lamatua dhu ji'i pahaha iisi mi nèngu. te nèngu neo pake ji'i ho bhoke j'ara, sèna ka dhèu bisa abhu mamuri nèti koasa sasala-sasigo rèngu.

source_text: but the time is come, and now it is, when true worshippers shall worship the father in spirit and truth; for also the father seeketh such, that worship him.
target_text: pe d'ai lod'o na, nuka mulai ne'e ne, dhèu dhu tare'a-re'a pahaha iisi mi ama èdhi ètu sorga, na, rèngu pahaha iisi mi nèngu madhutu roh na, aa madhutu ngaa dhu lèke. te ama ètu sorga d'èi dhèu sèmi sèra dhu pahaha iisi mi nèngu.

source_text: god is a spirit, and it behooveth them that worship him, to worship in spirit and truth.
target_text: te lamatua èèna, roh. de dhèu dhu pahaha iisi mi nèngu hud'i pahaha iisi madhutu ku roh na, aa madhutu ngaa dhu lèke.

source_text: the woman saith to him, i know that messiah is come, that is said christ; therefore when he cometh, he shall tell us all things.
target_text: ka dhèu bhèni ne lii, peka na, ja'a ke'a le mesias neo mai èèna, dhu dhèu peka na, ‘kristus'. ama lamatua padhadha tèke neo hia mai. ladhe na mai ka, tatu nèngu bhoke paled'a aa'i-aa'i mi ji'i.

source_text: jesus saith to her, i am he or i am, that speaketh with thee.
target_text: hèia yesus b'ala, na, nèngu èèna, nuka ja'a dhu padhai lii dènge èu ne.

source_text: and anon his disciples came, and wondered, that he spake with the woman; nevertheless no man said to him, what seekest thou, or, what speakest thou with her?
target_text: ropa nèngu padhai lii era, ana madhutu na sèra lèpa nèti d'ara kota. rèngu malaa, lula rèngu rèdhi yesus dhu padhai lii dènge bhèni samaria ca dhèu. te ngaa ca dhèu sa bani boe karèi dhèu bhèni, na, èu parluu ngaa? aa èci sa bani boe karèi yesus kahèi, peka na, nga tao ka ama padhai lii dènge dhèu bhèni ne?

source_text: therefore the woman left her water pot, and went into the city, and said to the men,
target_text: ka bhèni ne tèke eele g'ala na ètu era èèna, la'e asa d'ara kota. hèia na lolo dènge dhèu ètu sèra, peka na,

source_text: come ye, and see a man, that said to me all things that i have done; whether he be christ?
target_text: mai lati ladhe ku dhèu nèi laa! te na bhoke patalele aa'i le ngaa-ngaa dhu ja'a ad'u-ue kèdhi. tao-tao nèngu ne'e ka, kristus, dhu ama lamatua pamoa hia mai!

source_text: and they went out of the city, and came to him.
target_text: hèia dhèu ae kalua nèti d'ara kota, lasi laladhe ne.

source_text: in the meanwhile his disciples prayed him, and said, master or rabbi, eat.
target_text: lod'o bhèni ne la'e asa kota, hèia ana madhutu na peka dènge ne, ama mese! mai ka ta'a!

source_text: but he said to them, i have meat to eat, that ye know not.
target_text: te ngaa na dhaa, peka na, ja'a abhu le nganga'a dhu miu me'a boe.

source_text: therefore the disciples said together, whether any man hath brought him meat to eat?
target_text: ka ana madhutu na pakarèi èci dènge èci, aku rèngu na, tasamia, ne? cee ka dhu rèti nganga'a hia ne?

source_text: jesus saith to them, my meat is that i do the will of him that sent me, and that i perform the work of him.
target_text: te ngaa yesus peka dènge rèngu, na, sèmi ne'e. ama lamatua pua ja'a mai, sèna ka tao madhutu dad'èi na, aa pakako sasab'a-la'a na toke d'ai èle. ne'e ne, nuka sèmi nganga'a-nginu dhu ja'a abhu.

source_text: whether ye say not, that yet four months be, and ripe corn cometh? lo! i say to you, lift up your eyes, and see ye the fields, for now they be white to reap.
target_text: miu ladhe ku asa d'ara oka-tedhe, aa mi kasere sèku, ele boe miu peka na, ‘di èpa hèru ka, heka bisa puru are kèna. ' nanene, ee! ja'a pasanèd'e miu. ladhe miu laladhe paie-iie, are ètu d'ara oka-tedhe d'ai le lod'o puu-g'ètu. oka-tedhe sèra nuka sèmi dhèu-dhèu dhu mai asa èdhi. te rèngu se'e ka dhu sadia le parcaya ja'a.

source_text: and he that reapeth taketh hire, and gathereth fruit into everlasting life; that both he that soweth, and he that reapeth, have joy together.
target_text: mesa boe sèmi se'e di, te dhèu dhu puu-g'ètu sèra pakaboko hua-hela ètu d'ara gud'a, rèngu mulai sèmi rare rui-j'aj'èra ra. rèngu se'e, nuka sèmi dhèu pad'elo j'ara sèna ka dhèu parcaya mi ama lamatua, ho abhu mamuri dhu lèke dhu ma'ète boe. dènge j'ara sèmi èèna, dhèu sèle hini dènge dhèu puu-g'ètu, bisa sama-sama karej'e-karae.

source_text: in this thing is the word true, for one is that soweth, and another that reapeth.
target_text: dhèu peka na, ‘dhèu èci sèle hini; dhèu leo ka dhu kaboko isi rai. ' èèna, lèke kèna.

source_text: i sent you to reap, that that ye have not travailed; other men have travailed, and ye have entered into their travails.
target_text: ja'a pua-paleha miu ho lami kaboko isi rai nèti sasab'a dhèu leo. mema sasab'a miu boe, te ngaa miu abhu leto nèti rui-j'aj'èra rèngu.

source_text: and of that city many of the samaritans believed in him, for the word of the woman, that bare witnessing, that he said to me all things that i have done.
target_text: lod'o èèna, dhèu ètu d'ara kota samaria ae ka dhu parcaya yesus, lula lii padhai bhèni ne, dhu peka na, na bhoke patalele aa'i le ngaa-ngaa dhu ja'a ad'u-ue kèdhi.

source_text: therefore when samaritans came to him, they prayed him to dwell there; and he dwelt there two days.
target_text: ka ropa dhèu se'e mai d'ai madha yesus, ra pamako ne, peka na, ama pea ku laa dènge ji'i mi ne'e! hèia yesus pea dènge dhèu se, dua lod'o.

source_text: and many more believed for his word,
target_text: aa dhèu leo ae kahèi dhu parcaya ne, lula lii padhai na.

source_text: and said to the woman, that now not for thy speech we believe; for we have heard, and we know, that this is verily the saviour of the world.
target_text: hèia dhèu se peka dènge dhèu bhèni ne, aku rèngu na, med'a na, ji'i nanene dhoka lii èu di. te ngaa ne'e ne ji'i parcaya ne, lula ji'i nanene lii padhai na patoo madha dènge madha. ji'i nge'a tare'a, na, dhèu ne'e ne ka dhu bisa patalale èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti, ètu rai-haha ne nèti koasa sasala-sasigo èdhi.

source_text: and after two days he went out from thence, and went into galilee.
target_text: hèia yesus si tèke eele era èèna, pakèd'i lasi asa propensi galilea.

source_text: and he bare witnessing, that a prophet in his own country hath none honour, or worship.
target_text: ca tèka yesus dhu peka nèdhi, na, dhèu d'èi boe pakab'ua dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua nèti rae èta-èsu na.

source_text: therefore when he came into galilee, men of galilee received him, when they had seen all things that he had done in jerusalem in the feast day; for also they had come to the feast day.
target_text: uru èèna, lod'o dhèu dhae tao mèka kalela paska, dhèu galilea ae ka dhu lasi asa yerusalem, sèna ka tao lod'o hua iia ètu nèi. ka rèdhi aa'i-aa'i kahèi dhu yesus tao ètu yerusalem. nèti èèna ka, lod'o na lèpa asa galilea, dhèu sèmi ne dènge be'a.

source_text: therefore he came again into the cana of galilee, where he made the water into wine. and there was a little king, whose son was sick at capernaum.
target_text: ka yesus si lasi hari asa rae kana ètu propensi galilea. ètu era ne'e ka dhu yesus tao nèdhi èi j'aj'i anggor. lod'o èèna, abhu pegawi ca dhèu dhu pea ètu kota kapernaum. ana mone na dhu pèd'a.

source_text: when this had heard, that jesus should come from judea into galilee, he went to him, and prayed him, that he should come down, and heal his son; for he began to die.
target_text: ropa pegawi ne tadèngi, yesus lèpa le asa galilea nèti propensi yudea, hèia ca'e la'e asa rae kana ho tenge yesus. ropa paraga dènge ne, ka na pamako, sèna ka yesus puru la'e ho puri-pa'èle ana na nèti papèd'a-tarègu. te ana ne dhu pèd'a oe madhe.

source_text: therefore jesus said to him, but ye see tokens, and great wonders, ye believe not.
target_text: ka yesus peka dènge pegawi ne, ladhe miu mèdhi boe tadha-tadha malaa dhu ja'a tao, na, miu mo'o boe lèka ja'a!

source_text: the little king saith to him, lord, come down, before that my son die.
target_text: te ngaa pegawi ne dhaa, aku nèngu na, ama, lati ku laa. te aad'o, na, ana ja'a madhe.

source_text: jesus saith to him, go, thy son liveth. the man believed to the word, that jesus said to him, and he went.
target_text: hèia yesus lii dènge ne, lèpa ka. te ana mu mamuri. ka na lèpa dènge ka, lula nèngu parcaya lii padhai yesus.

source_text: and now when he came down, the servants came to meet him, and told to him, and said, that his son lived.
target_text: ropa pegawi ne ètu talora j'ara era, dhèu-dhèu sab'a na mai paraga dènge ne, ka ra peka na, ama susa ia ka, te ana ama èle le nèti papèd'a.

source_text: and he asked of them the hour, in which he was amended. and they said to him, for yesterday in the seventh hour the fever left him.
target_text: ka na karèi si, na èle, d'ara hake pèri sa? ka dhèu se dhaa, peka na, karèi med'a, lod'o titu mera d'ara hake èci sa, maringi-sagoro na èle dènge ka.

source_text: therefore the father knew, that that hour it was, in which jesus said to him, thy son liveth; and he believed, and all his house.
target_text: hèia pegawi ne ngee nèdhi dènge, na, ana na be'a le, ropa yesus peka na, ana ama èle le nèti papèd'a. ka pegawi ne, dènge isi èmu na aa'i-aa'i parcaya yesus.

source_text: jesus did again this second token, when he came from judea into galilee.
target_text: de ne'e ne, tadha malaa ka dua dhu yesus tao, lod'o na kalua nèti yudea la'e asa galilea.

source_text: after these things there was a feast day of the jews, and jesus went up to jerusalem.
target_text: nèbhu boe nèti èèna, abhu lod'o hua iia agama yahudi. ka yesus si lasi asa kota yerusalem.

source_text: and in jerusalem is a washing place, that in hebrew is called bethesda, and hath five porches. forsooth at jerusalem is a standing water of beasts, that in hebrew is called bethesda, having five little gates, or entries.
target_text: ètu nèi, abhu kolam cue dhu dènge lèmi teras dhu padètu dènge hèb'a babèdho èci, dhu dhèu peka na, babèdho kahib'i-kalèbho. dènge lii aram kolam ne, ngara na ‘batesda'.

source_text: in these lay a great multitude of sick men, blind, crooked, and dry, abiding the moving or the stirring of the water.
target_text: dhèu pèd'a ae-ae dhu tema mate ètu teras se'e. dhèu pèd'a se nuka sèmi: dhèu bèdhu, dhèu karuku, dènge dhèu bisa boe eso. rèngu se mate, ladhe pèri lod'o èi ne mulai dènge gagèb'o.

source_text: for the angel of the lord came down certain times into the standing water, and the water was moved; and he that first came down into the cistern, after the moving of the water, was made whole of whatever sickness he was held.
target_text: te ca tèka-tèka, ana pajuu lamatua nèti sorga maso uru asa d'ara èi ne, ho na gagèb'o èi ne. ho ladhe cee dhu maso uru asa d'ara èi ne, papèd'a nèngu èle dènge.

source_text: and a man was there, having eight and thirty years in his sickness.
target_text: ètu era ne'e abhu ca dhèu dhu pèd'a tèlu nguru aru tèu le.

source_text: and when jesus had seen him lying, and had known, that he had much time, he saith to him, wilt thou be made whole?
target_text: hèia yesus ladhe nèdhi dhèu ne j'unu ètu èèna. nèngu ne'a dhèu ne dhu pèd'a nèbhu le, ka na karèi ne, aku nèngu na, èu neo èle nèti papèd'a, do?

source_text: the sick man answered to him, lord, i have no man, that when the water is moved or troubled, to put me into the cistern; for while i come, another goeth down before me.
target_text: hèia dhèu ne dhaa, na, ko'o, ama. te ngaa ako carui ka, ladhe èi ne mulai gagèb'o, abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu ded'e ja'a ho pamaso asa d'ara èi ne. ladhe ja'a sèku maso, na, abhu le dhèu leo dhu maso uuru nèti ja'a.

source_text: jesus saith to him, rise up, take thy bed, and go.
target_text: ka yesus pua ne, aku nèngu na, titu ka! lulu dhèpi èu, ho lèpa ka.

source_text: and anon the man was made whole, and took up his bed, and went forth. and it was sabbath in that day.
target_text: ropa yesus padhai lii nare, hèia dhèu ne èle dènge ka nèti karuku na. ka na kèd'i, ded'e nèti dhèpi na, hèia la'e dènge ka. j'ara ne j'aj'i, lèke dènge lod'o sabaj'a dhèu yahudi.

source_text: therefore the jews said to him that was made whole, it is sabbath, it is not leaveful to thee, to take away thy bed.
target_text: ka ama-ama dhèu yahudi jèke dhèu dhu heka èle nèti papèd'a ne, aku rèngu na, weh! èu me'a, do aad'o? doe ne'e ne, lèke dènge lod'o ae sasab'a. madhutu atora agama èdhi, dhèu bisa boe nedhe dhèpi na, te èèna ngara na, sasab'a!

source_text: he answered to them, he that made me whole, said to me, take thy bed, and go.
target_text: ka na dhaa, aku nèngu na, ama-ama! baku nasa dènge ja'a. te dhèu dhu puri-pa'èle ja'a, dhu paredha ja'a peka na, ‘lulu dhèpi èu, ho lèpa ka. '

source_text: therefore they asked him, what man is that or who is that man, that said to thee, take up thy bed, and go?
target_text: hèia dhèu se karèi ne, cee ka dhu pua èu nedhe dhèpi èèna?

source_text: but he that was made whole, wist not who it was. and jesus bowed away from the people, that was set in the place.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu dhu èle nèti pèd'a ne, tadhe boe, na, yesus ne, cee. te yesus dhu kalua le mau-mau, lula dhèu ae ètu èèna.

source_text: afterward jesus found him in the temple, and said to him, lo! thou art made whole; now do not thou do sin or now do not thou sin, lest any worse thing befall to thee.
target_text: nèbhu boe, ka yesus paraga dènge dhèu ne ètu madha èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. ka yesus peka dènge ne, aku nèngu na, nanene! èu èle le nèti papèd'a èu. baku ad'u-ue hari sasala, sèna ka èu baku abhu hari j'aj'èra dhu bia risi.

source_text: that man went, and told to the jews, that it was jesus that made him whole.
target_text: hèia dhèu ne la'e asa ama-ama dhèu yahudi se, ka na lolo, peka na, dhu puri-pa'èle ja'a nèti papèd'a èèna, ngara na yesus.

source_text: therefore the jews pursued jesus, for he did this thing in the sabbath.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ra mulai paj'èra yesus, lula nèngu pa'èle dhèu pèd'a lèke dènge lod'o manèngi-mangaj'i.

source_text: and jesus answered to them, my father worketh till now, and i work.
target_text: te ngaa yesus peka dènge ra, sèmi ne'e. ama ku ae boe nèti sasab'a-la'a na. de ja'a sab'a taruu kahèi.

source_text: therefore the jews sought more to slay him, for not only he brake the sabbath, but he said that god was his father, and made him even to god.
target_text: lula ama-ama dhèu yahudi se cap le, peka na, yesus sisu atora lod'o ae sasab'a rèngu, nèti èèna ka ra tenge-tenge j'ara tasamia, ho pamadhe ne. risi-risi hari, na peka na, ama lamatua èèna, ama nèngu. dènge lii padhai sèmi ne'e, nèngu tao iisi na sama sèmi ama lamatua.

source_text: therefore jesus answered, and said to them, truly, truly, i say to you, the son may not of himself do anything, but that thing that he seeth the father doing; for whatever things he doeth, the son doeth in like manner those things.
target_text: ka yesus peka dènge ra, aku nèngu na, tare'a! ja'a peka mema, na, ja'a bisa boe tao ngaa-ngaa madhutu d'ara ja'a unu ku. te ja'a ne, ana ama lamatua. nèti èèna ka ja'a bisa sab'a dhodhoka madhutu ngaa dhu ja'a kèdhi ama ku sab'a. ja'a kèdhi ama ku tao ngaa, na, ja'a tao madhutu sèmi èèna kahèi.

source_text: for the father loveth the son, and showeth to him all things that he doeth; and he shall show to him greater works than these, that ye wonder.
target_text: ama ku ètu sorga sue ja'a, nuka ana na. na pad'elo dènge ja'a kahèi aa'i-aa'i dhu nèngu tao. na neo pad'elo dènge ja'a j'ara-j'ara dhu kapai risi hari, sèna ka miu mèdhi aa asa tabha malaa!

source_text: for as the father raiseth dead men, and quickeneth, so the son quickeneth whom he will.
target_text: ama ku pamamuri hari dhèu madhe. sèmi èèna kahèi, bèli-camèd'a ja'a hia mamuri dhu lèke mi cee èèna ka dhu madhutu dad'èi ja'a.

source_text: for neither the father judgeth any man, but hath given every doom to the son,
target_text: dhu mola-mola, sèmi ne'e ka: ama ku mesa na pama'ète boe hahuku mi dhèu. te ngaa na pangèd'u aa'i hak èèna mi ja'a, te ja'a ne, ana na. hèia ja'a ka dhu pama'ète, na, tatao dhèu lèke, do aad'o.

source_text: that all men honour the son, as they honour the father. he that honoureth not the son, honoureth not the father that sent him.
target_text: ama ku d'èi sèna ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i pakab'ua ja'a, sama sèmi rèngu pakab'ua nèngu kahèi. te dhèu dhu pakab'ua boe ja'a, ana nèngu ne, èci èèna ka rèngu pakab'ua boe ama ku dhu pua ja'a mai.

source_text: truly, truly, i say to you, that he that heareth my word, and believeth in him that sent me, hath everlasting life, and he cometh not into doom, but passeth from death into life.
target_text: tare'a! ja'a peka mema. dhèu dhu tare'a-re'a nanene lii padhai ja'a, aa parcaya ama lamatua dhu pua ja'a mai, na, nèngu abhu mamuri dhu lèke dhu ma'ète boe. lamatua huku heka nèngu. te dhèu èèna abhu heka hahuku madhe, te ngaa nèngu j'aj'i le dhèu dhu mamuri taruu dènge lamatua.

source_text: truly, truly, i say to you, for the hour cometh, and now it is, when dead men shall hear the voice of the son of god, and they that hear, shall live.
target_text: tare'a! ja'a peka mema dènge miu kèna. lod'o na dètu le, limuri ne dhu j'aj'i le, nuka dhèu-dhèu madhe nanene lii ja'a, ana ama lamatua. te dhèu dhu nanene dènge sèmi nare lii padhai ja'a, nèngu abhu mamuri dhu lèke.

source_text: for as the father hath life in him-self, so he gave to the son, to have life in himself;
target_text: mamuri aa'i-aa'i kapua na nèti ama ku. nèngu hia ja'a mamuri dhu lèke kahèi. te ja'a ne, ana na.

source_text: and he gave to him power to make doom, for he is man's son.
target_text: ama ku pangèd'u koasa dènge hak mi ja'a kahèi, sèna ka pama'ète hahuku mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra, lula ja'a ne, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a.

source_text: do not ye wonder in this, for the hour cometh, in which all men that be in burials, shall hear the voice of god's son.
target_text: miu baku malaa, te ciki oo'e hari dhèu madhe aa'i-aa'i ra tadèngi lii padhai ja'a.

source_text: and they that have done good things, shall go into again-rising of life; but they that have done evil things, into again-rising of doom.
target_text: hèia ra mamuri hari. ka rèngu kalua nèti d'ara ro'a ra. dhèu dhu uru sèra tao be'a, abhu mamuri dhu lèke dhu ma'ète boe. te ngaa dhèu dhu uru sèra ad'u-ue bhabhelu-katub'a, pasae hahuku taruu.

source_text: i may nothing do of myself, but as i hear, i deem, or i may not of myself do anything, but as i hear, i judge, and my doom is just, for i seek not my will, but the will of the father that sent me.
target_text: yesus tuhu hari lii padhai na, aku nèngu na, ja'a bisa boe tao ngaa-ngaa ladhe dhae tadèngi mèka nèti ama ku. ladhe ja'a tadèngi kore ku, heka ja'a pama'ète lii langu dhèu kèna. nèti èèna ka, ngaa dhu ja'a pama'ète sèra, lèke mola-mola. te ja'a ko'o boe madhutu dad'èi ja'a mesa ku, te ngaa ja'a madhutu dad'èi ama ku. lula nèngu ka dhu pua ja'a mai!

source_text: if i bear witnessing of myself, my witnessing is not true;
target_text: lèke iia boe, ladhe ja'a mesa ku dhu padhue-padhai lula-nèti ngi'u ja'a.

source_text: another is that beareth witnessing of me, and i know that his witnessing is true, that he beareth of me.
target_text: te ngaa abhu dhèu leo kahèi dhu j'aj'i sakasii lula-nèti ja'a. aa ja'a ke'a lii padhai nèngu lula-nèti ja'a, lèke tare'a-re'a.

source_text: ye sent to john, and he bare witnessing to the truth.
target_text: miu dhu pua mèdhi dhèu lasi pakarèi dènge yohanis tuka sarani. ka na peka lèke lula-nèti ja'a ne.

source_text: but i take not witnessing of man; but i say these things, that ye be safe.
target_text: aa te ngaa ja'a parluu boe lii sakasii nèti dhèu rai-haha. te ngaa ja'a pasanèd'e lii se'e, sèna ka miu bisa pakaj'èu nèti koasa sasala-sasigo miu.

source_text: he was a lantern burning and shining, or giving light; but ye would glad, or joy, at an hour in his light.
target_text: lii padhai yohanis ne, nuka sèmi labhu èci dhu heo pasaraa miu. ropa heo na d'elo miu era, d'ara miu karej'e-karae.

source_text: but i have more witnessing than john, for the works that my father gave to me to perform them or the works that my father gave me that i perform them, those works that i do bear wit-nessing of me, that the father sent me.
target_text: aa te ngaa ja'a abhu dhèu èci dhu kapai risi eele nèti yohanis dhu peka mola-mola lula-nèti ja'a ne. nèngu, nuka ama ku ètu sorga, dhu pangèd'u mi ja'a sasab'a ae-ae, sèna ka sab'a toke pa'èle. sasab'a ae se'e ka dhu j'aj'i mi tadha, na, ama ka dhu pua ja'a.

source_text: and the father that sent me, he bare witnessing of me. neither ye heard ever his voice, neither ye saw his likeness, or form.
target_text: lula nèngu ka dhu pua-paleha ja'a, nèngu ka dhu peka mola-mola lula-nèti ja'a kahèi. miu mesa mi tadèngi mèdhi mèka lii nèngu, do, patoo madha dènge madha, aa ladhe mèdhi mèka rèhu na.

source_text: and ye have not his word dwelling in you; for ye believe not to him, whom he sent.
target_text: lii holo-nori lamatua mamuri boe ètu d'ara miu, lula miu parcaya boe ja'a dhu nèngu pua mai.

source_text: seek ye the scriptures, in which ye guess to have everlasting life; and those it be, that bear witnessing of me.
target_text: miu d'èi parisa toke lutu sasuri mola-mèci lamatua, lula miu pangee, na, bèli-camèd'a miu abhu j'ara ho abhu mamuri dhu lèke dhu ma'ète boe. aa te ngaa sasuri sèra ka dhu lole lula-nèti ja'a ne.

source_text: and ye will not come to me, that ye have life.
target_text: te ngaa miu mo'o boe ara mai asa ja'a, ho j'aj'i dhèu ja'a, sèna ka abhu mamuri dhu lèke dhu ma'ète boe.

source_text: i take not clearness of men;
target_text: ja'a parluu boe dhèu ded'e kolongara ja'a padedha-dedha.

source_text: but i have known you, that ye have not the love of god in you.
target_text: lula ja'a ke'a mèu d'ara iiki miu. nèti èèna ka ja'a ke'a, na, miu sue boe ama lamatua.

source_text: i came in the name of my father, and ye took not me. if another come in his own name, ye shall receive him.
target_text: ja'a mai asa rai-haha ne, lula ama ku dhu nèd'u koasa ka pua ja'a mai. te ngaa miu mo'o boe sèmi mere ja'a. aa te ngaa ladhe dhèu leo dhu mai pake koasa nèngu, miu sèmi mere ne dènge be'a.

source_text: how may ye believe, that receive glory each of other, and ye seek not the glory that is of god alone?
target_text: miu èci dènge èci d'èi sèna ka abhu koa-kad'iri. te ngaa miu pusi-pahae boe, ladhe ama lamatua koa miu, do aad'o. aa te ngaa nèngu èèna, ama lamatua! abhu boe dhu leo. de ladhe miu pahae boe ne, na, tasamia miu bisa parcaya nèngu?

source_text: do not ye guess, that i am to accuse you with the father; it is moses that accuseth you, in whom ye hope.
target_text: baku pangee, na, ja'a pèci sasala mi dedha miu ètu katanga madha ama ku. aad'o. dhu pèci sasala sa dedha miu nuka musa. aa te ngaa, era maena miu ka nèngu, lula nèngu ka dhu hia miu atora ama lamatua.

source_text: for if ye believed to moses, peradventure ye should believe also to me; for he wrote of me.
target_text: de ladhe miu lèka musa, tatu miu parcaya ja'a tare'a-re'a. te nèngu ka dhu suri lula-nèti ja'a ne.

source_text: but if ye believe not to his letters, how shall ye believe to my words?
target_text: te ngaa lula miu parcaya èra boe mi ngaa dhu na suri, tasamia ka miu bisa lèka ngaa dhu ja'a peka-padhai? aad'o, sina ma?

source_text: after these things jesus went over the sea of galilee, that is tiberias. and a great multitude pursued him; for they saw the tokens that he did on them that were sick. therefore jesus went into an hill, and sat there with his disciples. and the pask was full nigh, a feast day of the jews.
target_text: lod'o kalela paska dhèu yahudi oe dètu. hèia yesus si lasi asa cabèka dano galilea. ngara leo dano ne, ‘dano tiberias'. dhèu ae dhu madhutu ne, lula rèdhi tadha-tadha malaa dhu na tao, lod'o puri-pa'èle dhèu-dhèu pèd'a. d'ai cabèka dano, yesus dènge ana-ana madhutu na ca'e asa ledhe iiki èci. hèia ra madhèdi ètu era èèna.

source_text: therefore when jesus had lifted up his eyes, and had seen, that a great multitude came to him, he saith to philip, whereof shall we buy loaves, that these men eat?
target_text: ropa yesus ladhe nèdhi dhèu ae mai pakaboko, hèia na karèi ana madhutu na ca dhèu, ngara na pelipus, aku nèngu na, ètu era mia èdhi bisa hèli nganga'a, ho hia dhèu se ra'a?

source_text: but he said this thing, tempting him; for he knew what he was to do.
target_text: yesus ne'a le ngaa dhu nèngu neo tao. te ngaa na peka sèmi èèna, sèna ka neo sèku pelipus.

source_text: philip answered to him, the loaves of two hundred pence suffice not to them, that each man take a little what.
target_text: ka pelipus dhaa, na, waa! masi ka gaji tuka ca dhèu dua ngasu lod'o èèna ka, d'ai mèka hèli roti ho panga'a dhèu udhu sobhu-sobhu se! masi ka ca dhèu abhu roti ciki oo'e èèna ka, pad'ai boe hèi!

source_text: one of his disciples, andrew, the brother of simon peter, saith to him,
target_text: hèia, ca dhèu hari nèti ana madhutu na, ngara na anderias, ari simon petrus, peka dènge yesus, aku nèngu na,

source_text: a child is here, that hath five barley loaves and two fishes; but what be these among so many?
target_text: ama! ana iiki èci ètu ne'e nèti roti lèmi bua, dènge i'a dua ngi'u. te ngaa d'ai dhèu ae-ae se ra'a, do aad'o?

source_text: therefore jesus saith, make them sit to or at the meat. and there was much hay in the place. and so men sat to or at the meat, as five thousand in number.
target_text: ètu era ne'e, j'u'u muri ae-ae. ka yesus peka dènge ana madhutu na, ator si madhèdi. hèia dhèu se madhèdi ka. lod'o èèna, dhèu ae titu kèna. dhèu mone di, pe d'ai lèmi riho dhèu sa.

source_text: and jesus took the five loaves, and when he had done thankings, he parted to the men that sat at the meat, and also of the fishes, as much as they would.
target_text: hèia yesus nare roti se, ka na manèngi makasi mi ama lamatua. ka na pangèd'u mi ana madhutu na sèra. sèna ka rèngu bagi hia dhèu se aa'i-aa'i ra. na tao sèmi èèna kahèi dènge i'a sèra. dhèu se aa'i-aa'i ra'a toke bècu.

source_text: and when they were full-filled or ful filled, he said to his disciples, gather ye the remnants that be left, that they perish not.
target_text: ropa ra'a toke bècu, hèia yesus peka dènge ana-ana madhutu na, aku nèngu na, pakaboko mere nganga'a dhu sisa se'e, sèna ka baku core eele iia d'ara.

source_text: and so they gathered, and filled twelve coffins, of the remnants of the five barley loaves and two fishes, that left to them that had eaten.
target_text: ka ra pakaboko nganga'a dhu sisa nèti roti lèmi bua deo sa, pènu canguru dua soe.

source_text: therefore those men, when they had seen the sign or the token, or miracle, that he had done, said, for this is verily the prophet, that is to come into the world.
target_text: ropa dhèu ae-ae se ladhe rèdhi tadha malaa dhu yesus tao ne, hèia ra peka na, ira ii! nèngu ne, tatu dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua dhu na jaji le neo hia mai.

source_text: and when jesus had known, that they were to come to take him, and make him king, he flew or fled alone again into an hill.
target_text: yesus ne'a, na, dhèu se neo laka-seti ne sèna ka j'aj'i dhèu aae. hèia la'e tèke eele si, ka na ca'e asa era kaj'èu ètu ledhe iiki èci, sèna ka nèngu mesa na ètu era èèna.

source_text: and when eventide was come, his disciples went down to the sea.
target_text: ropa lod'o heka cèna, ana-ana madhutu yesus puru lasi asa sebhe dano.

source_text: and they went up into a boat, and they came over the sea into capernaum. and darknesses were made then, and jesus was not or had not come to them.
target_text: yesus mai mèka pa'èci dènge rèngu. ka ra ca'e koha cue, hèia ra tuku lasi asa kota kapernaum ètu cabèka dano. ropa rèngu pakèd'i, lod'o dhu maroga le.

source_text: and for a great wind blew, the sea rose up.
target_text: lula ngèlu aae, ka naha mulai kapai.

source_text: therefore when they had rowed as five and twenty furlongs or thirty, they saw jesus walking on the sea, and to be nigh the boat; and they dreaded.
target_text: ropa ana madhutu yesus se'e tuku kaj'èu pe d'ai lèmi kilometer sa, hèia ladhe rèdhi yesus dhu kako re dedha èi. na mai padètu-dètu dènge koha rèngu, ka ra madha'u titu kèna.

source_text: and he said to them, i am; do not ye dread.
target_text: te ngaa yesus lii dènge ra, aku nèngu na, baku madha'u! te ja'a ne.

source_text: therefore they would take him into the boat, and anon the boat was at the land, to which they went.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, rèngu madha'u heka. aa ra neo sèna ka yesus ca'e sama-sama dènge rèngu. cag'ag'a laa, koha ne d'ai le dae dhu rèngu neo lasi.

source_text: on the tother day, the people, that stood over the sea, saw, that there was none other boat there but that one, and that jesus entered not with his disciples into the boat, but his disciples alone went or went alone. but other boats came from tiberias beside the place, where they had eaten bread, and did thankings to god. therefore when the people had seen, that jesus was not there, neither his disciples, they went up into boats, and came to capernaum, seeking jesus.
target_text: asa bèli èèna, dhèu ae sèra ètu cabèka dano era. rèngu padètu iiki dènge era dhu med'a na yesus manèngi makasi mi ama lamatua, ropa hia si ra'a. hèia dhèu se re'a, na, med'a na koha dhoka cue di ètu era èèna. te ngaa ana madhutu yesus se pake koha ne, lasi tèke eele era ne'e, aa yesus dhu ca'e boe dènge rèngu. te ngaa abhu pèri-pèri koha leo nèti kota tiberias dhu lasi-mai ètu era èèna. hèia, ropa dhèu ae se re'a, na, yesus dènge ana-ana madhutu na dhu aad'o heka, ka ra ca'e koha leo sèra lasi tenge yesus asa kapernaum, ètu cabèka dano.

source_text: and when they had found him over the sea, they said to him, rabbi, how camest thou hither?
target_text: ka ra paraga dènge yesus ètu cabèka dano. hèia ra karèi yesus, aku rèngu na, ama mese! ama d'ai era ne'e sange mera mia sa?

source_text: jesus answered to them, and said, truly, truly, i say to you ye seek me, not for ye saw the miracles, but for ye ate of the loaves, and were ful filled.
target_text: yesus dhaa, na, dhu lèke sèmi ne'e: miu se tenge ja'a lula boe miu mèdhi le tadha-tadha malaa, te ngaa lula ja'a panga'a miu toke bècu.

source_text: work ye not meat that perisheth, but that that dwelleth into everlasting life, which meat man's son shall give to you; for god the father hath marked him.
target_text: nanene paie-iie! baku sab'a tenge dhoka nganga'a di dhu bèli-camèd'a ele iie d'ara. te ngaa be'a risi miu sab'a sèna ka abhu nganga'a dhu taha taruu, dhu nèti mamuri dhu lèke dhu ma'ète boe. te ja'a ne, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a. ja'a ka dhu bisa hia miu mamuri èèna. te ama ètu sorga pangèd'u le hak mi ja'a ne.

source_text: therefore they said to him, what shall we do, that we work the works of god?
target_text: hèia dhèu se karèi, aku rèngu na, ladhe sèmi èèna, na, ji'i hud'i tao tasamia, sèna ka bisa pakako sasab'a ama lamatua?

source_text: jesus answered, and said to them, this is the work of god, that ye believe to him, whom he sent.
target_text: yesus dhaa, aku nèngu na, sasab'a lamatua, sèmi ne'e ka: miu hud'i parcaya ku ja'a ne. te ama lamatua ka dhu pua ja'a mai.

source_text: therefore they said to him, what token then doest thou, that we see, and believe to thee? what workest thou?
target_text: hèia dhèu se karèi hari, peka na, ama neo pad'elo tadha malaa sèmi ngaa, ho ji'i ngèdhi aa parcaya ama? aa ama neo tao ngaa hari hia ji'i?

source_text: our fathers ate manna in desert, as it is written, he gave to them bread from heaven to eat.
target_text: nuka sèmi uru-uru sèra, bèi-baki ji'i ra'a roti manna ètu d'ara mamoo. èèna nuka sèmi dhu suri tèke ètu d'ara sasuri ama lamatua, peka na, ‘nèngu hia si roti dhu mai nèti dedha-liru, sèna ka ra'a. '

source_text: therefore jesus saith to them, truly, truly, i say to you, moses gave you not bread from heaven, but my father giveth you very bread from heaven;
target_text: ka yesus b'ala, peka na, ja'a peka dhu lèke sèmi ne'e: uru èèna, musa boe ka dhu papuru roti èèna nèti dedha-liru hia mi bèi-baki miu. te dhu papuru mai roti èèna, nuka ama ku ètu sorga. limuri ne na sadia hia miu roti nèti liru kahèi. te ngaa roti ne'e ne, roti dhu tare'a-re'a taha toke d'ai mia-mia.

source_text: for it is very bread that cometh down from heaven, and giveth life to the world.
target_text: te roti nèti lamatua ne, nuka, dhu puru mai nèti sorga aa nèti mamuri hia mi dhèu ètu rai-haha ne.

source_text: therefore they said to him, lord, evermore give to us this bread.
target_text: hèia dhèu se manèngi, aku rèngu na, ama! hia taruu ji'i roti èèna!

source_text: and jesus said to them, i am bread of life; he that cometh to me, shall not hunger; and he that believeth in me, shall never thirst.
target_text: ka yesus peka dènge si, aku nèngu na, ja'a ne'e ka, roti èèna. te ja'a ka dhu kèti mamuri dhu lèke. de dhèu dhu j'aj'i dhèu unu ja'a, manganga heka! aa dhèu dhu parcaya ja'a, koko-kamango heka!

source_text: but i said to you, that ye have seen me, and ye believe not.
target_text: te ngaa ja'a peka kèdhi le dènge miu, na, masi ka miu mèdhi le ja'a, te ngaa miu parcaya mèka ja'a.

source_text: all thing that the father giveth to me, shall come to me; and i shall not cast him out, that cometh to me.
target_text: aa te ngaa dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu ama ku hag'e nare le ho j'aj'i dhèu unu ja'a, bèli-camèd'a rèngu mai asa ja'a. aa ladhe abhu dhèu dhu mai asa ja'a, tatu ja'a babège eele boe ne!

source_text: for i came down from heaven, not that i do my will, but the will of him that sent me.
target_text: te ja'a mai nèti dedha-liru. ja'a mai sèna ka sab'a madhutu dad'èi ama ku, lula nèngu ka dhu pua ja'a. ja'a ko'o boe madhutu dhoka dad'èi ja'a mesa ku.

source_text: and this is the will of the father that sent me, that all thing that the father gave to me, i lose not or nought of it, but again-raise it in the last day.
target_text: dad'èi ama lamatua sèmi ne'e: nèti dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu nèngu hag'e nare le ho j'aj'i dhèu unu ja'a, nèngu d'èi ja'a oru-kaboko si aa'i-aa'i. ja'a bisa boe soro tèke ca dhèu sa ele. te ngaa ladhe lod'o d'ai èle rai-haha ne, ja'a pamamuri hari si.

source_text: and this is the will of my father that sent me, that each man that seeth the son, and believeth in him, have everlasting life; and i shall again-raise him in the last day.
target_text: nuka sèmi dhu ja'a peka deo na, ama ku d'èi sèna ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu tadhe aa parcaya ja'a, nuka ana na, èèna na rèngu bisa abhu mamuri dhu lèke dhu ma'ète boe. hèia ètu lod'o èle rai-haha, ja'a pamamuri hari si.

source_text: therefore the jews grutched of him, for he had said, i am bread that came down from heaven.
target_text: ka ama-ama dhèu yahudi se mulai ka'uu-kamuki, lula yesus peka na, roti dhu mai nèti lamatua èèna, nuka ja'a dhu mai nèti sorga.

source_text: and they said, whether this is not jesus, the son of joseph, whose father and mother we have known. how then saith he this, that i came down from heaven?
target_text: ra padhai lii, peka na, tasamia ka sèmi ne'e? dhèu ne'e ne, yesus ana yusuf, si? ji'i tadhe ina-ama na. de tasamia ka nèngu ne peka na, ‘ja'a mai nèti sorga? ' abhu ètu mia?

source_text: therefore jesus answered, and said to them, do not ye grutch together.
target_text: hèia yesus lii dènge si, aku nèngu na, eee! loe eele ku ka'uu-kamuki!

source_text: no man may come to me, but if or no but the father that sent me, draw him; and i shall again-raise him in the last day.
target_text: ama ku ètu sorga ka pua ja'a mai asa rai-haha ne. abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu bisa mai asa ja'a, ladhe ama ku lere boe ne mai. aa d'ai lod'o èle rai-haha, ja'a pamamuri hari si.

source_text: it is written in the prophets, and all men shall be able to be taught of god. each man that hath heard of the father, and hath learned, cometh to me.
target_text: dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua uru-uru sèra suri rèdhi le, peka na, ‘ama lamatua neo aj'a-nori dhèu aa'i-aa'i. ' de dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu nanene ama ètu sorga, aa rèngu abhu aj'a-nori nèti nèngu, rèngu mai sa ja'a, sèna ka j'aj'i dhèu unu ja'a.

source_text: not for any man hath seen the father, but this that is of god, hath seen the father.
target_text: ja'a ne ka dhu puru mai nèti ama lamatua. de dhoka ja'a mesa-mesa ku kèdhi ne. abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu patoo madha dènge ama ètu sorga.

source_text: soothly, soothly, i say to you, he that believeth in me, hath everlasting life.
target_text: tare'a! ja'a peka dènge miu kèna! dhèu dhu parcaya ja'a, bèli-camèd'a abhu mamuri dhu lèke dhu ma'ète boe.

source_text: i am the bread of life.
target_text: te ja'a ne, nuka roti dhu nèti mamuri èèna.

source_text: your fathers ate manna in desert, and be dead.
target_text: uru-uru sèra, bèi-baki miu ra'a roti manna lod'o ra kako rai-reo d'ara mamoo. masi ka ra'a le roti èèna, te ngaa nèbhu-nèbhu madhe kahèi.

source_text: this is bread coming down from heaven, that if any man eat thereof, he die not.
target_text: te ngaa roti dhu limuri ne puru mai nèti sorga, leko-leo. te dhèu aa'i-aa'i bisa ra'a. sasoa na, dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu parcaya ja'a, rèngu cèri eele heka nèti ama lamatua.

source_text: i am living bread, that came down from heaven. if any man eat of this bread, he shall live without end. and the bread that i shall give, is my flesh for the life of the world.
target_text: lula ja'a ne, roti dhu nèti mamuri, dhu mai nèti sorga. pe ladhe ja'a madhe, ja'a soro ngi'u ja'a sèna ka madhe pala dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne, ho ra bisa mamuri. aa dhèu dhu ra'a roti ne, rèngu abhu mamuri dhu lèke dhu ma'ète boe.

source_text: therefore the jews chided together, and said, how may this give to us his flesh to eat?
target_text: ropa ama-ama dhèu yahudi se tadèngi rare lii padhai yesus ne, hèia ra pab'ala èci dènge èci, aku rèngu na, na padhai lii sèmi ngaa ka nèi? tasamia ka dhèu ne bisa hia ngi'u na, èdhi ta'e?

source_text: therefore jesus saith to them, truly, truly, i say to you, but ye eat the flesh of man's son, and drink his blood, ye shall not have life in you.
target_text: hèia yesus peka dènge si, aku nèngu na, ja'a padhai lii dhu mola-mola dènge miu kèna. ja'a ne, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a. dhèu dhu neo mamuri lèke, hud'i pa'èki ku dènge ja'a. de ladhe miu mi'a boe ngi'u ja'a, aa minu boe raa ja'a, na, miu abhu boe mamuri dhu lèke.

source_text: he that eateth my flesh, and drinketh my blood, hath everlasting life, and i shall again-raise him in the last day.
target_text: te dhèu dhu ra'e ngi'u ja'a, aa rinu raa ja'a, rèngu abhu le mamuri dhu lèke dhu ma'ète boe. d'ai lod'o èle rai-haha, ja'a pamamuri hari ne.

source_text: for my flesh is very meat, and my blood is very drink.
target_text: te nganga'a dhu lèke, nuka ngi'u ja'a. aa nganginu dhu lèke, nuka raa ja'a.

source_text: he that eateth my flesh, and drinketh my blood, dwelleth in me, and i in him.
target_text: de dhèu dhu ra'a ngi'u ja'a, dènge rinu raa ja'a, mamuri ra dhu pa'èki dènge ja'a. aa ja'a pa'èki dènge rèngu.

source_text: as my father living sent me, and i live for the father, and he that eateth me, he shall live for me.
target_text: ama ètu sorga dhu pua ja'a, nèngu mamuri tare'a-re'a. aa ja'a abhu mamuri dhu lèke nèti nèngu kahèi. nèti èèna ka dhèu dhu na'e ngi'u ja'a, nèngu unu mamuri dhu lèke nèti ja'a kahèi.

source_text: this is bread, that came down from heaven. not as your fathers ate manna, and be dead; he that eateth this bread, shall live without end.
target_text: uru-uru sèra, bèi-baki miu ra'a roti manna nèti dedha-liru. masi ka rèngu ra'a, te ngaa nèbhu-nèbhu rèngu madhe kahèi. te ngaa roti dhu mai nèti sorga ne, leko-leo. te dhèu dhu ra'a roti ne, bèli-camèd'a abhu mamuri dhu lèke.

source_text: he said these things in the syna-gogue, teaching in capernaum.
target_text: yesus aj'a j'ara se'e ètu d'ara èmu sabaj'a dhèu yahudi cue ètu kota kapernaum.

source_text: therefore many of his disciples hearing this, said, this word is hard, who may hear it?
target_text: dhèu ae dhu madhutu yesus. ropa rèngu tadèngi lii padhai na sèmi èèna, hèia abhu dhu peka na, a'aj'a na, bia! cee ka dhu bisa sèmi rare a'aj'a èèna?

source_text: but jesus witting at or within himself, that his disciples grutched of this thing, said to them, this thing offendeth you?
target_text: te ngaa yesus dhu ne'a le lii padhai rèngu se, hèia na karèi si, aku nèngu na, a'aj'a ne tao miu susa, do?

source_text: therefore if ye see man's son ascending or going up, where he was before?
target_text: tasamia hari, ladhe miu mèdhi ja'a, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne, ca'e hari asa era pea ja'a uru èèna?

source_text: it is the spirit that quickeneth, the flesh profiteth nothing; the words that i have spoken to you, be spirit and life.
target_text: roh lamatua ka dhu nèti mamuri dhu lèke. mamuri dhu lèke mai boe nèti ngi'u dhèu. te ngaa lii holo-nori ja'a kapua na nèti roh ama lamatua. de lii holo-nori ne'e bisa hia mamuri dhu lèke mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i kahèi.

source_text: but there be some of you that believe not. for jesus knew from the beginning, which were believing, and who was to betray him.
target_text: te ngaa abhu nèti miu cahag'e dhu lèka boe ja'a. yesus peka sèmi ne'e, lula nèngu dhu ne'a le karèi nèti uru j'ara, cee dhu parcaya boe, aa cee ka dhu èèna na pahie eele nèngu.

source_text: and he said, therefore i said to you, that no man may come to me, but it were given to him of my father.
target_text: hèia yesus tuhu hari lii padhai na, aku nèngu na, nèti èèna ka, ja'a peka mema le dènge miu, na, ama ku ètu sorga hud'i bhoke uuru ku j'ara hia dhèu, heka dhèu ne bisa mai j'aj'i dhèu unu ja'a kèna.

source_text: from this time many of his disciples went aback, and went not now with him.
target_text: karèi nèti lod'o èèna, ana madhutu na ae ka dhu tèke eele ne, lula rèngu ro'o heka madhutu nèngu.

source_text: therefore jesus said to the twelve, whether ye will also go away?
target_text: ka yesus karèi ana madhutu na dhèu canguru dua sèra, aku nèngu na, aa miu tasamia? neo tèke eele ja'a kahèi, do?

source_text: and simon peter answered to him, lord, to whom shall we go? thou hast words of everlasting life;
target_text: te ngaa simon petrus dhaa, peka na, ama! ji'i patai-patapa mi cee hari? abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu bisa lole dènge ji'i, j'ara tasamia ji'i bisa abhu mamuri dhu lèke dhu ma'ète boe. dhoka èu mesa mu di!

source_text: and we believe, and have known, or we have believed, and know, that thou art christ, the son of god.
target_text: aa ji'i lèka ama. lula ji'i dhu nge'a le, na, èu ne, nuka dhèu mola-mèci nèti ama lamatua.

source_text: therefore jesus answered to them, whether i chose not you twelve, and one of you is a fiend?
target_text: ka yesus peka dènge ra, aku nèngu na, ja'a hag'e kore le miu dhèu canguru dua. te ngaa sanèd'e! nèti miu se'e, abhu ca dhèu nuka sèmi nidhu!

source_text: and he said this of judas of simon iscariot, for this was to betray him, when he was one of the twelve.
target_text: dhu na peka ne, nuka yudas, ana simon iskariot. yudas ne, ca dhèu nèti ana madhutu na dhèu canguru dua sèra. nèngu ne'e ka dhu èèna na pahie yesus.

source_text: after these things jesus walked into galilee, for he would not walk into judea, for the jews sought to slay him.
target_text: èle èèna, hèia yesus si kako palème propensi galilea. nèngu neo boe kako palème propensi yudea, lula abhu ama-ama dhèu yahudi dhu neo pamadhe ne.

source_text: and there was nigh a feast day of the jews, scenopegia, that is, a feast of tabernacles.
target_text: lod'o èèna, dètu le dènge lod'o kalela puu-g'ètu dhu ra peka na, kalela paleo.

source_text: and his brethren said to him, pass from hence, and go into judea, that also thy disciples see thy works that thou doest;
target_text: ka ari yesus sèra peka dènge ne, aku rèngu na, be'a risi, èu pakeso nèti ne'e, lamu asa yudea. sèna ka dhèu dhu madhutu èu ètu nèi, bisa ladhe rèdhi j'ara-j'ara dhu èu tao.

source_text: for no man doeth anything in huddles, and himself seeketh to be open, +or forsooth no man doeth anything in hid place, or privy, and he seeketh to be in open. if thou doest these things, show thyself to the world.
target_text: te ladhe cee dhu neo sèna ka dhèu ae rèdhi kolo-karisi nèngu, na, nèngu baku tao pahuni-pahuni. lula èu dhu tao tadha malaa rupa-rupa, be'a risi hari, ladhe dhèu ae-ae bisa ladhe rèdhi ngaa dhu èu tao sèra!

source_text: for neither his brethren believed in him.
target_text: ari na sèra peka sèmi èèna, lula rèngu dhu lèka nèngu èra iia boe.

source_text: therefore jesus saith to them, my time came not yet, but your time is evermore ready.
target_text: hèia yesus dhaa, aku nèngu na, sèmi ne'e. lod'o ja'a dhae d'ai mèka. te ngaa ladhe miu neo lami, sad'i lake mere.

source_text: the world may not hate you, soothly it hateth me; for i bear witnessing thereof, that the works of it be evil.
target_text: dhèu ètu rai-haha ne tèka boe d'ara dènge miu. te ngaa rèngu tèka d'ara dènge ja'a, lula ja'a bhoke patalele aa'i tatao rèngu. te d'ara ra bhelu-katub'a.

source_text: go ye up to this feast day, but i shall not go up to this feast day, for my time is not yet fulfilled or full-filled.
target_text: lod'o kalela agama èdhi dètu le. de miu ka laa lami asa yerusalem. ja'a neo mèka laku, te dhae d'ai mèka lod'o.

source_text: when he had said these things, he dwelt in galilee.
target_text: na peka nare, hèia na pea ètu propensi galilea.

source_text: and after that his brethren were gone up, then he went up to the feast day, not openly, but as in private.
target_text: te ngaa ropa ari na si lasi madhutu kalela agama dhèu yahudi ètu yerusalem, yesus madhutu kahèi. te ngaa la'e pahuni-pahuni, sèna ka dhèu baku rèdhi ne.

source_text: therefore the jews sought him in the feast day, and said, where is he?
target_text: ètu yerusalem, lod'o kalela agama dhèu yahudi, ama-ama dhèu yahudi patangi-tenge yesus. ra pakarèi, aku rèngu na, dhèu èèna, ètu mia?

source_text: and much grutching was of him among the people. for some said, that he is good; and others said, nay, but he deceiveth the people;
target_text: dhèu ae dhu paka'uu lula-nèti nèngu. cahag'e peka na, nèngu ne, dhèu be'a. cahag'e hari peka na, aad'o! nèngu ne dhu kapod'e-kabèli dhèu ae-ae.

source_text: nevertheless no man spake openly of him, for dread of the jews.
target_text: te ngaa abhu boe dhu pacèu lii padhai lula-nèti yesus, te rèngu madha'u dènge ama-ama se.

source_text: but when the middle feast day came, jesus went up into the temple, and taught.
target_text: pas ètu talora kalela ne, yesus maso la'e asa èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. ka na aj'a dhèu ètu era èèna.

source_text: and the jews wondered, and said, how knoweth this man letters, since he hath not learned?
target_text: hèia ama-ama dhèu yahudi malaa, ka ra peka na, dhèu ne sakola nèdhi boe sèmi èdhi. te ngaa tasamia ka ne'a aa'i mèu j'ara se'e?

source_text: jesus answered to them, and said, my doctrine is not mine, but his that sent me.
target_text: ka yesus peka dènge ra, aku nèngu na, nanene. j'ara-j'ara dhu ja'a lole, kapua boe nèti ja'a mesa ku, te ngaa nèti nèngu dhu pua ja'a mai.

source_text: if any man will do his will, he shall know of the teaching, whether it be of god, or i speak of myself.
target_text: dhèu dhu tare'a-re'a neo madhutu dad'èi ama lamatua, nèngu èèna na ne'a mèu, a'aj'a ja'a ne, tare'a-re'a mai nèti ama lamatua, do nèti dhoka ja'a mesa ku.

source_text: he that speaketh of himself, seeketh his own glory; but he that seeketh the glory of him that sent him, is soothfast, and unrightwiseness is not in him.
target_text: te dhèu dhu padhai lii pake mamèu unu na, nèngu tenge dhoka kolongara di. te ngaa dhèu dhu neo ded'e kolongara nèti dhèu dhu pua-paleha na, tatu lii padhai lèke mola-mola. aa lii padhai nèngu koe-kapengo boe.

source_text: whether moses gave not to you a law, and none of you doeth or keep-eth the law? what seek ye to slay me?
target_text: musa pangèd'u le miu atora ama lamatua. te ngaa miu mo'o boe tao madhutu. de tasamia ka miu tenge j'ara ho neo pamadhe ja'a?

source_text: and the people answered, and said, thou hast a devil; who seeketh to slay thee?
target_text: hèia dhèu ae se karèi, peka na, èu peka ngaa, ne? ele boe nidhu tao èu, do? cee ka dhu tenge j'ara neo pamadhe èu?

source_text: jesus answered, and said to them, i have done one work, and all ye wonder.
target_text: ka yesus b'ala, peka na, sèmi ne'e ka. ja'a heka tao tadha malaa èci ètu lod'o manèngi-mangaj'i, te ngaa miu aa'i-aa'i mi kacèki le.

source_text: therefore moses gave to you circumcision; not for it is of moses, but of the fathers; and in the sabbath ye circumcise a man.
target_text: te ngaa ca tèka-tèka, miu sab'a kahèi ètu d'ara lod'o sabaj'a, nuka sèmi: musa hia le atora suna, dhu peka na, ladhe dhèu rara iisi ana mone ca dhèu, na, ètu d'ara lod'o ka aru, miu hud'i suna ku ana ne. masi ka lod'o ne, lèke dènge lod'o sabaj'a, miu hud'i suna ku nèngu. te ngaa madhutu mola-mola na, atora ne uru tèka nèti musa. te ama lamatua dhu hia uru le atora ne mi abraham.

source_text: if a man take circumcision in the sabbath, that the law of moses be not broken, have ye indignation, or wrath, to me, for i made all a man whole in the sabbath?
target_text: de ladhe suna ana iiki èci lèke dènge lod'o sabaj'a sisu boe atora musa, nga tao ka miu nasa dènge ja'a, lula ja'a puri-pa'èle dhèu karuku lèke dènge lod'o sabaj'a? maso boe d'ara ngangee, sina ma! ?

source_text: do not ye deem after the face, but deem ye a rightful doom.
target_text: baku pasale dhèu lula j'ara-j'ara dhu miu mèdhi dènge musi madha di. dadoo uuru ku dènge d'ara be'a, heka pama'ète dhu lèke.

source_text: therefore some of jerusalem said, whether this is not he, whom the jews seek to slay?
target_text: hèia pèri-pèri dhèu nèti kota yerusalem pakarèi, peka na, dhèu ne'e ne ka dhu ra patangi-tenge ho neo pamadhe ne, do?

source_text: and lo! he speaketh openly, and they say nothing to him. whether the princes know verily that this is christ?
target_text: ladhe ku laa! na padhai lii pahuni boe ètu madha dhèu ae-ae. te ngaa abhu boe dhu kai ne ho hutu hèb'a na. madhutu miu, tasamia? ele boe dhèu dhu rèd'u koasa sèra re'a le, peka na, dhèu ne'e ne, nuka kristus, dhu lamatua pajaji tèke ho neo pua mai èèna, si?

source_text: but we know this man, of whence he is; but when christ shall come, no man knoweth of whence he is.
target_text: te ngaa j'aj'i mi lii langu, sèmi ne'e: ladhe lamatua pua ka kristus mai, abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu re'a nèngu nèti mia. te ngaa èdhi te'a le dhèu ne nèti mia.

source_text: therefore jesus cried in the temple teaching, and said, ye know me, and ye know of whence i am; and i came not of myself, but he is true that sent me, whom ye know not.
target_text: lod'o èèna, yesus aj'a dhèu era ètu madha èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. ropa tadèngi dhèu se peka sèmi èèna, hèia na karèi si dènge lii mèdhu, aku nèngu na, miu pangee, na, miu se tadhe ja'a, aa me'a mèu ja'a mai nèti mia, do? ja'a ne, mai boe asa ne'e madhutu dad'èi ja'a mesa ku. te dhu pua ja'a èèna, abhu tare'a-re'a. aa miu tadhe boe nèngu.

source_text: i know him, and if i say that i know him not, i shall be like to you, a liar; but i know him, for of him i am, and he sent me.
target_text: te ngaa ja'a tadhe ne, lula ja'a mai nèti nèngu, aa nèngu ka dhu pua ja'a mai.

source_text: therefore they sought to take him, and no man set on him hands, for his hour came not yet.
target_text: ka dhèu se'e neo kèpe ne. te ngaa abhu boe dhu bisa kèpe ne, te d'ai mèka lod'o na.

source_text: and many of the people believed in him, and said, when christ shall come, whether he shall do more tokens than those that this doeth?
target_text: nèti dhèu ae-ae dhu ètu èèna, abhu ae kahèi dhu parcaya ne. dhèu se padhai lii, peka na, dhèu ne'e ne tao tadha malaa ae le. pe bèli-camèd'a, ladhe kristus mai, tatu boe na tao tadha malaa risi nèti dhèu ne'e, si?

source_text: the pharisees heard the people musing of him, these things; and the princes and the pharisees sent min-isters, to take him.
target_text: ètu talora aae dhèu ae se, abhu pèri-pèri dhèu nèti partei agama parisi kahèi. rèngu tadèngi dhèu ae se pakanucu j'ara-j'ara lula-nèti yesus. hèia, dhèu se, dènge kètu agama yahudi se pua pèri-pèri dhèu j'aga èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i sèna ka lasi kèpe yesus.

source_text: therefore jesus said to them, yet a little time i am with you, and i go to the father, that sent me.
target_text: ka yesus peka, na, lod'o ja'a pa'èci dènge miu di ciki oo'e ka, nare heka nèbhu. te nèbhu heka, ja'a laku hari asa nèngu dhu pua ja'a.

source_text: ye shall seek me, and ye shall not find me; and where i am, ye may not come.
target_text: pe èèna na, miu tenge ja'a, te ngaa mèdhi boe ja'a. te ja'a neo laku asa era èci dhu miu bisa boe madhutu.

source_text: therefore the jews said to them-selves, whither shall this go, for we shall not find him? whether he will go into the scattering of heathen men, and will teach the heathen?
target_text: ka ama-ama dhèu yahudi se pakarèi iisi-aanga ra, aku rèngu na, dhèu ne neo la'e mia? la'e asa era mia, dhu èdhi bisa boe paraga dènge ne? nèngu la'e lu'u asa dhèu yahudi dhu bali ètu rai kaj'èu, do? neo la'e aj'a-nori dhèu-dhèu dhu pake lii yunani ètu nèi, do? do, tasamia?

source_text: what is this word, which he said, ye shall seek me, and ye shall not find me; and where i am, ye may not come?
target_text: a'abhu na tasamia, ka na peka, na, ‘miu neo tenge ja'a, te ngaa paraga boe. ' aa, ‘ja'a laku asa era èci dhu miu bisa boe madhutu. '?

source_text: but in the last day of the great feast, jesus stood, and cried, and said, if any man thirsteth, come he to me, and drink.
target_text: d'ai lod'o oe èle kalela, dhu j'aj'i lod'o kapai risi èèna, hèia yesus kèd'i titu, ka na rodhe, peka na, nanene, ee! cee ka dhu koko-kamango, na, hud'i laa na mai asa ja'a ho ninu!

source_text: he that believeth in me, as the scripture saith, floods of quick water shall flow out of his womb.
target_text: cee dhu parcaya ja'a, na, mai sèna ka minu! te ètu d'ara sasuri ama lamatua, dhu suri tèke le, peka na, ‘èi dhu nèti mamuri, èèna na hae mai nèti d'ara dhèu-dhèu parcaya. ' ka rèngu abhu mamuri dhu lèke. dènge j'ara ne, rèngu bisa soru-bara dhèu leo, sèna ka ra abhu mamuri dhu lèke kahèi.

source_text: but he said this thing of the spirit or of the holy ghost, whom men that believed in him should take; for the spirit was not yet given, for jesus was not yet glorified.
target_text: yesus padhai lii lula-nèti roh ama lamatua, lula dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu parcaya yesus abhu roh èèna. te ngaa lod'o yesus padhai lii sèmi èèna, rèngu dhae sèmi rare mèka roh èèna, lula ama lamatua dhae hia mèka. ama lamatua mema hia mèka, lula na ded'e mèka padedha-dedha yesus.

source_text: therefore of that company, when they had heard these words of him, they said, this is verily a prophet.
target_text: dhèu ae-ae ètu sèra nanene lii padhai yesus ne. hèia abhu dhu peka, na, tatu dhèu ne, dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua, dhu na padhadha mema karèi nèti uru ka!

source_text: others said, this is christ. but some said, whether christ cometh from galilee?
target_text: abhu cahag'e dhu peka na, aad'o! nèngu ne, nuka kristus dhu ama lamatua paj'uj'u karèi nèti uru ka mai! te ngaa cahag'e hari pab'ala, peka na, bisa boe! te kristus èèna, dhèu galilea boe. tare'a, si?

source_text: whether the scripture saith not, that of the seed of david, and of the castle of bethlehem, where david was, christ cometh?
target_text: te sasuri ama lamatua suri, na, kristus èèna, ana-èpu nèti dhèu aae daud. ètu d'ara sasuri leo kahèi dhu suri, peka na, nèngu ne, dhèu betlehem, rae dhèu aae daud. sèmi èèna ka, si?

source_text: therefore dissension was made among the people for him.
target_text: ka dhèu se mulai pahag'a lula yesus.

source_text: and some of them would have taken him, but no man set hands on him.
target_text: abhu pèri-pèri dhèu dhu neo kèpe ne, te ngaa ca dhèu sa goi boe ne.

source_text: therefore the ministers came to the bishops, and pharisees, and they said to them, why brought ye not him?
target_text: èle ka, dhèu-dhèu madhenga èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i dhu mai neo kèpe yesus, lèpa asa kètu agama yahudi dènge dhèu parisi sèra. hèia dhèu kapai se karèi, aku rèngu na, nga tao ka miu mèti boe ne mai?

source_text: the ministers answered, never man spake so, as this man speaketh.
target_text: hèia dhèu se dhaa, na, ira ii! ji'i dhae paraga ngèdhi mèka dènge dhèu èci sa dhu padhai lii sama sèmi dhèu nèi!

source_text: therefore the pharisees answered to them, whether ye be deceived also?
target_text: ka dhèu parisi se karèi, aku rèngu na, heh! miu se lèke le tipu, si?

source_text: whether any of the princes, or of the pharisees believed in him?
target_text: sanèd'e! te nèti ji'i dhèu-dhèu parisi, do, ama-ama abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu lèka ne. tare'a, si? ladhe dhèu kapai parcaya boe, na, tasamia ka miu se lèka nèngu?

source_text: but this people, that knoweth not the law, be cursed.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu ae dhu neo parcaya ne, re'a boe atora ama lamatua. bèli-camèd'a rèngu dui rare huku dhu bia nèti ama lamatua!

source_text: nicodemus saith to them, he that came to him by night, that was one of them,
target_text: te ngaa ètu era ne'e, abhu kahèi dhèu parisi ca dhèu, ngara na nikodemus. nèngu ne'e ka dhu la'e asa yesus re mèda, ho padhai lii dènge ne. ka na karèi dhèu se'e, peka na,

source_text: whether our law deemeth a man, but it have first heard of him or no but first it have heard of him, and know what he doeth?
target_text: tasamia? madhutu atora agama, èdhi pama'ète uru ku lii langu dhèu, do? do, èdhi hud'i nanene uuru ku lii lolo na, sèna ka te'a mèu dhèu ne tao ngaa, heka pama'ète lii langu na kèna?

source_text: they answered, and said to him, whether thou art a man of galilee also? seek thou scriptures, and see thou, that a prophet riseth not of galilee.
target_text: hèia ra jèke ne, aku rèngu na, èu ne, dhèu galilea èci èèna ka dènge nèngu, do? parisa paie-iie uuru ku sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua! baca paie-iie sèna ka me'a mèu, na, abhu boe dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua dhu mai nèti galilea!

source_text: and they turned again, each into his house.
target_text: ka ra pacèri, èci-èci lèpa asa èmu ra.

source_text: but jesus went into the mount of olivet.
target_text: te ngaa yesus la'e asa ledhe saitun.

source_text: and early again he came into the temple; and all the people came to him; and he sat, and taught them.
target_text: asa bèli mad'ae aae èèna, nèngu la'e asa madha èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. dhèu ae mai pakaboko ètu madha nèngu. ka na madhèdi aj'a-nori si.

source_text: and scribes and pharisees brought a woman taken in adultery, and they setted her in the middle,
target_text: lod'o èèna, kèpe rare bhèni ca dhèu dhu talora na ad'u-ue j'ara makae. ka pèri-pèri mese agama dènge dhèu parisi ère rèti bhèni ne asa yesus. hèia ra laka-seti bhèni ne titu ètu madha rèngu aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: and said to him, master, this woman is now taken in adultery.
target_text: ka ra peka dènge yesus, aku rèngu na, ama mese. kèpe ngare bhèni ne dhu talora nèngu dhu ad'u-ue j'ara makae.

source_text: and in the law moses commanded us to stone such; therefore what sayest thou?
