target_text: ètu d'ara atora musa, abhu paredha èci dhu peka na, ‘dhèu dhu ad'u-ue j'ara makae dènge dhèu èmu na boe, hud'i abhu hahuku pèci toke madhe. ' de madhutu ama mese, na, tasamia?

source_text: and they said this thing tempting him, that they might accuse him. and jesus bowed himself down, and wrote with his finger in the earth.
target_text: dhèu se sèku ne, sèna ka abhu j'ara ho pèci sasala asa yesus ho pamanahu ne. yesus lii boe, te ngaa madhèdi pasaboti suri rai, pake suu kolo ai na.

source_text: and when they abided or con-tinued asking him, he raised himself, and said to them, he of you that is without sin, first cast a stone into her.
target_text: dhèu se loe boe karèi nèngu. hèia na titu, ka padhai lii, aku nèngu na, sèmi ne'e. ladhe nèti miu abhu dhu tao mèdhi mèka sasala, na, nèngu ka dhu bisa pèci uuru ku, sèna ka huku bhèni ne'e.

source_text: and again he bowed down himself, and wrote in the earth.
target_text: ka na madhèdi pasaboti hari, hèia suri hari rai.

source_text: and they hearing these things, went away one after another, and they began from the elder men; and jesus dwelt alone, and the woman standing in the middle.
target_text: ropa dhèu se tadèngi lii padhai na, rèngu j'aj'i makae. lula rèngu re'a ètu d'ara ra, rèngu ad'u-ue sasala kahèi. ka lasi ka èci-èci, mulai nèti dhèu heka toke d'ai ana ngèru, tèke eele dhodhoka yesus dènge bhèni ne ètu era èèna.

source_text: and jesus raised himself, and said to her, woman, where be they that accused thee? no man hath con-demned thee.
target_text: hèia yesus titu hari, ka na karèi, eea! mia lasi? abhu heka ca dhèu sa ètu ne'e ho pèci sasala mi èu, do?

source_text: she said, no man, lord. jesus said to her, neither i shall condemn thee; go thou, and now afterward do not thou sin more or do not thou do sin.
target_text: hèia bhèni ne dhaa, aku nèngu na, aad'o, ama. ka yesus lii dènge dhèu ne, peka na, ja'a neo boe huku èu kahèi. lèpa ka, te ngaa sanèd'e. tao ia ka sasala!

source_text: therefore again jesus spake to them, and said, i am the light of the world; he that pursueth me, walketh not in darknesses, but shall have the light of life.
target_text: ka yesus tuhu hari lii padhai dènge dhèu ae se, peka na, ja'a ne, nuka sèmi saraa hia dhèu ètu rai-haha ne. dhèu dhu madhutu ja'a mamuri boe ètu d'ara maroga, te ngaa na pea ètu d'ara saraa dhu nèti mamuri dhu lèke.

source_text: therefore the pharisees said, thou bearest witnessing of thyself; thy witnessing is not true.
target_text: abhu pèri-pèri dhèu parisi dhu pab'ala, peka na, weh! èu mesa mu neo j'aj'i sakasii nèti ngi'u èu unu mu, do? bisa boe sèmi èèna! te madhutu atora èdhi, hud'i dhèu leo ku dhu j'aj'i sakasii hia dhèu èci, bisa boe nèngu unu na. de ji'i ngo'o boe sèmi, aa ngo'o boe parcaya.

source_text: jesus answered, and said to them, and if i bear witnessing of myself, my witnessing is true; for i know from whence i came, and whither i go. but ye know not from whence i came, nor whither i go.
target_text: ka yesus dhaa, peka na, sèmi ne'e. hud'i laa ja'a j'aj'i sakasii mi ngi'u ja'a mesa ku, te lii padhai ja'a ne, lèke. lula ja'a mesa ku ke'a mola-mola ja'a ne mai nèti mia, aa neo laku asa mia. miu me'a boe ja'a mai nèti mia, aa me'a boe neo laku asa mia kahèi.

source_text: for ye deem after the flesh, but i deem no man;
target_text: miu nile dhèu madhutu a'abhu dhèu rai-haha. te ngaa ja'a madhutu boe a'abhu dhèu rai-haha ho nile dhèu èci sa.

source_text: and if i deem, my doom is true, for i am not alone, but i and the father that sent me.
target_text: ladhe ja'a nile dhèu, a'uku dhu ja'a pake, lèke mola-mola. te ja'a mesa ku boe dhu nile dhèu, te ngaa ja'a tao aa'i-aa'i sama-sama dènge ama ku dhu pua ja'a mai.

source_text: and in your law it is written, that the witnessing of two men is true.
target_text: baku bhèlu. te dhu suri tèke ètu atora agama miu, peka na, ‘ladhe abhu dhèu dua j'aj'i sakasii dhu padhue j'ara dhu sama, èèna lèke tare'a. '

source_text: i am, that bear witnessing of myself, and the father that sent me, beareth witnessing of me.
target_text: de ja'a mesa ku boe dhu j'aj'i sakasii mi ngi'u ja'a unu ku. te ama ku dhu pua ja'a, j'aj'i sakasii kahèi dhu padhai lii lula-nèti ja'a.

source_text: therefore they said to him, where is thy father? jesus answered, neither ye know me, nor ye know my father; if ye knew me, peradventure ye should know also my father.
target_text: hèia dhèu se karèi, aku rèngu na, te ama èu èèna, ètu mia? ka yesus b'ala, peka na, miu se tadhe iie boe ja'a. miu tadhe boe kahèi ama ku. te ladhe miu tadhe iie ja'a, tatu miu tadhe ne kahèi.

source_text: jesus spake these words in the treasury, teaching in the temple; and no man took him, for his hour came not yet.
target_text: aa'i-aa'i se, yesus peka-padhai lod'o nèngu aj'a-nori dhèu ètu èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i, padètu dènge era rèngu kaboko doi kolete. abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu kèpe ne, lula d'ai mèka lod'o na.

source_text: therefore again jesus said to them, lo! i go, and ye shall seek me, and ye shall die in your sin; whither i go, ye may not come.
target_text: yesus padhai lii tabha hari, peka na, bèli-camèd'a ja'a tèke eele miu, ho laku asa era leo. miu èèna na patangi-tenge ja'a, te ngaa mèdhi boe, te miu dhu dènge boe hak sèna ka lami asa era èèna. aa ladhe miu madhe, miu pasae sasala miu era.

source_text: therefore the jews said, whether he shall slay himself, for he saith, whither i go, ye may not come?
target_text: hèia ama dhèu yahudi sèra pakarèi iisi-aanga ra, peka na, na padhai lii ngaa, nèi? neo pamadhe iisi na, do? te na peka, na, ‘miu bisa boe lami asa era èèna. '

source_text: and he said to them, ye be of beneath, i am of above; ye be of this world, i am not of this world.
target_text: ka yesus peka dènge dhèu se'e, aku nèngu na, miu nèti rai-haha. te ngaa ja'a mai nèti dedha-liru. miu dhèu nèti rai-haha ne, te ngaa ja'a nèti boe rai-haha ne.

source_text: therefore i said to you, that ye shall die in your sins; for if ye believe not that i am, ye shall die in your sins.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, deo na ja'a peka dènge miu, na, bèli-camèd'a ladhe miu madhe, miu pasae sasala-sasigo miu era. de ladhe miu parcaya boe, na, ja'a ne, kristus, dhu ama lamatua pua mai, ladhe miu madhe, tatu miu pasae sasala miu era.

source_text: therefore they said to him, who art thou? jesus said to them, the beginning, or the first of all thing, which and i also speak to you.
target_text: ka ra karèi, peka na, weeh! te èu ne, cee? yesus dhaa, aku nèngu na, ja'a dhu peka mema karèi nèti uru ka.

source_text: i have many things to speak, and to deem of you, but he that sent me is soothfast; and i speak in the world these things, that i heard of him.
target_text: abhu j'ara ae dhu ja'a bisa peka lula-nèti miu. sasala miu ae kahèi. te ngaa ja'a pad'elo boe j'ara sèra. te dhu pua ja'a mai asa rai-haha ne, ladhe na padhai lii, ne'a dhoka peka dhu mola di. aa ja'a peka dènge dhèu ètu rai-haha ne, dhoka j'ara-j'ara dhu ja'a tadèngi nèti nèngu di.

source_text: and they knew not, that he called his father god.
target_text: dhu nèngu padhue-padhai, nuka ama na ètu sorga. te ngaa dhèu se re'a rare boe sasoa lii padhai na.

source_text: therefore jesus said to them, when ye have araised man's son, then ye shall know, that i am, and of myself i do nothing; but as my father taught me, i speak these things.
target_text: ka yesus padhai lii tabha hari, peka na, pe ladhe miu ded'e ka ja'a, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne, ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha, heka miu me'a kèna, na, ja'a ne, kristus. aa ja'a bisa boe tao ngaa-ngaa madhutu dad'èi ja'a mesa ku, te ngaa ja'a aj'a-nori dhoka j'ara-j'ara dhu ama ètu sorga aj'a-nori le ja'a.

source_text: and he that sent me is with me, and left me not alone; for i do ever-more those things, that be pleasing to him.
target_text: dhu pua-paleha ja'a bera-bera dènge ja'a taruu. nèngu tèke eele nèdhi boe ja'a mesa-mesa ku, lula ja'a loe boe sab'a madhutu dad'èi na.

source_text: when he spake these things, many believed in him.
target_text: ropa yesus peka j'ara se'e, dhèu ae parcaya nèngu.

source_text: therefore jesus said to the jews, that believed in him, if ye dwell in my word, verily, ye shall be my disciples;
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus peka dènge dhèu-dhèu yahudi dhu parcaya nèngu, na, ladhe miu mamuri pa'èki taruu dènge lii holo-nori ja'a, aa aj'a taruu nèti ja'a, na, miu bisa j'aj'i ana madhutu ja'a dhu lèke.

source_text: and ye shall know the truth, and the truth shall make you free.
target_text: miu bisa me'a mèu j'ara-j'ara dhu lèke. dènge j'ara-j'ara dhu lèke sèra ka dhu patabuli miu, sèna ka miu j'aj'i ia ka ènu.

source_text: therefore the jews answered to him, we be the seed of abraham, and we served never to man or and to no man we served ever; how sayest thou, that ye shall be free?
target_text: ka dhèu se pab'ala, aku rèngu na, hee! ji'i se, j'aj'i boe ènu dhèu! te ji'i se, ana-èpu abraham! de, nga tao ka èu peka, na, èèna na ji'i bebas?

source_text: jesus answered to them, truly, truly, i say to you, each man that doeth sin, is the servant of sin.
target_text: hèia yesus dhaa, peka na, dhu ja'a peka ne, lèke. te dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu mamuri ètu d'ara sasala, j'aj'i sama sèmi ènu dhu dhoka madhutu dad'èi sasala di.

source_text: and the servant dwelleth not in the house without end, but the son dwelleth without end.
target_text: te ngaa dhu tema, sèmi ne'e: ènu se abhu boe pala nèti lamatua èmu na. te dhoka ana lamatua èmu di dhu abhu pala taruu ètu èèna.

source_text: therefore if the son make you free, verily, ye shall be free.
target_text: de ja'a, nuka ana ama lamatua ne, ladhe saku eele sasala-sasigo miu, na, miu bebas, aa j'aj'i heka ènu nèti koasa sasala-sasigo. dènge j'ara ne, miu madhutu heka dad'èi sasala, aa tare'a-re'a bebas!

source_text: i know that ye be abraham's sons, but ye seek to slay me, for my word taketh not in you.
target_text: ja'a ke'a le miu se, ana-èpu abraham. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa miu loe boe patangi-tenge j'ara ho pamadhe ja'a, lula mo'o boe sèmi mere a'aj'a ja'a. te ètu d'ara miu, abhu heka era tatèka lii holo-nori ja'a.

source_text: i speak those things, that i saw at my father; and ye do those things, that ye saw at your father.
target_text: ja'a peka-padhai j'ara-j'ara dhu ja'a kèdhi le, dhu ama ku paj'uj'u le dènge ja'a. aa miu tao madhutu j'ara-j'ara dhu miu tadèngi le nèti ama-ama miu.

source_text: they answered, and said to him, abraham is our father. jesus saith to them, if ye be the sons of abraham, do ye the works of abraham.
target_text: dhèu se dhaa, peka na, ji'i se, ana-èpu abraham! ka yesus peka dènge ra, aku nèngu na, ladhe miu j'aj'i tare'a-re'a ana-èpu abraham, miu hud'i madhutu j'ara mamuri nèngu.

source_text: but now ye seek to slay me, a man that have spoken to you the truth, that i heard of god; abraham did not this thing.
target_text: te ngaa abraham tao boe bhabhelu sama sèmi dhu miu tao! te miu loe boe tenge j'ara ho neo pamadhe ja'a. aa te ngaa ja'a ne, dhu peka dènge miu j'ara-j'ara dhu lèke, dhu ja'a tadèngi nèti ama lamatua.

source_text: ye do the works of your father. therefore they said to him, we be not born of fornication; we have one father, god.
target_text: tatao miu se mema beda boe nèti tatao ama miu. te ngaa rèngu pab'ala, aku rèngu na, heh! ji'i se, ana d'èlu! baku peka na ji'i se, ana ama aad'o! te ama ji'i, èci di, nuka ama lamatua!

source_text: but jesus saith to them, if god were your father, soothly ye should love me; for i passed forth of god, or i proceeded, or came forth, of god, and came; for neither i came of myself, but he sent me.
target_text: hèia, aku yesus na, ladhe ama lamatua tare'a-re'a j'aj'i ama miu, tatu miu sue ja'a. te ja'a mai nèti nèngu, nèti èèna ka ja'a ka ne'e ne. ja'a mai ne madhutu boe dad'èi ja'a mesa ku. te ngaa ja'a mai, lula nèngu ka dhu pua ja'a.

source_text: why know ye not my speech? for ye may not hear my word.
target_text: nga tao ka miu dhane mere boe lii padhai ja'a? ele boe, lula miu mema mo'o boe nanene!

source_text: ye be of the father, the devil, and ye will do the desires of your father. he was a manslayer from the begin-ning, and he stood not in truth; for truth is not in him. when he speaketh leasing, he speaketh of his own; for he is a liar, and father of it.
target_text: miu se, ca ropa dènge dhèu aae nidhu. te miu d'èi madhutu dad'èi na! karèi nèti uru j'ara ka, nèngu d'èi dhoka pamadhe dhèu. nèngu lab'a j'ara dhu lèke, lula na tule eele j'ara aa'i-aa'i dhu lèke! ladhe na kapod'e-kabèli, mema sasab'a na kèna. te nèngu ne, tuka kapod'e-kabèli, aa baki nèti leko-monya!

source_text: but for i say truth, ye believe not to me.
target_text: ja'a ne'e ka dhu lole j'ara dhu lèke. te ngaa miu parcaya boe ja'a.

source_text: who of you shall reprove me of sin? if i say truth, why believe ye not to me?
target_text: pangee sèku! nèti miu se, cee ka dhu bisa pad'elo bukti, peka na, ja'a ne ad'u-ue sasala? malaa, nga! ladhe ja'a peka lèke, nga tao ka miu mo'o boe lèka ja'a?

source_text: he that is of god, heareth the words of god; therefore ye hear not, for ye be not of god.
target_text: dhèu dhu j'aj'i nèti ama lamatua nanene lii holo-nori na. te ngaa miu se j'aj'i boe nèti ama lamatua, nèti èèna ka miu mo'o boe nanene ja'a.

source_text: therefore the jews answered, and said to him, whether we say not well, that thou art a samaritan, and hast a devil?
target_text: ama-ama dhèu yahudi b'ala, peka na, lii padhai ji'i lèke tare'a-re'a. te ji'i dhu peka le, na, èu ne, dhèu yahudi boe, te ngaa dhèu samaria. èu ne nidhu tao!

source_text: jesus answered, and said, i have not a devil, but i honour my father, and ye have unhonoured me.
target_text: hèia yesus dhaa, aku nèngu na, ja'a nidhu tao boe. ja'a pakab'ua ama ku ètu sorga, te ngaa miu mo'o boe pakab'ua ja'a.

source_text: for i seek not my glory; there is he, that seeketh, and deemeth.
target_text: ja'a padedha boe iisi ho pad'elo kolo-karisi ja'a. te ngaa abhu èci dhu neo pad'elo dadedha ja'a. hud'i laa nèngu ka dhu pama'ète, na, lii padhai ja'a ne lèke, do aad'o.

source_text: truly, truly, i say to you, if any man keep my word, he shall not taste death without end.
target_text: lii holo-nori ja'a, lèke tare'a. de dhèu dhu nanene aa tao madhutu lii holo-nori ja'a, madhe boe.

source_text: therefore the jews said, now we have known, that thou hast a devil. abraham is dead, and the prophets, and thou sayest, if any man keep my word, he shall not taste death without end.
target_text: ropa tadèngi rare lii ne, hèia ama-ama dhèu yahudi se peka dènge ne, aku rèngu na, limuri ne ji'i nge'a le èu dhèu huj'u, lula nidhu tao le èu. te abraham, madhe. dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua uru-uru sèra, madhe le kahèi. te ngaa aku èu, na, ‘dhèu dhu nanene dènge madhutu lii holo-nori ja'a, madhe boe. ' mema èu ne tare'a-re'a huj'u le!

source_text: whether thou art greater than our father abraham, that is dead, and the prophets be dead; whom makest thou thyself?
target_text: do, èu ne pangee, na, èu ne kapai risi nèti abraham dhu madhe le? do, èu kapai risi nèti dhèu-dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua dhu madhe sèra? èu ngee, na, èu ne, cee?

source_text: jesus answered, if i glorify myself, my glory is nought; my father is, that glorifieth me, whom ye say, that he is your god.
target_text: hèia yesus dhaa, peka na, ladhe ja'a ka dhu padedha iisi, dhèu ro'o boe sèmi rare. madhutu iia-iia, na, ja'a boe ka dhu ded'e padedha-dedha iisi, te ngaa dhu ded'e ja'a padedha-dedha nuka ama ku. nèngu ne'e ka dhu miu mangaku, na, nèngu j'aj'i ama lamatua miu.

source_text: and ye have not known him, but i have known him; and if i say that i know him not, i shall be a liar like to you; but i know him, and i keep his word.
target_text: te ngaa miu tadhe boe ne. dhu tadhe mèu ka ja'a ne. ladhe ja'a peka na ja'a tadhe boe ne, ja'a leko-monya, sama sèmi miu. te ngaa ja'a tadhe mèu ne, aa ja'a tao madhutu lii holo-nori na kahèi.

source_text: abraham, your father, gladded or full out joyed to see my day; and he saw, and joyed.
target_text: d'ara baki miu abraham karej'e titu kèna, lod'o na tatae neo nèdhi mamai ja'a. nèngu mema nèdhi le, ka na karej'e-karae.

source_text: then the jews said to him, thou hast not yet fifty years, and hast thou seen abraham?
target_text: ama-ama dhèu yahudi se b'ala ne, aku rèngu na, umur èu dhae d'ai mèka lèmi nguru tèu sa hèi! te ngaa èu peka na, mèdhi le abraham. tare'a, do?

source_text: therefore jesus said to them, truly, truly i say to you, before that abraham should be or was made, i am.
target_text: hèia yesus dhaa, peka na, tare'a! te dhae rara iisi mèka abraham, ja'a dhu mema-mema le.

source_text: therefore they took stones, to cast to him; but jesus hid him, and went out of the temple.
target_text: ka dhèu se rare hadhu ho neo pèci ne, lula na tao iisi sama sèmi ama lamatua. te ngaa yesus kako mau-mau kalua nèti madha èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i.

source_text: and jesus passing, saw a man blind from the birth.
target_text: hèia yesus si kako taruu. ka na ladhe nèdhi dhèu bèdhu ca dhèu, dhu bèdhu karèi nèti ina na nara iisi nèngu.

source_text: and his disciples asked him, master, who sinned, this man, or his elders, or rabbi, who sinned, this man, or his father and mother, that he should be born blind?
target_text: hèia ana-ana madhutu na karèi, aku rèngu na, ama mese! cee ka tao sasala, ka dhèu ne bèdhu? nèti nèngu mesa na, do, nèti ina-ama na?

source_text: jesus answered, neither this man sinned, neither his elders or neither his father and mother; but that the works of god be showed in him.
target_text: ka yesus dhaa, peka na, dhèu bèdhu ne tao boe sala. aa ina-ama na aad'o kahèi. rara iisi na sèmi ne'e, ho hud'i laa dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra ladhe rèdhi tatao ama lamatua dhu be'a mi dedha nèngu.

source_text: it behooveth me to work the works of him that sent me, as long as the day is or the while the day is; the night shall come, when no man may work.
target_text: ama lamatua ka dhu pua ja'a. de èdhi hud'i tenge j'ara, sèna ka pakako sasab'a na, lod'o saraa era. te ladhe maroga mai, dhèu bisa heka sab'a.

source_text: as long as i am in the world, i am the light of the world.
target_text: ropa ja'a ètu rai-haha ne era, ja'a nuka sèmi saraa dhu d'elo hia mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: when he had said these things, he spat into the earth, and made clay of the spittle, and anointed the clay on his eyes,
target_text: ropa yesus padhai lii nare, ka na paru'e ilu mi rai. hèia na madhèdi pasaboti, ho pakihu rai ne j'aj'i kabheca. ka na lame musi madha dhèu ne dènge kabheca deo na.

source_text: and said to him, go, and be thou washed in the water, or cistern, of siloam, that is to say, sent. then he went, and washed, and came seeing.
target_text: hèia na peka, na, lamu asa kolam siloam, sèna ka riu rèhu èu. ètu d'ara lii ibrani, siloam, sasoa na, ‘nèti mai'. ka dhèu bèdhu ne la'e, ka riu rèhu na. ropa na lèpa hari mai, nèngu bisa nèdhi le!

source_text: and so neighbours, and they that had seen him before, for he was a beggar, said, whether this is not he, that sat, and begged?
target_text: hèia rae lesa dènge dhèu dhu rèdhi ne, dhu tema manèngi ngaa-ngaa nèti dhèu, ra pakarèi èci dènge èci, peka na, dhèu ne'e ne, dhèu bèdhu dhu tema madhèdi ho kanata ai manèngi ngaa-ngaa nèti dhèu, sina ma?

source_text: other men said, that this it is; and other men said, nay, but he is like him. but he said, that i am he.
target_text: dhèu cahag'e dhaa, peka na, oo! nèngu ka! dhèu cahag'e hari, peka na, aad'o! nèngu ne, rèhu na oe sèmi dhèu èèna! te ngaa dhèu ne dhaa, aku nèngu na, aad'o! ja'a èèna ka, ne'e ne! dhu uru èèna bèdhu!

source_text: therefore they said to him, how be thine eyes opened?
target_text: ka dhèu se karèi ne, peka na, tasamia ka èu bisa ladhe mèdhi?

source_text: he answered, that man, that is said jesus, made clay, and anointed mine eyes, and said to me, go thou to the water, or cistern, of siloam, and wash; and i went, and washed, and saw.
target_text: hèia na peka, aku nèngu na, sèmi ne'e! dhèu dhu ngara yesus èèna, pakihu kabheca ka lame mi musi madha ja'a. ka na pua ja'a, aku nèngu na, ‘lamu asa kolam siloam, ho riu rèhu èu ètu nèi. ' hèia ja'a tao madhutu sèmi èèna. nèti èèna ka, ja'a bisa ladhe kèdhi le!

source_text: and they said to him, where is he? he said, i know not.
target_text: èle ka dhèu se karèi ne, peka na, dhèu èèna, ètu mia? ka na dhaa, ke'a boe, mia la'e!

source_text: they led him that was blind to the pharisees. and it was sabbath, when jesus made clay, and opened his eyes.
target_text: lod'o èèna, ropa yesus pakihu rai j'aj'i kabheca, ka puri-pa'èle dhèu bèdhu ho bisa ladhe nèdhi èèna, lèke dènge lod'o a'ae sasab'a dhèu yahudi. ka lere rèti dhèu dhu uru èèna bèdhu, asa madha dhèu-dhèu partei agama parisi.

source_text: again the pharisees asked him, how he had seen. and he said to them, he laid or put to me clay on the eyes; and i washed, and i see.
target_text: ka dhèu parisi se karèi ne, èu lolo ku laa! tasamia ka èu bisa ladhe mèdhi? dhèu ne dhaa, peka na, sèmi ne'e. dhèu èèna tao kabheca mi musi madha ja'a. ka laku riu rèhu. hèia limuri ne, ja'a bisa kèdhi le.

source_text: therefore some of the pharisees said, this man is not of god, that keepeth not the sabbath. other men said, how may a sinful man do these signs, or miracles. and strife or division was among them.
target_text: ka abhu dhèu parisi cahag'e, peka na, dhèu dhu puri-pa'èle èu èèna, mai boe nèti ama lamatua. ji'i nge'a, lula nèngu sisu atora nèti lod'o a'ae sasab'a. aa abhu cahag'e hari, peka na, tasamia ka dhèu dhu ad'u-ue sasala bisa tao tadha-tadha malaa sèmi sèra? ka rèngu patao-palaha èci dènge èci toke ra pahag'a.

source_text: therefore they said again to the blind man, what sayest thou of him, that opened thine eyes? and he said, that he is a prophet.
target_text: hèia ra karèi hari dhèu dhu uru èèna bèdhu, aku rèngu na, madhutu a'abhu èu, dhèu dhu puri-pabe'a musi madha èu ne, dhèu sèmi ngaa sa? dhèu ne b'ala, peka na, madhutu a'abhu ja'a, dhèu èèna ca dhèu nèti dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua.

source_text: therefore the jews believed not of him, that he was blind, and had seen, till they called his father and mother, that had seen.
target_text: te ngaa ama-ama dhèu yahudi se ro'o boe lèka, na, dhèu ne uru èèna bèdhu, ka limuri ne bisa nèdhi le. hèia ra pua dhèu lasi paroa ina-ama na mai.

source_text: and they asked them, and said, is this your son, which ye say was born blind? how then seeth he now?
target_text: ropa ina-ama na mai d'ai madha si, hèia ama-ama se karèi, aku rèngu na, dhèu ne, ana miu, do? tare'a, do aad'o, nèngu ne dhu bèdhu mema karèi nèti mera iisi ne? tasamia ka limuri ne nèngu bisa ladhe nèdhi?

source_text: his father and mother answered to them, and said, we know, that this is our son, and that he was born blind;
target_text: ka ina-ama dhèu ne dhaa, peka na, nèngu ne, mema ana ji'i. aa na bèdhu karèi nèti ngara iisi ne.

source_text: but how he seeth now, we know not, or who opened his eyes, we know not; ask ye him, he hath age, speak he of himself.
target_text: te ngaa ji'i nge'a boe, na pake ngaa ka musi madha na bisa nèdhi sèmi ne'e. cee ka dhu puri-pa'èle musi madha na, ji'i nge'a boe kahèi. nèngu kapai le, de karèi ne, te nèngu bisa lolo unu na!

source_text: his father and mother said these things, for they dreaded the jews; for then the jews had conspired, that if any man acknowledged him christ, he should be done out of the synagogue.
target_text: dua ra padhai lii sèmi èèna, lula rèngu madha'u dènge ama-ama dhèu yahudi. lula re'a, na, ama-ama dhèu yahudi se dhu rare le lii èci, peka na, ladhe abhu dhèu mangaku, na, yesus ne, nuka kristus, na, babège eele dhèu sèra nèti d'ara èmu sabaj'a èdhi dhèu yahudi.

source_text: therefore his father and mother said, that he hath age, ask ye him.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ina-ama dhèu ne dhaa, peka na, nèngu kapai le. de karèi ne.

source_text: therefore again they called the man, that was blind, and said to him, give thou glory to god; we know, that this man is a sinner.
target_text: hèia ra paroa hari dhèu dhu uru èèna bèdhu. ka ra karèi ne, sèmi ne'e! èu hud'i peka ku mola-mola ètu madha ama lamatua, sèna ka j'aga paie kolongara na. te ji'i nge'a, na, yesus ne, dhèu bhelu-katub'a.

source_text: then he said, if he is a sinner, i know not; one thing i know, that when i was blind, now i see.
target_text: ka dhèu ne dhaa, peka na, ama si baku nasa! te ja'a ke'a boe, na, nèngu èèna, dhèu bhelu, do aad'o. dhu ja'a ke'a mola-mola, nuka, uru èèna ja'a bèdhu, te ngaa limuri ne ja'a bisa kèdhi.

source_text: therefore they said to him, what did he to thee? how opened he thine eyes?
target_text: hèia ra karèi ne, aku rèngu na, te na tao èu tasamia? tasamia na bhoke musi madha èu?

source_text: he answered to them, i said to you now, and ye heard; what will ye again hear? whether ye will be made his disciples?
target_text: dhèu ne dhaa, na, eee! te deo na ja'a lole le, te ngaa miu mo'o boe nanene. tasamia ka miu neo ja'a lolo hari? ele boe ama si neo j'aj'i ana madhutu na, do?

source_text: therefore they cursed him, and said, be thou his disciple; we be the disciples of moses.
target_text: ka ra padhai pa-aape ne, hèia ra peka, hud'i laa èu ka j'aj'i ana madhutu na! te ji'i se, ana madhutu musa.

source_text: we know, that god spake to moses; but we know not this, of whence he is.
target_text: ji'i nge'a ama lamatua ka dhu padhai lii dènge musa. te ngaa nge'a boe dhèu èèna bhodho nèti ro'a mia.

source_text: that man answered, and said to them, for in this is a wonderful thing, that ye know not, of whence he is, and he hath opened mine eyes.
target_text: ka dhèu dhu uru èèna bèdhu na, dhaa, ja'a malaa, nga! miu me'a boe nèngu mai nèti mia. aa te ngaa nèngu ka dhu bhoke pamèu musi madha ja'a, ka ja'a bisa kèdhi.

source_text: and we know, that god heareth not sinful men, but if any man be a worshipper of god, and doeth his will, he heareth him.
target_text: èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti te'a, na, ama lamatua parluu boe nanene lii dhèu bhelu, si? te ngaa ama lamatua nanene dhèu d'ara mola, dhu mamuri madhutu dad'èi na.

source_text: from the world it is not heard, that any man opened the eyes of a blind-born man;
target_text: karèi nèti ama lamatua paj'aj'i liru dènge rai-haha toke d'ai sange ne'e, abhu mèka lii lolo èci sa hèi, lula-nèti dhèu dhu puri-pabe'a dhèu bèdhu karèi rara iisi ne, ho nèngu bisa nèdhi.

source_text: but this man were of god, he might not do anything.
target_text: de ladhe yesus mai boe nèti ama lamatua, tatu nèngu bisa boe tao ngaa-ngaa, sina ma?

source_text: they answered, and said to him, thou art all born in sins, and teachest thou us? or thou teachest us? and they put him out.
target_text: hèia ra b'ala, aku rèngu na, wee! èu ne, dhèu bhelu karèi ina mu nara iisi èu! èu ngee, na, èu bisa aj'a hari ji'i, do? ka ra babège eele dhèu ne nèti èmu sabaj'a rèngu.

source_text: jesus heard, that they had put him out; and when he had found him, he said to him, believest thou in the son of god?
target_text: ropa yesus tadèngi rèngu babège eele dhèu dhu uru èèna bèdhu nèti èmu sabaj'a ra, hèia na la'e tenge dhèu ne, toke abhu. ka na peka, tasamia! èu parcaya dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne, do?

source_text: he answered, and said, lord, who is he, that i believe in him?
target_text: ka dhèu ne karèi hari ne, aku nèngu na, ama, te nèngu èèna cee? peka ku laa, sèna ka ja'a bisa parcaya ne.

source_text: and jesus said to him, and thou hast seen him, and he it is, that speaketh with thee.
target_text: hèia yesus peka, na, èu paraga le dènge ne. nèngu èèna, nuka ja'a ne, dhu padhai lii dènge èu ne.

source_text: and he said, lord, i believe. and he fell down, and worshipped him.
target_text: ka dhèu ne dhaa, aku nèngu na, ama, ja'a parcaya! hèia na patitu kètu urutuu pahaha iisi mi yesus.

source_text: therefore jesus said to him, i came into this world, in doom, that they that see not, see, and they that see, be made blind.
target_text: hèia yesus lii dènge ne, aku nèngu na, mamai ja'a asa rai-haha ne, sèna ka pad'elo sasala-sasigo dhèu, ho dhèu bèdhu bisa ladhe rèdhi, aa dhèu dhu rèdhi bisa j'aj'i bèdhu.

source_text: and some of the pharisees heard, that were with him, and they said to him, whether we be blind?
target_text: ètu era èèna abhu dhèu parisi pèri-pèri, dhu tadèngi lii padhai yesus. hèia ra karèi ne, aku rèngu na, tasamia! ji'i se bèdhu boe, sina ma?

source_text: jesus said to them, if ye were blind, ye should not have sin; but now ye say, that we see, your sin dwelleth still.
target_text: yesus b'ala, peka na, sèmi ne'e. ladhe musi madha miu bèdhu, abhu boe dhu pasala miu. te ngaa lula miu peka, na, miu bisa mèdhi, nèti èèna ka miu pasae sasala miu era.

source_text: truly, truly, i say to you, he that cometh not in by the door into the fold of the sheep, but ascendeth or goeth up by another way, is a night thief and a day thief.
target_text: yesus padhai lii pake lii pakasame, peka na, dhu ja'a peka dènge miu ne, lèke tare'a. abhu kahib'i-kalèbho dènge oka ra. ladhe dhèu maso boe re hèb'a oka, te ngaa ca'e re kolo oka, na, te'a le, nèngu ne, dhèu mana'u.

source_text: but he that entereth by the door, is the shepherd of the sheep.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe maso re hèb'a oka, nuka dhèu madhenga dhu piara kahib'i-kalèbho sèra.

source_text: to this the porter openeth, and the sheep hear his voice, and he calleth his own sheep by name, and leadeth them out.
target_text: dhèu j'aga hèb'a oka, tadhe dhèu madhenga kahib'i-kalèbho, hèia na bhoke babèdho hia nèngu. kahib'i-kalèbho se tadhe lii dhèu madhenga badha kahèi. ka ropa dhèu madhenga ne paroa ngara ra èci-èci, kahib'i-kalèbho se madhutu ne asa li'u.

source_text: and when he hath done out or hath sent out his own sheep, he goeth before them, and the sheep pursue him; for they know his voice.
target_text: ladhe dhèu madhenga ne neo nèti si asa mia, nèngu kako uuru. kahib'i-kalèbho se madhutu ne re limuri, lula ra tadhe lii na.

source_text: but they pursue not an alien, but flee from him; for they have not known the voice of aliens.
target_text: ladhe abhu dhèu dhu kahib'i-kalèbho tadhe boe, na, rèngu madhutu boe ne. te ngaa ra rai pakaj'èu, lula rèngu tadhe boe lii dhèu leo.

source_text: jesus said to them this proverb; but they knew not what he spake to them.
target_text: masi ka yesus lole lii pakasame ne hia dhèu se'e, te ngaa re'a boe sasoa na.

source_text: therefore jesus said to them again, truly, truly, i say to you, i am the door of the sheep.
target_text: ka yesus peka tabha hari dènge dhèu sèra, aku nèngu na, dhu ja'a lole dènge miu ne, lèke tare'a. ja'a ne nuka sèmi hèb'a oka kahib'i-kalèbho.

source_text: as many as have come, were night thieves and day thieves, but the sheep heard not them.
target_text: dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu mai uuru nèti ja'a, rèngu sama sèmi dhèu mana'u. masi ka rèngu loe boe paroa, te ngaa kahib'i-kalèbho se nanene boe lii rèngu.

source_text: i am the door. if any man shall enter by me, he shall be saved; and he shall go in, and shall go out, and he shall find pastures.
target_text: aa ja'a ne èci èèna ka dènge hèb'a oka èèna. ladhe abhu dhèu neo maso re ja'a, ama lamatua neo patabuli ne nèti koasa sasala-sasigo na. èèna sama sèmi nèngu la'e asa era ama lamatua, maso re ja'a dhu j'aj'i hèb'a oka. aa dhèu dhu maso re ja'a, nèngu neo asa mia èèna ka, ngaa-ngaa tao boe, dènge abhu na'a-ninu dhu be'a.

source_text: a night thief cometh not, but that he steal, slay, and lose; and i came, that they have life, and have more plenteously.
target_text: dhèu mana'u re'a dhoka tao maruru di, te rèngu mai ho mana'u, pamadhe dhèu, aa pa'ele iie mamuri dhèu. te ngaa ja'a kèti mamuri dhu hua iia titu kèna, te mamai ja'a ne, sèna ka dhèu bisa mamuri mera-milu, aa unu mamuri dhu lèke.

source_text: i am a good shepherd; a good shepherd giveth his life for his sheep.
target_text: ja'a kahèi nuka sèmi dhèu madhenga badha dhu be'a. te dhèu madhenga dhu be'a, sadia saraka ngi'u na toke madhe, sèna ka kahib'i-kalèbho na bisa mamuri.

source_text: but an hired hind, and that is not the shepherd, whose be not the sheep his own or whose the sheep be not his own, seeth a wolf coming, and he leaveth the sheep, and fleeth; and the wolf ravisheth, and disperseth, or scattereth, the sheep.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu sab'a dhu lamatua boe nèti kahib'i-kalèbho sèra, ropa nèdhi busa hui mai, na rai pakaj'èu, tèke eele kahib'i-kalèbho se. hèia busa hui ne kadhi nare kahib'i-kalèbho, ka rèngu cahag'e rai paceb'a.

source_text: and the hired hind fleeth, for he is an hired hind, and it pertaineth not to him of the sheep.
target_text: dhèu sab'a èèna rai, lula nèngu dhoka sab'a tenge doi di. na pusi-pahae boe j'aga paie-iie kahib'i-kalèbho sèra.

source_text: i am a good shepherd, and i know my sheep, and my sheep know me.
target_text: lèke tare'a! ja'a ne nuka sèmi dhèu madhenga badha dhu be'a. ja'a tadhe hua iia kahib'i-kalèbho ja'a sèra. aa rèngu tadhe ja'a kahèi.

source_text: as the father hath known me, i know the father; and i put my life for my sheep.
target_text: èèna, èci èèna ka dènge ama ku ètu sorga tadhe ja'a, aa ja'a tadhe nèngu kahèi. ja'a sadia kore le ho soro iisi ja'a toke madhe, sèna ka kahib'i-kalèbho ja'a bisa mamuri.

source_text: i have other sheep, that be not of this fold, and it behooveth me to bring them together, and they shall hear my voice; and there shall be made one fold and one shepherd.
target_text: abhu kahib'i-kalèbho ja'a dhu leo era, dhu dhae kaboko kore mèka sèna ka pa'èci dènge kahib'i-kalèbho ètu se'e se. ja'a hud'i eo pa'oru kore si mi ca era kahèi. ropa rèngu tadèngi lii ja'a, rèngu tadhe dènge. hèia ra mai pa'èci, sèna ka j'aj'i mi ca kaboko dhu dènge dhèu madhenga èci.

source_text: therefore the father loveth me, for i put my life, that again i take it.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ama ku ètu sorga sue ja'a. te ja'a dhu sadia le soro iisi ja'a toke madhe, sèna ka ja'a bisa mamuri hari.

source_text: no man taketh it from me, but i put it of myself. i have power to put it, and i have power to take it again. this commandment i have taken of my father.
target_text: abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu laka-seti ja'a ho madhe, te ngaa ja'a mesa ku soro iisi la'a toke madhe. ja'a dènge hak ho soro ngi'u ja'a, aa dènge hak kahèi sèna ka kore hari. paredha ne, dhu ja'a sèmi kore le nèti ama ku ètu sorga.

source_text: again dissension was made among the jews for these words.
target_text: lula dhèu se tadèngi lii padhai yesus sèmi èèna, ka dhèu yahudi se pab'ala hari isi-aanga ra.

source_text: and many of them said, he hath a devil, and maddeth, or waxeth mad; what hear ye him?
target_text: abhu dhèu ae nèti rèngu dhu peka na, dhèu ne, huj'u! aa nidhu tao ne! nga tao ka miu d'èi nanene ne?

source_text: other men said, these words be not of a man that hath a devil. whether the devil or a devil may open the eyes of blind men?
target_text: te ngaa abhu cahag'e peka na, ne'e ne nèti boe lii padhai dhèu huj'u, sina ma? lii padhai sèmi se'e se, kalua boe nèti d'ara hèb'a nidhu! aa nidhu sèra bisa boe kahèi puri-pa'èle musi madha dhèu bèdhu, si?

source_text: but the feasts of hallowing of the temple were made in jerusalem, and it was winter.
target_text: lod'o èèna, dhèu yahudi neo tao kalela agama rèngu. lod'o be'a ne, lèke dènge hèru pacuhi. pesta ne, pasanèd'e dhèu yahudi lod'o dhu dhèu leo mai pakaj'alu èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i ama lamatua ètu kota yerusalem, ka ra pamèu ne sèna ka ringi hari ca tèka.

source_text: and jesus walked in the temple, in the porch of solomon.
target_text: yesus kako palème ètu madha èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i ne, ètu era dhu ra pangare na, ‘paleo dhèu aae soleman'.

source_text: therefore the jews came about him, and said to him, how long takest thou away our soul? if thou art christ, say thou to us openly or plainly.
target_text: hèia ama-ama dhèu yahudi mai lingu rare ne, ka ra peka, eeh! ji'i se mate toke d'ai pèri lod'o hari, ho nge'a? ladhe èu ne, nuka kristus, na, peka mola-mola.

source_text: jesus answered to them, i speak to you, and ye believe not; the works that i do in the name of my father, bear witnessing of me.
target_text: yesus b'ala, aku nèngu na, ja'a dhu peka mema le, te ngaa miu mo'o boe lèka. aa te ngaa j'ara-j'ara dhu ja'a tao, aa'i-aa'i madhutu paredha ama ku di. j'ara se'e se ka dhu pad'elo, na, ja'a ne, cee.

source_text: but ye believe not, for ye be not of my sheep.
target_text: te ngaa miu mo'o boe lèka ja'a, lula miu se kahib'i-kalèbho ja'a boe.

source_text: my sheep hear my voice, and i know them, and they pursue me.
target_text: te kahib'i-kalèbho ja'a dhu tare'a sèra, tadhe lii ja'a. rèngu madhutu ja'a, aa ja'a tadhe rèngu kahèi.

source_text: and i give to them everlasting life, and they shall not perish without end, and none shall ravish them out of mine hand.
target_text: ja'a hia si mamuri dhu lèke dhu ma'ète boe, aa rèngu cèri eele boe nèti ama lamatua kahèi. abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu bisa parame rare si nèti ja'a.

source_text: that thing that my father gave to me, is more than all things; and no man may ravish from my father's hand.
target_text: ama ku ètu sorga ka dhu pangèd'u rèngu mi ja'a. nèngu èra risi aa'i mèu-mèu. nèti èèna ka, abhu boe ca dhèu sa hèi, dhu bisa parame rare si nèti nèngu.

source_text: i and the father be one.
target_text: te ama ku dènge ja'a ne, èci.

source_text: the jews took up stones, to stone him.
target_text: ropa tadèngi rare, hèia ama-ama dhèu yahudi se rare hari hadhu, neo pèci pamadhe yesus.

source_text: jesus answered to them, i have showed to you many good works of my father, for which work of them stone ye me?
target_text: ka yesus padhai lii, aku nèngu na, ja'a pad'elo le j'ara dhu be'a ae-ae nèti ama ku. miu pake j'ara be'a mia, ho neo pèci pamadhe ja'a?

source_text: the jews answered to him, we stone thee not of good work, but of blasphemy, and for thou, since thou art a man, makest thyself god.
target_text: hèia dhèu se dhaa, peka na, ji'i pèci boe èu lula èu tao j'ara be'a. te ngaa ji'i huku èu dènge j'ara pèci pake hadhu, lula èu pahahe ama lamatua. te èu dhoka dhèu rai-haha di, te ngaa tao iisi mu nuka sèmi ama lamatua! seli-kolane, nga!

source_text: jesus answered to them, whether it is not written in your law, that i said, ye be gods?
target_text: ka yesus b'ala, peka na, tasamia? ètu d'ara atora agama dhu miu mèd'u, dhu suri na, ‘ja'a peka mema, na, miu ama-ama se, dewa'.

source_text: if he said that they were gods, to whom the word of god was made, and the scripture may not be undone,
target_text: èdhi te'a le, na, aa'i-aa'i dhu suri ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua, lèke, aa bisa boe core eele. ama lamatua mesa na dhu peka le dhèu sèra, na, rèngu se, ‘dewa'.

source_text: that that the father hath hallowed, and hath sent into the world, ye say, that thou blasphemest, for i said, i am god's son?
target_text: de tasamia ka miu bisa peka, na, ja'a ne pahahe ama lamatua lula ja'a peka, na, ja'a ne ana ama lamatua? maso boe asa d'ara kahadhu, si! te ama ètu sorga ka dhu paj'uj'u ja'a aa pua ja'a mai asa rai-haha ne.

source_text: if i do not the works of my father, do not ye believe to me;
target_text: sèmi ne'e. ladhe ja'a pakako boe sasab'a-la'a ama ku, na, miu baku parcaya ja'a.

source_text: but if i do, though ye will not believe to me, believe ye to the works; that ye know and believe, that the father is in me, and i in the father.
target_text: te ngaa ja'a pakako taruu sasab'a ama ku. de masi ka miu lèka boe ja'a, te ngaa miu hud'i sèmi mere ku tadha malaa dhu ja'a tao. dènge sèmi èèna, miu bisa me'a kahèi, na, ama ku dhu pa'èki dènge ja'a. aa ja'a pa'èki dènge nèngu kahèi.

source_text: therefore they sought to take him, and he went out of their hands.
target_text: ka dhèu se sèku kèpe ne hari, te ngaa na tabhèli eele nèti kacui-aai rèngu.

source_text: and he went again over jordan, into that place where john was first baptizing, and he dwelt there.
target_text: hèia yesus la'e hari asa cabèka loko yarden, ètu era dhu uru èèna yohanis sarani dhèu. ka na pea taha ètu nèi.

source_text: and many came to him, and said, for john did no miracle or sign; and all things whatever john said of this, were sooth.
target_text: dhèu ae mai tenge ne. hèia ra peka, aku rèngu na, yohanis tao nèdhi boe tadha malaa. te ngaa aa'i-aa'i dhu nèngu lole lula-nèti yesus ne, lèke tare'a-re'a!

source_text: and many believed in him.
target_text: ka dhèu ae ètu nèi parcaya yesus.

source_text: and there was a sick man, lazarus of bethany, of the castle of mary and martha, his sisters. and it was mary, which anointed the lord with ointment, and wiped his feet with her hairs, whose brother lazarus was sick.
target_text: abhu dhèu èci, ngara na lasarus. nèngu pea ètu rae betania, sama-sama dènge a'a na bhèni dhèu dua, maria dènge marta. maria ne'e, ka dhu pakose haga lamatua yesus dènge èi hèu mèngi, ka pamèu pake rèu kètu na. ca lod'o, ka lasarus pèd'a aae.

source_text: therefore his sisters sent to him, and said, lord, lo! he whom thou lovest, is sick.
target_text: ka ana hèni na dhèu dua se pa'adhu lii moa hia yesus, aku rèngu na, lasarus, angalai ama èèna, pèd'a aae.

source_text: and jesus heard, and said to them, this sickness is not to the death, but for the glory of god, that man's son be glorified by him or that god's son be glorified by it.
target_text: ropa yesus tadèngi lii moa ne, hèia na lii, aku nèngu na, èi papèd'a ne nèti boe mamadhe. ama lamatua neo pake j'ara ne'e ho pad'elo dadedha na. sèna ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i ded'e padedha-dedha ja'a, nuka ana ama lamatua ne.

source_text: and jesus loved martha, and her sister mary, and lazarus.
target_text: yesus sue marta, maria, dènge ari ra lasarus.

source_text: therefore when jesus heard, that he was sick, then he dwelled in the same place two days.
target_text: lod'o na tadèngi, na, lasarus dhu pèd'a, yesus pea dua lod'o era ètu cabèka loko yarden.

source_text: and after these things he said to his disciples, go we again into judea.
target_text: ka na peka dènge ana madhutu na sèra, aku nèngu na, mai lati hari asa era pea lasarus ètu propensi yudea.

source_text: the disciples say to him, master or rabbi, now the jews sought to stone thee, and again goest thou thither?
target_text: te ngaa ana madhutu na pab'ala, peka na, ama mese. lai-lai ne, ama-ama dhèu yahudi sèra neo pèci pamadhe ama ètu nèi. te ngaa ama neo lamu hari asa nèi?

source_text: jesus answered, whether there be not twelve hours of the day? if any man wander in the day or whoever walketh in the day, he hurteth not, for he seeth the light of this world.
target_text: ka yesus dhaa, na, baku madha'u! bèli-bèli, nèti lod'o rea toke lod'o cèna, canguru dua jam, si? ladhe kako ètu d'ara saraa, dhèu kadhunu boe. te saraa pasaraa rai-haha ho dhèu bisa ladhe rèdhi dènge be'a.

source_text: but if he wander in the night, he stumbleth, for light is not in him.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe dhèu kako ètu d'ara maroga, na kadhunu pahari-pahari, te dènge boe saraa.

source_text: he said these things, and after these things he saith to them, lazarus, our friend, sleepeth, but i go to raise him from sleep.
target_text: yesus padhai lii èle, ka na peka, angalai èdhi lasarus bhèj'i le. te ngaa pe ja'a laku parèi ne.

source_text: therefore his disciples said, lord, if he sleepeth, he shall be safe.
target_text: hèia ana madhutu na peka, na, ama, ladhe nèngu bhèj'i di, sasoa na, èèna na nèngu èle nèti papèd'a, si?

source_text: but jesus had said of his death; but they guessed, that he said of the sleeping of sleep.
target_text: ra peka sèmi èèna, lula rèngu ngee, na, yesus padhai lii lula-nèti bhèj'i dhu biasa di. aa te ngaa, yesus lole lula-nèti mamadhe lasarus.

source_text: then therefore jesus said to them openly, lazarus is dead;
target_text: hèia yesus peka mola-mola dènge ra, aku nèngu na, sèmi ne'e. lasarus madhe le.

source_text: and i have joy for you, that ye believe, for i was not there; but go we to him.
target_text: aa te ngaa ja'a karej'e lula ja'a aad'o ètu nèi lod'o dhu na madhe mèka, sèna ka miu baku susa. te, ngaa dhu j'aj'i ne'e, èèna ka dhu tao miu bisa parcaya ja'a. mai lati ka!

source_text: therefore thomas, that is said didymus, said to even-disciples, go we also, that we die with him.
target_text: hèia tomas, dhu dhèu paroa, na, ana kembar, peka dènge ana madhutu dhu leo sèra, aku nèngu na, mai ka! be'a risi aa'i-aa'i ti lati, sèna ka madhe palere-lere dènge ne.

source_text: and so jesus came, and found him having then four days in the grave. and bethany was beside jerusalem, as it were fifteen furlongs. and many of the jews came to mary and martha, to comfort them of their brother.
target_text: ka yesus si lasi asa rae betania. rae ne, kaj'èu nèti yerusalem tèlu kilometer di. ka dhèu yahudi nèti nèi, ae ka dhu mai beke, sèna ka pa'èra d'ara marta dènge maria. ropa yesus si d'ai nèi, heka re'a, na, dhèu padhane le lasarus èpa lod'o kèna.

source_text: therefore as martha heard, that jesus came, she ran to him; but mary sat at home.
target_text: ka lod'o marta tadèngi, na, yesus mai le, hèia la'e paraga dènge yesus. te ngaa maria mate ètu èmu.

source_text: therefore martha said to jesus, lord, if thou haddest been here, my brother had not be dead.
target_text: hèia marta lii dènge yesus, peka na, ama, ee! ladhe ama ètu ne'e, tatu ari ja'a madhe boe.

source_text: but now i know, that whatever things thou shalt ask of god, god shall give to thee.
target_text: te ngaa ja'a parcaya kahèi, sad'i ama manèngi ngaa èèna ka nèti ama lamatua, tatu abhu.

source_text: jesus saith to her, thy brother shall rise again.
target_text: ka yesus lii dènge ne, peka na, marta! èèna na, ari mu mamuri hari.

source_text: martha saith to him, i know, that he shall rise again in the again-rising in the last day.
target_text: marta padhai lii, peka na, ja'a ke'a, pe d'ai lod'o èle rai-haha ne, ladhe ama lamatua pamamuri hari dhèu madhe aa'i-aa'i, nèngu pamamuri hari kahèi ari ja'a.

source_text: jesus saith to her, i am again-rising and life; he that believeth in me, yea, though he be dead, he shall live;
target_text: hèia yesus peka na, ja'a ka dhu hia dhèu madhe mamuri hari. ja'a ka dhu hia dhèu, mamuri dhu lèke kahèi. de dhèu dhu parcaya ja'a, abhu mamuri èèna, masi ka nèngu madhe.

source_text: and each that liveth or all that liveth, and believeth in me, shall not die without end. believest thou this thing?
target_text: ka dhèu dhu unu mamuri dhu lèke èèna, aa parcaya ja'a, bèli-camèd'a madhe boe, te ngaa mamuri taruu. marta, èu parcaya lii padhai ja'a ne, do?

source_text: she saith to him, yea, lord, i have believed, that thou art christ, the son of the living god, that hast come into this world.
target_text: hèia marta dhaa, na, oo, ama! ja'a parcaya, na, èu ne, nuka kristus, dhèu dhu ama lamatua paj'uj'u mema karèi nèti uru ka. aa èu ne, ana ama lamatua dhu na padhadha tèke hia mai asa rai-haha ne.

source_text: and when she had said this thing, she went, and called mary, her sister, in silence, and said, the master is come, and calleth thee.
target_text: ropa marta padhai lii nare, hèia na lèpa asa èmu na. ka na paroa ari na maria, sèna ka dua ra mesa-mesa ra. ka na peka, na, ama mese mai le. nèngu neo paraga dènge èu.

source_text: she, as she heard, arose anon, and came to him. and jesus came not yet into the castle, but he was yet in that place, where martha had come to meet him. therefore the jews that were with her in the house, and comforted her, when they saw mary, that she rose swiftly, and went out, they pursued her, and said, for she goeth to the grave, to weep there.
target_text: ropa tadèngi sèmi èèna, hèia maria la'e dènge ka tenge yesus. ropa dhèu yahudi dhu beke dènge maria ètu d'ara èmu, rèdhi nèngu kèd'i sahèka, ka rai li'u la'e, hèia lasi madhutu ne re limuri. te rèngu pangee, na, maria la'e tangi asa ro'a lasarus. lod'o èèna, yesus si d'ai mèka d'ara rae. nèngu ètu era dhu marta paraga dènge ne.

source_text: but when mary was come where jesus was, she seeing him felled down to his feet, and said to him, lord, if thou haddest been here, my brother had not be dead.
target_text: ropa maria la'e d'ai era èèna, ka ladhe nèdhi yesus. hèia na patitu kètu urutuu ètu madha yesus. ka na lii, aku nèngu na, ama! sèmi ama ètu ne'e, tatu ari ja'a madhe boe.

source_text: therefore when jesus saw her weeping, and the jews weeping that were with her, he made noise in spirit, and troubled himself,
target_text: ropa yesus nèdhi maria tangi, aa dhèu yahudi dhu madhutu ne tangi kahèi, ka yesus nasa aa d'ara na susa.

source_text: and said, where have ye laid him? they said to him, lord, come, and see.
target_text: hèia na karèi, aku nèngu na, miu padhane ne ètu mia? ra dhaa, peka na, mai, ama! sèna ka mèdhi unu mu.

source_text: and jesus wept.
target_text: hèia yesus tangi.

source_text: therefore the jews said, lo! how he loved him.
target_text: ka dhèu yahudi se papeka, aku rèngu na, ladhe ku laa. na sue lasarus titu kèna!

source_text: and some of them said, whether this man that opened the eyes of the born-blind man, might not make that this should not die?
target_text: te ngaa abhu cahag'e dhu papeka na, dhèu ne'e ne ka dhu hia dhèu bèdhu bisa nèdhi. nga tao ka nèngu bisa boe tenge j'ara, sèna ka lasarus baku madhe?

source_text: therefore jesus again making noise in himself, came to the grave. and there was a den, and a stone was laid thereon.
target_text: ka d'ara yesus susa. hèia la'e padètu-dètu asa ro'a dhu ra padhane lasarus. ro'a ne dhu ra katange le dènge hadhu aae cue.

source_text: and jesus saith, take ye away the stone. martha, the sister of him that was dead, saith to him, lord, he stinketh now, for he hath lain four days or soothly he is of four days dead.
target_text: hèia yesus pua dhèu ètu sèra, peka na, loli eele ku hadhu nèti hèb'a ro'a ne! te ngaa marta, ana hèni dhèu madhe ne, peka, aku nèngu na, irii, ama! na madhe èpa lod'o kèna! tatu hèu le.

source_text: jesus saith to her, have i not said to thee, that if thou believest, thou shalt see the glory of god?
target_text: ka yesus pasanèd'e ne, aku nèngu na, sanèd'e lii ja'a deo na, si? ja'a dhu peka mema le, na, ladhe èu tare'a-re'a parcaya ja'a, pe mèdhi dadedha ama lamatua.

source_text: therefore they took away the stone. and jesus lifted up his eyes, and said, father, i do thankings to thee, for thou hast heard me;
target_text: hèia pèri-pèri dhèu loli eele hadhu nèti hèb'a ro'a ne. ka yesus ladhe asa dedha-liru, hèia na peka, ama! ja'a manèngi makasi, lula ama nanene ja'a.

source_text: and i wist, that thou evermore hearest me, but for the people that standeth about, i said, that they believe, that thou hast sent me.
target_text: ja'a ke'a karèi nèti uru ka, na, ama nanene taruu ja'a. te ngaa doe ne ja'a peka sèmi ne'e, sèna ka dhèu-dhèu dhu titu ètu ne'e, bisa re'a, na, ama ka dhu pua ja'a.

source_text: when he had said these things, he cried with a great voice, lazarus, come forth, or lazarus, come thou out.
target_text: ropa peka nare, hèia na paroa dènge lii mèdhu, peka na, lasarus! kalua ka!

source_text: and anon he that was dead, came out, bound the hands and feet with bonds, and his face bound with a sudarium, or sweating cloth. and jesus saith to them, unbind ye him, and suffer ye him to go forth.
target_text: ka dhèu madhe ne kalua nèti d'ara ro'a. kacui-aai dènge haga na pa'èki era dènge bèla hutu dhèu madhe. aa abhu bèla dhu pahutu rèhu na kahèi. yesus pua dhèu ètu sèra, peka na, bhoke eele bèla hutu se, sèna ka na kako!

source_text: therefore many of the jews that came to mary and martha, and saw what things jesus did, believed in him.
target_text: ropa laladhe rèdhi tatao yesus ne, dhèu yahudi dhu beke dènge maria, ae ka dhu parcaya yesus.

source_text: but some of them went to the pharisees, and said to them, what things jesus had done.
target_text: te ngaa abhu cahag'e kahèi dhu lasi paraga dènge dhèu nèti partei parisi, sèna ka peka tatao yesus ne dènge rèngu.

source_text: therefore the bishops, and the pharisees gathered a council against jesus, and said, what do we? for this man doeth many miracles or signs.
target_text: èle èèna, hèia kètu agama yahudi sèra, dènge dhèu parisi pakaboko ho padhue. ra pakarèi, peka na, dhèu ne'e ne, tao tadha malaa rupa-rupa! de èdhi tao ne tasamia hari?

source_text: if we leave him thus, all men shall believe in him; and romans shall come, and shall take our place, and our folk.
target_text: te ladhe èdhi soro tèke ne, bèli-camèd'a dhèu aa'i-aa'i sanao-maena nèngu j'aj'i dhèu aae rèngu. dènge j'ara ne'e, èèna na sordad'u roma sèra mai paguri eele èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i èdhi dènge palaho isi kabarai èdhi.

source_text: but one of them, caiaphas by name, when he was bishop of that year, said to them, ye know nothing,
target_text: tèu èèna, kayafas dhu j'aj'i kètu kapai risi agama yahudi. na peka, na, goa, ee! miu me'a boe ngaa-ngaa!

source_text: nor think, that it speedeth to you, that one man die for the people, and that all the folk perish not.
target_text: te ladhe dhèu èci madhe pala dhèu aa'i-aa'i, èèna be'a risi hia miu. te ladhe aad'o, na, sordad'u roma mai, pamadhe aa'i mèu-mèu isi kabarai èdhi dhèu yahudi ne!

source_text: but he said not this thing of himself, but when he was bishop of that year, he prophesied, that jesus was to die for the folk,
target_text: lii kayafas ne mai boe nèti d'ara nèngu unu na. te ama lamatua pake hèb'a na, lula nèngu ka kètu kapai risi agama d'ara tèu èèna. nèti èèna ka, kayafas peka tèke, na, bèli-camèd'a yesus madhe pala dhèu yahudi aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: and not only for the folk, but that he should gather into one the sons of god that were scattered.
target_text: aa te ngaa, dhu lèke ka, yesus madhe boe hia dhèu yahudi mesa ra di, te ngaa pala dhèu unu ama lamatua aa'i-aa'i dhu pale-lème ètu rai-haha ne. nèngu èèna na oru nare si j'aj'i mi suku ca nau-ca nadha.

source_text: therefore from that day they thought for to slay him.
target_text: lula lii padhai kayafas ne'e ka, karèi nèti lod'o èèna, ama-ama dhèu yahudi tenge j'ara ho neo pamadhe yesus.

source_text: therefore jesus walked not then openly among the jews; but he went into a country beside the desert, into a city, that is said ephraim, and there he dwelled with his disciples.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, yesus la'e heka asa madha dhèu ae ètu talora ama-ama dhèu yahudi. nèngu dènge ana-ana madhutu na lasi asa d'ara kota èci, ngara na efraim, padètu dènge d'ara mamoo. ka ra pea taha ètu èèna.

source_text: and the pask of the jews was nigh, and many of the country went up to jerusalem before the pask, to hallow themselves.
target_text: lod'o èèna, dètu le dènge lod'o kalela paska agama yahudi. dhu tema le, d'ai lod'o sèmi èèna, dhèu ae nèti rae-rae mai pakaboko ètu kota yerusalem ho madhutu kalela paska ètu èèna. dhèu se d'ai uru, ho pamèu iisi madhutu atora agama.

source_text: therefore they sought jesus, and spake together, standing in the temple, what guess ye, for he cometh not to the feast day?
target_text: ae ka nèti rèngu patangi-tenge yesus ètu èèna. ropa ra titu ètu madha èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i, ka ra pakarèi, peka na, madhutu a'abhu miu, tasamia? yesus mai madhutu pesta kalela paska ne, do aad'o?

source_text: for the bishops, and the pharisees had given a commandment, that if any man know where he is, that he show, that they take him.

source_text: truly, i say to you before it be done, that when it is done, ye believe that i am.

source_text: and so one of his disciples was resting in the bosom of jesus, whom jesus loved.

target_text: hèia yesus dhaa, peka na, sèmi ne'e. ja'a neo kore roti ca'èta, ho cèb'u asa d'ara mago ne. èèna na ja'a hia mi dhèu dhu ja'a peka deo na. ka yesus cèb'u nare roti ne asa d'ara mago, hèia na j'ole asa yudas, ana simon iskariot.

source_text: and none of them that sat at the meat knew, whereto or what thing he said to him.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu leo dhu madhèdi ètu sèra re'a rare boe, nga tao ka yesus padhai lii sèmi èèna.

source_text: for some guessed, for judas had purses, that jesus had said to him, buy thou those things, that be needful to us to the feast day, or that he should give something to needy men.

source_text: therefore when he had taken the morsel, he went out anon; and it was night.

source_text: therefore when he was gone out, jesus said, now man's son is clarified, and god is clarified in him.

source_text: if god is clarified in him, and god shall clarify him in himself, and anon he shall clarify him.

source_text: little sons, yet a little i am with you; ye shall seek me, and, as i said to the jews, whither i go, ye may not come; and to you i say now.

'

source_text: i give to you a new commandment, that ye love together, as i have loved you, and that ye love together.

source_text: in this thing all men shall know, that ye be my disciples, if ye have love together.
target_text: ladhe miu pasue sèmi èèna, dhèu aa'i-aa'i bisa re'a, na, miu se, ana madhutu ja'a.

source_text: simon peter saith to him, lord, whither goest thou? jesus answered, whither i go, thou mayest not pursue me now, but thou shalt pursue me afterward.

source_text: peter saith to him, why may i not pursue thee now? i shall put my life for thee.
target_text: petrus karèi hari, peka na, ama! nga tao ka ja'a bisa mèka laku hèi? te ja'a dhu pa'èra iisi le ho madhe pala ama!

source_text: be not your heart afraid, or disturbed, or distroubled, nor dread it; ye believe in god, and believe ye in me.
target_text: yesus padhai lii tabha hari, peka na, d'ara miu baku susa. parcaya mi ama lamatua, aa parcaya mi ja'a kahèi.

source_text: in the house of my father be many dwellings; if anything less, i had said to you, for i go to make ready to you a place.
target_text: ètu èmu ama ku abhu kama ae-ae. ladhe era d'ai boe, tatu ja'a peka le dènge miu. ne'e ne, ja'a neo laku sadia tèke era hia miu ètu nèi.

source_text: and if i go, and make ready to you a place, again i shall come, and i shall take you to myself, that where i am, ye be.
target_text: ladhe ja'a laku aa sadia kore era pea hia miu, pe ja'a lèpa hari mai kore miu ho lati pea asa nèi. dènge j'ara ne'e, ladhe ja'a ètu mia, na, miu ètu èèna kahèi.

source_text: and whither i go, ye know, and ye know the way.
target_text: miu me'a le j'ara asa era dhu ja'a neo laku.

target_text: te ngaa tomas karèi, peka na, ama! ji'i nge'a boe ama neo lamu mia. de tasamia ka ji'i nge'a j'ara ho la'a asa nèi?

source_text: believest thou not, that i am in the father, and the father is in me? the words that i speak to you, i speak not of myself; but the father himself that dwelleth in me, he doeth the works.

source_text: believe ye not, that i am in the father, and the father is in me? else believe ye for those works.

source_text: and whatever thing ye ask the father in my name, i shall do this thing, that the father be glorified in the son.

source_text: if ye ask anything in my name, i shall do it.

source_text: if ye love me, keep ye my com-mandments.

source_text: these things i have spoken to you, dwelling among you;

source_text: but that the world know, that i love the father; and as the father gave a commandment to me, so i do. rise ye, go we hence.

source_text: i am a very vine, and my father is an earth-tiller.

source_text: each branch in me that beareth not fruit, he shall take away it or do it away; and each that beareth fruit, he shall purge it, that it bear the more fruit.

source_text: now ye be clean, for the word that i have spoken to you.
target_text: lii holo-nori ja'a se'e, bisa le pamèu d'ara miu, èci èèna ka dènge dhèu sab'a oka dhu pamèu dadana anggor.

source_text: dwell ye in me, and i in you; as a branch may not make fruit of itself, but it dwell in the vine, so neither ye, but ye dwell in me.

source_text: i am the vine, ye be the branches. who or he that dwelleth in me, and i in him, this beareth much fruit, for without me ye may nothing do.

target_text: te ngaa ladhe miu pa'èki pa'èra-èra dènge ja'a taruu, aa lii holo-nori ja'a pea taruu ètu d'ara miu, na, ngaa dhu miu manèngi mi ama lamatua, na tao hia miu.

source_text: in this thing my father is clarified, that ye bring forth full much fruit, and that ye be made my disciples.
target_text: ladhe miu tao j'ara dhu be'a ae-ae, sama sèmi dadana èci dhu hua ae-ae, èèna ka dhu ded'e padedha-dedha ama lamatua. dènge j'ara ne'e, miu pad'elo kahèi, na, miu ana madhutu ja'a.

source_text: as my father loved me, i have loved you; dwell ye in my love.
target_text: sèmi mia ama sue ja'a, sèmi èèna kahèi ja'a sue miu. miu hud'i pa'èki ku pa'èra-èra dènge ja'a, sèna ka ja'a bisa pad'elo dènge miu sasue ja'a.

source_text: if ye keep my commandments, ye shall dwell in my love; as i have kept the commandments of my father, and dwell in his love.
target_text: ladhe miu tao madhutu lii paredha ja'a sèra, na, miu pa'èki taruu dènge ja'a, hèia ja'a bisa pad'elo sasue ja'a mi dedha miu. èèna nuka sèmi ja'a tao madhutu lii paredha ama ku, hèia na pad'elo sasue na taruu mi dedha ja'a.

source_text: these things i spake to you, that my joy be in you, and your joy be full-filled.
target_text: karèi nèti uru ka, ja'a peka dènge miu j'ara se aa'i-aa'i ra, sèna ka d'ara miu karej'e-karae, sama sèmi d'ara ja'a. te madhutu dad'èi ja'a, d'ara miu hud'i karej'e dhu dènge boe too-lane!

source_text: this is my commandment, that ye love together, as i have loved you.
target_text: lii paredha ja'a sèmi ne'e ka: miu hud'i pasue ku èci dènge èci, sama sèmi ja'a sue miu.

source_text: no man hath more love than this, that a man put his life for his friends.
target_text: ladhe dhèu èci sadia madhe sèna ka angalai na bisa mamuri, nèngu tatu sue tare'a-re'a angalai na. abhu boe sasue dhu risi eele hari sèmi èèna.

source_text: ye be my friends if ye do those things, that i command to you.
target_text: ladhe miu madhutu paredha ja'a taruu, miu j'aj'i angalai ja'a.

source_text: now i shall not call you servants, for the servant knoweth not, what his lord shall do; but i have called you friends, for all things whatever i heard of my father, i have made known to you.
target_text: ja'a paroa heka miu, na, ‘ana pua-paleha' ja'a. te ana pua-paleha èci, ne'a iia boe dad'èi lamatua na. te ngaa ja'a paroa miu, na, ‘angalai' ja'a, lula ja'a bhoke patalele le aa'i-aa'i dhu ama ku peka le dènge ja'a.

source_text: ye have not chosen me, but i chose you; and i have put you, that ye go, and bring forth fruit, and your fruit dwell; that whatever thing ye ask the father in my name, he give to you.
target_text: miu pili boe ja'a. te ngaa ja'a ka dhu pili kore aa ded'e miu ho pakako sasab'a ne. de miu hud'i lami tao j'ara be'a ae-ae dhu taha nare nèbhu. èèna nuka sèmi aj'u anggor ca kapua dhu hua na be'a taruu. ladhe miu tao ka sèmi èèna, na, ngaa dhu miu manèngi mi ama ku, tatu na tao hia miu.

source_text: these things i command to you, that ye love together.
target_text: de dhu ja'a paredha miu sèmi ne'e ka: miu hud'i pasue ku èci dènge èci.

source_text: if the world hate you, know ye, that it had me in hate rather than you.
target_text: yesus lii tabha hari, na, ladhe dhèu ètu rai-haha ne d'èi boe miu, na, sanèd'e, te karèi nèti uru ka rèngu d'èi boe ja'a.

source_text: if ye had been of the world, the world should love that thing that was his; but for ye be not of the world, but i chose you from the world, therefore the world hateth you.
target_text: ladhe miu sama sèmi dhèu leo ètu rai-haha ne, tatu ra sue miu. te ngaa miu sama boe dènge rèngu. te ja'a dhu hag'e kore le miu, sèna ka cèri eele miu nèti rèngu. nèti èèna ka rèngu d'èi boe miu.

source_text: have ye mind of my word, which i said to you, the servant is not greater than his lord. if they have pursued me, they shall pursue you also; if they have kept my word, they shall keep yours also.
target_text: baku bhèlu dhu ja'a peka kore le dènge miu, na, ‘ca dhèu ana pua-paleha risi boe nèti lamatua na. ' de ladhe rèngu paj'èra ja'a, tatu ra paj'èra miu kahèi. ladhe rèngu nanene ka lii holo-nori ja'a, na, rèngu nanene miu kahèi.

source_text: but they shall do to you all these things for my name, for they know not him that sent me.
target_text: èèna na ra paj'èra miu, lula miu dhu pa'èki dènge ja'a. te rèngu tadhe boe nèngu dhu pua ja'a kahèi.

source_text: if i had not come, and had not spoken to them, they should not have sin; but now they have none excusation or not excusing of their sin.
target_text: ladhe ja'a dhae padhai lii kèdhi mèka dènge rèngu, aa pad'elo j'ara mamuri dhu lèke mi rèngu, na, ra pangee taruu, na, rèngu dènge boe sala ngaa-ngaa. te ngaa ja'a mai le, aa padhai dènge rèngu sèmi èèna. de ladhe rèngu tao sala, na, rèngu abhu boe j'ara ho peka na, ‘wee! ji'i se nge'a boe, na, dhu ji'i tao sèra, sala. '

source_text: he that hateth me, hateth also my father.
target_text: dhèu dhu d'èi boe ja'a, nèngu d'èi boe ama ku kahèi.

source_text: if i had not done the works in them, which none other man did, they should not have sin; but now both they have seen, and have hated me and my father.
target_text: ja'a tao kèdhi le tadha malaa rupa-rupa ètu katanga madha ra, dhu dhèu leo tao rèdhi mèka. ladhe ja'a tao boe j'ara sèra sa, rèngu sala boe kahèi ladhe ro'o boe sèmi rare ja'a. aa te ngaa rèngu dhu rèdhi le tadha malaa dhu ja'a tao sèra. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa rèngu d'èi boe ja'a, aa d'èi boe ama ku ètu sorga kahèi.

source_text: but that the word be fulfilled, that is written in their law, for they had me in hate without cause.
target_text: te ngaa j'ara se'e se dhu j'aj'i le, sèna ka madhutu ngaa dhu suri tèke ètu d'ara atora ama lamatua, dhu peka na, ‘rèngu d'èi boe ja'a. aa te ngaa nanasa rèngu se'e dènge boe kolo-kapua. '

source_text: but when the comforter shall come, which i shall send to you from the father, the spirit of truth, which cometh forth or proceedeth of the father, he shall bear witnessing of me;
target_text: te ngaa dhèu era sarai-maena èèna neo mai. nèngu èèna, nuka roh dhu tao miu me'a mèu ngaa dhu lèke. na mai nèti ama ku. ladhe ja'a laku le asa ama ku, pe ja'a hia roh na mai asa miu. na lole dènge miu lula-nèti ja'a.

source_text: and ye shall bear witnessing, for ye be with me from the beginning.
target_text: èèna na miu peka dènge dhèu lula-nèti ja'a kahèi, lula miu bera-bera dènge ja'a karèi nèti uru j'ara ka.

source_text: these things i have spoken to you, that ye be not caused to stumble.
target_text: ja'a peka le j'ara se'e dènge miu, sèna ka miu baku pakaj'èu nèti ja'a.

source_text: they shall make you without the synagogues, but the hour cometh, that each man that slayeth you, deem that he doeth service to god.
target_text: èèna na dhèu yahudi sèra babège eele miu nèti d'ara èmu sabaj'a ra. mesa boe j'ara ne'e di, te bèli-camèd'a d'ai lod'o na, ladhe dhèu pamadhe miu, ra pangee, na, rèngu tao j'ara dhu lèke hia ama lamatua.

source_text: and they shall do to you these things, for they have not known the father, neither me.
target_text: rèngu tao miu sèmi èèna, lula rèngu tadhe iia boe ja'a. aa rèngu tadhe boe ama ku kahèi.

source_text: but these things i spake to you, that when the hour of them shall come, ye have mind, that i said to you. i said not to you these things from the beginning, for i was with you.
target_text: te ngaa ja'a peka le j'ara se'e dènge miu, sèna ka lèpa lod'o limuri ladhe j'aj'i, miu bisa sanèd'e, na, ja'a dhu peka mema le. te ngaa ja'a peka uuru mèka dènge miu, lula ja'a bera-bera dènge miu era.

source_text: and now i go to him that sent me, and no man of you asketh me, whither goest thou?
target_text: yesus aj'a tabha hari, peka na, limuri ne, ja'a neo lèpa asa nèngu dhu pua ja'a mai asa rai-haha ne. te ngaa abhu boe nèti miu ca dhèu sa dhu karèi, na, ‘ama neo lamu mia? '

source_text: but for i have spoken to you these things, heaviness or sorrow hath full-filled your heart.
target_text: lula ja'a dhu peka le dènge miu, nèti èèna ka d'ara miu susa.

source_text: but i say to you truth, it speedeth to you, that i go; for if i go not forth or go away, the comforter shall not come to you; but if i go forth or go away, i shall send him to you.
target_text: te ngaa, ngaa dhu ja'a peka dènge miu ne, lèke tare'a. ladhe ja'a laku, na, miu abhu babe'a na. te ladhe ja'a laku boe, dhèu era sarai-maena èèna mai boe pad'elo j'ara hia miu. te ngaa ladhe ja'a laku, na, ja'a hia ne mai dènge miu.

source_text: and when he cometh, he shall reprove the world of sin, and of rightwiseness, and of doom,
target_text: pe ladhe na mai, na bhoke ngangee dhèu ètu rai-haha ne, ka re'a, na, d'ara dènge tatao ra, sala. na pamako si, sèna ka rèngu madhutu j'ara mamuri dhu lèke. aa na pasanèd'e rèngu, na, ladhe lamatua pama'ète lii langu ra, peka na, rèngu se sala, do sala boe.

source_text: of sin, for they have not believed in me;
target_text: dhèu era sarai-maena èèna pad'elo sasala ra, lula rèngu lèka boe ja'a.

source_text: and of rightwiseness, for i go to the father, and now ye shall not see me;
target_text: nèngu pad'elo j'ara mamuri dhu lèke kahèi. lula ja'a lèpa asa ama ku, èèna na miu mèdhi heka ja'a. nèti èèna ka, dhèu era sarai-maena ne mai gati ja'a.

source_text: but of doom, for the prince of this world is now deemed.
target_text: nèngu peka kahèi, na, ama lamatua pama'ète lii langu dhèu dènge mola, lula lamatua dhu pama'ète nare le lii langu dhèu aae nidhu, dhu paredha rai-haha ne.

source_text: yet i have many things to say to you, but ye may not bear them now.
target_text: abhu j'ara ae era dhu ja'a neo peka dènge miu, te ngaa ne'e ne miu dhae bisa mèka me'a.

source_text: but when the spirit of truth cometh, he shall teach you all truth; for he shall not speak of himself, but whatever things he shall hear, he shall speak; and he shall tell to you those things that be to come.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe roh dhu pad'elo j'ara-j'ara dhu lèke èèna mai ka, nèngu pad'elo j'ara sèna ka miu bisa me'a j'ara aa'i-aa'i dhu lèke. nèngu padhai lii boe nèti d'ara na mesa, te ngaa aa'i-aa'i dhu na tadèngi sèra mai nèti ama ku. nèngu neo peka dènge miu kahèi, ngaa dhu bèli-camèd'a j'aj'i.

source_text: he shall clarify me, for of mine he shall take, and shall tell to you.
target_text: nèngu neo ded'e ja'a padedha-dedha, lula na neo bhoke patalele aa'i hia miu, j'ara dhu lèke lula-nèti ja'a.

source_text: all things, whatever things the father hath, be mine; therefore i said to you, that of mine he shall take, and shall tell to you.
target_text: aa'i-aa'i dhu unu ama ku, unu ja'a kahèi. nèti èèna ka, ja'a peka deo na, roh lamatua èèna na bhoke patalele aa'i mèu-mèu j'ara dhu lèke lula-nèti ja'a, aa pad'elo dènge miu.

source_text: a little, and then ye shall not see me; and again a little, and ye shall see me, for i go to the father.
target_text: yesus tuhu hari lii padhai, peka na, nèbhu heka, miu mèdhi heka ja'a. te ngaa nèbhu boe kahèi, miu mèdhi hari ja'a.

source_text: therefore some of his disciples said together, what is this thing that he saith to us, a little, and ye shall not see me; and again a little, and ye shall see me, for i go to the father?
target_text: ka ana madhutu na cahag'e papeka èci dènge èci, aku rèngu na, a'abhu ama èèna, ngaa kèna? ka peka na, ‘nèbhu heka, miu mèdhi heka ja'a. te ngaa nèbhu boe kahèi, miu mèdhi hari ja'a. ' aa, nga tao ka na padhai lii, na, ‘lula ja'a neo laku asa ama ku'?

source_text: therefore they said, what is this that he saith to us, a little? we know not what he speaketh.
target_text: hèia ra pakarèi, peka na, a'abhu na ngaa, dhu peka na, ‘nèbhu heka'? èdhi te'a boe sasoa na.

source_text: and jesus knew, that they would ask him, and he said to them, of this thing ye seek among you, for i said, a little, and ye shall not see me; and again a little, and ye shall see me.
target_text: te ngaa yesus dhu ne'a rèngu neo karèi ne ca j'ara. hèia na karèi, aku nèngu na, deo na ja'a peka na, ‘nèbhu heka, miu mèdhi heka ja'a. te ngaa nèbhu boe, miu mèdhi hari ja'a kahèi. ' miu pakarèi sèmi èèna, si?

source_text: truly, truly, i say to you, that ye shall mourn and weep, but the world shall have joy; and ye shall be sorrow-ful, but your sorrow shall turn into joy.
target_text: be'a kahèi, ladhe miu neo me'a sèmi èèna. ja'a neo peka dènge miu kahèi sèmi ne'e: èèna na miu tangi dènge d'ara susa, te ngaa dhèu leo ètu rai-haha ne karej'e-karae. masi ka d'ara miu susa, te ngaa èèna na d'ara miu karej'e-karae hari.

source_text: a woman when she beareth child, hath heaviness or sorrow, for her time is come; but when she hath born a son, now she thinketh not on the pain, for joy, for a man is born into the world.
target_text: j'ara ne sama sèmi bhèni ca dhèu kabake pèd'a d'ai lod'o neo nara iisi. d'ara na rasa bia, lula d'ai lod'o j'aj'èra na kèna. te ngaa ladhe nara iisi nare, na, j'aj'èra na ele. te d'ara na karej'e, lula abhu dhèu hiu èci dhu mai asa rai-haha.

source_text: and therefore ye have now sorrow, but again i shall see you, and your heart shall have joy, and no man shall take from you your joy.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi dènge miu. ne'e ne miu tangi dènge d'ara susa. te ngaa nèbhu-nèbhu ja'a mai paraga hari dènge miu, ka d'ara miu j'aj'i hari karej'e-karae. aa ladhe j'ara ne j'aj'i, abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu bisa bhabhae rare d'ara karae miu.

source_text: and in that day ye shall not ask me anything; truly, truly, i say to you, if ye ask the father anything in my name, he shall give it to you.
target_text: aa ladhe j'ara sèmi sèra j'aj'i, miu pakarèi heka ngaa-ngaa dènge ja'a. tare'a! ja'a peka hari dènge miu kèna, na, sad'i miu manèngi ngaa èèna ka nèti ama ku, pake kolongara ja'a, èèna na nèngu tao sèmi èèna hia miu.

source_text: till now ye asked nothing in my name; ask ye, and ye shall take, that your joy be full.
target_text: toke d'ai sange ne'e, miu dhae manèngi mèka ngaa-ngaa pake kolongara ja'a. de manèngi la, sèna ka miu abhu. dènge j'ara ne, d'ara miu bisa karej'e tare'a-re'a.

source_text: i have spoken to you these things in proverbs; the hour cometh, when now i shall not speak to you in proverbs, but openly of my father i shall tell to you.
target_text: yesus padhai lii tabha hari, peka na, toke d'ai sange ne'e, ja'a tema aj'a-nori miu pake lii pakasame. te ngaa bèli-camèd'a d'ai lod'o na, ja'a aj'a miu pake heka lii pakasame. te ja'a neo peka mola-mola lula-nèti ama ku.

source_text: in that day ye shall ask in my name; and i say not to you, that i shall pray the father for you;
target_text: ladhe lod'o èèna d'ai, na, miu mesa mi dhu sabaj'a ho manèngi mi ama ku pake kolongara ja'a. baku dhoka ja'a mesa ku di dhu sabaj'a hia miu.

source_text: for the father himself loveth you, for ye have loved me, and have believed, that i went out from god.
target_text: te ama ku sue miu, lula miu sue ja'a. aa miu me'a mèu, na, ama lamatua ka dhu pua ja'a.

source_text: i went out from the father, and i came into the world; again i leave the world, and go to the father.
target_text: uru èèna, ja'a tèke eele ama ku, ho mai pea taha ètu rai-haha ne. te ngaa limuri ne, ja'a neo tèke eele rai-haha ne, ho laku pea pa'èci hari dènge ne.

source_text: his disciples said to him, lo! now thou speakest openly, and thou sayest no proverb.
target_text: tadèngi rare sèmi ne'e, hèia ana madhutu yesus se lii, aku rèngu na, de ne'e ne, ama padhai lii mola-mola kèna, aa aj'a-nori pake heka lii pakasame.

source_text: now we know, that thou know-est all things; and it is not need or no need to thee, that any man ask thee. in this thing we believe, that thou wentest out from god.
target_text: ji'i nge'a, na, ama dhu me'a aa'i mèu j'ara-j'ara. dhèu parluu heka sèku ama dènge karèi ngaa-ngaa, lula ama dhu me'a uru le ngaa dhu ra neo karèi, aa lii dhaa na tasa mera mia. j'ara ne peka dènge ji'i, na, ama mai nèti ama lamatua.

source_text: jesus answered to them, now ye believe.
target_text: hèia yesus karèi, aku nèngu na, tare'a, do? limuri ne, miu lèka ja'a, do?

source_text: lo! the hour cometh, and now it cometh, that ye be dispersed, or scattered, each into his own things, and that ye leave me alone; and i am not alone, for the father is with me.
target_text: sèmi ne'e. nèbhu boe, mulai ciki-diki ne, miu aa'i-aa'i mi rai paceb'a. ca dhèu-dhèu ka rai tèke eele ja'a mesa-mesa ku, ho la'e lu'u. masi ka sèmi èèna, ja'a mesa ku boe, lula ama ku bera-bera dènge ja'a.

source_text: these things i have spoken to you, that ye have peace in me; in the world ye shall have dis-ease, or have pressing, or over-laying, but trust ye, i have overcome the world.
target_text: ja'a peka tèke le j'ara se dènge miu, sèna ka d'ara miu mera-milu, lula miu dhu pa'èki dènge ja'a. te bèli-camèd'a dhèu ètu rai-haha ne pasusa dènge paj'èra miu. te ngaa pa'èra d'ara miu, lula ja'a segi aa'i le koasa aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne!

source_text: these things jesus spake, and when he had cast up or lifted up his eyes into heaven, he said, father, the hour cometh, clarify thy son, that thy son clarify thee. as thou hast given to him power on each flesh, or man, that all thing that thou hast given to him, he give to them everlasting life.
target_text: ropa yesus padhai lii nare, hèia na ladhe asa dedha-liru, ka sabaj'a, peka na: ama pasue. lod'o d'ai kèna ho ama ded'e ja'a padedha-dedha. ja'a ne, ana ama. ama dhu pangèd'u ja'a hak, sèna ka lalau-lalo'o dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne. ama hia hak ne, sèna ka ja'a hia mamuri dhu lèke dhu ma'ète boe mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu ama pangèd'u mai ho j'aj'i dhèu ja'a. de ne'e ne, ja'a manèngi sèna ka ama ded'e ja'a padedha-dedha ho pad'elo dadedha ama.

source_text: and this is everlasting life, that they know thee very god alone, and whom thou hast sent, jesus christ.
target_text: j'ara abhu mamuri dhu lèke dhu ma'ète boe, sèmi ne'e: dhèu hud'i tadhe ama ku, nuka ama lamatua dhu lèke. dhu leo aad'o. aa rèngu hud'i tadhe ku ja'a kahèi, nuka yesus kristus, dhu ama pua mai asa rai-haha ne.

source_text: i have clarified thee on the earth, i have ended the work, that thou hast given to me to do.
target_text: ja'a pad'elo le dadedha ama ètu rai-haha ne. ja'a pa'èle le sasab'a dhu ama pangèd'u mi ja'a.

source_text: and now, father, clarify thou me at thyself, with the clearness that i had at thee, before the world was made.
target_text: uru èèna, lod'o èdhi paj'aj'i mèka rai-haha ne, ja'a bera-bera le dènge ama. lod'o èèna, dadedha ja'a èci èèna ka dènge dadedha ama. ne'e ne ja'a neo lèpa hari asa ama. de ja'a manèngi ho ama ded'e ja'a padedha-dedha, sèna ka dadedha ja'a sama sèmi uru èèna.

source_text: i have showed thy name to those men, which thou hast given to me of the world; they were thine, and thou hast given them to me, and they have kept thy word.
target_text: yesus tuhu hari lii sabaj'a, peka na, ama hia le dhèu ètu rai-haha ne, j'aj'i dhèu ja'a. ja'a aj'a-nori si, ho rèngu tadhe ama. rèngu j'aj'i dhèu ama, hèia ama pangèd'u si j'aj'i unu ja'a kahèi. ka ra tao madhutu lii holo-nori ama.

source_text: and now they have known, that all things that thou hast given to me, be of thee.
target_text: limuri ne re'a le, na, j'ara aa'i-aa'i dhu ama pangèd'u mi ja'a sèra, kapua ra nèti ama.

source_text: for the words that thou hast given to me, i gave to them; and they have taken, and have known verily, that i went out from thee; and they believed, that thou sentest me.
target_text: te ja'a aj'a kore le rèngu lii holo-nori dhu ama hia mi ja'a. rèngu sèmi rare kahèi lii holo-nori se'e. re'a kahèi, na, ja'a mai nèti ama. ka ra parcaya, na, ama ka dhu pua ja'a mai asa rai-haha ne.

source_text: i pray for them, i pray not for the world, but for them that thou hast given to me, for they be thine.
target_text: ja'a sabaj'a hia rèngu. ne'e ne, ja'a sabaj'a boe hia dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne. te ngaa ja'a sabaj'a hia dhèu-dhèu dhu ama pangèd'u mi ja'a, te rèngu se unu ama.

source_text: and all my things be thine, and thy things be mine; and i am clarified in them.
