target_text: cag'ag'a laa, na pasoka titu, hèia na kako la'e-mai neo ne'a, haga nèngu be'a le, do dhae. èle èèna ka, na la'e palere dènge rèngu dua ra asa d'ara èmu manèngi-mangaj'i. na kako pasoa-pasoka dènge koa-kio ama lamatua.

source_text: and all the people saw him walking, and praising god.
target_text: dhèu aa'i-aa'i sèra ladhe rèdhi dhèu ne'e kako la'e-mai, aa koa-kio kolongara ama lamatua.

source_text: and they knew him, that he it was that sat at alms at the fair gate of the temple. and they were filled with wondering, and astonishing, in that thing that befelled to him.
target_text: ropa dhèu ae sèra tadhe ne, ka ra malaa, hèia peka, aku rèngu na, nèngu ne'e ka dhèu karuku dhu madhèdi ètu hèb'a saraga, ho manèngi ngaa-ngaa èèna, sina ma? tasamia ka na j'aj'i sèmi ne'e?

source_text: but when they saw peter and john, all the people ran to them at the porch that was called of solomon, and wondered greatly.
target_text: èle èèna ka, dhèu dhu èle nèti karuku èèna, madhutu petrus dènge yohanis. ka tèlu ra lasi d'ai èmu taleo cue, ngara na ‘èmu taleo dhèu aae soleman'. ètu èèna, dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu mai lingu rare rèngu malaa titu kèna.

source_text: and peter saw, and answered to the people, men of israel, what wonder ye in this thing? either what behold ye us, as by our virtue, either power, either piety, we made this man for to walk?
target_text: ropa petrus nèdhi rèngu, ka na padhai lii, peka na, dhèu isra'el aa'i-aa'i mi! nga tao ka miu malaa, lula j'ara ne'e ne? nga tao ka miu ladhe kaloo ji'i? miu ngee, na, dhèu ne kako lula ji'i pake na'i, do, lula ji'i maj'èni madhutu ama lamatua? do, tasamia?

source_text: god of abraham, and god of isaac, and god of jacob, and god of our fathers, hath glorified his son jesus, whom ye betrayed, and denied before the face of pilate, when he deemed him to be delivered.
target_text: ja'a neo peka dènge miu sèmi ne'e: bèi-baki èdhi abraham, isak dènge yakob manèngi-mangaj'i mi ama lamatua. lamatua èèna ka dhu ded'e padedha-dedha dhèu nèngu dhu na pili nare, nuka yesus. yesus èèna ka dhu miu tule eele ne, ka saraka ne asa gubernur pilatus. ka gubernur neo patabuli ne, te ngaa miu ka dhu palab'a, sèna ka na baku patabuli eele yesus.

source_text: but ye denied the holy and the rightful or just man, and asked a manslayer to be given to you.
target_text: te ngaa yesus, dhèu dhu sala boe. d'ara nèngu be'a. gubernur neo patabuli eele dhèu dhu sala boe ne, te ngaa miu aa'i-aa'i mi lab'a ne. aa dhu bhelu risi hari ka, miu dadugu-rariu ne, sèna ka na patabuli hia miu dhèu bhelu-katub'a èci dhu pamadhe nèdhi dhèu.

source_text: and ye slew the maker of life, whom god raised from death, of whom we be witnesses.
target_text: miu ka dhu pamadhe yesus! aa te ngaa nèngu ka dhu hia èdhi mamuri. mema tare'a nèngu madhe le, te ngaa ama lamatua pamamuri hari ne. nèngu ka dhu ji'i ladhe ngèdhi le dènge musi madha ji'i.

source_text: and in the faith of his name he hath confirmed this man, whom ye see and know; the name of him, and the faith that is by him, gave to this man full healing or full health in the sight of all you.
target_text: miu tadhe dhèu karuku ne. nèngu èra le, te ngaa ji'i boe ka dhu puri-pa'èle ne. ji'i se dènge boe koasa ngaa-ngaa. koasa èèna mai nèti yesus. dhèu ne'e ne èra, lula nèngu parcaya lamatua yesus. yesus ka dhu pa'èle ne, ètu katanga madha miu aa'i-aa'i mi.

source_text: and now, brethren, i wot that by unwitting ye did, as also your princes.
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i ti! limuri ne, ja'a ke'a le, miu dènge dhèu aae-dhèu kapai miu, tao bhelu mi dedha yesus, te ngaa miu me'a boe ngaa dhu j'aj'i lèpa limuri.

source_text: but god that before-told by the mouth of all prophets, that his christ should suffer, hath fulfilled so.
target_text: te ngaa ama lamatua peka mema nèti uru ka mai, pake dhèu nèti lii padhai nèngu, peka na, kristus, nuka dhèu dhu na hag'e nare èèna, hud'i d'ui ku j'aj'èra. ka j'aj'i le, sèmi èèna ka!

source_text: therefore be ye repentant, and be ye converted, that your sins be done away, that when the times of refreshing shall come from the sight of the lord,
target_text: nèti èèna ka, miu hud'i ele-ho'a, tèke eele sasala-sasigo miu, hèia lèpa asa ama lamatua, ho na saku eele aa baku ngee ia ka sasala miu sèra.

source_text: and he shall send that jesus christ, that is now preached to you.
target_text: pe ama lamatua pa'èra d'ara miu. ka na neo pua kristus dhu na hag'e nare èèna, mai hari asa miu. kristus èèna, nuka yesus, dhu na pua le mai asa miu.

source_text: whom it behooveth heaven to receive, into the times of restitution of all things, which the lord spake by the mouth of his holy prophets from the world.
target_text: nèti uru ka mai, lamatua padhai lii re dhèu nèti lii padhai na, peka na, ‘bèli-camèd'a, ama lamatua pamola j'ara aa'i-aa'i, sèna ka j'aj'i hiu. ' yesus hud'i mate ku ètu era mola-mèci toke d'ai lod'o nèngu mai hari, ho na pahiu ngaa-ngaa aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: for moses said, for the lord your god shall raise to you a prophet, of your brethren; as me, ye shall hear him by or upon all things, whatever he shall speak to you.
target_text: uru èèna, baki musa peka le dènge dhèu isra'el, aku nèngu na, ‘lamatua miu, nuka ama lamatua, bèli-camèd'a na pua dhèu èci nèti talora miu, ho j'aj'i dhèu nèti lii padhai na, sama sèmi na pake ja'a, ho j'aj'i dhèu kèti lii padhai na. de miu hud'i pasa dhilu, sèna ka mi nanene paie, ngaa-ngaa dhu na neo peka mi miu.

source_text: and it shall be, that every man or every soul that shall not hear that prophet, shall be destroyed, or exiled, from the people.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu cee dhu ro'o boe nanene paie, lii padhai lii dhèu èèna, èèna na cèri eele nèti dhèu unu lamatua sèra. dènge heka hak ètu talora rèngu. '

source_text: and all prophets from samuel and afterward, that spake, told these days.
target_text: mesa boe baki musa di dhu peka sèmi èèna. te lamatua pake dhèu leo kahèi, j'aj'i dhèu nèti lii padhai na. rèngu peka sèmi èèna kahèi. sama sèmi uru èèna, lamatua pake baki samuel, ho lolo j'ara-j'ara dhu limuri ne èdhi tèdhi dènge musi madha èdhi.

source_text: but ye be the sons of prophets, and of the testament that god ordained to our fathers, and said to abraham, in thy seed all the families of earth shall be blessed.
target_text: ama lamatua moa tèke le, mi baki abraham, peka na, ‘bèli-camèd'a, re ana-èpu èu èci, ja'a hia mèngi-nale mi dedha suku aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne. ' lii moa dhu ama lamatua peka le mi dhèu rèti lii padhai na, limuri ne, j'aj'i le mi dedha miu, nuka a'ari ja'a dhèu isra'el sèra.

source_text: god raised his son first to you, and sent him blessing you, that each man convert him from his wickedness.
target_text: ama lamatua pua ana na dhu na hag'e nare èèna, ho paj'uj'u j'ara, sèna ka miu tèke eele sasala-sasigo miu. dènge sèmi èèna, na pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi miu. lamatua pua uuru ana na mai asa miu, èle èèna, heka na pua ne asa suku leo sèra. èèna ka dhu j'aj'i mèngi-nale mi èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti.

source_text: and while they spake to the people, the priests and the magistrates of the temple, and the sadducees came upon them,
target_text: lod'o èèna, ropa petrus dènge yohanis padhai lii era dènge dhèu ètu sèra, dhèu kapai canau mai. rèngu sèra, kètu agama yahudi, dhèu nèti partei saduki, dènge komedhaa j'aga èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. rèngu mai neo patao dènge petrus dènge yohanis.

source_text: and sorrowed, that they taught the people, and told in jesus the again-rising from death.
target_text: dhèu sèra nasa, lula rèngu dua ra d'èi peka dènge dhèu ae, peka na, yesus mamuri hari le nèti mamadhe na. dènge j'ara èèna, nèngu bhoke j'ara hia dhèu madhe sèna ka bisa mamuri hari.

source_text: and they laid hands on them, and putted them into ward or into keeping into the morrow; for it was then eventide.
target_text: ka ra paredha dhèu rèngu lasi kèpe dua ra. te ngaa, lula lod'o oe cèna kèna, ka ra pamaso taha si asa d'ara bèdho. ho bèli èèna, heka ra neo parisa si kèna.

source_text: but many of them that had heard the word, believed; and the number of men was made five thousands or five thousand.
target_text: te ngaa ètu talora dhèu dhu d'èi nanene dhèu pajuu-paleha lamatua yesus sèra, ae ka dhu mangaku, na, lii aj'a-nori rèngu sèra lèke tare'a. nèti èèna ka dhèu parcaya asa tabha ae, pe d'ai lèmi riho dhèu sa.

source_text: and amorrow it was done or forsooth in the morrow it was done, that the princes of them, and elder men and scribes were gathered in jerusalem;
target_text: asa bèli èèna, dhèu kapai yahudi sèra pakaboko ètu kota yerusalem, nuka dhèu paredha, dhèu heka-dhèu heka ad'a yahudi, dènge mese agama yahudi sèra.

source_text: and annas, prince of priests, and caiaphas, and john, and alexander, and how many ever were of the kind or of the kindred of priests.
target_text: kètu kapai risi agama yahudi, dhu ngara na hanas, ètu èèna kahèi. dhèu kapai leo, sèmi kayafas, yohanis, aleksander, dènge a'ari leo sèra nèti kètu kapai risi agama yahudi ètu èèna kahèi.

source_text: and they set them in the middle, and asked, in what virtue, either in what name, have ye done this thing?
target_text: ropa ra tesa aa'i, ka ra paredha dhèu lasi rare petrus dènge yohanis, ho rèti mai asa madha ama-ama dhèu kapai se'e. ropa rèngu mai, ka ra karèi si, peka na, tasamia ka miu bisa puri-pa'èle dhèu karuku? miu pake koasa nèti cee? aa cee ka dhu pua miu ka miu bani tao j'ara èèna?

source_text: then peter filled with the holy ghost, said to them, ye princes of the people, and ye elder men, hear ye.
target_text: hèia roh ama lamatua pa'èra d'ara petrus, ka na dhaa, aku nèngu na, ama-ama! miu ka dhèu kapai, dènge dhèu heka kabarai isra'el! baku nasa ladhe ji'i ako malaa ciki.

source_text: if we today be deemed in the good deed of a sick man, in whom or in which this man is made safe,
target_text: ji'i ladhe, na, ama-ama si neo tao lii langu, lula ji'i puri-pa'èle dhèu karuku èci. aa miu neo me'a ji'i pake koasa nèti cee?

source_text: be it known to you all, and to all the people of israel, that in the name of jesus christ of nazareth, whom ye crucified, whom god raised from death, in this or in him this man standeth whole before you.
target_text: de ja'a neo peka sèmi ne'e: tatu ama si sanèd'e era dhèu nasaret, dhu ngara na yesus. nèngu èèna, kristus, dhu ama lamatua paj'uj'u mema nèti uru ka mai. te ngaa miu paku pamadhe ne ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa ama lamatua pamamuri hari ne. de ja'a d'èi sèna ka ama si dènge dhèu isra'el aa'i-aa'i mi me'a, na, ji'i puri-pa'èle dhèu karuku èèna, pake dhodhoka koasa yesus.

source_text: this is the stone, which was reproved of you building, which is made into the head of the corner;
target_text: yesus ne'e ka dhu ra suri tèke le ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua, peka na, ‘abhu hadhu cue dhu tuka core eele; te ngaa limuri mai, hadhu èèna j'aj'i hadhu padhèdi. '

source_text: and health is not in any other. for neither other name under heaven is given to men, in which it behooveth us to be made safe.
target_text: ètu palème rai-haha ne, ama lamatua bhoke boe j'ara leo dhu bisa patabuli èdhi nèti koasa sasala-sasigo èdhi. dhodhoka j'ara èci di, nuka yesus. abhu boe dhèu leo èci sa dhu bisa hia mamuri mi èdhi.

source_text: and they saw the steadfastness of peter and of john, and when it was found that they were men unlettered or without letters, and lay men, they wondered, and they knew them that they were with jesus.
target_text: dhèu dhu madhèdi ètu sèra sa re'a, na, petrus dènge yohanis se, dhoka dhèu biasa di, èci èèna ka dènge dhèu dhu re'a boe baca-suri. te ngaa dhèu sèra malaa dènge babani dua ra, lula rèngu padhai lii dhu dènge boe pahuni-pahuni. tabha hari, ra re'a, na, dhèu dua se, dhèu pa'èci nèti yesus.

source_text: and they saw the man that was healed, standing with them, and they might nothing gainsay.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, hèb'a dhèu se kutu mèno, toke ra padhai lii heka ae-ae, lula dhèu dhu èle nèti karuku èèna, titu dhii-dhii patoo madha dènge madha.

source_text: but they commanded them to go forth without the council. and they spake together,
target_text: èle èèna ka, ra pua dhèu pajuu-paleha yesus dhèu dua sèra, aku rèngu na, dua mi lami ku asa li'u ciki. ka ra padhue ho neo tenge j'ara aapa.

source_text: and said, what shall we do to these men? for the sign is made known by them to all men, that dwell at jerusalem; it is open, and we may not deny.
target_text: ka ra padhue-padhai, peka na, a'ari aa'i-aa'i ti! èdhi hud'i tao dhèu dua se samia? te dhèu yerusalem aa'i-aa'i ra re'a le, na, rèngu dua se ka dhu tao tadha malaa deo na. èdhi pasili tare heka, lula bukti nèngu abhu le!

source_text: but that it be no more published into the people, menace we to them, that they speak no more in this name to any man.
target_text: de hua iia èdhi tenge j'ara, sèna ka lii ne'e baku ra lolo palème asa mia-mia la'e. be'a risi èdhi pamadha'u si, sèna ka ra baku aj'a ia ka j'ara mamuri yesus. ladhe ra nanene boe, na, re'a mema!

source_text: and they called them, and announced to them, that on no manner they should speak, neither teach, in the name of jesus.
target_text: hèia ra paroa dua ra maso hari asa d'ara, ka ra peka dènge si, aku rèngu na, miu ladhe unu mi, ee! miu bisa heka lolo, do, aj'a-nori dhèu leo lula-nèti yesus!

source_text: but peter and john answered, and said to them, if it be rightful in the sight of god to hear you rather than god, deem ye.
target_text: te ngaa petrus dènge yohanis b'ala, peka na, cob'a ama-ama si pajiko ku laa. mia dhu be'a risi? madhutu paredha ama si, do, madhutu paredha ama lamatua?

source_text: for we must needs speak those things, that we have seen and heard. forsooth we may not not speak the things that we have seen and heard.
target_text: te ji'i ngèdhi le dènge musi madha ji'i, aa tadèngi le dènge ro'a dhilu ji'i madha j'ara ae. de tasamia ji'i kutu hèb'a, ho baku lolo dènge dhèu leo!

source_text: and they menaced them, and let them go, and found not how they should punish them, for the people; for all men clarified that thing that was done in that that was befallen.
target_text: dhèu dhu madhèdi pama'ète lii langu èèna, kai hari rèngu. ka ra patalale eele dua si, lula ra re'a heka j'ara ho huku si. rèngu madha'u kahèi, mage dhoka dhèu ae ètu li'u sèi pagama. te dhèu ae sèra koa-kio kolongara ama lamatua, lula dhèu karuku èèna èle le.

source_text: for the man was more than forty years old, in whom this sign of healing or of health was made.
target_text: dhèu èèna karuku èpa nguru risi tèu le, ka heka bisa kako kèna.

source_text: and when they were delivered, they came to their fellows, and told to them, how great or how many things the princes of priests and the elder men had said to them.
target_text: ropa ra patabuli eele petrus dènge yohanis, dua ra lèpa lasi asa angalai rèngu. hèia dua ra lole aa'i-aa'i ngaa dhu kètu agama yahudi dènge dhèu kapai leo sèra kai rèngu ho baku palolo.

source_text: and when they heard, with one heart they raised voice to the lord, and said, lord, thou that madest heaven and earth, sea, and all things that be in them,
target_text: ropa ra tadèngi rare lii lolo èèna, ka angalai rèngu aa'i-aa'i sèra pakaboko dènge d'ara èci, ho ra manèngi-mangaj'i, peka na, ama lamatua dhu koasa kapai risi eele. ama dhu paj'aj'i dedha-liru dènge rai-haha, dènge isi ra aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: which saidest by the holy ghost, by the mouth of our father david, thy child, why heathen men gnashed with teeth together or wrathed, and the peoples thought vain things?
target_text: uru-uru sèra, roh ama lamatua dhu mola-mèci pake le baki daud ho j'aj'i dhèu nèti lii padhai na, sèna ka suri mema lula-nèti dhèu lab'a yesus, peka na, ‘dhèu nèti rai leo sèra nasa lula lii lai-ngèlu; dhèu se'e tao lèke boe, ho tao lii langu dhu dènge boe kolo-kapua.

source_text: kings of the earth stood nigh, and princes came together into one, against the lord, and against his christ.
target_text: dhèu aae rai-haha sèra pakaboko ho neo pamusu lab'a ama lamatua; sèmi èèna kahèi, dhèu kapai sèra rare lii èci neo lasi lab'a ama lamatua dènge kristus, nuka dhèu dhu lamatua paj'uj'u mema karèi nèti uru ka mai. '

source_text: for verily, herod and pontius pilate, with heathen men, and peoples of israel, came together in this city against thine holy child jesus, whom thou anointedest,
target_text: ka ngaa dhu baki daud suri na, limuri ne j'aj'i le. aa sasoa na led'a le. ètu kota ne'e, dhèu aae herodes, gubernur pontius pilatus, dhèu heka-dhèu heka ad'a isra'el, dènge dhèu kapai suku leo sèra, pakaboko le. rèngu pare'a lii ho lab'a yesus, dhu ama lamatua hag'e nare le.

source_text: to do the things, that thine hand and thy counsel deemed to be done.
target_text: te ngaa limuri ne, èdhi te'a aa'i le j'ara sèra lèke mola-mola dènge dad'èi lamatua, madhutu ngaa dhu lamatua peka tèke nèti uru ka.

source_text: and now, lord, behold into the threatenings of them, and grant to thy servants to speak thy word with all trust,
target_text: lamatua, èu me'a rèngu dhoka padhai lii neo pamadha'u ji'i di. de ji'i manèngi ho lamatua hia ji'i d'ara bani. sèna ka ladhe ji'i la'a padhue-padhai asa dhèu ètu mia-mia lii lolo be'a lamatua lula-nèti yesus, d'ara ji'i madha'u boe.

source_text: in that thing that thou hold forth thine hand, that healings and signs and wonders be made by the name of thine holy son jesus.
target_text: ji'i manèngi lamatua hia ji'i koasa kahèi, sèna ka ji'i bisa puri-pa'èle dhèu pèd'a. ji'i manèngi kahèi koasa ho tao rupa-rupa tadha malaa, sèna ka dhèu re'a, koasa èèna mai nèti dhèu mola-mèci dhu lamatua pua mai, nuka yesus. lamatua, d'ai sange èèna ka lii sabaj'a ji'i.

source_text: and the word pleased before or to all the multitude; and they chose stephen, a man full of faith and of the holy ghost, and philip, and prochorus, and nicanor, and timon, and parmenas, and nicolas, a comeling or a guest, a man of antioch.
target_text: hèia dhèu se'e sèmi rare kahèi lii padhai lii petrus si. ka hag'e rare dhèu pidhu, nuka: dhèu èci, ngara na stefanus. nèngu ne parcaya tare'a-re'a lamatua yesus, dènge roh lamatua dhu mola-mèci pake nèngu. aa angalai nèngu na, nuka: pelipus, prokorus, nikanor, timon, permenas, dènge nikolas, nèti kota antiokia. nèngu dhèu yahudi boe, te ngaa na maso agama yahudi.

source_text: they ordained these before the sight of the apostles, and they prayed, and laid hands on them.
target_text: hèia lere rèti dhèu pidhu dhu ra pili rare sèra, asa madha dhèu pajuu-paleha lamatua. ka ra bane ai dènge manèngi-mangaj'i hia si, ho ded'e si j'aj'i dhèu ladhe-leru bhèni balu ana-lalu, sèna ka aa'i-aa'i ra abhu pala dhu pamera.

source_text: and the word of the lord waxed, and the number of the disciples in jerusalem was much multiplied; also a much company of priests obeyed to the faith.
target_text: èèna ka, dhèu tadèngi lii holo-nori lamatua ètu mia-mia. hèia dhèu-dhèu dhu madhutu j'ara mamuri lamatua yesus, asa tabha ae ètu kota yerusalem. aa ama agama yahudi sèra, ae kahèi dhu j'aj'i dhèu unu lamatua yesus.

source_text: and stephen, full of grace and of strength, made wonders and great signs in the people.
target_text: lod'o èèna, ama lamatua hia berkat ae mi stefanus. na hia stefanus koasa kahèi, ho na tao tadha-tadha malaa dènge j'ara-j'ara kapai, sèna ka dhèu ae rèdhi unu ra.

source_text: but some rose of the synagogue, that was called of libertines, and cyrenians, and of men of alexandria, and of them that were of cilicia and of asia, and disputed with stephen.
target_text: ètu era èèna, abhu pèri-pèri dhèu yahudi dhu mai nèti rai-rai kaj'èu, nuka: kota kirene, kota aleksandria, propensi kilikia, dènge propensi asia. uru èèna, rèngu j'aj'i ènu dhèu leo, te ngaa nèbhu-nèbhu ka lamatua rèngu patabuli si. èle èèna ka, dhèu se'e pakaboko ètu yerusalem. rèngu tema le lasi asa èmu manèngi-mangaj'i dhu ra patitu unu ra. èmu manèngi-mangaj'i èèna, ra pangare ne, ‘j'aj'i heka ènu'. ropa ra tadèngi lii padhai lii stefanus, dhèu se d'èi boe, ka ra pab'ala dènge ne.

source_text: and they might not withstand the wisdom and the spirit, that spake.
target_text: stefanus ne, dhèu d'èlu-mèu, lula nèngu padhai lii pake koasa roh lamatua dhu mola-mèci. nèti èèna ka, dhèu se'e segi boe nèngu.

source_text: then they privily sent men, that should say, that they have heard him saying words of blasphemy against moses and god.
target_text: ka ra tenge j'ara aapa mi dedha stefanus. ra lasi b'ae dhèu ho j'aj'i sakasii leko-monya, peka na, ji'i tadèngi, na, dhèu ne'e padhai lii pahaha musa dènge ama lamatua!

source_text: and so they moved together the people, and the elder men, and the scribes; and they came together, and took him, and brought into the council.
target_text: rèngu dadugu dhèu, toke d'ai dhèu heka ad'a yahudi dènge mese agama sèra tadèngi kahèi. ka ra nasa. nèti èèna ka, lasi kèpe rare stefanus, hèia ra nuni ne asa era pama'ète lii langu agama.

source_text: and they ordained false witnesses, that said, this man ceaseth not to speak words against the holy place, and the law.
target_text: sakasii leko-monya rèngu sèra, ue lii langu ho pamanahu stefanus, peka na, dhèu ne loe boe padhai lii pakarehe èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. aa na peka pa'ele iie lii paredha ama lamatua, dhu musa papuru mi èdhi.

source_text: for we heard him saying, that this jesus of nazareth shall destroy this place, and shall change the traditions, which moses betook to us.
target_text: ji'i tadèngi kahèi, na peka, na, yesus, dhèu nasaret, neo sag'e eele èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i ne. aa nèngu ne neo pa'ele iie atora ad'a dhu baki musa tao tèka hia èdhi.

source_text: and all men that sat in the council beheld him, and saw his face as the face of an angel.
target_text: èle èèna ka, dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu madhèdi ètu era pama'ète lii langu agama èèna ladhe kaloo stefanus, lula rèhu na sama sèmi rèhu ana pajuu lamatua nèti sorga.

source_text: and the prince of priests said to stephen, whether these things have them so?
target_text: hèia kètu kapai risi agama yahudi karèi stefanus, peka na, dhèu se'e galaa èu ne, lèke do aad'o?

source_text: which said, brethren and fathers, hear ye. the god of glory appeared to our father abraham, when he was in mesopotamia, before that he dwelt in charran, and said to him, go out of thy land, and of thy kindred, and come into the land, which i shall show to thee.
target_text: ka stefanus b'ala, aku nèngu na, ama-ama, aa a'ari aa'i-aa'i! miu nanene ku ja'a. uru-uru sèra, bèi-baki èdhi abraham dhae tèke eele mèka rai èta-èsu na. te ngaa ama lamatua dhu kapai risi pad'elo iisi na mi nèngu. lamatua hia ne paredha, peka na, ‘pakèd'i nèti rai èta-èsu èu; tèke eele a'ari èu. lamu ka asa era èci, dhu bèli-camèd'a ja'a paj'uj'u hia èu! ' hèia na pakèd'i ka nèti rai èta-èsu na, ètu rai mesopotamia, la'e asa kota haran.

source_text: then he went out of the land of chaldeans, and dwelt in charran. and from thence after that his father was dead, he translated him into this land, in which ye dwell now.
target_text: hèia na tèke eele rai dhèu kasdim, ka la'e pea ètu kota haran. ropa ama d'èlu na madhe, ka ama lamatua lere ne asa rai ne'e ne, dhu ama-ama a'ari pea toke d'ai sange ne'e ne.

source_text: and he gave not to him heritage in it, neither a pace of a foot, but he promised to give him it into possession, and to his seed after him, when he had not a son.
target_text: lod'o èèna, ama lamatua hag'e boe rai ca kasib'i sa hia ne ho j'aj'i rai pusaka na. te ngaa ama lamatua moa tèke le, na, nèngu hia rai ne'e, j'aj'i rai pusaka ana-èpu na. te ngaa lod'o èèna, abraham dènge mèka ana.

source_text: and god spake to him, that his seed shall be a comeling or a guest in an alien land, and they shall make them subject to servage, and shall evil treat them, four hundred years and thirty or four hundred years;
target_text: ka ama lamatua peka dènge ne, ‘bèli-camèd'a ana-èpu èu lasi pea ètu rai dhèu. ho dhèu rai èèna ènyi si, aa tao rèngu j'aj'i ènu, dènge paj'èra si toke d'ai èpa ngasu tèu.

source_text: and i shall judge the folk to whom they shall serve, saith the lord. and after these things they shall go out, and they shall serve to me in this place.
target_text: ho ladhe èle èpa ngasu tèu èèna, ja'a huku dhèu kabarai dhu tao ana-èpu èu j'aj'i ènu sèra. hèia ana-èpu èu tèke eele rai èèna, ho rèngu mai asa era ne'e ne, sèna ka ra manèngi makasi mi ja'a. '

source_text: and he gave to him the testament of circumcision; and so he engender-ed isaac, and circumcised him in the eighth day. and isaac engendered jacob, and jacob engendered the twelve patriarchs.
target_text: padhai lii nare sèmi èèna, ka na hia tadha lii moa ne dènge j'ara suna ana mone, j'aj'i tadha dhu sasoa na, abraham j'aj'i le dhèu unu ama lamatua. èle èèna ka, ropa ana na, isak, d'ai umur aru lod'o, hèia na suna ne. aa isak suna ana na, yakob kahèi. aa yakob suna ana-ana mone na, dhèu canguru dua sèra, ladhe umur rèngu d'ai aru lod'o. rèngu aa'i-aa'i sèra, bèi-baki èdhi dhèu yahudi.

source_text: and the patriarchs had envy to joseph, and sold him into egypt. and god was with him,
target_text: ca tèka, bèi-baki èdhi sèra d'ara pèd'a dènge ari ra yusuf, ka ra pahie eele ne ka j'aj'i ènu ètu rai masir nèi. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa ama lamatua tèke eele boe ne.

source_text: and delivered him of all his tribulations, and gave him grace and wisdom in the sight of pharaoh, king of egypt. and he ordained him sove-reign on egypt, and on all his house.
target_text: nèti èèna ka lamatua patabuli eele ne nèti j'aj'èra nèngu. ama lamatua hia ne d'èlu-mèu, ka ne'a j'ara ae-ae, ka dhèu aae masir sue ne. nèti èèna ka, na ded'e ne j'aj'i gubernur ètu rai masir. aa na nèd'u koasa kahèi ètu d'ara èmu dhèu aae.

source_text: and hunger came into all egypt, and canaan, and great tribulation; and our fathers found not meat.
target_text: hèia tèu manganga lèke rai masir dènge rai kana'an. tèu-tèu manganga mad'èu èèna, bia titu kèna. nèti èèna ka dhèu ètu mia-mia j'èra d'ai seli. sèmi èèna kahèi, bèi-baki èdhi abhu heka nganga'a.

source_text: but when jacob had heard, that wheat was in egypt, he sent our fathers first.
target_text: te ngaa baki yakob tadèngi lii, na, ètu rai masir abhu nganga'a. ka na pua ana-ana na sèra, nuka bèi-baki èdhi, ho lasi hèli nganga'a ètu rai masir.

source_text: and in the second time joseph was known of his brethren, and his kin was made known to pharaoh.
target_text: hèli rare, hèia ra lèpa. ropa oe èle nganga'a sèra, ka ama ra pua hari lasi hèli nganga'a ètu masir. lod'o èèna ka, heka yusuf bhoke d'ara, peka na, nèngu ne ari d'èlu rèngu. ka na patadha a'ari na sèra dènge dhèu aae masir.

source_text: and joseph sent, and called jacob, his father, and all his kindred, seventy and five men or souls.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yusuf manèngi ama na dènge a'ari na aa'i-aa'i lasi pea asa rai masir. rèngu dhu lasi asa nèi, aa'i-aa'i ra pidhu nguru lèmi dhèu.

source_text: and jacob came down into egypt, and was dead, he and our fathers;
target_text: de baki yakob pidha asa nèi, toke d'ai bèi-baki èdhi sèra madhe ètu masir.

source_text: and they were translated into sychem, and were laid in the sepulchre, that abraham bought by price of silver of the sons of emmor, the son of sychem.
target_text: ka nèbhu aae ku, heka rèti rui bèi-baki èdhi sèra lèpa hari asa rae sikem ètu rai kana'an. ka ra tèke rui sèra ètu era dhu uru èèna baki abraham hèli nare nèti ana-èpu hemor.

source_text: and when the time of promise came nigh, which god had acknowl-edged to abraham, the people waxed, and multiplied in egypt,
target_text: stefanus tuhu hari lii, peka na, se'e se j'aj'i, lula ama lamatua moa tèke le, na, èèna na limuri hari nèngu neo hia rai pusaka mi baki abraham ètu era èèna. ropa oe d'ai lod'o dhu ama lamatua moa èèna, èdhi dhèu yahudi tabha ae titu kèna ètu rai masir nèi.

source_text: till another king rose in egypt, which knew not joseph.
target_text: lod'o èèna, dhèu aae hiu èci paredha ètu nèi. te ngaa nèngu tadhe boe yusuf.

source_text: this beguiled our kin, and torment-ed our fathers, that they should put away or should put out their young children, for they should not live.
target_text: dhèu aae ne'e ènyi ruri dhèu èdhi sèra. aa na bhelu titu kèna dènge bèi-baki èdhi. na laka-seti rèngu ho core eele ana rèngu dhu rara iisi hiu, sèna ka madhe.

source_text: in the same time moses was born, and he was loved or accepted of god; and he was nourished three months in the house of his father.
target_text: lod'o èèna, d'ai lod'o ina musa nara iisi ne. musa kabèb'u titu kèna! ina dènge ama na madhutu boe lii paredha dhèu aae. ra piara pahuni ne, toke d'ai tèlu hèru.

source_text: and when he was put out in the flood, the daughter of pharaoh took him up, and nourished him into her son.
target_text: ropa rèngu bisa heka pahuni ne ètu d'ara èmu, ka ra panangi eele ne. te ngaa ana bhèni dhèu aae masir rage nare ne, ka sa'u nèti asa èmu, ka na ladhe-leru ne sèmi ana d'èlu nèngu.

source_text: and moses was learned in all the wisdom of egyptians, and he was mighty in his words and works.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, dhèu rai masir aj'a aa'i ne dènge mamèu ra, toke d'ai na j'aj'i dhèu d'èlu-mèu. nèngu ne d'èlu-mèu ètu d'ara lii padhai, aa ètu d'ara sab'a-la'a.

source_text: but when the time of forty years was full-filled to him, it rose up into his heart, that he should visit his brethren, the sons of israel.
target_text: ropa musa d'ai umur èpa nguru tèu, hèia na neo patadha dènge dhèu isra'el nèngu sèra.

source_text: and when he saw a man suffering wrong, he avenged him, and did vengeance for him that suffered the wrong, and killed the egyptian.
target_text: ropa na la'e, ka na nèdhi dhèu masir èci dhu game dhèu isra'el ca dhèu. ka na sarii dhèu isra'el èèna, aa na hake pamadhe dhèu masir èèna.

source_text: for he guessed that his brethren should understand, that god should give to them health by the hand of him; but they understood not.
target_text: te musa ngee, na, dhèu nèngu sèra re'a le, na, ama lamatua pua ne ho patabuli rèngu nèti j'aj'èra ra. te ngaa rèngu re'a mèka.

source_text: for in the day pursuing he appeared to them chiding, and he accorded or reconciled them in peace, and said, men, ye be brethren; why annoy ye each other?
target_text: bèli èèna, musa la'e hari ladhe dhèu isra'el na sèra. ka na rage dhèu dua pagama. aa na neo padame dhèu dua se, peka na, ‘weh! miu dua mi se, pa'a'ari. nga tao ka miu dua mi patao? '

source_text: but he that did the wrong to his neighbour, putted him away, and said, who ordained thee prince and dooms-man on us?
target_text: te ngaa dhèu dhu game angalai na, dhaa, aku nèngu na, ‘cee ka dhu ded'e èu j'aj'i kètu ji'i! aa cee ka dhu paj'uj'u èu, ho j'aj'i mi dhèu j'ue lii langu ji'i?

source_text: whether thou wilt slay me, as yesterday thou killedest the egyptian?
target_text: èu ngee, na, èu bisa pamadhe hari ja'a, sama sèmi èu pamadhe dhèu masir med'a na? '

source_text: and in this word moses flew, and was made a comeling in the land of midian, where he begat two sons.
target_text: ropa musa tadèngi nare lii ne'e, hèia na rai eele nèti rai masir, la'e pea ètu rai dhèu median. na leo-èmu ètu èèna, ka ra abhu ana mone dhèu dua.

source_text: and when he had ful filled forty years, an angel appeared to him in fire of flame of a bush, in desert of the mount of sinai.
target_text: d'ai èpa nguru tèu, hèia musa la'e asa d'ara mamoo èci, padètu dènge ledhe èci, ngara na ledhe sinai. ètu èèna, ana pajuu ama lamatua èci puru mai nèti sorga, ka pad'elo iisi na nèti d'ara ai dhu heo ètu ana aaj'u iiki ca kapua. ai na'e ana aaj'u èèna, te ngaa kèpu boe.

source_text: and moses saw, and wondered on the sight. and when he nighed to behold, the voice of the lord was made to him,
target_text: ladhe nèdhi sèmi èèna, ka musa loo-loo sène. ka na la'e padètu ho neo ne'a, ngaa ka ne. kabèdhi laa, na tadèngi ama lamatua padhai lii nèti d'ara ai, peka na,

source_text: and said, i am god of your fathers, god of abraham, god of isaac, and god of jacob. moses was made trembling, and durst not behold.
target_text: ‘ja'a ne, ama lamatua nèti bèi-baki èu! lamatua nèti baki abraham, baki isak, dènge baki yakob. ' tadèngi nare sèmi èèna, ka na madha'u toke d'ai isi karèbha. aa na bani heka doa kètu ho ladhe ana aaj'u dhu ai na'e èèna.

source_text: but god said to him, do off the shoes of thy feet, for the place in which thou standest is holy earth.
target_text: èle èèna ka, lamatua peka hari, aku nèngu na, ‘we, musa! era dhu èu titu ne, era luri. bhoke eele salapa èu!

source_text: i seeing saw the tormenting or the affliction of my people that is in egypt, and i heard the mourning of them, and came down to deliver them. and now come thou, and i shall send thee into egypt.
target_text: baku pangee, na, ja'a bhèlu eele le dhèu isra'el unu ja'a ètu masir sèi. aad'o! ja'a sanèd'e si era. ja'a ke'a j'aj'èra rèngu. ja'a tadèngi le lii roma iisi rèngu manèngi sasue. de ja'a neo puru ho patabuli eele si. mai ku asa ne'e! ja'a neo pua èu lèpa hari asa masir nèi. '

source_text: this moses whom they denied, saying, who ordained thee prince and doomsman on us? god sent this prince and again-buyer, with the hand of the angel, that appeared to him in the bush.
target_text: dènge j'ara sèmi èèna, ka lamatua dhu pad'elo iisi nèti d'ara ai èèna, na paredha musa ho lèpa hari asa masir. lamatua paj'uj'u nèngu ho patabuli eele dhèu isra'el nèti d'ara j'aj'èra rèngu. musa ne ka dhu uru èèna dhèu karèi, peka na, ‘cee ka dhu ded'e èu j'aj'i kètu ji'i? ' te ngaa ne'e ne, lamatua ka dhu ded'e ne!

source_text: this moses led them out, and did wonders and signs in the land of egypt, and in the red sea, and in desert forty years.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, musa lèpa hari asa rai masir. ètu nèi, na tao tadha-tadha malaa ae. ka na kalua eele dhèu isra'el nèti masir. nèti si kako re dhasi mea, ka ra kako palème d'ara mamoo d'ai èpa nguru tèu.

source_text: this is moses, that said to the sons of israel, god shall raise to you a prophet of your brethren, and as me ye shall hear him.
target_text: ka musa peka dènge dhèu isra'el, aku nèngu na, ‘èèna na lamatua ded'e dhèu èci nèti talora miu, ho na paj'aj'i ne dhèu nèti lii padhai nèngu, sama sèmi na ded'e nare ja'a. '

source_text: this it is, that was in the church in wilderness, with the angel that spake to him in the mount of sinai, and with our fathers; which took words of life to give to us.
target_text: musa pa'èci dènge dhèu isra'el èdhi sèra ètu d'ara mamoo. nèngu èèna ka dhu j'aj'i kalete mi bèi-baki èdhi dènge ana pajuu lamatua nèti sorga. te ana pajuu èèna ka dhu nèti lii holo-nori ama lamatua asa musa. sèra sa ka dhu pad'elo j'ara mamuri dhu lèke. lii holo-nori sèra ka dhu lamatua papuru ètu ledhe sinai.

source_text: to whom our fathers would not obey, but putted him away, and were turned away in their hearts into egypt,
target_text: masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa bèi-baki èdhi sèra ro'o boe nanene musa. aa ra tule eele ne, ho ra neo lèpa hari asa rai masir.

source_text: saying to aaron, make thou to us gods, that shall go before us; for to this moses that led us out of the land of egypt, we know not what is done to him.
target_text: ka ra lasi rarange harun, aku rèngu na, ‘ari mu musa ka dhu pakalua eele èdhi nèti rai masir. te ngaa èdhi te'a heka nèngu ètu ro'a mia. de ji'i manèngi èu tao mèdha sogo-tagu èci hia èdhi, sèna ka mèdha sogo-tagu èèna lere èdhi. '

source_text: and they made a calf in those days, and offered a sacrifice to the maumet or the simulacrum; and they were glad in the works of their hands.
target_text: ka ra tao ka mèdha sogo-tagu èci, rupa sèmi ana sapi ci'u. èle èèna ka, ra para badha hia mèdha sogo-tagu èèna. ka ra ra'a-sisi rame-rame, lula rèngu karej'e nèti mèdha sogo-tagu dhu rèngu tao unu ra.

source_text: and god turned, and betook them to serve to the knighthood of heaven, as it is written in the book of the prophets, whether ye, house of israel, offered to me slain sacrifices, either sacrifices, forty years in desert?
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ama lamatua soro kabodho hia si. ka ra mulai sogo-tagu ka mèdha dedha-liru, sèmi madha lod'o, hèru, dènge hua-hètu. te ngaa lamatua soro tèke si sèmi èèna. èèna na lèke sèmi lii dhu dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua suri tèke, peka na, ‘weh! miu dhèu isra'el sèra! d'ara èpa nguru tèu, miu kako palème d'ara mamoo. aa miu para badha sèra, neo sogo-tagu mi ja'a, do, neo sogo-tagu mi cee?

source_text: and ye have taken the tabernacle of moloch, and the star of your god rephan, figures that ye have made to worship them; and i shall translate you into babylon.
target_text: miu koa-kio boe ja'a! bèli-bèli miu sogo-tagu dhoka mèdha sogo-tagu miu sèra di. miu maso-kalua taruu d'ara èmu mèdha sogo-tagu nidhu, ngara na molok. miu biasa sogo-tagu nidhu hua-hètu èci kahèi, ngara na refan. de miu d'èi dhoka sogo-tagu mèdha pa'ue-ai miu. nèti èèna ka, limuri mai ja'a bhabhoo miu lami asa cabèka babel nèi. '

source_text: the tabernacle of witnessing was with our fathers in desert, as god disposed to them, and spake to moses, that he should make it after the form that he saw.
target_text: stefanus padhai lii taruu, peka na, ama lamatua paj'uj'u rupa nèti era manèngi-mangaj'i èci mi musa. hèia musa si patitu paleo manèngi-mangaj'i èci, dhu tao nèti ka'uri badha dènge bèla, sama sèmi rupa dhu lamatua pad'elo le. ka dhèu isra'el sèra mai sabaj'a mi ama lamatua ètu era èèna. ho ladhe rèngu pidha nèti ca'era asa era leo lasi, na, ra sag'e eele paleo manèngi-mangaj'i èèna, aa ra èki nèu ne, aa ra jèru rèti asa era hiu. ètu era hiu, ra patitu hari paleo èèna.

source_text: which also our fathers took with jesus, that was joshua, and brought into the possession of heathen men, which god putted away from the face of our fathers, till into the days of david,
target_text: limuri mai, lod'o yosua si pamusu dènge dhèu rai leo ètu rai kana'an, ama lamatua babège eele si. ka na pabagi rai kana'an èèna hia bèi-baki èdhi. lod'o rèngu parame rare rai èèna, rèngu rèti paleo manèngi-mangaj'i lamatua asa era èèna. paleo èèna titu taruu ètu èèna, toke d'ai lod'o dhèu aae daud nèd'u paredha.

source_text: that found grace with god, and asked that he should find a tabernacle to god of jacob.
target_text: dhèu aae daud manèngi-mangaj'i mi ama lamatua, sama sèmi baki yakob si. ka daud pakarej'e d'ara lamatua, hèia lamatua hia nèngu berkat. ka na manèngi ho lamatua paj'uj'u nèngu sèna ka patitu èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i dhu hiu.

source_text: but solomon builded the house to him.
target_text: te ngaa ana nèti daud, ngara na soleman ka dhu patitu èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i lamatua èèna.

source_text: but the high god dwelleth not in things made by hand, as he saith by the prophet,
target_text: te ngaa èdhi te'a, na, ama lamatua pea boe ètu d'ara èmu dhu dhèu rai-haha tao, lula uru èèna, dhèu nèti lii padhai lamatua èci suri tèke le, peka na,

source_text: heaven is a seat to me, and the earth is the stool of my feet; what house shall ye build to me, saith the lord, either what or which place is of my resting?
target_text: ‘dedha-liru èèna, kadera era ja'a madhèdi paredha. aa rai-haha èèna, era hue haga ja'a. de tasamia ka miu bisa tao èmu èci dhu be'a hia ja'a pea ètu d'ara? bisa boe!

source_text: whether mine hand made not all these things?
target_text: lula dedha-liru, rai-haha, dènge isi aa'i-aa'i sèra, ja'a ka dhu paj'aj'i! '

source_text: with hard noll, and uncircumcised hearts and ears, ye withstand ever-more the holy ghost; and as your fathers, so ye.
target_text: hèia stefanus tuhu hari lii padhai na, ka na jèke si, aku nèngu na, miu dhèu kètu hadhu! miu se, èci èèna ka dènge dhèu dhu tadhe boe ama lamatua, dènge dhèu dhu nanene boe nèngu. miu dhèu dhu palab'a dènge ama lamatua, èci èèna ka dènge bèi-baki miu dhu soro kabodho asa ne! ka limuri ne, miu neo hari palab'a dènge roh lamatua dhu mola-mèci, do?

source_text: whom of the prophets have not your fathers pursued, and have slain them that before-told of the coming of the rightful or just man, whose traitors and manslayers ye were now?
target_text: bèi-baki miu sèra ka dhu paj'èra taruu dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua sèra. miu peka ku! dhèu rèti lii padhai lamatua mia ka dhu rèngu paj'èra boe? aad'o, sina ma! uru èèna dhèu rèti lii padhai lamatua peka mema, aku rèngu na, limuri mai ama lamatua pua dhèu nèngu dhu mola-mèci. te ngaa bèi-baki miu pamadhe dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua sèra. ka miu tenge j'ara kahèi ho hia dhèu leo pamadhe dhèu mola-mèci nèti lamatua.

source_text: which took the law in ordinance of angels, and have not kept it.
target_text: aa ana pajuu ama lamatua nèti sorga sèra dhu rèti mai atora ad'a dhu lamatua neo hia mi èdhi, te ngaa miu pusi-pahae boe.

source_text: and they heard these things, and were diversely tormented in their hearts, and they grinded, or gnashed, with teeth on him.
target_text: ropa dhèu dhu pama'ète lii langu sèra nanene rare lii padhai lii stefanus, ka re'a mema, na, nèngu pasala si. ka ra kadhi ngutu aa tèka d'ara.

source_text: but when stephen was full of the holy ghost, he beheld into heaven, and saw the glory of god, and jesus standing on the right half of the virtue of god.
target_text: te ngaa roh mola-mèci lamatua sab'a ètu d'ara stefanus. na doa kètu ka ladhe asa dedha-liru. ètu nèi, na ladhe nèdhi dadedha ama lamatua, dènge nèdhi kahèi lamatua yesus titu ètu sebhe g'ana na ètu era dhu kab'ua risi.

source_text: and he said, lo! i see heavens opened, and man's son or the son of man standing on the right half of the virtue of god.
target_text: hèia stefanus padhai lii, peka na, sèmi ne'e ku, ama aa'i-aa'i. ja'a kèdhi liru bhoke eele, aa dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a titu ètu era hua iia, re sebhe g'ana ama lamatua.

source_text: and they cried with a great voice, and stopped their ears, and made with one will an assault into him.
target_text: ropa ra tadèngi sèmi èèna, hèia dhèu pama'ète lii langu sèra hutu ro'a dhilu ra. ka ra jèke ne, sèna ka kai stefanus baku bhoke hèb'a. ka ra mangamok neo game ne.

source_text: and they brought him out of the city, and stoned him. and the witnesses did off their clothes, beside the feet of a young man, that was called saul.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ra nuni-pa'oro ne rèti asa li'u kota. d'ai nèi, ka sakasii sèra bhoke eele kodho li'u ra, ho ra hia mi ana mone ngèru èci nèd'u. ngara na saulus, dhu j'aj'i dhèu dadugu-rariu dhèu. èle èèna ka, ra tabhie stefanus dènge hadhu.

source_text: and they stoned stephen, that called god to help, saying, lord jesus, receive my spirit.
target_text: ropa ra tabhie, hèia stefanus pa'oo, peka na, lamatua yesus! lod'o ja'a d'ai kèna. sèmi more ku samanga ja'a!

source_text: and he kneeled, and cried with a great voice, and said, lord, set not to them this sin. and when he had said this thing, he died or he slept in the lord.
target_text: èle èèna ka, na bèbhe-lèpe urutuu, ka na pa'oo hari dènge lii mèdhu, peka na, ama! baku hia si d'ui sasala ne'e! hèia na ma'ète a'ae dènge ka.

source_text: but saul was consenting to his death. and great persecution was made that day in the church, that was in jerusalem. and all men were scattered by the countries of judea and samaria, except the apostles.
target_text: aa saulus ètu èèna kahèi, ka nèngu d'èi ra pamadhe stefanus kahèi.

source_text: but good or dread-full men buried stephen, and made great mourning on him.
target_text: lod'o stefanus madhe, abhu pèri-pèri dhèu dhu mamuri d'ara d'èi dènge lamatua. lasi rare ngi'u aae stefanus ho ra padhane. ka ra tangi ne. nèti lod'o èèna, ka dhèu paj'èra dhèu unu lamatua yesus ètu kota yerusalem, toke d'ai rèngu j'èra bia. èle èèna ka, rèngu rai pahag'a lasi asa propensi yudea dènge propensi samaria. rèngu aa'i-aa'i rai, te ngaa tèke eele dhoka dhèu pajuu-paleha yesus di ètu yerusalem.

source_text: but saul greatly destroyed the church, and entered by houses, and drew out men and women, and betook them into prison or keeping.
target_text: te ngaa saulus tenge j'ara taruu ho pa'èle dhèu unu yesus sèra. na tenge si ètu mia-mia. na maso-kalua èmu dhèu ho na tenge si. sad'i abhu dhèu mone, do dhèu bhèni, na kèpe si, ho na cèlu si asa d'ara bèdho.

source_text: and they that were scattered, passed forth, preaching or evangel-izing the word of god.
target_text: masi ka ra paj'èra dhèu unu yesus sèra ho ra rai asa haa asa dhimu, te ngaa rèngu loe boe peka-padhai lii lolo be'a lamatua yesus asa mia-mia.

source_text: and philip came down into a city of samaria, and preached to them christ.
target_text: conto sèmi, ca tèka, pelipus la'e asa d'ara kota èci ètu propensi samaria, ho peka dènge dhèu ètu sèra, na, yesus, nuka kristus, dhu ama lamatua paj'uj'u nèti uru ka mai.

source_text: and the people gave attention to these things that were said of philip, with one will hearing and seeing the signs that he did.
target_text: ropa dhèu ae ladhe rèdhi tadha-tadha malaa dhu na tao, ka ra pakaboko ho nanene paie ngaa dhu pelipus peka-padhai.

source_text: for many of them that had unclean spirits, cried with great voice, and went out. and many sick in the palsy, and crooked, were healed.
target_text: conto sèmi, ètu èèna, abhu kahèi dhèu-dhèu dhu nidhu tao. nidhu sèra rai eele dhèu se'e dènge pakii-pakèce. dhèu karuku dènge dhèu haga roe cabèka, èle dènge nèti papèd'a.

source_text: therefore great joy was made in that city.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, dhèu-dhèu ètu d'ara kota èèna karej'e titu kèna.

source_text: but there was a man in that city, whose name was simon, a witch, that had deceived the folk of samaria, saying, that himself was some great man.
target_text: ètu kota èèna, abhu dhèu èci dhu pake na'i, ngara na simon. nèbhu le na pake na'i ètu talora dhèu samaria sèra. ka na padedha iisi na, peka na, ja'a dhèu èra!

source_text: to whom all harkened, from the least to the most, and said, this is the virtue of god, which is called great. and they believed him, for long time he had madded them with his witchcrafts, or for this thing, that much time he had made them mad with his witchings.
target_text: ka nèti kota èèna, ana iiki do dhèu kapai, dhèu mone do bhèni, palolo dhoka dhèu ne'e di, aku rèngu na, dhèu ne'e ele-madha, nga! ngaa-ngaa dhu na tao ne, mai nèti koasa ama lamatua! lula nèngu pake na'i, nèti uru ka mai dhèu ae lèka ne.

source_text: but when they had believed to philip, preaching or evangelizing of the kingdom of god, men and women were baptized in the name of jesus christ.
target_text: te ngaa limuri ne, rèngu nanene pelipus aj'a rèngu j'ara paredha ama lamatua. aa na peka j'ara ho rèngu rèti kolongara yesus, sèna ka rèngu bisa j'aj'i dhèu unu ama lamatua. ropa ra tadèngi rare sèmi èèna, dhèu ae parcaya, ka j'aj'i dhèu unu lamatua. bhèni-mone aa'i-aa'i sèra j'aj'i sèmi èèna. nèti èèna ka, ra abhu sarani.

source_text: and then also simon himself believed; and when he was baptized, he drew to philip; and he saw also that signs and great virtues were done, he was astonied, and wondered.
target_text: te ngaa simon parcaya kahèi, ka manèngi j'aj'i dhèu unu lamatua yesus. ka ra sarani ne. hèia na madhutu pelipus asa mia-mia. ropa nèdhi tadha-tadha malaa dhu pelipus tao, hèia na pangètu kètu na, peka na, ira ii! sèmi ne'e ne, risi eele!

source_text: but when the apostles that were at jerusalem, had heard that samaria had received the word of god, they sent to them peter and john.
target_text: lod'o èèna, dhèu pajuu-paleha lamatua yesus dhu ètu yerusalem sèra, tadèngi, na, dhèu ae parcaya le lii lolo be'a lamatua ètu propensi samaria. ka ra manèngi petrus dènge yohanis lasi asa nèi.

source_text: and when they came, they prayed for them, that they should receive the holy ghost; for he came not yet into any of them, but they were baptized only in the name of the lord jesus. then they laid hands on them, and they received the holy ghost.
target_text: ropa dua ra d'ai nèi, rèngu heka re'a kèna, dhèu ètu nèi abhu mèka roh lamatua dhu mola-mèci. rèngu dhoka abhu sarani pake kolongara yesus di. hèia petrus dènge yohanis bane ai mi dhèu sèra, ka ra manèngi-mangaj'i sèna ka dhèu samaria sèra sèmi rare roh lamatua dhu mola-mèci kahèi. ka dhèu se'e abhu dènge roh kahèi.

source_text: and when simon had seen, that the holy ghost was given by laying on of the hands of the apostles, and he proffered or offered to them money,
target_text: lod'o èèna, simon ladhe nèdhi rèngu dua ra bane ai mi dhèu se'e, ka dhèu sèra sèmi rare roh lamatua. hèia na j'ole doi asa petrus dènge yohanis, dènge lii manèngi, peka na,

source_text: and said, give ye also to me this power, that whomever i shall lay on mine hands or that on whomever i shall put on hands, that he receive the holy ghost.
target_text: ama-ama! miu hia ku ja'a koasa èèna. sèna ka ladhe ja'a bane ai mi dhèu, na, ra abhu roh ama lamatua dhu mola-mèci kahèi.

source_text: but peter said to him, thy money be with thee into perdition, for thou guessedest that the gift of god should be had for money or for thou guessedest the gift of god to be had, or wielded, by money.
target_text: te ngaa petrus jèke ne, aku nèngu na, ja'a dhoo èu dènge doi èu! èu ngee, na, èu bisa hèli koasa roh mola-mèci dènge doi dhari, do? aad'o! dhèu bisa boe hèli roh lamatua!

source_text: there is no part, nor lot to thee, in this word, for thine heart is not rightful before god.
target_text: èu dènge boe hak mi roh lamatua, lula d'ara èu mola boe. èu dhoka tenge-tenge j'ara di.

source_text: therefore do thou penance for this wickedness of thee, and pray god, if peradventure this thought of thine heart be forgiven to thee.
target_text: èu hud'i ae eele ku nèti sasala-sasigo èu sèra. hua iia èu sabaj'a ho teko-teko lamatua saku eele ngangee aapa èu.

source_text: for i see that thou art in the gall of bitterness and in the bond of wickedness.
target_text: ja'a ke'a, na, d'ara èu aapa, aa j'ara karehe ae dhu èki èu!

source_text: and simon answered, and said, pray ye for me to the lord, that nothing of these things that ye have said, come on me.
target_text: ka simon manèngi dua si, peka na, ama-ama! ladhe sèmi èèna, miu dua mi sabaj'a ku hia ja'a, sèna ka lii dhoo dhu miu peka èèna, baku lèke ja'a.

source_text: and they witnessed, and spake the word of the lord, and went again to jerusalem, and preached or evangelized to many countries of samaritans.
target_text: èle èèna, hèia petrus dènge yohanis lole aa'i lii lolo be'a lamatua yesus, aa ra lole lii holo-nori ama lamatua ètu d'ara kota èèna. hèia rèngu lèpa hari asa yerusalem. ra kako re rae-rae ètu propensi samaria, ho lole lii lolo be'a lamatua yesus mi dhèu ètu rae sèra.

source_text: and an angel of the lord spake to philip, and said, rise thou, and go to meet the south, to the way that goeth down from jerusalem into gaza; this is desert.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ana pajuu lamatua nèti sorga pua pelipus, peka na, lamu ku madhutu j'ara asa balèu. madhutu j'ara dhui, dhu nèti kota yerusalem la'e asa rai gasa.

source_text: and he rose, and went forth. and lo! a man of ethiopia, a mighty man-servant, a gelding of candace, the queen of ethiopians, which was on all her riches, came to worship in jerusalem. and he turned again, sitting on his chariot, and reading isaiah, the prophet.
target_text: ropa tadèngi nare lii paredha èèna, ka na pakèd'i dènge ka. lod'o nèngu kako ètu j'ara èèna, ladhe nèdhi dhèu èci. dhèu èèna, pegawi kapai nèti rai etiopia. nèngu ne ka dhu ladhe-leru mèdha-panyau dhèu aae bhèni, ngara na kandake. pegawi èèna heka sabaj'a nare ètu yerusalem, ka na lèpa èmu ca'e kareta. ropa pelipus nèdhi ne, nèngu madhèdi baca ètu dedha kareta. na baca sasuri dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua, ngara na yesaya.

source_text: and the spirit said to philip, nigh thou, and join thee to this chariot.
target_text: èle èèna ka, roh lamatua pua pelipus la'e padètu asa kareta èèna, sèna ka na paraga dènge dhèu èèna.

source_text: and philip ran to, and heard him reading isaiah, the prophet. and he said, guessest thou, whether thou un-derstandest, what things thou readest?
target_text: ropa na dètu, ka na tadèngi, na, dhèu èèna baca sasuri yesaya. ka pelipus karèi ne, peka na, ama! ama ku me'a, do aad'o, ngaa dhu ama baca èèna?

source_text: and he said, how may i, if no man show to me? and he prayed philip, that he should come up, and sit with him.
target_text: ka dhèu ne dhaa, peka na, aad'o, ja'a ke'a boe. hud'i abhu ku dhèu dhu peka-padhai dènge ja'a, heka ja'a ke'a kèna. ca'e mai ho madhèdi dènge ja'a.

source_text: and the place of the scripture that he read, was this, as a sheep he was led to slaying, and as a lamb before a man that sheareth him is dumb without voice, so he opened not his mouth.
target_text: sasuri dhu na baca èèna, sèmi ne'e ka, ra nuni rèti ne, sama sèmi nuni kahib'i-kalèbho, ho neo roro ne. nèngu j'aj'i sama sèmi ana kahib'i-kalèbho dhu dhèu g'ute rèu ne, te ngaa nèngu mau-mau sène, na kabee boe. hèb'a na kutu mèno, aa na kalua boe lii ca lamusi sa.

source_text: in meekness his doom was taken up; who shall tell out the generation of him? for his life shall be taken away from the earth.
target_text: ka ra lalangu ne, ra j'ue lii langu na lèke boe. lod'o èèna, ra pamadhe ne, masi ka nèngu dènge boe sasala-sasigo. de èdhi peka ngaa hari lula-nèti ana-èpu na?

source_text: and the gelding answered to philip, and said, i beseech thee, of what prophet saith he this thing? of himself, or of any other?
target_text: ropa na baca nare, hèia na karèi pelipus, peka na, tasamia, ee? sasuri yesaya ne, lèke mi nèngu, do, lèke mi dhèu leo?

source_text: and philip opened his mouth, and began at this scripture, and preached or evangelized to him jesus.
target_text: ka pelipus aj'a ne lii lolo be'a lamatua yesus. na lolo nèti lii sasuri yesaya, ho pad'elo j'ara madhutu yesus.

source_text: and while they went by the way, they came to a water or to some water. and the gelding said, lo! water; who forbiddeth me to be baptized?
target_text: lod'o rèngu ètu d'ara kakako era, rèngu rage loko èci dènge èi. ka dhèu èèna peka dènge pelipus, aku nèngu na, ama. ladhe ku èi ka nèi. ladhe èu ngee, na, cadhui boe, mai puru lati, ho èu sarani ku ja'a.

source_text: and philip said, if thou believest of all thine heart, it is leaveful. and he answered, and said, i believe that jesus christ is the son of god.
target_text: hèia pelipus dhaa, aku nèngu na, ladhe ama tare'a-re'a parcaya lamatua yesus, na, cadhui boe. mai dua ti puru ho ja'a sarani èu. ka na dhaa, peka na, ja'a parcaya tare'a-re'a, na, yesus èèna dhèu dhu ama lamatua paj'uj'u nèti uru ka mai. nèngu èèna, ana ama lamatua.

source_text: and he commanded the chariot to stand still. and they went down both into the water, philip and the gelding, and philip baptized him.
target_text: hèia pegawi èèna, paredha ho patitu kareta. ka dua ra puru asa d'ara èi èèna, ka pelipus sarani ne.

source_text: and when they were come up of the water, the spirit of the lord ravished philip, and the gelding saw him no more; and he went in his way joying.
target_text: ropa ra kalua mai nèti d'ara èi, kabèdhi laa roh lamatua ded'e nèti pelipus asa era leo. ka dhèu èèna nèdhi heka pelipus. hèia pegawi kapai èèna lèpa dènge d'ara karej'e-karae.

source_text: and philip was found in azotus; and he passed forth, and preached or evangelized to all cities, till he came to caesarea.
target_text: ka pelipus cèu ètu rae èci, ngara na asotus. nèti rae èèna, ka na la'e padhue-padhai taruu lii lolo be'a lamatua yesus. na dhuli rae-rae ètu rai èèna, toke d'ai kota kaisarea.

source_text: but saul, yet a blower or a breather of menaces, and of beatings, or slaying, against the disciples of the lord, came to the prince of priests,
target_text: lod'o èèna, saulus paj'èra taruu dhèu-dhèu dhu madhutu yesus. na tenge j'ara ho neo pamadhe si. nèti èèna ka, la'e asa kètu kapai risi agama yahudi,

source_text: and asked of him letters into damascus, to the synagogues; that if he found any men or women of this life, he should lead them bound to jerusalem.
target_text: ka manèngi pèri-pèri sasuri koasa, ho nèti la'e asa ama-ama èmu manèngi-mangaj'i agama yahudi ètu kota damsik nèi. na manèngi, ladhe nèngu rage dhèu dhu madhutu j'ara mamuri yesus ètu nèi, bhèni-mone, nèngu kèpe ho èki si, sèna ka ère nèti hari si asa yerusalem.

source_text: and when he made his journey, it befelled, that he came nigh to damascus. and suddenly a light from heaven shone about him;
target_text: ropa sèmi nare sasuri koasa sèra, ka nèngu dènge angalai na lasi asa kota damsik. ropa oe dètu dènge kota èèna, cag'ag'a laa, saraa puru nèti dedha-liru sarimu nare saulus.

source_text: and he fell to the earth, and heard a voice saying to him, saul, saul, what persecutest or pursuest thou me?
target_text: ka na bèbhe rai la'e. hèia na tadèngi lii èci padhai lii dènge ne, peka na, saulus! saulus! nga tao ka èu paj'èra ja'a sèmi ne'e?

source_text: and he said, who art thou, lord? and he said, i am jesus of nazareth, whom thou persecutest or pursuest. it is hard to thee, to kick against the prick.
target_text: hèia saulus karèi, aku nèngu na, ama dhu padhai lii ne, cee ka èu? lii èèna, peka hari, ja'a ne, yesus, dhu èu paj'èra aae ne.

source_text: and he trembled, and wondered, and said, lord, what wilt thou that i do? and the lord said to him, rise up, and enter into the city, and it shall be said to thee, what it behooveth thee to do.
target_text: kèd'i, ho lamu asa d'ara kota. d'ai nèi, pe ja'a peka dènge èu, ngaa dhu èu hud'i tao.

source_text: and those men that went with him, stood astonied, or were made afeared, or out of mind; for they heard a voice, but they saw no man.
target_text: aa angalai nèngu sèra tadèngi kahèi lii èèna, te ngaa rèdhi boe cee-cee. dhèu se'e malaa, ka re'a heka padhai lii ngaa-ngaa.

source_text: and saul rose from the earth; and when his eyes were opened, he saw nothing. and they drew him by the hands, and led him into damascus.
target_text: hèia saulus kèd'i titu. ka na neo bhoke musi madha na, te ngaa nèdhi heka ngaa-ngaa. ka ra sarad'e rèti ne asa d'ara kota damsik.

source_text: and he was three days not seeing; and he ate not, neither drank.
target_text: ètu d'ara tèlu lod'o, na bisa boe nèdhi ngaa-ngaa. aa na'a-ninu boe ngaa-ngaa kahèi.

source_text: and a disciple, ananias by name, was at damascus. and the lord said to him in a vision, ananias. and he said, lo! i, lord.
target_text: ètu d'ara kota èèna, abhu dhèu unu lamatua yesus èci, ngara na ananias. lamatua mai pad'elo iisi dènge ne, sama sèmi tanila sa. na paroa, peka na, ananias! hèia ananias dhaa, peka na, oo, lamatua!

source_text: and the lord said to him, rise thou, and go into a street that is called rectus; and seek, in the house of judas, saul by name, of tarsus. for lo! he prayeth;
target_text: lamatua peka, na, nanene ku! èu lamu tenge ku dhèu unu ja'a èci. kako lamu asa j'ara èci, dhu ngara na j'ara mola. lamu asa èmu dhèu èci, ngara na yudas. ètu èèna, karèi rèngu dhèu èci nèti kota tarsus, ngara na saulus. dhèu èèna sabaj'a era.

source_text: and he saw a man, ananias by name, entering and laying on him hands, that he receive sight.
target_text: ja'a hia ne tanila kahèi, na, èèna na dhèu mone èci neo mai paraga dènge ne, nuka èu, ananias. de lamu ho bane ai èu mi nèngu, sèna ka na bisa nèdhi hari.

source_text: and ananias answered, lord, i have heard of many of this man, how great evil he did to thy saints in jerusalem;
target_text: te ngaa ananias b'ala, aku nèngu na, sèmi ne'e, lamatua! ji'i tadèngi le lii palolo lula-nèti dhèu èèna. nèngu èèna ka dhu paj'èra dhèu-dhèu unu lamatua ètu yerusalem. nèti èèna ka, dhèu bani heka bhodho baboro!

source_text: and this hath power of the princes of priests, to bind all men that call thy name to help.
target_text: limuri ne, ji'i tadèngi hari, peka na, kètu agama yahudi sèra hia ne koasa ho mai kèpa dhèu-dhèu dhu madhutu j'ara mamuri lamatua yesus.

source_text: and the lord said to him, go thou, for this is to me a vessel of choosing, that he bear my name before heathen men, and kings, and before the sons of israel.
target_text: te ngaa lamatua padhai lii hari dènge ananias, peka na, masi ka sèmi èèna, èu hud'i lamu ku! te ja'a hag'e kore nèngu le, ho na bhoke j'ara, sèna ka na lole lii lolo be'a ja'a hia dhèu kabarai leo sèra, hia dhèu aae-dhèu aae, dènge dhèu isra'el kahèi.

source_text: for i shall show to him, how great things it behooveth him to suffer for my name.
target_text: aa èèna na, ja'a pad'elo dènge ne, sèna ka nèngu ne'a mema j'aj'èra tasa mera mia ka dhu bèli-camèd'a nèngu pasae, lula nèngu madhutu ja'a.

source_text: and ananias went, and entered into the house; and laid on him his hands, and said, saul brother, the lord jesus sent me, that appeared to thee in the way, in which thou camest, that thou see, and be full-filled with the holy ghost.
target_text: tadèngi nare lii padhai lii lamatua, hèia ananias la'e ka maso asa èmu èèna. ka na bane ai na mi saulus, peka na, angalai saulus! lamatua yesus dhu pad'elo iisi mi èu ètu talora j'ara lod'o èu mai asa ne'e, nèngu èèna ka dhu pua ja'a mai paraga dènge èu ètu ne'e. na pua ja'a kahèi ho sabaj'a dènge tao kacui-aai mi dedha èu, sèna ka èu bisa mèdhi hari. aa na d'èi ho èu sèmi more roh na dhu mola-mèci.

source_text: and anon as the scales felled from his eyes, he received sight. and he rose, and was baptized.
target_text: cag'ag'a laa, saulus rasa ngaa èci bèbhe eele nèti musi madha nèngu, sèmi nai i'a. hèia na ladhe nèdhi hari. ka na kèd'i, aa ra sarani dènge ne.

source_text: and when he had taken meat, he was comforted. and he was by some days with the disciples, that were at damascus.
target_text: èle èèna ka, na na'a-ninu. ka na abhu hari a'èra. ka saulus pea hari dènge dhèu unu lamatua yesus pèri-pèri lod'o ètu kota damsik.

source_text: and anon, he entered into the synagogues, and preached the lord jesus, for this is the son of god.
target_text: aa la'e asa d'ara èmu manèngi-mangaj'i dhèu yahudi, ka na peka dènge si, aku nèngu na, mi nanene paie! mema yesus tare'a-re'a ana ama lamatua.

source_text: and all men that heard him, wondered, and said, whether this is not he that impugned in jerusalem them that called to help this name? and hither he came for this thing or hither for this thing he came, that he should lead them bound to the princes of priests?
target_text: ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra malaa dènge bingu, ropa ra tadèngi saulus padhai lii sèmi èèna. hèia ra papeka, aku rèngu na, nèngu ka dhu paj'èra dhèu unu yesus ètu yerusalem, sina ma? aa mamai ne, sèna ka na kèpe dhèu se'e ho nèti asa kètu agama yahudi sèra! na, tasamia ka ne?

source_text: but saul much the more or much more waxed strong, and confounded the jews that dwelled at damascus, and affirmed that this is christ.
target_text: te ngaa saulus padhai lii taruu, aku nèngu na, yesus èèna, nuka dhèu dhu ama lamatua moa nèti uru, ho pua na mai. saulus padhai lii dènge d'èlu-mèu aa d'ara adhu, toke dhèu yahudi sèra segi boe nèngu. nèti èèna ka, a'èra saulus asa tabha kapai.

source_text: and when many days were ful filled, jews made a counsel, that they should slay him.
target_text: nèbhu boe ka, dhèu yahudi sèra sanunu ho neo pamadhe ne.

source_text: and the ambushes of them were made known to saul. and they kept the gates day and night, that they should slay him.
target_text: te ngaa saulus ae nare ngangee aapa rèngu èèna, dhu peka na, ra mate ne mèu-mèda ètu hèb'a-hèb'a tebho kota, ho ra neo pamadhe ne.

source_text: but his disciples took him by night, and delivered him, and let him down in a basket by the wall.
target_text: ka ca tèka hari, d'ara mèda, angalai saulus pèri-pèri dhèu mai rare ne, ka ra papuru ne ètu d'ara kadhari cue, re karasa li'u tebho kota. dènge j'ara èèna ka, nèngu rai nèti kota damsik.

source_text: and when he came into jeru-salem, he assayed or attempted to join him to the disciples; and all dreaded him, and believed not that he was a disciple.
target_text: èle èèna ka, saulus la'e asa yerusalem. d'ai nèi, ka na neo pa'èci dènge dhèu unu lamatua yesus. te ngaa dhèu sèra madha'u dènge nèngu, lula ra pangee, na, nèngu dhoka sangaja di, j'aj'i dhèu parcaya dhu madhutu lamatua yesus. èle èèna na, nèngu kabèli hari ho neo kèpe rèngu.

source_text: but barnabas took, and led him to the apostles, and told to them, how in the way, he had seen the lord, and that he spake to him, and how in damascus he did trustily in the name of jesus.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu èci, ngara na barnabas, nèngu ka dhu nèti saulus ho patadhe mi dhèu pajuu-paleha lamatua ètu èèna. na lole ngaa dhu j'aj'i mi dedha saulus ètu talora j'ara. na peka, na, saulus paraga le dènge lamatua yesus kahèi. aa yesus padhai lii dènge nèngu kahèi. na lolo kahèi babani saulus padhai lii j'ara mamuri lamatua yesus mi dhèu damsik sèra.

source_text: and he was with them, and entered, and went out in jerusalem, and did trustily in the name of jesus.
target_text: ropa ra tadèngi rare barnabas peka sèmi èèna, heka ra sèmi rare saulus kèna. ka ra pea pa'èci ètu kota yerusalem. saulus bani lole lii lolo be'a lamatua yesus kahèi, sad'i dènge dhèu cee èèna ka. nèngu madha'u boe.

source_text: and he spake with heathen men, and disputed with greeks. and they sought to slay him.
target_text: na pakarèi dènge pèri-pèri dhèu yahudi dhu padhai lii yunani. te ngaa rèngu ro'o boe sèmi rare lii padhai lii nèngu. nèti èèna ka, ra tenge j'ara neo pamadhe ne.

source_text: which thing when the brethren had known, they led him by night to caesarea, and let him go to tarsus.
target_text: ropa dhèu unu lamatua yesus re'a ngangee karehe dhèu sèra, hèia lasi rare saulus rèti asa kota kaisarea. d'ai nèi, ka ra pua ne lèpa asa kota na, tarsus.

source_text: and the church by all judea, and galilee, and samaria, had peace, and was edified, and walked in the dread of the lord, and was full-filled with comfort of the holy ghost.
target_text: èle èèna ka, dhèu unu lamatua yesus ètu propensi yudea, propensi galilea, dènge propensi samaria, mamuri dènge mera-milu. rèngu asa tabha ae. rèngu mamuri madhutu dad'èi lamatua. ka roh lamatua dhu mola-mèci pa'èra d'ara rèngu.

source_text: and it befelled, that peter, the while he passed about all, came to the holy men that dwelled at lydda.
target_text: lod'o-lod'o sèra, petrus biasa kako palème asa mia-mia, ho pa'èra d'ara dhèu unu lamatua sèra. ca lod'o ka na la'e ngad'o rèngu ètu rae lida.

source_text: and he found there a man, aeneas by name, that from eight years he had lain bed-ridden; and he was sick in the palsy.
target_text: ètu nèi, na paraga dènge dhèu mone èci, ngara na eneas. dhèu ne, karuku aru tèu kèna, ka na kèd'i nare heka nèti era j'unu na.

source_text: and peter said to him, aeneas, the lord jesus christ heal thee; rise thou, and array, either make ready, thee. and anon he rose.
target_text: hèia petrus peka dènge ne, aku nèngu na, eneas! limuri ne, lamatua yesus kristus pa'èle èu. de kèd'i ka! lalau paie era j'unu èu! nanene nare sèmi èèna, hèia na kèd'i dènge ka.

source_text: and all men that dwelt at lydda, and at saron, saw him, which were converted to the lord.
target_text: ropa ladhe rèdhi eneas èle le, dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu rae lida dènge rae saron parcaya lamatua yesus.

source_text: and in joppa was a discipless, whose name was tabitha, that is to say, dorcas. this was full of good works and alms-deeds, that she did.
target_text: lod'o èèna, dhèu bhèni èci, ngara na tabita, pea dètu dènge nebhe dhasi ètu kota yope. madhutu lii yunani ra paroa bhèni ne, ngara na dorkas. sasoa na ‘rusa'. bhèni ne parcaya lamatua yesus. tatao bhèni ne be'a mi dedha dhèu leo, aa na tema laladhe dhèu j'èra.

source_text: and it befelled in those days, that she was sick, and died. and when they had washed her, they laid her in a solar.
target_text: lod'o èèna, tabita ne pèd'a aae, ka madhe. ka dhèu padiu ne èi. èle èèna ka, ra papake ne mèdha-papake, ka ra paj'unu ne ètu kama dedha.

source_text: and for lydda was nigh joppa, the disciples heard that peter was therein, and sent two men to him, and prayed, that thou tarry not to come to us.
target_text: lod'o èèna, dhèu se tadèngi, na, petrus ètu rae lida, dhu kaj'èu nèti kota yope, sèmi kako haga na ele boe ca'èta lod'o sa. ka ra pua dhèu dua lasi paroa petrus, peka na, ama! ji'i manèngi ama mai ku lai-lai asa kota yope.

source_text: and peter rose up, and came with them. and when he was come, they led him into the solar. and all the widows stood about him, weeping, and showing coats and clothes, which dorcas made to them.
target_text: tadèngi nare sèmi èèna, ka petrus kèd'i dènge ka, la'e madhutu rèngu. d'ai nèi, ka na maso taruu asa d'ara kama tabita. ètu d'ara kama na, pènu le dènge bhèni balu dhu mai tangi. bhèni balu sèra pad'elo mi petrus kodho dènge mèdha-papake leo, dhu dorkas j'au hia rèngu, lod'o na mamuri era.

source_text: and when all men were put with-outforth, peter kneeled, and prayed. and he turned to the body, and said, tabitha, arise thou. and she opened her eyes, and when she saw peter, she sat up.
target_text: hèia petrus pua si kalua nèti kama. ka na patitu urutuu ho na manèngi-mangaj'i. hèia na ladhe asa dhèu madhe ne, ka na padhai lii, peka na, tabita! kèd'i ka! cag'ag'a laa, tabita bhoke musi madha na. ropa ladhe nèdhi petrus, ka na kèd'i madhèdi.

source_text: and he took her by the hand, and raised her. and when he had called the holy men and widows, he assigned her alive.
target_text: hèia petrus kèpe kacui-aai na, ho hia ne titu. ka petrus paroa bhèni balu sèra dènge dhèu-dhèu leo ètu èèna, ho na hia bhèni dhu mamuri hari ne asa rèngu.

source_text: and it was made known by all joppa; and many believed in the lord.
target_text: ka lii lole ne, dhèu lolo palème d'ara kota yope, toke d'ai dhèu ae parcaya lamatua yesus.

source_text: and it was made, that many days he dwelled in joppa, at one simon, a currier or a tanner.
target_text: èle èèna ka, petrus pea pèri-pèri lod'o ètu èmu dhèu èci, ngara na simon. dhèu ne'e, tuka pamèu ka'uri badha.

source_text: a man was in caesarea, cornelius by name, a centurion of the company of knights, that is said of italy;
target_text: lod'o èèna, abhu komedhaa sordad'u roma dhèu èci, ngara na kornelis. nèngu ne, komedhaa nèti sordad'u cangasu dhèu. rèngu mai nèti kaj'èu, nèti rai italia, ka ra pea ètu kota kaisarea.

source_text: a religious man, and dreading the lord, with all his household; doing many alms to the people, and praying the lord evermore.
target_text: nèngu dènge isi èmu na d'èi padètu dènge ama lamatua. te ngaa ae ka dhèu roma leo sèmi boe èèna. nèngu biasa soru-bara dhèu j'èra, aa na maj'èni sabaj'a mi ama lamatua.

source_text: this saw in a vision openly, as in the ninth hour of the day, or noon, an angel of god entering in to him, and saying to him, cornelius.
target_text: ca lod'o hari, pe d'ara hake tèlu nihia sa, na abhu tanila. na ladhe nèdhi iia-iia ana pajuu ama lamatua èci puru mai nèti sorga, ka na paroa ne, peka na, kornelis!

source_text: and he beheld him, and was adread, and said, who art thou, lord? and he said to him, thy prayers and thine alms-deeds have gone up into mind, in the sight of the lord.
target_text: ropa kornelis ladhe nèdhi ana pajuu nèti sorga, ka na madha'u titu kèna. hèia na karèi, aku nèngu na, tasamia, ama? ka ana pajuu ne dhaa, na, lamatua tadèngi le lii manèngi-mangaj'i èu, aa na ne'a le d'ara hua iia èu mi dedha dhèu leo. ka na sanèd'e èu.

source_text: and now send thou men into joppa, and call one simon, that is named peter.
target_text: de pua dhèu lasi asa kota yope, ho paroa rèti dhèu èci, ngara na simon petrus.

source_text: this is harboured at a man, simon, currier, or tanner, whose house is beside the sea. this shall say to thee, what it behooveth thee to do.
target_text: dhèu èèna manubha ètu èmu cue ètu sebhe dhasi, unu simon, tuka pamèu ka'uri badha.

source_text: and when the angel that spake to him, was gone away or had gone away, he called two men of his house, and a knight that dreaded the lord, which were at his bidding or that obeyed to him.
target_text: ropa ana pajuu nèti sorga ne tèke eele kornelis, ka na paroa ana sab'a na dhèu dua, dènge sordad'u èci dhu d'èi padètu dènge lamatua kahèi.

source_text: and when he had told to them all these things, he sent them into joppa.
target_text: kornelis lolo aa'i ngaa dhu nèngu nèdhi èèna, ka na pua si lasi asa kota yope.

source_text: and on the day pursuing, while they made journey, and nighed to the city, peter went up into the highest place of the house to pray, about the sixth hour.
target_text: ka asa bèli èèna, pe d'ara lod'o titu mera sa, dhèu paleha nèti kornelis sèra oe d'ai le yope. lod'o èèna, petrus ca'e la'e neo manèngi-mangaj'i asa kalaga dedha èmu simon.

source_text: and when he was hungered, he would have eaten. but while they made ready, a ravishing of the spirit or an excess of soul felled on him;
target_text: ropa na manèngi-mangaj'i, na rasa manganga. na mate dhèu lalau nganga'a-nginu. ropa nèngu manèngi-mangaj'i era, na abhu tanila kahèi.

source_text: and he saw heaven opened, and a vessel coming down, as a great sheet with four corners or with four cords, to be let down from heaven into earth,
target_text: na nèdhi sèmi liru bhoka. ka hahèla-koi bhèla aae ca bèla puru mai, dhu èki re suu-suu èpa na.

source_text: in which were all four-footed beasts, and creeping things of the earth, and volatiles of heaven, either of the air.
target_text: ètu d'ara hahèla-koi èèna, nèngu ladhe nèdhi rupa-rupa badha, nuka badha ai èpa, badha rod'o-kakara, dènge rupa-rupa manu-bhui kahèi.

source_text: and a voice was made to him, rise thou, peter, and slay, and eat.
target_text: hèia na tadèngi lii èci pua ne, petrus! kèd'i ka! kèj'i badha se, ho mu'a!

source_text: and peter said, lord, forbid it, for i never eat any common thing, and unclean.
target_text: te ngaa petrus dhaa, aku nèngu na, bisa boe, ama! baku sèmi èèna! te ja'a ku'a kèdhi mèka sisi badha sèmi se'e! ji'i dhèu yahudi luri sisi badha se'e aa'i-aa'i ra!

source_text: and again the second time the voice was made to him, that thing that god hath cleansed, say thou not unclean.
target_text: te ngaa lii ne b'ala hari, peka na, ladhe ama lamatua peka mèdha ngaa dhu mèu, èu baku peka kaj'alu!

source_text: and this thing was done by thrice; and anon the vessel was received again into heaven.
target_text: hahèla-koi èèna cèu tèlu hari, èle èèna ka ca'e hari asa dedha-liru la'e.

source_text: and while that peter doubted within himself, what the vision was that he saw, lo! the men, that were sent from cornelius, sought the house of simon, and stood at the gate.
target_text: hèia petrus pajiko la'e-mai sasoa tanila deo na. kabèdhi laa, ana paleha kornelis sèra d'ai madha èmu simon. ra titu ètu hèb'a èmu.

source_text: and when they had called, they asked if simon, that is named peter, had there harbour.
target_text: ka ra lii, peka na, ji'i tenge dhèu èci dhu manubha ètu èmu ne'e. ngara na, simon petrus. ele boe ama tadhe, do?

source_text: and while peter thought on the vision, the spirit said to him, lo! three men seek thee.
target_text: ropa petrus pajiko sasoa tanila na era. ka roh lamatua dhu mola-mèci peka dènge ne, petrus. dhèu mate èu ka haha si.

source_text: therefore rise thou, and go down, and go with them, and doubt thou nothing, for i sent them.
target_text: de puru ho lamu ka dènge si. èu baku mage-mage ia ka. masi ka ad'a yahudi aj'a, na, dhèu yahudi hud'i madenge dènge dhèu leo, te ngaa èu baku madenge dènge rèngu, lula ja'a ka dhu pua rèngu mai rare èu.

source_text: and peter came down to the men, and said, lo! i am, whom ye seek; what is the cause, for which ye be come? or ye have come?
target_text: ka petrus puru la'e paraga dènge dhèu sèra. hèia na peka, aku nèngu na, ja'a ne'e ka dhu miu tenge. de miu parluu ngaa?

source_text: and they said, cornelius, the centurion, a just man, and dreading god, and having good witnessing of all the folk of jews, took answer of an holy angel, to call thee into his house, and to hear words of thee.
target_text: ka ra dhaa, aku rèngu na, komedhaa sordad'u roma èci pua ji'i mai asa ne'e. nèngu èèna, komedhaa nèti cangasu sordad'u. dhèu ne d'ara mola, aa na d'èi padètu dènge ama lamatua. dhèu yahudi ae dhu re'a le babe'a dhèu ne'e. med'a na, heka ana pajuu ama lamatua puru mai nèti sorga, ho pua lamatua ji'i manèngi èu lamu asa èmu na, ho na neo nanene unu na nèti èu.

source_text: therefore he led them in, and received in harbour; and that night they dwelled with him. and in the day pursuing he rose, and went forth with them; and some of the brethren followed him from joppa or some of brethren from joppa followed him, that they be witnesses to peter.
target_text: ropa tadèngi nare sèmi èèna, hèia petrus manèngi rèngu ho j'unu taha mèda ne ètu èèna. bèli mad'ae èèna, ra pakèd'i, lasi palere. dhèu unu lamatua yesus pèri-pèri nèti yope lasi kahèi.

source_text: and the tother day, he entered into caesarea. and cornelius abode them, with his cousins, and necessary friends, that were called together.
target_text: mèda èèna rèngu j'unu ètu j'ara. bèli èèna, heka rèngu d'ai kota kaisarea kèna. ropa rèngu d'ai, kornelis mate mema rèngu. na pakaboko nare le a'ari na dènge mone-aanga angalai na ètu èmu nèngu.

source_text: and it was done, when peter was come in or when peter had entered, cornelius came meeting him, and fell down at his feet, and worshipped him.
target_text: ropa petrus d'ai hèb'a èmu, kornelis mai soru ne, ka madhèdi patitu kètu urutuu ètu haga petrus, ho na pahaha iisi.

source_text: but peter raised him, and said, arise thou, also i myself am a man, as thou.
target_text: te ngaa petrus pakèd'i ne, peka na, ama! baku sèmi èèna! baku pahaha iisi mi ja'a. te ja'a ne, dhèu rai-haha sama sèmi èu kahèi.

source_text: and he spake with him, and went in, and found many that were come together.
target_text: ropa tadèngi nare sèmi èèna, kornelis kèd'i titu dènge. ka dua ra padhai lii, kako lasi asa d'ara èmu. d'ai d'ara èmu, petrus nèdhi dhèu ae pakaboko mate nèngu.

source_text: and he said to them, ye know, how abominable it is to a jew, to be joined either to come to an alien; but god showed to me, that no man say a man common, either unclean.
target_text: na ladhe palème dhèu sèra, ka na padhai lii, peka na, a'ari aa'i-aa'i mi! miu me'a mema ad'a ji'i dhèu yahudi. madhutu ad'a ji'i, na, ji'i bisa boe pa'èci dènge dhèu leo. ngaa hari, maso asa d'ara èmu ra. te ngaa ama lamatua pad'elo le dènge ja'a, ladhe mèdha ngaa dhu nèngu peka na mèu, ja'a baku peka na mèdha èèna kaj'alu. de limuri ne, ja'a madenge heka dènge dhèu leo. ja'a hud'i tao dhèu leo sama sèmi a'ari ja'a kahèi.

source_text: for which thing i came, when i was called, without doubting. there-fore i ask you, for what cause have ye called me?
target_text: nèti èèna ka, lod'o miu lami paroa, ka ja'a mai dènge. ja'a pamata heka, lula lamatua peka nare le dènge ja'a sèmi èèna. miu peka ku laa. miu parluu ngaa nèti ja'a?

source_text: and cornelius said, today, four days into this hour or from the fourth day passed till to this hour, i was praying and fasting in the ninth hour in mine house. and lo! a man stood before me in a white cloth,
target_text: hèia kornelis lole aa'i mèu-mèu, aku nèngu na, èpa lod'o dhu la'e èèna, ropa lod'o nihia, ja'a manèngi-mangaj'i ètu èmu ja'a. cag'ag'a laa, dhèu mone èci titu ètu madha ja'a. mèdha-papake na heo loa-loa.

source_text: and said, cornelius, thy prayer is heard, and thine alms-deeds be in mind in the sight of god.
target_text: ka na paroa ja'a, aku nèngu na, ‘kornelis! lamatua tadèngi le lii manèngi èu, aa na ne'a le d'ara hua iia èu mi dedha dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: therefore send thou into joppa, and call simon, that is named peter; this is harboured in the house of simon currier, beside the sea. this, when he shall come, shall speak to thee.
