source_text: and he also endeavoured to defoul the temple; whom also we took, and would deem after our law.
target_text: dhèu ne'e ne, neo pakaj'alu èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i ji'i dhu mola-mèci èèna. aa nèti dènge dhèu dintiu asa d'ara la'e. nèti èèna ka, ji'i kèpe ngare ne. madhutu dad'èi ji'i, ji'i neo huku ne, pake atora ji'i unu mi.

source_text: but lysias, the tribune, came above with great strength, and delivered him from or out of our hands;
target_text: te ngaa komedhaa lisias mai ère nare ne nèti kacui-aai ji'i.

source_text: and commanded his accusers to come to thee, of whom thou deem-ing, mayest know of all these things, of which we accuse him.
target_text: hèia na paredha, peka na, ladhe abhu dhèu dhu neo tao lii langu dènge paulus, hud'i lasi ku asa madha ama gubernur ètu kaisarea. madhutu dad'èi na, sèna ka ama gubernur unu mu ka dhu uri lii èèna. ka limuri ne, ji'i mai asa ne'e, sèna ka ama parisa lii ne. pe èèna na, ama unu mu me'a ngaa dhu ji'i lole ne, mema lèke tare'a-re'a. d'ai sange èèna ka. makasi ae.

source_text: and jews put to, and said, that these things had them so.
target_text: ropa tertulus padhai lii nare, ka dhèu yahudi leo sèra, re lii padhai lii na kahèi, aku rèngu na, tare'a, ama! dhu lèke kèna!

source_text: and paul answered, when the president granted him to say, of many years i know thee, that thou art doomsman to this folk, and i shall do enough for me with good reason.
target_text: hèia gubernur paredha paulus, aku nèngu na, ne'e ne, ja'a hia èu tebho ho siri iisi èu. hèia paulus kèd'i titu, ka na ded'e lii padhai, aku nèngu na, ama gubernur! ama paredha nèbhu le ètu propensi ji'i ne. de ama dhu me'a le tare'a-re'a, j'ara mamuri ji'i dhèu yahudi, tasa mera mia. nèti èèna ka, ja'a madha'u boe siri iisi ètu katanga madha ama.

source_text: for thou mayest know, for to me be not more or no more than twelve days, since i came up to worship in jerusalem;
target_text: pe d'ai canguru dua lod'o dhu la'e èèna, ja'a laku asa yerusalem ho sabaj'a ètu d'ara èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. ama bisa karèi sèku dhèu-dhèu dhu sabaj'a sama-sama dènge ja'a lod'o èèna.

source_text: and neither in the temple they found me disputing with any man, neither making concourse of the people, neither in the synagogues, neither in city;
target_text: ètu d'ara èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i, ja'a pab'ala boe dènge ca dhèu sa. aa ètu d'ara èmu sabaj'a dhu leo sèra kahèi, ja'a oru kore boe dhèu ho tao maruru. sèmi èèna kahèi, ètu yerusalem, ja'a pakaco boe.

source_text: neither they may prove to thee, of the which things they now accuse me.
target_text: te ngaa limuri ne, dhèu se neo pamanahu ja'a. ngaa dhu ra padhai lii deo sa, lèke boe, lula dènge boe bukti.

source_text: but i acknowledge to thee this thing, that after the sect which they say heresy, so i serve to god the father, believing to all things that be written in the law and prophets;
target_text: sèmi ne'e ka, ama gubernur. ja'a hud'i mangaku ku mi ama, ngaa èci. ja'a dhu madhutu partei hiu èci, dhu dhèu pangare na ‘j'ara mamuri lamatua yesus'. ja'a sabaj'a mi ama lamatua, sama sèmi bèi-baki ja'a sèra sabaj'a mi nèngu. ja'a madhutu kahèi atora aa'i-aa'i nèti baki musa, dènge parcaya tare'a-re'a ngaa dhu dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua uru-uru sèra, suri tèke hia ji'i.

source_text: and i have hope in god, which also they themselves abide, the again-rising to coming or to come of just men and wicked.
target_text: ja'a sanao-maena mi ama lamatua, sama sèmi rèngu dhu titu ètu se'e se, ho ra lab'a ja'a ne. ji'i se parcaya, na, bèli-camèd'a ama lamatua pamamuri hari dhèu madhe: dhèu be'a, do bhelu-katub'a, èci èèna ka.

source_text: in this thing i study without hurting, to have conscience to god, and to men evermore.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ja'a ma'ète boe tenge j'ara, sèna ka ja'a bisa mamuri dènge d'ara mola ètu katanga madha ama lamatua, aa dhèu rai-haha kahèi. dènge sèmi èèna ka, dhèu èci sa bisa boe pamanahu ja'a.

source_text: but after many years, i came to do alms-deeds to my folk, and offerings, and avows or vows;
target_text: ja'a sab'a pèri-pèri tèu kèna, ètu li'u rai isra'el, ka ja'a heka lèpa asa yerusalem kèna. lod'o ja'a mai èèna, ja'a kèti doi dhu dhèu pakaboko sèna ka bantu dhèu-dhèu ji'i dhu mamuri j'èra. èle ka, ja'a laku asa èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i ho neo sabaj'a, aa hia korban rupa-rupa mi ama lamatua ètu èèna.

source_text: in which they found me purified in the temple, not with company, neither with noise. and they caught me, and they cried, and said, take away our enemy. and some jews of asia,
target_text: ropa ja'a pamèu iisi ètu d'ara èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i madhutu j'ara ad'a ji'i, ka rèngu mai ho neo kèpe ja'a. te ngaa lod'o èèna, dhèu ae boe ètu sèra, aa èci sa dhu tao pakaco boe ngaa-ngaa!

source_text: which or whom it behooved to be now present at thee, and accuse, if they had anything against me,
target_text: dhu ètu èèna, dhoka pèri-pèri dhèu yahudi nèti propensi asia, dhu mai neo sabaj'a ètu èèna kahèi. de ladhe rèngu sèi dhu neo tao lii langu dènge ja'a, rèngu sèra ka dhu hud'i mai tao lii langu dènge ja'a ku ètu ne'e. ama se'e se, aad'o!

source_text: either these themselves say, if they found in me anything of wicked-ness, since i stand in the council,
target_text: te ngaa dhèu sèi cèu boe. de ama karèi ku si, sasala ja'a ngaa? uru èèna, lod'o rèngu parisa lii ja'a ètu era parisa lii langu agama èèna, rèngu abhu boe sasala ja'a èci sa hèi. de ama ku karèi sèku rèngu!

source_text: but only of this one voice, by which i cried standing among them, for of the again-rising of dead men i am deemed this day of you.
target_text: dhoka ele boe ca j'ara di, dhu tao ngangee rèngu kaco, aa ra d'èi boe ja'a. ropa ja'a padhai lii dènge lii aae, peka na, ‘miu neo huku ja'a, lula ja'a parcaya, na, ama lamatua bisa pamamuri hari dhèu madhe! '

source_text: soothly felix delayed or deferred them, and knew most certainly of the way, and said, when lysias, the tribune, shall come down, i shall hear you.
target_text: paulus padhai lii sèmi èèna, te ngaa, lula gubernur feliks tadèngi ae le kahèi lula-nèti ‘j'ara mamuri lamatua yesus', ka na katange eele sidang èèna, ka na peka, aku nèngu na, sèmi ne'e ka! ja'a neo paroa komedhaa lisias, ho nanene uuru ku lii lolo nèngu. ladhe ja'a padhai lii kore ku dènge nèngu, heka ja'a pama'ète lii ne'e kèna.

source_text: and he commanded to a centurion to keep him, and that he had rest or to have rest, neither to forbid any man to minister of his own things to him.
target_text: ka na pua ama sordad'u ca dhèu la'e taha paulus. te ngaa na paredha, sèna ka ako hia ne bebas ciki, aa baku kai mone-aanga angalai na sèra mai lalau ne.

source_text: and after some days felix came, with drusilla his wife, that was a jewess, and called paul, and heard of him the faith that is in christ jesus.
target_text: dhèu èmu gubernur feliks, dhèu yahudi, ngara na dorsila. pèri-pèri lod'o dhu la'e èèna, gubernur tenge lod'o dhu hua iia, sèna ka nèngu dènge dhèu èmu na neo padhai lii dènge paulus. ka na pua sèna ka dhèu rèti ne mai asa madha rèngu dua ra. hèia paulus lole dènge ra, j'ara tasamia sèna ka dhèu bisa parcaya yesus kristus, dhèu dhu lamatua moa nèti uru ka mai.

source_text: and while he disputed of right-wiseness, and chastity, and of doom to coming or to come, felix was made trembling, and answered, that pertaineth now, go; but in time covenable, i shall call thee.
target_text: na peka kahèi j'ara tasamia ho dhèu bisa muri mola, aa tasamia ho dhèu bisa j'aga ngi'u, sèna ka baku tao sala. na lole kahèi, bèli-camèd'a ama lamatua pama'ète lii langu mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra, peka na, lèke, do sala. ropa feliks tadèngi nare sèmi èèna, ka na madha'u. hèia na peka, aku nèngu na, paulus! d'ai sange èèna ka laa! ladhe abhu lod'o taleo, na, ja'a paroa hari èu.

source_text: also he hoped, that money should be given to him of paul; for which thing again or oft he called him, and spake with him.
target_text: lod'o èèna, gubernur feliks tenge-tenge j'ara, sèna ka paulus palèke ne doi, ho na patabuli eele ne. nèti èèna ka, na paroa taruu paulus, ho padhai lii dènge ne.

source_text: and when two years were ful-filled, felix took a successor, porcius festus; and felix would or willing to give grace to the jews, and left paul bound.
target_text: te ngaa re j'ara leo, gubernur feliks neo ère d'ara kètu agama yahudi sèra kahèi. nèti èèna ka, na pama'ète boe lai-lai lii paulus ne'e. na soro tèke lii ne'e sène, toke d'ai dua tèu. èle èèna ka, abhu dhèu hiu dhu gati eele gubernur feliks. ngara na porkius festus. te ngaa rèngu taha taruu paulus.

source_text: therefore when festus came into the province, after the third day he went up to jerusalem from caesarea.
target_text: lod'o èèna, gubernur hiu, festus, pidha asa kaisarea, ho neo pakako paredha na. nèngu pea ètu èèna dhoka tèlu lod'o di, ka na la'e taruu asa yerusalem.

source_text: and the princes of priests, and the worthiest or the first of the jews went to him against paul, and prayed him,
target_text: ètu nèi, kètu agama yahudi, dènge dhèu heka-dhèu heka ad'a yahudi sèra, mai paraga sèna ka neo patadha dènge gubernur hiu ne. rèngu rèti kahèi dènge lii galaa rèngu mi paulus ètu d'ara lii padhue-padhai rèngu.

source_text: and asked grace against him, that he should command him to be led to jerusalem; and they set ambush to slay him in the way.
target_text: ra manèngi kahèi, ladhe bisa, na, gubernur pua dhèu nèngu sèra, rèti hari paulus ho lèpa asa yerusalem. te ngaa rèngu pare'a lii, neo pamadhe paulus ètu talora j'ara.

source_text: but festus answered, that paul should be kept in caesarea; soothly that he himself should proceed more advisedly or hastily.
target_text: te ngaa gubernur dhaa, aku nèngu na, sèmi ne'e ku, ama-ama! hud'i laa ra taha ne ètu kaisarea. te ja'a neo lèpa asa nèi d'ara lai-lai ne.

source_text: therefore he said, they that in you be mighty, come down together; and if any crime is in the man, accuse they him.
target_text: de ladhe nèti miu dhu abhu koasa ho uri lii langu ne, na, rèngu pakèd'i palere dènge ja'a asa kaisarea. ladhe tare'a dhèu ne'e tao sala ngaa, miu bisa tao lii dènge ne ètu nèi.

source_text: and he dwelled among them no more than eight either ten days, and came down to caesarea; and the tother day he sat for doomsman, and commanded paul to be brought. and when he was brought forth, jews stood about him, which came down from jerusalem, putting against him many and grievous causes, which they might not prove.
target_text: èle èèna ka, festus pea pe d'ai canguru lod'o sa ètu yerusalem, heka na lèpa asa kaisarea kèna. lod'o èèna, abhu pèri-pèri dhèu yahudi dhu madhutu dènge nèngu, d'ai nèi. asa bèli èèna, hèia gubernur mulai parisa lii langu èèna. ka na pua dhèu lasi rare paulus mai asa madha na. ropa paulus maso asa èèna, dhèu yahudi se kèd'i titu rai-reo rare ne, ka ra mulai core sasala ae-ae mi nèngu. te ngaa rèngu bisa boe pad'elo bukti èci sa hèi.

source_text: for paul yielded reason in all things, that neither against the law of jews, neither against the temple, neither against the emperor or caesar, i sinned anything.
target_text: hèia paulus siri iisi na, aku nèngu na, ama gubernur. ja'a tao boe ngaa-ngaa dhu nèti bhabhelu-katub'a. ja'a tao boe kahèi j'ara èci sa dhu palab'a dènge agama yahudi ji'i. ja'a pakaj'alu boe èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i ama lamatua ètu yerusalem. aa ja'a tao boe kahèi ngaa-ngaa dhu palab'a dènge j'ara-j'ara paredha roma.

source_text: but festus would do grace or willing to give grace to the jews, and answered to paul, and said, wilt thou go up to jerusalem, and there be deemed of these things before me?
target_text: te ngaa lula gubernur neo nare d'ara dhèu yahudi sèra, ka na karèi paulus, aku nèngu na, èu ngee tasamia? èu mo'o, do aad'o, ladhe ja'a uri lii langu èu ne ètu yerusalem?

source_text: and paul said, at the doom place of the emperor or of caesar i stand, where it behooveth me to be deemed. i have not annoyed the jews, as thou knowest well.
target_text: ropa tadèngi lii karèi gubernur sèmi èèna, hèia paulus dhaa, aku nèngu na, ama gubernur. ja'a ne, ana kabarai roma. ka limuri ne, ja'a titu ètu madha ama gubernur, dhèu paredha roma, dhu dènge hak ho parisa lii langu ja'a madhutu atora. de ja'a ko'o boe laku asa yerusalem, ho pama'ète lii ja'a ètu nèi. ama dhu me'a unu mu, peka na, ja'a ne tao boe sala ngaa-ngaa ho lab'a dhèu yahudi se'e.

source_text: for if i have annoyed, either done anything worthy death, i forsake not to die; but if nothing of those is, that they accuse me, no man may give me to them. i appeal to the emperor or to caesar.
target_text: de ladhe tare'a-re'a ja'a tao sala ngaa-ngaa dhu palèke dènge huku mamadhe, ja'a sèmi kore. te ngaa ladhe ngaa dhu rèngu peka na, lèke boe madhutu atora roma, na, abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu soro ja'a asa d'ara adhe-aai dhèu se'e. rèngu dhodhoka tenge j'ara di, sèna ka neo pamadhe ja'a. de madhutu hak ja'a, ja'a manèngi sèna ka lii langu ja'a ne hia asa dhèu aae kapai, keser, ètu kota roma. hud'i nèngu unu ku j'ue lii ja'a ne!

source_text: then festus spake with the coun-cil, and answered, to the emperor or to caesar thou hast appealed, to the emperor or to caesar thou shalt go.
target_text: ropa tadèngi paulus manèngi sèmi èèna, ka gubernur padhue-padhai dènge anga na dhu madhutu uri lii langu èèna. èle èèna ka, na peka dènge paulus, aku nèngu na, lula èu manèngi le ca'e banding asa dhèu aae kapai, de èu hud'i lamu ku asa roma. peka èle sèmi èèna ka, gubernur katange eele sidang èèna.

source_text: and when some days were passed, agrippa king, and bernice came down to caesarea, to welcome or to greet festus.
target_text: èle èèna ka, dhèu aae dhèu yahudi, ngara na agripa, dènge ana hèni na, ngara bernike, mai asa kaisarea. rèngu dua ra mai sèna ka hia hormat mi gubernur hiu.

source_text: and when they dwelled there many days, festus showed to the king of paul, and said, a man is left bound of felix,
target_text: rèngu manubha pèri-pèri lod'o dènge gubernur festus. ca tèka, festus lole lii langu paulus dènge rèngu dua ra. ka na peka, aku nèngu na, ama dhèu aae! ètu kaisarea ne'e, ji'i taha dhèu èci, ngara na paulus. uru èèna, gubernur dhui abhu boe lod'o ho pama'ète lii langu na.

source_text: of which, when i was at jeru-salem, princes of priests, and the elder men of the jews came to me, and asked damnation against him.
target_text: d'ara lai-lai ne, lod'o ja'a ètu yerusalem, kètu agama yahudi dènge dhèu heka d'ara rai sèra, mai galaa sasala paulus, ka ra manèngi ja'a sèna ka huku mema ka.

source_text: to whom i answered, that it is not custom to romans, to damn any man, before that he that is accused have his accusers present, and take place of defending, to put away the crimes, that be put against him.
target_text: te ngaa ja'a peka dènge rèngu, aku ja'a na, ‘madhutu atora paredha roma, ja'a hud'i parisa uru ku lii langu, heka hia huku kèna. aa dhèu dhu tao lii langu sèra, hud'i mai patoo madha dènge madha kahèi. sèna ka ja'a neo tadèngi ku sasala ngaa dhu miu pasale ne. aa nèngu kahèi abhu tebho sèna ka siri iisi na. dènge j'ara sèmi èèna ka, ja'a heka pama'ète lii langu na, ladhe na sala, ja'a huku ne. '

source_text: therefore when they came together hither, without any delay, in the day pursuing i sat for doomsman, and commanded the man to be brought.
target_text: lod'o ja'a lèpa asa kaisarea, abhu pèri-pèri dhèu yahudi dhu palere dènge ja'a asa ne'e. asa bèli èèna, ja'a parisa dènge lii ne. ka ja'a hia rèti paulus mai asa madha ja'a, sèna ka ja'a neo nanene j'aj'aj'i lii langu ne tasa mera mia.

source_text: and when his accusers stood nigh, they said no cause of which things i had suspicion of evil.
target_text: hèia dhèu-dhèu yahudi se titu, ho ra lolo sasala paulus èci-èci. te ngaa, ngaa dhu ra peka sèra bia boe sèmi dhu ja'a ngee.

source_text: but they had against him some questions of their vain worshipping, or religion, and of one jesus dead, whom paul affirmed to live.
target_text: rèngu se dhodhoka patasala ètu j'ara-j'ara agama rèngu di. te rèngu pab'ala dènge paulus, lula-nèti dhèu èci, ngara na yesus. madhutu rare'a dhèu yahudi, yesus èèna, madhe le. te ngaa paulus dènge èra, peka na, yesus mamuri hari le.

source_text: and i doubted of such manner questions, and said, whether he would go to jerusalem, and there be deemed of these things?
target_text: rèngu pasisu sèmi èèna, te ngaa, lula ja'a ne dhèu hiu, ka ja'a ke'a mèka uri lii agama ne, tasamia. nèti èèna ka, ja'a karèi paulus, peka na, ‘tasamia ladhe ja'a parisa lii langu èu ne ètu yerusalem nèi? '

source_text: but for paul appealed, that he should be kept to the knowing of the emperor or of caesar, i commanded him to be kept, till i send him to the emperor or to caesar.
target_text: te ngaa na sèmi nare boe. nèti èèna ka, na manèngi ca'e asa paredha dedha mi dhèu aae kapai ètu roma. ka ja'a patabuli boe ne, mate ja'a abhu lod'o ho rèti ne la'e asa roma.

source_text: and agrippa said to festus, i myself would hear the man. and he said, tomorrow thou shalt hear him.
target_text: ropa tadèngi lii lolo festus sèmi èèna, hèia dhèu aae agripa peka, aku nèngu na, be'a risi ja'a neo tadèngi unu ku, nèti dhèu èèna. hèia festus dhaa, na, bisa! bèli ku, pe ja'a uri ho ama nanene unu mu nèti dhèu èèna.

source_text: and on the tother day, when agrippa and bernice came with great desire, or pride of state, and entered into the auditorium, with tribunes and the principal men of the city, when festus bade, paul was brought.
target_text: d'ai bèli èèna, gubernur festus uri ho dhèu aae agripa bisa nanene lii padhai paulus. na uri kahèi, sèna ka dhèu ae nanene paulus. nuka: komedhaa-komedhaa sordad'u, dènge dhèu-dhèu kapai ètu kota kaisarea. èle èèna ka, dhèu aae agripa dènge bernike maso dènge mèdha-papake dhèu aae. ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i sèra pakab'ua si. ropa rèngu pakaboko tesa-tesa le, hèia gubernur pua rèti paulus asa d'ara.

source_text: and festus said, king agrippa, and all men that be with us, ye see this man, of which all the multitude of jews prayed me at jerusalem, and asked, and cried, that he should live no longer.
target_text: hèia ra rèti paulus asa d'ara la'e. ka gubernur bhoka hèb'a, peka na, ama dhèu aae agripa, ama-ama, dènge miu tamu aa'i-aa'i mi dhu ja'a pakab'ua. dhèu ne'e ne, ngara na paulus. pèri-pèri ama dhèu yahudi sèra tao lii langu dènge ne. ka abhu dhu mai asa ja'a, rèngu cahag'e nèti yerusalem, aa cahag'e nèti era ne'e, mai laka-seti ja'a, peka na, dhèu ne'e ne, bisa heka hia ne mamuri.

source_text: but i found, that he had done nothing worthy of death; and i deemed to send him to the emperor or to caesar, for he appealed this thing.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ja'a parisa ne. te ngaa ja'a abhu boe sasala dhu pamèci dènge huku madhe. te ngaa, lula nèngu unu na dhu manèngi le, ca'e asa paredha dedha ètu roma, nèti èèna ka, to'o do to'o boe, ja'a hud'i hia rèti ne ku la'e asa roma.

source_text: of which man i have not certain, what thing i shall write to the lord. for which thing i brought him to you, and mostly to thee, thou king agrippa or o king agrippa, that when asking is made, i have what i shall write. for it is seen to me without reason, to send a bound man, and not to signify the cause of him.
target_text: ladhe ja'a hia lere rèti ne, ja'a hud'i ku tao sasuri. te ngaa deo ne'e ne, ja'a suri sasuri ne tasamia, hia mi dhèu aae kapai nèi? de nèti èèna ka, ja'a pakaboko ama-ama aa'i-aa'i, sèna ka miu nanene lii langu na. ropa tadèngi mere lii na, ja'a manèngi sèna ka ama dhèu aae agripa, nori ja'a, sèna ka ja'a bisa suri ngaa dhu palèke dènge ngangee dhèu aae kapai nèi. ja'a ngee, na, lèke boe ladhe ja'a pa'adhu lii langu ne asa dhèu aae kapai la'e, te ngaa peka boe sasala dhu dhèu ne ad'u-ue. d'ai sange ne'e ka, lii padhai lii ja'a. makasi!

source_text: and agrippa said to paul, it is suffered to thee, to speak for thyself. then paul held forth the hand, and began to yield reason.
target_text: hèia dhèu aae agripa pua paulus, aku nèngu na, ne'e ne, èu bisa siri iisi èu. ji'i aa'i mi mate le neo nanene èu. ka paulus tao tadha dènge kacui-aai na, hèia na padhai lii, aku nèngu na,

source_text: of all things, in which i am accused of the jews, thou king agrippa, i guess me blessed at thee, when i shall defend me this day;
target_text: ama dhèu aae agripa dhu ja'a pakab'ua. ja'a rasa oto, lula ama hia ja'a tebho sèna ka ja'a padhai lii dènge miu, j'ara aa'i-aa'i dhu dhèu yahudi se galaa mi ja'a.

source_text: mostly for thou knowest all things that be among jews, customs and questions. for which thing, i beseech, hear me patiently.
target_text: ja'a ke'a, na, ama me'a risi eele ad'a èdhi dhèu yahudi, dènge j'ara madhe-muri èdhi. de ja'a manèngi ho ama nanene paie ku lii ja'a ne.

source_text: for all jews that before knew me from the beginning, know my life from youth;
target_text: karèi nèti ana iiki ka mai, ra aj'a-nori le ja'a, sèna ka mamuri madhutu ad'a èdhi dhèu yahudi. uru èèna, ra aj'a ja'a ètu rae. èle èèna ka, ja'a sakola tabha hari ètu yerusalem. dhèu yahudi ètu yerusalem sèra re'a le j'ara mamuri dènge tatao ja'a.

source_text: that from the beginning was in my folk in jerusalem, if they will bear witnessing or bear witness, that by the most certain sect of our religion, i lived a pharisee.
target_text: ladhe kètu agama se ro'o, rèngu bisa lolo, peka na, rèngu se ka dhu tadhe le ja'a karèi nèti uru èèna ka. te ja'a ne maso partei agama parisi kahèi. dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra re'a, na, ji'i dhèu parisi se, dhu kèpe pa'èra aa madhutu atora aa'i-aa'i nèti agama yahudi.

source_text: and now for the hope of repromission, that is made to our fathers of god, i stand subject in doom; in which hope our twelve lineages, serving night and day hope to come; of which hope, sir king, i am accused of the jews. what unbelieveful thing is deemed at you, if god raiseth dead men?
target_text: ja'a dènge dhèu aa'i-aa'i nèti canguru dua suku isra'el, mate tae-tae ho ama lamatua tao madhutu lii moa na. lii moa èèna, dhu na peka tèke le dènge bèi-baki èdhi karèi nèti uru ka. ka toke d'ai sange ne'e, èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti manèngi-mangaj'i mèu-mèda, sèna ka lii moa lamatua èèna j'aj'i ka. isi lii moa èèna, peka na, èèna na nèngu neo pamamuri hari dhèu dhu madhe sèra. ama dhèu aae agripa dhu ja'a pakab'ua. lula ja'a parcaya, peka na, èèna na lamatua pamamuri hari dhèu madhe, nèti èèna ka, rèngu se tao lii langu dènge ja'a. de ja'a karèi ku: tasamia ka ètu talora aae miu se, abhu dhu mo'o boe parcaya, peka na, ama lamatua bisa pamamuri hari dhèu dhu madhe le? tatu nèngu bisa!

source_text: and soothly i guessed, that i ought to do many contrary things against the name of jesus of nazareth.
target_text: uru èèna, mema ja'a tao rupa-rupa j'ara ho palab'a dènge dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu madhutu yesus, dhèu nasaret.

source_text: which thing also i did in jeru-salem, and i enclosed many of the saints in prison, when i had taken power of the princes of priests. and when they were slain, i brought or i gave the sentence. and by all synagogues oft i punished them, and constrained to blaspheme; and more i waxed mad against them, and pursued till into alien cities.
target_text: lod'o èèna, kètu agama yahudi sèra hia ja'a koasa, sèna ka laku paj'èra dhèu unu yesus ètu mia-mia. ja'a kèpe si, ka nuni kèti si asa yerusalem, ho core si pamaso asa d'ara bèdho. ja'a madhutu pama'ète sèna ka huku madhe si cahag'e. ja'a laku kahèi asa d'ara èmu-èmu sabaj'a, ho paj'èra si. aa ja'a neo pakaseti si, sèna ka rèngu tèke eele parcaya rèngu mi yesus. ae ka dhu ja'a laku magèi si dènge d'ara sagoro tob'i-tob'i. sad'i ja'a tadèngi dhèu parcaya yesus sèra ètu era èci, do masi ka d'ai rai leo èèna ka, ja'a laku magèla kore si!

source_text: in which, the while i went to damascus, with power and suffering of the princes of priests,
target_text: èle èèna ka, paulus tuhu hari lii na, peka na, ca tèka, kètu agama yahudi sèra hia ja'a sasuri koasa ho laku magèla dhèu parcaya yesus ètu kota damsik. ka ja'a laku.

source_text: at midday, in the way i saw, sir king, that from heaven a light shined about me, passing the shining of the sun, and about them that were together with me.
target_text: ama dhèu aae agripa! ropa ji'i ètu talora j'ara era, pe d'ai lod'o titu mera sa, cag'ag'a laa, saraa aae èci dhu mariu nèti dedha-liru, senter lèke ja'a dènge anga ja'a sèra.

source_text: and when we all had fallen down into the earth, i heard a voice saying to me in hebrew tongue, saul, saul, what persecutest or pursuest thou me? it is hard to or for thee, to kick against the prick.
target_text: ji'i aa'i-aa'i mi bèbha baa-baa ètu rai, lula saraa èèna mariu aae. hèia ja'a tadèngi lii èci, pake lii aram, peka na, ‘we, saul! nga tao ka èu loe boe paj'èra ja'a ne? bia titu kèna, ladhe èu sisu taruu dad'èi ja'a. '

source_text: and i said, who art thou, lord? and the lord said, i am jesus, whom thou persecutest or pursuest.
target_text: ja'a tadèngi lii èèna, te ngaa ladhe kèdhi boe dhèu èèna. ka ja'a karèi, peka na, ‘ama dhu padhai lii ne, cee ka èu? ' hèia lii èèna dhaa mi ja'a, peka na, ‘ja'a ne, yesus, dhu èu paj'èra taruu èèna.

source_text: but rise up, and stand on thy feet. for why to this thing i appeared to thee, that i ordain thee minister and witness of those things that thou hast seen, and of those things in which i shall show or shall appear to thee.
target_text: saul! kèd'i ka! ja'a pad'elo iisi mi èu ne, sèna ka èu j'aj'i dhèu unu ja'a. èu hud'i lamu ku lole dènge dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra, ngaa dhu èu mèdhi le nèti ja'a limuri ne. ladhe èèna na, ja'a pad'elo asa ae hari dènge èu, ngaa-ngaa dhu hiu, sèna ka lamu lole dènge dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: and i shall deliver thee from peoples and folks, to which now i send thee,
target_text: èèna na, èu paraga dènge j'aj'èra ae-ae. te ngaa ja'a j'aga èu nèti dhèu dhu neo paj'èra èu, masi ka nèti dhèu yahudi, do nèti dhèu yahudi boe. tare'a! ja'a pua èu lamu asa dhèu dhu yahudi boe.

source_text: to open the eyes of them, that they be converted or turned from darkness to light, and from power of satan to god, that they take remission of sins, and part among saints, by faith that is in me.
target_text: lamu bhoke musi madha si, sèna ka re'a, ho ra mamuri ètu d'ara saraa. hèia ra tèke eele j'ara-j'ara mamuri ra dhu koe-kapengo sèra. aa èu hud'i pad'elo kahèi, j'ara mamuri dhu mola. lamu ho patabuli eele si nèti koasa dhèu aae nidhu, sèna ka mèti si asa ama lamatua. dènge j'ara ne, ama lamatua saku eele sasala-sasigo aa'i-aa'i si. ka rèngu j'aj'i dhèu unu lamatua kahèi, èci èèna ka dènge dhèu-dhèu leo dhu lamatua hag'e nare le, lula rèngu parcaya ja'a. èèna ka dhu ja'a peka dènge èu, saul! '

source_text: wherefore, sir king agrippa, i was not unbelieveful to the heavenly vision;
target_text: hèia paulus tuhu hari lii, peka na, de ama dhèu aae. sasab'a dhu ja'a sèmi kore unu ku nèti sorga, ja'a pakako ne. toke d'ai doe ne'e ne, ja'a sab'a taruu, ae mèka ciki sa.

source_text: but i told or i showed to them, that be at damascus first, and at jerusalem, and by all the country of judea, and to heathen men, that they should do penance, and be converted to god, and do worthy works of penance.
target_text: hiu-hiu èèna, ja'a lole j'ara mamuri yesus mi dhèu yahudi ètu damsik sèra. èle èèna ka, ja'a mai lole dènge dhèu yahudi dhu ètu yerusalem dènge palème propensi yudea. hèia ja'a laku palème kabarai dhèu dhu yahudi boe sèra. ja'a padhai lii pahuni boe dènge rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra, ho ra tèke eele j'ara mamuri rèngu dhu sala sèra, sèna ka ra saraka mamuri rèngu mi ama lamatua. rèngu hud'i tao dhu be'a ku ètu d'ara mamuri rèngu hia mi dhèu leo kahèi, ho j'aj'i tadha, peka na, rèngu j'aj'i le dhèu hiu ètu lamatua.

source_text: for this cause, jews took me, when i was in the temple, to slay me.
target_text: lula sasab'a ja'a sèmi èèna, ka dhèu yahudi sèra kèpe ja'a ètu d'ara èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i ètu yerusalem. rèngu neo pamadhe ja'a kahèi.

source_text: but i was helped by the help of god till into this day, and stand, witnessing to less and to more. and i say nothing else than which things the prophets and moses spake that shall come,
target_text: te ngaa malo-malo ka ama lamatua soru ja'a. nèti èèna ka, ja'a mamuri d'ai sange ne'e ne. de ja'a bisa titu ètu ne'e, ho lole dènge dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra, ana iiki-dhèu kapai, lula-nèti j'ara mamuri yesus. ngaa dhu ja'a peka ne, aa'i-aa'i ra, èci èèna ka dènge lii a'aj'a-nanori nèti musa dènge dhèu rèti lii padhai lamatua uru sèra.

source_text: if christ is to suffer, if he is the first of the again-rising of dead men, that shall show light to the people and to heathen men.
target_text: rèngu aj'a-nori lula-nèti kristus, dhèu dhu ama lamatua moa neo hia mai. dhu peka na, kristus hud'i pasae ku j'aj'èra. hèia na madhe. te ngaa èle èèna, nèngu ka dhu j'aj'i dhèu uru dhu ama lamatua pamamuri hari. nèngu ka dhu pasaraa dhèu yahudi sèra, dènge dhèu-dhèu leo ètu rai-haha ne.

source_text: when he spake these things, and yielded reason, festus said with great voice, paul, thou maddest or thou waxest mad; many letters turn thee to madness.
target_text: ropa paulus lole sasab'a na era, ka festus cag'ag'a laa poro ète lii padhai na dènge lii mèdhu, peka na, he! paulus! èu ne, tao-tao dhu huj'u le. èu mèu ae ka, kahadhu èu, ele iie.

source_text: and paul said, i mad not, thou best festus, but i speak out the words of truth and of soberness.
target_text: te ngaa paulus dhaa, peka na, ama gubernur dhu ja'a pakab'ua. ja'a ne huj'u boe. ngaa aa'i-aa'i dhu ja'a lole ne, mema lèke tare'a. ja'a leko boe.

source_text: for also the king, to whom i speak steadfastly, knoweth of these things; for i deem, that nothing of these is hid from him; for neither in a corner was aught of these things done.
target_text: ama dhèu aae agripa unu na dhu ne'a le kahèi, ngaa dhu ja'a peka-padhai ne. nèti èèna ka, ja'a bani padhai lii dènge boe pasili. ja'a lèka ama dhèu aae dhu tadèngi le j'ara se'e aa'i-aa'i, lula ngaa dhu j'aj'i sèra, j'aj'i boe ètu era pahuni. dhu peka na, yesus dhu madhe èèna, muri hari le. dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra re'a le j'ara ne.

source_text: believest thou, king agrippa, to prophets? i know that thou believest.
target_text: karèi nèti uru ka, dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua sèra peka mema le j'ara ne'e. ja'a bani patèka, peka na, ama dhèu aae parcaya kahèi, lii dhèu rèti lii padhai sèra, sina ma?

source_text: and agrippa said to paul, in little thing thou counselest me for to be made a christian man.
target_text: ka dhèu aae agripa, poro ète lii padhai lii na, aku nèngu na, ee, paulus! nèbhu boe, te èu pamaso ja'a j'aj'i dhèu sarani!

source_text: and paul said, i desire with god, both in little and in great, not only thee, but all these that hear today, to be made such as i am, except these bonds.
target_text: te ngaa paulus dhaa, sèmi ne'e, ama. ja'a manèngi mi ama lamatua, sèna ka d'ara lai-lai ne, do ako nèbhu hari ciki, baku dhoka ama dhèu aae di mesa na, te ngaa dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu deo ne'e ne tadèngi lii padhai ja'a ne, j'aj'i sama sèmi ja'a, nuka dhèu unu yesus! sad'i dhodhoka ama si baku j'aj'i dhèu bèdho, sama sèmi dhu ja'a pasae ne.

source_text: and the king rose up, and the president, and bernice, and they that sat nigh to them.
target_text: ropa paulus peka nare, ka dhèu aae agripa dènge ana hèni na bernike, gubernur festus, dènge dhèu kapai aa'i-aa'i sèra, kèd'i titu, hèia lèpa aa'i.

source_text: and when they went away, they spake together, and said, that this man hath not done anything worthy death, neither or bonds.
target_text: ropa rèngu d'ai li'u, ra padhue, aku rèngu na, dhèu ne, tao sala boe ngaa-ngaa dhu palèke dènge huku madhe, do pamaso ne asa d'ara bèdho!

source_text: and agrippa said to festus, this man might be delivered or dismissed, if he had not appealed to the emperor or to caesar.
target_text: èle èèna ka, dhèu aae agripa peka dènge gubernur festus, aku nèngu na, kasian. dhèu ne manèngi le ca'e asa paredha dedha mi dhèu aae kapai ètu roma. ladhe aad'o, na, lii langu ne èle le, aa bisa patabuli ne.

source_text: but as it was deemed him to ship into italy, they betook paul with other keepers or with other men kept to a centurion, by name julius, of the company of knights of the emperor.
target_text: hèia gubernur festus pama'ète, sèna ka lere rèti paulus la'e asa madha dhèu aae kapai keser ètu roma, sèna ka pama'ète lii langu na ètu nèi. ka na pangèd'u paulus dènge dhèu bèdho dhu leo sèra, asa komedhaa sordad'u èci, ngara na yulius, ho lere nèti si asa propensi italia. yulius ne, komedhaa nèti sordad'u dhu madhenge keser.

source_text: and we went up into the ship of adramyttium, and began to sail, and were borne about the places of asia, while aristarchus of macedonia, thessalonica, dwelled still with us.
target_text: lod'o èèna, ja'a nuka lukas, laku lere kahèi paulus. aa dènge angalai èci, dhèu makedonia nèti kota tesalonika, ngara na aristarkus. ji'i aa'i-aa'i mi ca'e kapa cue, dhu mai nèti kota adramitium. madhutu dad'èi juraga, kapa ne neo dhuli hèb'a-namo ae ètu propensi asia.

source_text: and in the day pursuing, we came to sidon; and julius treated courteously paul, and suffered him to go to friends, and to do his needs or to do the care of him.
target_text: ji'i pakèd'i tèke eele kaisarea. ka d'ai bèli èèna, ji'i d'ai kota sidon. komedhaa yulius tao paulus dènge be'a, aa na peka dènge ne kahèi, bisa la'e pangad'o dènge angalai na ètu dae. dad'èi yulius sèna ka paulus bisa abhu nèti rèngu, ngaa dhu na parluu ètu d'ara kakako na.

source_text: and when we removed from thence, we under-sailed to cyprus, for that winds were contrary.
target_text: hèia ji'i aa'i-aa'i mi ca'e hari, ho pakèd'i. te ngaa ngèlu madha kapai seli, toke kapa ne oe kako nare boe. ka ra pod'e kaduru kapa ne, re talora aae pulu siprus dènge rai siria, sèna ka ako abhe ngèlu nèti madha.

source_text: and we sailed in the sea of cilicia and pamphylia, and came to lystra, that is lycia.

target_text: ji'i dhu pakèd'i nèbhu mèka, te ngaa ngèlu aae mai. dhu dhèu peka na, ‘ngèlu badae-dhimu'. ka lai ngèlu ne, tiu nèti kapa ne asa talora lèu. ana mataroo se soro lèke heka kad'uru kapa, ka ra soro tèke ne sène, hud'i madhutu ngèlu tao ne.

source_text: for which thing, ye men, be of good comfort or of good heart; for i believe to my god, that so it shall be, as it is said to me.

target_text: ropa d'ai roma, sordad'u sèra pamaso dhèu bèdho sèra asa d'ara bèdho. te ngaa ra pamaso boe paulus. ra hud'i ne sène, ho bisa seb'a èmu cue. ètu èmu èèna, na pea dènge sordad'u dhèu èci dhu j'aga ne. kacui-aai rèngu dua ra, dhu èki pake rate.

source_text: and after the third day, he called together the worthiest of the jews. and when they came, he said to them, brethren, i did nothing against the people either custom of fathers, and i was bound at jerusalem, and was betaken into the hands of romans.
target_text: èle tèlu lod'o, hèia paulus paroa dhèu heka-dhèu heka dhèu yahudi ètu sèra, ho mai paraga dènge ne. ropa ra pakaboko, hèia paulus padhai lii dènge si, aku nèngu na, a'ari aa'i-aa'i! ja'a ètu ne'e ne, lula a'ari èdhi dhèu yahudi sèra kèpe rare ja'a ètu yerusalem. ka ra soro ja'a asa d'ara kacui-aai dhèu paredha roma. te ngaa ja'a tao sala boe ngaa-ngaa! ja'a tao boe ngaa-ngaa dhu lab'a isi kabarai èdhi. aa ja'a lab'a boe kahèi atora ad'a dhu èdhi sèmi tare nèti bèi-baki èdhi sèra.

source_text: and when they had asked of me, would have delivered me, for that no cause of death was in me.
target_text: dhèu paredha parisa le lii ja'a ne ètu nèi. te ngaa ra abhu boe sasala ja'a èci sa dhu bisa abhu huku madhe. nèti èèna ka, ra neo patalale eele ja'a.

source_text: but for the jews gainsaid, i was constrained to appeal to the emperor or to caesar; not as having anything to accuse my people.
target_text: te ngaa, lula ama-ama dhèu yahudi sèmi boe lii pama'ète nèti dhèu paredha ho patalale ja'a, nèti èèna ka, ko'o do ko'o boe, ja'a hud'i ca'e banding ku mai asa roma. masi ka ja'a tao sèmi ne'e, te ngaa dènge boe d'ara neo galaa dhèu ja'a unu ku.

source_text: therefore for this cause i prayed to see you, and speak to you; for for the hope of israel i am gird about with this chain.
target_text: nèti lii langu ne'e ka, ja'a pakaboko a'ari aa'i-aa'i ètu ne'e. madhutu dad'èi ja'a, èdhi bisa padhue-padhai ngaa dhu èdhi dhèu yahudi sanao-maena: nuka, èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti sanao mi dhèu aae dhu ama lamatua neo hia mai, sèna ka hia mamuri mi èdhi dhèu isra'el. nèti j'ara se'e ka, ra èki ja'a dènge rate ne.

source_text: and they said to him, neither we have received letters of thee from judea, neither any of brethren coming showed, either spake, any evil thing of thee.
target_text: hèia dhèu se dhaa, aku rèngu na, toke d'ai lod'o deo ne'e ne, ji'i sèmi mèka sasuri èci sa nèti yudea, dhu peka lii langu èu ne. sèmi èèna kahèi, a'ari dhu mai nèti nèi, lolo boe ngaa-ngaa èci sa lula-nèti èu.

source_text: but we pray to hear of thee, what things thou feelest; for of this sect it is known to us, that everywhere men gainsaith it.
target_text: te ngaa ji'i neo nanene ngaa dhu èu parcaya, lula ji'i tadèngi le ètu mia-mia, peka na, dhèu sèmi boe ngaa dhu partei kristen sèra aj'a-nori si. de mamèci na, tasamia? ji'i dhae nge'a mèka. de lolo ku dènge ji'i laa.

source_text: and when they had ordained a day to him, many men came to him into the inn. to which he expounded, witnessing the kingdom of god, and counselled them of jesus, of the law of moses, and of prophets, from the morrow till to the eventide.
target_text: ka rèngu rare lii èci ho pili ca lod'o dhu leo, sèna ka ra paraga hari. ropa d'ai lod'o pamoa èèna, dhèu ae titu kèna mai pakaboko ètu era pea paulus. hèia paulus mulai lole ka dènge rèngu, dad'èi ama lamatua mi dhèu unu na. na pake isi nèti sasuri musa, dènge sasuri dhèu rèti lii padhai lamatua dhu leo sèra, sèna ka rèngu bisa parcaya yesus. na padhai lii nèti mad'ae toke d'ai lod'o nihia.

source_text: and some believed to these things that were said of paul, some believed not.
target_text: ropa tadèngi rare lii padhai lii paulus ne, abhu ka cahag'e dhu parcaya. te ngaa abhu kahèi dhu parcaya boe.

source_text: and when they were not consent-ing together, they departed. and paul said one word, for the holy ghost spake well by isaiah, the prophet, to our fathers,
target_text: nèti èèna ka, rèngu pab'ala èci dènge èci, toke cahag'e neo lèpa. te ngaa paulus peka, aku nèngu na, mema lii pasisu miu ne, lèke sama sèmi ngaa dhu uru èèna roh ama lamatua dhu mola-mèci peka le dènge yesaya,

source_text: and said, go thou to this people, and say to them, with ear ye shall hear, and ye shall not understand; and ye seeing shall see, and ye shall not behold.
target_text: peka na, ‘lamu peka dènge dhèu se'e se, na, èèna na, miu nanene taruu lii ja'a, te ngaa me'a boe ciki sa! miu laladhe taruu ngaa dhu ja'a tao, te ngaa miu pusi boe ciki sa.

source_text: for the heart of this people is greatly fatted, and with ears they heard heavily, and they closed together their eyes, lest peradventure they see with eyes, and with ears hear, and by heart understand, and be converted, and i heal them.
target_text: lula d'ara dhèu se'e se adhu sèmi hadhu. dhilu rèngu d'èi heka nanene! aa musi madha rèngu, bèdho mèno le! hud'i rèngu sène, ra tadèngi ia ka; aa hud'i laa, sèna ka musi madha ra ladhe rèdhi ia ka. aa hud'i laa, sèna ka d'ara ra adhu sèmi hadhu taruu. toke d'ai rèngu sèra re'a heka j'ara ho lèpa mai asa ja'a, de j'ara tasamia ka ja'a bisa tao pabe'a hari rèngu? '

source_text: therefore be it known to you, that this health of god, is sent to heathen men, and they shall hear.
target_text: hèia paulus katange lii padhai lii na, aku nèngu na, sèmi ne'e, a'ari! sèna ka miu se me'a, na, ama lamatua sadia tèke le mamuri hia dhèu yahudi boe, lula rèngu dhu d'èi nanene ne.

source_text: and when he had said these things, jews went out from him, and had much question, or musing, or seeking, among themselves.
target_text: ropa paulus padhai lii nare sèmi èèna, ka dhèu se lèpa ka. te ngaa ngangee rèngu pa'èci boe, lula ra pasisu èci dènge èci.

source_text: and he dwelled full two years in his hired place; and he received all that entered to him,
target_text: paulus pea ka ètu èmu dhu na seb'a èèna, d'ai dua tèu. na sèmi dènge karej'e dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu mai tenge paraga dènge ne.

source_text: and preached the kingdom of god, and taught those things that be of the lord jesus christ, with all trust, without forbidding. amen.
target_text: dènge j'ara sèmi ne'e, nèngu abhu j'ara sèna ka na aj'a-nori si lula-nèti paredha ama lamatua, aa j'ara mamuri lamatua yesus kahèi. na lole dènge pahuni boe, aa na abhu boe dhu pahèb'e ne. ama teofilus dhu be'a. lii lolo ja'a d'ai sange ne'e ka. makasi. nèti ja'a, lukas

source_text: paul, the servant of jesus christ, called an apostle, separated or set apart into the gospel of god,
target_text: sasuri ne nèti ja'a, paulus. ama lamatua pili nare le ja'a ho j'aj'i dhèu pajuu-paleha yesus kristus. ka na ded'e ja'a j'aj'i ana pua-paleha kristus, ho laku lole lii lolo be'a na dènge dhèu ètu mia-mia.

source_text: which he had promised before by his prophets in holy scriptures of his son, which is made to him of the seed of david by or after the flesh,
target_text: uru èèna, ama lamatua dhu ator tèke le, ho dhèu rèti lii padhai na suri j'ara-j'ara nèti lii lolo be'a èèna ètu sasuri mola-mèci na. te, ètu d'ara sasuri ne, lamatua pajaji neo hia mai ana na yesus, ho j'aj'i dhèu rai-haha. de limuri ne, lii moa na èèna j'aj'i le, lula yesus dhu mai le nèti ana-èpu dhèu aae daud.

source_text: and he was before-ordained, or predestined by grace, the son of god in virtue, by the spirit of hallowing of the again-rising of dead men, of jesus christ our lord,
target_text: te ngaa re èci hari, ama lamatua pad'elo tadha, peka na, yesus kristus èèna, ana nèngu kahèi. te roh yesus èèna, mola-mèci tare'a-re'a, sama sèmi ama lamatua. aa lamatua pake koasa na, sèna ka pamamuri hari yesus nèti mamadhe na. nèti èèna ka, èdhi te'a, na, ana ama lamatua èèna, nuka kètu èdhi, yesus kristus.

source_text: by whom we have received grace and the office of apostle or apostle-hood, to obey to the faith in all folks, for his name,
target_text: yesus pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi ja'a, te na pili nare le ja'a j'aj'i dhèu pajuu-paleha na, ho lole lii aj'a-nori na buli mia-mia. dad'èi na, dhèu dhu yahudi boe parcaya ne kahèi, aa mamuri madhutu dad'èi ama lamatua. ja'a neo kahèi, sèna ka dhèu nèti suku aa'i-aa'i lèka kristus, aa mamuri madhutu dad'èi na.

source_text: among which ye be also called of jesus christ,
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi dènge miu ètu kota roma. miu j'aj'i nèti suku ae-ae nèti mia-mia, yesus kristus dhu hag'e nare le miu, peka na, mai ka! mai j'aj'i dhèu unu ja'a!

source_text: to all that be at rome, darlings or the beloved of god, and called holy, grace be to you, and peace of god our father, and of the lord jesus christ.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ja'a pa'adhu sasuri ne hia miu ètu roma, dènge pasanèd'e, peka na, ama lamatua sue miu. nèngu manèngi kahèi ho miu j'aj'i dhèu unu na dhu mamuri mola-mèci. ja'a sabaj'a sèna ka ama èdhi, ama lamatua, dènge kètu èdhi, yesus kristus, pad'elo d'ara hua iia ra, aa hia miu mamuri dènge mera-milu.

source_text: first i do thankings to my god, by jesus christ, for all you, for your faith is showed in all the world.
target_text: ja'a bhoke sasuri ja'a ne, dènge manèngi makasi ae-ae mi ama lamatua, lula yesus kristus sab'a ètu d'ara miu. ja'a manèngi makasi kahèi, lula dhèu dhu pea ètu rae-rae d'ara paredha roma, ra palolo lula-nèti parcaya miu mi yesus.

source_text: for god is a witness to me, to whom i serve in my spirit, in the gospel of his son, that without ceasing i make mind of you evermore in my prayers,
target_text: ja'a loe boe sabaj'a hia miu. tare'a! lamatua mesa na ne'a, na, ngaa dhu ja'a padhai ne, lèke. nèngu ne'a kahèi, na, ja'a ne sab'a dènge d'ara kateme ho lole dènge dhèu lii lolo be'a nèti ana na.

source_text: and beseech or praying, if in any manner sometime i have a speedy way in the will of god to come to you.
target_text: lod'o-lod'o ja'a manèngi-mangaj'i, ja'a peka sèmi ne'e ka: lamatua, ja'a mesa ku ke'a boe j'ara na tasamia. te ngaa, ladhe madhutu dad'èi lamatua, na, bhoke la j'ara, sèna ka ja'a bisa laku pangad'o dènge angalai ja'a sèra ètu roma.

source_text: for i desire to see you, to impart somewhat to you of spiritual grace or that i give to you something of spiritual grace, that ye be confirmed,
target_text: ja'a sabaj'a sèmi èèna, te ja'a neo titu kèna kèdhi miu, sèna ka ja'a bisa bagi hia miu koasa nèti roh lamatua, ho hud'i laa miu j'aj'i dhèu unu lamatua dhu taha pa'èra-èra.

source_text: that is, to be comforted together in you, by that faith that is both yours and mine together.
target_text: madhutu a'abhu ja'a sèmi ne'e ka: ladhe ja'a j'aj'i dhiu pea dènge miu, ja'a neo pa'èra d'ara miu, ho sèna ka parcaya miu asa èra. aa ja'a neo kahèi ho miu pa'èra d'ara ja'a.

source_text: and, brethren, i will not, that ye not know, that oft i purposed to come to you, and i am hindered till this time, that i have some fruit in you, as in other folks.
target_text: a'ari pasue aa'i-aa'i! ja'a d'èi ladhe miu me'a, na, ja'a neo ae le ho dhiu pangad'o dènge miu ètu roma. te ngaa toke sange ne'e, dhodhoka tao nelu di. de ladhe ja'a j'aj'i dhiu, ja'a sanao sèna ka abhu dhèu ae era dhu lèka èra kristus, sama sèmi dhu ja'a abhu ètu era-era leo. ladhe sèmi èèna, na, rui-j'aj'èra ja'a abhu hua-hela dhu be'a.

source_text: to greeks and to barbarians, to wise men and to unwise men, i am debtor, so that that is in me is ready to preach the gospel or to evangelize also to you that be at rome.
target_text: masi ka, tasamia èèna ka, ja'a hud'i lole ku lii lolo be'a lamatua mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i. mi dhèu dhu pake lii yunani do, dhèu dintiu dhu pake lii leo, dhèu kapai do, dhèu haha do, dhèu sakola do, dhèu sakola boe. nèti èèna ka, ja'a pa'èra neo dhiu sa roma, sèna ka paraga dènge miu.

source_text: for i shame not the gospel, for it is the virtue of god into health, to each man that believeth, to the jew first, and to the greek.
target_text: ja'a makae boe ciki sa, dènge lii lolo be'a lamatua yesus. te ladhe abhu dhèu dhu parcaya ama lamatua, lii lolo be'a ne dènge koasa nèti lamatua, ho patabuli dhèu ne'e nèti koasa sasala-sasigo na. dhèu yahudi ka dhu re'a uuru j'ara ne'e ne, heka dhèu suku leo sèra kèna.

source_text: for the rightwiseness of god is showed in it, of faith into faith, as it is written, for a just man liveth of faith.
target_text: lii lolo be'a ne pad'elo kahèi j'ara lamatua ho pamola dhèu nèti sasala ra. aa'i-aa'i sèra sa bisa j'aj'i, sad'i dhèu parcaya ne. te dhu suri le ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci lamatua, peka na, dhèu hud'i parcaya uuru ku ama lamatua, heka bisa pabe'a dènge nèngu kèna. te ladhe ra mamuri dènge parcaya ne, heka abhu mamuri dhu lèke kèna.

source_text: for the wrath of god is showed from heaven on all unpiety and wickedness or unrightwiseness of those men, that withhold or hold aback the truth of god in unrightwiseness.
target_text: te ngaa ama lamatua peka le, na, abhu dhèu dhu pusi-pahae boe nèngu. aa abhu dhu ad'u-ue rupa-rupa j'ara bhelu-katub'a. te ngaa lamatua sèmi nare boe tatao rèngu sèra. lula ètu d'ara iiki rèngu, dhu re'a le, mia ka dhu lèke. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa rèngu loe boe tao j'ara-j'ara dhu lèke boe sèra. ra kakèj'i dhèu, toke dhèu re'a heka mia ka dhu lèke. nèti èèna ka, ama lamatua papuru hahuku nèti dedha-liru, sèna ka paj'èra si.

source_text: for that thing of god that is known, is showed or is made open to them, for god hath showed to them. for the invisible things of him, that be understood, be beheld of the creature of the world, by those things that be made, yea, and the everlasting virtue of him, and the godhead, so that they may not be excused or they be unexcusable.
target_text: dhèu se'e se, abhu boe alasan ho siri iisi ra, lula j'ara-j'ara dhu pahuni boe dhu dhèu bisa re'a mèu nèti lamatua. te ama lamatua mesa na ka dhu pad'elo! a'abhu ja'a sèmi ne'e ka: mulai nèti na paj'aj'i dedha-liru dènge rai-haha, toke d'ai sange ne'e ne, ladhe dhèu neo re'a mèu nèti ngi'u lamatua, aa dènge koasa na dhu dènge boe too-lane èèna, bisa kahèi! masi ka ladhe tèdhi boe ama lamatua, te ngaa dhèu bisa tadhe ne nèti ngaa-ngaa dhu na ad'u-ue. nèti èèna ka, ja'a peka, na, dhèu bhelu sèra abhu boe alasan ho siri iisi ra, peka na, ja'a ke'a boe ngaa-ngaa nèti ama lamatua.

source_text: for when they had known god, they glorified him not as god, neither did thankings; but they vanished in their thoughts, and the unwise heart of them was darked or made dark.
target_text: de masi ka rèngu re'a j'ara-j'ara lamatua, te ngaa ro'o boe mangaku, na, lamatua èèna, ama lamatua èdhi! rèngu se ro'o boe, manèngi makasi mi lamatua kahèi. ka ngangee ra j'aj'i kahèlu, toke ra re'a heka ngaa dhu lèke. rèngu j'aj'i bingu aa padhai lii rupa-rupa dhu kolo-kapua aad'o lula-nèti ama lamatua. aa d'ara ra maroga aatu-aatu.

source_text: for they saying that themselves were wise, they were made fools.
target_text: rèngu èci-èci padedha iisi ra, peka na, ja'a ke'a mèu madha j'ara ae-ae! masi ka ngangee ra sèmi èèna, te ngaa madhutu mola-mola na, rèngu goa titu kèna.

source_text: and they exchanged the glory of uncorruptible god into the likeness of an image of a deadly or a corruptible man, and of birds, and of four-footed beasts, and of serpents.
target_text: ka dhèu se pahaha boe iisi ra mi ama lamatua dhu kapai risi eele èèna, te rèngu peka na, ji'i pusi boe lamatua sèmi èèna! te ngaa ra sogo-tagu mi rupa-rupa patung, raropa sèmi dhèu rai-haha, sèmi manu-bhui sa, do sèmi badha leo sèra, toke d'ai patung dhu rupa sèmi mege sa. dènge ra sogo-tagu sèmi èèna, rèngu tule eele ama lamatua dhu mamuri taa-taa, ho ra gati eele dènge mèdha-panyau dhu bisa madhe!

source_text: for which thing god betook them into the desires of their heart, into uncleanness, that they punish with wrongs their bodies in themselves.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, lamatua soro tèke si, sèna ka ra ad'u-ue madhutu dad'èi rèngu. na soro tèke si, ho ra tao j'ara bhelu-katub'a rupa-rupa, dhu amo le ètu d'ara rèngu. toke rèngu se re'a heka makae sa hèi. hèia dènge ngi'u aae ra, rèngu ad'u-ue madha j'ara kaj'alu rupa-rupa, aa ra tao sèmi èèna kahèi dènge dhèu leo.

source_text: the which men changed the truth of god into leasing, and praised and served a creature rather than the creator, that is blessed into worlds of worlds or into without end. amen.
target_text: ètu d'ara iiki ra dhu re'a le j'ara-j'ara dhu lèke nèti ama lamatua, te ngaa ro'o boe madhutu. ngangee rèngu dhu moca le, hèia ra pangee, na, be'a risi èdhi tao rupa-rupa. masi ka pakarehe aa'i-aa'i, ngaa-ngaa tao boe! ra koa-kad'iri mèdha dhu lamatua paj'aj'i, te ngaa rèngu pahaha boe iisi mi lamatua dhu paj'aj'i mèdha se. ra tao iisi sèmi dhèu dhu mola-mèci, te ngaa dhu mola-mèu lao di! dhu lèke ka, ladhe èdhi dhèu rai-haha ne koa-kio taruu ama lamatua! èèna ka dhu mèci!

source_text: therefore god betook them into passions of shame or of evil fame. for the women of them changed the natural use into that use that is against kind.
target_text: nèti bhabhelu-katub'a rèngu sèra ka, lamatua soro tèke si, ho rèngu tao karehe sèmi èèna madhutu dad'èi ra. hèia ra tao rupa-rupa j'ara makae, dhu dènge heka d'ara makae. bhèni ra, ro'o heka pa'èci dènge mone dhèu èmu ra, te ngaa d'èi tao dhu lèke boe. te bhèni j'unu tao j'ara makae dènge bhèni.

source_text: also the men forsook the kindly use of women, and burned in their desires together, and men into men wrought filthhood, and received into themselves the meed that behooved of their error.
target_text: dhèu mone sèmi èèna kahèi! ra d'èi heka j'unu pa'èci dènge dhèu èmu ra, te ngaa d'èi j'unu dènge dhèu mone leo! rèngu se, dhu dènge heka d'ara makae! nèti èèna ka, pe rèngu dui rare j'aj'èra pamèci dènge tatao rèngu sèra! te rèngu se dhu sigo eele kaj'èu le, nèti j'ara dhu lèke.

source_text: and as they proved that they had not god in knowing, god betook them into a reprovable wit, that they do those things that be not covenable;
target_text: ra pangee, na, be'a risi baku patai-patapa dènge lamatua. nèti èèna ka, lamatua soro tèke si, sèna ka ra tao madhutu dad'èi ra! de rèngu ngee dhoka dhu karehe di! ka ra tao j'ara-j'ara dhu lèke boe!

source_text: that they be full-filled with all wickedness, malice, fornication, covet-ousness, waywardness, full of envy, manslayings, strife, guile, evil will,
target_text: mamuri ra pènu dènge rupa-rupa bhabhelu-katub'a. ka re'a heka tao dhu be'a, te ngaa dhoka dhu bhelu di. rèngu manga'a. èci tèke d'ara dènge èci. èci d'èi boe karisi èci. èci pamadhe èci. ra d'èi patao-palaha. ra kapod'e-kabèli. ra leko-monya. ra d'èi padhai-kakoli dhèu.

source_text: privy backbiters, detractors, hate-ful to god, debaters or despisers, proud, and high over-measure, finders of evil things, not obedient to father and mother,
target_text: rèngu d'èi pa'ele iie kolongara dhèu. ra palab'a dènge ama lamatua. ra kurang ajar, d'èi pahahe dhèu, d'èi padedha iisi, d'èi tenge j'ara-j'ara karehe, aa d'èi palab'a dènge ina-ama ra.

source_text: unwise, unmannerly, without love or without affection, without bond of peace, without mercy.
target_text: ro'o boe re'a dènge j'ara dhu mola. ro'o boe re'a dènge lii pamoa unu ra, ka dhèu lèka heka rèngu. re'a boe sue dhèu. dènge boe d'ara kasia ciki sa mi dedha dhèu.

source_text: the which when they had known the rightwiseness of god, understood not, that they that do such things be worthy the death, not only they that do those things, but also they that consent to the doers.

source_text: what then shall we say, that abraham, our father after the flesh, found?

source_text: for if abraham is justified of works of the law, he hath glory, but not with god.
target_text: èdhi bisa te'a sèmi ne'e: ladhe abraham bisa pabe'a dènge lamatua, lula na tao j'ara be'a, nèngu kahèi abhu hak ho koa iisi ètu madha dhèu rai-haha. te ngaa ètu madha lamatua, nèngu bisa boe bhoka hèb'a.

source_text: for what saith the scripture? abraham believed to god, and it was areckoned to him to rightwiseness.

source_text: soothly to him that worketh not, but believeth into him that justifieth a wicked or an unpious man, his faith is areckoned to rightwiseness, after the purpose of god's grace.

source_text: as david saith the blessedness of a man, whom god accepteth, he giveth to him rightwiseness without works of the law,

source_text: blessed be they, whose wicked-nesses be forgiven, and whose sins be hid or be covered.
target_text: masi ka dhèu se sisu atora lamatua, te ngaa na saku eele sasala-sasigo si. nèti èèna ka, rèngu oto titu kèna! dhèu dhu tao bhabhelu, lamatua pabhèlu eele sasala si.

source_text: blessed is that man, to whom god areckoned not sin.
target_text: te ladhe lamatua pa'iga heka sasala dhèu, na, dhèu sèra oto tare'a!

source_text: then whether dwelleth this blessedness only in circumcision, or also in prepuce? for we say, that the faith was areckoned to abraham to rightwiseness.

source_text: how then was it areckoned? in circumcision, or in prepuce? not in circumcision, but in prepuce.
target_text: lod'o mia lamatua cap abraham sèmi èèna? lod'o dhu na suna le, do dhae? dhu mola-mola, nuka lèke lod'o dhu na suna mèka.

source_text: and he took a sign of circumcision, a token or a marking of rightwiseness of the faith which is in prepuce, that he be father of all men believing by prepuce, that it be areckoned also to them to rightwise-ness;
target_text: tare'a! lod'o abraham suna mèka, ama lamatua cap nare le nèngu dhèu d'ara mola dhu pabe'a dènge lamatua. nèbhu ku, heka na suna kèna, ho j'aj'i tadha, na, nèngu j'aj'i le dhèu dhu lèka lamatua. dènge sèmi èèna ka, abraham j'aj'i dhèu oti j'ara hia dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu parcaya lamatua. te lamatua sèmi nare dhèu dhu parcaya, ho ra pabe'a dènge lamatua, masi ka ra suna, do aad'o.

source_text: and that he be father of circumcision, not only to them that be of circumcision, but also to them that pursue the steps of the faith, which faith is in prepuce of our father abraham, or but and to them that pursue the steps of the faith of our father abraham, that is in prepuce.
target_text: abraham bhoke j'ara kahèi hia èdhi dhèu yahudi dhu suna le. lula boe nèti èdhi suna, te ngaa lula èdhi parcaya kristus sama sèmi abraham parcaya lamatua lod'o dhu na suna mèka.

source_text: for not by the law is the promise to abraham, or to his seed, that he should be the heir of the world, but by the rightwiseness of faith.
target_text: ama lamatua dhu pa'èki pajaji dènge abraham, dènge ana-èpu na, peka na, nèbhu-nèbhu rai-haha kateme j'aj'i mi pusaka rèngu. lamatua pajaji sèmi èèna, lula abraham parcaya ne, aa lamatua cap ne dhèu d'ara mola dhu pabe'a dènge ne. te ngaa lamatua pajaji boe sèmi èèna, ladhe dhoka abraham tao madhutu atora lamatua.

source_text: for if they that be of the law, be heirs, faith is destroyed, promise is done away.
target_text: te ladhe dhèu dhu madhutu dhoka atora lamatua di, bisa sèmi rare pusaka dhu lamatua moa, sasoa na, parcaya mi lamatua parcuma di. aa lii pajaji lamatua èèna guna boe ngaa-ngaa.

source_text: for the law worketh wrath; for where is no law, there is no trespass, neither is trespassing or prevarication.
target_text: ètu era mia abhu atora lamatua, ètu èèna kahèi dhèu sisu atora èèna. aa ladhe dhèu sisu atora lamatua, na, lamatua nasa, hèia na huku si. aa ladhe atora lamatua aad'o, tatu dhèu sisu boe.

source_text: therefore rightwiseness is of faith, that by grace promise be stable or be steadfast to each seed, not to that seed only that is of the law, but to that that is of the faith of abraham, which is father of us all.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, èdhi hud'i parcaya ku lamatua. èèna ka dhu risi eele nèti aa'i-aa'i. te lamatua d'èi pad'elo dènge mola-mola d'ara hua iia na mi dhèu dhu parcaya ne. aa ladhe èdhi lèka ne, sama sèmi abraham, tatu èdhi abhu ngaa dhu na moa, masi ka èdhi dhèu yahudi dhu tao madhutu atora na, do aad'o. de èdhi aa'i-aa'i dhu parcaya ne, sama sèmi ana-èpu abraham.

source_text: as it is written, for i have set thee father of many folks, before god to whom thou hast believed. the which god quickeneth dead men or the which quickeneth the dead, and calleth those things that be not, as those that be.
target_text: lamatua dhu peka tèke le ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci na, aku nèngu na, ja'a ad'u-ue sèna ka èu j'aj'i bèi-baki nèti suku ae-ae. abraham parcaya ama lamatua. nèbhu-nèbhu ka ama lamatua tao paj'aj'i lii moa na. nèngu kahèi dhu pamamuri hari dhèu madhe. lamatua dhoka padhai lii di, ka ngaa-ngaa dhu aad'o, j'aj'i dènge.

source_text: the which abraham against hope believed into hope, that he should be made father of many folks, as it was said to him, thus shall thy seed be, as the stars of heaven, and as the gravel or sand that is in the brink of the sea.
target_text: masi ka abraham dènge mèka ana, te ngaa na lèka ama lamatua, aa tatae lamatua tao madhutu lii pajaji na. nèti parcaya èèna ka, lamatua tao ne j'aj'i mi bèi-baki nèti suku ae-ae. èèna nuka sèmi dhu suri ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci, na, ana-èpu ae-ae bèli-camèd'a mai nèti èu.

source_text: and he was not made unsteadfast in the belief, neither he beheld his body then nigh dead, when he was almost of an hundred years, nor the womb of sarah nigh dead.

source_text: also in the promise of god he doubted not with untrust; but he was comforted in belief, giving glory to god,

source_text: witting most fully that whatever things god hath promised, he is mighty also to do.
target_text: abraham lèka tare'a-re'a, ngaa dhu lamatua padhadha le, nèngu bisa tao.

source_text: therefore it was areckoned to him to rightwiseness.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ama lamatua cap abraham, peka na, dhèu d'ara mola dhu pabe'a dènge nèngu.

source_text: and it is not written only for him, that it was areckoned to him to rightwiseness,

source_text: but also for us, to whom it shall be areckoned, that believe in him that raised our lord jesus christ from death.

source_text: which was betaken for our sins, and rose again for our justifying.

source_text: therefore we, justified of faith, have we peace at god by our lord jesus christ.

source_text: by whom we have nigh going to or access, by faith into this grace, in which we stand, and have glory in the hope of the glory of god's children.

source_text: for if when we were enemies, we be reconciled to god by the death of his son, much more we reconciled shall be safe in the life of him.

source_text: and not only this, but also we glory in god, by our lord jesus christ, by whom we have received now reconciling.

source_text: but death reigned from adam unto moses, also into them that sinned not in likeness of the trespassing of adam, the which is likeness of christ to coming or to come.

source_text: but not as the guilt or the trespass, so the gift; for if through the guilt or the trespass of one many be dead, much more the grace of god and the gift in the grace of one man jesus christ hath abounded into many men.

source_text: and not as by one sin, so by the gift; for the doom, of one into condemnation, but the grace of many guilts or trespassings into justification.

source_text: for if in the guilt of one death reigned through one, much more men that take plenty of grace, and of giving, and of rightwiseness, shall reign in life by one jesus christ.

source_text: therefore as by the guilt of one into all men into condemnation, so by the rightwiseness of one into all men into justifying of life.

source_text: for as by unobedience of one man many be made sinners, so by the obedience of one many shall be ordained just.

source_text: and the law entered, that guilt should be plenteous; but where guilt was plenteous, grace was more plenteous or abounded.

source_text: that as sin reigned into death, so grace reign by rightwiseness into ever-lasting life, by jesus christ our lord.

source_text: therefore what shall we say? shall we dwell in sin, that grace be plenteous?
target_text: de èdhi peka ngaa hari? ele boe miu pangee, na, ama lamatua pabhèlu eele le sasala èdhi, lula d'ara hua iia na. nèti èèna ka, hud'i laa èdhi tino tao sala, sèna ka lamatua pad'elo d'ara hua iia na risi hari mi èdhi.

source_text: god forbid. for how shall we that be dead to sin, live yet therein?

source_text: whether, brethren, ye know not, that whichever we be baptized in christ jesus, we be baptized in his death?
target_text: ele boe miu me'a boe, na, ropa sarani èdhi, èèna j'aj'i tadha, na, èdhi tèke eele le mamuri dhui, ho abhu mamuri hiu, nuka dhu pa'èki dènge yesus kristus. èèna sama sèmi èdhi madhe le palere-lere dènge ne.

source_text: for we be together buried with him by baptism into death; that as christ arose from death by the glory of the father, so walk we in a newness of life.
target_text: lod'o kristus madhe, ra padhane ne. aa lod'o ra sarani èdhi, èèna nuka sèmi èdhi madhe kahèi, tèke eele mamuri dhui, hèia ra padhane èdhi. de ama lamatua pake koasa na dhu kapai aae èèna, ho pamamuri hari kristus nèti mamadhe na. ama lamatua d'èi ladhe èdhi sèmi tare koasa na kahèi, ho mamuri hari j'aj'i dhèu dhu hiu.

source_text: for if we planted together be made to the likeness of his death, also we shall be of the likeness of his rising again;
target_text: te èèna sama sèmi èdhi madhe palere dènge yesus. de èdhi dhu pa'èki dènge ne, tatu bèli-camèd'a èdhi mamuri hari nèti mamadhe, sama sèmi nèngu mamuri hari.

source_text: witting this thing, that our old man is crucified together, that the body of sin be destroyed, that we serve no more to sin.
target_text: uru èèna, èdhi j'aj'i dhèu dhu tao rupa-rupa sasala. te ngaa mamuri èdhi dhu dhui èèna, madhe le, èci èèna ka dènge paku pamadhe èdhi ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha palere-lere dènge kristus. limuri ne, bhabhelu ètu d'ara èdhi dènge heka koasa ho uri èdhi. limuri ne, èdhi aad'o heka ètu d'ara a'èki sèna ka tao hari sasala. te èdhi sèmi heka ènu dhu dènge boe hak ho pili neo tao ngaa.

source_text: for he that is dead to sin, is justified from sin.
target_text: ladhe dhèu dhu madhe le, nèngu bebas le, si? abhu heka ngaa èci sa laka-seti ne, ho ad'u-ue hari sasala.

source_text: and if we be dead with christ, we believe that also we shall live together with him;
target_text: de, lula èèna nuka sèmi èdhi madhe le palere-lere dènge kristus, na, èdhi parcaya, peka na, bèli-camèd'a èdhi mamuri taruu dènge ne kahèi.

source_text: witting that christ, rising again from death, now dieth not, death shall no more have lordship on him.
target_text: èdhi te'a, na, lula yesus kristus mamuri hari le nèti mamadhe na, de nèngu bisa heka madhe hari. te abhu boe èci sa dhu dènge koasa ho pamadhe hari ne.

source_text: for that he was dead to sin, he was dead once; but that he liveth, he liveth to god.
target_text: na madhe ca tèka èèna ka, ho segi koasa nèti sasala. te ngaa limuri ne na mamuri ho pakab'ua ama lamatua.

source_text: so ye deem yourselves to be dead to sin, but living to god in jesus christ our lord.
target_text: miu hud'i tao ku iisi sèmi èèna. nuka sèmi miu dhu madhe le, nèti èèna ka sasala dènge heka koasa mi dedha miu. de limuri ne, miu hud'i mamuri ku ho pakab'ua ama lamatua, lula miu dhu pa'èki le dènge yesus kristus.

source_text: therefore reign not sin in your deadly body, that ye obey to his covetings.
target_text: bhabhelu ètu d'ara èu dhu dènge koasa. baku soro tèke bhabhelu èèna ator èu, ka èu dhoka madhutu dad'èi ngi'u aae sèna ka èu tao bhabhelu-katub'a. te èèna na ngi'u aae èu madhe.

source_text: neither give ye your members arms of wickedness to sin, but give ye yourselves to god, as they that live of dead men, and your members arms of rightwiseness to god.
target_text: aa baku soro isi èu sèna ka tao j'ara dhu lèke boe, te èèna sala kahèi. te ngaa pangèd'u mamuri èu mi ama lamatua di, sèna ka nèngu ka dhu uri mamuri èu. sama sèmi èu dhu madhe le, ka mamuri hari. de pake la mamuri èu kateme aa'i, sèna ka tao j'ara dhu lèke sèra, hia mi lamatua.

source_text: for sin shall not have lordship over you; for ye be not under the law, but under grace.
target_text: baku soro tèke sèna ka sasala ator miu, sama sèmi sasala ka dhu j'aj'i lamatua miu. de limuri ne miu hud'i mamuri madhutu ia ka atora musa, sèna ka pabe'a hari dènge ama lamatua. te miu dhu mamuri mola le, lula lamatua dhu pad'elo le d'ara hua iia na mi miu. de limuri ne d'ara hua iia lamatua ka dhu uri mamuri miu.

source_text: what therefore? shall we do sin, for we be not under the law, but under grace? god forbid.
target_text: de tasamia? ele boe miu ngee, na, èdhi madhutu ia ka atora musa, ho pabe'a hari dènge ama lamatua. de hud'i laa èdhi tao sala taruu di. te lamatua neo pad'elo d'ara hua iia na era mi èdhi! miu pangee sèmi èèna ka, si? ja'a pasanèd'e, èèna na sale!

source_text: know ye not, that to whom ye give you servants to obey to, ye be servants of that thing, to which ye have obeyed, either of sin to death, either of obedience to rightwiseness?
target_text: ja'a kore upama nèti ènu dènge lamatua na. ladhe miu soro ngi'u mi ho sab'a hia dhèu èci, na, miu hud'i nanene, aa sab'a madhutu dad'èi na. te nèngu èèna kètu miu, aa miu j'aj'i ènu na. sèmi èèna kahèi, miu bisa pili neo madhutu mia. te miu bisa pili, sèna ka ad'u-ue sasala, hèia miu j'aj'i mi ènu nèti sasala ne. te ngaa ladhe miu pili sèmi èèna, miu tao iisi mi pacèri nèti ama lamatua. do, miu bisa pili tao dhu lèke, dènge j'aj'i ènu dhu tao madhutu ngaa dhu lamatua pua mi. ladhe pili sèmi èèna, miu bisa pabe'a dènge ne!

source_text: but i thank god, that ye were servants of sin; but ye have obeyed of heart into that form of teaching, in which ye be betaken.
target_text: uru èèna, miu soro tèke sèna ka sasala uri miu, te ngaa limuri ne miu nanene d'ara iiki miu, sèna ka tao madhutu ngaa dhu dhèu sarani aj'a-nori miu. nèti èèna ka ja'a manèngi makasi mi lamatua.

source_text: and ye delivered from sin, be made servants of rightwiseness.
target_text: te lamatua dhu patalale le miu nèti koasa sasala, toke sasala sèra uri heka miu. de limuri ne, j'ara dhu lèke ka dhu uri miu.

source_text: i say that thing that is of man, for the unsteadfastness, or the infirmity, or unstableness, of your flesh. but as ye have given your members to serve to uncleanness, and to wickedness into wickedness, so now give ye your members to serve to rightwiseness into holiness.
target_text: ja'a peka ne'e, pake conto dhu j'aj'i bèli-bèli, nèti lamatua dènge ènu, sèna ka miu me'a malai ngaa dhu ja'a peka-padhai. uru èèna, miu hia ngi'u miu j'aj'i ènu sèna ka tao sala, dhu pakaj'alu miu madhutu atora musa. te ngaa limuri ne, miu hud'i hia ngi'u miu j'aj'i ènu dhu me'a dhoka tao dhu be'a di, dhu hia miu j'aj'i dhèu mola-mèci ètu madha ama lamatua.

source_text: for when ye were servants of sin, ye were free of rightwiseness.
target_text: uru èèna, ropa miu dhoka nanene aa tao madhutu dad'èi sasala, miu mo'o boe nanene aa tao dhu lèke.

source_text: therefore what fruit had ye then in those things, in which ye shame now? for the end of them is death.
target_text: de ja'a neo karèi sèmi ne'e: miu abhu ngaa dhu be'a nèti tatao miu sèra? aad'o, sina ma? aa te ngaa, ngaa dhu miu abhu sèra tao miu mi'e makae di. lula miu tao sala sèmi èèna, ka dhu miu abhu, nuka lamatua soro kabodho mi miu.

source_text: but now ye delivered from sin, and made servants to god, have your fruit into holiness, and the end everlasting life.
target_text: te ngaa limuri ne, ama lamatua patalale eele le miu nèti lamatua uru èèna, de miu parluu ia ka tao sasala. de ne'e ne miu hud'i j'aj'i ku dhèu sab'a nèti ama lamatua. lèpa lod'o limuri, pe miu j'aj'i mola-mèci hia ne, aa abhu mamuri mola-mèci dhu d'ai mia-mia.

source_text: for the wages of sin is death; the grace of god is everlasting life in christ jesus our lord.
target_text: te ropa èdhi tao sasala, lamatua tule eele èdhi toke d'ai mia-mia. èèna ka dhu èdhi abhu. èdhi madhe kèna! te ngaa ama lamatua bhoke le j'ara èci hia èdhi. te na neo hia iia èdhi mamuri mola dhu ma'ète boe. èdhi abhu mamuri èèna, ladhe èdhi j'aj'i dhèu unu kètu èdhi, yesus kristus.

source_text: brethren, whether ye know not; for i speak to men that know the law; for the law hath lordship in a man, as long time as he liveth?
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! ja'a neo padhai lii dènge miu dhu me'a mèu atora huku sèra. sèmi ne'e ka: ladhe miu mamuri era, atora huku dènge hak ho ator miu. te ngaa ladhe miu madhe le, atora huku dènge heka hak mi miu.

source_text: for that woman that is under an husband, is bound to the law, while the husband liveth; but if her husband is dead, she is delivered or is unbound from the law of the husband.
target_text: ja'a kore pakasame nèti atora dhèu èmu-kamali. ladhe dhèu bhèni èci leo le èmu dènge mone èci, na, madhutu atora huku, dua ra j'aj'i dhèu èmu-kamali toke madhe. te ngaa ladhe dhèu mone madhe uuru, bhèni balu ne pa'èki heka dènge atora deo na. nèngu bisa hari leo-èmu.

source_text: therefore she shall be called adulteress, if she be with another man, while the husband liveth; but if her husband is dead, she is delivered from the law of the husband, that she be not adulteress, if she be with another man.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe bhèni ne leo hari èmu lod'o dhèu èmu na mamuri era, nèngu bersina. te ngaa ladhe dhèu èmu na madhe le, atora nèti laleo èmu lèke heka nèngu. bhèni ne j'aj'i dhèu kalora iisi. de ladhe na madhèdi hari dènge dhèu leo, madhutu atora, nèngu bersina boe.

source_text: and so, my brethren, ye be made dead to the law by or through the body of christ, that ye be of another, that rose again from death, that ye bear fruit to god.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi dènge miu dhèu parcaya! sèmi ne'e: kristus madhe le. èèna nuka sèmi miu madhutu madhe dènge ne kahèi, hèia tèke eele mamuri miu dhu dhui. ka atora huku lèke heka mi miu. limuri ne atora huku lèke heka miu, te ngaa mamuri miu pa'èki dènge kristus, dhu mamuri hari nèti mamadhe na. èèna cakaraa dènge bhèni balu dhu leo hari èmu. ngaa-ngaa tao boe. de limuri ne aa'i-aa'i dhu miu ad'u-ue sèra, hia mi lamatua.

source_text: for when we were in flesh, passions of sins, that were by the law, wrought in our members, to bear fruit to death.
target_text: te uru èèna, èdhi tao dhoka madhutu dad'èi ngi'u aae èdhi di. lula èdhi te'a atora, èèna ka dhu hia èdhi sisu atora sèra, ho tao j'ara-j'ara dhu lèke boe. de sasala èdhi sèra ka dhu tao ama lamatua soro kabodho mi èdhi.

source_text: but now we be unbound from the law of death, in which we were held, so that we serve in newness of spirit, and not in oldness of letter.
target_text: uru èèna, èdhi hud'i tao madhutu ku atora. te ngaa limuri ne, atora ne lèke heka èdhi, dhu tèke eele le mamuri dhu dhui. madhutu dad'èi j'ara dhui, na, atora musa dhu suri ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci èèna, dhu èki tèke èdhi. te ngaa madhutu dad'èi j'ara hiu, na, èdhi pa'èki heka dènge atora èèna. te roh lamatua ka dhu uri èdhi! nèti èèna ka, limuri ne èdhi sab'a dhoka hia lamatua.

source_text: what therefore shall we say? the law is sin? god forbid. but i knew not sin, but by the law; for i knew not that coveting was sin, but for the law said, thou shalt not covet.
target_text: de èdhi neo peka ngaa? neo peka, na, atora dhu lamatua hia re musa ne, sala! aad'o! te ladhe ja'a ke'a mèu boe atora ne, tatu ja'a bisa boe ke'a j'ara-j'ara dhu lèke boe ètu d'ara ja'a. nuka sèmi, abhu atora dhu peka na, mage d'ara neo mere mèdha-panyau dhèu. te ngaa dènge j'ara tasamia ka, ja'a bisa ke'a, na, d'ara neo sèmi èèna, sala, ladhe ke'a boe atora èèna? bisa boe!

source_text: and through occasion taken, sin by the commandment hath wrought in me all covetousness; for without the law, sin was dead.
target_text: te ngaa lula abhu atora dhu peka sèmi èèna, èèna nuka sèmi j'ara-j'ara bhelu ètu d'ara ja'a, sèna ka ja'a neo kore rupa-rupa mèdha-panyau dhèu. ladhe dènge boe atora dhu kai, sasala na abhu boe koasa ho ator dhèu.

source_text: and i lived without the law sometime; but when the commandment was come or had come, sin lived again. but i was dead,
target_text: ètu mamuri ja'a uru èèna, ja'a ke'a mèu mèka dad'èi nèti atora lamatua. nèbhu-nèbhu ku, heka ke'a kèna. nèti èèna ka, ja'a mulai mase'a, na, ja'a sisu le atora sèra ka ad'u-ue sasala. de hua nèti sasala èèna ka, ja'a hud'i madhe ku.

source_text: and this commandment that was to life, was found to me, to be to death.
target_text: hèia d'ara ja'a roe bhilu, te ke'a na, ja'a mesa ku bisa boe pabe'a ja'a dènge lamatua, ladhe tao madhutu dhoka atora na. de pantas ladhe ja'a abhu nanasa nèti lamatua, nuka huku madhe èèna, lula ja'a sisu le atora na. aa te ngaa lamatua hia atora ne, sèna ka dhèu bisa mamuri dhu lèke. te ngaa bagi ja'a, atora ne ka dhu pa'ele iie ja'a, ka lamatua soro kabodho mi ja'a.

source_text: for sin, through occasion taken by the commandment, deceived me, and by that it slew me.
target_text: atora ne mema pad'elo j'ara mamuri dhu mola. te ngaa abhu bhabhelu dhu sub'u ètu d'ara ja'a. nèti èèna ka, ja'a tipu hari ngi'u ja'a mesa ku, ho pangee na, ja'a bisa pabe'a ja'a dènge ama lamatua, sad'i ja'a tao madhutu atora na. hèia èèna nuka sèmi atora mesa èèna ka dhu tao toke lamatua mad'enge dènge ja'a.

source_text: therefore the law is holy, and the commandment is holy, and just, and good.
target_text: de ladhe deo na dhèu peka na, atora dhu lamatua hia re musa èèna, sala, na, ja'a dhaa na, aad'o! atora lamatua ne, mola-mèci! aa paredha aa'i-aa'i ètu d'ara atora ne mola-mèci, lèke, aa be'a kahèi.

source_text: is then that thing that is good, made death to me? god forbid. but sin, that it seem sin, through good thing wrought death to me, that me or that men sin over-manner through the commandment.
target_text: ele boe miu pangee, na, atora ne ka dhu tao lamatua soro kabodho mi ja'a, do? aad'o! te masi ka ja'a ke'a atora sèra, te ngaa ja'a nanene taruu bhabhelu ètu d'ara ja'a, nèti èèna ka ja'a tao sala. de nèti sasala ja'a èèna ka lamatua soro kabodho mi ja'a. atora ne mema be'a, te èèna ka dhu pad'elo j'ara-j'ara bhelu-katub'a dhu tao èdhi pacèri nèti ama lamatua. de ropa lamatua pad'elo j'ara mamuri dhu lèke, atora èèna ka dhu peka paled'a, na, bhabhelu ètu d'ara èdhi èèna, be'a boe.

source_text: and we know, that the law is spiritual; but i am fleshly, sold under sin.
target_text: èdhi te'a, na, atora dhu lamatua pangèd'u re musa, puru mai nèti roh lamatua. te ngaa ja'a ne dhoka dhèu rai-haha biasa di, dhu dènge d'ara dhu èra boe. hèia ja'a nanene j'ara-j'ara bhelu ètu d'ara ja'a, toke ja'a manahu asa d'ara sasala. èèna nuka sèmi sasala dhu j'aj'i lamatua ja'a, aa ja'a j'aj'i mi ènu nèti sasala.

source_text: for i understand not that that i work; for i do not the good thing that i will, but i do that evil thing that i hate.
target_text: pamalaa ja'a. ja'a ke'a boe ngaa ka dhu ja'a tao. te ja'a tao boe madhutu ngaa dhu ja'a neo tao. te ngaa ja'a tao madhutu ngaa dhu ja'a d'èi boe tao.

source_text: and if i do that thing that i will not, i consent to the law, that it is good.
target_text: ladhe ja'a tao ngaa dhu ja'a neo boe tao, ja'a mangaku, na, atora lamatua ne lèke.

source_text: but now i work not it now, but the sin that dwelleth in me.
target_text: de ja'a boe ka dhu uri ngi'u ja'a. te bhabhelu dhu muri ètu d'ara ja'a ka dhu uli ja'a!

source_text: but i know, that in me, that is, in my flesh, dwelleth no good; for will lieth to me, but i find not to perform good thing.
target_text: ja'a ke'a le, na, abhu boe j'ara dhu be'a muri ètu d'ara ja'a. te ja'a ne dhèu rai-haha dhu d'ara karehe. d'èi do d'èi boe, ja'a bisa boe pakaseti iisi sèna ka tao dhu lèke. ja'a d'èi tao dhu be'a, te ngaa j'aj'i boe!

source_text: for i do not that good thing that i will, but i do that evil thing that i will not.
target_text: te ja'a d'èi tao dhu be'a, te ngaa j'aj'i boe tao. aa ko'o boe tao dhu bhelu, te ngaa cèku tao!

source_text: and if i do that evil thing that i will not, i work not it, but the sin that dwelleth in me.
target_text: de ladhe ja'a ad'u-ue ngaa dhu ko'o boe tao, èèna mai boe nèti ja'a mesa ku, te ngaa lula sasala dhu muri ètu d'ara ja'a.

source_text: therefore i find the law or a law to me willing to do good thing, for evil thing lieth to me.
target_text: ne'e ne j'aj'i mi tate'a èci, sèmi ne'e ka: masi ka ja'a neo tao dhu be'a, te ngaa abhu bhabhelu dhu palab'a ètu d'ara ja'a.

source_text: for i delight together to the law of god, after the inner man.
target_text: aa te ngaa madhutu iia-iia ètu d'ara ja'a karej'e titu kèna, ladhe ja'a pangee atora lamatua.

source_text: but i see another law in my members, fighting against the law of my soul, and making me captive in the law of sin, that is in my members.
target_text: te ngaa nuka sèmi abhu koasa ètu d'ara ja'a dhu pa'ele iie ja'a. te ja'a neo tao dhu be'a, te ngaa j'aj'i boe. èèna nuka sèmi koasa bhabhelu ètu d'ara ja'a dhu kèpe nare ja'a, ho laka-seti madhutu ne.

source_text: i am an unhappy or a woeful man; who shall deliver me from the body of this sin?
target_text: ira ii, kasian, ee! ja'a ne dhèu j'èra! dhèu cee ka dhu bisa patabuli ja'a nèti koasa bhabhelu dhu muri ètu d'ara ja'a ne, dhu tao lamatua mad'enge dènge ja'a?

source_text: the grace of god, by jesus christ our lord. therefore i myself by the soul serve to the law of god; but by the flesh to the law of sin.
target_text: te ngaa malo-malo ka! ama lamatua unu na ka dhu bhoke j'ara ho patabuli eele ja'a! ja'a manèngi makasi ae-ae mi lamatua, lula kètu èdhi yesus kristus bisa hia mamuri mi ja'a! de ladhe ja'a mamuri maena dhoka mi ngi'u ja'a di, na, ja'a j'èra. masi ka ja'a neo tao madhutu atora lamatua, te ngaa abhu koasa bhabhelu ètu d'ara ja'a, dadugu ja'a, sèna ka tao taruu dhoka bhabhelu-katub'a di.

source_text: therefore now nothing of condemnation is to them that be in christ jesus, which wander not after the flesh.
target_text: de ama lamatua huku boe dhèu dhu pa'èki dènge yesus kristus!
