target_text: de ladhe na j'aj'i kètu, èdhi dhèu parcaya j'aj'i nuka sèmi ngi'u na. bèli-camèd'a èdhi ka dhu sab'a pa'èle aa'i mèu sasab'a dhu na pakako lod'o na ètu rai-haha ne era. te nèngu ka dènge koasa ho paj'aj'i aa'i mèu-mèu madhutu dad'èi ama lamatua. lii sabaj'a ja'a sèmi ne'e ka hia miu.

source_text: and when ye were dead in your guilts and sins,
target_text: uru èèna, miu sisu paredha ama lamatua, aa ad'u-ue rupa-rupa sasala. nèti èèna ka lamatua peka na, miu nuka sèmi dhèu dhu madhe le.

source_text: in which ye wandered sometime, after the course of this world, after the prince of the power of this air, of the spirit that worketh now into the sons of unbelief;
target_text: uru èèna, mamuri miu madhutu dad'èi rai-haha ne, dènge dad'èi dhèu aae nidhu. toke d'ai sange ne'e, nidhu loe boe dadugu-rariu dhèu rai-haha, sèna ka palab'a dènge ama lamatua.

source_text: in which also we all lived sometime in the desires of our flesh, doing the wills of the flesh and of the thoughts, and we were by kind the sons of wrath, as other men;
target_text: uru èèna, èdhi mamuri sèmi èèna kahèi, ka ngaa dhu èdhi rasa do, pangee do, èdhi tao madhutu dad'èi d'ara di. te èdhi dhèu bhelu, èci èèna ka dènge dhèu rai-haha aa'i-aa'i. nèti èèna ka ama lamatua nasa titu kèna dènge èdhi,

source_text: but god, that is rich in mercy, for his full much charity in which he loved us, yea, when we were dead in sins, quickened us together in christ, by whose grace ye be saved,
target_text: aa pangee na, èdhi nuka sèmi dhèu madhe kahèi dhu cèri eele nèti nèngu. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa d'ara na la'e boe lula na sue èdhi titu kèna. nèti èèna ka, na pad'elo d'ara hua iia na, aa pua yesus kristus mai sèna ka pala-bagi mamuri hiu hia èdhi. de lamatua ka dhu hia mamuri mi èdhi lula d'ara hua iia na.

source_text: and again-raised together, and made together to sit in heavenly things in christ jesus;
target_text: yesus kristus madhe, te ngaa ama lamatua pamamuri hari ne. hèia lamatua ded'e ne ho nèd'u paredha ètu sorga. lamatua tao sèmi èèna kahèi mi dedha èdhi, na pala-bagi mamuri hiu mi èdhi, hèia na ded'e èdhi, ka tèd'u paredha sama-sama dènge kristus ètu sorga.

source_text: that he should show in the worlds above coming the plenteous riches of his grace in goodness on us in christ jesus.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, mulai nèti doe ne'e, d'ai mia-mia la'e, ama lamatua pad'elo d'ara sasue na ae-ae, dènge d'ara hua iia na dhu risi aa'i èèna, lula èdhi parcaya yesus kristus.

source_text: for by grace ye be saved by faith, and this not of you; for it is the gift of god, not of works, that no man have glory.
target_text: ropa miu parcaya kristus, ama lamatua hia miu mamuri, lula d'ara hua iia na. na hia mamuri sèmi èèna, baku pangee, na, nèngu b'ala ngaa dhu miu tao. lula mamuri èèna j'aj'i hadia dhu na hia iia d'ara mi miu. nèti èèna ka, miu baku padedha iisi nèti ngaa dhu miu tao.

source_text: for we be the making of him, made of nought in christ jesus, in good works, which god hath ordained, that we go in those works.
target_text: èdhi mamuri, lula ama lamatua ka dhu paj'aj'i èdhi. hèia yesus kristus hia èdhi mamuri hiu, sèna ka èdhi tao j'ara-j'ara dhu be'a, dhu lamatua pama'ète nare le karèi nèti uru ka.

source_text: for which thing be ye mindful that sometime ye were heathen in flesh, which were said prepuce, from that that is said circumcision made by hand in flesh;
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! miu me'a le, na, dhèu yahudi kèpe pa'èra-èra atora suna rèngu, aa ra pusi-pahae boe miu dhèu yahudi boe, lula mo'o boe madhutu atora èèna! madhutu iia-iia na, atora suna ne dhoka nèti ngi'u aae di, nèti boe d'ara dhèu.

source_text: and ye were in that time without christ, alienated or strangers from the living of israel, and guests of the testaments, not having hope of promise, and without god in this world.
target_text: lod'o miu dhae parcaya mèka yesus kristus, miu dènge mèka hak ho j'aj'i dhèu unu ama lamatua. te uru èèna, miu dhae maso mèka asa d'ara lii pajaji ama lamatua dhu na pa'èki tèke mi abraham, aa dènge ana-èpu na. lod'o èèna, miu mamuri ètu rai-haha, te ngaa bisa boe maena mi ama lamatua, lula miu j'aj'i dhèu leo rai kara era,

source_text: but now in christ jesus ye that were sometime far, be made nigh in the blood of christ.
target_text: dhu cèri nèti lamatua. te ngaa limuri ne, yesus kristus bhoke nare le j'ara, sèna ka miu bisa pa'èki dènge ama lamatua. te kristus madhe sèna ka cuhi d'ara lamatua, ho miu bisa padame dènge ne, aa bisa j'aj'i dhèu unu na.

source_text: for he is our peace, that made both one, and unbinding the middle wall of a wall without mortar,
target_text: uru èèna, ji'i dhèu yahudi ngo'o boe mamuri dame dènge miu dhèu leo rai kara. nuka sèmi kadidhi dhu hag'e eele èdhi. te ngaa lula mamadhe yesus ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha, ka na paguri eele le kadidhi èèna, sèna ka èdhi dhu uru èèna pamusu, bisa padame hari ho j'aj'i mi ca suku.

source_text: enmities in his flesh; and voided the law of commandments by dooms, that he make two in himself into a new man, making peace,
target_text: te uru èèna, dhèu yahudi tenge j'ara ho pake atora agama rèngu sèna ka pabe'a dènge ama lamatua. te ngaa ropa yesus kristus madhe, na pa'ele iie le j'ara dhui, aa bhoke j'ara hiu, sèna ka dhèu yahudi dènge dhèu leo kara, dua-dua ra bisa mamuri pabe'a dènge ama lamatua. dènge sèmi èèna, rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra pa'èki j'aj'i mi ca suku dhu hiu, dhu mamuri mera-milu.

source_text: to reconcile both in one body to god by the cross, slaying the enmities in himself.
target_text: de kristus madhe ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha sèna ka tao dua suku sèra j'aj'i mi èci, aa nèti hari si asa ama lamatua. te kristus palaho eele aa'i le ngaa dhu uru èèna tao rèngu ho pamusu.

source_text: and he coming preached peace to you that were far, and peace to them that were nigh;
target_text: nèngu mai asa rai-haha ne, nèti lii lolo be'a hia dhèu yahudi dènge dhèu leo kara sèra, dhu lole na, uru èèna miu mamuri pamusu, te ngaa limuri ne abhu le j'ara sèna ka miu bisa mamuri padame èci dènge èci.

source_text: for by him we both have nigh coming in one spirit to the father.
target_text: de ji'i dhèu yahudi dènge miu dhèu yahudi boe, aa'i-aa'i ti abhu j'ara ho lati asa ama lamatua èdhi, lula yesus bhoke le j'ara hia èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti. aa roh ama lamatua dhu mola-mèci pad'elo j'ara mi èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti kahèi.

source_text: therefore now ye be not guests and strangers, but ye be citizens of saints, and the household meine of god;
target_text: lula pa'ue-ai yesus kristus, nèti èèna ka miu dhèu yahudi boe j'aj'i heka dhèu leo rai kara dhu dènge boe hak ngaa-ngaa. te limuri ne, miu unu le hak ho j'aj'i ana kabarai sorga, lula ama lamatua ded'e le miu j'aj'i ana-èpu na.

source_text: above builded on the founda-ment of apostles and of prophets, upon that highest cornerstone, christ jesus;
target_text: ne'e ne, nuka sèmi ama lamatua neo patitu èmu cue. na patitu hadhu dhu padhèdi uru, nuka yesus kristus. hèia na tao fanderen, nuka dhèu rèti lii padhai na dènge dhèu pajuu-paleha na. ka na padhèdi hadhu se pagod'o-god'o ètu dedha sèra aa'i-aa'i. hadhu se, nuka èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti dhu j'aj'i le ana-èpu na.

source_text: in whom each building made waxeth into an holy temple in the lord.
target_text: èmu ne titu èra bia, lula hadhu se dhu pagod'o si dènge be'a ètu dedha hadhu dhu padhèdi uru sèra. aa èmu èèna nèbhu-nèbhu asa kapai, ka dhèu lasi asa d'ara èmu èèna, sèna ka manèngi-mangaj'i mi ama lamatua.

source_text: in whom also ye be builded together into the habitation of god, in the holy ghost.
target_text: de limuri ne, ama lamatua tao sèna ka miu dhèu yahudi boe kahèi j'aj'i nuka sèmi hadhu, sama-sama dènge ji'i dhèu yahudi. ama lamatua padhèdi pagod'o-god'o èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti, ho j'aj'i era pea roh na.

source_text: for the grace of this thing i, paul, the bound of christ jesus, for you heathen men,
target_text: lula ama lamatua hag'e boe dhèu yahudi dènge dhèu yahudi boe, nèti èèna ka na pua ja'a, paulus, ho lole lii lolo be'a yesus kristus dènge miu dhèu yahudi boe ètu d'ara kota epesus. ja'a pakako le sasab'a ja'a, toke ja'a j'aj'i ana bèdho.

source_text: if nevertheless ye have heard the dispensation of god's grace, that is given to me in you.
target_text: tatu miu me'a kahèi, na, ama lamatua pua-paleha ja'a mai, lula na neo pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi miu.

source_text: for by revelation the sacrament is made known to me, as i above wrote in short thing,
target_text: uru èèna, mema ama lamatua dhae peka mèka dènge dhèu rai-haha ne, lula-nèti ngaa dhu na pama'ète hia mi dhèu dhu yahudi boe. te ngaa limuri ne, nèngu peka le dènge ja'a, j'ara ne aa'i-aa'i ra. aa ne'e ne, ja'a dhu suri pabab'a-bab'a le ètu sasuri ne hia miu.

source_text: as ye may read, and understand my prudence in the mystery of christ.
target_text: ladhe miu baca mere, tatu miu bisa me'a kahèi dad'èi ama lamatua mi yesus kristus, dhu na bhoke hia ja'a.

source_text: which was not known to other generations to the sons of men, as it is now showed to his holy apostles and prophets in the spirit,
target_text: te uru èèna, dhèu rai-haha re'a mèka dad'èi na. te ngaa limuri ne, na pake le roh na, sèna ka peka dad'èi na mi dhèu rèti lii padhai na, dènge dhèu pajuu-paleha na.

source_text: that heathen men be even-heirs, and of one body, and partners together of his promise in christ jesus by the evangel;
target_text: te karèi nèti uru ka, ama lamatua pama'ète le sèmi ne'e: ladhe dhèu yahudi boe parcaya lii lolo be'a yesus kristus, rèngu bisa j'aj'i kahèi ana-ana ama lamatua, sama sèmi dhèu yahudi sèra. nèti èèna ka, limuri ne èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti pa'a'ari le, aa èdhi sama-sama bisa abhu mèngi-nale nèti ama èdhi, ama lamatua.

source_text: whose minister i am made, by the gift of god's grace, which is given to me by the working of his virtue.
target_text: ama lamatua pad'elo d'ara hua iia na, ka hag'e nare ja'a j'aj'i dhèu pajuu-paleha na. aa na pangèd'u koasa na mi ja'a kahèi, sèna ka pakako sasab'a na.

source_text: to me, least of all saints, this grace is given to preach or to evangelize among heathen men the unsearchable riches of christ,
target_text: nèti dhèu unu lamatua aa'i-aa'i, ja'a ne haha d'ai seli. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa lamatua hag'e nare ja'a, ho pakako sasab'a na dhu kapai risi eele èèna. dad'èi na sèna ka ja'a lole dènge dhèu yahudi boe, lula-nèti d'ara hua iia yesus kristus dhu dènge boe too-lane.

source_text: and to enlighten all men, which is the dispensation of the sacrament hid from worlds in god, that made all things of nought;
target_text: te karèi nèti ama lamatua paj'aj'i rai-haha ne, dad'èi na neo hia kristus mai èèna, dhu pahuni era. te ngaa limuri ne, nèngu neo, sèna ka ja'a lole dènge dhèu aa'i-aa'i, ho ra re'a mèu dad'èi na èèna.

source_text: that the much-fold wisdom of god be known to princes and potentates in heavenly things by the church,
target_text: te dad'èi na èèna, d'èlu-mèu risi eele. hèia nèngu neo pake dhèu unu na, ho pad'elo mamèu na mi koasa-koasa dhu leo, aa mi aa'i-aa'i dhu rèd'u paredha ètu dedha-liru.

source_text: by the before-ordinance or after the setting of worlds, which he made in christ jesus our lord.
target_text: lod'o dhu na paj'aj'i mèka rai-haha ne, nèngu pama'ète nare le neo bhoke j'ara ho patabuli eele dhèu rai-haha nèti koasa sasala-sasigo ra. nèti èèna ka, na pake kètu èdhi, yesus kristus, sèna ka tao madhutu sèmi èèna.

source_text: in whom we have trust and nigh coming to, in trusting by the faith of him.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, èdhi dhu parcaya yesus kristus, parluu heka madha'u padhai lii dènge ama lamatua. te nèngu dhu pakabhèle mema ai na, sèna ka sèmi nare èdhi lod'o mia èèna ka.

source_text: for which thing i ask, that ye fail not in my tribulations for you, which is your glory.
target_text: sanèd'e, ee! ja'a j'èra lula lalau-lalo'o miu dhèu yahudi boe. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa d'ara miu mage èra boe kahèi. ja'a pasae kore j'aj'èra ne, lula neo pa'èra miu ho sèmi mere babe'a na.

source_text: for grace of this thing i bow my knees to the father of our lord jesus christ,
target_text: lod'o dhu ja'a ngee kèdhi d'ara hua iia ama lamatua dhu risi eele èèna, hèia ja'a patitu kètu urutuu ho manèngi makasi.

source_text: of whom each fatherhood in heavens or in heaven and in earth is named,
target_text: te a'ari aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha dènge ètu sorga unu dhoka ama èci di, nuka ama lamatua.

source_text: that he give to you, after the riches of his glory, virtue to be strengthened by his spirit in the inner man,
target_text: ja'a sabaj'a sèna ka na hia mèngi-nale ae-ae mi dedha miu, madhutu dad'èi d'ara na dhu hua iia risi èèna. aa ja'a manèngi kahèi ho na hia roh na, dènge koasa na, sèna ka pa'èra d'ara miu.

source_text: that christ dwell by faith in your hearts; that ye rooted and grounded in charity,
target_text: ja'a manèngi ho yesus kristus pea ètu d'ara miu, lula miu parcaya ne taruu. aa ja'a sabaj'a kahèi sèna ka miu mamuri pa'èki dènge sasue na, nuka sèmi ana aaj'u asa èra, lula amo na maso marèma asa d'ara rai.

source_text: may comprehend with all saints, which is the breadth, and the length, and the highness, and the deepness; also to know the charity of christ more excellent than science, that ye be full-filled in all the plenty of god.
target_text: ja'a sabaj'a kahèi ho miu dènge dhèu unu lamatua aa'i-aa'i bisa me'a mèu sasue kristus dhu dhèu rai-haha ne d'èu rare boe. te sasue ne, kapai titu kèna, taleo titu kèna, marèma titu kèna, aa ae titu kèna! ja'a sabaj'a kahèi sèna ka miu rasa sasue na, toke sasue ne maso papènu d'ara dènge mamuri miu.

source_text: and to him that is mighty to do all things more plenteously than we ask or understand, by the virtue that worketh in us,
target_text: koasa ama lamatua kapai titu kèna, risi aa'i nèti dhu èdhi manèngi dènge dhu èdhi bisa ngee. aa na pake koasa na dhu kapai aae èèna, ho sab'a ètu d'ara èdhi.

source_text: to him be glory in the church, and in christ jesus, into all the generations of the worlds of worlds. amen.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, èdhi dhu pa'èki le dènge kristus, ti ded'e ne padedha-dedha! koa-kio ne taruu, mulai nèti doe ne'e, toke d'ai mia-mia la'e. ne'e ka dhu lèke!

source_text: therefore i bound for the lord beseech you, that ye walk worthily in the calling, in which ye be called,
target_text: ja'a pakako le sasab'a lamatua ja'a, toke ja'a j'aj'i ana bèdho. de limuri ne ja'a pamako miu, sèna ka mamuri mola madhutu dad'èi ama lamatua, lula na paroa nare le miu, sèna ka j'aj'i dhèu unu na.

source_text: with all meekness and mildness, with patience supporting each other in charity,
target_text: nèti èèna ka, miu hud'i mamuri dènge pahaha iisi, aa pamaho'o èci dènge èci. miu hud'i taha mere d'ara, aa tadhe mèu èci dènge èci, ho mamuri pasue dhu tare'a. ladhe nèti miu, abhu dhu tenge lii langu dènge angalai na, baku tèka d'ara dènge ne kahèi.

source_text: busy to keep unity of spirit in the bond of peace.
target_text: tenge j'ara ho muri dame èci dènge èci, lula roh ama lamatua dhu èki le miu j'aj'i mi èci.

source_text: one body and one spirit, as ye be called in one hope of your calling;
target_text: te dhèu unu yesus kristus dhu j'aj'i le èci, nuka sèmi ngi'u kristus unu na. aa rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra sèmi rare le roh lamatua dhu dhoka èci èèna di. aa rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra sanao-maena dhoka mi ama lamatua di, lula nèngu ka dhu paroa nare si ho j'aj'i dhèu unu na.

source_text: one lord, one faith, one baptism,
target_text: lamatua èdhi, dhoka èci di; parcaya èdhi, dhoka ca j'ara di, sèna ka bisa padame dènge ne. aa èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti abhu sarani, sèna ka pa'èki dènge ne.

source_text: one god and father of all, which is above all men, and by all things, and in us all.
target_text: ama lamatua, dhoka èci di, aa ama èdhi, dhoka nèngu di. dhoka nèngu di dhu paredha èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti. dhoka nèngu di dhu bera-bera dènge èdhi. aa nèngu mesa na di dhu mamuri ètu d'ara èdhi.

source_text: but to each of us grace is given by or after the measure of the giving of christ;
target_text: te ngaa yesus kristus pala-bagi le koasa na mi èdhi, sèna ka èdhi èci-èci ka pakako sasab'a na.

source_text: for which thing he saith, he ascending on high, led captivity captive, he gave gifts to men.
target_text: nèti èèna ka sasuri ama lamatua, peka na, nèngu ca'e la'e asa era dedha, sèna ka na pamusu ètu èèna toke segi. hèia ère nèti dhèu ae-ae dhu lèke taha, aa papala hadia mi dhèu rai-haha.

source_text: but what is it, that he went up or ascended, no but that also he came down first into the lower parts of the earth?
target_text: sanèd'e lii-lii dhu peka na, nèngu ca'e la'e. ladhe na ca'e la'e, sasoa na, uru èèna na puru nèdhi le asa rai-haha ne.

source_text: he it is that came down, and that ascended or went up on all heavens, that he should fill all things.
target_text: de dhèu dhu puru mai èèna, nuka kristus. te nèngu ca'e hari asa sorga, sèna ka bisa uri aa'i dhu ètu dedha-liru dènge ètu rai-haha.

source_text: and he gave some apostles, some prophets, others evangelists, others shepherds and teachers,
target_text: kristus dhu pangèd'u koasa mi dhèu unu na, sèna ka ra pakako sasab'a-la'a dhu na pala-bagi hia rèngu. abhu cahag'e dhu na hia si koasa ho j'aj'i dhèu pajuu-paleha na; cahag'e j'aj'i dhèu rèti lii padhai na; cahag'e j'aj'i sèmi ca dhèu ama sa, ho lalau-lalo'o dhèu unu kristus; cahag'e j'aj'i dhèu d'èlu-mèu ho aj'a dhèu unu na; aa cahag'e hari j'aj'i dhèu dhu tema rèti lii lolo be'a asa era-era dhu hiu.

source_text: to the full ending of saints, into the work of ministry, into the edification of christ's body,
target_text: ca dhèu-dhèu ka sèmi rare sasab'a ra, sèna ka pa'èra dhèu-dhèu parcaya ho aa'i-aa'i ra bisa pakako sasab'a lamatua. dènge j'ara ne'e, èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti dhu parcaya yesus kristus asa tabha èra,

source_text: till we run all, into or in unity of faith and of knowing of god's son, into a perfect man, after the measure of the age of the plenty of christ; that we be not now little children, moving as waves, and be not borne about with each wind of teaching, in the waywardness of men, in subtle wit, to the deceiving of error.
target_text: toke èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti parcaya d'ara èci. aa èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti tadhe tare'a-re'a ana ama lamatua. èdhi sèmi heka ana iiki, lula èdhi madhutu mola-mola le j'ara nèngu, aa j'aj'i le dhèu dhu mamuri madhutu dad'èi na. ladhe èdhi mamuri ka sèmi èèna, èdhi sèmi heka koha dhu dènge boe uli, ka madhutu dhoka rii di. te ladhe dhèu kapod'e-kabèli mai aj'a pagoa èdhi, ra tao rare boe.

source_text: but do we truth in charity, and wax in him by all things, that is christ our head;
target_text: te ngaa èdhi dènge lii mako lole dhoka ngaa dhu lèke hia mi a'ari èdhi sèra, lula èdhi sue rèngu. aa ladhe èdhi mamuri sèmi èèna ètu d'ara ngaa èèna ka, èdhi j'aj'i ca ropa dènge kristus. te nèngu ne kètu èdhi dhu uri èdhi.

source_text: of whom all the body set together, and bound together by each jointure of under-serving, by working into the measure of each member, maketh increasing of the body, into the edification of itself in charity.
target_text: aa èdhi j'aj'i nuka sèmi ngi'u na. sama sèmi ngi'u dhèu èci, dhu dènge musi madha, hèb'a, kacui-aai, aa haga, ladhe sab'a sama-sama madhutu sasab'a ra èci-èci, na, ngi'u na asa tabha èra. sèmi èèna kahèi dènge dhèu unu yesus kristus sèra. ladhe èdhi pasue aa soru-bara èci dènge èci, tatu èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti asa tabha èra kahèi.

source_text: therefore i say and witness this thing in the lord, that ye walk not now, as heathen men walk, in the vanity of their wit;
target_text: nanene paie-iie, ngaa dhu ja'a neo peka, lula kètu ja'a, yesus kristus ka dhu nori ja'a. miu mamuri ia ka sèmi dhèu dhu tadhe boe ama lamatua. lula ngaa dhu ra tao sèra madhutu dhoka gagoa ra.

source_text: that have understanding darkened with darknesses, and be alienated or made far from the life of god, by ignorance that is in them, for the blindness of their heart.
target_text: rèngu raga leli, nuka sèmi dhèu kako ètu d'ara maroga. ra mamuri pacèri nèti ama lamatua, lula ra kètu hadhu, aa pusi-pahae boe ne.

source_text: which despairing betook them-selves to unchastity, into the working of all uncleanness in covetousness.
target_text: rèngu re'a heka makae. nèti èèna ka, ra madhutu dhoka dad'èi d'ara ho ad'u-ue j'ara makae dènge mamuri kaj'alu. te ngaa re'a boe roca kahèi.

source_text: but ye have not so learned christ,
target_text: te ngaa dhèu aj'a-nori boe miu j'ara mamuri kristus sèmi èèna!

source_text: if nevertheless ye heard him, and be taught in him, as is truth in jesus.
target_text: te, ngaa dhu miu me'a le lula-nèti yesus kristus, a'aj'a èèna ka dhu mola. tatu miu tadèngi le!

source_text: do ye away by the old living or after the first living, the old man, that is corrupt by the desires of error;
target_text: de tèke eele j'ara mamuri miu dhu dhui èèna! te ladhe miu mamuri kaj'alu madhutu dad'èi dhèu rai-haha, na, miu dhu lèke le tipu. miu dènge heka hak mamuri sèmi uru èèna.

source_text: and be ye renewed or made new again in the spirit of your soul;
target_text: te ngaa hud'i laa ama lamatua tao d'ara dènge ngangee miu j'aj'i hiu,

source_text: and clothe ye the new man, which is made after god in rightwiseness and holiness of truth.
target_text: ho miu j'aj'i dhèu hiu, madhutu ropa na. nèti èèna ka, miu hud'i pad'elo ku d'ara hiu miu, dhu mola-mèci dènge mera-milu.

source_text: for which thing put ye away leasing, and speak ye truth each man with his neighbour, for we be members each to other or together.
target_text: de limuri ne, loe eele ka nèti kapod'e-kabèli! padhai lii èci dènge èci dhu mola, te èdhi dhu pa'èki le j'aj'i mi èci, nuka sèmi ngi'u èci dhu dènge musi madha, hèb'a, kacui-aai, aa dènge haga.

source_text: be ye wroth, and do not do sin or do not ye sin; the sun fall not down on your wrath.
target_text: ladhe nasa, baku ad'u sasala kahèi. hua iia miu pabe'a hari! baku tèke nanasa toke lod'o cèna!

source_text: do not ye give stead to the devil.
target_text: dènge j'ara ne, dhèu aae nidhu bisa boe dadugu-rariu miu. baku golo ne!

source_text: he that stole, now steal he not; but more rather travail he in working with his hands that that is good, that he have whereof he shall give to the needy.
target_text: dhèu dhu d'èi mana'u, ae eele ka! be'a risi dhèu sèmi sèra sab'a pake kacui-aai unu ra, sèna ka rui-j'aj'èra na soru-bara dhèu dhu unu aad'o sèra.

source_text: each evil word go not out of your mouth; but if any is good to the edification of faith, that it give grace to men that hear.
target_text: ladhe padhai lii, na, baku hia lii karehe, masi ka ca hèb'a doko-doko di! hua iia risi padhai lii dhu be'a di. aa holo dhèu sèna ka ra soru-bara dènge be'a, aa pa'èra d'ara si.

source_text: and do not ye make the holy ghost of god sorry, or heavy, in which ye be marked in the day of redemption.
target_text: baku papèd'a d'ara roh ama lamatua, te nèngu pea ètu d'ara miu. aa na cap nare miu, peka na, miu j'aj'i le dhèu unu ama lamatua. roh na j'aj'i mi tadha, peka na, toke d'ai èle rai-haha ne, ama lamatua sui nare miu, sèna ka mamuri taruu dènge ne.

source_text: all bitterness, and wrath, and indignation, and cry, and blasphemy be taken away from you, with all malice;
target_text: de baku tèka d'ara dènge dhèu leo! bqku kadhi ngutu dènge dhèu! baku panasa! baku patao-palaha! baku padhai kakoli pa'ele iie kolongara dhèu! aa baku ad'u-ue j'ara bhabhelu dhu leo-leo hèi!

source_text: and be ye together benign, or of good will, merciful, forgiving together, as also god forgave to you in christ.
target_text: te ngaa be'a risi mi pasue, aa tao j'ara dhu be'a èci dènge èci. miu hud'i pabhèlu eele ku sasala dhèu, aa hia si abho, sama sèmi ama lamatua saku eele sasala miu, lula miu pa'èki le dènge kristus.

source_text: therefore be ye followers of god, as most dearworthy sons;
target_text: miu ana pasue ama lamatua. nèti èèna ka, miu hud'i madhutu ku dad'èi na.

source_text: and walk ye in love, as christ loved us, and gave himself for us an offering and a sacrifice to god, into the odour of sweetness.
target_text: aa miu hud'i mamuri pasue ku èci dènge èci, sama sèmi kristus sue miu. te na soro le ngi'u na, ho madhe gati èdhi. dènge j'ara ne'e, nèngu j'aj'i nuka sèmi badha sogo-tagu dhu ra tunu ka hèu mèngi, sèna ka pakarej'e d'ara ama lamatua.

source_text: and fornication, and all unclean-ness, or avarice, be not named among you, as it becometh holy men;
target_text: miu dhèu mola-mèci unu ama lamatua kahèi. de baku mamuri dènge d'ara kaj'alu! baku ngee madha j'ara kaj'alu kahèi! de baku tao j'ara karehe dènge dhèu dhu j'aj'i boe dhèu èmu-kamali èu! baku manga'a dèu ngara!

source_text: either filth, or folly speech, or buffoonery or harlotry, that pertaineth not to profit, but more rather doing of thankings.
target_text: baku padhai lii kaj'alu! aa baku padhai lii leli! te dhèu unu ama lamatua, ladhe padhai lii sèmi sèra, lèke boe. hua iia risi miu padhai lii be'a aa manèngi makasi mi lamatua.

source_text: for know ye this, and understand, that each lecher or each fornicator, or unclean man, or covetous man, that serveth to maumets or to idols, hath not heritage in the kingdom of christ and of god.
target_text: sanèd'e paie-iie! te ama lamatua nare boe dhèu dhu mamuri kaj'alu, aa dhèu dhu tao j'ara karehe dènge dhèu dhu j'aj'i boe dhèu èmu-kamali nèngu! rèngu bisa boe j'aj'i dhèu unu kristus, aa ama lamatua j'aj'i boe dhèu aae rèngu. ama lamatua sèmi nare boe kahèi dhèu dhu manga'a dèu ngara, lula rèngu seti eele ne, ka ra pakab'ua risi j'ara dhu leo sèra.

source_text: no man deceive you by vain words; for why for these things the wrath of god came upon the sons of unbelief.
target_text: mage dhèu pagoa miu dènge padhai lii hèb'a hua, peka na, mamuri kaj'alu ciki di, ngaa-ngaa tao boe, we! te tatu ama lamatua nasa mi dhèu dhu mamuri madhutu boe dad'èi na.

source_text: therefore do not ye be made partners of them.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, baku pa'èki ngi'u dènge dhèu sèmi sèra.

source_text: for ye were sometime darknesses, but now ye be light in the lord. walk ye as the sons of light.
target_text: uru èèna, miu nuka sèmi dhèu dhu mamuri ètu d'ara maroga, lula miu tadhe mèka ama lamatua. te ngaa limuri ne, na hia le saraa, sèna ka tao miu j'aj'i ana-ana na. nèti èèna ka, miu hud'i mamuri ètu d'ara saraa na.

source_text: for the fruit of light is in all goodness, and rightwiseness, and truth.
target_text: te dhèu dhu mamuri taruu ètu d'ara saraa, dhèu ne tao j'ara dhu be'a, mamuri mola, aa leko-monya boe.

source_text: and prove ye what thing is well pleasing to god.
target_text: tenge taruu j'ara ho pakarej'e d'ara ama lamatua, lula nèngu ne dhèu aae èdhi.

source_text: and do not ye commune to unfruiteous works of darknesses; but more rather reprove ye them.
target_text: baku pa'èki ngi'u dènge dhèu dhu mamuri ètu d'ara maroga. te tatao ra, gaguna aad'o. de mi pasanèd'e si, aa bhoke paled'a sasala-sasigo ra.

source_text: for what things be done of them in privy, it is foul, yea, to speak.
target_text: te, ngaa dhu ra ad'u-ue pahuni-pacub'i, kaj'alu titu kèna, toke èdhi makae, ladhe neo padhai lii j'ara-j'ara sèra.

source_text: and all things that be reproved of the light, be openly showed or be made open; for all thing that is showed, is light.
target_text: ja'a pakasame sèmi ne'e: ladhe dhèu d'elo mèdha èci ètu d'ara maroga, tatu dhèu bisa rèdhi mèu.

source_text: for which thing he saith, rise thou that sleepest, and rise up from death, and christ shall lighten or illumine thee.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi, ladhe èdhi peka paled'a j'ara bhelu dhu dhèu ad'u-ue, nèngu bisa ne'a, na, j'ara dhu na ad'u-ue ne, karehe. abhu lii sod'a èci, peka na, wee! miu dhu bhèj'i, kèd'i ka! miu dhu madhe, mamuri hari ka! te kristus neo hia saraa mi miu.

source_text: therefore, brethren, see ye, how warily ye shall go; not as unwise men, but as wise men,
target_text: nèti èèna ka, miu èci-èci parisa paie mamuri mi, sèna ka baku sèmi dhèu goa. be'a risi pake ngangee dhu be'a nèti ama lamatua.

source_text: again-buying the time, for the days be evil.
target_text: limuri ne dhèu loe boe tao j'ara-j'ara bhabhelu. de ladhe abhu lod'o tao j'ara dhu be'a, na baku pamata!

source_text: therefore do not ye be made unwise, but understanding which is the will of god or of the lord.
target_text: pangee paie-iie, ho me'a mèu dad'èi lamatua èdhi, sèna ka baku mi goa.

source_text: and do not ye be drunk of wine, in which is lechery or is luxury, but be ye filled with the holy ghost;
target_text: baku mahu, te, ngaa dhu miu minu èèna ka dhu uli miu, sèna ka tao j'ara dhu karehe. te ngaa bhoke d'ara miu, sèna ka roh ama lamatua dhu mola-mèci èèna ka dhu uli miu.

source_text: and speak ye to yourselves in psalms, and hymns, and spiritual songs, singing and saying psalm in your hearts to the lord;
target_text: de padhai lii èci dènge èci pake lii holo-nori ama lamatua, mèti lii koa-kio mi nèngu, aa mèti lii sod'a dhu miu abhu nèti roh mola-mèci na. aa ladhe sod'a, baku dhoka ètu hèb'a di, te ngaa koa-kio ama lamatua dènge d'ara kateme.

source_text: evermore doing thankings for all things, in the name of our lord jesus christ to god and to the father.
target_text: te yesus kristus j'aj'i le kètu èdhi, aa ama lamatua dhu tao le j'ara-j'ara ae titu kèna hia èdhi. nèti èèna ka, èdhi baku loe manèngi makasi mi lamatua.

source_text: be ye subject together in the dread of christ.
target_text: miu aa'i-aa'i mi, hud'i mamuri èci nanene èci. dènge j'ara ne'e, miu pakab'ua yesus kristus.

source_text: women, be they subject to their husbands, as to the lord,
target_text: bhèni dhu dènge dhèu èmu! miu hud'i mamuri nanene dhèu èmu mi, sama sèmi miu nanene yesus kristus, kètu miu.

source_text: for the man is head of the woman, as christ is head of the church; he is saviour of his body.
target_text: te dhèu èmu miu èèna, nuka sèmi kètu nèti miu bhèni se. aa yesus kristus kahèi j'aj'i kètu nèti dhèu unu na. te nèngu ka dhu bhoke j'ara ho dhèu abhu mamuri.

source_text: but as the church is subject to christ, so women to their husbands in all things.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, dhèu unu kristus hud'i mamuri nanene paie-iie nèngu. de sèmi èèna kahèi, bhèni dhu dènge dhèu èmu, hud'i nanene pabe'a-be'a ku dhèu èmu na, ètu madha j'ara aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: men, love ye your wives, as christ loved the church, and gave himself for it,
target_text: mone dhu dènge le dhèu èmu, sèmi èèna kahèi! miu hud'i sue dhèu èmu miu, èci èèna ka dènge kristus sue dhèu unu na, toke na soro ngi'u na, sèna ka madhe gati rèngu.

source_text: to make it holy; and cleansed it with the washing of water, in the word of life,
target_text: nèngu tao sèmi èèna ka, ho rèngu j'aj'i mola-mèci ètu madha ama lamatua, lula rèngu madhutu le lii holo-nori na, aa sarani le.

source_text: to give the church glorious to himself, that it had no wem, or spot, nor rivelling or wrinkle, or any such thing, but that it be holy and undefouled.
target_text: dhèu unu yesus kristus èci èèna ka dènge bhèni dhu neo kab'i dhu pagaa iisi na, te dhèu mone dhu neo kab'i èèna neo mai nare ne. sama sèmi èèna kahèi, kristus neo mai nare dhèu unu na sèra. nèti èèna ka, rèngu hud'i mamuri dènge be'a aa mola-mèci, toke abhu boe sasala ciki sa.

source_text: so and men shall love their wives, as their own bodies. he that loveth his wife, loveth himself;
target_text: èci èèna kahèi dènge mone dhu dènge dhèu èmu! miu hud'i sue ku dhèu èmu mi, nuka sèmi miu sue ngi'u miu mesa mi. te ladhe dhèu mone sue dhèu èmu na, sasoa na, nèngu sue ngi'u nèngu unu na.

source_text: for no man hated ever his own flesh, but nourisheth and fostereth it, as christ doeth the church.
target_text: abhu boe dhèu dhu sue boe ngi'u na. te ngaa na lalau-lalo'o ngi'u na pabe'a-be'a, sèmi yesus ladhe-leru dhèu unu na paie-iie,

source_text: and we be members of his body, of his flesh, and of his bones.
target_text: lula èdhi nuka sèmi ngi'u nèngu.

source_text: for this thing a man shall forsake his father and mother, and he shall draw or he shall cleave to his wife; and they shall be twain in one flesh.
target_text: ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci suri, peka na, nèti èèna ka, dhèu mone hud'i tèke eele ku ina-ama na, ho la'e mamuri d'ara èci dènge dhèu èmu-kamali na, te dua ra j'aj'i le èci.

source_text: this sacrament is great; yea, i say in christ, and in the church.
target_text: te mamuri pasue dhèu èmu-kamali ne, lamatua bhoke le ètu d'ara lii holo-nori na nèti uru ka mai. j'ara ne'e ne, ka dhu kapai. te ngaa limuri ne, èdhi te'a kahèi, na, lii holo-nori ne pad'elo sasue kristus mi dhèu unu na sèra.

source_text: nevertheless ye all, each man love his wife as himself; and the wife dread her husband.
target_text: de dhèu mone hud'i sue ku dhèu èmu na, nuka sèmi sue ngi'u nèngu unu na. aa dhèu bhèni hud'i pakab'ua ku dhèu èmu na.

source_text: sons, obey ye to your father and mother, in the lord; for this thing is rightful or is just.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi ana-ana! miu hud'i mamuri nanene ku ina-ama mi, te èèna ka dhu pamèci dènge dad'èi d'ara lamatua èdhi.

source_text: honour thou thy father and mother, that is the first commandment in the promise;
target_text: ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua, suri tèke le, peka na, èu hud'i pakab'ua ku ina dènge ama mu. ne'e ne lii paredha ama lamatua dhu uru tèka, dhu dènge lii pajaji.

source_text: that it be well to thee, and that thou be long living on the earth.
target_text: te lod'o lamatua hia paredha èèna, nèngu moa kahèi, peka na, ladhe èu tao madhutu sèmi èèna, pe èu abhu mèngi-nale ae-ae, aa mamuri èu madhii-manèro.

source_text: and, fathers, do not ye provoke your sons to wrath; but nourish ye them in the teaching and chastising or in the discipline and correction of the lord.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi, ina-ama sèra! miu baku ènyi aa lii taka leli ana-ana miu, te aad'o na, ra nasa ka ra parui. be'a risi miu lalau-lalo'o si paie-iie, aa nori si nèti ana iiki mai ho madhutu j'ara lamatua. ladhe ra tao sala, nori si dènge be'a madhutu dad'èi lamatua.

source_text: servants, obey ye to fleshly lords with dread and trembling, in simple-ness of your heart, as to christ;
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi dènge dhèu-dhèu sab'a! miu hud'i madha'u ku dènge lamatua dhu paredha miu ètu rai-haha ne, aa nanene ne. baku sab'a dènge d'ara cabèka, te ngaa madhutu dad'èi lamatua dènge d'ara kateme, nuka sèmi miu madhutu dad'èi kristus dènge be'a.

source_text: not serving at the eye, as pleasing to men, but as servants of christ; doing the will of god by discretion,
target_text: te miu dhèu sab'a unu kristus. de ètu rai-haha ne miu baku sad'i sab'a di, lula lamatua dhu ladhe miu. te ngaa sab'a dènge d'ara maj'èni hia lamatua mi, masi ka nèngu aad'o ètu madha. te èèna ka dhu madhutu dad'èi ama lamatua.

source_text: with good will serving as to the lord, and not as to men;
target_text: de sab'a sasab'a miu dènge d'ara kateme hia lamatua miu ètu rai-haha ne, nuka sèmi miu sab'a hia ama lamatua, kètu èdhi.

source_text: witting that each man, whatever good thing he shall do, he shall receive this of the lord, whether servant, whether free man.
target_text: lula èdhi te'a, na, bèli-camèd'a ama lamatua b'ala hia dhèu dhu tao j'ara be'a. masi ka rèngu dhèu sab'a do, lamatua do, ènu do, ènu boe do, nèngu b'ala aa'i mèu-mèu si.

source_text: and, ye lords, do the same things to them, forgiving menacings; witting that both their lord and yours is in heavens, and the taking of persons is not with god.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi, lamatua sèra! baku miu j'ege pamadha'u leli dhèu dhu sab'a hia miu sèra. te rèngu dènge lamatua ètu sorga kahèi, èci èèna ka dènge miu. ama lamatua ladhe boe rèhu dhèu, te ngaa na nanene dhèu cee èèna ka. masi ka lamatua do, dhèu sab'a do, na nanene si aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: here afterward, brethren, be ye comforted in the lord, and in the might of his virtue.
target_text: nanene pabe'a-be'a lii padhai ja'a dhu limuri tèka ne. miu hud'i kèpe pa'èra-èra ku parcaya miu mi ama lamatua, lula nèngu ka kètu miu, aa koasa na dhu dedha risi eele aa'i si. èèna na dhu bisa pa'èra miu!

source_text: clothe you with the armour of god, that ye may stand against the ambushings, or assailings, of the devil.
target_text: sordad'u dènge rèka ho lab'a musu ra. sèmi èèna kahèi, lamatua neo pake miu sèmi sordad'u. te nèngu neo miu lab'a aa'i j'ara-j'ara bhelu-katub'a dhu dhèu aae nidhu ad'u-ue. nèti èèna ka, miu hud'i pa'èra ku, sèna ka pake aa'i rèka nèti ama lamatua.

source_text: for why striving or battle is not to us against flesh and blood, but against the princes and potentates, against governors of the world of these darknesses, against spiritual things of wickedness, in heavenly things.
target_text: te èdhi ètu d'ara pamusu! èdhi lab'a boe musu dhèu rai-haha, te ngaa èdhi lab'a koasa bhabhelu dhu èdhi tèdhi boe, lab'a dhu rèd'u paredha, lab'a koasa maroga, aa lab'a j'ara-j'ara bhelu-katub'a.

source_text: therefore take ye the armour of god, that ye may against-stand in the evil day; and in all things stand perfect.
target_text: de miu hud'i pa'èra pake rèka aa'i-aa'i nèti ama lamatua sèna ka bèli-camèd'a, ropa d'ai lod'o-lod'o bhabhelu-katub'a, miu bisa lab'a taruu. te ladhe miu taha, miu bisa segi.

source_text: therefore stand ye, and be girded about your loins in soothfastness, and clothed with the habergeon of rightwiseness,
target_text: de miu hud'i titu pa'èra-èra! parcaya dhoka lii holo-nori lamatua dhu lèke, te èèna nuka sèmi miu dhu bori dhari hake sordad'u. mamuri mola, te èèna sama sèmi miu silu kodho bèsi pa'abhe kakara.

source_text: and your feet shod in making ready of the gospel of peace.
target_text: pa'èra ho lami peka-padhai lii lolo be'a dhu pad'elo j'ara, sèna ka dhèu bisa mamuri padame dènge ama lamatua, te èci èèna ka dènge miu pake salapa sordad'u.

source_text: in all things take ye the shield of faith, in which ye may quench all the fiery darts of him that is most wicked or the worst.
target_text: parcaya taruu mi lamatua, te parcaya èèna sama sèmi mèdha èci dhu sordad'u pake ho sili iisi nèti rèka musu. dènge parcaya sèmi èèna, miu bisa pamadhe ai ètu isi kataki nidhu bhelu, dhu ra siri mi miu.

source_text: and take ye the helmet of health, and the sword of the ghost, that is, the word of god.
target_text: kèpe pa'èra-èra lalèka miu dhu peka na, miu unu le mamuri nèti ama lamatua, te èèna sèmi sordad'u pake solo bèsi. kèpe pa'èra-èra lii holo-nori ama lamatua nèti roh na dhu mola-mèci, te èèna sama sèmi sordad'u dhu kèpe samala.

source_text: by all prayer and beseeching pray ye all time in spirit, and in him waking in all busyness, and beseeching for all holy men or for all saints.
target_text: ladhe miu neo titu èra, na, miu baku loe sabaj'a pake koasa nèti roh mola-mèci ama lamatua. j'aga taruu aa baku bhèlu sabaj'a hia dhèu unu lamatua buli mia-mia.

source_text: and for me; that word be given to me in opening of my mouth, with trust to make known the mystery of the gospel,
target_text: aa baku bhèlu kahèi sabaj'a hia ja'a. manèngi sèna ka ama lamatua hia kahèi lii holo-nori na, sèna ka ja'a bisa peka mola-mola naneo na mi dhèu leo.

source_text: for which i am set in message in a chain; so that in it i be hardy to speak, as it behooveth me to speak out.
target_text: masi ka ja'a j'aj'i ana bèdho, te ngaa lamatua yesus pua-paleha ja'a, sèna ka j'aj'i mi ai g'ana nèngu. de sabaj'a hia ja'a, ho ja'a baku madha'u padhai dhu lèke, te èèna ka dhu j'aj'i sasab'a-la'a ja'a!

source_text: and that ye know, what things be about me, what i do, tychicus, my most dear brother, and true minister in the lord, shall make all things known to you;
target_text: ja'a d'èi sèna ka miu me'a mèu mamuri ja'a. nèti èèna ka, ja'a pua tikikus dhiu asa miu. nèngu ne, a'ari pasue ja'a, aa na maj'èni pakako sasab'a kètu èdhi, yesus kristus.

source_text: whom i sent to you for this same thing, that ye know what things be about us, and that he comfort your hearts.
target_text: hud'i laa na lole j'ara-j'ara mamuri èdhi ètu ne'e. aa ja'a neo, sèna ka na pa'èra d'ara miu kahèi.

source_text: peace to brethren, and charity, with faith of god our father, and of the lord jesus christ.
target_text: ja'a manèngi ama èdhi, ama lamatua, dènge kètu èdhi, yesus kristus, ho tao miu mamuri padame èci dènge èci, aa pasue èci dènge èci, lula miu parcaya mi rèngu.

source_text: grace with all men that love our lord jesus christ in uncorruption. amen, that is, so be it.
target_text: ja'a manèngi-mangaj'i kahèi, sèna ka kètu èdhi, kristus pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu sue ne taruu. sasuri ja'a, d'ai sange ne'e ka. saloom, paulus

source_text: paul and timothy, servants of jesus christ, to all the holy men in christ jesus, that be at philippi, with bishops and deacons,
target_text: sasuri ne, nèti ja'a, paulus. aa angalai ja'a, timotius pa'adhu hia miu lii maho'o kahèi. ji'i dua mi se, ana sab'a nèti yesus kristus. ji'i pa'adhu sasuri ne, hia mi dhèu unu ama lamatua dhu parcaya yesus kristus ètu kota pilipi. ji'i neo kahèi, ho dhèu dhu j'aj'i kètu juma'at dènge dhèu dhu soru-bara kètu juma'at sèra, re'a mèu isi sasuri ne'e.

source_text: grace and peace to you of god our father, and of the lord jesus christ.
target_text: ama lamatua èèna, ama èdhi. aa yesus kristus èèna, kètu èdhi. ji'i manèngi sèna ka rèngu pad'elo d'ara hua iia ra mi miu, ho bisa mamuri dènge mera-milu.

source_text: i do thankings to my god in all mind of you
target_text: masi ka nèbhu le ja'a paraga heka dènge miu, te ngaa ja'a bhèlu boe miu! lod'o-lod'o ja'a sanèd'e miu, ja'a manèngi makasi mi lamatua, lula miu parcaya ne taruu.

source_text: evermore in all my prayers for all you with joy, and make beseeching
target_text: lod'o ja'a sabaj'a hia miu, d'ara ja'a karej'e-karae,

source_text: on your communing in the gospel of christ, from the first day till now;
target_text: lula karèi nèti hiu-hiu miu sèmi mere lii lolo be'a lamatua, miu pakako taruu sasab'a na, sama-sama dènge ja'a.

source_text: trusting this same thing, that he that began in you a good work, shall perform it till into the day of jesus christ.
target_text: èèna j'aj'i mi tadha, peka na, ama lamatua mulai sab'a ètu d'ara miu kèna. aa ja'a ke'a tare'a, na, lamatua pakako taruu sasab'a na dhu be'a èèna, toke pamèci aa'i mèu-mèu, toke d'ai lod'o yesus kristus mai hari.

source_text: as it is just to me to feel this thing for all you, for that i have you in heart, and in my bonds, and in defending and confirming of the gospel, that all ye be fellows of my joy.
target_text: mema lèke tare'a ladhe ja'a sue miu, lula d'ara ja'a dhu pa'èki le dènge miu karèi nèti uru ka. ca hari nèi, miu sab'a le bera-bera dènge ja'a, lod'o ja'a lole dènge dhèu lii lolo be'a lamatua, aa ropa ja'a dhaa mi dhèu dhu lab'a lii lolo be'a èèna. masi ka ja'a maso bui, te ngaa miu hari boe nèti baboa ja'a.

source_text: for god is a witness to me, how i covet all you in the bowels of jesus christ.
target_text: ama lamatua dhu ne'a, na, d'ara ja'a neo taruu paraga dènge miu. te sasue ja'a mi dedha miu, èci èèna ka dènge sasue yesus kristus.

source_text: and this thing i pray, that your charity be plenteous more and more in knowing or in science, and in all wit; that ye approve the better things, that ye be clean and without offence in the day of christ;
target_text: de ja'a sabaj'a hia miu sèmi ne'e ka: ja'a manèngi ho miu asa tabha pasue èci dènge èci. ja'a manèngi kahèi sèna ka ama lamatua hia miu me'a mèu, mia dhu be'a, sèna ka miu mamuri mola-mèci. pe d'ai lod'o kristus pama'ète lii langu dhèu aa'i-aa'i, na peka na, miu sala boe ngaa-ngaa,

source_text: full-filled with the fruit of rightwiseness by jesus christ, into the glory and praising of god.
target_text: lula nèngu mesa na ka dhu tao d'ara miu mola-mèci, ho bisa mamuri mola. dènge mamuri mola sèmi èèna ka, dhèu leo ded'e padedha-dedha aa koa-kio kolongara ama lamatua.

source_text: for, brethren, i will that ye know, that the things that be about me have come more to the profit of the gospel,
target_text: a'ari pasue aa'i-aa'i! ja'a d'èi sèna ka miu me'a, na, abhu dhèu dhu pasusa ja'a, toke pamaso ja'a asa d'ara bèdho. te ngaa te'a boe, na, lii lolo be'a lamatua pale-lème le ètu mia-mia,

source_text: so that my bonds were made known in christ, in each moot hall, and in all other places;
target_text: toke sordad'u dhu madhenga èmu dhèu aae, dènge dhèu leo aa'i-aa'i re'a, na, ja'a maso bui lula madhutu yesus kristus.

source_text: that more of the brethren trusting in the lord more plenteously for my bonds, durst without dread speak the word of god.
target_text: ka dhèu unu ama lamatua ètu se'e se rèdhi, na, lamatua ka dhu tao j'ara èèna lod'o ja'a ètu d'ara bui ne. nèti èèna ka, rèngu asa tabha bani, toke re'a heka madha'u. hèia ra padhai paled'a-led'a lii holo-nori lamatua ètu mia-mia.

source_text: but some for envy and strife, some for good will, preach christ; and some of charity, witting that i am put in the defence of the gospel. but some of strife or of contention show christ not cleanly, guessing them to raise tribulation to my bonds.
target_text: ètu ne'e abhu dua rupa dhèu dhu maj'èni aj'a j'ara-j'ara lula-nèti kristus. nèti èèna ka, abhu dhu sab'a dènge d'ara mola, aa abhu dhu sab'a dènge d'ara koe-kapengo. dhu sab'a dènge d'ara mola, rèngu be'a dènge ja'a. dhèu se re'a mèu, na, ja'a dui sasusa ne, lula pakako sasab'a ja'a, dhu hari boe kabodho ciki sa. te ngaa dhu sab'a dènge d'ara koe-kapengo, d'èi boe dhèu risi nèti rèngu aa tenge kolongara di. rèngu pamae-pamanyèla dhèu-dhèu parcaya, sad'i abhu dhèu dhu madhutu ra. te ra tenge j'ara ho bisa padedha iisi ra, peka na, rèngu risi ja'a. rèngu pangee, na, ladhe abhu dhèu dhu madhutu rèngu, èèna na asa tabha paj'èra ja'a ètu d'ara bui.

source_text: but what? while on all manner, either by occasion, either by truth, christ is showed; and in this thing i have joy, but also i shall have joy.
target_text: te ngaa hud'i rèngu sène! ja'a pusi-pahae boe, ladhe dhèu aj'a dènge d'ara mola, do aad'o. sad'i dhu rèngu aj'a, dhoka lula-nèti yesus kristus di! èèna ka dhu pakarej'e d'ara ja'a. aa ja'a karej'e tare'a-re'a,

source_text: and i know, that this thing shall come to me into health, by your prayer, and the underministering of the spirit of jesus christ,
target_text: lula ja'a ke'a, na, miu sabaj'a hia ja'a, aa roh yesus kristus dhu soru-bara ja'a. nèti èèna ka, ja'a ke'a, na, lèpa lod'o limuri, aa'i-aa'i se èle dènge sod'a-mole!

source_text: by mine abiding and hope. for in nothing i shall be ashamed, but in all trust as evermore and now, christ shall be magnified in my body, either by life, either by death.
target_text: masi ka ja'a muri do, madhe do, ngaa-ngaa tao boe. sad'i ama lamatua pake ja'a, sèna ka ded'e padedha-dedha kolongara yesus kristus, aa aj'a mola-mola lula-nèti nèngu, toke abhu boe ngaa èci sa dhu pamakae ja'a. se'e se ka dhu ja'a sanao karèi nèti uru, toke doe ne'e ne.

source_text: for to me to live is christ, and to die is winning. that if to live in flesh, this is fruit of work to me, lo! what i shall choose, i know not. but i am constrained of two things, i have desire to be departed from the body, and to be with christ, it is much more better;
target_text: te ja'a pangee sèmi ne'e ka: ladhe ja'a mamuri, na, hud'i laa pa'èki dènge kristus, aa pakako taruu sasab'a-la'a na. èèna ka dhu be'a. te ngaa ladhe ja'a madhe, ja'a oto risi hari, lula ja'a tèke eele rai-haha ne, aa mamuri hari ho pea pa'èci dènge kristus ètu sorga. nèti èèna ka, d'ara ja'a kajari, aa ke'a boe mia ka dhu be'a risi eele!

source_text: but to dwell in flesh, is needful for you.
target_text: de sèmi ne'e ka laa! lula miu parluu ja'a era ètu ne'e, be'a risi ja'a pea pa'èci dènge miu ètu rai-haha ne.

source_text: and i trusting this thing, know that i shall dwell, and perfectly dwell to all you, to your profit and joy of faith,
target_text: ja'a ke'a, na, mamuri ja'a madhera era, sèna ka paraga hari dènge miu. te lamatua neo ho ja'a pa'èra d'ara miu, hèia miu asa lèka ne dènge d'ara karej'e.

source_text: that your thanking abound in christ jesus in me, by my coming again to you.
target_text: de bèli-camèd'a miu ded'e padedha-dedha kolongara yesus kristus, lula na bhoke le j'ara sèna ka ja'a lèpa pa'asu-pareo hari dènge miu.

source_text: only live ye worthily to the gospel of christ, that whether when i come and see you, either absent i hear of you, that ye stand in one spirit of one will, travailing together to the faith of the gospel. and in nothing be ye afeared of adversaries, which is to them cause of perdition, but to you a cause of health. and this thing is of god.
target_text: masi ka tasa mera mia, mamuri miu hud'i lèke ku, te miu dhèu unu lamatua. de miu hud'i mamuri dhu mèci ku, aa tao madhutu lii lolo be'a yesus kristus dhu peka le dènge miu. aa ladhe bèli-camèd'a ja'a lèpa hari dhiu pangad'o dènge miu, do tadèngi dhoka lii nèti dhèu di, peka na, miu mamuri mola, na, d'ara ja'a karej'e. te ja'a bisa ke'a, na, miu dhu mamuri d'ara èci, lula pa'èki dènge roh èci di. aa bisa ke'a, na, miu pa'èra ho pakako sama-sama lii lolo be'a lamatua yesus, sèna ka dhèu leo parcaya kahèi. aa miu me'a boe madha'u kahèi, masi ka abhu dhèu dhu lab'a miu. ne'e ne j'aj'i mi tadha hia musu, na, ama lamatua neo lalèta eele si. te ngaa ama lamatua hia miu mamuri, ho bèli-camèd'a miu mamuri taruu dènge nèngu.

source_text: for it is given to you for christ, that not only ye believe in him, but also that ye suffer for him;
target_text: te, lula ama lamatua d'ara hua iia risi, nèti èèna ka na bhoke le j'ara, sèna ka miu bisa parcaya kristus, aa j'aj'i dhèu unu na. mesa boe parcaya di, te ngaa lamatua soro tèke miu abhu sasusa kahèi, lula miu madhutu nèngu.

source_text: having the same strife, which ye saw in me, and now ye have heard of me.
target_text: te dhu ja'a tadèngi, abhu dhèu ètu sèra dhu lab'a miu, lula miu pakako lii lolo be'a kristus. sanèd'e, te ca hari ni rèngu lab'a le ja'a kahèi, toke d'ai doe ne'e ne.

source_text: therefore if any comfort is in christ, if any solace of charity, if any fellowship of spirit, if any inwardness of mercy doing,
target_text: a'ari pasue aa'i-aa'i, unu yesus kristus! na pangèd'u le miu j'ara be'a ae-ae. de miu bisa pa'èra d'ara èci dènge èci. miu bisa holo dhu mai nèti sasue miu. miu bisa mamuri pabe'a èci dènge èci, lula roh lamatua dhu sab'a ètu talora aae miu. aa miu bisa pad'elo rasa kasia miu dènge d'ara be'a èci dènge èci.

source_text: ful fill ye my joy, that ye under-stand the same thing, and have the same charity, of one will, and feel the same thing;
target_text: ladhe miu tao sèmi èèna, na, d'ara ja'a karej'e kea rae-rae. risi-risi hari, ladhe miu pasue dènge d'ara èci, mamuri ètu ca j'ara, aa mere lii èci ètu d'ara sasab'a-la'a.

source_text: nothing doing by strife, neither by vain glory, but in meekness, deeming each other to be higher in virtue than himself;
target_text: baku tao ngaa-ngaa dhu tenge dhoka pa'oto ngi'u èu risi nèti dhèu leo. aa baku pangee, na, èu risi nèti dhèu leo. te pamone do pabhèni èu èèna, dènge boe kolo-kapua. te ngaa èdhi hud'i pahaha iisi ku, sèna ka te'a, na, dhèu leo risi nèti èdhi.

source_text: not beholding each by himself what things be his own, but those things that be of other men.
target_text: aa baku dhoka uri mamuri miu mesa-mesa mi. te ngaa èdhi hud'i ladhe kahèi, ngaa dhu dhèu leo parluu.

source_text: and feel ye this thing in you, which was also in christ jesus;
target_text: te d'ara èdhi hud'i sama ku sèmi d'ara yesus kristus.

source_text: which when he was in the form of god, deemed not raven, that himself were even to god or himself to be even to god,
target_text: masi ka nèngu ca ropa dènge ama lamatua, aa nèngu kètu èdhi kahèi, èci èèna ka dènge ama lamatua, te ngaa na tèke eele hak na, aa pake boe dadedha dènge kapai na.

source_text: but he lowed or meeked himself, taking the form of a servant, and was made into the likeness of men,
target_text: hèia na puru mai asa rai-haha ne, ca ropa dènge dhèu rai-haha. na tèke eele hak na aa'i-aa'i, sèna ka tao iisi na j'aj'i nuka sèmi ènu sa.

source_text: and in habit was found as a man. he meeked himself, and was made obedient to the death, yea, to the death of the cross.
target_text: mesa boe j'aj'i dhèu haha d'ai seli di, te ngaa na tao ngi'u na j'aj'i dhèu dhu laku-laku boe kahèi, sèna ka tao madhutu dad'èi ama lamatua. masi ka ra pamadhe ne ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha, na sèmi nare kahèi, aa madhe, nuka sèmi dhèu bhelu.

source_text: for which thing god enhanced him, and gave to him a name that is above all name;
target_text: lula nèngu pahaha iisi sèmi èèna, nèti èèna ka ama lamatua ded'e ne padedha-dedha. aa pangèd'u ne ngara dhu kapai aae. te abhu boe ngara èci sa dhu kapai aae risi nèti nèngu.

source_text: that in the name of jesus each knee be bowed, of heavenly things, and of earthly things, and of hell's;
target_text: ama lamatua ded'e padedha-dedha ngara na èèna, sèna ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i pakab'ua ne. nuka: dhèu ètu dedha-liru, dènge dhèu ètu rai-haha ne. dhèu mamuri dènge dhèu madhe. bèli-camèd'a dhèu aa'i-aa'i patitu kètu urutuu, ho pahaha iisi mi nèngu.

source_text: and each tongue acknowledge, that the lord jesus christ is in the glory of god the father.
target_text: aa bèli-camèd'a dhèu aa'i-aa'i peka na, yesus kristus èèna, tare'a-re'a lamatua! dènge sèmi èèna, rèngu koa-kio ama lamatua kahèi.

source_text: therefore, my most dearworthy brethren, as evermore ye have obeyed, not in my presence only, but much more now in mine absence, work ye with dread and trembling your health.
target_text: a'ari pasue aa'i-aa'i! nanene paie-iie! uru èèna, lod'o ja'a pea ètu kota pilipi era, miu nanene lii padhai ja'a, ka miu madhutu j'ara mola ama lamatua. limuri ne, èdhi pahag'a, te ngaa ja'a manèngi ho miu titu èra ètu d'ara mamuri mola. sanèd'e, te ladhe miu nanene boe nèngu, bèli-camèd'a pe mèdhi unu mi! lula nèngu ka dhu patalale miu nèti koasa sasala-sasigo mi. hèia miu mamuri dhu mèci, te miu j'aj'i le dhèu unu na.

source_text: for it is god that worketh in you, both to will, and to perform, for good will.
target_text: te ama lamatua mesa na ka dhu sab'a ètu d'ara miu. nèngu ka dhu bhoke j'ara, sèna ka miu neo nanene ne. aa nèngu ka dhu hia koasa kahèi, ho miu d'èi sab'a pakarej'e d'ara na.

source_text: and do ye all things without grutchings, and doubtings;
target_text: de ladhe sad'i miu tao ngaa èèna ka, na, baku ka'uu-kamuki, aa baku pasibha d'ara lii.

source_text: that ye be without complaint, and simple as the sons of god, without reproof, in the middle of a shrewd nation and a wayward; among which ye shine as givers of light in the world.
target_text: tao sèmi èèna, sèna ka miu j'aj'i dhèu dhu d'ara mola-mèci, aa dhèu dhu dènge boe sasala. miu mamuri ètu d'ara talora aae dhèu bhelu dènge dhèu kapod'e-kabèli. te ngaa baku madhutu si! te mamuri miu hud'i mola-mèci ku, lula miu ana-ana lamatua. hèia mamuri miu hud'i heo ku, ho pad'elo j'ara hia rèngu, nuka sèmi hua-hètu dhu pasaraa ètu d'ara maroga.

source_text: and hold ye together the word of life to my glory in the day of christ; for i have not run in vain, neither i have travailed in vain.
target_text: hèia miu mamuri mola dènge pakako lii holo-nori lamatua. dènge sèmi èèna, bèli-camèd'a miu tao d'ara ja'a kea rae-rae, lod'o yesus kristus lèpa hari mai. aa rui-j'aj'èra ja'a core eele boe iia d'ara, te ngaa dènge kab'ua.

source_text: but though i be offered or slain on the sacrifice and service of your faith, i have joy, and i thank you all. and for the same thing have ye joy, and together thank ye me.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe sèmi ja'a dutu pa'èle aa'i mèu-mèu mamuri ja'a, ho j'aj'i nuka sèmi korban èi anggor, sèna ka miu bisa parcaya asa èra, aa pakako sasab'a lamatua, ja'a sèmi kore mamadhe dènge karej'e. èèna nuka sèmi ama agama tiko èi anggor ètu mei korban, ho pahaha iisi mi lamatua. dènge j'ara ne, èdhi bisa sama-sama karej'e, lula korban ne, iia d'ara boe.

source_text: and i hope in the lord jesus, that i shall send timothy soon to you, that i be of good comfort, when those things be known that be about you.
target_text: ja'a sanao, nèbhu heka, lamatua yesus bhoke j'ara, ho ja'a pua timotius dhiu, sèna ka na pa'èra d'ara miu. èle èèna, na lèpa hari mai sa ne'e, ho na lolo dènge ja'a kakako miu, aa pakarej'e d'ara ja'a.

source_text: for i have no man so of one will, that is busy for you with clean affection.
target_text: ja'a pua boe dhèu leo, dhoka timotius di, lula nèngu ne d'ara èci dènge ja'a. aa na sue tare'a-re'a miu.

source_text: for all men seek those things that be their own, not those that be of christ jesus.
target_text: nèngu ne, sama boe dènge a'ari dhu leo sèra. te rèngu sèra pangee dhoka ngi'u rèngu unu ra, te ngaa uri boe ngaa-ngaa dhu pamèci hia yesus kristus.

source_text: but know ye the assay of him, for as a son to the father he hath served with me in the gospel.
target_text: te ngaa miu me'a le, na, timotius sab'a d'ai madhe, pakako sasab'a ama lamatua. na sab'a dènge ja'a nuka sèmi ana dhu sab'a hia ama na. ji'i dua mi la'a peka-padhai lii lolo be'a lamatua yesus ètu mia-mia.

source_text: therefore i hope that i shall send him to you, anon as i see what things be about me.
target_text: ladhe rèngu pama'ète rare ku lii langu ja'a, ja'a heka pua timotius dhiu asa miu kèna.

source_text: and i trust in the lord, that also myself shall come to you soon.
target_text: te ngaa limuri ne, lamatua pa'èra d'ara ja'a, na, nèbhu heka ja'a bisa dhiu paraga dènge miu.

source_text: and i guessed it needful to send to you epaphroditus, my brother and even-worker, and mine even-knight, but your apostle, and the minister of my need.
target_text: uru èèna, lod'o ja'a ètu d'ara j'aj'èra era, miu pua a'ari èdhi epaproditus mai ladhe-leru ja'a. na pakako sasab'a lamatua sama-sama dènge ja'a, nuka sèmi ca dhèu sordad'u dhu maj'èni madhutu paredha komedhaa na. te ngaa ne'e ne, ja'a neo pua na lèpa hari asa miu.

source_text: for he desired you all, and he was sorrowful, therefore that ye heard that he was sick.
target_text: te d'ara na neo ae le nèdhi miu. aa na ngee miu, lula ne'a, na, miu tadèngi le nèngu dhu pèd'a.

source_text: for he was sick to the death, but god had mercy on him; and not only on him, but also on me, lest i had heaviness on heaviness.
target_text: mema lèke tare'a. ca hari ni, na pèd'a aae oe madhe. te ngaa ama lamatua sue ne, aa lamatua sue ja'a kahèi, ka na puri-pa'èle epaproditus, sèna ka ja'a baku asa susa.

source_text: therefore more hastily i sent him, that when ye have seen him, ye have joy again, and i be without heaviness.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ja'a neo pua hari na lèpa, ho bisa paraga hari dènge miu dènge d'ara karej'e-karae. ladhe sèmi èèna, d'ara ja'a heka mau kèna.

source_text: therefore receive ye him with all joy in the lord, and have ye such with all honour. for the work of christ he went to death, giving his life, that he should fulfill that that failed of you with my service.
target_text: de miu hud'i sèmi mere ne dènge be'a, te nèngu ne dhèu unu lamatua. aa miu hud'i pakab'ua ku dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra dhu ca ropa dènge ne. te nèngu pakako sasab'a kristus, toke oe madhe. aa nèngu hari boe kabodho ciki sa, lula na neo soru-bara ja'a, gati miu. de sèmi mere hari ne dènge d'ara karej'e.

source_text: henceforward, my brethren, have ye joy in the lord. to write to you the same things, to me it is not slow, and to you it is necessary.
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! nanene paie-iie! d'ara miu hud'i karej'e ku, lula miu pa'èki dènge kristus. masi ka ja'a suri pahari-pahari, te ngaa ja'a roca boe pasanèd'e miu sèna ka baku lèke tipu!

source_text: see ye hounds, see ye evil work-men, see ye division or concision.
target_text: baku pamud'e dènge dhèu kapod'e-kabèli, dhu laka-seti dhèu, peka na, miu hud'i suna ku, ho j'aj'i tadha, na, miu se dhèu unu lamatua. madhutu iia-iia na, lamatua paredha boe sèmi èèna! rèngu sala le èèna! te ngaa masi ka sèmi èèna, ra bata-magèla dhèu nuka sèmi busa pakadhi sa.

source_text: for we be circumcision, which by spirit serve to god, and glory in christ jesus, and have not trust in the flesh,

source_text: that was circumcised in the eighth day, of the kin or the kindred of israel, of the lineage of benjamin, an hebrew of hebrews, by the law a pharisee, by love pursuing the church of god, by rightwiseness that is in the law living without complaint.

source_text: and that i be found in him, not having my rightwiseness that is of the law, but that that is of the faith of christ jesus, that is of god the right-wiseness in faith,

source_text: to know him, and the virtue of his rising again, and the fellowship of his passion, and to be made like or configured to his death,

source_text: if on any manner i come to the resurrection that is from death.

source_text: not that now i have taken, or now i am perfect; but i pursue, if in any manner i comprehend or i take in which thing also i am compre-hended of jesus christ. brethren, i deem me not that i have comprehended; but one thing, i forget those things that be behind, and stretching forth myself to those things that be before,

source_text: therefore whoever we be perfect, feel we this thing. and if ye under-stand in other manner anything, this thing god shall show to you.

source_text: nevertheless to what thing we have come, that we understand the same thing, and that we perfectly dwell in the same rule.

source_text: brethren, be ye my followers, and wait ye them that walk so, as ye have our form.

source_text: for many walk, which i have said oft to you, but now i weeping say, them, the enemies of christ's cross,

source_text: whose end is death, whose god is the womb, and the glory in the confusion of them, that savour or that understand earthly things.

source_text: but our living is in heavens or in heaven; from whence also we abide the saviour our lord jesus christ,

source_text: which shall reform the body of our meekness, that is made like or configured to the body of his clearness, by the working by which he may also make all things subject to him.

source_text: therefore, my brethren most dear-worthy and most desired, my joy and my crown, so stand ye in the lord, most dear brethren.

target_text: dènge j'ara ne'e, miu bisa mamuri dhu lèke, dènge mèti kolongara hua iia ama lamatua. aa miu bisa pakarej'e d'ara lamatua ètu madha j'ara aa'i-aa'i ra kahèi. ladhe miu pad'elo d'ara be'a mi dhèu, pe lamatua hia miu hua-hela dhu be'a. dènge sèmi èèna, miu asa tadhe mèu lamatua.

source_text: and be comforted in all virtue, by the might of his clearness, in all patience and long abiding with joy, that ye do thankings to god and to the father or doing thankings to god the father, which made you worthy into the part of heritage of holy men in light. which delivered us from the power of darknesses, and translated us into the kingdom of the son of his loving,
target_text: ji'i manèngi-mangaj'i kahèi mi ama lamatua, sèna ka nèngu hia miu koasa na dhu dedha risi èèna, ho miu bisa tago j'ara aa'i-aa'i ra dènge taha d'ara. ji'i manèngi ho d'ara miu dènge karej'e-karae, sèna ka miu manèngi makasi taruu mi ama lamatua. te na bhoke le j'ara, sèna ka miu sèmi mere pusaka pala miu ètu sorga. pusaka èèna ka dhu na pala-bagi mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra dhu parcaya yesus kristus. te na patabuli eele le èdhi nèti koasa maroga, hèia na pamaso èdhi j'aj'i dhèu unu yesus kristus sèna ka pea ètu d'ara saraa. ama lamatua ka dhu ded'e yesus kristus j'aj'i dhèu aae èdhi. yesus ne, ana pasue ama lamatua.

source_text: in whom we have again-buying, and remission of sins.
target_text: te ama lamatua hia ana na, sèna ka sui nare èdhi, dènge saku eele sasala-sasigo èdhi.

source_text: which is the image of god invisible, the first begotten of each creature.
target_text: kristus ne, ca ropa dènge ama lamatua, dhu dhèu rai-haha bisa boe ladhe rèdhi. nèngu dhu mema le, uru nèti aa'i-aa'i, aa nèngu j'aj'i kètu nèti aa'i-aa'i dhu ama lamatua paj'aj'i.

source_text: for in him all things be made, in heavens and in earth, visible and invisible, either thrones, either dominations, either princehoods, either powers, all things be made of nought by him, and in him,
target_text: te ama lamatua pake ne, ho paj'aj'i aa'i isi nèti dedha-liru dènge rai-haha. na paj'aj'i j'ara-j'ara dhu dhèu rai-haha bisa ladhe rèdhi, dènge dhu bisa boe ladhe rèdhi. nuka, rèngu dhu rèd'u paredha, rèngu dhu rèd'u koasa, dhèu aae-dhèu aae, dènge dhèu kapai-dhèu kapai sèra. aa'i-aa'i dhu ama lamatua neo tao sèra, na tao hia mi yesus kristus, aa yesus dhu sab'a sèra aa'i-aa'i kahèi.

source_text: and he is before all, and all things be in him.
target_text: lod'o aa'i-aa'i se dhae j'aj'i mèka, te nèngu ka dhu mema-mema le. aa'i-aa'i se pa'èki dènge ne. aa nèngu ka dhu uri si.

source_text: and he is head of the body of the church; which is the beginning, or the first of all, and the first begotten of dead men, that he hold the first dignity or primacy, in all things.
target_text: nèngu ka dhu j'aj'i kètu mi dhèu parcaya aa'i-aa'i. aa dhèu parcaya sèra, nuka sèmi ngi'u na. te nèngu ka dhu pakako aa'i-aa'i si. nèti aa'i-aa'i dhu madhe, hèia mamuri hari, nèngu ka dhu kapai risi, ho sèna ka nèngu ka dhu dedha risi aa'i mèu-mèu.

source_text: for in him it pleased all plenty to inhabit,
target_text: aa'i-aa'i dhu ètu d'ara ama lamatua, abhu kahèi ètu d'ara kristus, aa èèna ka dhu pakarej'e d'ara lamatua.

source_text: and by him all things to be reconciled into him, and made peace by the blood of his cross, those things that be in earths, either that be in heavens.
target_text: ama lamatua pake yesus kristus, ho padame dènge aa'i-aa'i dhu na paj'aj'i le. na hia ana na, ho j'aj'i korban dhu pasuti raa na, aa madhe ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha, sèna ka aa'i-aa'i ètu dedha-liru, aa aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne, bisa padame hari dènge ama lamatua.

source_text: and when ye were sometime aliened or made strangers, and enemies by wit, in evil works, now he hath reconciled you
target_text: uru èèna, miu mamuri ètu li'u, pakaj'èu nèti ama lamatua. miu pamusu dènge ne, ka mamuri pacèri nèti nèngu, lula d'ara miu karehe dènge tatao dhu bhelu èèna ka, miu lab'a taruu ne.

source_text: in the body of his flesh by death, to have you holy, and unwemmed, and without reproof before him.
target_text: masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa limuri ne nèngu ka dhu bhoke le j'ara, ho èdhi bisa padame hari dènge ne. te nèngu ka dhu pua ana na, ho j'aj'i dhèu rai-haha. aa nèngu ka dhu hia ana na èèna j'aj'i mi korban, aa madhe ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha, sèna ka èdhi bisa padame hari dènge ne. yesus kristus tao j'ara ne'e, ho bisa lere nèti èdhi lati titu ètu katanga madha ama lamatua, sèna ka j'aj'i dhèu mola-mèci dènge d'ara mola, dhu dènge heka sasala ngaa-ngaa.

source_text: if nevertheless ye dwell in the faith, founded, and stable, and unmoveable from the hope of the gospel that ye have heard, which is preached in all creature that is under heaven. of which i, paul, am made a minister,
target_text: sad'i miu taha taruu dènge lalèka miu. kèpe pa'èra-èra, sèna ka baku kalau! baku pakaj'èu nèti lii lolo be'a èèna, dhu miu sèmi mere ropa miu nanene hiu-hiu lii èèna. te lii lolo be'a èèna j'aj'i mi era sarai miu. dhèu lasi palolo lème le lii lolo be'a èèna ètu mia-mia ètu rai-haha ne. aa lamatua ka pua ja'a, paulus, sèna ka laku lole lii lolo be'a ne kahèi.

source_text: and now i have joy in passion for you, and i ful fill those things that fail of the passions of christ in my flesh, for his body, that is the church.
target_text: lod'o kristus mamuri ètu rai-haha ne, na dui j'aj'èra ae d'ai seli. aa limuri ne, ja'a pasae rupa-rupa j'aj'èra kahèi. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa d'ara ja'a karej'e taruu. ladhe abhu dhèu dhu hud'i abhu ku j'aj'èra, na, hud'i laa ja'a dui j'aj'èra èèna sama-sama dènge ra, nuka sèmi kristus pasae nare j'aj'èra nèti dhèu-dhèu unu na. te dhèu unu na, j'aj'i sama sèmi ngi'u nèngu.

source_text: of which i paul am made minister or a servant by the dispensation of god, that is given to me in you, that i ful fill the word of god,
target_text: ama lamatua hia ja'a sasab'a na kahèi, ho ladhe-leru dhèu-dhèu unu na. nèti èèna ka, ja'a aj'a lii holo-nori na, toke lutu-sela hia miu.

source_text: the private or the mystery that was hid from worlds and generations. but now it is showed to his saints, to whom god would make known the riches of the glory of this sacrament in heathen men, which is christ in you, the hope of glory.
target_text: dhèu tadèngi lii holo-nori lamatua karèi nèti uru ka. te ngaa dhae re'a mèu mèka naneo nèti lii holo-nori se'e dènge be'a, te naneo na dhu pahuni era. te ngaa limuri ne, lamatua bhoke le naneo ne hia dhèu unu na. aa naneo na èèna, lii dhu kapai titu kèna pala mi suku aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne. lii babe'a dhu kapai risi èèna, nuka: kristus mamuri ètu d'ara miu! èèna na ka dhu tao miu parcaya taruu, peka na, bèli-camèd'a nèngu tao j'ara dhu hua iia risi hia miu ètu sorga. ne'e ne ka dhu èdhi dhèu rai-haha ne mate tae-tae karèi nèti uru-uru j'ara ka.

source_text: whom we show, reproving each man, and teaching each man in all wisdom, that we offer each man perfect in christ jesus.
target_text: de ji'i peka dènge dhèu aa'i-aa'i lula-nèti kristus. ji'i aj'a-nori dènge pasanèd'e dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra, pake ngangee lii padhai dhu ama lamatua hia mi ji'i. ji'i tao j'ara se'e, ho pa'èra dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu madhutu kristus, sèna ka bèli-camèd'a rèngu bisa titu ètu madha na, dhu dènge boe makae, lula ra mamuri mola taruu.

source_text: in which thing also i travail, in striving by the working of him, that he worketh in me in virtue.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ja'a titu pa'èra, aa sab'a j'èra titu kèna hia miu. ja'a bisa taha sab'a bia sèmi èèna, lula koasa kristus ka pa'èra ja'a. aa koasa na èèna, kapai titu kèna!

source_text: but i will that ye know, what busyness i have for you, and for them that be at laodicea, and whichever saw not my face in flesh,
target_text: miu dhu pea ètu kota kolose, aa miu ètu kota laodikia, dènge rèngu dhu paraga rèdhi mèka dènge ja'a. nanene paie-iie! ja'a d'èi sèna ka miu aa'i-aa'i mi me'a mèu sasab'a ja'a dhu bia ne hia miu, aa hia mi rèngu kahèi.

source_text: that their hearts be comforted, and they be taught in charity, into all the riches of the plenty of under-standing, into the knowing of the mystery of god, the father of jesus christ,
target_text: dad'èi ja'a ka, neo pa'èra d'ara rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra, sèna ka rèngu bisa pa'èki j'aj'i mi èci, lula ra mamuri pasue. hèia ra j'aj'i re'a mèu, lula rèngu re'a tare'a, na, uru èèna naneo lamatua pahuni era. dhu pahuni èèna, nuka kristus!

source_text: in whom all the treasures of wisdom and of science, or of cunning, be hid.
target_text: ladhe miu pa'èki j'aj'i d'ara èci dènge kristus, heka na hia miu d'èlu-mèu dhu miu parluu, aa aj'a miu pake mamèu se, sèna ka tao j'ara-j'ara dhu be'a. mamèu se'e se, nuka sèmi mèdha-panyau dhu kab'ua.

source_text: for this thing i say, that no man deceive you in height of words.
target_text: ja'a peka dènge miu j'ara se aa'i-aa'i, sèna ka mage dhoka dhèu mai kapod'e-kabèli miu dènge hèb'a mènyi.

source_text: for though i be absent in body, by spirit i am with you, joying and seeing your order and the firmness of your belief that is in christ.
target_text: ja'a mema kaj'èu nèti miu. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa ja'a bhèlu boe miu, lula d'ara ja'a dhu pa'èki le dènge miu. aa ja'a karej'e, lula ke'a, na, miu mamuri dhu lèke, aa miu dhu kèpe pa'èra parcaya miu mi kristus era.

source_text: therefore as ye have taken jesus christ our lord, walk ye in him,
target_text: lula uru èèna miu sèmi mere le yesus kristus j'aj'i kètu miu, nèti èèna ka limuri ne, miu hud'i nanene ne taruu. aa nèngu èèna j'aj'i kètu miu era.

source_text: and be ye rooted and builded above in him, and confirmed in the belief, as ye have learned, abounding in him in doing of thankings.
target_text: ladhe miu pa'èki taruu dènge ne sèmi èèna, miu nuka sèmi ana aaj'u dhu asa tabha èra, lula amo la'e asa marèma aae. aa miu nuka sèmi èmu dhu èra, lula dhu patitu ètu fanderen dhu èra. miu pa'èra taruu ètu d'ara lalèka miu, sama sèmi a'aj'a dhu miu abhu mèdhi le. hud'i laa, sèna ka d'ara miu pasoa-pasoka ètu d'ara manèngi makasi, lula j'ara aa'i-aa'i ra dhu ama lamatua tao tèke le hia miu.

source_text: see ye that no man deceive you by philosophy and vain fallacy, after the tradition of men, after the elements of the world, and not after christ.
target_text: j'aga paie-iie, sèna ka baku madhutu dhèu leo dhu pake d'èlu-mèu dhèu rai-haha, ho ère rèti miu nèti j'ara mola. aa mage madhutu a'aj'a dhèu rai-haha dhu dènge boe kolo-kapua. te a'aj'a rèngu sèra dhoka mai nèti d'èlu-mèu dhèu rai-haha di, aa nèti atora-atora rai-haha ne. te ngaa a'aj'a sèra mai boe nèti kristus.

source_text: for in him dwelleth body-like all the fullness of the godhead.
target_text: aa'i-aa'i dhu ètu d'ara ama lamatua, abhu kahèi ètu d'ara kristus. aa kristus kahèi j'aj'i dhèu rai-haha, èci èèna ka dènge èdhi.

source_text: and ye be ful filled in him, that is head of all principat and power.
target_text: lula miu pa'èki le dènge kristus, aa j'aj'i dhèu unu na, nèti èèna ka, na tao pamèci miu. te nèngu dedha risi eele nèti koasa aa'i-aa'i dènge aa'i-aa'i dhu rèd'u paredha, masi ka dhu be'a do dhu bhelu.

source_text: in whom also ye be circumcised in circumcision not made with hand, in despoiling or in nakedness of the body of flesh, but in circumcision of christ;
target_text: lod'o suna dhèu yahudi, ra j'ue eele ka'uri dhu karisi nèti era makae ra, sèna ka j'aj'i tadha, na, rèngu j'aj'i dhèu unu ama lamatua. lod'o miu maso j'aj'i dhèu unu kristus, miu suna kahèi. sasoa na sèmi ne'e ka: suna ne, lula boe nèti dhèu j'ue eele ka'uri nèti ngi'u aae ne, te ngaa kristus j'ue eele j'ara-j'ara bhabhelu-katub'a nèti d'ara èdhi. nuka j'ara-j'ara bhabhelu dhu èdhi d'èi ad'u-ue, lula èdhi dhèu rai-haha.

source_text: and ye be buried together with him in baptism, in whom also ye have risen again by faith of the working of god, that raised him from death.
target_text: lod'o ra sarani miu pake èi, èèna nuka sèmi padhane miu, sama-sama dènge kristus. hèia miu abhu mamuri dhu hiu, sèmi nèngu unu mamuri hiu kahèi. miu abhu sèmi èèna, lula miu parcaya, peka na, ama lamatua pake koasa na dhu kapai aae èèna, ho pamamuri hari yesus kristus nèti mamadhe na. lamatua pake kahèi koasa ne'e ho sab'a ètu d'ara miu.

source_text: and when ye were dead in your guilts, and in the prepuce of your flesh, he quickened together you with him; forgiving to you all guilts or all trespasses,
target_text: uru èèna, miu nuka sèmi dhèu dhu madhe le, lula miu dhu tao sasala rupa-rupa, aa miu dhae j'aj'i mèka dhèu unu ama lamatua. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa na saku eele aa'i-aa'i sasala-sasigo miu, aa bagi hia miu mamuri hiu, sama sèmi na pamamuri hari yesus kristus.

source_text: doing away that writing of decree that was against us, that was contrary to us; and he took away that from the middle, pitching it on the cross;
target_text: dhu mola-mola ka, èdhi hud'i abhu ku huku, lula èdhi sisu le atora-atora ama lamatua. te ngaa na saku eele le hahuku se'e ropa ra paku yesus kristus ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha.

source_text: and he spoiled principats and powers, and led out trustily, openly overcoming them in himself.
target_text: ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha ne, na segi aa'i le koasa maroga, aa aa'i-aa'i dhu paredha dènge bhabhelu. ka na pamakae si ètu madha dhèu ae-ae. aa'i-aa'i se, nuka sèmi sordad'u dhu segi musu, dhu lèpa kako palème rae dènge lii sod'a, sèna ka pad'elo sasegi ra aa pamakae musu ra.

source_text: therefore no man judge you in meat, or in drink, or in part of feast day, or of new moon, or of sabbaths,
target_text: ladhe abhu dhèu dhu neo pamanahu miu, nèti j'ara-j'ara ta'a-tinu, mage mi pusi-pahae si. aa ladhe dhèu neo tao lii dènge miu, nèti j'ara-j'ara lod'o be'a, do tao pesta hèru hiu, do atora lod'o ae sasab'a, na, baku pusi-pahae si.

source_text: which be shadow of things to coming or to come; for the body is of christ.
target_text: j'ara sèmi sèra sa, guna boe! te sèra sa nuka sèmi mamaho di, dhu èèna na ele. te ngaa kristus ne ka dhu asli. nèngu ne ele boe aa taa-taa.

source_text: no man deceive you, willing to teach in meekness, and the religion of angels, those things which he hath not seen, walking vainly, swollen or in-blown with wit of his flesh,
target_text: ladhe dhèu neo pamanahu miu, lula miu mo'o boe madhutu atora dhu rèngu tao unu ra, baku nanene si. te ladhe miu nanene si, miu bisa heka abhu j'ara-j'ara hua iia dhu ama lamatua neo hia miu. de mage-mage! te mema abhu dhèu dhu d'èi tenge j'ara ho pamanahu miu. dad'èi ra, ladhe miu pahaha iisi miu, aa sogo-tagu ana pajuu lamatua ètu sorga, lula ra pangee, na, abhu tanila dhu peka sèmi èèna. rèngu tao iisi ra be'a risi nèti dhèu leo aa'i-aa'i ra. madhutu iia-iia na, sèmi boe èèna. te ngangee ra sama sèmi dhèu rai-haha biasa di.

source_text: and not holding the head, of which all the body, by bands and joinings together under-ministered and made, waxeth into the increasing of god.
target_text: kristus èèna kètu, te ngaa rèngu ro'o boe pa'èki dènge ne. aa dhèu unu kristus, nuka sèmi ngi'u na dhu na ator si. na tao dhèu unu na asa tabha èra, pake koasa ama lamatua. dènge j'ara ne'e, rèngu j'aj'i nuka sèmi kalua dènge rui dhu pa'èki pa'èra-èra, sèna ka èci bara èci, toke ngi'u dhu kateme bisa sab'a dènge be'a.

source_text: for if ye be dead with christ from the elements of the world, what yet as men living to the world deem ye?
target_text: miu madhe le sama-sama dènge kristus. hèia miu pa'èki heka dènge koasa-koasa maroga ètu rai-haha ne. de nga tao ka miu loe boe madhutu rupa-rupa atora rai-haha? rèngu peka sèmi ne'e ka:

source_text: that ye touch not, neither taste, neither treat with hands those things,
target_text: mage kèpe ne'e; baku mi'e èèna, mage goi ne'e.

source_text: which all be into death by that use, after the commandments and teachings of men;
target_text: te ngaa atora sèra, dhoka pa'ue-ai nèti dhèu rai-haha, ho ra aj'a mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i. madhutu iia-iia na, atora sèra dhodhoka uri j'ara-j'ara dhu èèna na ele iia d'ara di!

source_text: which have a reason of wisdom in vain religion or in superstition and meekness, and not to spare the body, not in any honour to the fulfilling of the flesh.
target_text: ladhe sèmi dhèu bisa tao madhutu atora sèra, ra pangee, na, bèli-camèd'a dhèu pakab'ua si, aa peka na, rèngu se d'èlu-mèu titu kèna; dhèu dhu tao iisi ra sèmi dhèu kèpe pa'èra atora agama; dhèu dhu d'ara mako; dhèu dhu paj'èra ngi'u unu ra, dènge dhèu dhu maj'èni sogo-tagu. madhutu iia-iia na, aad'o! atora sèra bisa boe pamèu ngangee dhèu rai-haha, dènge d'ara dhu d'èi ad'u-ue bhabhelu!

source_text: therefore if ye have risen together with christ, seek ye those things that be above, where christ is sitting on the right half of god.
target_text: ama lamatua hia le miu mamuri hiu, nuka sèmi nèngu pamamuri hari miu sama-sama dènge kristus. limuri ne, kristus madhèdi le ètu era dhu kab'ua risi ètu baboa g'ana ama lamatua. nèti èèna ka, miu hud'i pangee dhoka j'ara-j'ara dhu pakarej'e d'ara lamatua.

source_text: savour or understand ye those things that be above, not those that be on the earth.
target_text: pangee dhoka j'ara-j'ara dhu lamatua d'èi. baku pusi-pahae dènge j'ara dhu dhodhoka pakarej'e d'ara dhèu rai-haha di.

source_text: for ye be dead, and your life is hid with christ in god.
target_text: te miu madhe kahèi, ropa kristus madhe. hèia mamuri hiu miu èèna kalau boe, lula miu pa'èki le dènge kristus, dhu bera-bera dènge ama lamatua ètu sorga.

source_text: for when christ shall appear, your life, then also ye shall appear with him in glory.
target_text: kristus mamuri ètu d'ara miu, aa na pabe'a mamuri miu. bèli-camèd'a, ropa na lèpa hari mai, miu cèu palere-lere dènge ne kahèi ètu d'ara dadedha dènge kapai na!
