source_text: and hath witnessing in good works, if she nourished children, if she re-ceived poor men to harbour, if she hath washed the feet of holy men, if she ministered to men that suffered trib-ulation, if she followed all good work.
target_text: dhèu re'a, na, nèngu ca dhèu dhu tema tao babe'a mi dhèu; dhu ladhe-leru ana-ana na dènge be'a; dhu bhoke tèke kacui-aai ho leru dhèu leo; dhu soru-bara dhèu parcaya sèra ètu d'ara sasab'a, masi ka dhu samaa èèna ka; dhu d'èi soru dhèu ètu d'ara sasusa; aa dhu bhori mema ho soru-bara ètu madha j'ara dhu be'a.

source_text: but eschew thou younger widows; for when they have done lechery, they will be wedded in christ, or when they have done lechery in christ, they will be wedded,
target_text: baku pili bhèni balu dhu ngèru era, ho sab'a ètu d'ara juma'at. te mage dhoka cèu ètu d'ara na, ho neo hari leo-èmu. ladhe sèmi èèna, rèngu se abhu heka lod'o dhu taleo, ho lalau dhèu sarani dènge be'a.

source_text: having damnation, for they have made void the first faith.
target_text: te ladhe lod'o dhu rèngu pake hia juma'at èèna kura, èci èèna ka dènge rèngu pa'ele iie lii pajaji rèngu ètu katanga madha lamatua. èèna na, dhèu pasala si.

source_text: also they idle learn to go about houses, not only idle, but they be full of words and curious or curiosity, speaking things that it behooveth not.
target_text: mage dhoka rèngu bai-eed'a, aa maso-kalua èmu dhèu, padhai-kaked'u pa'ele iie kolongara dhèu. aa dhu karehe risi eele hari, rèngu soro iisi asa d'ara lii langu dhèu leo, dènge padhai dhu lèke boe.

source_text: therefore i will, that younger widows be wedded, and bring forth children, and be housewives, to give none occasion to the adversary, because of cursed thing.
target_text: be'a risi eele, bhèni balu dhu ngèru era leo hari èmu, sèna ka rara iisi, aa ladhe-leru d'ara èmu rèngu. dènge sèmi èèna, dhèu dhu pamusu dènge èdhi abhu boe j'ara ho pa'ele iie kolongara èdhi.

source_text: for now some be turned aback after satan.
target_text: abhu bhèni balu ngèru cahag'e dhu kako sala j'ara. rèngu se madhutu j'ara dhèu aae nidhu.

source_text: if any faithful man hath widows, minister he to them, that the church be not charged, that it suffice to them that be very widows.
target_text: ladhe abhu bhèni dhu parcaya lamatua, dhu a'ari ra j'aj'i le bhèni balu, na, bhèni ne hud'i ladhe-leru ku bhèni balu èèna. baku soro tèke hia juma'at ladhe-leru. dènge j'ara sèmi èèna juma'at bisa ladhe-leru bhèni balu dhu leo, dhu tare'a-re'a dènge heka a'ari.

source_text: the priests that be well governors, that is, truly keep well priesthood, be they had worthy to double honour; most they that travail in word and teaching.
target_text: dhèu dhu ladhe-leru juma'at dènge be'a, miu hud'i pakab'ua risi ne, aa b'ae gaji dènge be'a. risi-risi rèngu dhu sab'a dènge d'ara kateme, ho lole pataraa lii holo-nori lamatua, aa aj'a j'ara mamuri dhu lèke.

source_text: for the scripture saith, thou shalt not bridle the mouth of the ox threshing, and, a workman is worthy his hire.
target_text: te dhu suri ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci lamatua, peka na, ladhe pake sapi j'èli puru are nèti huri, mage mi kape hèb'a na kahèi, sèna ka bisa na'a. aa dhu suri kahèi, peka na, cee ka dhu sab'a, na, nèngu hud'i abhu gaji ku.

source_text: do not thou receive accusing against a priest, but under twain or three witnesses.
target_text: ladhe abhu dhèu dhu galaa kètu juma'at, baku sad'i sèmi mere di! hud'i abhu ku dua do tèlu sakasii dhu lii èci, heka mi sèmi mere ho parisa ne.

source_text: but reprove thou men that sin before all men, that also others have dread.
target_text: ladhe miu kai ne, te ngaa na mamuri taruu madhutu d'ara sasala èèna, kai hari ne ètu madha juma'at. dènge j'ara sèmi èèna, dhèu leo bani boe madhutu tatao èèna.

source_text: i pray or i adjure thee before god, and jesus christ, and his chosen angels, that thou keep these things without prejudice, and do nothing in bowing to the other side.
target_text: pakako aa'i atora se'e mi juma'at dhu hag'e boe, aa baku bia cabèka. ja'a pangèd'u sasab'a ne'e mi d'ara kacui-aai èu, ètu katanga madha ama lamatua dènge yesus kristus. ana pajuu dhu ama lamatua hag'e nare ètu sorga, j'aj'i sakasii kahèi!

source_text: put thou hands to no man, neither anon commune thou with other men's sins. keep thyself chaste. put thou hands to no man soon, neither commune thou with other men's sins. keep thyself chaste.
target_text: baku pamèri ded'e dhèu j'aj'i kètu juma'at. ladhe uuru ku paie-iie ne. te ladhe miu ded'e sad'i ngara di, hèia dhèu ne tao sala, na, miu pasae sasala èèna kahèi, lula tatao na. j'aga paie ngi'u èu sèna ka mamuri mola taruu.

source_text: do not thou yet drink water, but use a little wine, for thy stomach, and for thine oft-falling infirmities.
target_text: ja'a tadèngi èu kabake pèd'a taruu. be'a risi nèti deo ne'e, èu pab'ali èi dènge anggor ciki tao sèmi èi na'i. baku minu dhoka èi iia di.

source_text: some men's sins be open, before going to doom; but of some men they come after or they follow.
target_text: ladhe paie-iie! abhu sasala dhèu dhu cèu mema. rèngu d'ai mèka madha hakim, te ngaa dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu re'a le èèna. te ngaa abhu dhèu leo kahèi dhu nèbhu-nèbhu ku, heka sasala ra cèu kèna.

source_text: and also good deeds be open, and those that have them in other manner, may not be hid.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi dènge dhèu dhu tao be'a sèra. abhu mema dhu led'a. te ngaa cahag'e pahuni-pahuni tao dhu be'a. te ngaa masi ka sèmi èèna, ngaa dhu rèngu tao sèra, nèbhu-nèbhu cèu asa li'u kahèi. bisa boe pahuni tatao dhu be'a.

source_text: whatever servants be under yoke, deem they their lords worthy all honour, lest the name of the lord and the doctrine or his doctrine be blasphemed.
target_text: abhu lamatua dhu ènu na parcaya lamatua yesus. rèngu hud'i pakab'ua lamatua ra, sèna ka dhèu leo abhu boe j'ara ho padhai lii pamanahu kolongara ama lamatua, aa pamud'e dènge lii aj'a-nori èdhi.

source_text: and they that have faithful, or christian, lords, despise them not, for they be brethren; but more serve they them, for they be faithful and loved, which be partners of beneficence, or good doing. teach thou these things, and admonish thou these things.
target_text: abhu ènu dhu lamatua na parcaya le lamatua yesus. ènu ne bisa boe pahaha lamatua na, lula lamatua na dhu parcaya lamatua yesus. masi ka tasamia èèna ka, rèngu hud'i lalau ku pabe'a risi hari lamatua ra, lula rèngu dènge rèngu sèra aa'i-aa'i ra, dhèu parcaya dhu hud'i mamuri pasue ku. timotius! aj'a aa'i-aa'i se, aa pa'èra d'ara dhèu sarani sèra, sèna ka tao madhutu aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: if any man teach otherwise, and accordeth not to the wholesome words of our lord jesus christ, and to that teaching that is by piety,
target_text: lii aj'a-nori èdhi dhu lèke èèna, j'aj'i kapua nèti d'ara mamuri èdhi dhu pakarej'e d'ara lamatua. te ngaa dhèu dhu nori leo nèti lii aj'a se'e, dhèu sèra dhu core eele le lii lamatua yesus kristus dhu lèke.

source_text: he is proud, and knoweth nothing, but languisheth about questions and strivings or fightings of words, of the which be brought forth envies, strives, blasphemies, evil suspicions,
target_text: dhèu sèmi èèna, padedha iisi, te ngaa goa. papèd'a rèngu ka d'èi dhoka tenge lii langu, aa pab'ala d'ara lii. j'ara se'e se ka dhu tao dhèu ho: tèka d'ara, patao-palaha, pa'ele iie kolongara dhèu leo, aa pangee dhu lèke boe mi dhèu leo.

source_text: fightings of men, that be corrupt in soul or in reason, and that be deprived from truth, that deem winning to be piety.
target_text: dhèu sèmi se'e, loe boe patao-palaha. ngangee ra karehe bia. re'a heka mia ka dhu be'a. rèngu ngee, ladhe rèngu maj'èni dènge j'ara-j'ara agama, rèngu bisa j'aj'i dhèu kaja-su'i.

source_text: but a great winning is piety, with sufficience.
target_text: mema, agama bisa hia a'oto mi dhèu. te mamuri dènge lamatua èèna ka dhu hia dhèu karej'e nèti ngaa dhu rèngu unu. èèna, heka agama dhu lèke kèna.

source_text: for we brought in nothing into this world, and no doubt, that we may not bear anything away.
target_text: sanèd'e paie-iie! lod'o rara iisi èdhi, èdhi tèti boe ngaa-ngaa èci sa asa rai-haha ne. aa ladhe lod'o madhe, tèti boe ngaa-ngaa èci sa kahèi nèti rai-haha ne.

source_text: but we having foods, and with what things we shall be covered or clothed, be we satisfied with these things.
target_text: de sad'i dènge nganga'a, mèdha-papake sèra sa nia le!

source_text: for they that will be made rich, fall into temptation, and into the snare of the devil, and into many unprofitable desires and noxious, which drown men into death and perdition.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu dhu neo kaja, mud'a titu kèna lèke dadugu-rariu rupa-rupa, aa lèke sasii g'ana-kariu, lula rèngu pangee dhoka mèdha-panyau di. j'ara se'e se ka dhu pa'ele iie mamuri rèngu.

source_text: for the root of all evils is covetousness, which some men coveting erred from the faith, and besetted them with many sorrows.
target_text: te sue doi-dhari, èèna j'aj'i mi amo nèti rupa-rupa bhabhelu. abhu dhèu cahag'e magèle dhoka doi-dhari di, toke ra pakaj'èu nèti parcaya ra dhu lèke. hèia rèngu mesa ra pa'ele iie mamuri ra.

source_text: but, thou, man of god, flee these things; but follow thou rightwiseness, piety, faith, charity, patience, mildness.
target_text: timotius! èu ne, dhèu unu ama lamatua. de pakaj'èu iisi nèti bhabhelu-katub'a aa'i-aa'i. mamuri mola-mèci. mamuri madhutu dad'èi lamatua ètu madha j'ara aa'i-aa'i ra. parcaya taruu mi yesus kristus. sue dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra. pa'èra ètu d'ara j'aj'èra. mamuri d'ara be'a dènge dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: strive thou a good strife of faith, catch everlasting life, into which thou art called, and hast acknowledged a good acknowledging before many witnesses.
target_text: sab'a pa'èra-èra dènge d'ara kateme, sèna ka pakako lii holo-nori aa'i-aa'i dhu èdhi parcaya. lamatua paroa le èu, ho abhu mamuri taa-taa. de liku pa'èra-èra mamuri èèna, baku patalale eele. aa èu dhu peka le ètu madha dhèu ae, lula-nèti parcaya èu mi lamatua yesus.

source_text: i command to thee before god, that quickeneth all things, and before christ jesus, that yielded a witnessing under pilate of pontii, a good confession, that thou keep the commandment without wem, without reproof, into the coming of our lord jesus christ;
target_text: de nèti deo ne'e, ja'a manèngi èu pa'èki lii pajaji sèmi ne'e: tao madhutu lii paredha aa'i-aa'i nèti lamatua yesus. baku sisu èci sa hèi, sèna ka dhèu baku rèdhi sasala èu. tao madhutu aa'i-aa'i ra dènge mola-mola toke lod'o mamai hari kètu èdhi, yesus kristus. ja'a manèngi èu jaji sèmi èèna ètu madha ama lamatua. nèngu ka dhu hia le samanga mi dhu mamuri aa'i-aa'i ra. ja'a manèngi kahèi èu jaji sèmi èèna ètu madha yesus kristus. nèngu dhu peka paled'a le, lula-nèti ngi'u nèngu, ètu madha gubernur pontius pilatus.

source_text: whom the blessed and alone almighty king of kings and lord of lords shall show in his times.
target_text: lamatua yesus dhu kapai risi, nèngu ka dhu nèd'u koasa! nèngu èèna, dhèu aae kapai nèti dhèu aae aa'i-aa'i ra. aa nèngu èèna, lamatua kapai nèti lamatua aa'i-aa'i ra. ropa d'ai lod'o na, lamatua paled'a aa'i-aa'i si.

source_text: which alone hath undeadliness or immortality, and dwelleth in light, to which light no man may come; whom no man saw, neither may see; to whom glory, and honour, and empire be without end. amen.
target_text: dhoka nèngu mesa na di, dhu madhe boe. nèngu mamuri ètu d'ara saraa dhu dhèu rai-haha taha boe laladhe. abhu boe dhèu èci sa ladhe rèdhi ne. lii-lii pakab'ua dhodhoka mi nèngu di! koasa aa'i-aa'i, ètu kacui-aai na, toke d'ai mia-mia! d'ai sange ne'e ka! tare'a!

source_text: command thou to the rich men of this world, that they understand not highly or proudly, neither that they hope in uncertainty of riches, but in the living god, that giveth to us all things plenteously to use;
target_text: peka mi dhèu kaja ètu rai-haha ne, ho rèngu baku padedha iisi, aa baku dhoka maena mèdha-panyau rèngu di. te mèdha-panyau sèra, bèli-camèd'a èla aa'i. de dhu lèke ka, maena dhoka mi ama lamatua dhu mamuri di. te nèngu ka dhu pala-bagi èdhi ngaa-ngaa dhu èdhi parluu, sèna ka èdhi mamuri dènge karej'e.

source_text: to do well, to be made rich in good works, lightly to give, to commune,
target_text: peka dènge ra, ho pake kakaja sèra sèna ka tao dhu be'a. rèngu hud'i maj'èni tao dhu be'a. rèngu hud'i bhoke kacui-aai ho soru-bara dhèu leo, aa d'èi pala-bagi mèngi-nale dhu rèngu abhu nèti lamatua.

source_text: to treasure to themselves a good foundament, into time to coming or time to come, that they catch everlasting life.
target_text: hèia ra pakaboko mèdha-panyau ho j'aj'i mi kapua dhu èra, hia mamuri ra bèli-camèd'a. ka rèngu unu mamuri dhu dènge kab'ua.

source_text: thou timothy, keep the thing or the deposit betaken to thee, eschew-ing cursed novelties of voices, and opinions of false name of knowing;
target_text: timotius! j'aga paie aa'i-aa'i dhu ama lamatua pangèd'u le mi èu. baku lamu padhai lii dhu dènge boe kolo-kapua. baku padhai lii kaj'alu dhu pakab'ua boe ama lamatua. sanèd'e, ee! te abhu dhèu dhu pangee, na, rèngu dhèu d'èlu-mèu. te ngaa ‘mamèu' rèngu sèra dhu hèb'a hua. baku lamu pab'ala lii padhai dènge ra.

source_text: which some men promising, about the faith fell down or fell down about the faith. the grace of god be with thee. amen.
target_text: abhu dhèu cahag'e lèka lii aj'a-nori dhu kapod'e-kabèli sèra, toke ra sero eele nèti parcaya ra dhu lèke mi ama lamatua. ja'a manèngi sèna ka ama lamatua pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi dedha èu dènge angalai mu si aa'i-aa'i ra. saloom, paulus

source_text: paul, the apostle of jesus christ, by the will of god, by the promise of life that is in christ jesus, to timothy, his most dearworthy son, grace, mercy, and peace of god the father, and of jesus christ, our lord.
target_text: timotius dhu be'a! sasuri ne nèti ja'a, paulus, dhu ama lamatua mesa na hag'e nare j'aj'i dhèu pajuu-paleha yesus kristus. ra pua ja'a ho laku lole nèti mamuri dhu lèke, dhu lamatua moa le hia dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu parcaya yesus kristus. timotius! èu dhu j'aj'i le sèmi ana ja'a. de ja'a manèngi sèna ka ama lamatua dènge kètu èdhi, yesus kristus, sue èu, pad'elo d'ara hua iia ra mi èu, aa hia èu mamuri dènge mera-milu.

source_text: i do thankings to my god, to whom i serve from my progenitors or my ancestors, in clean conscience, that without ceasing i have mind of thee in my prayers, night and day,
target_text: mèu-mèda ja'a sabaj'a hia èu. ja'a manèngi taruu makasi mi ama lamatua, lula èu madhutu taruu ne. èu me'a! ja'a sab'a hia nèngu dènge d'ara mola-mèci, èci èèna ka dhu bèi-baki èdhi sèra sab'a hia ne.

source_text: desiring to see thee; having mind of thy tears, or mindful of thy tears, that i be ful filled with joy.
target_text: ja'a sanèd'e lod'o èdhi pacèri uru èèna, èu pahaa èi madha. nèti èèna ka, ja'a neo titu kèna paraga hari dènge èu, sèna ka d'ara ja'a karej'e.

source_text: and i bethink of that faith, that is in thee not feigned, which also dwelled first in thine aunt lois, and in thy mother eunice. and i am certain, that also in thee.
target_text: ja'a ngee kèdhi uru èèna, lod'o èu heka parcaya tare'a lamatua yesus. parcaya sèmi èèna na dhu amo le ètu d'ara bèi mu luisa dènge ina mu yunike. aa ja'a ke'a mèu, na, parcaya sèmi èèna muri le ètu d'ara èu kahèi.

source_text: for which cause i admonish thee, that thou raise again the grace of god, that is in thee by the setting on or the on-putting of mine hands.
target_text: uru èèna, lod'o dhu ja'a bane ai ètu kètu èu aa sabaj'a hia èu, lod'o èèna kahèi lamatua hia karunya mi èu, sèna ka èu bisa sab'a hia ne. de ne'e ne, ja'a manèngi sèna ka èu pakaroo hari karunya èu dhu nuka sèmi ai dhu oe madhe sa.

source_text: for why god gave not to us the spirit of dread, but of virtue, and of love, and of soberness.
target_text: te roh ama lamatua tao boe èdhi j'aj'i dhèu madha'u. te ngaa na tao, sèna ka èdhi j'aj'i dhèu dhu d'ara èra, dhu te'a pasue, aa te'a taha tare d'ara.

source_text: therefore do not thou shame the witnessing of our lord jesus christ, neither me, his prisoner; but travail thou together in the gospel by the virtue of god;
target_text: de baku makae peka-padhai j'ara-j'ara lula-nèti lamatua èdhi. aa baku makae lula ja'a ne ana bèdho. te ja'a maso bui lula ja'a pakako sasab'a na. de ladhe lamu lole lii lolo be'a, èu hud'i pa'èra ku iisi, ho dui j'aj'èra nuka sèmi ji'i dui. ladhe èu paraga dènge j'aj'èra sèmi èèna, èèna na lamatua pa'èra d'ara èu.

source_text: that delivered us, and called with his holy calling, not after our works, but by his purpose and grace, that is given to us in christ jesus before worldly times; but now it is open by the lightening of our saviour jesus christ, which destroyed death, and lightened life and uncorruption by the gospel.
target_text: lula lamatua ka dhu patabuli èdhi nèti koasa sasala-sasigo èdhi. aa na hag'e nare èdhi ho j'aj'i dhèu unu na dhu mola-mèci. na pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi èdhi, lula na sue èdhi, masi ka èdhi tao boe ngaa-ngaa ho nia sèmi babe'a na. lod'o lamatua paj'aj'i mèka rai-haha ne, te ngaa pama'ète nare le ho hia yesus kristus mai, sèna ka na pad'elo d'ara hua iia na, aa pala mamuri hia èdhi. ka yesus kristus mai le, aa bhoke paled'a ngaa dhu uru èèna ama lamatua nelu tao, aa pad'elo d'ara hua iia nèngu mi èdhi. na palaho le koasa mamadhe! ne'e ka dhu j'aj'i lii lolo be'a! de cee dhu parcaya lamatua yesus, madhe heka taa-taa, te ngaa mamuri manèro toke d'ai mia-mia dènge ama lamatua.

source_text: in which i am set a preacher and apostle, and master of heathen men.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ama lamatua ded'e nare ja'a j'aj'i dhèu pajuu-paleha yesus kristus, sèna ka ja'a lole lii lolo be'a na, aa aj'a-nori dhèu ètu mia-mia.

source_text: for which cause also i suffer these things; but i am not confound-ed. for i know to whom i have believed, and i am certain that he is mighty to keep that is taken to my keeping, into that day.
target_text: sèra sa ka dhu paj'èra ja'a ètu d'ara èmu bèdho ne. te ngaa ja'a makae boe! lula ja'a ke'a le cee ka dhu ja'a parcaya, nuka lamatua yesus. aa ja'a ke'a kahèi, peka na, nèngu ka dhu pangèd'u sasab'a ne'e mi adhe-aai ja'a, nèngu ka dhu bisa j'aga sasab'a ne'e, aa nèngu ka dhu pa'èra ja'a sèna ka pakako sasab'a ne'e, toke nèngu mai hari.

source_text: have thou the form of whole-some words, which thou heardest of me in faith and love in christ jesus.
target_text: de madhutu ka, j'ara mamuri nèti a'aj'a dhu lèke dhu ja'a pad'elo le dènge èu. ladhe èu parcaya taruu, aa sue dhèu aa'i-aa'i sèmi èèna, ne'e peka na, èu j'aj'i le èci dènge yesus kristus.

source_text: keep thou the good deposit, or thing, taken to thy keeping by the holy ghost, that dwelleth in us.
target_text: ama lamatua pangèd'u le ètu d'ara adhe-aai èu kakaja èci dhu kab'ua, nuka a'aj'a dhu lèke. de ladhe-leru pabe'a kakaja èèna! pake roh ama lamatua dhu mola-mèci dhu ètu d'ara èdhi, sèna ka hud'i laa na pa'èra èu ho ladhe-leru kakaja èèna paie-iie.

source_text: thou knowest this, that all that be in asia be turned away from me, of which is phygellus and hermogenes.
target_text: ele boe èu tadèngi le, na, figelus, hermogenes dènge dhèu leo nèti propensi asia sèra, pusi-pahae heka ja'a.

source_text: the lord give mercy to the house of onesiphorus, for oft he refreshed me, and shamed not my chain. but when he came to rome, he sought me busily, and found me. the lord give to him to find mercy of god in that day. and how great things he ministered to me at ephesus, thou knowest better.
target_text: te ngaa onesiforus leko-leo nèti rèngu. na pakaj'èu boe nèti ja'a. èu mesa mu me'a, lod'o ja'a ètu kota epesus era, nèngu ka dhu ladhe-leru ja'a. limuri ne, na pea ètu kota roma ne'e. ropa na d'ai ne'e, na patangi-tenge ja'a ètu mia-mia. ka na abhu ja'a ètu d'ara èmu bèdho ne. te ngaa na makae boe. na mai taruu ngad'o ja'a ho pa'èra d'ara ja'a. de ja'a manèngi sèna ka ama lamatua pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi onesiforus dènge a'ari na aa'i-aa'i ra. ladhe lod'o èle rai-haha ne, ho lamatua pama'ète lii langu dhèu rai-haha, ja'a sanao ho lamatua pama'ète dhu be'a hia mi onesiforus si.

source_text: therefore thou, my son, be comforted in grace that is in christ jesus.
target_text: ana timotius dhu ja'a sue! yesus kristus d'ara hua iia titu kèna. limuri ne, èu èci le dènge nèngu. na pa'èra èu. de èu me'a dhoka sèmi more di!

source_text: and what things thou hast heard of me by many witnesses, betake thou these to faithful men, which shall be able also to teach other men.
target_text: uru èèna, ja'a aj'a le èu ètu madha dhèu ae lula-nèti j'ara mamuri lamatua dhu mola. de limuri ne ja'a manèngi èu, ho aa'i-aa'i dhu èu tadèngi nèti ja'a, lamu aj'a hari hia dhèu dhu èu bisa lèka si. dhèu sèra hud'i bisa lasi aj'a hari sèmi èèna kahèi mi dhèu leo.

source_text: travail thou as a good knight of christ jesus.
target_text: èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti, nuka sèmi sordad'u yesus kristus. de èdhi pasae j'aj'èra sèmi nèngu kahèi. lula èu ne sordad'u dhu be'a, èu hud'i pasae more ku pala unu mu.

source_text: no man holding knighthood to god, en wrappeth himself with worldly needs, that he please to him, to whom he hath proved himself.
target_text: sordad'u dhu pakako sasab'a bisa boe sab'a pab'ali dènge sasab'a dhu leo. dènge j'ara sèmi ne'e, nèngu ne'a pakarej'e d'ara komedhaa na.

source_text: for he that fighteth in a battle, shall not be crowned, but he fight lawfully.
target_text: tare conto leo sèmi olaraga. ladhe madhutu lomba, hud'i madhutu ku atora na. te ladhe aad'o, na, kalua! bisa boe abhu juara. sèmi èèna kahèi, ladhe neo pakako sasab'a lamatua, madhutu ku atora na.

source_text: it behooveth an earth-tiller to receive first of the fruits.
target_text: ladhe kahèi dhèu sab'a oka-tedhe. na sab'a dènge tèku rui na ètu d'ara oka na. de nèngu ka dhu uru tèka abhu hua-hela.

source_text: understand thou what things i say. for the lord shall give to thee understanding in all things.
target_text: pangee paie-iie conto sèra. pe ama lamatua hia me'a mèu j'ara sèra aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: be thou mindful that the lord jesus christ of the seed of david hath risen again from death, after my gospel,
target_text: pangee pabe'a-be'a mi yesus kristus. nèngu èèna ana-èpu dhèu aae daud. na madhe, te ngaa ama lamatua pamamuri ne. èèna ka j'aj'i lii lolo be'a dhu ja'a laku peka-padhai ètu mia-mia.

source_text: in which i travail unto bonds, as working evil, but the word of god is not bound.
target_text: lula ja'a lole lii lolo be'a, èèna ka ja'a j'èra sèmi ne'e ne. risi-risi hari ra èki-karadhe ja'a dènge rate, tao ja'a sèmi dhèu bhelu-katub'a sa. te ngaa rèngu taha rare boe lii lolo be'a ama lamatua.

source_text: therefore i suffer or i sustain all things for the chosen, that also they get the health that is in christ jesus, with heavenly glory.
target_text: de ja'a sadia pasae rupa-rupa j'aj'èra. sad'i dhèu unu lamatua dhu na hag'e nare sèra abhu mamuri. pe ama lamatua ded'e si padedha-dedha, lula rèngu j'aj'i dhèu unu yesus kristus.

source_text: a true word is this that i say, that if we be dead together to the world, also we shall live together in bliss;
target_text: aa lii se'e mema lèke tare'a: ladhe èdhi mangaku, na, kristus madhe ho gati èdhi, èci èèna ka èdhi madhe tèke eele mamuri dhui, hèia èdhi kahèi mamuri bera-bera dènge ne.

source_text: if we suffer or if we sustain, we shall reign together with christ; if we deny him, he shall deny us;
target_text: ladhe èdhi taha ètu d'ara j'aj'èra, èdhi tèd'u paredha sama-sama dènge nèngu kahèi. te ngaa ladhe èdhi pasili ne, nèngu pasili èdhi kahèi.

source_text: if we believe not, he dwelleth faithful, he may not deny himself.
target_text: masi ka d'ara èdhi satia boe, te ngaa nèngu satia taa-taa, lula nèngu bisa boe leko-monya. ngaa dhu na peka, èèna ka dhu na tao.

source_text: teach thou these things, witness-ing before god. do not thou strive in words; for to nothing it is profitable, but to the subverting of men that hear.
target_text: pasanèd'e dhèu parcaya, sèna ka rèngu baku bhèlu j'ara se'e aa'i-aa'i ra. kai si dènge kolongara ama lamatua, ho ra loe eele ka nèti pa'uji lii padhai lii. te aa'i-aa'i sèra guna boe ngaa-ngaa. dhodhoka pa'ele iie ngangee nèti dhèu dhu nanene.

source_text: busily keep or take care to give thyself a proved, praiseable workman to god, without shame, rightly treating the word of truth.
target_text: tenge j'ara dhu be'a, sèna ka tao iisi èu nuka sèmi dhèu sab'a dhu nia abhu koa nèti ama lamatua. dhèu sèmi èèna parluu boe makae, lula nèngu èèna sab'a sasab'a na dènge be'a. èu hud'i j'aj'i dhèu dhu aj'a dènge mola lii holo-nori lamatua mi dhèu, aa baku dènge koe-kapengo. lula lii holo-nori na, mola!

source_text: but eschew thou or shun thou unholy and vain speeches, for why those profit much to unfaithfulness,
target_text: pakaj'èu nèti lii padhue dhu dènge boe kolo-kapua, aa nèti lii padhai dhu pakab'ua boe lamatua. te sèra sa dhoka tao dhèu asa bhelu-katub'a.

source_text: and the word of them creepeth as a canker. of whom philetus is, and hymenaeus,
target_text: lii padhai dhu bhelu-katub'a sèra paj'ala sèmi èi papèd'a kangker. lii padhai himeneus dènge filetus sèmi sèra ka!

source_text: which felled down from the truth, saying that the rising-again is now done, and they subverted or turned upside-down the faith of some men.
target_text: dua ra aj'a sala, peka na, dhèu madhe mamuri aa'i hari le. te ngaa èèna lèke boe! dènge j'ara sèmi èèna, rèngu se piku eele nèti ngaa dhu lèke. ngaa dhu rèngu aj'a se'e, pa'ele iie parcaya nèti dhèu cahag'e.

source_text: but the firm foundament of god standeth, having this mark, the lord knoweth which be his, and, each man that nameth the name of the lord, departeth from wickedness.
target_text: te ngaa kapua dhu ama lamatua padhèdi nare èèna, kalau-karèto boe. ètu kapua èèna, dhu suri peka na, lamatua tadhe mèu dhèu unu na, aa, dhèu cee dhu pahaha iisi mi ama lamatua, hud'i pakaj'èu ku nèti bhelu-katub'a. kapua èèna, dhèu unu lamatua.

source_text: but in a great house be not only vessels of gold and of silver, but also of tree, and of earth; and so some be into honour, and some into despite. therefore, if any man cleanseth himself from these, he shall be a vessel hallowed into honour, and profitable to the lord, ready to all good work.
target_text: ètu d'ara èmu dhèu kaja, abhu rupa-rupa mèdha-panyau. abhu dhu tao nèti hualaa iia dènge hualaa pudhi. te ngaa abhu kahèi dhu tao nèti aj'u dènge rai kalili. mèdha dhu kab'ua, lamatua èmu na d'èi pake ètu d'ara iia-aala. te ngaa mèdha dhu biasa sèra, lamatua èmu makae pake ètu madha dhèu. sèmi èèna kahèi dènge dhèu rai-haha. ladhe abhu dhu pakaj'èu iisi ra nèti bhelu-katub'a, nèngu èci èèna ka dènge mèdha-panyau dhu kab'ua sèra. lamatua èmu d'èi pake ne, lula nèngu dènge gaguna sèna ka tao rupa-rupa sasab'a dhu be'a.

source_text: and flee thou the desires of youth, but follow thou rightwiseness, faith, charity, peace, with them that inwardly call or that in-call the lord of a clean heart.
target_text: ana ngèru sèra manahu malai lula madhutu dad'èi ra. te ngaa èu, timotius, hud'i j'aga ngi'u mu paie-iie, ho baku madhutu dad'èi d'ara sèmi èèna. tenge j'ara ho tao dhu be'a taruu. parcaya taruu lamatua. mamuri pasue aa padame dènge dhèu leo. dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu parcaya lamatua, dhu mamuri dènge d'ara mola-mèci, rèngu d'èi dhoka tao j'ara dhu be'a. de èu, timotius, hud'i mamuri ku sama sèmi rèngu sèra!

source_text: and eschew thou or shun foolish questions, and without knowing, or discipline, witting that those engender chidings.
target_text: ja'a pasanèd'e hari èu ca tèka! baku lamu soro iisi asa d'ara lii langu dhu dènge boe kolo-kapua. te sèra sa dhodhoka tao dhèu ho patao-palaha di.

source_text: but it behooveth the servant of the lord to chide not; but to be mild to all men, able to teach, patient,
target_text: dhèu dhu sab'a hia lamatua nia boe j'aj'i dhèu dhu tenge lii langu, sina ma? te ngaa rèngu sèra hud'i d'ara be'a dènge dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra, dhu d'èlu-mèu aj'a-nori dhèu, dhu taha rare d'ara ropa paraga dènge dhèu dhu tema tenge lii langu.

source_text: with temperance reproving them that against-stand the truth, that some-time god give to them repenting or penance, that they know the truth,
target_text: rèngu hud'i holo paie-iie dhèu dhu palab'a sèra. dènge sèmi èèna, ele boe lamatua hia si ele-ho'a, hèia ra sèmi rare ngaa dhu lèke.

source_text: and that they rise again from the snares of the devil, of whom they be held prisoners at his will.
target_text: hèia ra mase'a, ka ra rai nèti kacui-aai dhèu aae nidhu, dhu uru èèna èki si ho madhutu dad'èi na.

source_text: but know thou this thing, that in the last days perilous times shall nigh,
target_text: timotius! ladhe dètu dènge lod'o èle rai-haha ne, j'aj'èra na ae titu kèna. ja'a peka mema dènge èu sèmi èèna.

source_text: and men shall be loving them-selves, covetous, high of bearing, proud, blasphemers, not obedient to father and mother, unkind, cursed,
target_text: dhèu dhoka sue ngi'u ra, aa manga'a doi-dhari. rèngu padedha iisi, aa d'èi pahaha dhèu leo, d'èi pakarehe kolongara lamatua, d'èi boe nanene ina-ama ra, re'a boe manèngi makasi, kètu hadhu, d'èi boe madha j'ara lamatua,

source_text: without affection, or good will, without peace, false blamers or false challengers, uncontinent, or unchaste, unmild, without benignity,
target_text: re'a boe sue dhèu, d'èi boe mamuri padame, d'èi pa'ele iie kolongara dhèu, taha rare boe iisi ra, bhelu-katub'a dhu risi eele, d'èi boe dhu be'a,

source_text: traitors, over-thwart or froward, swollen or blownwith proud thoughts, blind, lovers of lusts more than of god,
target_text: d'èi pahie mone aanga-angalai ra, ngangee bab'a, aa tao ngi'u ra d'èlu-mèu risi, madhutu dhoka dad'èi d'ara risi nèti dad'èi lamatua.

source_text: having the likeness of piety, but denying the virtue of it. and eschew thou these men.
target_text: rèngu tao iisi ra dhèu d'èlu-mèu, te ngaa dhu mola-mèu lao. koasa lamatua abhu boe ètu d'ara ra. baku padètu dènge dhèu sèmi sèra kahèi!

source_text: of these they be that pierce houses, and lead women captives or and lead little women captive, charged with sins, which be led with diverse desires,
target_text: rèngu maso asa d'ara èmu dhèu dènge rèhu mare, ho lasi kakèj'i d'ara dhèu bhèni dhu èra boe, aa mud'a lèke god'a. dhèu bhèni sèmi sèra sa, mamuri ètu d'ara sasala-sasigo dhu udhu sobhu-sobhu, aa madhutu dhoka rupa-rupa dad'èi d'ara ra.

source_text: evermore learning, and never perfectly coming to the science, or to the knowing, of truth.
target_text: ropa ra tadèngi mese hiu mai nori j'ara dhu hiu, na, rèngu madhutu rii. te ngaa re'a boe hag'e mia ka dhu lèke, aa mia dhu sale.

source_text: and as jannes and jambres against-stood moses, so these against-stand the truth, men corrupt in understanding or in soul, reproved about the faith.
target_text: èu sanèd'e era lii lolo yanes dènge yamres, si? lod'o èèna, dua ra palab'a dènge musa. mese taa limuri se'e, tatao ra èci èèna ka. rèngu palab'a dènge lii holo-nori dhu be'a. ngangee ra ele iie le, aa parcaya rèngu lèke boe.

source_text: but further they shall not profit, for the unwisdom of them shall be known to all men, as theirs was.
target_text: mese dhu lèke boe sèmi sèra sa, bisa boe taha rare nèbhu. nèbhu-nèbhu dhèu aa'i-aa'i re'a gagoa rèngu! nuka sèmi uru èèna dhèu re'a kapod'e-kabèli lula-nèti yanes dènge yamres.

source_text: but thou hast gotten my teaching or my doctrine, ordinance, purposing or purpose, faith, long abiding, love, patience,
target_text: timotius! èu me'a aa'i le mamuri ja'a. èu me'a aa'i ngaa dhu ja'a aj'a. èu me'a j'ara mamuri ja'a. èu me'a d'ara dad'èi ja'a. èu me'a ngaa dhu ja'a parcaya. èu mèdhi unu mu le, ja'a taha kore d'ara, aa sasue ja'a mi dhèu. aa èu me'a tasamia ja'a taha ètu d'ara j'aj'èra dènge be'a.

source_text: persecutions, passions, which were made to me at antioch, at iconium, at lystra, what manner persecutions i suffered, and the lord hath delivered me of all.
target_text: èu me'a kahèi ra hake-paparu ja'a, aa dui rupa-rupa j'aj'èra. ja'a abhu j'aj'èra sèmi èèna ètu kota antiokia, ikonium, dènge listra. te ngaa ama lamatua patalale eele ja'a nèti j'ara sèra aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: and all men that will live faithfully or piously in christ jesus, shall suffer persecution.
target_text: mema dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu parcaya yesus kristus, aa neo mamuri mola-mèci madhutu dad'èi ama lamatua, tatu dhèu paj'èra rèngu.

source_text: but evil men and deceivers shall increase into worse, erring them-selves, and sending others into error.
target_text: ngaa hari, dhèu bhelu dènge dhèu kapod'e-kabèli sèra, asa tabha bhelu. rèngu kapod'e-kabhèli ho pamanahu dhèu leo, te ngaa rèngu sèra lèke kapod'e kahèi.

source_text: but dwell thou in these things that thou hast learned, and that be betaken to thee, witting of whom thou hast learned;
target_text: te ngaa èu hud'i kèpe pa'èra-èra lii holo-nori dhu èu abhu le. aa ngaa dhu èu parcaya èèna, madhutu taruu. te èèna ka dhu lèke! èu me'a mèu cee ka dhu aj'a aa'i-aa'i sèra mi èu! èu bisa lèka si!

source_text: for thou hast known holy letters from thy youth, which may learn thee or may inform thee to health, by faith that is in christ jesus.
target_text: karèi nèti èu ana iiki era, èu abhu a'aj'a le isi nèti sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua. nèti sasuri se'e, èu me'a rahasia mamuri dhu lèke, dhu tao èu me'a mèu j'ara mamuri. nèti èèna ka, èu parcaya yesus kristus.

source_text: for all scripture inspired of god is profitable to teach, to reprove, to chastise, for to learn in rightwiseness,
target_text: aa'i-aa'i dhu ra suri ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci, mema ama lamatua ka dhu uri ho dhèu suri sèra. gaguna sasuri èèna, nuka: aj'a dhèu ngaa dhu lèke, pad'elo sasala dhèu, ère hari dhèu asa j'ara dhu mola, aa nori dhèu ho bèli-bèli mamuri madhutu dad'èi lamatua.

source_text: that the man of god be perfect, learned to all good works.
target_text: dènge sèmi èèna, sasuri mola-mèci èèna bisa tao pamèci dhèu unu lamatua sèra, sèna ka rèngu re'a sasab'a dhu be'a aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: i witness before god and christ jesus, that shall deem the quick and the dead, by the coming of him, and he kingdom of him, preach the word, be thou busy covenably without rest, reprove thou, beseech thou, blame thou in all patience and doctrine.
target_text: bèli-camèd'a yesus kristus mai hari asa rai-haha ne, ho nèd'u paredha nuka sèmi dhèu aae. masi ka dhèu dhu mamuri era, do dhèu dhu madhe le, aa'i-aa'i ra lasi asa katanga madha na, sèna ka na pama'ète lii langu ra èci-èci. nèti èèna ka, ètu madha ama lamatua dènge yesus kristus, ja'a manèngi mi èu ho lamu peka-padhai dènge dhèu-dhèu, lii holo-nori ama lamatua. èu pa'èra taruu! baku pangee, na, lod'o dhu be'a, do aad'o. pad'elo sasala dhèu, te ngaa kai si pabe'a-be'a dènge lii mako. pa'èra d'ara dhèu pake lii holo-nori dhu lèke.

source_text: for time shall be, when men shall not suffer or not sustain whole-some teaching, but at their desires they shall gather together to themselves masters itching or pleasing to the ears.
target_text: te bèli-camèd'a, dhèu ro'o heka nanene lii holo-nori dhu lèke. pe ra kaboko rare mese-mese dhu d'èlu-mèu padhue-padhai madhutu dad'èi ra, sèna ka pabe'a ro'a dhilu ra.

source_text: and truly they shall turn away the hearing from truth, but to fables they shall turn.
target_text: ra hutu dhilu ra ho tule eele lii holo-nori dhu lèke. te ngaa pasa dhilu ra, ho nanene lii lolo nanuku dhu leko-monya sèra!

source_text: but wake thou, in all things travail thou, do thou the work of an evangelist, fulfill thy service, or office, be thou sober.
target_text: masi ka tasamia èèna ka, èu hud'i taha d'ara. pa'èra ètu d'ara j'aj'èra. lamu lole lii lolo be'a, sèna ka dhèu sèmi rare yesus kristus. soru-bara dhèu dènge d'ara kateme, toke pa'èle sasab'a. baku dènge d'ara cabèka.

source_text: for i am sacrificed now, and the time of my departing is nigh.
target_text: baku pusi dènge ngi'u ja'a ne, te lod'o mamadhe ja'a dètu le. èci èèna ka dènge galaa dhu isi na oe èle kèna.

source_text: i have striven a good strife, i have ended the course, i have kept the faith.
target_text: te ngaa ja'a segi le ètu d'ara pa'uji èèna dènge be'a. ja'a rai d'ai le lane. ja'a madhutu taruu le yesus kristus dènge be'a.

source_text: in the tother time a crown of rightwiseness is kept to me, which the lord, a just doomsman, shall yield to me in that day; and not only to me, but also to these that love his coming.
target_text: de ne'e ne, di èci ka dhu ja'a tatae. nuka piala juara dhu lamatua tao tèke le hia dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu mamuri mola. lamatua èdhi èèna, nuka dhèu pama'ète lii langu dhu mola. dhu ne'a boe bia cabèka. ladhe d'ai ka lod'o na, na pangèd'u mi ja'a piala juara èèna. te ngaa mesa boe ja'a di. dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu sue ne, aa dhu mate mamai na, rèngu sèra abhu piala sèmi èèna kahèi.

source_text: hie thou to come to me soon.
target_text: timotius! mai ka lai-lai ngad'o ja'a!

source_text: for demas, loving this world, hath forsaken me, and went to thessalonica, crescens into galatia, titus into dalmatia;
target_text: te limuri ne ja'a kaliu bia. krekes la'e le asa propensi galati. aa titus la'e le asa rai dalmatia. aa demas sue risi j'ara-j'ara dhu lèke boe ètu rai-haha ne, la'e le sa kota tesalonika.

source_text: luke alone is with me. take thou mark, and bring with thee; for he is profitable to me into service.
target_text: dhodhoka lukas di dhu pea dènge ja'a ètu ne'e. tenge more markus sèna ka dua mi mai palere-lere. te nèngu èèna bisa ladhe-leru ja'a ètu ne'e.

source_text: forsooth i sent tychicus to ephesus.
target_text: ja'a hia le tikikus la'e asa kota epesus.

source_text: the cloth which i left at troas at carpas, when thou comest, bring with thee, and the books, but most the parchments.
target_text: ladhe èu mai, baku bhèlu mèti kodho pana ja'a dhu tèke eele ètu èmu karpus ètu kota troas. aa baku bhèlu mèti dènge sasuri ja'a sèra, risi-risi dhu ja'a suri ètu ka'uri badha.

source_text: alexander, the treasurer, showed to me much evil; the lord shall yield to him after his works.
target_text: aleksander, tuka tabaga èèna, tao bhelu dhu ciki boe mi dedha ja'a. hud'i nèngu sène, te bèli-camèd'a, lamatua ka dhu b'ala ne, sèmi dhu nèngu tao mi dedha ja'a.

source_text: whom also thou eschew; for he against-stood full greatly our words.
target_text: èu hud'i mage-mage ku dènge dhèu èèna, lula nèngu na d'èi palab'a lii-lii dhu èdhi aj'a-nori.

source_text: in my first defence no man helped me, but all forsook me; be it not areckoned to them.
target_text: lod'o hiu-hiu ja'a titu ètu madha hakim ho siri iisi ja'a, abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu re ja'a. rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra kako tèke eele ja'a mesa ku. te ngaa hud'i rèngu sène! pe lamatua pabhèlu eele sasala ra.

source_text: but the lord helped me or the lord stood nigh to me, and comforted me, that the preaching be full-filled by me, and that all folks hear, that i am delivered from the mouth of the lion.
target_text: masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa ama lamatua tèke eele boe ja'a. na pa'èra ja'a, sèna ka ja'a bisa peka-padhai lii lolo be'a na dhu pakura boe ciki sa. ja'a lolo sèmi èèna ka mi dhèu yahudi boe, ho ra nanene lii lolo be'a. aa pakaj'èu le nèti mamadhe-mamopo.

source_text: and the lord delivered me from all evil work, and shall make me safe into his heavenly kingdom, to whom be glory into worlds of worlds. amen.
target_text: aa èèna na ama lamatua pakaj'èu ja'a nèti bhabhelu-katub'a aa'i-aa'i ra. aa lere nèti ja'a dènge sod'a-mole laku asa sorga. ètu era nèi, nèngu ka dhu nèd'u paredha. lamatua èèna, kapai seli eele! ja'a koa-kio ded'e padedha-dedha ne, dhu ma'ète boe! tare'a sèmi èèna.

source_text: greet well prisca, and aquila, and the house of onesiphorus.
target_text: baku bhelu mèti lii maho'o ja'a mi ina priskila dènge dhèu èmu na akila. sèmi èèna kahèi, mi a'ari onesiforus.

source_text: erastus left or dwelt at corinth, and i left trophimus sick at miletum.
target_text: erastus pea ètu kota korintus. ca hari ni, ja'a tèke eele trofimus ètu kota miletus, lula na pèd'a aae.

source_text: hie thou to come before winter. eubulus, and pudens, and linus, and claudia, and all brethren, greet thee well.
target_text: tenge j'ara sèna ka lod'o d'ai mèka hèru pacuhi, èu dhu d'ai le ne'e. angalai ètu se'e se, nuka: ebolus, pudes, linus dènge ina klaudia pa'adhu lii maho'o hia miu. sèmi èèna kahèi, dènge a'ari dhèu kristen dhu leo sèra.

source_text: our lord jesus christ be with thy spirit. the grace of god be with you. amen.
target_text: ja'a sanao sèna ka ama lamatua sama-sama dènge èu taruu. sèna ka lamatua pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi miu aa'i-aa'i mi. d'ai sange ne'e ka, paulus

source_text: paul, the servant of god, and apostle of jesus christ, by the faith of the chosen of god, and by the knowing of the truth, which is after piety, into the hope of everlasting life, which life god that lieth not, promised before times of the world; but he hath showed in his times his word in preaching, that is betaken to me, by the commandment of god, our saviour, to titus, most dearworthy or beloved son, by the common faith, grace and peace of god the father, and of christ jesus, our saviour.
target_text: ana titus dhu be'a! sasuri ne'e nèti ja'a, paulus, ana pua-paleha ama lamatua, aa dhèu pajuu-paleha yesus kristus. na pua ja'a sèna ka pa'èra parcaya dhèu dhu na hag'e nare sèra. na pua ja'a ho pad'elo j'ara mola kahèi, sèna ka ra mamuri madhutu dad'èi lamatua. dènge sèmi èèna, dhèu unu ama lamatua re'a, na, bèli-camèd'a rèngu mamuri taa-taa dènge ne. lod'o ama lamatua paj'aj'i mèka rai-haha ne, te ngaa na moa mema, bèli-camèd'a dhèu unu na mamuri taa-taa dènge ne. nèngu ne'a boe leko-monya. d'ai lod'o na, ka ama lamatua peka paled'a, na, nèngu saku eele sasala-sigo dhèu, sèna ka ra mamuri taa-taa dènge ne. aa na paredha ja'a ho laku peka lii lolo be'a hia dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu mia-mia. titus! èu ne nuka sèmi ana d'èlu ja'a sa, lula èu dènge ja'a ne sama-sama parcaya kristus. de ja'a sabaj'a mi ama lamatua dènge yesus kristus dhu hia mamuri mi èdhi, sèna ka ra pad'elo d'ara hua iia ra mi èu, ho èu mamuri dènge mera-milu.

source_text: for cause of this thing i left thee at crete, that thou amend those things that fail, and ordain priests by cities, as also i assigned to thee.
target_text: ca hari ni, ja'a pama'ète kore le, ho èu pea ètu pulu kreta, sèna ka uri pèri-pèri j'ara dhu èdhi parluu era ètu èèna. aa hud'i laa èu ded'e dhèu dhu re'a lalau-lalo'o juma'at ètu d'ara rae-rae. baku bhèlu atora dhu ja'a peka le dènge èu, lula-nèti dhèu dhu j'aj'i kètu juma'at. peka na:

source_text: if any man is without crime, or great sin, an husband of one wife, and hath faithful sons, not in accusation of lechery, or not subject.
target_text: ladhe neo ded'e dhèu ho j'aj'i kètu juma'at, nèngu hud'i mamuri ku dènge boe sasala. nèngu hud'i satia dènge dhèu èmu na ca dhèu di. ana-ana na parcaya kahèi yesus kristus. mage dhoka dhèu peka, na, rèngu sèra ana-ana dhu tenge patao-palaha di, aa palab'a dènge dhèu.

source_text: for it behooveth a bishop to be without crime, as a dispenser of god, not proud, not wrathful, not given to drunkenness, not a smiter, not covetous of foul winning;
target_text: lula kètu juma'at sèra pakako sasab'a lamatua, de rèngu hud'i mamuri dènge mola, aa dènge kolongara hua iia. baku ded'e dhèu dhu d'èi padedha iisi; dhu nasa malai, d'èi mahu, dhu d'èi pagama, aa dhu manga'a doi-dhari.

source_text: but holding hospitality, benign, prudent, sober, just, holy, continent,
target_text: dhèu dhu j'aj'i kètu juma'at sèra hud'i d'èi sèmi rare dhèu asa d'ara èmu ra. dhu d'èi j'ara-j'ara dhu be'a, dhu taha rare d'ara, dhu bia boe cabèka, dhu d'ara mola-mèci, aa dhu re'a taha rare ngi'u.

source_text: taking or embracing that true word, that is after doctrine; that he be mighty to admonish in wholesome teaching or doctrine, and to reprove them that gainsay.
target_text: rèngu hud'i kèpe pa'èra-èra ku lii holo-nori ama lamatua, dhu uru èèna èdhi nori si. dènge sèmi èèna, rèngu pad'elo j'ara lamatua dhu mola hia dhèu leo, aa bisa pamola lii lolo dhu lèke boe j'ara sèra.

source_text: for there be many unobedient, and vain speakers, and deceivers, most they that be of circumcision,
target_text: te abhu dhèu ae dhu d'èi palab'a a'aj'a dhu lèke. abhu dhu peka-padhai dènge boe kolo-kapua. aa abhu kahèi dhu d'èi kapod'e-kabèli. risi-risi dhèu yahudi dhu peka, na, dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu neo abhu mamuri hud'i suna ku.

source_text: which it behooveth to be reproved; which subvert all houses, teaching which things it behooveth not, for the love of foul winning.
target_text: ra pake a'aj'a rèngu dhu sala ho nuni rèti a'ari èdhi pakaj'èu nèti lii holo-nori lamatua dhu lèke. rèngu sèra d'èi dhoka tenge doi-dhari dènge j'ara kapod'e-kabèli di! kai dhèu sèmi sèra sa, sèna ka ra loe nèti aj'a j'ara-j'ara dhu lèke boe.

source_text: and one of them, their proper prophet said, men of crete be ever more liars, evil beasts, of slow womb.
target_text: ca tèka, dhèu èci nèti pulu kreta, dhu tema padhai pake lii hini, lole dhèu nèngu unu na, aku nèngu na, dhèu pulu kreta d'èi dhoka padhai lii hèb'a hua di, dhu manga'a, nuka sèmi badha hui dhu re'a boe atora, aa bai-eed'a mèje adhe!

source_text: this witnessing is true. for which cause blame them sore, that they be whole in faith,
target_text: mamuri dhèu sèra mema sèmi èèna ka! de èu hud'i lamu ère more hari dhèu dhu lèke kapod'e-kabèli sèra, ho pa'èra hari parcaya ra mi lamatua.

source_text: not giving attention to fables of jews, and to commandments of men, that turn away them or turn them away from truth.
target_text: èle èèna, ra nanene ia ka nanuku nèti dhèu yahudi sèra, aa rèngu hud'i ae eele ku nèti lii paredha dhèu-dhèu dhu tule eele lii holo-nori dhu lèke.

source_text: and all things be clean to clean men; but to unclean men and to unfaithful, nothing is clean, for the soul and conscience of them be made unclean.
target_text: sanèd'e paie-iie! bagi dhèu dhu d'ara mola-mèci, aa'i-aa'i mola-mèci. te ngaa bagi dhu d'ara kaj'alu aa dhu parcaya boe lamatua, abhu boe ngaa èci sa dhu mola-mèci. lula d'ara dènge ngangee rèngu dhu kaj'alu mema le.

source_text: they acknowledge that they know god, but by deeds they deny him; when they be abominable, and unbelieveful, and reprovable to all good work.
target_text: rèngu mangaku tadhe ama lamatua. te ngaa mamuri ra nuka sèmi dhèu dhu tadhe boe ne. rèngu padhai lii leo, tao leo. rèngu mema tare'a-re'a dhèu karehe di! rèngu ro'o boe madhutu dad'èi lamatua. baku maena dhèu sèmi sèra re'a tao dhu be'a!

source_text: but speak thou those things that beseem or that become wholesome teaching;
target_text: te ngaa èu ne, titus, baku j'aj'i sèmi rèngu kahèi! èu hud'i pa'èra d'ara dhèu, sèna ka ra mamuri madhutu lii holo-nori lamatua dhu lèke.

source_text: that old men be sober, chaste, prudent, whole in faith, in love, and patience;
target_text: peka dènge ama-ama dhèu heka sèra ho mamuri madhutu atora, j'aga paie kolongara, aa taha rare d'ara. rèngu hud'i kèpe pa'èra aa taha taruu madhutu lii holo-nori ama lamatua dhu lèke. aa rèngu hud'i sue dhèu leo kahèi.

source_text: also old women in holy habit, not slanderers or backbiters, not serving much to wine, well-teaching, that they teach prudence.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi dènge ina-ina dhu heka sèra. peka dènge ra j'aga paie kakako dènge lii padhai ra, aa mamuri taruu madhutu dad'èi lamatua. baku padhai-kakoli kolongara dhèu. baku j'aj'i ènu dhua ara-dhua pèd'u. te ngaa rèngu hud'i aj'a dhèu, sèna ka ra mamuri dènge mola.

source_text: admonish thou young women, that they love their husbands, that they love their children;
target_text: dènge j'ara sèmi èèna, rèngu j'aj'i dhèu pad'elo j'ara mi ina-ina dhu ngèru era, sèna ka ra sue dhèu èmu-kamali dènge ana-ana ra.

source_text: and that they be prudent, chaste, sober, having care of the house, benign, subject to their husbands, that the word of god be not blasphemed.
target_text: rèngu hud'i aj'a kahèi dhèu ho ra mamuri dènge taha rare d'ara, mola-mèci, re'a lalau d'ara èmu, re'a pahae dhèu èmu ra, aa d'èi nanene lii dhèu èmu ra. ladhe mamuri rèngu sèmi èèna, dhèu bisa heka padhai lii pahaha lii holo-nori ama lamatua.

source_text: also admonish young men, that they be sober.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi, holo mone ngèru sèra, sèna ka ra mamuri dènge taha rare d'ara.

source_text: in all things give thyself ensample of good works, in teaching, in wholeness or in holiness of living, that is, in cleanness of soul and body, in firmness of virtues.
target_text: titus! èu ne hud'i mamuri dènge be'a ku, ho bisa j'aj'i dhèu pad'elo j'ara mi dhèu leo. sad'i èu tao ngaa èci sa, sab'a dènge be'a, sama sèmi dhu èu aj'a dhèu sèra. ladhe èu aj'a ngaa sa èci, na, tao madhutu ngaa dhu èu aj'a sèra. mage pamud'e dènge sasab'a èu.

source_text: an wholesome word, and unreprovable; that he that is of the contrary side, be ashamed, having none evil thing to say of you.
target_text: ladhe èu nori dhèu, pake lii holo-nori dhu lèke, sèna ka dhèu abhu boe j'ara ho pamanahu èu. dènge j'ara sèmi ne'e, dhèu-dhèu dhu lab'a èdhi ra'e makae, lula rèngu abhu boe j'ara ho segi èdhi.

source_text: admonish thou servants to be subject to their lords; in all things pleasing, not gainsaying,
target_text: aj'a ènu sèra ho ra nanene lamatua rèngu ètu j'ara ngaa èèna ka, aa pakarej'e d'ara lamatua ra. baku ra pab'ala lii padhai dènge lamatua ra.

source_text: not defrauding, but in all things showing good faith, that they honour in all things the doctrine of god, our saviour.
target_text: rèngu baku mana'u mèdha-panyau lamatua ra. rèngu hud'i pad'elo ku dhu peka, na, lamatua ra bisa parcaya rèngu tare'a-re'a. rèngu sèra hud'i j'aj'i dhèu dhu be'a aa satia. ladhe dhèu leo neo pakasame mamuri ènu rèngu dènge aa'i-aa'i dhu èdhi aj'a, tatu ra dhaa, peka na, lii a'aj'a èdhi be'a titu kèna. te a'aj'a èdhi se'e, madhutu j'ara-j'ara ama lamatua dhu hia le mamuri mi èdhi.

source_text: for the grace of god, our saviour, hath appeared to all men,
target_text: te ama lamatua pad'elo le babe'a d'ara na mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra, aa bhoke j'ara ho patabuli dhèu nèti koasa sasala-sasigo ra.

source_text: and taught us, that we forsake wickedness or unpiety, and worldly desires, and live soberly, and justly, and piously in this world,
target_text: nèti èèna ka, mamuri dhu pamèci boe, aa dad'èi dhu karehe, ti core eele si. èdhi mamuri ètu rai-haha ne, hud'i te'a taha tare d'ara, mamuri dènge mola-mèci, aa satia dènge ama lamatua.

source_text: abiding the blessed hope and the coming of the glory of the great god, and our saviour jesus christ;
target_text: limuri ne èdhi sanao-maena mamai hari yesus kristus dhu kapai risi eele! èèna j'aj'i mèngi-nale mi èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti. nèngu èèna, lamatua èdhi dhu kapai risi dhu pala-bagi le mamuri mi èdhi.

source_text: that gave himself for us, to again-buy us from all wickedness, and make clean to himself a people acceptable, and pursuer of good works.
target_text: nèngu hia le ngi'u aae na j'aj'i mi korban, sèna ka patabuli eele èdhi nèti koasa sasala-sasigo èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti, sèna ka tao èdhi j'aj'i dhèu unu na dhu mamuri mola-mèci, dhu d'èi dhoka tao j'ara hua iia di.

source_text: speak thou these things, and admonish thou, and reprove thou with all commandment; no man despise thee.
target_text: de titus, aj'a aa'i-aa'i se mi dhèu sarani sèra. pa'èra d'ara si, sèna ka madhutu a'aj'a sèra. dhèu cee dhu tao sala, na, pad'elo j'ara be'a hia ne. dhèu bisa boe pahaha èu, lula èu dènge hak ho tao paie rèngu.

source_text: admonish them to be subjects or to be subject to princes, and to powers; to obey to that that is said, and to be ready to all good work;
target_text: pasanèd'e dhèu sarani sèra, ho nanene dhèu paredha aa dhèu-dhèu dhu rèd'u koasa. rèngu hud'i madhutu ku atora sèra. aa rèngu hud'i pa'èra tao j'ara-j'ara dhu be'a.

source_text: to blaspheme no man, to be not full of chiding, but temperate or patient, showing all mildness to all men.
target_text: baku lasi padhai pa'ele iie kolongara dhèu. baku d'èi pasibha d'ara lii. be'a risi, mamuri mola, dènge d'ara hua iia mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: for we were sometime unwise, unbelieveful, erring, and serving to desires, and to diverse lusts, doing in malice and envy, worthy to be hated, hating each other.
target_text: te uru èèna, lod'o èdhi tadhe mèka lamatua yesus, èdhi te'a boe ngaa-ngaa, aa dènge mud'a lèke tipu. èdhi to'o boe nanene dhèu leo. èdhi dhoka mamuri madhutu d'ara bhelu di, ka èki ngi'u èdhi dènge rupa-rupa dad'èi d'ara ti. èdhi d'ara karehe dènge dhèu leo. èdhi mamuri dhoka dènge jeluus. èdhi d'èi tèka d'ara mi dhèu leo, hèia ra kab'èli tèka d'ara dènge èdhi.

source_text: but when the benignity and the manhood or the humanity of our saviour god appeared,
target_text: masi ka mamuri èdhi ne ele iie le, te ngaa ama lamatua dhu hia mamuri mi èdhi, pad'elo le sasue dènge d'ara hua iia na mi dedha èdhi.

source_text: not of works of rightwiseness that we did, but by his mercy he made us safe, by the washing, or baptism, of again-begetting, and again-newing of the holy ghost,
target_text: na hia èdhi mamuri lula boe nèti tatao èdhi dhu be'a, te ngaa lula sasue na mi èdhi. nèngu rase pamèu-mèu sasala èdhi sèra pake roh na dhu mola-mèci, sèna ka pahiu mamuri èdhi, nuka sèmi rara iisi hari èdhi.

source_text: whom he shedded out into us plenteously by jesus christ, our saviour,
target_text: lula yesus kristus madhe le ho pakaj'èu èdhi nèti koasa sasala sèra, nèti èèna ka ama lamatua hia dènge boe too-lane roh na dhu mola-mèci mi èdhi.

source_text: that we justified by his grace, be heirs by hope of everlasting life.
target_text: lula d'ara hua iia yesus, ka na pabe'a pa'èci èdhi dènge ama lamatua, nuka sèmi ana na. hèia èdhi te'a, na, bèli-camèd'a èdhi mamuri taa-taa dènge ne. se'e se j'aj'i mi pusaka èdhi!

source_text: a true word is this, and of these things i will that thou confirm others, that they that believe in god, be busy to be above or to be before others in good works. these things be good, and profitable to men.
target_text: dhu ja'a peka ne, lèke tare'a. ngaa dhu ja'a aj'a ne, dènge kab'ua hia mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i. nèti èèna ka, èu hud'i pasanèd'e dhèu ho madhutu lii aj'a dhu mola. dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu parcaya lamatua, loe boe tenge j'ara sèna ka tao j'ara dhu be'a.

source_text: and eschew thou foolish questions, and genealogies, and strivings or strives, and fightings of the law; for those be unprofitable and vain.
target_text: baku soro iisi asa d'ara lii langu dhu leko-monya, nuka sèmi: pasibha d'ara lii langu dhu dènge boe kolo-kapua, patao iia d'ara dènge dhèu leo, patula-pajuku nèti j'aj'aj'i mia dhu dedha risi, aa patao nèti atora ad'a yahudi. tao ngaa? sèra sa aa'i-aa'i, èci sa gaguna na aad'o. pèci eele lod'o iia d'ara!

source_text: eschew or shun thou a man heretic, after one and the second correction;
target_text: lamu holo dhèu dhu tema pamae juma'at sèra. ladhe nèngu tao taruu, kai ne. aa ladhe na loe boe, soro tèke ne sène.

source_text: witting that he that is such a manner man is subverted, and trespasseth, and is condemned by his own doom.
target_text: dhèu sèmi èèna, ngangee na mola heka. nèti tatao unu na ka, dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra re'a mèu sasala na.

source_text: when i send to thee artemas, or tychicus, hie thou or haste to come to me to nicopolis; for i have purposed to dwell in winter there.
target_text: ja'a neo hia artemas do tikikus, dhiu paraga dènge èu asa pulu kreta. ladhe na d'ai, èu tenge j'ara sèna ka mai lai-lai paraga dènge ja'a ètu kota nikopolis. te ja'a neo pea ètu nèi d'ara hèru pacuhi ne.

source_text: busily before send or send before zenas, a wise man of law, and apollos, that nothing fail to them.
target_text: èu tadhe le dhèu dhu d'èlu-mèu hukum, ngara na senas, aa angalai na apolos, do? ra neo lasi asa era kaj'èu. de mu bara si, sèna ka ra baku kura ngaa-ngaa ètu talora j'ara.

source_text: they that be of ours, learn to be governors or to be before in good works, to necessary uses, that they be not without fruit.
target_text: te dhèu dhu madhutu lamatua yesus baku madhèdi iia d'ara di. rèngu hud'i maj'èni tao dhu be'a, aa bara dhèu dhu tare'a-re'a parluu. dènge sèmi èèna, mamuri ra dènge kab'ua.

source_text: all men that be with me greet thee well. greet thou well them, that love us in the faith. the grace of god be with you all. amen.
target_text: titus. ji'i aa'i-aa'i ètu ne'e pa'adhu lii maho'o hia èu. aa hia kahèi mi angalai ji'i dhu sama-sama parcaya lamatua yesus. ja'a sabaj'a manèngi sèna ka lamatua pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi dedha miu aa'i-aa'i mi. d'ai sange ne'e ka, paulus

source_text: paul, the bound of christ jesus, and timothy, brother, to philemon, beloved, and our helper,
target_text: sasuri ne nèti ja'a, paulus. angalai ja'a, timotius, hia lii maho'o kahèi. sèna ka èu me'a, ra taha ja'a ètu d'ara èmu bèdho ne, lula ja'a peka-padhai dènge dhèu lula-nèti yesus kristus. ja'a suri sasuri ne hia èu, pilmon, dhu ji'i sue, aa dhu j'aj'i angalai ètu d'ara sasab'a;

source_text: and to apphia, most dear sister, and to archippus, our even-knight, and to the church that is in thine house,
target_text: hia ina apfia, dhu ji'i tadhe nuka sèmi ana hèni ji'i; hia arkipus, dhu sab'a sama-sama dènge ji'i ètu d'ara sasab'a ne'e; dènge hia juma'at dhu tema sabaj'a sama-sama ètu d'ara èmu èu.

source_text: grace be to you, and peace of god our father, and of the lord jesus christ.
target_text: ja'a manèngi sèna ka ama lamatua, dènge kètu èdhi, yesus kristus, pad'elo d'ara hua iia ra mi dedha miu, sèna ka miu bisa mamuri padame èci dènge èci.

source_text: i do thankings to my god, ever-more making mind of thee, in my prayers,
target_text: pilmon! lod'o-lod'o dhu ja'a sabaj'a hia èu, ja'a manèngi makasi mi lamatua, lula mamuri èu.

source_text: hearing thy charity, and faith, that thou hast in the lord jesus, and to all holy men,
target_text: te ja'a tadèngi ae le nèti parcaya èu mi lamatua yesus, dènge sasue èu mi dhèu-dhèu parcaya.

source_text: that the communing of thy faith be made open, in knowing of all good thing in christ jesus.
target_text: lula lalèka èu, èu bisa mamuri d'ara èci dènge dhèu parcaya dhu leo sèra. ja'a manèngi-mangaj'i ho ladhe miu pad'elo d'ara be'a miu èci dènge èci, miu bisa me'a mèu madha j'ara aa'i-aa'i dhu be'a, dhu èdhi bisa tao hia lamatua yesus.

source_text: and i had great joy and comfort in thy charity, for the entrails of holy men rested or were refreshed by thee, brother.
target_text: sasue èu èèna ka pakarej'e d'ara ja'a, aa pa'èra d'ara ja'a kahèi. aa sasue èu èèna ka, pa'èra kahèi d'ara dhèu parcaya sèra.

source_text: for which thing i having much trust in christ jesus, to command to thee that that pertaineth to profit; but i beseech more for charity, since thou art such as the old paul, and now the bound of jesus christ.
target_text: a'a, ee! ja'a parluu ciki, sèmi ne'e: ja'a j'aj'i dhèu pajuu-paleha kristus. nèti èèna ka, ja'a dènge hak kahèi ho paredha èu, sèna ka tao j'ara ne'e. te ngaa ja'a ko'o boe tao paredha di, dhoka neo manèngi èu bantu di, nuka sèmi dhèu heka dhu to'a mi dedha èu. ja'a j'aj'i ana bèdho lula madhutu yesus kristus. nèti èèna ka ja'a bani manèngi èu soru-bara ja'a, lula ja'a ke'a sasue èu mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: i beseech thee for my son onesimus, whom i in bonds begat,
target_text: ja'a manèngi sèna ka èu pad'elo sasue èu mi ana ja'a, onesimus. nèngu èèna, nuka sèmi ana d'èlu ja'a, te nèngu parcaya yesus nèti sasab'a ja'a, ropa ja'a ètu d'ara bui ne.

source_text: which sometime was unprofitable to thee, but now profitable, both to thee and to me;
target_text: ja'a ke'a, onesimus ne, ènu èu dhu rai nèti èu. ja'a ke'a, na, uru èèna nèngu dhu laku boe ètu katanga madha èu. te ngaa limuri ne, ja'a parcaya nèngu nèti gaguna ae-ae hia èdhi dua ti.

source_text: whom i sent again to thee. and receive thou him as mine entrails;
target_text: ja'a sue ne titu kèna. te ngaa hud'i laa, ja'a pua na lèpa hari asa èu.

source_text: whom i would withhold with me, that he should serve for thee to me in bonds of the gospel;
target_text: madhutu ngangee ja'a, na, ja'a taha onesimus sèna ka gati èu, ho nèngu ladhe-leru ja'a ètu ne'e. te ja'a bisa boe tao ngaa-ngaa ètu d'ara bèdho ne. ja'a j'aj'i ana bèdho, lula peka-padhai dènge dhèu lii lolo be'a lamatua yesus.

source_text: but without thy counsel i would not do anything, that thy good should not be as of need, but willful.
target_text: ja'a ko'o boe sèna ka èu sad'i madhutu di, ladhe èu rasa dhèu laka-seti èu. dad'èi ja'a, na, èu tao dhu be'a madhutu dad'èi èu unu mu. de ladhe èu mo'o mèka sèmi dènge be'a lii manèngi ja'a, na, ja'a ko'o boe tao ngaa ciki sa mi onesimus ne, lula dhu hak dhoka èu di.

source_text: for peradventure therefore he departed from thee for a time, that thou shouldest receive him without end;
target_text: ele boe èu pangee sèmi ne'e: lamatua soro tèke onesimus ele nèti èu d'ara ciki oo'e ne, sèna ka na mai hari ho pea taruu dènge èu.

source_text: now not as a servant, but for a servant a most dear brother or but more than a servant, most dear brother, most to me; and how much more to thee, both in the flesh and in the lord?
target_text: lod'o na rai èèna, nèngu dhoka j'aj'i dhèu ènu èu di. te ngaa ladhe nèngu lèpa hari dhiu, nèngu j'aj'i mi ari pasue èu. ja'a sue ne titu kèna kahèi. de ne'e ne, gaguna na hia mi èu asa tabha. te nèngu ne mesa boe j'aj'i ènu èu di, te ngaa nèngu j'aj'i kahèi ari dhu sama-sama parcaya kristus.

source_text: therefore if thou hast me a fellow, receive him as me;
target_text: de sèmi ne'e ka. ladhe èu tadhe ja'a ne angalai èu ètu d'ara sasab'a èci, na, ja'a manèngi ho èu sèmi more nèngu, nuka sèmi ja'a ka dhu dhiu èèna.

source_text: for if he hath anything annoyed thee, either oweth, areckon thou this thing to me.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe onesimus tao nèdhi sala mi dedha èu, do, na pakèlu era, hud'i laa pe ja'a ka tago kore.

source_text: i, paul, wrote with mine hand, i shall yield; that i say not to thee, that also thou owest to me thyself.
target_text: ladhe laa! sasuri pakèlu ne, ja'a suri unu ku. ja'a, paulus, èèna na b'ae pama'ète kèlu onesimus mi pilmon. d'ai le, sina ma? de ja'a parluu heka pasanèd'e, na, èu pakèlu ja'a ae risi. te èu j'aj'i dhèu unu lamatua, lula ja'a.

source_text: so, brother, i shall use thee in the lord; full-fill thou mine entrails in christ.
target_text: lèke kèna! hud'i laa sèna ka èu bantu ja'a ètu j'ara ne'e, lula èdhi pa'a'ari ètu d'ara lamatua. pakarej'e d'ara ja'a sèmi èèna, lula èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti sama-sama dhèu unu kristus.

source_text: i trusting of thine obedience wrote to thee, witting that thou shalt do over that that i say.
target_text: pilmon! ja'a suri sasuri ne hia èu, lula ja'a parcaya èu bisa taru kira mi ja'a dènge be'a. ja'a rasa, èèna na èu tao risi nèti ngaa dhu ja'a sanao.

source_text: also make thou ready to me an house to dwell in; for i hope that by your prayers i shall be given to you.
target_text: j'ara èci era. sadia ku kama èci hia ja'a. te ja'a parcaya lamatua tadèngi lii sabaj'a miu, aa pe na bhoke j'ara ho kalua eele ja'a nèti d'ara bui, sèna ka dhiu hari pa'asu-pareo dènge miu ètu nèi.

source_text: epaphras, prisoner with me in christ jesus, greeteth thee well,
target_text: epapras ètu ne'e. nèngu j'aj'i dhèu bui kahèi, lula nèngu lole j'ara-j'ara lula-nèti yesus kristus sèmi ja'a kahèi. na pa'adhu lii maho'o kahèi hia èu.

source_text: and marcus, aristarchus, demas, lucas, mine helpers.
target_text: markus, aristarkus, demas, dènge lukas ètu ne'e kahèi. sasab'a rèngu èci èèna ka dènge ja'a. rèngu hia lii maho'o kahèi.

source_text: the grace of our lord jesus christ be with your spirit. amen.
target_text: ja'a manèngi kètu èdhi, yesus kristus, sèna ka pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi miu aa'i-aa'i mi. d'ai sange ne'e ka! saloom, paulus

source_text: god, that spake sometime by prophets in many manners to our fathers,
target_text: uru èèna, ama lamatua pake dhèu rèti lii padhai na, ho padhai lii dènge bèi-baki èdhi dhèu ibrani. nèngu pake rupa-rupa j'ara, sèna ka peka pahari-pahari dènge rèngu.

source_text: at the last in these days he hath spoken to us by the son; whom he hath ordained heir of all things, and by whom he made the worlds.
target_text: te ngaa limuri ne, na pua le ana na mai, sèna ka padhai lii dènge èdhi. karèi nèti uru-uru j'ara ka, ama lamatua hag'e nare le ana na, ho nèd'u paredha sama-sama dènge nèngu. te lod'o na paj'aj'i liru dènge rai-haha dènge isi ra aa'i-aa'i, ana na dhu sab'a sama-sama dènge ne kahèi.

source_text: which when also he is the brightness of glory, and the figure of his substance, and beareth all things by word of his virtue, he maketh purgation of sins, and sitteth on the right half of the majesty in heavens;
target_text: ana lamatua ne, pad'elo dadedha ama na, nuka sèmi saraa madha lod'o dhu lèke tèru. te nèngu ne, ca ropa dènge ama na. aa nèti lii holo-nori na dhu èra titu kèna, na pakako aa'i-aa'i ètu dedha-liru dènge rai-haha. nèngu bhoke j'ara kahèi, ho saku eele sasala-sasigo dhèu, sèna ka ra j'aj'i mola-mèci. hèia na lèpa hari asa sorga, ho madhèdi ètu baboa g'ana ama lamatua, ètu era dhu kab'ua aae.

source_text: and so much is made better than angels, by how much he hath inherited a more diverse name before them.
target_text: ana-ana pajuu ama lamatua ètu sorga mema kapai. te ngaa ana na kapai risi eele nèti rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra. kapai dènge dadedha ama lamatua risi eele nèti aa'i-aa'i ra. aa kapai dènge dadedha èèna, na pangèd'u le mi ana na. nèti èèna ka, ana na kapai risi eele nèti ana-ana pajuu na ètu sorga.

source_text: for to which of the angels said god any time, thou art my son, i have engendered thee today? and again, i shall be to him into a father, and he shall be to me into a son?
target_text: ama lamatua peka nèdhi mi ana na, aku nèngu na, doe ne'e, ja'a ded'e èu ho mèd'u paredha. ama lamatua, peka kahèi, na, ja'a ne, ama na. aa nèngu ne, ana ja'a. ama lamatua peka dènge ana na sèmi èèna, te ngaa ama lamatua peka nèdhi boe sèmi èèna, mi ana-ana pajuu na ètu sorga.

source_text: and when again he bringeth in the first begotten son into the world, he saith, and all the angels of god worship him.
target_text: lod'o ama lamatua pua mai ana na dhu kapai risi eele èèna, na paredha ana-ana pajuu na ètu sorga, aku nèngu na, miu ana pajuu aa'i-aa'i! lami ho pakab'ua, aa pahaha iisi mi ana ja'a!

source_text: but he saith to angels, he that maketh his angels spirits, and his ministers flame of fire.
target_text: ama lamatua padhai lii kahèi mi ana pajuu na ètu sorga, peka na, ja'a tao ana-ana pajuu ja'a ètu sorga, j'aj'i malai sama sèmi lai ngèlu. ja'a tao ènu-ènu ja'a, j'aj'i nuka sèmi ai. ama lamatua peka dènge ra sèmi èèna, lula rèngu dhoka ana pua-paleha na di.

source_text: but to the son he saith, god, thy throne is into the world of worlds; a rod of equity is the rod of thy realm;
target_text: te ngaa mi ana d'èlu na, nèngu peka dhu leo, na, èu ne, ama lamatua. èu, èèna na madhèdi ètu kadera paredha toke d'ai mia-mia. èu èèna na mèd'u koasa, ho paredha dènge d'ara mola.

source_text: thou hast loved rightwiseness, and hatedest wickedness; therefore the god or therefore god, thy god, anointed thee with oil of joy, more than thy fellows.
target_text: d'ara èu karej'e, ladhe mèdhi dhèu dhu mamuri mola. te ngaa d'ara mu susa, ladhe mèdhi dhèu dhu mamuri koe-kapengo. nèti èèna ka, d'ara èu karej'e, ka ja'a pasuti èi lèngi mi kètu èu, ho ded'e èu j'aj'i dhèu aae, dhu risi nèti dhèu aae leo sèra.

source_text: and, thou, lord, in the beginning foundedest the earth, and heavens be works of thine hands;
target_text: ama lamatua peka mi ana na kahèi, na, ana, ee! èu ne, kètu dhu mèd'u paredha karèi nèti uru ka. èu ne'e ka dhu pua liru j'aj'i, hèia na j'aj'i dènge. èu ne'e ka dhu paredha rai-haha, hèia na j'aj'i dènge.

source_text: they shall perish, but thou shalt perfectly dwell; and all shall wax old as a cloth, and thou shalt change them as a cloth, and they shall be changed. but thou art the same thyself, and thy years shall not fail.
target_text: bèli-camèd'a liru dènge rai-haha laho aa'i si. bèli-camèd'a liru dènge rai-haha ele aa'i si. te ngaa èu mesa mu, mamuri toke d'ai mia-mia. èèna na èu core eele liru dènge rai-haha, nuka sèmi dhèu core eele kaha'i soho dhasi. bèli-camèd'a èu gati eele liru aa rai-haha, nuka sèmi dhèu silu mèdha-papake hiu. te ngaa èu mesa mu sèmi boe èèna. lula èu mamuri toke d'ai mia-mia.

source_text: but to which of the angels said god at any time, sit thou on my right half, till i put thine enemies a stool of thy feet?
target_text: ama lamatua peka kahèi dènge ana na, aku nèngu na, ana, ee! mai madhèdi asa era dhu kab'ua titu kèna, ètu baboa g'ana ja'a ne. pe ja'a tao musu èu sèra, toke ra pahaha iisi mi èu. ama lamatua peka-padhai mi ana na sèmi èèna, te ngaa na padhai lii nèdhi boe sèmi èèna mi ana-ana pajuu na ètu sorga.

source_text: whether they all be not serving spirits, sent to serve for them that take the heritage of health?
target_text: ana pajuu na sèra mema panting. te nèngu paleha si lasi lalau-lalo'o dhèu unu na aa'i-aa'i dhu èèna na nèngu patabuli eele si nèti koasa sasala-sasigo ra. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa ana ama lamatua risi nèti rèngu era.

source_text: therefore more plenteously it behooveth us to keep those things, that we have heard, lest peradventure we float away.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, èdhi hud'i kèpe ku pa'èra-èra ngaa dhu èdhi tadèngi le nèti j'ara-j'ara ana ama lamatua, sèna ka èdhi baku bhèlu eele.

source_text: for if that word that was said by angels, was made firm, and each breaking of the law or each tres-passing, and unobedience took just retribution of meed,
target_text: lod'o uru-uru sèra, lamatua pake ana pajuu na nèti sorga, ho lole lii moa na mi bèi-baki èdhi. te'a boe na, lii moa sèra aa'i-aa'i ra lèke. ladhe ra sisu paredha na, rèngu tatu abhu huku dhu palèke dènge tatao ra.

source_text: how shall we escape, if we despise so great an health? which, when it had taken beginning to be told out by the lord, of them that heard, is confirmed into us.
target_text: mema uru èèna, sèmi èèna ka. te ngaa limuri ne, ana ama lamatua bhoke le j'ara hiu, sèna ka hia mamuri mi dhèu rai-haha. na peka le j'ara mamuri dhu be'a aae ne mi dhèu unu na dhu pakako sasab'a na ètu rai-haha ne. hèia ra peka dènge èdhi, sèna ka èdhi parcaya. te ngaa ladhe èdhi pusi-pahae boe, dui tare pala ti!

source_text: for god witnessed together by miracles or signs, and wonders, and great marvels, and diverse virtues, and partings or distributions of the holy ghost, by his will.
target_text: te ama lamatua pangèd'u si koasa kahèi, sèna ka ra tao rupa-rupa tadha malaa. na papuru roh na mi rèngu kahèi, ho ra ad'u-ue j'ara-j'ara leo dhu madhutu dad'èi na. nèti èèna ka èdhi te'a, na, aa'i-aa'i se j'ara mamuri dhu lèke tare'a-re'a.

source_text: but not to angels god subjected the world that is to coming, of which we speak. forsooth not to angels god subjected the roundness of the earth to come, of which we speak.
target_text: ja'a lole lula-nèti rai-haha rupa hiu dhu bèli-camèd'a j'aj'i. te ngaa ama lamatua peka nèdhi boe dènge ana-ana pajuu na ètu sorga, na, pe rèngu ka dhu ator rai-haha hiu èèna. te dhu lalau ka, dhèu rai-haha.

source_text: but some man witnessed in a place, and said, what thing is man, that thou art mindful of him, or man's son, for thou visitest him?
target_text: ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua, na, daud dhu karèi nèdhi le kab'ua nèti dhèu rai-haha, aku nèngu na, ama lamatua! nga tao ka ama tao madha-dhilu mi dhèu rai-haha? nga tao ka ama sue si? te rèngu dhoka dhèu rai-haha biasa di!

source_text: thou hast made him a little less than angels; thou hast crowned him with glory and honour; and thou hast ordained him on the works of thine hands.
target_text: te ngaa lamatua pangèd'u si koasa, ka rèngu oe sèmi ana pajuu ètu sorga. lamatua pakab'ua si hèi, aa ded'e si,

source_text: thou hast made all things subject under his feet. and in that that he subjected all things to him, he left nothing unsubject to him. but now we see not yet all things subject to him;
target_text: ho ra paredha aa'i dhu lamatua paj'aj'i. de madhutu sasuri daud, ama lamatua ded'e dhèu rai-haha j'aj'i kètu, sèna ka ra uri aa'i-aa'i dhu na paj'aj'i. te ngaa èdhi tèdhi mèka na, dhèu rai-haha èci sa dhu paredha aa'i-aa'i sèmi èèna.

source_text: but we see him that was made a little less than angels, jesus, for the passion of death, crowned with glory and honour, that he through the grace of god should taste death for all men.
target_text: te ngaa abhu ca dhèu dhu bisa paredha aa'i-aa'i se. nèngu èèna, nuka yesus. na mai pea taha ètu rai-haha ne, sèna ka j'aj'i dhèu rai-haha dhu pasae j'aj'èra, ka na madhe hia mi èdhi. nèti mamadhe na, ama lamatua pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi dhèu rai-haha. èle èèna ka, ama lamatua koa-kad'iri ne, aa ded'e ne padedha-dedha, sèna ka na paredha aa'i-aa'i dhu ama lamatua paj'aj'i nare sèra.

source_text: for it beseemed him, for whom all things, and by whom all things were made, which had brought many sons into glory, and wasthe author or the maker of the health or salvation of them, that he had an end by passion.
target_text: de lèke, ladhe ama lamatua hia yesus pasae j'aj'èra, ho yesus bisa bhoke j'ara mamuri pala mi dhèu rai-haha. te ama lamatua neo sèna ka dhèu ae bisa mamuri bera-bera dènge nèngu ètu sorga. ama lamatua ka dhu paj'aj'i aa'i mèu-mèu. aa aa'i-aa'i dhu mamuri, mamuri lula nèngu ka.

source_text: for he that halloweth, and they that be hallowed, be all of one; for which cause he is not ashamed to call them brethren,
target_text: ama lamatua tatu sèmi nare si dènge be'a dhèu dhu yesus tao mola-mèci, ho j'aj'i ana-ana na. ama lamatua èèna, ama nèti yesus. dènge sèmi èèna, yesus dènge rèngu, ca ama. nèti èèna ka, yesus makae boe paroa mi dhèu se'e, na, miu se, a'ari ja'a.

source_text: saying, i shall tell thy name to my brethren; in the middle of the church i shall praise thee.
target_text: te yesus peka le dènge ama na, ja'a neo peka dènge a'ari ja'a, lula-nèti babe'a ama! ja'a neo sod'a ètu talora aae rèngu, lula-nèti dadedha ama!

source_text: and again, i shall be trusting into him; and again, lo! i and my children, which god gave to me.
target_text: yesus tuhu hari lii padhai na, aku nèngu na, ja'a sarai-maena mi ama lamatua toke d'ai mia-mia. hèia yesus peka hari, na, ladhe ku! ja'a ka ne'e, sama-sama dènge ana-ana ama lamatua, dhu na pangèd'u le mi ja'a, ho uri si.

source_text: therefore for children communed to flesh and blood, and he also took part of the same, that by death he should destroy him that had lordship of death, that is to say, the devil,
target_text: lula ana-ana lamatua se, dhèu rai-haha biasa, nèti èèna ka yesus hud'i j'aj'i ku dhèu rai-haha sama sèmi rèngu kahèi. te nèngu hud'i j'aj'i uuru ku dhèu rai-haha, heka na bisa madhe. ho nèti mamadhe na, heka nèngu bisa parame nare koasa nèti dhèu aae nidhu. te dhèu aae bhabhelu-katub'a ne'e ka dhu nèd'u koasa, ho uri j'ara-j'ara dhu pa'èki dènge mamadhe.

source_text: and that he should deliver them that by dread of death, by all life were bound to servage.
target_text: aa nèngu kahèi tao dhèu rai-haha madha'u dènge mamadhe, toke ra madhutu dad'èi na, nuka sèmi ènu sa. te ngaa limuri ne, yesus bisa patalale le dhèu rai-haha nèti d'ara madha'u.

source_text: and he took never angels, but he took the seed of abraham.
target_text: te dhu lèke, nuka yesus mai boe ho soru-bara ana-ana pajuu ètu sorga. te ngaa na mai sèna ka soru nare èdhi, nuka ana-èpu abraham.

source_text: wherefore he ought to be likened to brethren by all things, that he should be made merciful and a faithful bishop to god, that he should be merciful to the trespasses of the people.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, yesus j'aj'i sama sèmi èdhi, dhu j'aj'i le a'ari na. dènge j'ara ne'e nèngu j'aj'i mi kètu agama èdhi dhu kapai risi eele, ho soru-bara èdhi sèna ka madhutu dad'èi ama lamatua. yesus pad'elo d'ara hua iia na kahèi mi èdhi. aa ladhe na peka ngaa, na tao madhutu sèmi èèna kahèi. uru èèna, bèi-baki èdhi manèngi kètu kapai risi agama yahudi, sèna ka tao korban, ho lamatua saku eele sasala-sasigo rèngu. limuri ne, yesus mesa na ka dhu j'aj'i korban, sèna ka lamatua saku eele sasala èdhi.

source_text: for in that thing in which he suffered, and was tempted, he is mighty to help also them that be tempted.
target_text: lod'o yesus mamuri ètu rai-haha ne, na abhu j'aj'èra ae-ae. abhu kahèi dhu dadugu ne, sèna ka ad'u-ue sasala. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa nèngu manahu boe. nèti èèna ka, ladhe abhu dhu dadugu-rariu èdhi, sèna ka tao sasala, yesus ka dhu bisa soru-bara èdhi ho baku manahu.

source_text: therefore, holy brethren, and partners of heavenly calling, behold ye the apostle and the bishop of our confession, jesus,
target_text: de sèmi ne'e, a'ari! ama lamatua hag'e nare le miu, aa cap miu dhèu d'ara mola, sèna ka èèna na miu mamuri bera-bera dènge ne ètu sorga. nèti èèna ka, miu hud'i pangee ku pabe'a-be'a lula-nèti yesus ne. te èdhi dhu mangaku le, na, nèngu ne dhèu pajuu-paleha ama lamatua, aa nèngu kahèi kètu kapai risi agama èdhi.

source_text: which is true to him that made him, as also moses in all the house of him.
target_text: lod'o ama lamatua pua yesus mai, yesus tao madhutu aa'i dad'èi lamatua. dènge j'ara ne, nèngu nuka sèmi musa. te musa tao madhutu dad'èi lamatua kahèi, lod'o na ladhe-leru bèi-baki èdhi uru sèra.

source_text: but this bishop is had worthy of more glory than moses, by as much as he hath more honour of the house, that made the house.
target_text: masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa yesus kapai risi nèti musa. te yesus sama sèmi lamatua èmu. aa mema lèke, lula lamatua èmu kapai risi nèti ana pua-paleha ètu d'ara èmu.

source_text: for each house is made of some man; he that made all things of nought is god.
target_text: dhèu èci-èci ka pa'uri d'ara èmu na. te ngaa ama lamatua ka dhu uri aa'i mèu-mèu.

source_text: and moses was true in all his house, as a servant, into witnessing of those things that were to be said;
target_text: de musa tao madhutu dad'èi ama lamatua, lod'o na j'aj'i ana pua-paleha nèti isi èmu lamatua. te lod'o èèna, na peka mema le ngaa dhu bèli-camèd'a ama lamatua neo tao.

source_text: but christ as a son in his house. which house we be, if we hold firm trust and glory of hope into the end.
target_text: masi ka yesus madhutu kahèi dad'èi ama lamatua, te ngaa nèngu ana pua-paleha dhu sama boe sèmi musa. lula nèngu ne, kristus, ana ama lamatua dhu ama lamatua hag'e nare le karèi nèti uru ka, sèna ka pua mai asa rai-haha ne. aa kristus ne'a mèu uri isi èmu ama na. de ladhe èdhi kèpe pa'èra-èra lalèka èdhi, aa ma'ète boe sanao-maena èdhi mi kristus, èdhi bisa j'aj'i isi èmu na kahèi.

source_text: wherefore as the holy ghost saith, today, if ye have heard his voice,
target_text: nèti èèna ka, miu hud'i pasa dhilu paie-iie, ho nanene pabe'a ngaa dhu roh ama lamatua dhu mola-mèci peka, na, doe ne'e, ropa miu tadèngi lii ama lamatua,

source_text: do not ye harden your hearts, as in wrathing, like the day of temptation in desert;
target_text: mage miu kètu hadhu, sama sèmi dhèu sèra, dhu lasi-mai èpa nguru tèu ètu pad'a sod'a. te rèngu ro'o heka puai-pahae musa, toke ama lamatua mesa na oe taha nare heka d'ara na.

source_text: where your fathers tempted me, and proved, and saw my works forty years. wherefore i was wroth to this generation, and i said, evermore they err in heart, for they knew not my ways;
target_text: pangee ku laa! èpa nguru tèu kateme ja'a tao rupa-rupa tadha malaa ètu katanga madha ra! te ngaa ra loe boe sèku ja'a. nèti èèna ka, ja'a nasa dènge ra, peka na, ‘miu se, seli-kolane! te miu soro kabodho tèke eele j'ara ja'a, ho madhutu j'ara miu dhu koe-kapengo! '
