target_text: ele boe miu bhèlu lii holo-nori ama lamatua dhu na peka le dènge miu, nuka sèmi ca dhèu ama padhai lii dènge ana na, peka na, ana, ee! ladhe ama èdhi dhu huku ho aj'a èu, sèna ka èu mamuri madhutu j'ara dhu lèke, na, èu baku pamud'e! aa ladhe na kai ho aj'a èu, na, èu baku paroe d'ara.

source_text: for the lord chastiseth him that he loveth; he beateth or scourgeth every son that he receiveth.
target_text: te ama èdhi kai ho aj'a dhèu dhu na sue. mema dhèu-dhèu dhu na sèmi nare j'aj'i ana na, nèngu kai ho aj'a si.

source_text: abide ye still in chastising or discipline; god proffereth or offereth him to you as to sons. for what son is it, whom the father chastiseth not?
target_text: de ladhe ama lamatua kai ho aj'a miu sèna ka mamuri madhutu j'ara dhu lèke, na, taha taruu aa sèmi mere. na tao sèmi èèna, lula miu j'aj'i le ana na. te ama aa'i-aa'i hud'i kai ho aj'a ana na, toke ana na bisa mamuri madhutu j'ara dhu lèke.

source_text: that if ye be out of chastising or discipline, whose partners be ye all made, then ye be adulterers, and not sons.
target_text: te ladhe ama lamatua kai boe ho aj'a miu sama sèmi ana na dhu leo sèra, sasoa na, miu se ana nèngu boe.

source_text: and afterward we had fathers of our flesh, teachers, and we with reverence dreaded them. whether not much more we shall obey to the father of spirits, and we shall live?
target_text: èdhi tema pakab'ua ama matana èdhi ètu rai-haha ne, lula na kai ho aj'a-nori ti, lod'o èdhi dhu ana iiki era. dhu lèke na kèna. te ngaa dhu be'a risi hari, èdhi hud'i nanene ku ama lamatua dènge be'a, lula nèngu ne, ama èdhi ètu sorga, aa na kai ho aj'a-nori èdhi, sèna ka èdhi mamuri madhutu j'ara na dhu lèke.

source_text: and they in time of few days taught us by their will; but this father teacheth to that thing that is profitable, in receiving the hallowing of him.
target_text: ama matana èdhi kai ho aj'a èdhi, dhoka d'ara ciki oo'e di, madhutu ngaa dhu na ngee na be'a. te ngaa ama lamatua dhu ne'a risi, ngaa dhu èdhi parluu te'a. nèti èèna ka, na kai ho aj'a èdhi, sèna ka mamuri mola-mèci sama sèmi nèngu.

source_text: and each chastising in this present time seemeth to be not of joy, but of sorrow; but afterward it shall yield fruit of rightwiseness most peaceable to men exercised by it.
target_text: mema èdhi d'èi boe ladhe abhu lii kai. te ngaa nèbhu-nèbhu, d'ara èdhi j'aj'i mau, lula te'a tare le mamuri madhutu dad'èi ama lamatua.

source_text: for which thing raise ye up slow hands, and knees unbound, and make ye rightful steps to your feet; that no man halting err, but more be healed.
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! pa'èra kacui-aai miu dhu roe, aa pasamaa haga miu dhu bia. baku rai piku g'ana-kariu, te ngaa rai mola taruu, sèna ka pa'èra d'ara rèngu dhu roe-bhilu ho bisa rai taruu. miu hud'i pa'èra d'ara miu, sèna ka taha taruu ètu d'ara parcaya mi kristus.

source_text: pursue ye peace with all men, and holiness, without which no man shall see god.
target_text: a'ari dhu parcaya kristus! miu hud'i pa'èra ngi'u mi, sèna ka mamuri padame èci dènge èci. aa baku loe tenge j'ara ho mamuri mola-mèci. te dhèu dhu mola-mèci boe, bisa boe rèdhi ama lamatua.

source_text: behold ye, that no man fail to the grace of god, that no root of bitterness burrowing upward hinder us, and many be defouled by it;
target_text: pa'èra d'ara èci dènge èci, sèna ka mage dhoka abhu nèti miu dhu rai, toke rasa heka d'ara hua iia ama lamatua. aa j'aga paie ho baku soro tèke ladhe abhu dhu papèd'a d'ara ètu talora aae miu. te èèna nuka sèmi raco dhu pa'ele iie dhèu ae.

source_text: that no man be lecher, either unholy, as esau, which for one meal's meat sold his first things, or heritage.
target_text: mage-mage aa j'aga ho baku abhu dhèu nèti miu dhu tao j'ara makae dènge dhèu dhu j'aj'i boe dhèu èmu-kamali nèngu. aa mage-mage aa j'aga ho baku abhu dhèu nèti miu dhu pusi-pahae boe ama lamatua, nuka sèmi esau. esau ne, ana uuru isak. ca lod'o, esau lèpa dènge kabake manganga. na manèngi nganga'a ca pega nèti ari na yakob, ho b'ae pake hak ana uuru.

source_text: for know ye, that afterward he coveting to inherit blessing, was reproved. for he found not place of penance, though he sought it with tears.
target_text: te ngaa èdhi te'a, nèbhu boe ka, esau manyasa. te ropa isak neo manèngi lamatua hia mèngi-nale mi ana uuru na esau, te ngaa bisa heka, lula esau dhu hia iia d'ara le hak ana uuru na. nèti èèna ka, masi ka na tangi roma iisi, tasamia èèna ka, nèngu bisa heka abhu ngaa dhu uru èèna nèngu core eele.

source_text: but ye have not come to the fire able to be touched, and able to come to, and to the whirlwind or the great wind, and mist, and tempest,
target_text: sèmi ne'e a'ari! èdhi bisa lati le asa madha ama lamatua, madhutu j'ara hiu dhu na bhoke nare le hia èdhi. te ngaa uru-uru sèra, bèi-baki èdhi bisa mèka sèmi èèna. te lod'o ama lamatua pa'èki lii pajaji dènge rèngu, rèngu padètu dènge ledhe sinai. ètu dedha ledhe ne, abhu ai dhu heo. abhu ngèlu aae kahèi. aa maroga saguru nare ledhe ne, ka dhèu se madha'u titu kèna.

source_text: and sound of trump, and voice of words; which they that heard, excused them, that the word should not be made to them.
target_text: rèngu tadèngi lii tiu tèbhe kahèi, hèia lii dhu mèdhu aae nèti lamatua kalua nèti ledhe ne. ropa tadèngi lii lamatua, hèia asa ra madha'u, toke ra manèngi musa, peka na, ira ii! ji'i bisa heka taha dènge lii nèi!

source_text: for they bare not that that was said, and if a beast touched the hill, it was stoned or it shall be stoned.
target_text: rèngu mema bisa boe taha, lula ngaa dhu lamatua paredha èèna, bia titu kèna. te na peka, na, ca dhèu sa bisa boe j'èli ledhe ne! masi ka dhèu, do badha! te dhèu cee dhu j'èli ledhe ne, hud'i lèke pèci toke madhe.

source_text: and so dreadful it was that was seen, that moses said, i am afeared, and full of trembling.
target_text: ngaa dhu rèngu ladhe rèdhi ètu ledhe ne, mema pamadha'u tare'a, toke musa karèbha kahèi.

source_text: but ye have come nigh to the hill of zion, and to the city of god living or of living god, the heavenly jerusalem, and to the multitude of many thousand angels,
target_text: te ngaa limuri ne, j'ara asa lamatua bhoke tèke le, aa èdhi bisa patoo madha padhai lii dènge ne. limuri ne, èdhi lati asa ledhe cue, ngara na sion. ètu era ne'e, abhu kota yerusalem. kota yerusalem ne, ètu boe rai-haha ne, te ngaa kota yerusalem hiu ètu sorga, era pea ama lamatua. ètu nèi, abhu ana pajuu ama lamatua ae-ae, toke riho-riho, dhu loe boe tao pesta.

source_text: and to the church of the first men, which be written in heavens, and to god, doomsman of all, and to the spirit of just perfect men,
target_text: ètu kota nèi kahèi, j'aj'i le era pakaboko dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu parcaya kristus. te ama lamatua dhu tao nare le daftar, ho suri ngara ra èci-èci ètu sorga. ètu era nèi kahèi, ama lamatua neo parisa aa tai-dadoo mamuri dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra. aa ètu nèi kahèi, pakaboko dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu uru èèna ama lamatua sèmi nare si dènge be'a, lula ra parcaya ne. ètu nèi, rèngu j'aj'i kateme ètu madha lamatua.

source_text: and to jesus, mediator of the new testament, and to the sprinkling of blood, speaking better than abel or better speaking than abel's blood.
target_text: aa yesus kahèi ètu era nèi, dhu j'aj'i mi kalete hia ama lamatua dènge dhèu rai-haha. yesus madhe, pasuti raa na, sèna ka ama lamatua bisa pa'èki lii pajaji hiu dènge èdhi. nèti èèna ka, raa yesus ne, cuhi d'ara ama lamatua. te ngaa raa yesus leko-leo nèti raa habel ètu d'ara sasuri lii lolo dhu uru tèka. te lod'o kain pamadhe habel, raa habel dhu suti èèna, papana d'ara ama lamatua, toke na huku kain.

source_text: see ye, that ye forsake or refuse not the speaker; for if they that forsaked or refusing him that spake on the earth, escaped not, much more we that turn away from him that speaketh to us from heavens.
target_text: pasa dhilu pabe'a-be'a, ho nanene ngaa dhu ama lamatua neo peka dènge miu. baku tao sèmi bèi-baki èdhi dhu ro'o boe nanene lii padhai musa, lod'o na j'aj'i dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua ètu rai-haha ne. nèti èèna ka lamatua huku si. ngaa hari dènge èdhi se! ladhe èdhi to'o boe nanene lii na nèti sorga, tatu nèngu huku èdhi bia risi eele!

source_text: whose voice then moved the earth, but now he again promiseth, and saith, yet once and i shall move not only the earth, but also heaven.
target_text: lod'o bèi-baki èdhi titu ètu ledhe sinai, lii lamatua dhu mèdhu èèna, tao rai opo. limuri ne na moa, na, bèli-camèd'a ja'a tao ne opo ca tèka hari. mesa boe rai di opo, te ngaa liru opo kahèi.

source_text: and that he saith, yet once, he declareth the translation of moveable things, as of made things, that those things dwell, that be unmoveable.
target_text: lod'o lamatua peka, na, nèngu neo tao opo aa'i-aa'i ca tèka hari, sasoa na, lamatua neo pagaged'o aa'i-aa'i dhu na paj'aj'i ètu dedha-liru dènge ètu rai-haha ne, toke abhu dhu bisa boe taha. ele aa'i si. te dhu taha di, nuka dhu pea taruu.

source_text: therefore we receiving the kingdom unmoveable, have we grace, by which serve we pleasing to god with dread and reverence.
target_text: ama lamatua nèd'u paredha ètu sorga. èèna bisa boe laho. ngaa-ngaa tao boe! lula na neo sèmi nare, na, miu maso j'aj'i mi dhèu unu na ètu nèi. de mai ho èdhi manèngi makasi mi nèngu, pahaha iisi mi nèngu, aa ded'e padedha-dedha ne, lula dadedha na.

source_text: for our god is fire that wasteth.
target_text: te ngaa èdhi baku pamud'e kahèi, lula nanasa ama lamatua nuka sèmi ai dhu na'e pakèpu aa'i mèu-mèu.

source_text: the charity of brotherhood dwell in you,
target_text: de a'ari aa'i-aa'i! abhu pèri-pèri j'ara dhu ja'a neo pasanèd'e miu. baku bhèlu pasue taruu a'ari dhèu parcaya.

source_text: and do not ye forget hospitality; for by this some men pleased to angels, that were received to harbour.
target_text: baku bhèlu bhoke d'ara sèna ka sèmi mere dhèu dhu miu tadhe boe asa d'ara èmu mi. te abhu pèri-pèri a'ari dhu sèmi rare dhèu, te ngaa re'a boe, na, dhèu sèra, ana pajuu ama lamatua nèti sorga.

source_text: think ye on bound men, as ye were together bound, and of travailing men, as yourselves dwelling in the body.
target_text: baku bhèlu tao ai-hèb'a mi dhèu ètu d'ara bui, te ra kèpa si lula ra parcaya kristus. nèti èèna ka, miu hud'i soru-bara si, nuka sèmi miu ka dhu ra kèpe rare. aa mage bhèlu soru-bara dhèu dhu lèke j'aj'èra nèti dhèu. lalau si pabe'a-be'a, nuka sèmi miu mesa mi ka dhu abhu j'aj'èra èèna.

source_text: wedding is in all things honourable, and bed unwemmed or undefouled; for god shall deem fornicators and adulterers.
target_text: paleo èmu èèna, mola-mèci. te ngaa mage paleo èmu dhu mola-mèci ne, j'aj'i mi kaj'alu. te tatu ama lamatua huku dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu tao j'ara makae dènge dhèu èmu nèngu boe.

source_text: be your manners without covetousness, satisfied with present things; for he said, i shall not leave thee, neither forsake,
target_text: baku manga'a doi-dhari. te ngaa miu hud'i mamuri nèti ngaa dhu miu abhu, te èèna d'ai le. ama lamatua dhu peka le, na, ja'a bhèlu boe miu. ja'a soro tèke boe miu.

source_text: so that we say trustily, the lord is an helper to me; i shall not dread what a man shall do to me.
target_text: de pa'èra d'ara miu, nuka sèmi dhu ra suri, na, lula lamatua ja'a neo soru-bara ja'a, nèti èèna ka, ja'a madha'u boe. te abhu boe ca dhèu sa hèi, dhu bisa cèri eele ja'a nèti ama lamatua.

source_text: have ye mind of your sovereigns, that have spoken to you the word of god; of whom behold ye the going out of living, and pursue ye the faith of them,
target_text: baku bhèlu dhèu-dhèu dhu uru sèra aj'a-nori miu lii holo-nori ama lamatua. pajiko paie-iie j'ara mamuri ra, aa madhutu lalèka ra. te, dhu rèngu parcaya, nuka:

source_text: jesus christ, yesterday, and today, he is also into worlds.
target_text: yesus kristus ub'a nèdhi boe. nèti uru, doe ne'e, toke d'ai mia-mia la'e, nèngu hali boe.

source_text: do not ye be led away with diverse and strange teachings. for it is best to stable the heart with grace, not with meats, which profited not to men wandering or going in them.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, miu baku madhutu rii nèti a'aj'a dhu sala. ama lamatua tao pa'èra le d'ara miu, lula na pad'elo le d'ara hua iia na dènge miu. lula boe nèti miu madhutu atora nganga'a-nganginu dhu guna boe.

source_text: we have an altar, of which they that serve to the tabernacle, have not power or leave to eat.
target_text: uru-uru sèra, ètu madha paleo manèngi-mangaj'i ama lamatua, abhu mei èci dhu era tèka badha korban. ama agama ka dhu lalau ètu sèra, dhu dènge hak ra'a sisi dhu sisa nèti dedha mei ne. te ngaa limuri ne, èdhi dhu dènge le mei leo. aa ama agama rupa dhui dènge boe hak ra'a ètu mei èèna.

source_text: for of which beasts the blood is borne in for sin into holy things by the bishop, the bodies of them be burnt without the castles.
target_text: uru èèna, tèu mai-tèu mai kètu kapai risi agama nèti raa badha korban, sèna ka tèke asa d'ara kama luri mola-mèci ama lamatua. dènge j'ara ne'e, lamatua pabhèlu eele sasala ra. èle na, pasae rèti badha ne lasi tunu asa li'u rae.

source_text: for which thing jesus, that he should hallow the people by his blood, suffered without the gate.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi dènge yesus. nèngu j'aj'i korban kahèi, sèna ka ama lamatua bisa saku eele sasala dhèu rai-haha. aa lod'o j'aj'èra na èèna, ra nuni rèti ne kahèi, ho pamadhe ne asa li'u kota yerusalem.

source_text: therefore go we out to him without the castles, bearing his reproof.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, mai ka èdhi lati asa yesus, ho parcaya ne taruu. masi ka dhèu pahahe èdhi, èdhi hud'i pa'èra sèmi tare ne, nuka sèmi yesus.

source_text: for we have not here a city dwelling, but we seek a city to coming or to come.
target_text: te èdhi dhoka manubha taha ètu rai-haha ne. te ngaa èdhi sanao-maena, sèna ka pea ètu kota hiu cue ètu sorga toke d'ai mia-mia la'e.

source_text: therefore by him offer we a sacrifice of praising evermore to god, that is to say, the fruit of lips acknowledging to his name.
target_text: lula yesus j'aj'i le korban pala èdhi, nèti èèna ka èdhi parluu heka tèti badha korban asa ama lamatua. te ngaa abhu mèdha korban dhu leo era, dhu èdhi hud'i tèti ku hia ne, nuka, koa-kio dhu ded'e padedha-dedha kolongara na.

source_text: and do not ye forget well-doing, and communing; for by such sacrifices god is well-served.
target_text: aa mage bhèlu tao j'ara be'a hia dhèu leo. ladhe ra parluu ngaa, lami soru-bara si. te sèra sa, j'aj'i nuka sèmi mèdha persembahan dhu pakarej'e d'ara ama lamatua.

source_text: obey ye to your sovereigns, and be ye subject to them; for they perfectly wake, as to yielding reason for your souls, that they do this thing with joy, and not sorrowing; for this thing speedeth not to you.
target_text: miu hud'i nanene ku dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu uri miu. te dhèu se'e ka dhu j'aga miu mèda-mèu ètu d'ara mamuri miu dènge ama lamatua. bèli-camèd'a rèngu hud'i lapor ku sasab'a rèngu asa ama lamatua. de nanene paie si, sèna ka ra bisa sab'a aa lapor dènge d'ara karej'e. mage dhoka ra peka dènge d'ara dhu laho mae-mae, lula miu tèke eele j'ara mamuri yesus kristus. te ladhe sèmi èèna, na, miu oto boe.

source_text: pray ye for us, and we trust that we have good conscience in all things, willing to live well.
target_text: sabaj'a taruu hia ji'i. te d'ara ji'i mema mola, aa ji'i neo tao j'ara be'a taruu.

source_text: moreover i beseech you to do this thing, that i be restored the sooner to you.
target_text: aa be'a risi hari, sabaj'a sèna ka ja'a bisa lèpa malai asa miu.

source_text: and god of peace, that led out from death the great shepherd of sheep, in the blood of the ever-lasting testament, our lord jesus christ, shape you in all good thing or make you able in each good work, that ye do the will of him; and he do in you that thing that shall please before him, by jesus christ, to whom be glory into worlds of worlds. amen.
target_text: ama lamatua ka dhu pamau d'ara èdhi. ja'a manèngi sèna ka na soru-bara miu, ho miu bisa madhutu aa'i dad'èi na. ja'a manèngi kahèi, ho na soru-bara èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti, sèna ka te'a pakarej'e d'ara na. te ama lamatua pake le raa yesus kristus dhu suti èèna, sèna ka pa'èki lii pajaji hiu dènge èdhi. lii pajaji ne j'aj'i taruu toke d'ai mia-mia. ka ama lamatua pamamuri hari kètu èdhi, yesus kristus. de yesus ka dhu ladhe-leru èdhi limuri ne, nuka sèmi dhèu madhenga badha dhu be'a risi. nèti èèna ka, èdhi ded'e kolongara na padedha-dedha, aa koa-kio ne taa-taa! èèna ka dhu lèke.

source_text: and, brethren, i pray you, that ye suffer a word of solace; for by full few things i have written to you.
target_text: a'ari pasue! ja'a manèngi sèna ka miu sèmi mere lii holo ja'a ne dènge d'ara kateme. te sasuri ne bab'a iiki di.

source_text: know ye our brother timothy, that is sent forth, with whom if he shall come more hastily, i shall see you.
target_text: abhu lii lolo dhu ja'a neo miu aa'i-aa'i mi me'a, nuka: a'ari èdhi timotius dhu kalua le nèti d'ara bui. ladhe na mai malai paraga dènge ja'a, èèna na ji'i dua mi palere-lere dhiu asa miu.

source_text: greet ye well all your sovereigns, and all holy men or all saints. the brethren of italy greet you well.
target_text: ja'a pa'adhu lii maho'o hia kètu miu sèra, aa lii maho'o hia miu aa'i-aa'i dhu parcaya yesus kristus. a'ari nèti propensi italia hia miu lii maho'o kahèi.

source_text: the grace of god be with you all. amen.
target_text: ja'a manèngi sèna ka ama lamatua pad'elo d'ara hua iia na dènge miu aa'i-aa'i mi. d'ai sange ne'e ka!

source_text: james, the servant of god, and of our lord jesus christ, to the twelve kindreds, that be in scattering abroad, health.
target_text: lii maho'o nèti ja'a, yakobis. ja'a ne'e ana pua-paleha nèti ama lamatua dènge kètu èdhi, yesus kristus. ja'a tao sasuri ne'e hia miu dhèu yahudi dhu pea ètu kabarai dhèu, dhu d'èi madhutu lamatua yesus.

source_text: my brethren, deem ye all joy, when ye fall into diverse temptations,
target_text: a'ari! ja'a neo peka sèmi ne'e: ladhe miu abhu rupa-rupa j'aj'èra, na, baku paroe d'ara. sèmi mere dènge d'ara karej'e, te bèli-camèd'a abhu babe'a.

source_text: witting that the proving of your faith worketh patience;
target_text: te èdhi te'a, na, ladhe miu pa'èra-èra ètu d'ara j'aj'èra sèmi èèna, aa pakaj'èu le nèti dadugu, aa miu parcaya lamatua era, èèna ka dhu asa tabha pa'èra d'ara miu, ladhe mi paraga hari dènge dadugu dhu leo.

source_text: and patience hath a perfect work, that ye be perfect and whole, and fail in nothing.
target_text: baku hari kabodho nèti j'aj'èra. te ngaa miu hud'i taha ètu d'ara j'aj'èra, toke miu abhu mamèci, aa kura boe ngaa-ngaa èci sa.

source_text: and if any of you needeth wisdom, ask he of god, which giveth to all men largely, and upbraideth not; and it shall be given to him.
target_text: ladhe abhu nèti miu dhu re'a mèka j'ara kalua nèti j'aj'èra, miu bisa pakarèi mi lamatua dhu ne'a aa'i ngaa-ngaa. nèngu ka dhu bisa pad'elo j'ara kalua hia miu. nèngu ka dhu bhoke j'ara dènge d'ara karej'e, aa dhu ne'a boe nasa, ladhe miu manèngi.

source_text: but ask he in faith, and doubt nothing; for he that doubteth, is like to a wave of the sea, which is moved and borne about of the wind.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe manèngi mi nèngu, na, baku dènge d'ara kacanga. miu hud'i parcaya tare'a ku, na, nèngu bisa hia ngaa dhu miu manèngi. te ladhe dhèu manèngi dènge d'ara kacanga, èèna na nuka sèmi laka dhasi dhu pahaka la'e-mai ladhe lèke ngèlu.

source_text: therefore guess not that man, that he shall take anything of the lord. a man double in soul is unstable in all his ways.
target_text: dhèu dhu parcaya kalili boe sèmi èèna, èra boe ètu d'ara j'ara aa'i-aa'i ra. baku maena, na, nèngu abhu ngaa-ngaa nèti lamatua.

source_text: and a meek brother have glory in his enhancing,
target_text: dhèu unu aad'o dhu parcaya lamatua yesus, nèngu hud'i pakarej'e d'ara na, lula ama lamatua ded'e le nèngu j'aj'i dhèu unu na.

source_text: and a rich man in his lowness; for as the flower of grass he shall pass. the sun rose up with heat, and dried the grass or the hay, and the flower of it felled down, and the fairness of his cheer perished; and so a rich man withereth in his ways.
target_text: aa dhèu kaja dhu parcaya le lamatua yesus, nèngu hud'i karèj'e kahèi, lula lamatua aj'a ne sèna ka baku padedha iisi. limuri ne nèngu ne'a, na, bèli-camèd'a mèdha-panyau na ele aa'i mèu-mèu, nuka sèmi hela bunga dhu saraga, te ngaa ladhe lèke lod'o pana, na kamale eele. sèmi èèna kahèi dènge dhèu kaja sèra. masi ka rèngu bhute dènge urusan ra, te ngaa rèngu ele kahèi.

source_text: blessed is the man, that suffereth temptation; for when he shall be proved, he shall receive the crown of life, which god promised to men that love him.
target_text: lamatua hia berkat mi dhèu dhu taha ètu d'ara dadugu-rariu. hèia na sèmi nare bab'ae rui-j'aj'èra na, nuka mamuri dhu lamatua padhadha le ho pala-bagi mi dhèu dhu sue ne. èèna nuka sèmi dhèu dhu segi ètu pa'uji olaraga dhu abhu solo juara.

source_text: no man when he is tempted, say, that he is tempted of god; for why god is not a tempter of evil things, for he tempteth no man.
target_text: sanèd'e paie-iie! ladhe nèti miu abhu dhu paraga dènge dadugu-rariu, aa neo ad'u-ue madha j'ara dhu sala, baku peka, na, ama lamatua ka dhu sèku ja'a. te ama lamatua neo boe tao sala. aa na sèku nèdhi boe dhèu, sèna ka tao sala.

source_text: but each man is tempted, drawn and stirred, of his own coveting. soothly each man is tempted of his own coveting, drawn from reason, and snared, or deceived.
target_text: te sasala mai nèti d'ara dhèu. ropa d'ara na neo ad'u-ue j'ara karehe, hèia na kapod'e kahadhu na, sèna ka tao j'ara kaj'alu.

source_text: afterward or then coveting, when it hath conceived, bringeth forth sin; but sin, when it is ful filled, engendereth death.
target_text: hèia na tao madhutu ngangee na dhu kaj'alu èèna. d'ai lod'o limuri, ama lamatua huku pamadhe dhèu dhu tao bhabhelu.

source_text: therefore, my most dearworthy brethren, do not ye err.
target_text: a'ari pasue! baku lèke tipu nèti j'ara se'e aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: each good gift, and each perfect gift is from above, and cometh down from the father of lights, with whom is none other changing, nor over-shadowing of reward.
target_text: j'ara karehe sèra mai boe nèti lamatua. te ngaa nèngu ka dhu pala-bagi mèngi-nale aa'i-aa'i, dènge ngaa aa'i-aa'i dhu mola-mèci. nèngu ka dhu paj'aj'i madha lod'o, hèru dènge hua-hètu. aa'i-aa'i ra pea boe kalili mi ca'era ètu dedha-liru, aa tao mamaho ra dhu ub'a-ub'a. dhoka ama lamatua di dhu ub'a boe.

source_text: for willfully he begat us by the word of truth, that we be a beginning of his creature.
target_text: dad'èi lamatua hia mi èdhi sèmi ne'e: na hia mi èdhi lii holo-nori na dhu lèke. aa na pake lii holo-nori na ho hia èdhi mamuri. nèti ngaa aa'i-aa'i dhu na paj'aj'i ètu rai-haha ne, na hag'e nare le èdhi j'aj'i mi hua-hela dhu uru tèka.

source_text: know ye, my brethren most loved, be each man swift to hear, but slow to speak, and slow to wrath;
target_text: a'ari pasue! sanèd'e, ee! dhu be'a èèna sèmi ne'e ka: dhèu baku padhai lii leli di. be'a risi, ropa dhèu leo peka dhu be'a, nèngu pasa dhilu ho nanene uuru ku! aa dhèu baku nasa malai.

source_text: for the wrath of man worketh not the rightwiseness of god.
target_text: te ladhe dènge nasa, dhèu bisa boe tao ngaa-ngaa dhu be'a madhutu dad'èi ama lamatua.

source_text: for which thing cast ye away all uncleanness, and plenty of malice, and in mildness, receive ye the word that is planted, that may save your souls.
target_text: de miu hud'i tunu eele ku sasala mi aa'i-aa'i, sèmi dhèu dhu ko'o pamèu oka-tedhe, ka ra tunu maruru sèra. aa miu hud'i sèmi dènge pahaha iisi mi lii holo-nori lamatua. lii holo-nori sèra, nuka sèmi hini dhu sèle ètu d'ara miu. ladhe miu tao sèmi èèna, bèli-camèd'a lamatua saku eele sasala mi, aa na sèmi nare miu, sèna ka mamuri taa-taa dènge ne.

source_text: but be ye doers of the word, and not hearers only, deceiving yourselves.
target_text: ladhe miu me'a le lii holo-nori lamatua, miu hud'i tao madhutu. baku dhoka nanene di! ladhe miu d'èi dhoka nanene di, te ngaa tao madhutu boe, miu kapod'e-kabèli ngi'u miu unu mi.

source_text: for if any man is an hearer of the word, and not a doer, this shall be likened to a man that beholdeth the cheer of his birth in a mirror; for he beheld himself, and went away, and anon he forgot which or what he was.
target_text: ladhe dhèu tadèngi le lii holo-nori èèna, te ngaa madhutu boe, èci èèna ka dènge dhèu dhu lee rèhu na ètu d'ara tèru. ropa na hari kabodho nèti tèru, nèngu bhèlu eele dènge ka, rèhu na.

source_text: but he that beholdeth into the law of perfect freedom, and dwelleth in it, and is not made a forgetful hearer, but a doer of work, this shall be blessed in his deed.
target_text: te ngaa miu baku loe parisa paie-iie lii holo-nori ama lamatua dhu tesa, dhu bisa pakaj'èu dhèu nèti koasa sasala ra. pe lamatua hia mèngi-nale mi ngaa-ngaa dhu miu tao, sad'i miu nanene, aa tao madhutu lii-lii sèra. baku maso dhoka re dhilu kariu, aa kalua re dhilu g'ana!

source_text: and if any man guesseth himself to be religious, and refraineth not his tongue, but deceiveth his heart, the religion of him is vain.
target_text: ladhe dhèu ngee, nèngu maj'èni ètu d'ara agama, te ngaa ne'a boe j'aga hèb'a na, nèngu monya ngi'u nèngu unu na. agama nèngu parcuma.

source_text: a clean religion, and unwemmed with god and the father, is this, to visit fatherless and motherless children, and widows in their tribulation, and to keep himself undefouled from this world.
target_text: te ngaa agama dhu lèke, nuka dhu dènge boe kaj'alu. èèna ka dhu pakarej'e d'ara ama lamatua. agama dhu lèke èèna, tao d'ara dhèu d'èi soru-bara bhèni balu dènge ana lalu. dhèu dhu dènge agama sèmi sèra, hia boe dhèu ètu rai-haha ne dadugu rèngu asa j'ara karehe.

source_text: my brethren, do not ye have the faith of our lord jesus christ of glory, in acception of persons. my brethren, do not in acception, or taking, of persons, have the faith of our lord jesus christ of glory.
target_text: a'ari! tasamia ka miu peka, na, miu parcaya yesus kristus, kètu èdhi dhu kapai èèna, ladhe miu patema hag'e rèhu dhèu? baku sèmi èèna!

source_text: for if a man that hath a golden ring, and in a fair clothing, cometh in your company, and a poor man entereth in a foul clothing,
target_text: sèmi abhu dhèu dua dhu lasi asa d'ara èmu sabaj'a miu. ca dhèu pake mèdha-papake dhu kale'e dènge kadheli hualaa pènu kacui-aai na. ca dhèu hari pake kodho kaj'alu.

source_text: and if ye behold into him that is clothed with clear clothing, and if ye say to him, sit thou here well; but to the poor man ye say, stand thou there, either sit under the stool of my feet;
target_text: hèia miu bhute lami soru dhèu dhu pake mèdha-papake kale'e èèna, ho hia ne madhèdi ètu era be'a re madha. te ngaa dhu pake mèdha-papake kaj'alu èèna, miu pua ne, peka na, lamu titu sa kabodho nèi, ee! do aad'o na, madhèdi ètu rai ne!

source_text: whether ye deem not with your-selves, and be made doomsmen of wicked thoughts?
target_text: dènge j'ara miu laladhe rèhu dhèu sèmi èèna, miu nuka sèmi dhèu pama'ète lii dhu bia cabèka. èèna mai nèti ngangee karehe dhu uli miu.

source_text: hear ye, my most dearworthy brethren, whether god chose not poor men in this world, rich in faith, and heirs of the kingdom, that god promised to men that love him?
target_text: a'ari pasue! ama lamatua hag'e nare le dhèu unu aad'o ètu rai-haha ne'e, sèna ka ra parcaya pa'èra mi nèngu. masi ka rèngu dhu dènge boe unu, te ngaa d'ara ra kaja. aa na hag'e si, ho ra abhu unu kahèi ètu d'ara paredha ama lamatua, dhu na pajaji hia mi dhèu-dhèu dhu sue ne.

source_text: but ye have despised the poor man. whether rich men oppress not you by power, and they draw you to dooms?
target_text: te ngaa dènge miu ladhe rèhu dhèu sèmi èèna, miu pahaha le dhèu unu aad'o sèra. te ngaa rèngu tao boe ngaa-ngaa dhu karehe mi dedha miu. bhèlu le, do? dhèu kaja sèra ka dhu jajuku mi la'e-mai. aa rèngu sèra ka dhu tenge j'ara ho nuni pa'oro miu asa era pama'ète lii langu. rèngu abhu dhu kee, aa miu abhu sota na.

source_text: whether they blaspheme not the good name, that is called to help on you? or that is in-called of you?
target_text: miu se, dhèu unu lamatua yesus. te ngaa dhèu kaja sèra ka dhu padhai pa'ele iie kolongara lamatua yesus! nga tao ka miu lami pahaha iisi mi rèngu?

source_text: nevertheless if ye perform the king's law, by scriptures, thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself, ye do well.
target_text: heka lèke kèna, ladhe miu tao madhutu atora èci dhu dedha risi, dhu peka na, èu hud'i sue ku dhèu leo, nuka sèmi èu sue ngi'u èu unu mu. atora ne dhu suri le ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua.

source_text: but if ye take persons, ye work sin, and be reproved of the law, as trespassers or as transgressors.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe miu pili madhutu rèhu dhèu, aa mere d'ara dhèu kaja di, miu sisu le atora èèna. madhutu atora lamatua, miu sala le.

source_text: and whoever keepeth all the law, but offendeth in one, he is made guilty of all.
target_text: dhèu dhu tao madhutu aa'i atora ama lamatua, te ngaa sisu atora èci di, èci èèna ka dènge nèngu sisu aa'i atora lamatua.

source_text: for he that said, thou shalt do no lechery or thou shalt not do lechery, said also, thou shalt not slay; that if thou doest no lechery, but thou slayest, thou art made a trespasser of the law.
target_text: lamatua hia le atora dhu peka, na, miu bhèni-mone baku tao j'ara karehe dènge dhèu dhu j'aj'i boe dhèu èmu-kamali miu. aa na hia atora dhu leo kahèi, peka na, baku pamadhe dhèu. de ladhe miu tao boe j'ara karehe, te ngaa miu pamadhe dhèu, èci èèna ka, miu sisu le atora lamatua.

source_text: thus speak ye, and thus do ye, as beginning to be deemed by the law of freedom.
target_text: de ladhe miu neo padhai lii, ho neo tao madha j'ara èci, miu hud'i sanèd'e sèmi ne'e ku: pe ama lamatua ka dhu pama'ète, na, èdhi madhutu atora na ho sue dhèu leo, do aad'o. lula atora èèna ka dhu bisa patabuli èdhi nèti hahuku lamatua.

source_text: for why doom without mercy is to him, that doeth no mercy; but mercy above raiseth doom.
target_text: te lamatua pusi-pahae boe dhèu dhu sue boe dhèu leo. te ngaa ladhe miu sue dhèu leo, tatu lamatua pahae miu kahèi. miu baku madha'u ladhe abhu hahuku nèti lamatua, lula na ige nare le sèra aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: my brethren, what shall it profit, if any man say that he hath faith, but he hath not works? whether faith shall be able to save him?
target_text: a'ari! ladhe dhèu peka, na, nèngu parcaya lamatua, te ngaa tao boe ngaa-ngaa èci sa ho pad'elo parcaya na, èèna dènge boe guna ngaa-ngaa. parcaya sèmi èèna, bisa boe hia nèngu mamuri.

source_text: and if a brother or sister be naked, and have need of each day's livelode or lifelode,
target_text: ladhe abhu dhèu sarani ca dhèu dhu dènge boe mèdha-papake do nganga'a dhu na'a bèli-bèli,

source_text: and if any of you say to them, go ye in peace, be ye made hot, and be ye full-filled; but if ye give not to them those things that be necessary to the body, what shall it profit?
target_text: te ngaa miu dhoka dènge lii padhai lii di, peka na, kako paie-iie, oo! hud'i laa lamatua hia èu berkat! mage lèke lai ngèlu toke pèd'a! baku madhe manganga! guna ngaa padhai lii sèmi èèna, ladhe tao boe ngaa èci sa ho soru-bara si?

source_text: so also faith, if it hath not works, is dead in itself.
target_text: de d'ai mèka ladhe peka, èu parcaya di! dènge parcaya di, aa dhu palèke boe dènge tatao, èèna peka mèka, na, ‘parcaya'. te tatao sèmi èèna, nuka sèmi parcaya dhu madhe le, dhu gaguna na aad'o ciki sa.

source_text: but some man shall say, thou hast faith, and i have works; show thou to me thy faith without works, and i shall show to thee my faith of works.
target_text: abhu dhèu dhu tao lii langu, peka na, sad'i dhèu parcaya dhoka lamatua di, parluu heka tao j'ara dhu be'a. dhèu leo dhu tadhe boe lamatua, re'a tao j'ara dhu be'a kahèi. te ngaa j'ara nèngu sèmi ne'e: tadha nèti parcaya èu èèna, nuka tatao èu dhu be'a. te ngaa ladhe èu tao boe dhu be'a, ja'a kèdhi boe tadha nèti parcaya èu ne. ja'a bisa pad'elo parcaya ja'a, dènge j'ara ad'u-ue dhu be'a.

source_text: thou believest, that one god is; thou doest well; and devils believe, and together tremble.
target_text: èu madhutu a'aj'a dhu peka, na, ama lamatua èèna, dhoka nèngu di. dhu leo aad'o. be'a kahèi! te ngaa nidhu sèra be'a risi nèti èu, lula rèngu parcaya sèmi èèna kahèi, toke ra karèbha. de baku ngee, na, te'a dènge dhoka kahadhu di, d'ai le èèna. dhae!

source_text: but wilt thou know, thou vain man, that faith without works is idle?
target_text: goa, ee! de me'a mèu le, si? parcaya dhu pad'elo boe dènge tatao be'a, gaguna na aad'o kahèi.

source_text: whether abraham, our father, was not justified of works, offering isaac, his son, on the altar?
target_text: tare conto nèti abraham. uru èèna, na sab'a madhutu ngaa dhu lamatua paredha ne, ho nèti ana na isak, sèna ka tao asa dedha mei sogo-tagu ho j'aj'i mi korban. nèti èèna ka, ama lamatua peka na, abraham tao le dhu lèke.

source_text: therefore thou seest, that faith wrought with his works, and his faith was ful filled of works.
target_text: abraham parcaya ama lamatua, ka na sèmi nare paredha èèna, hèia na tao madhutu. de èdhi te'a, na, nèngu lèka tare'a-re'a lamatua, lula na tao madhutu lii paredha èèna.

source_text: and the scripture was ful filled, saying, abraham believed to god, and it was areckoned to him to rightwiseness, and he was called the friend of god.
target_text: de se'e se j'aj'i sèmi dhu suri ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci, dhu peka na, abraham parcaya ama lamatua, hèia ama lamatua sèmi nare nèngu ho j'aj'i dhèu dhu d'ara mola. aa dhu suri kahèi, peka na, abraham èèna, angalai lamatua.

source_text: ye see that a man is justified of works, and not of faith only.
target_text: me'a mèu le, si? èdhi te'a, na, ama lamatua sèmi nare dhèu, ladhe parcaya na mi lamatua dhu tao nèngu d'èi sab'a madha j'ara hua iia. te ngaa ladhe dhoka parcaya di, d'ai mèka.

source_text: in like manner, whether also rahab, the whore, was not justified of works, and received the messengers, and sent them out by another way?
target_text: conto leo, nuka rahab, dhu uru èèna bhèni kajeo. lod'o dhèu kota jeriko tenge neo pamadhe dhèu mata-mata nèti isra'el, rahab ka pahuni si. hèia na pua si rai asa li'u re j'ara leo, sèna ka dhèu jeriko baku kèpe rare si. hèia lamatua sèmi nare ne, nuka sèmi dhèu bhèni dhu d'ara mola, lula na tao dhu be'a.

source_text: for as the body without spirit is dead, so also faith without works is dead.
target_text: parcaya dhu nèti boe hua-hela, èci èèna ka dènge ngi'u dhu dènge boe a'ae. sasoa na, madhe. sèmi èèna kahèi, ladhe dhèu peka, na, nèngu parcaya lamatua, te ngaa tao boe ngaa-ngaa dhu be'a, sèra dhu leko-monya! èèna peka mèka, na, parcaya dhu mamuri.

source_text: my brethren, do not ye be made many masters, witting that ye take the more doom.
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! abhu dhèu ae dhu neo aj'a-nori dhèu parcaya sèra. be'a kahèi! te ngaa sanèd'e paie-iie, bèli-camèd'a ama lamatua parisa toke lutu dhèu dhu aj'a dhèu parcaya sèra. de dhèu baku sad'i aj'a di.

source_text: for all we offend in many things. if any man offendeth not in word, this is a perfect man, for also he may lead about all the body with a bridle.
target_text: èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti ae ka padhai lii sala. te ngaa dhèu dhu taha nare hèb'a na, ho baku padhai leli, ne'a kahèi uri mamuri na.

source_text: for if we put bridles into horses' mouths, for to consent to us, and we lead about all the body of them.
target_text: tare conto sèmi jara. èdhi te'a uri jara dhu kapai ho madhutu dad'èi èdhi, dhoka dènge ère rarapa na.

source_text: and lo! ships, when they be great, and be driven of strong winds, yet they be borne about of a little rudder, where the moving of the governor will.
target_text: conto leo hari, nuka kapa. ngèlu mèdhu tiu kapa aae madhutu dad'èi na. te ngaa uli dhu ana iiki-iiki bisa pod'e kad'uru kapa ne madhutu dad'èi juraga.

source_text: so also the tongue is but a little member, and raiseth great things. lo! how little fire burneth or kindleth a full great wood.
target_text: èci èèna kahèi dènge he'o èdhi. masi ka he'o ana iiki, te ngaa tatao na kapai titu kèna! èèna nuka sèmi he'o ai dhu ana iiki te ngaa bisa tunu eele j'ami dhu kapai aae.

source_text: and our tongue is fire, the university of wickedness. the tongue is ordained in our members, which defouleth all the body; and it is enflamed, or set afire, of hell, and enflameth the wheel of our birth.
target_text: hèb'a ne nuka sèmi he'o ai. re hèb'a, èdhi bisa pa'ele iie madha j'ara ae-ae. hèb'a èdhi bisa pa'ele iie kateme mamuri èdhi. bhelu-katub'a ae-ae ètu rai-haha ne, mai nèti d'ara hèb'a dhèu. aa dhèu aae nidhu pake hèb'a dhèu ho pakako sasab'a na.

source_text: and all the kind of beasts, and of fowls, and of serpents, and of others is chastised, and those be made tame of man's kind;
target_text: dhèu pamau rare rupa-rupa badha hui, badha dhu rod'o re rai, manu-bhui, dènge i'a ètu d'ara dhasi.

source_text: but no man may chastise the tongue, for it is an unpeaceable evil, and full of deadly venom.
target_text: te ngaa abhu mèka ca dhèu sa dhu pamau rare he'o na. te he'o ne, mèdha dhu bhelu, dhu uri tare boe. nèngu èci èèna ka dènge raco dhu lale lème d'ara ngi'u, toke pamadhe dhèu.

source_text: in it we bless god, the father, and in it we curse men, that be made to the likeness of god. of the same mouth passeth or cometh forth blessing and cursing. my brethren, it behooveth not that these things be done so.
target_text: dènge hèb'a èèna ka, dhèu koa-kio, aa dhèu padhèd'a. se'e se, lèke boe! èdhi pake hèb'a ho koa-kio ama lamatua. aa dènge hèb'a èèna kahèi, èdhi padhèd'a aapa dhèu dhu lamatua paj'aj'i madhutu rupa na. tasamia ka j'aj'i sèmi èèna?

source_text: whether a well of the same hole bringeth forth sweet and salt water?
target_text: abhu ètu mia èi ca madha, bisa kalua èi nèta dènge èi sèro.

source_text: my brethren, whether a fig tree may make grapes, either a vine figs? so neither salt water may make sweet water.
target_text: bisa boe, sina ma, nèti kanana kalua hua dhimu? aa tarae sina bisa kalua hua anggor? te aj'u ladhe hua na, hua madhutu rupa ra. èci èèna ka, èdhi bisa boe dhui èi nèta nèti dano èi sèro.

source_text: who is wise, and taught among you? show he of good living his working or his work, in mildness of his wisdom.
target_text: dhèu dhu ngangee madhera, aa ne'a j'ara dhu madhutu dad'èi lamatua, baku padedha iisi. te ne'a, mamèu na mai nèti lamatua. hud'i laa nèngu pad'elo mamèu na dènge j'ara mamuri dhu mola.

source_text: that if ye have bitter envy, and strivings or strives be in your hearts, do not ye have glory, and be liars against the truth. for this wisdom is not from above coming down, but earthly, and beastly, and fiendly.
target_text: baku padedha iisi, peka na, èu dhèu dhu dènge ngangee madhera, ladhe èu tèka d'ara era ho pabèbhe dhèu leo. èci èèna ka èu ne, dhèu kapod'e-kabèli. te mamuri sèmi èèna, peka boe, ‘ngangee madhera'. tatao nuka sèmi, tèka d'ara, d'èi pabèbha dhèu, sèra sa mai boe nèti ama lamatua. èèna na tatao dhèu rai-haha. sèra sa lèke mi dhèu dhu soro boe mamuri ra mi ama lamatua. tatao sèra madhutu dad'èi nidhu.

source_text: for where is envy and strife, there is unsteadfastness and all shrewd work.
target_text: te ladhe tèka d'ara aa d'èi pabèbha dhèu, tatu abhu kahèi patao-palaha dènge rupa-rupa bhabhelu-katub'a.

source_text: but wisdom that is from above, first it is chaste, afterward peaceable, mild, able to be counselled or persuadable, consenting to good things, full of mercy and of good fruits, deeming without feigning.
target_text: te ngaa ngangee madhera dhu mai nèti ama lamatua, nuka: dhu tao èdhi mamuri mola, pamau d'ara èdhi, d'èi pa'uru dhèu, taha tare d'ara, dènge lii mako. hua-hela nèti ngangee madhera èèna, nuka: tao èdhi d'ara hua iia, d'èi soru-bara dhèu, bia boe cabèka, aa kapod'e-kabèli boe dhèu leo.

source_text: and the fruit of rightwiseness is sown in peace, to men that make peace.
target_text: dhèu dhu uri padame, bèli-camèd'a nèngu abhu babe'a. j'ara èèna nuka sèmi dhèu dhu sèle hini, ho nèbhu-nèbhu na puu hua dhu be'a.

source_text: whereof be battles and chidings among you? whether not of your covetings, that fight in your members?
target_text: miu loe boe patao-palaha aa pagama èci dènge èci. tasamia ka sèmi èèna? èèna, lula ètu talora aae miu abhu dhèu dhu dhoka tenge j'ara ho pakarej'e d'ara na.

source_text: ye covet, and ye have not; ye slay, and ye have envy, and ye may not get. ye chide, and make battle; and ye have not, for that ye ask not.
target_text: miu neo ae le abhu mèdha èci, te ngaa ai d'ai boe. hèia mi tèke d'ara, patao-palaha, dènge pagama, toke mangingi boe pamadhe dhèu. lula miu sabaj'a boe, aa manèngi boe nèti lamatua, nèti èèna ka miu abhu boe.

source_text: ye ask, and ye receive not; for that ye ask evil, as ye show openly in your covetings.
target_text: te ngaa masi ka miu sabaj'a toke padhe aj'u-hadhu, miu abhu boe ngaa dhu miu manèngi, lula manèngi madhutu dhodhoka dad'èi d'ara miu di.

source_text: adulterers, know not ye, that the friendship of this world is enemy or enmity to god? therefore whoever will be the friend of this world, is made the enemy of god.
target_text: mema miu satia boe! miu nuka sèmi dhèu èmu-kamali dhu èci pusi-pahae boe èci, aa tao j'ara makae di. ladhe miu pa'angalai dènge dad'èi rai-haha, miu pamusu dènge ama lamatua. j'ara èèna la'e sèmi èèna ka!

source_text: whether ye guess, that the scripture saith vainly, the spirit that dwelleth in you, coveteth to envy?
target_text: nèti èèna ka, sasuri mola-mèci lamatua, peka na, lamatua hia le roh na ètu d'ara èdhi. aa madhutu dad'èi roh, èdhi madhutu ne taa-taa. te ama lamatua ne d'ara kura kahèi.

source_text: but he giveth the more grace; for which thing he saith, god withstandeth proud men, but to meek men he giveth grace.
target_text: ngaa hari, ama lamatua neo hia tabha hari babe'a d'ara na. ka sasuri mola-mèci, peka na, lamatua lab'a dhèu dhu padedha iisi ra, te ngaa na pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi dhèu dhu pahaha iisi ra.

source_text: therefore be ye subject to god; but withstand ye the devil, and he shall flee from you.
target_text: de soro iisi mi asa adhe-aai ama lamatua, sèna ka madhutu dad'èi na. miu baku madhutu dad'èi dhèu aae nidhu. lab'a ne pa'èra-èra; baku golo. dènge sèmi èèna, na rai tèke eele miu.

source_text: nigh ye to god, and he shall nigh to you. ye sinners, cleanse ye the hands, and ye double in soul or ye double of will, purge ye the hearts. be ye wretches, and wail ye or weep ye; your laughing be turned into weeping, and your joy into sorrow of heart.
target_text: tenge j'ara sèna ka mamuri d'ara èci dènge ama lamatua. ladhe sèmi èèna, nèngu padètu-dètu dènge miu kahèi. wee, miu dhu mamuri ètu d'ara kaj'alu sèra! miu hud'i pamola ku j'ara mamuri miu. aa miu dhu d'ara kajari sèra! miu hud'i kako mola-mola madhutu lamatua, aa baku piku hari g'ana do kariu. nèbhu nare sange ne'e, miu mamuri karae dènge pasoa-pasoka di. de hua iia, ae eele ka! miu me'a le, na, d'ara miu kajari lula sasala-sasigo miu sèra. be'a risi miu ele-ho'a aa tangi dènge d'ara manyasa.

source_text: be ye meeked in the sight of the lord, and he shall enhance you.
target_text: ladhe tare'a-re'a miu me'a, na, miu dhu nia boe ètu katanga madha ama lamatua, bèli-camèd'a na ded'e nare miu, sèna ka j'aj'i mi dhèu dhu nia ètu madha na.

source_text: my brethren, do not ye backbite each other. he that backbiteth his brother, either that deemeth his brother, backbiteth the law, and deemeth the law. and if thou deemest the law, thou art not a doer of the law, but a doomsman.
target_text: a'ari! baku padhai pakarehe kolongara èci dènge èci. te ladhe miu padhai le sèmi èèna, aa d'èi pèci sasala nèti èci asa èci, miu lab'a le atora nèti lamatua dhu peka na, èu hud'i sue ku a'ari èu, nuka sèmi èu sue ngi'u èu unu mu. aa ladhe miu madhutu boe atora ne, miu ded'e iisi mi dedha risi nèti atora ama lamatua.

source_text: but one is maker of the law, and judge, that may lose and deliver. and who art thou, that deemest thy neighbour?
target_text: dhodhoka lamatua mesa na dhu tao atora èèna, dhu dènge hak ho pama'ète lii langu èdhi. dhoka nèngu di mesa na dhu dènge hak, sèna ka hia mamuri mi èdhi, do huku pamadhe ti. miu dènge boe hak ho pama'ète lii langu dhèu, do padhai pakarehe kolongara dhèu.

source_text: lo! now ye, that say, today either tomorrow we shall go into that city, and there we shall dwell a year, and we shall make merchandise, and we shall make winning;
target_text: sèmi ne'e! madhutu iia-iia na, miu me'a le ho baku peka na, deo ne'e, do bèli, ji'i neo la'a sa kota nèi! ji'i neo pea mi era nèi pe d'ai ca tèu sa. aa ji'i neo d'aga sèna ka abhu ku leto d'ai ciki sa.

source_text: which know not, what is to you in the morrow. for what is your life? a smoke or a vapour appearing at a little time, and afterward it shall be wasted.
target_text: èu me'a ngaa dhu j'aj'i lod'o bèli? dhèu èci sa re'a boe tasamia mamuri na. mamuri èdhi dhèu ne nuka sèmi sèb'u dhu tèdhi dhoka ètu d'ara ciki oo'e èèna, kaca'a laa ele.

source_text: therefore that ye say, if the lord will, and if we live, we shall do this thing, either that thing.
target_text: be'a risi miu peka na, ladhe lamatua sue, na, ji'i mamuri madhera. aa ladhe lamatua d'èi, hud'i laa ji'i tao ne'e.

source_text: and now ye make full out joy in your prides; every such joying is wicked.
target_text: te ladhe peka boe sèmi èèna, miu dhodhoka padedha iisi di. èci èèna ka dènge miu bhèlu eele lamatua ètu d'ara nanelu miu sèra. èèna sala kapai titu kèna!

source_text: therefore it is sin to him, that knoweth to do good, and doeth not.
target_text: sanèd'e paie-iie! dhèu dhu re'a le ngaa dhu lèke, te ngaa tao boe madhutu, èci èèna ka dènge nèngu tao sala le.

source_text: do now, ye rich men, weep ye, yelling in your wretchednesses that shall come to you. your riches be rotten, and your clothes be eaten of moths. your gold and silver hath rusted, and the rust of them shall be to you into witnessing, and shall eat your fleshes, as fire. ye have treasured to you wrath in the last days. lo! the hire of your workmen, that reaped your fields, which is defrauded of you, crieth; and the cry of them hath entered into the ears of the lord of hosts. ye have eaten on the earth, and in your lecheries ye have nourished your hearts. in the day of slaying ye brought, and slew the just man, and he against-stood not you. ye led to, and slew the just man, and he withstood you not.
target_text: miu dhèu kaja sèra, sanèd'e, ee! pasa dhilu ho nanene paie-iie! dhèu sab'a hia miu toke èi kabhèsu hae, te ngaa miu taha mere gaji ra. limuri ne rui-j'aj'èra ra pa'oo-parodha dhu peka nèti kapod'e-kabèli miu. tatu ama lamatua dhu kapai risi eele èèna, tadèngi le lii roma iisi dhèu sab'a sèra. sasab'a miu ètu rai-haha ne, dhoka tao pagaa ngi'u miu mesa mi, ka mamuri mi ha'a-ha'a, hèti-hèti. limuri ne miu nuka sèmi sapi kab'oi dhu neo lèke roro. miu huku dènge pamadhe le dhèu be'a sèra, dhu re'a boe siri iisi ra ètu madha miu. miu dhèu kaja sèra! tangi ka laa! pe miu pasae mere rupa-rupa j'aj'èra. mèdha-panyau miu, ele iia kèna. aa mèdha-papake miu dhu be'a sèra, ana ca ngèpi na'e aa'i si. hualaa iia dènge hualaa pudhi miu sèra, dènge heka kab'ua. aa bèli-camèd'a hualaa miu sèra ra'e hari miu, sèmi ai na'e aj'u mango. rai-haha oe èle kèna, te ngaa tasamia ka miu kabhèsu lutu pakaboko taruu mèdha dhu madhe sèra? mèdha-panyau miu unu mi ka dhu j'aj'i tadha, peka na, miu me'a boe mia ka dhu dènge kab'ua ètu madha lamatua!

source_text: therefore, brethren, be ye patient, till to the coming of the lord. lo! an earth-tiller abideth the precious fruit of the earth, patiently suffering, till he receive timeful and lateful fruit.
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! miu hud'i taha d'ara ku, tatae mamai hari lamatua. ladhe ku laa dhèu sab'a oka-tedhe, dhu tatae hèru puu-g'ètu. èj'i hua hiu, na sèle hini. mate hari èj'i limuri, ho na pamangèru ana nganga'a sèra. nèbhu-nèbhu ku heka hua kèna. d'ai lod'o puu-g'ètu, dhèu ne la'e puu.

source_text: and be ye patient, and confirm ye your hearts, for the coming of the lord shall nigh.
target_text: miu hud'i taha d'ara sèmi èèna kahèi. pa'èra ngi'u, te nèbhu heka lamatua mai!

source_text: brethren, do not ye be sorrowful or do not ye be scornful each to other, that ye be not deemed. lo! the judge standeth nigh before the gate.
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! baku ka'uu-kamuki èci dènge èci. ka'uu-kamuki taruu, pe lamatua ka dhu huku èu! ladhe ka, te ama hakim ètu dedha nèi, titu le ètu madha miu.

source_text: brethren, take ye ensample of evil going out, and of long abiding, and travail, or and of long abiding of travail, and of patience, the prophets, that spake to you in the name of the lord.
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! madhutu conto nèti dhèu rèti lii padhai lamatua sèra. masi ka rèngu paraga dènge susa rupa-rupa, te ngaa rèngu taha taruu ètu d'ara sasusa.

source_text: lo! we bless them that suffered. ye have heard the patience of job, and ye saw the end of the lord, for the lord is merciful, and doing mercy.
target_text: ladhe abhu dhèu dhu taha ètu d'ara sasusa, èdhi d'èi padedha ngara dhèu ne. nuka sèmi ayub. masi ka na abhu susa rupa-rupa, te ngaa na kalau-karèto boe. hèia lamatua sue ne, ka na ator aa'i-aa'i j'aj'i mi be'a hia ayub. lamatua tao sèmi èèna, lula d'ara na hua iia, pènu dènge sasue.

source_text: before all things, my brethren, do not ye swear, neither by heaven, neither by earth, neither by whatever other oath. but be your word yea, yea, nay, nay, that ye fall not under doom.
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! dhu be'a risi miu baku j'oka subha. ladhe neo peka, oo, na, dhaa la oo. aa ladhe peka aad'o na, dhaa la aad'o. sèmi èèna, d'ai le! baku parisi dènge j'oka subha dhu ale ngara dhèu madhe ètu rai-haha ne. ngaa hari pasubha dènge kolongara lamatua dhu mamuri ètu dedha-liru. gaguna na aad'o dènge pasubha rupa-rupa. de ladhe taruu sèmi èèna, miu pasae mere huku, lula lii subha sèra.

source_text: and if any of you is sorrowful, or heavy, pray he with patient soul, and say he a psalm.
target_text: ladhe nèti miu abhu sasusa, be'a risi na sabaj'a. aa dhu ètu d'ara karej'e, be'a risi na sod'a koa-kio lamatua.

source_text: if any of you is sick, lead he in priests of the church, and pray they for him, and anoint him with oil in the name of the lord;
target_text: ladhe ètu talora miu abhu dhu pèd'a, be'a risi paroa ina-ama juma'at. manèngi sèna ka ra pasuti èi lèngi mi dhèu pèd'a ne, aa sabaj'a pake kolongara lamatua, ho hud'i laa lamatua ka dhu puri-pa'èle ne.

source_text: and the prayer of faith shall save the sick manor shall save the sick, and the lord shall make him light; and if he be in sins, they shall be forgiven to him.
target_text: aa ladhe miu sabaj'a dènge lèka tare'a-re'a lamatua hia dhèu pèd'a, èèna na lamatua puri-pa'èle ne. aa ladhe na tao sala, pe lamatua saku eele sasala na sèra.

source_text: therefore acknowledge ye each to other your sins, and pray ye each for other, that ye be saved. for the continual prayer of a just man is much worth.

source_text: blessed be god, and the father of our lord jesus christ, which by his great mercy begat us again into living hope, by the again-rising of jesus christ from death,

source_text: into heritage uncorruptible, and undefouled, and that shall not fade, that is kept in heavens for you,

source_text: that in the virtue of god be kept by the faith into health, and is ready to be showed in the last time.

source_text: in which ye shall make joy, though it behooveth now a little to be sorry in diverse temptations;

source_text: that the proving of your faith be much more precious than gold, that is proved by fire; and be found into praising, and glory, and honour, in the revelation of jesus christ.

source_text: whom when ye have not seen, ye love; into whom also now ye not seeing, believe; but ye that believe shall have joy, and gladness that may not be told out, and ye shall be glorified,

source_text: and have or bring again the end of your faith, the health of your souls.

source_text: and sought which either what manner time the spirit of christ signified in them, and before-told those passions that be in christ, and the latter glories.

source_text: to which it was showed, for not to themselves, but to you they ministered those things, that now be told to you by them that preached to you by the holy ghost, sent from heaven, into whom angels desire to behold.

source_text: for which thing be ye gird the loins of your soul, sober, perfect, and hope ye into that grace that is proffered to you by the showing of jesus christ,

source_text: as sons of obedience, not made like to the former desires of your unknowingness or your ignorance,

source_text: but like him that hath called you holy; that also yourselves be holy in all living;

source_text: for it is written, ye shall be holy, for i am holy.

source_text: witting that not by corruptible gold, either silver, ye be bought again of your vain living of fathers' tradition,

source_text: but by the precious blood as of the lamb undefouled and unspotted, christ jesus,

source_text: but ye be a chosen kin or ye be a kind chosen, a kingly priesthood, holy folk, a people of purchasing, that ye tell the virtues of him, that called you from darknesses into his wonderful light.

source_text: which sometime were not a people of god, but now ye be the people of god; which had not mercy, but now ye have mercy.

source_text: most dear, i beseech you, as comelings or as guests, and pilgrims, to abstain you from fleshly desires, that fight against the soul;

source_text: and have ye your conversation or your life good among heathen men, that in that thing that they backbite of you, as of mis-doers, they behold you of good works, and glorify god in the day of visitation.

source_text: be ye subject to each creature of man, for god; either to the king, as to him that is higher or is more worthy in state,
target_text: dad'èi lamatua èdhi, sèna ka miu nanene dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu rèd'u paredha. nuka sèmi: nanene mi dhèu aae, te nèngu ka ama paredha dedha.

source_text: either to dukes, as to those that be sent of him to the vengeance of mis-doers, and to the praising of good men or of good deeds.
target_text: nanene mi gubernur, te dhèu aae ka dhu pua ne, ho huku dhèu dhu ad'u-ue bhabhelu, aa na koa-kad'iri dhèu dhu tao j'ara dhu lèke.

source_text: for so is the will of god, that ye do well, and make the unknowing-ness of unprudent or unwise men to be dumb.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ama lamatua d'èi miu tao dhu lèke, sèna ka dhèu goa dhu re'a boe ngaa-ngaa sèra, abhu boe j'ara ho galaa miu.

source_text: as free men, and not as having freedom the covering of malice, but as the servants of god.
target_text: masi ka miu dhèu bebas dhu dènge hak sèna ka madhutu dad'èi d'ara mi, te ngaa miu baku tao leli hak ne ho ad'u-ue bhabhelu. pake hak ne sèna ka sab'a hia ama lamatua, te miu j'aj'i le dhèu unu na.

source_text: honour ye all men, love ye brotherhood, dread ye god, honour ye the king.
target_text: miu hud'i pakab'ua ku dhèu aa'i-aa'i. miu hud'i sue ku dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu parcaya kristus. miu hud'i mamuri dhu lèke ètu madha lamatua, te nèngu ka dhu pama'ète lii langu miu. aa miu hud'i pakab'ua ku rèngu aa'i-aa'i dhu rèd'u paredha.

source_text: servants, be ye subject in all dread to lords, not only to good and to mild, but also to tyrants.
target_text: ana pua-paleha sèra! nanene paie-iie lamatua miu sèra, aa pakab'ua si. mage nanene dhoka lamatua dhu d'ara be'a aa lii mako di. masi ka lamatua miu bhelu titu kèna, te ngaa miu hud'i nanene paie ne kahèi.

source_text: for this is grace, if for conscience of god any man suffereth heavinesses or sorrows, and suffereth unjustly.
target_text: ladhe nèti miu abhu huku dhu lèke boe j'ara nèti lamatua miu masi ka miu sala boe ngaa-ngaa, aa ladhe miu taha ètu d'ara sasusa èèna, lula miu ngee mèdhi dad'èi lamatua, pe ama lamatua pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi dedha miu.

source_text: for what grace is it, if ye sin, and be buffeted, and suffer? but if ye do well, and suffer patiently, this is grace with god.
target_text: ladhe sèmi miu tao sala, hèia abhu gama, na, a'oto na ngaa, ladhe miu taha ètu d'ara j'aj'èra èèna? abhu boe, si? te ngaa ladhe miu abhu susa lula tao dhu be'a, hèia miu taha mere d'ara, na, lamatua ladhe-leru miu.

source_text: for to this thing ye be called. for also christ suffered for us, and left ensample to you, that ye follow the steps of him.
target_text: te kristus neo kahèi sèna ka miu mamuri mola, masi ka miu abhu susa. te nèngu dui j'aj'èra kahèi pala èdhi. dènge sèmi èèna, nèngu j'aj'i mi conto, sèna ka èdhi madhutu ne, èci èèna ka èdhi madhutu kab'a-j'èla na.

source_text: which did not sin, neither guile was found in his mouth.
target_text: sasuri mola-mèci lamatua, peka na, nèngu tao nèdhi boe sala. abhu boe lii kapod'e-kabèli kalua nèti hèb'a na.

source_text: and when he was cursed, he cursed not; when he suffered, he menaced not; but he betook himself to him, that deemed him unjustly.
target_text: lod'o ra padhai lii pa-aape ne, nèngu bhoka boe hèb'a. ropa dhèu pasusa nèngu, na b'ala boe. te ngaa na soro ngi'u na asa d'ara adhe-aai ama lamatua. te ne'a, na, ama lamatua èèna dhèu pama'ète lii langu dhu mola.

source_text: and he himself bare or suffered our sins in his body on a tree, that we be dead to sins, and live to rightwiseness, by whose wan wound ye be healed.
target_text: kristus ka dhu pasae nare sasala èdhi ropa madhe ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha. na ad'u-ue j'ara ne, ho patabuli èdhi nèti koasa sasala, sèna ka èdhi mamuri ia ka dènge tao sasala. ka limuri ne èdhi mamuri heka tao sasala, dhoka mamuri dènge tao dhu lèke di. te nèngu gati èdhi, sèna ka pasae nare hahuku èdhi. hahuku ne'e ka dhu panu'a nèngu toke madhe. te nu'a dhu pamadhe yesus èèna ka puri-pa'èle miu.

source_text: for ye were as sheep erring, but ye be now turned to the shepherd or but ye be converted now to the shepherd, and bishop of your souls.
target_text: te miu nuka sèmi kahib'i-kalèbho dhu uru èèna sigo eele nèti j'ara. te ngaa limuri ne miu lèpa hari le asa j'ara lamatua dhu mola. te nèngu ka dhu madhenga dènge kab'oi miu, nuka sèmi dhèu madhenga badha dhu j'aga dènge ladhe-leru kahib'i-kalèbho na sèra.

source_text: also women be they subject to their husbands; that if any man, that is, husbands, believe not to the word, by the conversation of women they be won without word.
target_text: bhèni aa'i-aa'i dhu leo le èmu! deo na ja'a peka, na, èdhi hud'i nanene paie-iie ku dhèu dhu rèd'u koasa. de miu hud'i nanene ku dhèu èmu miu. sanèd'e, te abhu dhèu mone cahag'e dhu leo le èmu, ro'o boe tao madhutu lii holo-nori lamatua. masi ka rèngu ro'o boe nanene lii padhai miu, te ngaa èèna na, rèngu neo parcaya lamatua, lula rèdhi j'ara mamuri miu.

source_text: and behold ye in dread your holy conversation.
target_text: te rèngu rèdhi miu sab'a aa'i-aa'i dènge d'ara mola-mèci aa mamuri dhu pakab'ua ama lamatua.

source_text: of whom be there not without-forth curious adorning of hair, either doing about of gold, either adorning of clothing;
target_text: bhèni dhu bhèni iia, mai boe nèti ngaa dhu tèdhi nèti li'u. nuka sèmi: sageri kètu madhutu rupa-rupa mod'e, do, pake mèdha hualaa dhu risi eele, do, pake mèdha-papake dhu kab'ua aae dhu lèke boe j'ara.

source_text: but that that is the hid man of heart, in uncorruption, and of mild spirit, or in uncorruptibility of quiet and mild spirit, which is rich in the sight of god.
target_text: te ngaa dhu tao bhèni iia dhu lèke, nuka: d'ara dhu tèdhi boe nèti li'u. conto sèmi: d'ara hua iia, dènge lii mako. te bhèni iia sèmi èèna ka dhu taha taruu, masi ka toke d'ai heka bhora. madhutu a'abhu lamatua, bhèni iia sèmi èèna ka dhu kab'ua risi.

source_text: for so sometime holy women hoping in god adorned themselves, and were subject to their own husbands.
target_text: te uru-uru sèra, dhèu bhèni dhu d'ara mola-mèci, dhu parcaya ama lamatua, rèngu sèra ka dhu bhèni iia. rèngu nanene aa madhutu dhèu èmu ra dènge be'a.

source_text: as sarah obeyed to abraham, and called him lord; of whom ye be daughters well-doing, and not dreading any perturbation.
target_text: tare conto nèti sara. nèngu nanene mi dhèu èmu na abraham. nèngu soro iisi na, sèna ka dhèu èmu na ator nèngu. miu bhèni aa'i-aa'i hud'i madhutu ku j'ara nèti sara ne. ladhe miu tao dhu lèke, na, miu madha'u boe.

source_text: also men dwell together, and by knowing or science, give ye honour to the woman's frailty, or to her vessel, as to the more feeble, and as to even-heirs of grace and of life, that your prayers be not hindered.
target_text: mone aa'i-aa'i dhu leo le èmu! mamuri d'ara èci dènge dhèu èmu miu. ngee paie-iie ngaa dhu be'a hia mi nèngu, aa tao madhutu. pakab'ua ne ètu j'ara aa'i-aa'i, lula a'èra bhèni sama boe dènge a'èra dhèu mone. te miu sama-sama abhu pusaka dhu ama lamatua neo hia miu. nuka, mamuri hiu dhu lamatua hia miu nèti d'ara hua iia na. te ngaa miu mone dhu ngara na dhèu èmu-kamali, hud'i mamuri d'ara èci dènge dhèu èmu miu, sèna ka ladhe miu dua mi sabaj'a d'ara èci manèngi ngaa èèna ka nèti lamatua, na, lamatua nanene lii manèngi miu.

source_text: and in faith all of one will, in prayer be ye each suffering with other, lovers of brotherhood, merciful, mild, meek; forsooth in faith all of one understanding, or will, in prayer be ye compassionate, or each suffering with other, lovers of fraternity, merciful, mild, meek;
target_text: a'ari pasue aa'i-aa'i! ja'a pab'ab'e lii holo ja'a aa'i-aa'i sèra sèmi ne'e ka: miu hud'i mamuri ku d'ara èci. ladhe ca dhèu abhu susa do karej'e, na, miu dhu leo hud'i rasa sèmi èèna kahèi. sue dhèu dhu parcaya kristus. pad'elo d'ara hua iia èci dènge èci. baku padedha iisi, te miu hud'i pahaha iisi ku.

source_text: not yielding evil for evil, neither cursing for cursing, but on the contrary blessing; for in this thing ye be called, that ye wield blessing by heritage.
target_text: baku b'ala bhabhelu dènge bhabhelu. ladhe dhèu padhai lii padhèto dènge miu, baku b'ala kahèi. te ngaa manèngi sèna ka lamatua hia dhu be'a mi nèngu. te lamatua dhu paroa nare le miu j'aj'i mi dhèu unu na, sèna ka miu bisa sèmi mere dhu hua iia nèti nèngu.

source_text: for he that will love life, and see good days, constrain his tongue from evil, and his lips, that they speak not guile or that they speak no guile.
target_text: te dhu suri tèke ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci lamatua, na, dhèu dhu tenge mamuri be'a, aa dhu tenge mamuri madhera, dhèu èèna hud'i j'aga hèb'a na sèna ka baku ore leli, aa baku pakapod'e d'ara lii.

source_text: and bow he from evil, and do good; seek he peace, and perfectly follow it.
target_text: nèngu hud'i ele-ho'a, sèna ka tao heka bhelu, te ngaa tao dhu lèke di. nèngu hud'i patema mamuri padame dènge dhèu aa'i-aa'i, aa tenge j'ara ho pabe'a taruu dènge ra.

source_text: for the eyes of the lord be on just men, and his ears on the prayers of them; but the cheer or the face of the lord is on men that do evils.
target_text: te lamatua èdhi dhu haduli dhèu dhu mamuri mola. aa nèngu kahèi neo nanene lii manèngi-mangaj'i rèngu. te ngaa lamatua èdhi loe boe lab'a dhèu dhu ad'u-ue taruu bhabhelu-katub'a.

source_text: and who is it that shall annoy you, if ye be pursuers and lovers of goodness?
target_text: ladhe miu d'èi tao dhu lèke, cee ka dhu neo paj'èra hari miu? abhu boe, si?

source_text: but also if ye suffer anything for rightwiseness, ye be blessed; but dread ye not the dread of them, that ye be not disturbed or distroubled.
target_text: te ngaa masi ka miu tao dhu lèke, hèia abhu dhu pasusa miu, miu oto. ladhe abhu dhèu dhu tadhe boe kristus j'aj'i madha'u lula madha j'ara èci, na, miu baku madhutu ho madha'u sèmi èèna. ngangee miu baku kahèlu, aa d'ara miu baku susa èci èèna ka dènge rèngu.

source_text: but hallow ye the lord christ in your hearts, and evermore be ye ready to do satisfaction to each man asking you reason of that faith and hope that is in you, but with mildness, and dread,
target_text: pamau d'ara miu, lula miu dhu ded'e le kristus ètu d'ara miu ho j'aj'i lamatua miu dhu mola-mèci. ladhe sèmi dhèu manèngi sèna ka miu lole parcaya miu aa sanao-maena miu, dhu peka na, bèli-camèd'a kristus tao aa'i j'aj'i mi be'a, na, miu hud'i pa'èra ku ho dhaa lii karèi rèngu sèra.

source_text: having good conscience; that in that thing that they backbite of you, they be confounded, which challenge falsely your good conversation in christ.
target_text: te ngaa miu hud'i dhaa ku nèti d'ara dhu hua iia, aa pakab'ua si, sèna ka re'a, na, miu tao dhu lèke mai nèti d'ara dhu mola. masi ka miu tao dhu be'a sèmi èèna, te ngaa tatu abhu dhu padhai lii neo pamanahu miu, lula miu pa'èki dènge kristus. de ladhe miu tao taruu dhu be'a, na, rèngu dhu pa-aape miu èèna na ra'e makae.

source_text: for it is better that ye do well, and suffer, if the will of god will, than doing evil. soothly it is better, if the will of god will, ye well-doing, to suffer, than evil-doing.
target_text: ladhe èèna palèke dènge dad'èi lamatua, na, baku bhèlu, te be'a risi miu abhu j'aj'èra nèti tao j'ara dhu lèke; baku nèti miu ad'u-ue j'ara karehe.

source_text: for also christ once died for our sins, he just for unjust, that he should offer to god us or should offer us to god, made dead in flesh, but made quick in spirit.
target_text: te kristus madhe ca tèka di, lula èdhi dhèu rai-haha tao sala. nèngu dhu mamuri mola, madhe le pala èdhi dhu mamuri koe-kapengo. nèngu madhe sèna ka miu bisa pabe'a hari dènge ama lamatua. kristus èèna, dhèu rai-haha sama sèmi èdhi kahèi, dhèu pamadhe ne, te ngaa roh lamatua pamamuri hari ne.

source_text: for which thing he came in spirit, and also to them that were enclosed together in prison;
target_text: roh èèna kahèi lere nèti nèngu la'e aj'a-nori mi roh-roh dhu lèke bèdho ètu era èci, nuka sèmi d'ara bui.

source_text: which were sometime unbelieve-ful, when they abided the patience of god in the days of noah, when the ship or the ark was made, in which a few, that is to say, eight souls were made safe by water.
target_text: roh se, nuka samanga nèti dhèu dhu uru-uru sèra ro'o boe nanene lamatua. lod'o èèna, noh tao kapa aae cue. lamatua tatae sèna ka neo nèdhi dhèu sèra tao madhutu dad'èi na, te ngaa rèngu pusi-pahae boe. nèti èèna ka, abhu dhoka dhèu aru di, dhu mamuri nèti èi aae lala.

source_text: and so baptism of like form maketh us safe; not the putting away of the filths of flesh, but the asking of a good conscience in god, by the again-rising of our lord jesus christ,
target_text: èi aae lala ne j'aj'i conto, nuka sèmi lod'o sarani miu. sarani ne j'aj'i tadha, peka na, lamatua patabuli eele miu nèti koasa sasala-sasigo miu, lula kristus mamuri hari le. lod'o sarani miu, ra padiu boe miu, ho pamèu ngi'u mi. te dhu lèke ka, nuka, miu padhadha mi lamatua, ho neo tao pamèu d'ara miu. dènge sèmi èèna, na, miu bisa mamuri mola.

source_text: that is in the right half of god, and swalloweth death, that we should be made heirs of everlasting life. he went into heaven, and angels, and powers, and virtues be made subject to him.
target_text: limuri ne, yesus lèpa hari le asa sorga. ètu nèi, na madhèdi ètu era dhu kab'ua risi eele, re baboa g'ana ama lamatua. ka ana-ana pajuu ètu sorga, koasa aa'i-aa'i, dènge dhu rèd'u koasa, hud'i nanene ku kristus.

source_text: therefore for christ suffered in flesh, be ye also armed by the same thinking; for he that suffered in flesh ceased from sins,
target_text: kristus èèna, dhèu rai-haha èci èèna ka dènge èdhi. lula nèngu abhu le j'aj'èra ae-ae, miu hud'i pa'èra dui sasusa sama sèmi nèngu kahèi. te ngaa sanèd'e, te dhèu dhu abhu susa lula pa'èki dènge kristus, nèngu pama'ète nare le ho ad'u-ue heka sasala.

source_text: that that is left now of time in flesh live not now to the desires of men, but to the will of god.
target_text: masi ka nèngu mamuri era ètu rai-haha ne, te ngaa nèngu mamuri heka ètu d'ara sasala sama sèmi dhèu rai-haha leo sèra. te nèngu mamuri madhutu dad'èi ama lamatua.

source_text: for the time that is passed is enough to the will of heathen men to be ended, which walked in lecheries, and lusts, in much drinking of wine, in unmeasurable or oft eatings, and drinkings, and unleaveful worshipping of maumets or of idols.
target_text: uru èèna, lod'o ae le ka dhu miu bisa pake ho ad'u-ue bhabhelu ngaa èèna ka, sama sèmi dhèu dhu tadhe boe lamatua. nuka sèmi: rèngu tao j'ara dhu lèke boe. tao j'ara makae. tao bhabhelu madhutu dad'èi d'ara ra. rinu mahu. rèngu tao pesta liar. rèngu tao pesta j'ara makae rupa-rupa. ra sogo-tagu nidhu dènge j'ara dhu pamamuru iisi èdhi.

source_text: in which now they be astonied, in which thing they wonder, for ye run not together into the same confusion of lechery, and blaspheme.
target_text: rèngu padhai pa'ele iie kolongara miu, lula rèngu re'a boe, nga tao ka miu tao boe madhutu bhabhelu sèmi rèngu dhu seli-kolane èèna.

source_text: and they shall give reason to him, that is ready to deem the quick and the dead.
target_text: te ngaa sanèd'e, bèli-camèd'a rèngu hud'i lasi ku asa madha ama lamatua, dhu j'aj'i dhèu pama'ète lii langu. rèngu hud'i lole dènge ama lamatua nga tao ka rèngu mamuri ètu d'ara bhelu-katub'a sèmi sèra. baku bhèlu, te dhèu aa'i-aa'i bèli-camèd'a hud'i lasi ku asa madha nèngu. dhèu dhu mamuri era, do dhu madhe le, aa'i-aa'i hud'i lasi ku asa madha lamatua.

source_text: for why for this thing it is preached or it is evangelized also to dead men, that they be deemed by men in flesh, and that they live by god in spirit.
target_text: lèke tare'a! ama lamatua neo parisa dhèu dhu madhe le, nuka sèmi dhu nèngu parisa dhèu rai-haha leo sèra. te nèngu neo ne'a j'ara mamuri rèngu uru sèra. nèti èèna ka, yesus la'e le peka-padhai lii lolo be'a lamatua mi dedha rèngu, sèna ka rèngu kahèi bisa abhu mamuri dhu lèke ho tao madhutu dad'èi lamatua.

source_text: for the end of all things shall nigh. therefore be ye prudent, and wake ye in prayers;
target_text: lod'o èle rai-haha ne oe dètu ae le. nèti èèna ka, miu hud'i pajiko paie-iie dènge d'ara dhu mau, sèna ka lamatua sèmi nare lii manèngi miu.

source_text: before all things have ye charity each to other in yourselves always lasting; for charity covereth the multitude of sins.
target_text: dhu lèke ka, miu hud'i mamuri pasue taruu èci dènge èci. te masi ka dhèu leo tao sasala ae-ae, te ngaa miu bisa pa'angalai era dènge ne, lula miu sue ne.

source_text: hold ye hospitality together with-out grutching;
target_text: pakabhèle ai sèna ka sèmi mere dhèu tao-mai ho manubha ètu d'ara èmu miu. te ngaa sanèd'e, baku sèmi mere si dènge d'ara ka'uu-kamuki.

source_text: each man as he hath received grace, ministering it into each other or ministering each to other, as good dispensers of the manyfold grace of god.
target_text: èdhi dhèu parcaya aa'i-aa'i abhu le karunya nèti lamatua. de èdhi hud'i pake karunya ne ho lalau-lalo'o a'ari dhèu parcaya. haduli aa pake pabe'a-be'a karunya èèna, te èèna ka dhu dènge guna hia mi lamatua.

source_text: if any man speaketh, speak he as the words of god; if any man ministereth, as of the virtue which god ministereth; that god be honoured in all things by jesus christ our lord, to whom is glory and lordship into worlds of worlds. amen.
target_text: nuka sèmi: ladhe abhu karunya aj'a-nori dhèu, na, sanèd'e te miu hud'i lole dènge dhèu aa'i-aa'i pake lii holo-nori ama lamatua. ladhe abhu karunya ho ladhe-leru dhèu, na, sab'a pake a'èra dhu lamatua pala-bagi mi miu. dènge j'ara ne, dhèu aa'i-aa'i tadhe, na, miu dhèu unu yesus kristus. dènge sèmi èèna, rèngu ded'e padedha-dedha ama lamatua. te nèngu èèna, kapai titu kèna! aa koasa nèd'u paredha na dhu dènge boe too-lane! lèke tare'a-re'a sèmi èèna!

source_text: most dear brethren, do not ye go in pilgrimage in fervour, that is made to you to temptation, as if any new thing befall to you;
target_text: a'ari pasue aa'i-aa'i! mage malaa ladhe paraga dènge dadugu-rariu dhu bia. te èèna neo uji parcaya miu. baku pangee, na, dhoka èu di dhu abhu dadugu-rariu sèmi èèna.

source_text: but commune ye with the passions of christ, and have ye joy, that also ye be glad, and have joy in the revelation of his glory.
target_text: te ngaa d'ara miu bisa karej'e-karae, lula miu abhu j'aj'èra sama sèmi kristus dhu abhu j'aj'èra kahèi. dènge j'ara ne, èèna na d'ara miu asa karej'e-karae ropa dhèu aa'i-aa'i ladhe rèdhi dadedha kristus.

source_text: if ye be despised for the name of christ, ye shall be blessed; for that that is of the honour, and of the glory, and of the virtue of god, and the spirit that is his, shall rest on you.
target_text: ropa dhèu pahahe miu, lula pa'èki dènge kristus, miu oto, lula dadedha roh lamatua pa'èra miu.

source_text: but no man of you suffer as a manslayer, either a thief, either curser, either a desirer of other men's goods or things;
target_text: te ngaa ladhe miu abhu j'aj'èra, na, baku lula miu pamadhe dhèu, do, dhèu mana'u, dhèu bhelu-katub'a, do, dhèu dhu d'èi soro iisi asa lii langu dhèu.

source_text: but if he suffer as a christian man, shame he not, but glorify he god in this name.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe dhèu pasae j'aj'èra lula j'aj'i dhèu unu kristus, nèngu baku makae. hua iia risi rèngu koa-kio ama lamatua, lula rèngu j'aj'i dhèu kristen.

source_text: for time is, that doom begin at god's house; and if it begin first at us, what end shall be of them, that believe not to the gospel?
target_text: lod'o d'ai le ho dhèu lasi asa madha ama lamatua. na parisa uuru mamuri dhèu-dhèu unu na. de pangee paie-iie! ladhe na mulai nèti èdhi dhèu kristen, na, tasa mera mia dènge rèngu dhu ro'o boe sèmi lii lolo be'a na? tatu hahuku rèngu bia risi hari!

source_text: and if a just man scarcely shall be saved, where shall the unfaithful man and the sinner appear?
target_text: te abhu dhu suri ètu sasuri mola-mèci lamatua, na, ladhe dhèu dhu mamuri mola oe abhu boe mamuri sa hèi, tasamia hari dènge rèngu dhu ro'o boe pahae lamatua? aa tasamia hari dènge dhèu dhu mamuri ètu d'ara sasala?

source_text: therefore and they that suffer by the will of god, betake their souls in good deeds to the faithful maker of nought.
target_text: de ladhe ama lamatua soro tèke dhèu unu na abhu susa madhutu dad'èi lamatua, na, rèngu bisa lèka, peka na, èèna na nèngu j'aga si kahèi. te nèngu ka paj'aj'i si. nèngu kahèi tao madhutu ngaa dhu na peka le. lula nèngu j'aga si sèmi èèna, nèti èèna ka rèngu bisa tao taruu j'ara dhu lèke.

source_text: therefore i, an even-elder man, and a witness of christ's passions, which also am a communer of that glory, that shall be showed in time to come; beseech the elder men, that be among you,
target_text: ja'a ne, ca dhèu kètu kahèi. uru èèna, lod'o kristus pasae j'aj'èra na, ja'a kèdhi unu ku dènge musi madha ja'a. aa bèli-camèd'a ladhe dhèu aa'i-aa'i laladhe rèdhi dadedha ama lamatua, ja'a kahèi neo kèdhi dènge musi madha ku. de ja'a neo holo kètu juma'at dhu leo sèra, na:

source_text: feed ye the flock of god, that is among you, and purvey ye, not as constrained, but willfully, by god; not for love of foul winning, but willfully,
target_text: miu nuka sèmi dhèu madhenga badha dhu ladhe-leru kahib'i-kalèbho ra. de miu hud'i leru paie-iie dhèu dhu lamatua pangèd'u asa miu. uri si paie-iie. mage miu ladhe-leru si, lula dhoka sasab'a miu di, te ngaa lula miu d'èi tao sèmi èèna. uli si madhutu dad'èi lamatua. baku d'èi tenge oto, te ngaa sab'a dènge karej'e ho soru-bara dhèu unu lamatua.

source_text: neither as having lordship in the clergy, but that ye be made ensample to the flock, of will or by intent.
target_text: baku paredha leli, ho pabia dhèu dhu lamatua hia miu ladhe-leru si. te ngaa miu hud'i j'aj'i conto dhu be'a, dhu bisa paj'uj'u j'ara hia rèngu.

source_text: and when the prince of shepherds shall appear, ye shall receive the crown of glory, that may never fade.
target_text: yesus, nuka sèmi kètu nèti dhèu madhenga badha. bèli-camèd'a ladhe na lèpa hari mai, ama lamatua neo b'ae rui-j'aj'èra miu, lula miu uri dhèu miu dènge be'a. upa ne, bisa boe ele iie, te ngaa taha taa-taa d'ai mia-mia.

source_text: also, ye young men, be ye subject to elder men, and all show ye together meekness; for the lord withstandeth proud men, but he giveth grace to meek men.
target_text: ana ngèru aa'i-aa'i! miu kahèi hud'i nanene ku kètu juma'at sèra. miu aa'i-aa'i mi baku padedha iisi. te ètu sasuri mola-mèci lamatua, dhu suri, peka na, lamatua lab'a dhèu dhu padedha iisi, te ngaa nèngu d'èi pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi dhèu dhu pahaha iisi.

source_text: therefore be ye meeked under the mighty hand of god, that he raise you in the time or in the day of visitation,
target_text: nèti èèna ka, miu hud'i sanèd'e ku koasa lamatua, sèna ka miu baku pamone-pabhèni. hèia ropa d'ai lod'o na, lamatua koa-kad'iri miu.

source_text: and cast ye all your busyness into him, for to him is care of you.
target_text: pataleo d'ara miu, sèna ka lamatua uri j'ara aa'i-aa'i dhu tao miu madha'u. te nèngu ka dhu haduli miu.

source_text: be ye sober, and wake ye, for your adversary, the devil, as a roaring lion goeth about, seeking whom he shall devour.
target_text: mage-mage! pake ngangee madhera. aa j'aga paie-iie, te musu èdhi, nuka dhèu aae nidhu, neo palaho miu. neo dhèle aa'i miu, nuka sèmi singa dhu manganga, dhu patangi-tenge badha neo na'a.

source_text: whom against-stand ye, strong in the faith, witting that the same passion is made to that brotherhood of you, that is in the world.
target_text: te ngaa baku madha'u. miu hud'i lab'a dhèu aae nidhu èèna. miu hud'i pa'èra lalèka miu mi lamatua kahèi. te miu me'a le, na, a'ari miu dhèu parcaya buli mia-mia ètu rai-haha ne, abhu sasusa sama sèmi miu kahèi.

source_text: and god of all grace, that called you into his everlasting glory, you suffering a little in christ jesus, he shall perform, and shall confirm, and shall make firm.
target_text: te ngaa sanèd'e, te ama lamatua d'èi pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi èdhi kahèi. nèngu ka dhu paroa le miu, sèna ka j'aj'i dhèu unu na, lula miu sèmi mere le kristus. nèti èèna ka, nèngu neo ded'e miu padedha-dedha, sèna ka miu bisa mamuri taruu dènge nèngu. te ngaa ladhe miu abhu le j'aj'èra dhoka ètu d'ara ciki oo'e di ètu rai-haha ne, lamatua neo pabe'a hari miu. na neo pa'èra miu, aa tao miu bisa taha. nèngu pamadhèdi miu kahèi mi dedha fanderen dhu èra.

source_text: to him be glory and lordship, into worlds of worlds. amen.
target_text: ji'i manèngi sèna ka lamatua nèd'u koasa aa'i-aa'i toke d'ai mia-mia. lèke tare'a!

source_text: by silvanus, a faithful brother to you as i deem, i wrote shortly; beseeching, and witnessing that this is the very grace of god, in which ye stand.
target_text: silas ka dhu soru-bara ja'a ho suri sasuri dhu bab'a ne. nèngu ne, a'ari èdhi dhèu parcaya, aa ai g'ana ja'a. ja'a holo-nori miu sèna ka miu taha pa'èra, te lamatua d'èi pad'elo d'ara hua iia na taruu mi èdhi. de miu hud'i èra ku, sèna ka baku hari kabodho.

source_text: the church that is gathered in babylon, and marcus, my son, greeteth you well.
target_text: dhèu parcaya dhu pakaboko ètu kota babel hia miu lii maho'o. ama lamatua hag'e nare le rèngu, sama sèmi na pili miu. ana ja'a markus pa'adhu lii maho'o kahèi.

source_text: greet ye well together in holy kiss. grace be to you all that be in christ. amen.
target_text: ladhe miu paraga, na, pa'uu èci dènge èci ho pad'elo pasue miu. ja'a d'èi ladhe miu aa'i-aa'i mi dhu parcaya kristus bisa mamuri dame dènge mera-milu. saloom, petrus
