source_text: and to the angel of the church of ephesus write thou, these things saith he, that holdeth the seven stars in his right hand, which walketh in the middle or in the midst of the seven golden candlesticks.
target_text: èle èèna ka, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a èèna paredha ja'a, aku nèngu na, yohanis, èu suri more ku sasuri èci. isi na sèmi ne'e: ‘mi juma'at ètu kota epesus: sasuri ne, nèti ja'a, yesus. ja'a ka dhu kèd'u pidhu hua-hètu ètu ai g'ana ja'a. ja'a dhu kako palème kahèi laladhe pidhu labhu hualaa se cue-cue. nanene paie lii padhai ja'a.

source_text: i know thy works, and thy travail or thy toil, and thy patience, and that thou mayest not suffer evil men; and thou hast assayed them that say that they be apostles, and be not, and thou hast found them liars;
target_text: ja'a ladhe kèdhi le, j'ara mamuri miu ètu kota epesus, peka na, miu sab'a bia hia lamatua. ladhe abhu dhèu bhelu ètu talora aae miu, miu soro tèke boe ne. ladhe dhèu mai dadugu, peka na, nèngu dhèu pajuu-paleha lamatua, miu parisa paie-iie mamuri na, sèna ka me'a na, nèngu ne dhèu kapod'e-kabèli. hèia miu tule eele, aa nanene boe ne.

source_text: and thou hast patience, and thou hast suffered or sustained for my name, and failedest not.
target_text: masi ka dhèu paj'èra miu lula miu parcaya ja'a, te ngaa miu taha taruu aa hari boe ciki sa.

source_text: but i have against thee a few things, that thou hast left thy first charity.
target_text: te ngaa ja'a ladhe, na, miu manahu ètu ca madha j'ara. lula uru èèna, lod'o miu hiu-hiu parcaya ja'a, miu mamuri pasue èci dènge èci. te ngaa limuri ne, miu sèmi heka èèna.

source_text: therefore be thou mindful from whence thou hast fallen, and do penance, and do the first works; or else, i shall come soon to thee, and i shall move thy candlestick from his place, but thou do penance.
target_text: de miu hud'i sanèd'e hari ku j'ara uru èèna! te limuri ne, miu pakaj'èu ae nèti j'ara uru èèna. de miu ae eele ka nèti sasala miu se'e, sèna ka mi pasue hari sèmi uru èèna. te aad'o na, bèli-camèd'a ja'a mai kore hari labhu hualaa èèna nèti miu.

source_text: but thou hast this good thing, that thou hatedest the deeds of nicolaitans, which also i hate.
target_text: te ngaa d'ara ja'a ako karej'e, lula miu tule eele lii aj'a-nori nèti nikolai, dhu ana madhutu na sèra tao madhutu. ja'a tule eele kahèi tatao kapod'e-kabèli ra sèra.

source_text: he that hath ears, hear he, what the spirit saith to the churches. to him that overcometh, i shall give to eat of the tree of life, that is in the paradise of my god.
target_text: nanene paie-iie, ngaa dhu roh lamatua neo peka dènge juma'at na sèra. dhèu cee dhu taha pa'èra madhutu ja'a toke na madhe, pe ja'a soro tèke na'a hua aj'u ètu d'ara talora oka ama lamatua. te dhèu dhu na'a hua aj'u èèna, nèngu abhu mamuri taa-taa dènge lamatua. '

source_text: and to the angel of the church of smyrna write thou, these things saith the first and the last, that was dead, and liveth.
target_text: èle èèna ka, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a èèna, tuhu hari lii na, aku nèngu na, yohanis, èu suri more hari ku sasuri leo èci, dhu isi na sèmi ne'e: ‘mi juma'at ètu kota smirna: sasuri ne, nèti ja'a, yesus. aa'i-aa'i ra j'aj'i nèti ja'a, karèi nèti uru ka toke d'ai èle. uru èèna mema ja'a madhe, te ngaa limuri ne, ja'a mamuri hari le. de miu nanene lii padhai ja'a ne.

source_text: i know thy tribulation, and thy poverty, but thou art rich; and thou art blasphemed of them, that say, that they be jews, and be not, but be the synagogue of satan.
target_text: ja'a ke'a le j'aj'èra mamuri miu ètu kota smirna. masi ka ètu madha dhèu rai-haha, miu unu aad'o, te ngaa ètu madha lamatua miu kaja. abhu dhèu dhu mangaku, na, rèngu sèra dhèu unu lamatua, te ngaa padhai lii pakarehe kolongara miu. te ngaa madhutu iia-iia na, rèngu se unu boe lamatua. rèngu madhutu dhoka dhèu aae nidhu di.

source_text: dread thou nothing of these things, which thou shalt suffer. lo! the devil shall send some of you into prison, that ye be tempted or ye be proved; and ye shall have tribulation ten days. be thou faithful to the death, and i shall give to thee a crown of life.
target_text: de nanene paie-iie. miu baku madha'u, ladhe abhu j'aj'èra era. sad'i miu me'a, na, dhèu aae nidhu neo tenge dhèu ho kèpe miu cahag'e, sèna ka pamaso asa d'ara bèdho d'ai canguru lod'o. dad'èi na, sèna ka miu rai tèke eele ja'a. masi ka nidhu neo pamadhe miu èèna ka, te ngaa miu baku bhèlu ja'a kahèi. te dhèu cee dhu taha madhutu ja'a toke madhe, bèli-camèd'a ja'a pala-bagi ne mamuri, sèna ka na mamuri taa-taa dènge ja'a.

source_text: he that hath ears, hear he, what the spirit saith to the churches. he that overcometh, shall not be hurt of the second death.
target_text: nanene paie-iie, ngaa dhu roh lamatua neo peka dènge juma'at na sèra. dhèu cee dhu madhutu ja'a toke madhe, èèna na nèngu abhu boe j'aj'èra ètu d'ara dhasi ai dhu heo robhe-robhe kura boe ciki sa èèna. dènge sèmi ne'e, nèngu abhu boe mamadhe ka dua hari. '

source_text: and to the angel of the church of pergamum, write thou, these things saith he, that hath the sword sharp on either side or on each side.
target_text: hèia dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne, tuhu hari lii padhai na, peka na, yohanis, èu suri more hari ku sasuri leo èci, dhu peka sèmi ne'e ka: ‘mi juma'at ètu kota pergamus: sasuri ne, nèti ja'a, yesus. ja'a ka dhu kèd'u samala rèka dua dhu madèka. nanene lii padhai ja'a.

source_text: i know where thou dwellest, where the seat of satan is; and thou holdest my name, and deniedest not my faith. and in those days was antipas, my faithful witness, that was slain at you, where satan dwelleth.
target_text: ja'a ke'a mèu le kota pergamus miu èèna. te, dhu nèd'u paredha ètu èèna, nuka dhèu aae nidhu. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa miu kèpe pa'èra kolongara ja'a, aa parcaya taruu ja'a. uru èèna abhu dhèu ja'a èci ètu èèna, ngara na antipas. nèngu aj'a lèke mola-mola j'ara mamuri ja'a, te ngaa ra pamadhe ne. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa miu pasili boe ja'a.

source_text: but i have against thee a few things; for thou hast there men holding the teaching of balaam, which taught balak to send cause of stumbling before the sons of israel, to eat of sacrifices of idols, and to do fornication;
target_text: te ngaa ja'a ladhe, na, miu manahu ètu ca j'ara dua j'ara. abhu nèti miu pèri-pèri dhèu dhu d'èi madhutu lii aj'a-nori nèti balaam. uru èèna balaam aj'a balak ho kakèj'i dhèu isra'el, toke ra sisu dad'èi lamatua. balak kakèj'i dhèu isra'el sèra, ho pae'a dènge ra'a-rinu mèdha sogo-tagu, aa ra tao j'ara makae dènge dhèu dhu j'aj'i boe dhèu èmu-kamali ra.

source_text: so also thou hast men holding the teaching of nicolaitans.
target_text: abhu kahèi pèri-pèri dhèu nèti miu dhu madhutu lii aj'a-nori nèti nikolai.

source_text: also do thou penance; if anything less, i shall come soon to thee, and i shall fight with them with the sword of my mouth.
target_text: de miu hud'i loe ku nèti sasala-sasigo miu sèra. ladhe aad'o, na, nèbhu heka ja'a dhiu pad'ui miu dènge lii sakaa dhu nuka sèmi pare dènge samala.

source_text: he that hath ears, hear he, what the spirit saith to the churches. to him that overcometh i shall give angel meat hid or manna; and i shall give to him a white stone, and in the stone a new name written, which no man knoweth, but he that taketh.
target_text: nanene paie-iie, ngaa dhu roh lamatua peka dènge juma'at na. dhèu cee ka dhu taha madhutu ja'a toke madhe, pe ja'a hia ne na'a roti manna nèti sorga dhu tèke paie iie ne. pe ja'a pangèd'u ne hèi, hadhu pudhi cue dhu suri tèke ngara hiu na. dhodhoka nèngu mesa na di dhu ne'a ngara na; dhèu leo re'a boe. '

source_text: and to the angel of the church of thyatira write thou, these things saith the son of god, that hath eyes as flame of fire, and his feet like latten.
target_text: ka dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a èèna, tuhu hari lii padhai na, peka na, yohanis, èu suri more hari ku sasuri leo èci, dhu peka sèmi ne'e ka: ‘mi juma'at ètu kota tiatira: sasuri ne nèti ja'a, yesus, nuka ana ama lamatua. musi madha ja'a heo lo'a-lo'a sèmi ai, aa haga ja'a mea gèu-gèu sèmi tabaga ètu d'ara ai. nanene ku lii padhai ja'a.

source_text: i know thy works, and faith, and charity, and thy service, and thy patience, and thy last works more than the former.
target_text: ja'a kèdhi le mamuri miu. miu sue ja'a tare'a, aa parcaya èra ja'a kahèi. miu madhutu taruu lii paredha ja'a ho lalau-lalo'o dhèu. masi ka dhèu paj'èra miu, te ngaa miu taha taruu. ja'a ke'a kahèi, limuri ne miu sab'a bia risi hari hia ja'a.

source_text: but i have against thee a few things; for thou sufferest the woman jezebel, which saith that she is a prophetess, to teach and deceive my servants, to do lechery, and to eat of things offered to idols.
target_text: te ngaa miu manahu ètu ca j'ara: miu sèmi mere dènge be'a, bhèni dhu ngara na isabel, dhu padedha iisi peka na, nèngu èèna dhèu nèti lii padhai lamatua. ka miu hud'i na sène, aj'a j'ara-j'ara dhu lèke boe mi dhèu ja'a. lula lii a'aj'a na dhu kapod'e-kabèli èèna ka, dhèu ja'a tao j'ara karehe dènge dhèu dhu j'aj'i boe dhèu èmu-kamali ra, aa ra'a nganga'a sogo-tagu.

source_text: and i gave to her time, that she should do penance, and she would not do penance of her fornication.
target_text: ja'a dhu kai le bhèni èèna pèri-pèri hari le, sèna ka ele-ho'a nèti sasala na, te ngaa na d'èi boe.

source_text: and lo! i send her into a bed, and they that do lechery with her shall be in most tribulation, but they do penance of her works.
target_text: de ladhe paie-iie. te ja'a pama'ète kore le, ho hia ne lèke papèd'a èci, toke na bisa boe puru nèti era j'unu na. sèmi èèna kahèi dènge rèngu dhu j'unu pa'èci dènge ne. ladhe rèngu tèke eele boe bhèni aapa ne, nèbhu boe ja'a huku si kahèi.

source_text: and i shall slay her sons into death, and all churches shall know, that i am searching reins and hearts; and i shall give to each man of you after his works.
target_text: èèna na ja'a pamadhe aa'i ana-ana nèti bhèni aapa ne. dènge j'ara ne'e, dhèu-dhèu parcaya sèra re'a, na, ja'a ne ke'a aa'i d'ara dhèu. pe ja'a b'ala miu madhutu tatao dhu miu ad'u-ue.

source_text: and i say to you, and to others that be at thyatira, whoever have not this teaching, and that knew not the highness of satan, how they say, i shall not send on you another charge;
target_text: te ngaa miu cahag'e ètu tiatira sèra, dhu madhutu boe lii a'aj'a bhèni aapa ne. miu tule eele le a'aj'a dhu pahuni èèna, dhu ra peka na, ‘ilmu maroga nèti dhèu aae nidhu'. nèti èèna ka, ja'a parluu heka kai miu,

source_text: nevertheless hold ye that that ye have, till i come.
target_text: sad'i miu kèpe pa'èra-èra lalèka miu mi dedha ja'a, toke ja'a lèpa hari mai.

source_text: and to him that shall overcome, and that shall keep till into the end my works, i shall give power on folks, and he shall govern them in an iron rod; and they shall be broken altogether, as a vessel of a potter, as also i received of my father; and i shall give to him a morrow star.
target_text: dhèu cee dhu taha madhutu ja'a toke madhe, pe ja'a hia ne koasa. koasa èèna kapai, nuka sèmi koasa dhu ja'a abhu nèti ama ku, ho paredha dhèu ètu rai-haha ne dènge tatea bèsi. ladhe abhu dhu lab'a ne, pe na ab'o palaho si, nuka sèmi dhèu pamae èru rai. èèna na, ja'a hia miu hua-hètu dhimu kahèi.

source_text: he that hath ears, hear he, what the spirit saith to the churches.
target_text: nanene paie-iie, ngaa dhu roh lamatua neo peka dènge juma'at na sèra. '

source_text: and to the angel of the church of sardis write thou, these things saith he, that hath the seven spirits of god, and the seven stars. i know thy works, for thou hast a name, that thou livest, and thou art dead.
target_text: hèia dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne lii hari dènge ja'a, aku nèngu na, èu suri more hari ku sasuri leo èci, dhu isi na sèmi ne'e: ‘mi juma'at ètu kota sardis: sasuri ne, nèti ja'a, yesus. roh ama lamatua ètu ja'a. aa roh ne, pidhu rupa. ja'a dhu kèpe kahèi pidhu hua-hètu ètu d'ara ai ja'a. nanene lii padhai ja'a. ja'a ke'a le tatao miu ètu sardis. dhèu peka, na, miu se mamuri madhutu dad'èi ja'a, te ngaa miu nuka sèmi samanga aad'o ètu kètu.

source_text: be thou waking, and confirm thou other things, that were to dying; for i find not thy works full before my god.
target_text: de kèd'i ka! pa'èra parcaya miu dhu oe èle na. te ja'a dhu parisa le ngaa dhu miu sab'a, abhu boe dhu mèci ètu madha ama lamatua.

source_text: therefore have thou in mind, how thou receivedest, and heardest; and keep, and do penance. therefore if thou wake not, i shall come as a night thief to thee, and thou shalt not know in what hour i shall come to thee.
target_text: de baku bhèlu lii aj'a-nori dhu mola, dhu miu nanene aa abhu nèti uru èèna. madhutu paie-iie dad'èi ama lamatua, aa tèke eele sasala-sasigo miu sèra. ladhe miu kèd'i malai boe, ho mi tao madhutu j'ara sèra, cag'ag'a laa ja'a dhiu nuka sèmi dhèu mana'u dhu miu me'a mere boe.

source_text: but thou hast a few names in sardis, which have not defouled their clothes; and they shall walk with me in white clothes, for they be worthy.
target_text: te ngaa abhu cahag'e era nèti miu ètu sardis dhu mamuri mola, nuka sèmi dhèu dhu pakaj'alu boe mèdha-papake ra. lula miu mamuri mola, ka miu nia kako palere-lere dènge ja'a, pake mèdha-papake pudhi.

source_text: he that overcometh, shall be clothed thus with white clothes; and i shall not do away his name from the book of life, and i shall acknowledge his name before my father, and before his angels.
target_text: dhèu cee dhu taha madhutu ja'a toke madhe, bèli-camèd'a nèngu pake mèdha-papake pudhi kahèi. bèli-camèd'a ja'a roso eele boe ngara na nèti d'ara sasuri dhu suri ngara dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu èèna na mamuri taa-taa dènge lamatua. èèna na ja'a mangaku ne ètu madha ama ku, dènge ètu madha ana pajuu ama ku ètu sorga, peka na, nèngu ne dhèu ja'a.

source_text: he that hath ears, hear he, what the spirit saith to the churches.
target_text: nanene paie-iie, ngaa dhu roh lamatua peka dènge juma'at na sèra. '

source_text: and to the angel of the church of philadelphia write thou, these things saith the holy and true, that hath the key of david; which openeth, and no man closeth, he closeth, and no man openeth.
target_text: ka dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne lii hari, peka na, yohanis, èu hud'i suri more hari ku sasuri leo èci, dhu lii na sèmi ne'e ka: ‘mi juma'at ètu kota piladelfia: sasuri ne nèti ja'a, yesus. ja'a dhu mola-mèci dènge dhu lèke tare'a. ja'a ka dhu kèd'u gagoe dhèu aae daud. ladhe ja'a bhoke kore babèdho, abhu boe ca dhèu sa bisa bèdho hari. ladhe ja'a bèdho kore, abhu boe ca dhèu sa bisa bhoke.

source_text: i know thy works, and lo! i gave before thee a door opened, which no man may close; for thou hast a little virtue, and hast kept my word, and deniedest not my name.
target_text: ja'a ke'a aa'i ngaa dhu miu tao. ja'a ke'a kahèi, pangaru miu kapai boe. masi ka sèmi èèna, miu pasili boe ja'a, aa madhutu taruu lii a'aj'a ja'a. sanèd'e paie, te ja'a dhu conge le babèdho hia miu, de dhèu èci sa bisa boe bèdho hari.

source_text: lo! i shall give to thee of the synagogue of satan, which say that they be jews, and be not, but lie. lo! i shall make them, that they come, and worship before thy feet; and they shall know, that i loved thee,
target_text: nanene paie-iie! te abhu dhèu leko-monya dhu peka na, rèngu sèra dhèu unu lamatua. te ngaa rèngu sèra, dhèu kapod'e-kabèli dhu madhutu dhèu aae nidhu. pe me'a unu mi! ja'a tao si, sèna ka ra dhiu patitu kètu urutuu ètu madha miu, aa ra mangaku na, ja'a tare'a-re'a sue miu.

source_text: for thou keptest the word of my patience. and i shall keep thee from the hour of temptation, that is to coming or to come into all the world, to tempt men that dwell in earth.
target_text: lula miu madhutu le paredha ja'a, ka miu taha madhutu ja'a, nèti èèna ka, ja'a bhabhae miu nèti j'aj'èra dhu lamatua neo hia mai, ho sèku dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne.

source_text: lo! i come soon; hold thou that that thou hast, that no man take thy crown.
target_text: nèbhu heka, ja'a dhiu. de miu kèpe pa'èra-èra lii aj'a-nori ja'a, dhu miu abhu le karèi nèti uru ka. te mage dhoka abhu dhu parame rare rui-j'aj'èra dhu lamatua neo b'ala hia miu.

source_text: and him that shall overcome, i shall make a pillar in the temple of my god, and he shall no more go out; and i shall write on him the name of my god, and the name of the city of my god, of the new jerusalem, that cometh down from heaven of my god, and my new name.
target_text: dhèu cee ka dhu taha madhutu ja'a toke madhe, bèli-camèd'a nèngu pea taruu dènge lamatua, sama sèmi agarii aae dhu titu mèno ètu d'ara èmu ama lamatua. pe ja'a suri ngara lamatua ja'a, dènge ngara kota lamatua ètu ngi'u dhèu ne. kota èèna ra pangare, na, ‘yerusalem hiu', dhu bèli-camèd'a lamatua papuru mai nèti sorga. aa èèna na, ja'a suri kahèi ngara hiu ja'a mi ngi'u dhèu ne.

source_text: he that hath ears, hear he, what the spirit saith to the churches.
target_text: nanene paie-iie, ngaa dhu roh ama lamatua peka mi juma'at na sèra. '

source_text: and to the angel of the church of laodicea write thou, these things saith amen, the faithful witness and true, which is beginning of god's creature.
target_text: èle ka, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne, tuhu hari lii, peka na, yohanis, èu hud'i suri more ku sasuri dhu limuri tèka, dhu isi na sèmi ne'e ka: ‘mi juma'at ètu kota laodikia: sasuri ne nèti ja'a, yesus, dhu dhèu paroa na, ‘tare'a sèmi èèna'. ja'a ne loe boe padhai lii dènge mola lii holo-nori ama lamatua. dènge aa'i-aa'i dhu lamatua ad'u-ue sèra, j'aj'aj'i ra nèti ja'a.

source_text: i know thy works, for neither thou art cold, neither thou art hot; i would that thou were cold, either hot;
target_text: ja'a ladhe kèdhi le tatao miu ètu laodikia. te ngaa miu sèmi ngaa mèro? ! pana aad'o, aa pacuhi aad'o kahèi. ladhe pana, na, hud'i tare'a-re'a pana! aa ladhe pacuhi, na, hud'i tare'a-re'a pacuhi!

source_text: but for thou art lukewarm, and neither cold, neither hot, i shall begin to cast or to vomit thee out of my mouth.
target_text: te ngaa, lula d'ara miu kajari, bèli-camèd'a ja'a sabhuu eele miu nèti d'ara hèb'a ja'a, sama sèmi dhèu sabhuu ilu.

source_text: for thou sayest, that i am rich, and full of goods, and have need of nothing; and thou knowest not, that thou art a wretch, and wretchful or wretched, and poor, and blind, and naked.
target_text: miu padhai lii padedha iisi, peka na, ‘ji'i se, kaja-su'i. ji'i mamuri be'a, kura boe ngaa-ngaa! ' te ngaa madhutu iia-iia na, d'ara miu dhu bèdhu le, ka me'a heka mia ka dhu be'a. nèti èèna ka, miu j'aj'i mi dhèu dhu dènge boe ngaa-ngaa, aa dhu dènge boe mèdha ètu ua mi.

source_text: i counsel thee to buy of me burnt gold, that thou be made rich, and be clothed with white clothes, that the confusion or the shame of thy nakedness be not seen; and anoint thine eyes with a collyrium, that is, a medicine for eyes, gathered of diverse herbs, that thou see.
target_text: de hua iia mai ho hèli mere poe-pai nèti ja'a, sèna ka miu tare'a-re'a j'aj'i dhèu kaja-su'i. aa hèli mere mèdha-papake pudhi, ho pahutu era makae mi. aa hèli mere kahèi èi na'i musi madha, sèna ka roso mi musi madha miu, ho mèdhi mèu hari.

source_text: i reprove, and chastise whom i love; therefore pursue thou good men, and do penance.
target_text: ladhe dhèu pasue ja'a tao sala, ja'a kai aa huku si, sèna ka ra j'aj'i be'a. de miu hud'i pamola d'ara mi, ho madhutu ja'a dènge d'ara kateme.

source_text: lo! i stand at the door, and knock; if any man heareth my voice, and openeth the gate to me, i shall enter to him, and sup with him, and he with me.
target_text: nanene paie-iie. te ja'a nuka titu ètu hèb'a èmu ne, aa ja'a paroa taruu ho neo maso asa d'ara èmu. ladhe dhèu cee dhu tadèngi lii ja'a, ho na conge èmu, ja'a dhiu asa d'ara, sèna ka madhèdi ta'a-tinu pa'èci.

source_text: and i shall give to him that shall overcome, to sit with me in my throne, as also i overcame, and sat with my father in his throne.
target_text: dhèu cee dhu taha madhutu ja'a toke madhe, bèli-camèd'a ja'a pangèd'u ne hak, ho nèd'u paredha bera-bera dènge ja'a. te ja'a taha le madhutu ama ku kahèi, nèti èèna ka limuri ne ja'a kèd'u paredha sama-sama dènge ne.

source_text: he that hath ears, hear he, what the spirit saith to the churches.
target_text: nanene paie-iie, ngaa dhu roh lamatua peka mi juma'at na sèra. '

source_text: after these things i saw, and lo! a door was opened in heaven. and the first voice that i heard, was as of a trump speaking with me, and said, go thou up hither, and i shall show to thee which things it behooveth to be done soon after these things.
target_text: ropa dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne, peka nare lii moa na mi pidhu juma'at sèra, hèia lamatua bhoke pad'elo dènge ja'a, ngaa-ngaa dhu leo hari. ètu d'ara ciki oo'e èèna kahèi, ja'a kèdhi babèdho èci dhu bhoke le tangare la'e asa sorga. ka ja'a tadèngi hari lii dhu mèdhu nèti dhèu deo na, nuka sèmi lii tiu tèbhe, peka na, mai ku! ca'e asa ne'e, sèna ka ja'a pad'elo dènge èu ngaa-ngaa dhu j'aj'i bèli-camèd'a.

source_text: and anon i was in spirit, and lo! a seat was set in heaven, and upon the seat one sitting.
target_text: lod'o èèna kahèi, roh lamatua ded'e nèti ja'a asa sorga. cag'ag'a laa, ja'a kèdhi kadera paredha èci, aa abhu dhu madhèdi ètu dedha.

source_text: and he that sat, was like the sight of a stone jasper, and to sardine; and a rainbow was in the compass of the seat, like the sight of emerald.
target_text: dhu madhèdi ètu kadera èèna heo mangèru dènge mea, èci èèna ka dènge hadhu kale'e dhu kab'ua, dhu ra peka na, yaspis dènge sardius. abhu kahèi saroo èci dhu reo nare kadera paredha na. saroo ne heo na mangèru sama sèmi hadhu kale'e samrud.

source_text: and in the compass of the seat were four and twenty small seats; and above or upon the thrones four and twenty elder men sitting, covered about with white clothes, and in the heads of them golden crowns.
target_text: ètu èèna kahèi, abhu dua nguru èpa kadera paredha iiki, dhu reo rare kadera paredha dhu ètu talora aae èèna. ètu dedha kadera paredha iiki se'e, madhèdi katua dua nguru èpa dhèu. aa'i-aa'i ra pake mèdha-papake pudhi, dènge solo paredha dhu tao nèti hualaa.

source_text: and lightnings, and voices, and thunderings came out of the throne; and seven lamps burning before the throne, which be the seven spirits of god.
target_text: nèti kadera paredha ètu talora aae èèna, abhu bela dhu kacèb'a, dènge d'oro dhu lii mèdhu patuu ma'èta boe. abhu kahèi ob'o pidhu bua dhu heo ètu madha kadera paredha èèna. rèngu se, nuka sèmi roh ama lamatua dhu pidhu rupa.

source_text: and before the seat as a sea of glass, like crystal, and in the middle of the seat, and in the compass of the seat, were four beasts, full of eyes before and behind.
target_text: ètu madha kadera paredha ne, ja'a kèdhi èi, oe sèmi dhasi dhu mèu aadha-aadha nuka sèmi tèru. hèia ja'a kèdhi badha èpa ngi'u dhu dhae kèdhi mèka ciki sa rai-reo kadera èèna. ngi'u ra nèti madha toke kabodho, pènu dènge musi madha. badha se'e ka dhu lalau-lalo'o lamatua.

source_text: and the first beast like a lion; and the second beast like a calf; and the third beast having a face as of a man; and the fourth beast like an eagle flying.
target_text: badha ka èci, rèhu na sèmi singa. ka dua, rèhu na sèmi sapi mone. ka tèlu, rèhu na sèmi dhèu. aa ka èpa, rèhu na nuka sèmi manea luji dhu lela.

source_text: and the four beasts had each of them six wings; and all about and within they were full of eyes; and they had not rest day and night, saying, holy, holy, holy, the lord god almighty, that was, and that is, and that is to coming or is to come.
target_text: badha èpa ngi'u se, ci'u-ci'u ka dhu dènge èla ra, èna. re li'u dènge re d'ara èla se, pènu dènge musi madha kahèi. mèu-mèda, badha se loe boe sod'a, peka na, ji'i koa-kio kolongara ama lamatua! ji'i ded'e padedha-dedha kolongara lamatua! lamatua èèna, dhu mola-mèci risi eele! koasa lamatua dhu kapai risi eele. lamatua èèna karèi nèti uru ka mai. lamatua dhu deo ne'e ne. aa lamatua dhu taa-taa toke d'ai mia-mia la'e!

source_text: and when those four beasts gave glory, and honour, and blessing to him that sat on the throne, that liveth into worlds of worlds,
target_text: dènge ra sod'a sèmi èèna, rèngu koa-kio dènge pakab'ua ama lamatua, aa ra manèngi makasi mi nèngu kahèi, lula nèngu ka dhu madhèdi ètu dedha kadera paredha èèna, aa nèngu ka dhu taa-taa toke d'ai mia-mia. ropa rèngu sod'a,

source_text: the four and twenty elder men fell down before him that sat on the throne, and worshipped him that liveth into worlds of worlds. and they cast their crowns before the throne, and said,
target_text: hèia dua nguru èpa katua sèra pabèbha iisi ra, ka patitu kètu urutuu ètu madha ama lamatua, dhu madhèdi ètu kadera paredha èèna. katua se bhoke eele solo paredha ra, ka ra tèke mi madha kadera paredha èèna, ho pahaha iisi mi nèngu dhu mamuri taa-taa dènge boe too-lane. èle ka, ra koa-kio ne, peka na,

source_text: thou, lord our god, art worthy to take glory, and honour, and virtue; for thou madest of nought all things, and for thy will those were, and be made of nought.
target_text: ooo, ama lamatua! ji'i koa-kio kolongara lamatua! ji'i ded'e padedha-dedha kolongara lamatua. lamatua ne, kètu ji'i. lamatua ne, ama lamatua ji'i! lamatua ka dhu nia sèmi more koa-kio ji'i. lamatua ka dhu pantas sèmi lii pakab'ua ji'i. lula lamatua ka dhu koasa kapai risi eele. aa lamatua ka dhu dedha risi eele. lamatua ka dhu paj'aj'i aa'i-aa'i. lamatua ka dhu hia mamuri aa'i-aa'i. aa'i-aa'i dhu tesa, j'aj'i, lula lamatua ka dhu ad'u-ue. aa'i-aa'i dhu mamuri, dènge a'ae, lula lamatua ka dhu hia.

source_text: and i saw in the right hand of the sitter on the throne, a book written within and without, and sealed with seven seals.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ja'a ladhe hari nèngu dhu madhèdi ètu dedha kadera paredha èèna. na kèpe dènge sasuri ca lulu ètu ai g'ana na. ètu lalulu sasuri ne, dhu suri le re li'u dènge d'ara. ra segel le ètu pidhu era.

source_text: and i saw a strong angel, preaching with a great voice, who is worthy to open the book, and to undo the seals of it?
target_text: hèia ja'a kèdhi ana pajuu nèti sorga ca dhèu dhu kapai aae. dènge lii aae, na karèi, dhèu cee ka dhu dènge hak ho bisa bhoke segel aa baca sasuri ne?

source_text: and none or no man in heaven, neither in earth, neither under earth, might open the book, neither behold it.
target_text: na karèi sèmi èèna ka, te ngaa ra abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu dènge hak, ho bisa bhoke dènge baca isi sasuri ne. masi ka ètu sorga, do ètu rai-haha ne, abhu boe èci sa hèi dhu dènge hak. ètu era dhèu madhe, aad'o kahèi.

source_text: and i wept much, for none or no man was found worthy to open the book, neither to see it.
target_text: ropa kèdhi sèmi èèna, hèia ja'a tangi d'ara pèd'a, lula abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu dènge hak ho bisa bhoke sasuri aa baca isi na.

source_text: and one of the elder men said to me, weep thou not; lo! a lion of the lineage of judah, the root of david, hath overcome to open the book, and to undo the seven seals of it.
target_text: èle ka, ca dhèu nèti dua nguru èpa katua se'e, lii dènge ja'a, peka na, baku tangi, we. te ana-èpu dhèu aae daud ca dhèu dhu kapai risi eele, dhu ra haji ngara na, ‘singa nèti udhu-rasa yahuda'. nèngu ka dhu ab'o palaho le aa'i-aa'i dhu bhelu-katub'a. de nèngu ka dhu dènge hak, sèna ka bisa bhoke segel aa baca isi sasuri ne.

source_text: and i saw, and lo! in the middle of the throne, and of the four beasts, and in the middle of the elder men, a lamb standing as slain, that had seven horns, and seven eyes, which be the seven spirits of god, sent into all the earth.
target_text: ropa tadèngi kore lii ne'e, ja'a kèdhi ana kahib'i-kalèbho dhu titu ètu talora aae badha èpa ngi'u sèra, dènge dua nguru èpa katua dhu madhèdi reo rare kadera paredha èèna. ana kahib'i-kalèbho ne, oe sèmi dhu ra pamadhe le. nèngu ne dènge tadhu pidhu, aa musi madha na pidhu kahèi. musi madha pidhu sèra, nuka sèmi roh na dhu dènge pidhu rupa, dhu na papuru mai palème rai-haha ne.

source_text: and he came, and took of the right hand of the sitter in the throne the book.
target_text: hèia ja'a ladhe kèdhi ana kalèbho ne, kako la'e asa madha nèngu dhu madhèdi ètu kadera paredha èèna, sèna ka sèmi nare lalulu sasuri nèti ai g'ana na.

source_text: and when he had opened the book, the four beasts and the four and twenty elder men fell down before the lamb; and had each of them harps, and golden vials full of odours, which be the prayers of saints.
target_text: ropa ana kalèbho ne sèmi nare sasuri, cag'ag'a laa badha èpa ngi'u, dènge dua nguru èpa katua sèra, pabèbha iisi ra, ka ra patitu kètu urutuu ètu madha na. rèngu se èci-èci ka kèpe mèdha lii sod'a oe sèmi sasadhu sa, dènge mago hualaa dhu isi dènge raa aj'u hèu mèngi, sèna ka ra pasèbu ho pahèu mèngi. raa aj'u hèu mèngi se'e ka, nuka lii manèngi-mangaj'i nèti dhèu unu lamatua.

source_text: and they sung a new song, and said, lord our god, thou art worthy to take the book, and to open the seals of it; for thou were slain, and again-boughtest us to god in thy blood, of each lineage, and tongue, and people, and nation;
target_text: ka rèngu aa'i-aa'i sod'a lii sod'a hiu èci, peka na: ana kalèbho ne'e ka dhu nia sèmi nare sasuri ne. ana kalèbho ne'e ka dhu dènge hak ho bisa bhoke segel sèra. te nèngu ne'e ka dhu ra pamadhe le. hèia ama lamatua pake raa na, ho sui nare dhèu nèti suku aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne, sèna ka dhèu cahag'e bisa j'aj'i dhèu unu lamatua. dènge sèmi èèna, dhèu rai-haha nèti lii aa'i-aa'i dènge rai aa'i-aa'i, bisa j'aj'i ana-ana lamatua.

source_text: and madest us a kingdom, and priests to our god; and we shall reign on earth.
target_text: ana kalèbho ne'e ka, oru nare si aa'i-aa'i, j'aj'i mi ca rae-ca nadha. ana kalèbho ne'e ka, hag'e nare si, j'aj'i dhèu sab'a lamatua. bèli-camèd'a rèngu se'e ka dhu rèd'u paredha ètu rai-haha. pe rèngu sab'a hia lamatua ètu rai-haha.

source_text: and i saw, and heard the voice of many angels all about the throne, and of the beasts, and of the elder men. and the number of them was thousands of thousands,
target_text: èle ka, ja'a boti kètu, hèia tadèngi lii mèdhu aae èci. hèia ja'a ladhe badha aae èpa ngi'u, dènge dua nguru èpa katua se, tabha hari dènge ana pajuu nèti sorga ae titu kèna. ana pajuu se d'ai juta-kehi.

source_text: saying with a great voice, the lamb that was slain, is worthy to take virtue, and godhead or divinity, and wisdom, and strength, and honour, and glory, and blessing.
target_text: rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra sod'a dènge lii mèdhu, peka na, ji'i ded'e padedha-dedha ana kalèbho dhu ra pamadhe le, lula nèngu ka dhu nia sèmi nare lii koa-kio ji'i! koasa na, kapai risi eele. kakaja na, lale-kabèle. ngangee lii padhai na, lèke mola-mola. a'èra na, èci sa risi boe. ji'i j'oka padedha-dedha kolongara na. ji'i pakab'ua ne. ji'i koa-kio ne.

source_text: and each creature that is in heaven, and that is on the earth, and under earth, and the sea, and which things be in it, i heard all saying, to him that sat in the throne, and to the lamb, blessing, and honour, and glory, and power, into worlds of worlds.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ja'a tadèngi hari lii sod'a dhu leo èci. lii sod'a ne, mai nèti aa'i-aa'i dhu mamuri ètu: sorga, dedha-liru, rai-haha, dènge d'ara dhasi. rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra sod'a. nèti era dhèu madhe kahèi, ra madhutu sod'a. aa'i-aa'i ra sod'a, peka na, ji'i koa-kio ama lamatua dhu madhèdi ètu dedha kadera paredha. ji'i nedhe padedha-dedha kahèi ana kalèbho ne. ji'i pakab'ua rèngu. ji'i pahaha iisi mi rèngu. lula rèngu ka dhu rèd'u paredha taa-taa! aa koasa ra dhu dènge boe too-lane!

source_text: and the four beasts said, amen. and the four and twenty elder men fell down on their faces, and worshipped him that liveth into worlds of worlds.
target_text: hèia èpa badha aae se, loe boe dènge lii dhaa, peka na, tare'a-re'a! lèke kèna! ka dua nguru èpa katua se'e pabèbha hari iisi ra, hèia ra patitu kètu urutuu, ho ra pahaha iisi mi ama lamatua, dènge ana kalèbho èèna.

source_text: and i saw, that the lamb had opened one of the seven seals. and i heard one of the four beasts saying, as a voice of thunder, come thou, and see.
target_text: èle ka, ja'a ladhe kèdhi ana kalèbho bhoke segel ka èci nèti lalulu sasuri èèna. hèia ja'a tadèngi, na, èci nèti èpa badha aae sèra parodha dènge lii mèdhu, nuka sèmi lii d'oro. na paredha, peka na, lamu dènge ka!

source_text: and i saw, and lo! a white horse; and he that sat on him had a bow, and a crown was given to him. and he went out overcoming, that he should overcome.
target_text: cag'ag'a laa, ja'a kèdhi jara pudhi ci'u. dhèu èci dhu manya'e pake dènge solo kapala musu, lula nèngu ka dhu segi taruu ètu d'ara pamusu. limuri ne na kèpe le kataki-hahusu, la'e ho segi hari musu na ètu rai-haha.

source_text: and when he had opened the second seal, i heard the second beast saying, come thou, and see.
target_text: hèia ana kalèbho ne bhoke segel ka dua. ka ja'a tadèngi badha aae ka dua paredha, peka na, lamu dènge ka!

source_text: and an other red horse went out; and it was given to him that sat on him, that he should take peace from the earth, and that they slay together themselves; and a great sword was given to him.
target_text: ka jara ci'u dhu mea gèu-gèu kalua mai. dhèu dhu manya'e jara ne sèmi nare samala aae èci. ra hia ne koasa ho la'e pamaruru ètu rai-haha, sèna ka dhèu rai-haha èci pamadhe èci.

source_text: and when he had opened the third seal, i heard the third beast saying, come thou, and see. and lo! a black horse; and he that sat on him had a balance in his hand.
target_text: ka ana kalèbho bhoke segel ka tèlu. hèia ja'a tadèngi lii paredha nèti badha aae ka tèlu, peka na, lamu dènge ka! kaca'a laa, ja'a kèdhi jara mèdhi ci'u. dhèu dhu manya'e jara ne nèd'u dènge kabatai cue, sèna ka tai nganga'a dhu oe kura kèna.

source_text: and i heard as a voice in the middle of the four beasts, saying, a bilibre, that is, a weight of two pounds, of wheat for a penny, and three bilibres of barley for a penny; and hurt thou not wine, nor oil.
target_text: hèia ja'a tadèngi hari, nuka sèmi lii èci mai nèti talora aae badha èpa ngi'u se, peka na, bèli-camèd'a, abhu manganga-mad'èu dhu kapai titu kèna ètu rai-haha. gaji dhèu ca lod'o nia dhoka hèli laludhu tèlu moo di; te ngaa neo laludhu be'a, abhu dhoka ca moo di. masi ka sèmi èèna, dhèu bisa boe pa'ele iie aj'u saitun dènge aj'u anggor ètu d'ara oka ra.

source_text: and when he had opened the fourth seal, i heard a voice of the fourth beast saying, come thou, and see.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ana kalèbho ne bhoke segel ka èpa. hèia ja'a tadèngi lii nèti badha aae ka èpa hia paredha, peka na, lamu dènge ka!

source_text: and lo! a pale horse; and the name was death to him that sat on him, and hell pursued him. and power was given to him on four parts of the earth, to slay with sword, and with hunger, and with death, and with beasts of the earth.
target_text: kaca'a laa, ja'a ladhe kèdhi jara ci'u dhu rèu na sanama karara. dhèu dhu manya'e jara ne, ngara na ‘mamadhe'. aa abhu dhu madhutu ne re limuri, ngara na ‘era pea samanga dhèu madhe'. rèngu dua ra abhu koasa ho lasi pamadhe dhèu ètu rai-haha pake samala, tèu manganga-madèu, papèd'a-tarègu, dènge pasoku badha hui dhu bhelu. ladhe ige aa'i dhèu dhu madhe, aa'i-aa'i ra ca kaboko nèti èpa kaboko nèti dhèu dhu pea ètu rai-haha.

source_text: and when he had opened the fifth seal, i saw under the altar the souls of men slain for the word of god, and for the witnessing that they had.
target_text: hèia ana kalèbho ne bhoke segel ka lèmi. ka ja'a kèdhi samanga dhèu dhu ra pamadhe uru sèra ètu ro'a mei korban. ra pamadhe rèngu lula parcaya ama lamatua, aa aj'a-nori dhèu taruu lula-nèti lii holo-nori na.

source_text: and they cried with a great voice, and said, how long thou, lord, that art holy and true, deemest thou not, and avengest not our blood of these that dwell in the earth?
target_text: ra pa'oo-parodha, peka na, oo lamatua, ama dhu kapai risi! ama dhu mola-mèci! ji'i parcaya ngaa dhu lamatua peka-padhai. te ngaa ji'i hud'i tatae d'ai pèri lod'o hari, heka lamatua pama'ète lii langu, sèna ka huku dhèu dhu pamadhe ji'i ètu rai-haha nèi?

source_text: and white stoles, for each soul a stole, were given to them; and it was said to them, that they should rest yet a little time, till the number of their fellows and of their brethren be fulfilled, that be to be slain, as also they were.
target_text: ropa rèngu karèi rare sèmi èèna, hèia rèngu èci-èci ka abhu kodho pudhi robho d'ai rai. abhu dhu peka dènge ra, tatae hari ku ciki oo'e, toke miu tesa aa'i. te abhu anga miu era dhu ra pamadhe sèmi miu kahèi.

source_text: and i saw, when he had opened the sixth seal, and lo! a great earth-moving was made; and the sun was made black, as a sackcloth of hair, and all the moon was made as blood.
target_text: ka ana kalèbho ne bhoke segel ka èna. kaca'a laa, ja'a ladhe kèdhi rai-haha ne opo kapai titu kèna. hèia madha lod'o maroga kiu-kiu, nuka sèmi bèla mèdhi, aa hèru mea sama sèmi raa.

source_text: and the stars of heaven felled down on the earth, as a fig tree sendeth his unripe figs, when it is moved of a great wind.
target_text: hua hètu-hua hètu nèti dedha-liru bèbhe mai asa rai-haha, nuka sèmi hua aj'u hoa dhu kabhui, lula lèke ngèlu aae.

source_text: and heaven went away, as a book wrapped in or enfolded; and all the mountains and isles were moved from their places.
target_text: hèia ja'a ladhe, na, liru mae bagi mi dua, ka lulu nuka sèmi dhèpi, toke ele. aa ledhe-ledhe dènge pulu aa'i-aa'i ra gaged'o, toke ele nèti era ra.

source_text: and the kings of the earth, and princes, and tribunes, and rich, and strong, and each bondman, and free man, hid them in dens and stones of hills.
target_text: ropa j'ara se j'aj'i, dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha, mulai nèti dhèu aae-dhèu kapai, komedhaa sordad'u, dhèu kaja-su'i, toke d'ai ènu sèra, aa'i-aa'i ra madha'u titu kèna. ka rai lasi lu'u ètu ro'a-ro'a loe, dènge sasanga-sasanga hadhu ètu ledhe.

source_text: and they say to hills and to stones, fall ye on us, and hide ye us from the face of him that sitteth on the throne, and from the wrath of the lamb;
target_text: dhèu sèra pua ledhe-ledhe aa hadhu aae sèra, peka na, saguru mere ka ji'i laa! pahuni ji'i sèna ka nèngu dhu madhèdi ètu dedha kadera paredha aae èèna, baku nèdhi ji'i. aa ana kalèbho èèna huku ia ka ji'i.

source_text: for the great day of their wrath cometh, and who shall be able to stand?
target_text: ira ii! ji'i laho mae-mae le, te lod'o d'ai mamadhe-mamopo kèna! ama lamatua dènge ana kalèbho èèna, neo dutu nanasa rèngu mi dedha ji'i. te ngaa èci sa bisa boe sili rare, hèia tatu madhe aa'i mèu-mèu!

source_text: after these things i saw four angels standing on the four corners of the earth, holding the four winds of the earth, that they blew not on the earth, neither on the sea, neither on any tree.
target_text: hèia ja'a ladhe kèdhi ana pajuu lamatua dhèu èpa puru mai nèti sorga, titu ètu èpa madha ngèlu ètu rai-haha ne, ho taha ngèlu. ka ngèlu bisa boe tiu asa d'ara dhasi, rai-dedha, dènge aj'u-aj'u.

source_text: and i saw another angel ascending or going up from the rising of the sun, that had a sign of the living god. and he cried with a great voice to the four angels, to which it was given to annoy the earth, and the sea,
target_text: lamatua hia si koasa, ho ra pa'ele iie rai-dedha dènge d'ara dhasi. ka ja'a kèdhi hari ana pajuu dhu leo ca dhèu nèti sorga, mai nèti dhimu. na mai nèti dènge cap ama lamatua dhu mamuri taa-taa. hèia na rodhe mi ana pajuu dhèu èpa sèra, peka na,

source_text: and said, do not ye annoy the earth, and the sea, neither to trees, till we mark the servants of our god in the foreheads of them.
target_text: mate ku! baku pa'ele iie ku rai-dedha, do d'ara dhasi, do aj'u sèra. mate toke ji'i tao ngare ku cap mi katangarèi dhèu unu lamatua sèra.

source_text: and i heard the number of men that were marked, an hundred thousand and four and forty thousand marked, of every lineage of the sons of israel;
target_text: èle èèna ka, rèngu peka dènge ja'a, na, ana pajuu ne tao le tadha mi dhèu unu lamatua sèra. dhèu sèra aa'i-aa'i ra 144. cangasu èpa nguru èpa riho dhèu, dhu mai nèti suku isra'el. nuka:

source_text: of the lineage of judah, twelve thousand marked; of the lineage of reuben, twelve thousand marked; of the lineage of gad, twelve thousand marked;
target_text: nèti suku yahuda, 12. canguru dua riho dhèu; suku ruben, 12. 000 dhèu; suku gad, 12. 000 dhèu;

source_text: of the lineage of aser, twelve thousand marked; of the lineage of nephthalim, twelve thousand marked; of the lineage of manasses, twelve thousand marked;
target_text: suku aser, 12. 000 dhèu; suku naftali, 12. 000 dhèu; suku manase, 12. 000 dhèu;

source_text: of the lineage of simeon, twelve thousand marked; of the lineage of levi, twelve thousand marked; of the lineage of issachar, twelve thousand marked;
target_text: suku simeon, 12. 000 dhèu; suku lewi, 12. 000 dhèu; suku isaskar, 12. 000 dhèu;

source_text: of the lineage of zebulon, twelve thousand marked; of the lineage of joseph, twelve thousand marked; of the lineage of benjamin, twelve thousand marked.
target_text: suku sebulon, 12. 000 dhèu; suku yusuf, 12. 000 dhèu; aa nèti suku benyamin, 12. 000 dhèu.

source_text: after these things i saw a great people, whom no man might number, of all folks, and lineages, and peoples, and languages or tongues, standing before the throne, in the sight of the lamb; and they were clothed with white stoles, and palms were in the hands of them.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ja'a kèdhi dhèu ae titu kèna, dhu ige kore boe. rèngu mai nèti suku aa'i-aa'i, nèti udhu-rasa aa'i-aa'i, nèti kabarai aa'i-aa'i, aa nèti lii aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha. rèngu pakaboko tangara asa kadera paredha, aa asa ana kalèbho kahèi. dhèu sèra pake kodho pudhi, aa ra kèpe dènge rèu palam.

source_text: and they cried with a great voice, and said, health to our god, that sitteth on the throne, and to the lamb.
target_text: ka aa'i-aa'i ra koa-kio, aku rèngu na, ji'i koa-kio ama lamatua ji'i, dhu madhèdi ètu kadera paredha na. ji'i ded'e padedha-dedha ana kalèbho ne kahèi! rèngu se'e ka dhu pala mamuri hia ji'i. rèngu se'e ka dhu bhoke j'ara mamuri hia ji'i.

source_text: and all the angels stood all about the throne, and of the elder men, and the four beasts. and they fell down in the sight of the throne, on their faces, and worshipped god,
target_text: ropa padhai lii rare sèmi èèna, ana pajuu lamatua nèti sorga dhu rai-reo rare kadera paredha ne, patitu kètu urutuu ra, toke rèhu d'ai rai, tangare asa kadera paredha aae ne. katua-katua dènge èpa badha aae sèra, tao madhutu sèmi èèna kahèi. rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra pahaha iisi mi ama lamatua,

source_text: and said, amen! blessing, and clearness, and wisdom, and doing of thankings, and honour, and virtue, and strength to our god, into worlds of worlds. amen.
target_text: aa ra peka na, tare'a! èèna tare'a-re'a! ji'i koa-kio ama lamatua kahèi! ji'i j'oka padedha-dedha kolongara lamatua kahèi! ngangee dènge lii padhai lamatua, dhu lèke mola-mola. koasa lamatua dhu kapai risi eele. a'èra lamatua seli eele. ji'i loe boe manèngi makasi mi ama lamatua. ji'i loe boe pakab'ua lamatua. lèke! tare'a sèmi èèna!

source_text: and one of the elder men answered, and said to me, who be these, that be clothed with white stoles? and from whence came they?
target_text: ropa rèngu koa-kio rare sèmi èèna, hèia nèti dua nguru èpa katua se, èci karèi ja'a, aku nèngu na, dhèu ae-ae dhu pake kodho pudhi se, èu tadha si, do? rèngu se mai nèti mia?

source_text: and i said to him, my lord, thou knowest. and he said to me, these be they, that came from great tribulation, and washed their stoles, and made them white in the blood of the lamb.
target_text: te ngaa ja'a dhaa, peka na, aad'o, ama. ja'a tadhe boe rèngu se, cee. ama ka dhu tadhe risi. ka na peka dènge ja'a, aku nèngu na, rèngu se, dhèu dhu bhodho nèti d'ara j'aj'èra aae. rèngu se, dhèu dhu pake le raa ana kalèbho ne, sèna ka rase mèdha-papake ra, aa tao papudhi kodho ra.

source_text: therefore they be before the throne of god, and serve to him day and night, in his temple. and he that sitteth in the throne, dwelleth on them.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, rèngu titu ètu madha kadera paredha ama lamatua. mèu-mèda rèngu lalau-lalo'o lamatua ètu d'ara èmu manèngi-mangaj'i na. lamatua dènge si taa-taa. lamatua madhenge si taa-taa.

source_text: they shall no more hunger, neither thirst, neither the sun shall fall on them, nor any heat.
target_text: pe rèngu re'a heka manganga. pe rèngu koko-kamango heka. pe madha lod'o pakèpu heka si. pe ka'uri rèngu carici heka lèke lod'o pana.

source_text: for the lamb, that is in the middle of the throne, shall govern them, and shall lead forth them or lead them forth to the wells of waters of life; and god shall wipe away each tear from the eyes of them.
target_text: ana kalèbho dhu padètu dènge kadera paredha èèna, pe nèngu ka j'aj'i dhèu bata-magee kètu rèngu. èèna na nèngu ka eo nèti si, lasi rinu asa madha èi dhu nèti mamuri hia dhèu. pe lamatua saku eele sasusa ra, sèna ka ra tangi ia ka.

source_text: and when he had opened the seventh seal, a silence or silence was made in heaven, as half an hour.
target_text: hèia ana kalèbho ne bhoke segel ka pidhu. kabèdhi laa, aa'i-aa'i ètu sorga kalau-karèto boe. abhu boe lii èci sa, pe d'ai catenga jam sa.

source_text: and i saw seven angels standing in the sight of god, and seven trumps were given to them.
target_text: ka ja'a ladhe kèdhi ana pajuu dhèu pidhu nèti sorga, titu taruu ètu madha ama lamatua, dhu pa'èra lalau ne. rèngu èci-èci ka sèmi rare tèbhe ra.

source_text: and another angel came, and stood before the altar, and had a golden censer; and many incenses were given to him, that he should give of the prayers of all saints on the golden altar, that is before the throne of god.
target_text: ka ana pajuu dhu leo ca dhèu, titu ètu madha mei era tunu raa aj'u hèu mèngi. nèngu dhu nèd'u dènge mago hualaa cue, era isi raa aj'u hèu mèngi. hèia ra hia ne raa aj'u hèu mèngi ae-ae, sèna ka na pab'ali dènge lii manèngi-mangaj'i nèti dhèu unu ama lamatua. ka na nèti mago hualaa, ho tao sèmi korban dhu hèu mèngi, sèna ka la'e tèke asa dedha mei hualaa ètu madha kadera paredha aae.

source_text: and the smoke of the incenses of the prayers of the holy men ascended or went up from the angel's hand before god.
target_text: ka na tunu raa aj'u hèu mèngi ne. hèia hèu mèngi na ca'e asa madha ama lamatua, palere-lere dènge lii manèngi-mangaj'i nèti dhèu unu lamatua.

source_text: and the angel took the censer, and filled it of the fire of the altar, and cast it into the earth. and thunders, and voices, and lightnings were made, and a great earth-moving.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ana pajuu ne nare ai nèti dedha mei ne, la'e tao asa d'ara mago hualaa èèna. hèia na pèci mago ne asa rai-haha. kaca'a laa, ja'a ladhe kèdhi bela kacèb'a lolo aae nèti g'ana-kariu ètu rai-haha. ka lii tea ma'ète boe, aa rai opo kapai titu kèna.

source_text: and the seven angels, that had the seven trumps, made them ready, that they should trump.
target_text: èle ka, ana pajuu dhèu pidhu nèti sorga sèra, pa'èra ho tiu tèbhe ra.

source_text: and the first angel trumped; and hail was made, and fire mingled together in blood; and it was sent into the earth. and the third part of the earth was burnt, and the third part of trees was burnt, and all the green grass was burnt.
target_text: ropa ana pajuu ka èci tiu tèbhe na, hèia èj'i es aa ai pab'ali dènge raa, sabhori mai asa rai-haha. j'u'u aa'i-aa'i ètu mia-mia kèpu-ladhu ai. ca era nèti tèlu era ètu rai-haha ne, kèpu-ladhu ai. aa ca kaboko nèti tèlu kaboko ana aaj'u ètu rai-haha ne, dhu kèpu-ladhu ai kahèi.

source_text: and the second angel trumped; and as a great hill burning with fire was cast into the sea; and the third part of the sea was made blood,
target_text: ropa ana pajuu ka dua tiu tèbhe na, ka mèdha èci sama sèmi ledhe aae cue dhu heo robhe-robhe, pèci la'e asa d'ara dhasi, toke ca era nèti tèlu era ètu d'ara dhasi j'aj'i raa.

source_text: and the third part of creature was dead, that had lives in the sea, and the third part of the ships perished.
target_text: hèia ca kaboko nèti tèlu kaboko badha ètu d'ara dhasi, madhe aa'i mèu-mèu. ca kaboko nèti tèlu kaboko kapa aa'i-aa'i ètu d'ara dhasi, laho eele aa'i si.

source_text: and the third angel trumped; and a great star burning as a little brand, fell from heaven; and it fell into the third part of floods, and into the wells of waters. and the name of the star is said wormwood. and the third part of waters was made into wormwood; and many men were dead of the waters, for those were made bitter.
target_text: ropa ana pajuu ka tèlu tiu tèbhe na, hèia nèti dedha-liru hua-hètu aae cue bèbhe mai, nuka sèmi ob'o kapai aae èci dhu heo. hua-hètu ne, ngara na ‘pèd'u'. ropa na bèbhe mai, èi loko dènge madha èi, j'aj'i pèd'u. hèia nèti dhèu dhu rinu, ae ka dhu madhe. ladhe sèmi loko dènge èi madha ètu rai-haha ne hag'e mi tèlu, na, ca hag'e j'aj'i pèd'u.

source_text: and the fourth angel trumped; and the third part of the sun was smitten, and the third part of the moon, and the third part of the stars, so that the third part of them was darked, and the third part of the day shined not, and also of the night.
target_text: hèia ana pajuu ka èpa tiu tèbhe na. kaca'a laa, madha lod'o, hèru dènge hua-hètu lèke hake, hèia maroga. ladhe re mèu, maroga èpa jam, lula madha lod'o heo iia heka. aa ladhe re mèda, maroga kiu-kiu èpa jam kahèi, lula hèru dènge hua-hètu heo iia heka kahèi.

source_text: and i saw, and heard the voice of an eagle flying by the middle of heaven, and saying with a great voice, woe! woe! woe! to men that dwell in earth, of the other voices of the three angels, that shall trump after.
target_text: èle ka, ja'a doa kètu, ka ladhe kèdhi manea luji ci'u dhu lela dedha titu kèna. na parodha, peka na, kasian! kasian! bèli-camèd'a j'aj'èra kapai lèke dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu mamuri ètu rai-haha. te ana pajuu dhèu tèlu era, dhu tiu mèka tèbhe ra.

source_text: and the fifth angel trumped; and i saw, that a star had fallen down from heaven into earth; and the key of the pit of deepness was given to it.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ana pajuu ka lèmi tiu tèbhe na. hèia ja'a kèdhi hua-hètu cue bèbhe asa rai-haha. ra pangèd'u hua-hètu ne gagoe èci, ho na bhoke babèdho ro'a j'aj'èra dhu marèma na dènge boe too.

source_text: and it or he opened the pit of deepness, and a smoke of the pit went up, as the smoke of a great furnace; and the sun was darked, and the air, of the smoke of the pit.
target_text: lod'o na bhoke nare babèdho ro'a ne, kaca'a laa sèb'u dhu mèdhi guru-guru kalua mai, nuka sèmi sèb'u ai na'e j'ami. sèb'u ne kalua mai dhu kahore-kahore, ca'e la'e asa dedha, ka dedha-liru dènge madha lod'o maroga.

source_text: and locusts went out of the smoke of the pit into earth; and power was given to them, as scorpions of the earth have power.
target_text: hèia kabara ae titu kèna, lela nèti d'ara sèb'u ai ne, ka bèbhe asa rai-haha. ama lamatua dhu pangèd'u le koasa mi rèngu, sama sèmi karakarai.

source_text: and it was commanded to them, that they should not hurt the grass of the earth, neither any green thing, neither any tree, but only men, that have not the sign or the mark of god in their foreheads.
target_text: te ngaa ama lamatua peka dènge si, ho baku pa'ele iie j'u'u, aj'u-aj'u, dènge ana aaj'u ètu rai-haha. te ngaa ra hud'i paj'èra ku dhèu dhu dènge boe tadha lamatua ètu katangarèi ra.

source_text: and it was given to them, that they should not slay them, but that they should be tormented five months; and the tormenting of them, as the tormenting of a scorpion, when he smiteth a man.
target_text: lamatua soro tèke kabara se paj'èra dhèu sèra toke d'ai lèmi hèru, te ngaa bisa boe pamadhe si. dhodhoka tao papèd'a di, sama sèmi karakarai tèpu.

source_text: and in those days men shall seek death, and they shall not find it; and they shall desire to die, and death shall flee from them.
target_text: ètu d'ara lèmi hèru èèna, rarii aa j'èra titu kèna, toke ra manèngi madhe. masi ka sèmi èèna, ra madhe boe.

source_text: and the likeness of locusts be like horses made ready into battle; and on the heads of them as crowns like gold, and the faces of them as the faces of men.
target_text: ja'a ladhe rupa kabara se sama sèmi jara pamusu. rèngu pake solo kapala musu dhu tao nèti hualaa. rèhu ra sama sèmi rèhu dhèu.

source_text: and they had hairs, as the hairs of women; and the teeth of them were as the teeth of lions.
target_text: rèu kètu ra madhera èci èèna ka dènge rèu kètu dhèu bhèni. ngutu ra mariu sèmi ngutu singa.

source_text: and they had habergeons, as iron habergeons, and the voice of their wings as the voice of chariots of many horses running to battle.
target_text: rèngu se oe sèmi pake kodho bèsi ètu sangasa ra. lii kahaku èla ra mèdhu sama sèmi jara sordad'u ae titu kèna dhu ère kareta pamusu ra.

source_text: and they had tails like scorpions, and pricks were in the tails of them; and the might of them was to annoy men five months.
target_text: rèu lai ra èra titu kèna, aa dhu dènge raco nuka sèmi raco karakarai. rèngu se abhu koasa, ho paj'èra dhèu pake raco ra, toke d'ai lèmi hèru.

source_text: and they had on them a king, the angel of deepness, to whom the name in hebrew is abaddon, but by greek apollyon, and by latin he hath a name exterminus, that is, destroyer.
target_text: dhèu aae kabara se, nuka kètu nèti rèngu aa'i-aa'i dhu ra babège si nèti d'ara ro'a j'aj'èra dhu dènge boe too-lane. ngara na ètu d'ara lii ibrani, abadon, aa madhutu lii yunani, apolion. sasoa na, dhu d'èi pa'ele iie.

source_text: one woe is passed, and lo! yet come two woes.
target_text: dènge j'ara ne'e, seli le j'aj'èra ka èci. te ngaa baku pamud'e! te dua j'aj'èra dhu leo era, dhu bèli-camèd'a j'aj'i hari.

source_text: after these things also the sixth angel trumped; and i heard a voice from the four corners of the golden altar, that is before the eyes of god,
target_text: ka ana pajuu ka èna tiu tèbhe na. hèia ja'a kèdhi mei hualaa, era dhu pake tunu raa aj'u hèu mèngi, dhu patangara dènge lamatua. ka lii èci kalua nèti èpa tadhu ètu kabicu mei èèna,

source_text: and said to the sixth angel that had a trump, unbind thou the four angels, that be bound in the great flood euphrates.
target_text: ho peka dènge ana pajuu dhu heka tiu nare tèbhe na, abhu ana pajuu dhèu èpa, dhu nèbhu nare sange ne'e lèke èki ètu d'ara loko aae èci, dhu ngara na efrat. lamu patabuli eele si!

source_text: and the four angels were unbound, which were ready into hour, and day, and month, and year, to slay the third part of men.
target_text: hèia la'e patabuli si, sèna ka ana pajuu èpa se lasi pamadhe dhèu, dhu lèke dènge tèu na, hèru na, lod'o na, dènge jam na, dhu lamatua pama'ète nare le. ladhe èdhi bagi dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne mi tèlu kaboko, na, dhu madhe, ca kaboko.

source_text: and the number of the host of horsemen was twenty thousand times ten thousand. and i heard the number of them.
target_text: rèngu peka dènge ja'a, na, sordad'u ana pajuu dhu ca'e jara pamusu sèra aa'i-aa'i ra, dua ngasu juta dhèu.

source_text: and so i saw horses in vision; and they that sat on them had fiery habergeons, and of jacinth, and of brimstone. and the heads of the horses were as the heads of lions; and fire, and smoke, and brimstone, cometh forth of the mouth of them.
target_text: hèia ja'a ladhe kèdhi sordad'u dènge jara ra. sordad'u se dhu pake kodho bèsi pa'abhe sangasa ra. kodho se nuka, dhu mea gèu-gèu, mangèru kale'e, dènge karara oe sèmi èi nasu. rupa kètu jara se, sama sèmi kètu singa. nèti hèb'a jara se, kalua ai, sèb'u, aa èi nasu,

source_text: of these three plagues the third part of men was slain, of the fire, and of the smoke, and of the brimstone, that came out of the mouth of them.
target_text: ho hia j'aj'èra tèlu rupa asa rai-haha, toke dhèu ètu rai-haha ne madhe aa'i ca kaboko nèti tèlu kaboko.

source_text: for the power of the horses is in the mouth of them, and in the tails of them; for the tails of them be like to serpents, having heads, and in them they annoy.
target_text: èle èèna, hèia jara se lasi paj'èra dhèu pake hèb'a dènge rèu lai ra. ètu rèu lai ra, abhu kètu sèmi kètu mege.

source_text: and the other men, that were not slain in these plagues, neither did penance of the works of their hands, that they worshipped not devils, and simulacra of gold, and of silver, and of brass, and of stone, and of tree, which neither may see, neither hear, neither wander;
target_text: te ngaa abhu dhèu cahag'e ètu rai-haha, dhu ra pamadhe boe nèti j'aj'èra se'e. masi ka sèmi èèna, rèngu neo boe tèke eele bhabhelu-katub'a ra. rèngu sogo-tagu taruu nidhu aa mèdha-panyau dhu ra tao nèti hualaa, doi pudhi, tabaga, hadhu, dènge aj'u. masi ka mèdha se bisa boe rèdhi ngaa-ngaa, bisa boe tadèngi ngaa-ngaa, aa bisa boe kako, te ngaa ra loe boe sogo-tagu si.

source_text: and they did not penance of their manslayings, neither of their witchcrafts, neither of their fornication, neither of their thefts, were slain.
target_text: dhèu se'e ro'o boe loe kahèi nèti sasala dhu leo, nuka sèmi pamadhe dhèu, pake na'i nidhu, tao j'ara karehe dènge dhèu dhu j'aj'i boe dhèu èmu-kamali ra, aa mana'u pagogo-pagero.

source_text: and i saw another strong angel coming down from heaven, clothed with a cloud, and the rainbow on his head; and the face of him was as the sun, and the feet of him as a pillar of fire.
target_text: hèia ja'a ladhe kèdhi ana pajuu lamatua dhu kapai èci puru mai nèti sorga. ra'i-liru sarimu nare ngi'u na. kètu na dhu poi dènge saroo. rèhu na heo sama sèmi madha lod'o, aa haga na heo èci èèna ka dènge heo ai.

source_text: and he had in his hand a little book opened; and he set his right foot on the sea, and the left foot on the earth.
target_text: nèngu ne kèpe dènge lalulu sasuri iiki, dhu bhoke tèke. na titu, haga g'ana na ètu d'ara dhasi, haga kariu na ètu dedha-rai.

source_text: and he cried with a great voice, as a lion when he roareth; and when he had cried, the seven thunders spake their voices.
target_text: hèia na pa'oo-parodha, sèmi lii taraa singa. ropa na pa'oo-parodha nare, hèia d'oro lii pagod'o-god'o pidhu hari.

source_text: and when the seven thunders had spoken their voices, i was to write. and i heard a voice from heaven, saying, mark thou what things the seven thunders spake, and do not thou write them.
target_text: ropa d'oro lii, ka ja'a neo suri lii padhai ra. te ngaa ja'a tadèngi lii èci nèti sorga, peka na, èu baku lolo dènge dhèu lii padhai lula-nèti pidhu d'oro se'e! mage mu suri ngaa-ngaa kahèi.

source_text: and the angel whom i saw standing above the sea, and above the earth, lifted up his hand to heaven,
target_text: ka ana pajuu dhu titu haga calaa ètu dedha-rai, aa haga calaa ètu d'ara dhasi èèna, j'oka ai g'ana na asa dedha-liru,

source_text: and swore by him that liveth into worlds of worlds, that made of nought heaven, and those things that be in it, and the earth, and those things that be in it, and the sea, and those things that be in it, that time shall no more be.

'

'

source_text: and the voice of harps, and of men of music, and singing with pipe and trump, shall no more be heard in it. and each craftsman, and each craft, shall no more be found in it. and the voice of a millstone shall no more be heard in thee,

source_text: joy we, and make we mirth, or joy we withinforth, and glad we withoutforth, and give glory to him; for the weddings of the lamb came, and the wife of him made ready herself.

source_text: and i saw an angel coming down from heaven, having the key of deepness, and a great chain in his hand.

source_text: blessed be they, that wash their stoles, that the power of them be in the tree of life, and enter by the gates into the city.
target_text: dhèu dhu rase pamèu le mèdha-papake ra, rèngu ka dhu oto. te rèngu ka abhu hak ho maso re babèdho kapai dhu la'e asa d'ara kota ne. dhèu dhu mamuri mola, rèngu ka dhu oto. te bèli-camèd'a rèngu abhu ijin ho ra'a hua dhu hia dhèu mamuri taa-taa.

source_text: for withoutforth shall be shut hounds, and witches, and unchaste men, and man-quellers, and serving to idols, and each that loveth and maketh leasing or lies.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu leo bisa boe maso asa era èèna. dhèu dhu unu boe lamatua, bisa boe pea ètu era èèna. nuka rèngu dhu parcaya boe lamatua, dhèu dhu tao j'ara makae dènge dhèu dhu j'aj'i boe dhèu èmu-kamali ra, tuka sogo-tagu, tuka pamadhe dhèu, tuka suagi, dènge rèngu dhu leko-monya. rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra bisa boe ara asa d'ara. rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra pea dhoka mi li'u di.

source_text: i jesus sent mine angel, to witness to you these things in churches. i am the root and kin of david, and the shining morrow star.
target_text: ja'a ne, yesus. ja'a ka dhu paleha ana pajuu ja'a nèti sorga, ho bhoke j'ara se'e aa'i-aa'i ra, sèna ka pe miu lami lole peka lii pajaji ja'a se'e mi pidhu juma'at sèra. ja'a ne, ana-èpu dhèu aae daud. ja'a ne, dhèu aae dhu kèd'u paredha. saraa nèti ja'a heo lo'a-lo'a, nuka sèmi hua-hètu oe mèu. saraa nèti ja'a madèka titu kèna, nuka sèmi hua-hètu èèna.

source_text: and the spirit and the spousess or the wife say, come thou. and he that heareth, say, come thou; and he that thirsteth, come; and he that will, take he freely the water of life.
target_text: roh ama lamatua mai paroa, peka na, mai asa ne'e! bhèni dhu neo kab'i paroa kahèi, peka na, mai ka! aa'i-aa'i dhu tadèngi peka kahèi, mai ka! dhèu cee dhu koko-kamango, mai ho minu! dhèu cee dhu neo ninu èi dhu nèti mamuri, mai mere ka! dhèu bisa rare èi ne dhu iia-iia d'ara. dhèu bisa rinu èi ne dhu b'ae boe.

source_text: and i witness to each man hearing the words of prophecy of this book, if any man shall put to these things, god shall put on him the vengeances or the plagues written in this book.
target_text: ja'a, yohanis, pasanèd'e dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu èèna na tadèngi ngaa dhu ama lamatua bhoke mema hia ja'a ètu d'ara sasuri ne: ladhe abhu dhèu dhu patabha hari ngaa-ngaa ètu d'ara sasuri ne, èèna na ama lamatua pabie hari hahuku na mi nèngu dènge pidhu calaka sèra dhu na dutu mai asa rai-haha.

source_text: and if any man shall do away of the words of the book of this prophecy, god shall take away the part of him from the book of life, and from the holy city, and from these things that be written in this book.
target_text: aa ladhe abhu dhu pakura hari isi sasuri ne, pe ama lamatua tao eele hak nèngu, sèna ka bisa boe maso asa d'ara kota dhu mola-mèci, aa bisa boe na'a hua aj'u dhu hia dhèu mamuri taa-taa.

source_text: he saith, that beareth witnessing of these things, yea, amen. lo! i come soon. amen. come thou, lord jesus.
target_text: yesus mesa na ka dhu bhoke j'ara aa'i-aa'i sèra. na moa le, peka na, tare'a-re'a sèmi èèna! nèbhu heka, ja'a neo dhiu. de mai ka, lamatua yesus!

source_text: the grace of our lord jesus christ be with you all. amen.
target_text: ja'a manèngi sèna ka lamatua yesus pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi dhèu unu na aa'i-aa'i. lèke tare'a sèmi èèna! amin! nèti ja'a, yohanis
